NOT FULL ONLY 85%!!!
local function resolveInstancePath(pathTable)
	local current = pathTable[1] or game
	for i = 2, 7 do
		local segment = pathTable[i]
		if segment and current and current[segment] then
			current = current[segment]
		end
	end
	return current
end

local function getUpvalue(cell)
	if cell and cell[1] and cell[3] ~= nil then
		return cell[1][cell[3]]
	end
	return cell
end

local function setUpvalue(cell, value)
	if cell and cell[1] and cell[3] ~= nil then
		cell[1][cell[3]] = value
	end
	return value
end

local function isAlive(cell)
	local target = getUpvalue(cell)
	if type(target) == "function" then
		local ok, res = pcall(target)
		return ok and res ~= false and res ~= nil
	end
	return target ~= false and target ~= nil
end

local PulseModules = {}

-- =========================================================================

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Display - Map Voting Helper
-- KEY: d
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["d"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F = G[0], G[2], G[1]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
		A(F.Idled, function()
			if a.afk and a.afk.on then
				pcall(function()
					G:CaptureController()
					G:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
end

		local function f(R)
			local B = {}
			for U in (R .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
				B[#B + 1] = U
			end
			while #B > 0 and B[#B] == "" do
				table.remove(B)
			end
			while #B > 0 and B[1] == "" do
				table.remove(B, 1)
			end
			return B
		end
		local function R(B)
			local U, M = f(B.art), f(B.map)
			local B = {}
			for c, K in ipairs(U) do
				local w = M[c] or ""
				local M = {}
				local c, L = 1, #K
				while c <= L do
					local W = w:sub(c, c)
					local V = c
					while V < L and w:sub(V + 1, V + 1) == W do
						V += 1
					end
					local w = K:sub(c, V):gsub("%*", "•")
					local K = G.COL[W]
					M[#M + 1] = K and '<font color="' .. K .. '">' .. w .. "</font>" or w
					c = V + 1
				end
				B[#B + 1] = table.concat(M)
			end
			return table.concat(B, "\n"), #U
		end
		local function B()
			if G.lbl and G.lbl.Parent then
				return G.lbl
			end
			local U = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
			local M = U and U:FindFirstChild("MainLobby") and U.MainLobby:FindFirstChild("Parts")
			if M then
				for c, c in ipairs(M:GetChildren()) do
					local M = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
					local c = M and M:FindFirstChild("Title")
					if c and c:IsA("TextLabel") and (c.Text == G.orig or c.Text == G.text) then
						return c
					end
				end
			end
			if U and os.clock() - G.lastScan > 30 then
				G.lastScan = os.clock()
				for M, M in ipairs(U:GetDescendants()) do
					if M:IsA("TextLabel") and (M.Text == G.orig or M.Text == G.text) then
						return M
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function U()
			local M = {}
			for c, c in ipairs(X:GetPlayers()) do
				if c.Character then
					M[#M + 1] = c.Character
				end
			end
			for c, c in pairs(G.parts) do
				if c then
					M[#M + 1] = c
				end
			end
			return M
		end
		local function M(c, K, w)
			local L = RaycastParams.new()
			L.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local W = U()
			for V = 1, 10 do
				L.FilterDescendantsInstances = W
				local V = workspace:Raycast(c, -K * 40, L)
				if not V then
					return nil
				end
				local L = (V.Position - c):Dot(-K)
				if V.Instance.Transparency < 0.9 and V.Normal:Dot(K) > 0.7 and L >= (w or 0) then
					return L
				end
				W[#W + 1] = V.Instance
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function c(K)
			K = Vector3.new(K.X, 0, K.Z)
			return K.Magnitude > 0.1 and K.Unit or nil
		end
		G.PIECES[1].spot = function()
			local K = B()
			local w = K and K:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
			local K = w and w.Parent
			if not (K and K:IsA("BasePart")) then
				return nil
			end
			local w = c(K.CFrame.RightVector)
			if not w then
				return nil
			end
			local L = K.Position + Vector3.new(0, 11.3, 0)
			local K = M(L + w * 0.5, w) or 9.92
			return L + w * 0.5 - w * (K - 0.03), w
		end
		G.PIECES[2].spot = function(K, w)
			local L = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
			local W = L and L:FindFirstChild("RadioBoard")
			local L = W and W:FindFirstChild("Screen")
			if not (L and L:IsA("BasePart")) then
				return nil
			end
			local W = c(L.CFrame.LookVector)
			local V = c(L.CFrame.RightVector)
			if not (W and V) then
				return nil
			end
			local r = L.Position + Vector3.new(0, 8.4, 0) - V * 5.2
			local L
			for _ = -4.0, 4 do
				for q = -2.0, 2 do
					local u = r + V * (_ * (K / 2 - 0.4) / 4) + Vector3.new(0, q * (w / 2 - 0.3) / 2, 0) + W * 0.5
					local K = M(u, W, 3)
					if K and (not L or K < L) then
						L = K
					end
				end
			end
			if not L then
				return nil
			end
			return r + W * 0.5 - W * (L - 0.03), W
		end

		function G.b64(M)
			for K, K in ipairs({ crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }) do
				if type(K) == "function" then
					local w, L = pcall(K, M)
					if w and type(L) == "string" and #L > 0 then
						return L
					end
				end
			end
			local K = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
			local w = {}
			for L = 1, 64 do
				w[K:byte(L)] = L - 1
			end
			local K = {}
			for L = 1, #M - 3, 4 do
				local W, V, r, _ = M:byte(L, L + 3)
				local L = (w[W] or 0) * 262144 + (w[V] or 0) * 4096 + (w[r] or 0) * 64 + (w[_] or 0)
				K[#K + 1] = string.char(L // 65536, L // 256 % 256, L % 256)
			end
			local w = table.concat(K)
			if M:sub(-2.0) == "==" then
				w = w:sub(1, -3.0)
			elseif M:sub(-1.0) == "=" then
				w = w:sub(1, -2.0)
			end
			return w
		end
		function G.hqAsset(M)
			G.hqA = G.hqA or {}
			if G.hqA[M] then
				return G.hqA[M]
			end
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local K = "PulseHub/troll_hq_v1_" .. M .. ".png"
			pcall(function()
				if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
					makefolder("PulseHub")
				end
				if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(K)) then
					local w = G.HQ[M]
					if type(w) == "string" and #w < 64 then
						local L = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseData")
						w = L and L.take(w) or nil
					end
					if type(w) ~= "string" or #w < 64 then
						return
					end
					writefile(K, G.b64(w))
				end
				local w = getcustomasset(K)
				if type(w) == "string" and #w > 0 then
					G.hqA[M] = w
				end
			end)
			return G.hqA[M]
		end
		function G.buildHQ(M)
			if #G.HQ < 4 then
				return false
			end
			local K = {}
			for w = 1, 4 do
				K[w] = G.hqAsset(w)
				if not K[w] then
					return false
				end
			end
			local w = M.height
			local L = w
			local W, V = M.spot(L, w)
			if not W then
				return true
			end
			local r = Instance.new("Model")
			r.Name = M.name
			local _ = CFrame.lookAt(W, W + V)
			local W, V = L / 2, w / 2
			for w = 0, 1 do
				for L = 0, 1 do
					local q = Instance.new("Part")
					q.Name = "Tile" .. w * 2 + L + 1
					q.Anchored, q.CanCollide, q.CanQuery, q.CanTouch, q.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
					q.Transparency = 1
					q.Size = Vector3.new(W, V, 0.05)
					q.CFrame = _ * CFrame.new((0.5 - L) * W, (0.5 - w) * V, 0)
					local W = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
					W.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
					W.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
					W.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(896, 896)
					W.LightInfluence = 0
					W.Brightness = 1.15
					W.ZOffset = 1
					W.ResetOnSpawn = false
					W.Parent = q
					local V = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
					V.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					V.BorderSizePixel = 0
					V.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					V.Image = K[w * 2 + L + 1]
					V.Parent = W
					q.Parent = r
				end
			end
			r.Parent = workspace
			G.parts[M.name] = r
			return true
		end
		G.GORDER = { "P", "U", "L", "S", "E", "D", "A", "T", "*" }
		local function M()
			if G.gm ~= nil then
				return G.gm
			end
			G.gm = false
			local K
			for w, w in ipairs({ crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }) do
				if type(w) == "function" then
					local L, W = pcall(w, G.GLYPHS)
					if L and type(W) == "string" and #W == #G.GORDER * 360 then
						K = W
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if not K then
				local w = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
				local L = {}
				for W = 1, 64 do
					L[w:byte(W)] = W - 1
				end
				local w, W = G.GLYPHS, {}
				for V = 1, #w - 3, 4 do
					local r, _, q, u = w:byte(V, V + 3)
					local V = (L[r] or 0) * 262144 + (L[_] or 0) * 4096 + (L[q] or 0) * 64 + (L[u] or 0)
					W[#W + 1] = string.char(V // 65536, V // 256 % 256, V % 256)
				end
				K = table.concat(W)
				if w:sub(-2.0) == "==" then
					K = K:sub(1, -3.0)
				elseif w:sub(-1.0) == "=" then
					K = K:sub(1, -2.0)
				end
				if #K ~= #G.GORDER * 360 then
					return false
				end
			end
			local w = {}
			for L, W in ipairs(G.GORDER) do
				w[W] = { f = (L - 1) * 360, s = (L - 1) * 360 + 180 }
			end
			G.graw, G.gm = buffer.fromstring(K), w
			return w
		end
		local K = PULSE_NV(function(w, L, W, V)
			local r = M()
			if not r then
				return nil
			end
			local M = game:GetService("AssetService")
			local _ = G.graw
			local q, u = buffer.readu8, buffer.writeu8
			local s = {}
			local h = math.ceil(W / 1024)
			local Y = math.ceil(W / h)
			local l = os.clock()
			local function x()
				if os.clock() - l > 0.004 then
					task.wait()
					l = os.clock()
				end
			end
			for l = 1, h do
				local h = (l - 1) * Y
				local l = math.min(Y, W - h)
				local W, Y = pcall(function()
					return M:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(l, V) })
				end)
				if not W or not Y then
					for M, M in ipairs(s) do
						pcall(function()
							M.img:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					return nil
				end
				local M = l * V
				local W, S, k = buffer.create(M), buffer.create(M), buffer.create(M)
				for y = 1, #w do
					local Q, E = w[y], L[y] or ""
					local w = (y - 1) * 12 - 1
					for L = 1, #Q do
						local y = Q:sub(L, L)
						local Q = y ~= " " and r[y]
						local r = (L - 1) * 8 - 1 - h
						if Q and r > -10.0 and r < l then
							local y = E:sub(L, L) == "w" and 2 or 1
							for L = 0, 17 do
								local E = w + L
								if E >= 0 and E < V then
									local w, I = E * l, L * 10
									for L = 0, 9 do
										local E = r + L
										if E >= 0 and E < l then
											local r = w + E
											local w = q(_, Q.s + I + L)
											if w > q(W, r) then
												u(W, r, w)
											end
											local w = q(_, Q.f + I + L)
											if w > 0 then
												local L = q(S, r)
												if w >= L then
													u(k, r, y)
												end
												u(S, r, w + L * (255 - w) // 255)
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					x()
				end
				local w = buffer.create(M * 4)
				for L = 0, M - 1 do
					local M = q(S, L) / 255
					local r = q(W, L) / 255 * 0.45
					local W = M + r * (1 - M)
					if W > 0.002 then
						local _ = r * (1 - M)
						local r = L * 4
						if q(k, L) == 2 then
							u(w, r, math.floor((255 * M + 40 * _) / W + 0.5))
							u(w, r + 1, math.floor(255 * M / W + 0.5))
							u(w, r + 2, math.floor(255 * M / W + 0.5))
						else
							u(w, r, math.floor((255 * M + 40 * _) / W + 0.5))
							u(w, r + 1, math.floor(43 * M / W + 0.5))
							u(w, r + 2, math.floor(43 * M / W + 0.5))
						end
						u(w, r + 3, math.floor(W * 255 + 0.5))
					end
					if L % 40000 == 0 then
						x()
					end
				end
				local M = pcall(function()
					Y:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(l, V), w)
				end)
				if not M then
					pcall(function()
						Y:Destroy()
					end)
					for M, M in ipairs(s) do
						pcall(function()
							M.img:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					return nil
				end
				s[#s + 1] = { img = Y, x0 = h, w = l }
			end
			return s
		end)
		local function M(w)
			if w.building then

					end)

		local function L(W)
			return a.tr(W)
		end
		local function a(W, V)
			local r = Instance.new("UICorner")
			r.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, V)
			r.Parent = W
			return r
		end
		local function W(V)
			return Font.new(w.FONT, V or Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
		end
		function w.cfg()
			if type(J.npc) ~= "table" then
				J.npc = {}
			end
			local V = J.npc
			if V.on == nil then
				V.on = true
			end
			if V.dances == nil then
				V.dances = true
			end
			if tonumber(V.volume) == nil then
				V.volume = 100
			end
			return V
		end
		function w.soundGroup()
			if w.sgrp and w.sgrp.Parent then
				return w.sgrp
			end
			local J = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
			J.Name = "PulseNpcSounds"
			J.Volume = math.clamp((tonumber(w.cfg().volume) or 100) / 100, 0, 1)
			J.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
			w.sgrp = J
			return J
		end
		function w.setVolume(J)
			w.cfg().volume = math.clamp(tonumber(J) or 100, 0, 100)
			pcall(function()
				w.soundGroup().Volume = w.cfg().volume / 100
			end)
		end
		local function J(V, r, _)
			local q = Instance.new(V)
			for u, s in pairs(r) do
				q[u] = s
			end
			if V == "Sound" then
				pcall(function()
					q.SoundGroup = w.soundGroup()
				end)
			end
			if _ then
				q.Parent = _
			end
			return q
		end
		local function V()
			return gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end
		local function r(_, q)
			pcall(function()
				local u = J("Sound", { SoundId = _, Volume = q or 0.4 }, game:GetService("SoundService"))
				u:Play()
				task.delay(3, function()
					pcall(function()
						u:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end
		function w.myRoot()
			local _ = t.Character
			return _ and _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		function w.voiceInit()
			if #w.voices > 0 and w.voices[1].Parent then
				return
			end
			w.voices = {}
			local _ = game:GetService("SoundService")
			for q, q in ipairs(w.VOICE) do
				for u = 1, 2 do
					w.voices[#w.voices + 1] = J("Sound", {
						Name = "PulseNpcVoice",
						SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. q,
						Volume = 0,
					}, _)
				end
			end
			w.vi = 0
		end
		function w.syllable()
			w.voiceInit()
			w.vi = w.vi % #w.voices + 1
			local _ = w.voices[w.vi]
			if not _ or _.TimeLength <= 0.3 then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				_:Stop()
				_.PlaybackSpeed = 1.08 + math.random() * 0.28
				_.TimePosition = math.random() * math.max(0, _.TimeLength - 0.3)
				_.Volume = 0.55
				_:Play()
				local q = 0.085 + math.random() * 0.06
				task.delay(q, function()
					if not _.Parent then
						return
					end
					f:Create(_, TweenInfo.new(0.05), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
					task.delay(0.06, function()
						if _.Volume <= 0.01 then
							pcall(function()
								_:Stop()
							end)
						end
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end
		function w.loadAnims(_)
			w.anims = {}
			local q = _:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or J("Animator", {}, _)
			for _, u in pairs(w.ANIM) do
				pcall(function()
					local s = q:LoadAnimation(J("Animation", { AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. u }))
					s.Looped = (_ == "idle")
					s.Priority = (_ == "idle" or _ == "look") and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
						or Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
					w.anims[_] = s
				end)
			end
			if w.anims.idle then
				w.anims.idle:Play(0.3)
			end
		end
		function w.gesture(_)
			local q = _ and w.anims[_]
			if not q then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				for u, s in pairs(w.anims) do
					if u ~= "idle" and u ~= _ and s.IsPlaying then
						s:Stop(0.25)
					end
				end
				q.Looped = false
				q:Play(0.2)
				task.delay(_ == "laugh" and 2.2 or 2.4, function()
					pcall(function()
						if q.IsPlaying then
							q:Stop(0.4)
						end
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end
		function w.build()
			local _ = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
			local q = _ and _:FindFirstChild("RadioBoard")
			local _ = q and q:FindFirstChild("Screen")
			if not (_ and _:IsA("BasePart")) then
				return
			end
			local q = c(_.CFrame.LookVector)
			local u = c(_.CFrame.RightVector)
			if not (q and u) then
				return
			end
			local c = _.Position - u * 18.2 - q * 0.7
			local _ = RaycastParams.new()
			_.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			_.FilterDescendantsInstances = U()
			local u = workspace:Raycast(c + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30.0, 0), _)
			if not u then
				return
			end
			local _ = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 236)
			local s = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
			s.HeadColor, s.TorsoColor, s.LeftArmColor, s.RightArmColor, s.LeftLegColor, s.RightLegColor =
				_, _, _, _, _, _
			s.HatAccessory = w.HAT
			s.Shirt = w.SHIRT
			s.Pants = w.PANTS
			local _, h = pcall(function()
				return X:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(s, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
			end)
			if not _ or not h then
				s.HatAccessory, s.Shirt, s.Pants = "", 0, 0
				_, h = pcall(function()
					return X:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(s, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
				end)
				if not _ or not h then
					return
				end
			end
			h.Name = "PulseNpc"
			local X = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local _ = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local s = h:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not (X and _ and s) then
				h:Destroy()
				return
			end
			X.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
			X.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
			for Y, Y in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
				if Y:IsA("BasePart") then
					Y.CanCollide, Y.CanQuery, Y.CanTouch = false, false, false
				end
			end
			_.Anchored = true
			local Y
			for l, l in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
				if l:IsA("Accessory") then
					local x = l:FindFirstChild("Handle")
					if x then
						Y = x
					end
				end
			end
			for l, l in ipairs(s:GetChildren()) do
				if l:IsA("Decal") then
					l:Destroy()
				end
			end
			s.Transparency = 1
			if not Y then
				local l = J("Part", {
					Name = "TrollHead",
					Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1),
					Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
					CanCollide = false,
					CanQuery = false,
					CanTouch = false,
					Massless = true,
				})
				J("SpecialMesh", { MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Head, Scale = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5) }, l)
				J("Decal", { Name = "face", Face = Enum.NormalId.Front, Texture = w.FACE }, l)
				l.CFrame = s.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.22, 0)
				J("WeldConstraint", { Part0 = l, Part1 = s }, l)
				l.Parent = h
				Y = l
			end
			local l = u.Position.Y + X.HipHeight + _.Size.Y / 2
			w.home = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(c.X, l, c.Z), Vector3.new(c.X, l, c.Z) + q)
			h:PivotTo(w.home)
			h.Parent = workspace
			local c = Y.Position.Y + Y.Size.Y / 2 - _.Position.Y
			w.model, w.hrp, w.hum = h, _, X
			w.neck = s:FindFirstChild("Neck")
			G.parts.PulseNpc = h
			w.loadAnims(X)
			w.tagUi(_, math.clamp(c, 1.6, 4) + 0.35)
			local X = J("ProximityPrompt", {
				Name = "Talk",
				ActionText = L("Talk"),
				ObjectText = w.name,
				KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.G,
				HoldDuration = 0,
				MaxActivationDistance = 10,
				RequiresLineOfSight = false,
				Style = Enum.ProximityPromptStyle.Custom,
			}, _)
			w.prompt = X
			A(X.Triggered, function()
				task.spawn(w.open)
			end)
			A(X.PromptShown, function()
				w.promptUi(true)
			end)
			A(X.PromptHidden, function()
				w.promptUi(false)
			end)
		end
		local function X(c)
			c = math.clamp(c, 0, 1)
			return 1 - (1 - c) ^ 3
		end
		local function c(_, q, u, s, h)
			local Y = f:Create(_, TweenInfo.new(q, s or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, h or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), u)
			Y:Play()
			return Y
		end
		local function _()
			return L("GUIDE") .. "  ·  PULSE HUB"
		end
		function w.vp()
			local q = workspace.CurrentCamera
			return q and q.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1000)
		end
		function w.safe()
			local q, u, s = 0, 0, 0
			pcall(function()
				local h = V()
				local Y = w.probe
				if not (Y and Y.Parent) then
					Y = J("ScreenGui", {
						Name = "PulseNpcSafe",
						ResetOnSpawn = false,
						IgnoreGuiInset = true,
						ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets,
						DisplayOrder = -10.0,
					})
					J("Frame", { Name = "Area", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Y)
					Y.Parent = h
					w.probe = Y
				end
				local h = w.vp()
				local l = Y:FindFirstChild("Area")
				if h and l and h.X > 0 then
					local Y, x = l.AbsolutePosition, l.AbsoluteSize
					q = math.max(0, Y.X)
					u = math.max(0, h.X - (Y.X + x.X))
					s = math.max(0, h.Y - (Y.Y + x.Y))
				end
			end)
			w.safeL, w.safeR, w.safeB = q, u, s
			return q, u, s
		end
		function w.leftPos(q)
			return UDim2.new(0.07, w.safeL or 0, 0.93, (q or -18.0) - (w.safeB or 0))
		end
		function w.fit()
			local q = w.vp()
			w.fitVP = q
			local u = math.clamp(math.min(q.X / 1760, q.Y / 940), 0.5, 1.45)
			for q, q in ipairs(w.scales or {}) do
				q.Scale = u
			end
			local q, q, u = w.safe()
			if w.left then
				w.left.Position = w.leftPos(-18.0)
			end
			if w.opts then
				w.opts.Position = UDim2.new(0.955, -q, 0.93, -18.0 - u)
			end
		end
		function w.b64(q)
			for u, u in ipairs({ crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode }) do
				if type(u) == "function" then
					local s, h = pcall(u, q)
					if s and type(h) == "string" and #h > 200 then
						return h
					end
				end
			end
		end
		function w.icons()
			if w.iconAsset ~= nil then
				return w.iconAsset
			end
			w.iconAsset = false
			pcall(function()
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				local q
				for u, u in ipairs({
					crypt and crypt.base64decode,
					base64decode,
					base64_decode,
					base64 and base64.decode,
				}) do
					if type(u) == "function" then
						local s, h = pcall(u, w.ICONS)
						if s and type(h) == "string" and #h > 200 then
							q = h
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if not q then
					return
				end
				pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
				writefile("PulseHub/npc_icons_v1.png", q)
				local q, u = pcall(getcustomasset, "PulseHub/npc_icons_v1.png")
				if q and type(u) == "string" and u ~= "" then
					w.iconAsset = u
				end
			end)
			return w.iconAsset
		end
		function w.hideScan(q)
			local function u(s, h)
				if not s then
					return
				end
				for Y, Y in ipairs(s:GetChildren()) do
					if not w.KEEP[Y.Name] and not q.set[Y] then
						local s = Y:IsA("ScreenGui") or h and (Y:IsA("BillboardGui") or Y:IsA("Highlight"))
						if s and Y.Enabled then
							q.set[Y] = true
							q.guis[#q.guis + 1] = Y
							Y.Enabled = false
						end
					end
				end
			end
			u(t:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), false)
			pcall(function()
				u(V(), true)
			end)
		end
		function w.hideOn()
			local q = game:GetService("StarterGui")
			local u = w.hid
			if u then
				u.off = false
				if u.back then
					u.back = false
					for s, s in ipairs(u.core) do
						pcall(q.SetCoreGuiEnabled, q, s, false)
					end
					for s, s in ipairs(u.fx) do
						pcall(function()
							s.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
				return
			end
			u = { guis = {}, set = {}, core = {}, fx = {}, ltm = {}, camSeen = {}, a = 0, off = false, scanAt = 0 }
			w.hid = u
			w.hideScan(u)
			for s, s in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
				if s ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
					local h, Y = pcall(q.GetCoreGuiEnabled, q, s)
					if h and Y then
						u.core[#u.core + 1] = s
						pcall(q.SetCoreGuiEnabled, q, s, false)
					end
				end
			end
			local function q(s)
				if s:IsA("BasePart") or s:IsA("Decal") then
					if u.ltm[s] == nil then
						u.ltm[s] = s.LocalTransparencyModifier
					end
				elseif
					(
						s:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
						or s:IsA("Trail")
						or s:IsA("Beam")
						or s:IsA("Fire")
						or s:IsA("Smoke")
						or s:IsA("Sparkles")
					) and s.Enabled
				then
					u.fx[#u.fx + 1] = s
					s.Enabled = false
				end
			end
			u.grab = q
			local s = t.Character
			if s then
				for h, h in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
					q(h)
				end
			end
			w.hideCam(u)
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcHide")
			end)
			R:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcHide", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function(q)
				pcall(w.hideStep, q)
			end)
		end
		function w.selfPts()
			local q = t.Character
			local u = {}
			if q then
				for s, s in ipairs({
					"Head",
					"UpperTorso",
					"Torso",
					"HumanoidRootPart",
				}) do
					local h = q:FindFirstChild(s)
					if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then
						u[#u + 1] = h.Position
					end
				end
			end
			return u
		end
		function w.liveSkin()
			local q = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local u = w.selfPts()
			local s, h
			for Y, Y in ipairs(q and q:GetChildren() or {}) do
				if Y.Name == "PulseSkin" and Y:IsA("Model") then
					local q, l = pcall(Y.GetPivot, Y)
					if q then
						local q = math.huge
						for x, x in ipairs(u) do
							q = math.min(q, (l.Position - x).Magnitude)
						end
						if not h or q < h then
							s, h = Y, q
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return s
		end
		function w.hideCam(q)
			local u = w.selfPts()
			local s = {}
			local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
			for Y, Y in ipairs(h and h:GetChildren() or {}) do
				s[#s + 1] = Y
			end
			local h = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
			for Y, Y in ipairs(h and h:GetChildren() or {}) do
				s[#s + 1] = Y
			end
			local h = workspace:FindFirstChild("PulseTrail")
			for Y, Y in ipairs(h and h:GetChildren() or {}) do
				s[#s + 1] = Y
			end
			for Y, Y in ipairs(s) do
				if not q.camSeen[Y] then
					local s = Y.Name == "PulseSkin" or Y.Parent == h
					if not s then
						local h, l = pcall(function()
							if Y:IsA("Model") then
								return Y:GetPivot()
							end
							if Y:IsA("BasePart") then
								return Y.CFrame
							end
						end)
						if h and l then
							for h, h in ipairs(u) do
								if (l.Position - h).Magnitude < 10 then
									s = true
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if s then
						q.camSeen[Y] = true
						q.grab(Y)
						for u, u in ipairs(Y:GetDescendants()) do
							q.grab(u)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		function w.restoreUi(q)
			if q.back then
				return
			end
			q.back = true
			for u, u in ipairs(q.guis) do
				pcall(function()
					if u.Parent and not u.Enabled then
						u.Enabled = true
					end
				end)
			end
			local u = game:GetService("StarterGui")
			for s, s in ipairs(q.core) do
				pcall(u.SetCoreGuiEnabled, u, s, true)
			end
			for u, u in ipairs(q.fx) do
				pcall(function()
					if u.Parent then
						u.Enabled = true
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		function w.hideStep(q)
			local u = w.hid
			if not u then
				return
			end
			u.a = math.clamp(u.a + (u.off and -q or q) / 0.45, 0, 1)
			local q = X(u.a)
			for s, h in pairs(u.ltm) do
				if s.Parent then
					s.LocalTransparencyModifier = h + (1 - h) * q
				end
			end
			if u.off then
				if os.clock() - u.offAt > 0.3 then
					w.restoreUi(u)
				end
				if u.a <= 0 and u.back then
					w.hideEnd()
				end
			else
				if os.clock() - u.scanAt > 0.5 then
					u.scanAt = os.clock()
					w.hideScan(u)
					pcall(w.hideCam, u)
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(u.guis) do
					if q.Enabled then
						q.Enabled = false
					end
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(u.fx) do
					if q.Parent and q.Enabled then
						q.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		function w.hideOff()
			local q = w.hid
			if not q then
				return
			end
			q.off, q.offAt = true, os.clock()
		end
		function w.hideEnd()
			local q = w.hid
			w.hid = nil
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcHide")
			end)
			if not q then
				return
			end
			w.restoreUi(q)
			for u, s in pairs(q.ltm) do
				pcall(function()
					if u.Parent then
						u.LocalTransparencyModifier = s
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		function w.tagUi(q, q)
			w.lift = q
			w.hud()
		end
		function w.promptUi(q)
			local u = w.prompt
			if not (u and w.hrp) then
				return
			end
			w.hud()
			local s = w.proot
			pcall(function()
				local h = u.KeyboardKeyCode
				w.pkey.Text = h and h ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and h.Name or "G"
				w.pact.Text = L("Talk")
			end)
			w.pShown = q and not w.isOpen
			local q = w.pscale
			local u = w.hs or 1
			if w.pShown then
				s.Visible = true
				q.Scale = 0.75 * u
				w.pAnimEnd = os.clock() + 0.3
				c(q, 0.26, { Scale = u }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			else
				w.pAnimEnd = os.clock() + 0.2
				local h = c(q, 0.12, { Scale = 0.75 * u }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
				h.Completed:Connect(function()
					if not w.pShown then
						s.Visible = false
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		function w.hudStep()
			local q, u, s = w.hrp, w.tagF, w.proot
			if not (q and q.Parent and u and u.Parent) then
				return
			end
			local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not h then
				return
			end
			local Y = h.CFrame.Position
			local l = q.Position + Vector3.new(0, w.lift or 3, 0)
			local x = (Y - l).Magnitude
			w.camDist = x
			if x > 120 and not w.dance and not w.isOpen and not s.Visible then
				if u.Visible then
					u.Visible = false
				end
				if w.pigTag and w.pigTag.Visible then
					w.pigTag.Visible = false
				end
				return
			end
			w.hs = math.clamp(h.ViewportSize.Y / 1000, 0.6, 1.35)
			local S = os.clock()
			if S - (w.occAt or 0) > 0.15 then
				w.occAt = S
				local k = RaycastParams.new()
				k.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				k.FilterDescendantsInstances = U()
				k.RespectCanCollide = false
				local y = l - Y
				local Q = x < 90 and workspace:Raycast(Y, y, k)
				w.occluded = Q and Q.Instance.Transparency < 0.9 and (Q.Position - Y).Magnitude < y.Magnitude - 0.5
					or false
			end
			local k, y = h:WorldToViewportPoint(l)
			local l = y and k.Z > 0 and x < 80 and not w.occluded and not w.isOpen
			u.Visible = l
			if l then
				u.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(k.X + 0.5), math.floor(k.Y + 0.5))
				w.tagScale.Scale = math.clamp(16 / math.max(x, 1), 0.7, 1.15) * w.hs
				local u = w.myRoot()
				local l = u ~= nil and (u.Position - q.Position).Magnitude < 20
				w.bub.Visible = l and not w.dance
				local u = w.dance
				if u and u.running and not u.ending then
					w.lyrStep(u.t or 0)
				elseif w.lyrL then
					w.lyrL.Visible = false
				end
				if l and not w.dance then
					w.bub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, math.floor(-48.0 + math.sin(S * 2.6) * 3 + 0.5))
					for u, l in ipairs(w.dots) do
						local x = (math.sin(S * 6.5 - u * 1.1) + 1) / 2
						local u = math.floor(5 + x * 2.5 + 0.5)
						l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u, u)
						l.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 - x * 0.45
					end
				end
			end
			local u = w.sLyrF
			if u then
				local l = w.dance
				local x = l and l.tv and l.tv.F
				local k = x and x.P and x.P.Head
				local x = false
				if k and k.Parent and l.running and not l.ending and not w.isOpen then
					local y = k.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.7, 0)
					local k, Q = h:WorldToViewportPoint(y)
					local E = (Y - y).Magnitude
					if Q and k.Z > 0 and E < 80 then
						u.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(k.X + 0.5), math.floor(k.Y + 0.5))
						w.sLyrBase.Scale = math.clamp(16 / math.max(E, 1), 0.7, 1.15) * w.hs
						x = w.lyrDraw(w.sLyrL, w.sLyrScale, w.sLyrSt, l.t or 0, "s")
					end
				end
				if not x and w.sLyrL.Visible then
					w.sLyrL.Visible = false
				end
				u.Visible = x
			end
			local u = w.pigTag
			if u then
				local l = w.dance
				local x = l and l.pig
				local l = x and x.headPos
				local k = false
				if l and x.body and x.body.Parent then
					local y = l + Vector3.new(0, 1.05 + 0.08 * math.sin(S * 3), 0)
					local l, Q = h:WorldToViewportPoint(y)
					local E = (Y - y).Magnitude
					local Y = x.alpha or 1
					k = Q and l.Z > 0 and E < 80 and Y > 0.02 and not w.isOpen
					if k then
						local y = math.clamp((os.clock() - (x.born or 0)) / 0.35, 0, 1)
						y = 1 + 2.70158 * (y - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (y - 1) ^ 2
						u.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(l.X + 0.5), math.floor(l.Y + 0.5))
						w.pigTagScale.Scale = math.max(0.01, math.clamp(14 / math.max(E, 1), 0.55, 1.1) * w.hs * y)
						w.pigTagGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(S * 1.7) * 0.4, 0)
						w.pigTagGrad.Rotation = 8 * math.sin(S * 1.1)
						w.pigTagLbl.TextTransparency = 1 - Y
						w.pigTagLbl.Rotation = 3 * math.sin(S * 2.2)
					end
				end
				u.Visible = k
			end
			if s.Visible then
				if w.pShown and S > (w.pAnimEnd or 0) then
					w.pscale.Scale = w.hs
				end
				local u = q.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0) + h.CFrame.RightVector * 1.4
				local q, Y = h:WorldToViewportPoint(u)
				if Y and q.Z > 0 then
					s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(q.X + 0.5), math.floor(q.Y + 0.5))
				else
					s.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1000.0, -1000.0)
				end
			end
		end

		function w.clearOpts(V)
			for q, q in ipairs(w.opts:GetChildren()) do
				if q:IsA("GuiButton") then
					q.Active = false
					local u = w.paint[q]
					w.paint[q] = nil
					if V and u then
						u("gone", 0.14)
						task.delay(0.18, function()
							pcall(function()
								q:Destroy()
							end)
						end)
					else
						q:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end
		function w.join()
			task.spawn(function()
				local V = setclipboard or toclipboard
				if V then
					pcall(V, "https://discord.gg/pulsezone")
				end
				local V = getgenv().__pulseDiscordInvite
				if V then
					pcall(V, "pulsezone")
				end
			end)
			w.show("joined")
		end
		function w.show(V)
			local q = w.TREE[V]
			if not q or not w.isOpen then
				return
			end
			w.seq += 1
			local V = w.seq
			w.hot = {}
			w.clearOpts(true)
			local u = L(q.text)
			w.body.Text = u
			w.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
			w.skip = false
			if q.gesture then
				w.gesture(q.gesture)
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local s = {}
				for h, h in utf8.codes(u) do
					s[#s + 1] = utf8.char(h)
				end
				local u = #s
				local h, Y = 0, 0
				local l = os.clock()
				w.talking = true
				while h < u and w.isOpen and w.seq == V do
					local x = w.skip and u or math.min(u, math.floor((os.clock() - l) * 52))
					if not w.skip then
						for l = h + 1, x do
							local S = s[l]
							if S and S:match("[%a\128-\255]") and os.clock() - Y > 0.075 then
								local S = s[l - 1] or " "
								if not S:match("[%a\128-\255]") or l % 3 == 0 then
									Y = os.clock()
									w.syllable()
								end
							end
						end
					end
					h = x
					w.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = h
					if h < u then
						R.RenderStepped:Wait()
					end
				end
				w.talking = false
				if w.seq ~= V or not w.isOpen then
					return
				end
				w.body.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1.0
				task.wait(0.1)
				if w.seq ~= V or not w.isOpen then
					return
				end
				for V, u in ipairs(q.opts) do
					local q = u[2]
					w.button(u[1], V, function()
						if q == false then
							w.close()
						elseif q == "join" then
							w.join()
						elseif q == "verity" then
							w.cutPlay()
						else
							w.show(q)
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		end
		local function V(q)
			return CFrame.lookAt(q.Position, q.Position + q.LookVector)
		end
		function w.camShot()
			local q = w.hrp
			local u = q.Position + Vector3.new(0, (w.lift or 3) - 1.15, 0)
			local q = w.myRoot()
			local s = q and q.Position or u + w.home.LookVector * 6
			if (s - u).Magnitude > 30 then
				s = u + w.home.LookVector * 6
			end
			local q = Vector3.new(u.X - s.X, 0, u.Z - s.Z)
			local s = q.Magnitude
			q = s > 0.5 and q.Unit or -w.home.LookVector
			local h = q:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
			local Y = math.clamp(s + 3.2, 6.5, 9)
			local s = u - q * Y + h * 2.2 + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)
			local q = RaycastParams.new()
			q.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			q.FilterDescendantsInstances = U()
			local Y = workspace:Raycast(u, s - u, q)
			if Y then
				s = u + (s - u).Unit * math.max(2.5, (Y.Position - u).Magnitude - 0.6)
			end
			return CFrame.lookAt(s, u + h * 0.55 - Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0))
		end
		function w.camStep()
			local q, u = workspace.CurrentCamera, w.cam
			if not (q and u) then
				return
			end
			if u.mode == "cut" then
				local s = w.cut
				if s and s.cf then
					q.CFrame = s.cf
					q.FieldOfView = s.fov
				end
				return
			end
			local s = os.clock()
			local h = u.shot * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(s * 0.6) * 0.004, math.sin(s * 0.45) * 0.006, 0)
			local Y = u.fov * 0.8
			if u.mode == "in" then
				local l = X((s - u.t0) / 0.7)
				q.CFrame = u.start:Lerp(h, l)
				q.FieldOfView = u.fovStart + (Y - u.fovStart) * l
			else
				local h = X((s - u.t0) / 0.5)
				local s = u.home
				local Y = w.myRoot()
				if not Y or u.me0 and (Y.Position - u.me0).Magnitude > 40 then
					w.camEnd()
					return
				end
				if u.me0 then
					s = s + (Y.Position - u.me0)
				end
				q.CFrame = u.start:Lerp(s, h)
				q.FieldOfView = u.fovStart + (u.fov - u.fovStart) * h
				if h >= 1 then
					w.camEnd()
				end
			end
		end
		function w.camEnd()
			local q = w.cam
			w.cam = nil
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCam")
			end)
			local u = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if q and u then
				pcall(function()
					u.FieldOfView = q.fov
					if u.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
						u.CameraType = q.ctype
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		function w.camOn()
			local q = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not q then
				return
			end
			local u = w.cam
			if not u then
				if q.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then
					return
				end
				local s = w.myRoot()
				u = { fov = q.FieldOfView, ctype = q.CameraType, home = V(q.CFrame), me0 = s and s.Position }
				w.cam = u
			end
			local s, h = pcall(w.camShot)
			if not s then
				w.camEnd()
				return
			end
			u.shot, u.start, u.fovStart = h, V(q.CFrame), q.FieldOfView
			u.mode, u.t0 = "in", os.clock()
			q.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCam")
			end)
			R:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
				pcall(w.camStep)
			end)
		end
		function w.camOff()
			local q, u = w.cam, workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not (q and u) then
				return
			end
			q.start, q.fovStart = V(u.CFrame), u.FieldOfView
			q.mode, q.t0 = "out", os.clock()
		end
		w.CUT = {

		function w.raw(q)
			if type(q) ~= "string" then
				return nil
			end
			if #q < 64 then
				local u = getgenv().__pulseData
				q = u and u.take(q)
				if type(q) ~= "string" then
					return nil
				end
			end
			return w.b64(q)
		end
		function w.fileAsset(q, u)
			local s, h = pcall(function()
				if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
					return nil
				end
				if type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(q) then
					local Y, l = pcall(getcustomasset, q)
					if Y and type(l) == "string" and l ~= "" then
						return l
					end
				end
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
					return nil
				end
				local Y = w.raw(u)
				if not Y then
					return nil
				end
				pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
				writefile(q, Y)
				return getcustomasset(q)
			end)
			if s and type(h) == "string" and h ~= "" then
				return h
			end
			return nil
		end
		function w.songAsset()
			if w.songA then
				return w.songA
			end
			w.songA = w.fileAsset("PulseHub/verity_v1.mp3", w.VERITY)
			return w.songA or false
		end
		function w.loadSet(q, u, s)
			local h = {}
			if not q then
				return h
			end
			for Y, l in pairs(w.CUT.ids) do
				if u[Y] then
					pcall(function()
						local u = q:LoadAnimation(J("Animation", { AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. l }))
						u.Looped = Y == "idle"
						u.Priority = Y == "idle" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or s
						h[Y] = u
					end)
				end
			end
			return h
		end
		function w.cutPreload()
			local q = w.songAsset()
			if q and not (w.song and w.song.Parent) then
				w.song =
					J("Sound", { Name = "PulseNpcSong", SoundId = q, Volume = 0.9 }, game:GetService("SoundService"))
			end
			if not (w.cutT and w.cutT.rig == w.hum) then
				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(w.CUT.tA) do
					q[u[2]] = true
				end
				local u = w.hum and w.hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
				w.cutT = w.loadSet(u, q, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2)
				w.cutT.rig = w.hum
			end
			if not w.wsz then
				w.wsz = {}
				local q = game:GetService("TextService")
				for u, u in ipairs(w.CUT.lines) do
					for s, s in ipairs(u.w) do
						local u = s[2]
						if not w.wsz[u] then
							local s, h = pcall(function()
								local Y = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
								Y.Text, Y.Font, Y.Size, Y.Width = u, W(Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold), 46, 4000
								return q:GetTextBoundsAsync(Y)
							end)
							w.wsz[u] = s and h or Vector2.new(utf8.len(u) * 46 * 0.58, 52)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		function w.makeActor()
			local q = t.Character
			local u = q and q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not u then
				return nil
			end
			local u = w.liveSkin() or q
			local q = u.Archivable
			u.Archivable = true
			local s, h = pcall(function()
				return u:Clone()
			end)
			u.Archivable = q
			if not s or not h then
				return nil
			end
			for q, q in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
				if
					q:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
					or q:IsA("Tool")
					or q:IsA("BillboardGui")
					or q:IsA("Highlight")
					or q:IsA("ForceField")
					or q:IsA("Sound")
					or q:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
					or q:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
					or q:IsA("Trail")
					or q:IsA("Beam")
				then
					pcall(function()
						q:Destroy()
					end)
				elseif q:IsA("BasePart") then
					q.CanCollide, q.CanQuery, q.CanTouch, q.Anchored = false, false, false, false
				end
			end
			local q = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local u = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local s = h:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not (q and u and s) then
				h:Destroy()
				return nil
			end
			u.Anchored = true
			pcall(function()
				q.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				q.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
				q.EvaluateStateMachine = false
			end)
			local s = math.huge
			for Y, Y in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
				if Y:IsA("BasePart") and Y ~= u and not Y:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory") then
					s = math.min(s, Y.Position.Y - Y.Size.Y / 2)
				end
			end
			local Y = q.HipHeight > 0.5 and q.HipHeight + u.Size.Y / 2 or u.Position.Y - s
			local q = w.home.LookVector
			local s = w.home.Position + q * 6
			local l = RaycastParams.new()
			l.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			l.FilterDescendantsInstances = U()
			local x = workspace:Raycast(s + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30.0, 0), l)
			local l = (x and x.Position.Y or w.home.Position.Y - (w.hum.HipHeight + w.hrp.Size.Y / 2)) + Y
			local Y = Vector3.new(s.X, l, s.Z)
			h.Name = "PulseNpcActor"
			h.Parent = workspace
			u.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Y, Y - q)
			G.parts.PulseNpcActor = h
			return h
		end
		local function q(u)
			return 1 + 2.70158 * (u - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (u - 1) ^ 2
		end
		function w.cutLine(u, s)
			for h, h in ipairs(u.words) do
				pcall(function()
					h.h:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			u.words, u.line = {}, s
			u.lineOut = nil
			w.subLL.Padding = UDim.new(0, s.wob and 2 or 12)
			local h = s.who == "t"
			local Y = h and w.name or t.DisplayName
			if u.who ~= s.who then
				u.who, u.whoAt = s.who, os.clock()
				w.who.Text = string.upper(Y)
				w.who.BackgroundColor3 = h and w.RED or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				w.who.TextColor3 = h and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
			end
			for h, Y in ipairs(s.w) do
				local s = w.wsz and w.wsz[Y[2]] or Vector2.new(utf8.len(Y[2]) * 27, 52)
				local l = J("Frame", {
					Name = "W" .. h,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(s.X) + 6, math.ceil(s.Y) + 6),
					LayoutOrder = h,
				}, w.subLine)
				local s = J("TextLabel", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, 4),
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = W(Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold),
					TextSize = 46,
					Text = Y[2],
					TextTransparency = 1,
					TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					ZIndex = 1,
				}, l)
				local x = J("UIScale", { Scale = 0.3 }, s)
				local S = J("TextLabel", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = W(Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold),
					TextSize = 46,
					Text = Y[2],
					TextTransparency = 1,
					TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
					ZIndex = 2,
					TextColor3 = Y[3] and Color3.fromRGB(255, 58, 72) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					TextStrokeColor3 = Y[3] and Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 6) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
				}, l)
				local k = J("UIScale", { Scale = 0.3 }, S)
				local y = J("UIStroke", {
					Color = Y[3] and Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 6) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					Thickness = 2.5,
					Transparency = 1,
					ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
				}, S)
				u.words[h] = {
					h = l,
					l = S,
					s = k,
					st = y,
					sh = s,
					ss = x,
					t = Y[1],
					i = h,
					rot = (math.random() - 0.5) * 22,
				}
			end
		end
		function w.cutShot(u, s, h)
			local Y = w.CUT.shots[u]
			local l = Y[1]
			local x = w.CUT.shots[u + 1] and w.CUT.shots[u + 1][1] or w.CUT.len
			local u = math.clamp((s - l) / math.max(0.1, x - l), 0, 1)
			local x = math.clamp(s - l, 0, 10)
			local l, S, k, y, Q = h.T, h.A, h.d, h.r, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local E = Y[2]
			local Y, I, C, H = nil, nil, 44, 0
			if E == "wide" or E == "wide2" then
				local n = (l + S) / 2
				local O = E == "wide" and 7.4 or 6
				Y = n + y * O + Q * 0.7 + k * ((E == "wide" and -1.2 or 0.8) + (E == "wide" and 2.4 or -1.4) * u)
				I = n - Q * 0.35
				C = E == "wide" and 50 or 46 - 6 * u
			elseif E == "tOTS" or E == "tOTS2" then
				local n = E == "tOTS"
				Y = S + k * (n and 3.2 or 2.8) + y * (n and 2.8 or 2.5) + Q * (n and 0.85 or 0.6)
				Y = Y + (l - Y) * ((n and 0.1 or 0.2) * u)
				I = l + y * 0.35 - Q * 0.2
				C = n and 40 or 36
			elseif E == "tClose" then
				Y = l + k * (4.4 - 0.9 * u) + y * 0.9 + Q * 0.1
				I = l - Q * 0.2
				C = 40
			elseif E == "tLow" then
				local n = -0.3 + 0.6 * u
				Y = l + (k * math.cos(n) + y * math.sin(n)) * 3.7 - Q * 1.35
				I = l + Q * 0.2
				C = 48
			elseif E == "mClose" then
				Y = S - k * 3.4 + y * 1.7 + Q * 0.55
				I = S - Q * 0.2
				C = 40 - 4 * u
				H = s >= 9.14 and math.exp(-(s - 9.14) * 7) * 0.02 or 0
			elseif E == "mPunch" then
				Y = S - k * 3.2 + y * 1.3 + Q * 0.5
				I = S - Q * 0.1
				C = 62 - 22 * math.min(1, x / 0.12)
				H = math.exp(-x * 6) * 0.03
			elseif E == "mOTS" then
				Y = l - k * 2.6 + y * 3 + Q * 1
				Y = Y + (S - Y) * (0.14 * u)
				I = S - y * 0.35 - Q * 0.3
				C = 40 - (s >= 17.7 and 5 * math.min(1, (s - 17.7) / 1.5) or 0)
			elseif E == "tECU" then
				Y = l + k * 3 + y * 0.25
				I = l - Q * 0.1
				C = 34
				H = 0.012
			elseif E == "tPunch" then
				Y = l + k * 3.1 + Q * 0.04
				I = l - Q * 0.08
				C = 52 - 18 * math.min(1, x / 0.09) + (s >= 22.86 and -7.0 * math.min(1, (s - 22.86) / 0.08) or 0)
				H = math.exp(-x * 3) * 0.035 + (s >= 22.86 and math.exp(-(s - 22.86) * 4) * 0.04 or 0)
			end
			local u = CFrame.lookAt(Y, I)
			if h.rp then
				local l = Y - I
				local Y = workspace:Raycast(I, l, h.rp)
				if Y then
					local h = math.max(1.2, (Y.Position - I).Magnitude - 0.4)
					u = CFrame.lookAt(I + l.Unit * h, I)
				end
			end
			if H > 0 then
				u = u
					* CFrame.Angles(
						math.sin(s * 37) * H,
						math.sin(s * 29 + 1) * H,
						math.sin(s * 7) * H * (E == "tECU" and 5 or 1.5)
					)
			end
			return u, C
		end
		function w.cutCam(u)
			local s = w.cut.G
			local h = w.CUT.shots
			local Y = 1
			for l = 1, #h do
				if u >= h[l][1] then
					Y = l
				end
			end
			local l, x = w.cutShot(Y, u, s)
			local S = h[Y][3]
			if S and Y > 1 and u - h[Y][1] < S then
				local k, y = w.cutShot(Y - 1, u, s)
				local s = X((u - h[Y][1]) / S)
				l, x = k:Lerp(l, s), y + (x - y) * s
			end
			local X = w.CUT
			local s = X.phase + math.floor((u - X.phase) / X.period) * X.period
			local X = u >= 0 and math.exp(-(u - s) * 10) or 0
			w.cut.beat = X
			x = x * (1 - X * (u > 20 and 0.05 or 0.028))
			return l, x
		end
		function w.cutStep()
			local X = w.cut
			if not X then
				return
			end
			local u = X.running and os.clock() - X.t0 or 0
			local s = w.CUT
			if X.running then
				while X.ai <= #s.tA and s.tA[X.ai][1] <= u do
					local h = w.cutT and w.cutT[s.tA[X.ai][2]]
					if h then
						if X.tCur and X.tCur ~= h then
							pcall(function()
								X.tCur:Stop(0.25)
							end)
						end
						pcall(function()
							h:Play(0.15)
						end)
						X.tCur = h
					end
					X.ai += 1
				end
				while X.mi <= #s.mA and s.mA[X.mi][1] <= u do
					local h = X.mAn[s.mA[X.mi][2]]
					if h then
						if X.mCur and X.mCur ~= h then
							pcall(function()
								X.mCur:Stop(0.25)
							end)
						end
						pcall(function()
							h:Play(0.15)
						end)
						X.mCur = h
					end
					X.mi += 1
				end
				while X.fi <= #s.flash and s.flash[X.fi][1] <= u do
					w.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - s.flash[X.fi][2]
					c(w.flash, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
					X.fi += 1
				end
				local h = s.lines[X.li]
				while h and u >= h.w[1][1] - 0.06 do
					w.cutLine(X, h)
					X.li += 1
					h = s.lines[X.li]
				end
				local h, Y = false, false
				for l, l in ipairs(s.lines) do
					if u >= l.w[1][1] and u <= l.w[#l.w][1] + 0.5 then
						if l.who == "t" then
							h = true
						else
							Y = true
						end
					end
				end
				w.talking, w.actorTalking = h, Y
			end
			local h, Y = w.cutCam(u)
			X.cf, X.fov = h, Y
			local h = X.line
			local Y = 1 + (X.beat or 0) * 0.07
			local l = h and u > h.t1 and math.clamp((u - h.t1) / 0.2, 0, 1) or 0
			for x, x in ipairs(X.words) do
				local S = u - x.t
				if S < 0 then
					x.l.TextTransparency, x.l.TextStrokeTransparency, x.st.Transparency, x.sh.TextTransparency =
						1, 1, 1, 1
				else
					local k = math.min(1, S / 0.24)
					local y = math.min(1, S / 0.1) * (1 - l)
					x.s.Scale = (0.3 + 0.7 * q(k)) * Y * (1 - 0.2 * l)
					x.l.TextTransparency = 1 - y
					x.l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - y * 0.6
					x.st.Transparency = 1 - y * 0.75
					x.l.Rotation = x.rot * (1 - k) + (h.wob and math.sin(u * 15 + x.i * 1.7) * 7 or 0)
					local q = math.floor((1 - k) * 16 - l * 12 + 0.5)
					x.l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, q)
					x.ss.Scale = x.s.Scale
					x.sh.Rotation = x.l.Rotation
					x.sh.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, q + 4)
					x.sh.TextTransparency = 1 - y * 0.55
				end
			end
			local q = X.whoAt and os.clock() - X.whoAt or 1
			local h = X.line and 1 - l or 0
			w.who.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - h
			w.who.TextTransparency = 1 - h
			w.who.Rotation = (1 - math.min(1, q / 0.2)) * -6.0
			if X.running and u >= s.len then
				w.cutEnd(false)
			end
		end
		function w.cutPlay()
			if w.cut or not w.isOpen then
				return
			end
			pcall(w.danceStop)
			w.seq += 1
			w.hot = {}
			w.clearOpts(true)
			w.body.Text = ""
			w.talking = false
			pcall(w.cutPreload)
			w.cutUi()
			local X, q = pcall(w.makeActor)
			if not X or not q then
				w.show("who")
				return
			end
			local X = q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local u = X and (X:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or J("Animator", {}, X))
			local X = { idle = true }
			for s, s in ipairs(w.CUT.mA) do
				X[s[2]] = true
			end
			local s = w.loadSet(u, X, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
			if s.idle then
				pcall(function()
					s.idle:Play(0.1)
				end)
			end
			for X, X in pairs(w.anims) do
				pcall(function()
					if X.IsPlaying and X ~= w.anims.idle then
						X:Stop(0.2)
					end
				end)
			end
			local X = q:FindFirstChild("Head")
			w.actorNeck = X and X:FindFirstChild("Neck")
			w.faceAt = q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local u = w.hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, (w.lift or 3) - 1.15, 0)
			local h = X.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
			local X = Vector3.new(h.X - u.X, 0, h.Z - u.Z)
			X = X.Magnitude > 0.1 and X.Unit or w.home.LookVector
			local Y = RaycastParams.new()
			Y.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			Y.FilterDescendantsInstances = U()
			local l = {
				actor = q,
				mAn = s,
				words = {},
				ai = 1,
				mi = 1,
				fi = 1,
				li = 1,
				running = false,
				t0 = os.clock(),
				G = { T = u, A = h, d = X, r = X:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit, rp = Y },
			}
			w.cut = l
			w.left.Visible = false
			w.opts.Visible = false
			w.subs.Visible = true
			w.fit()
			c(w.barT, 0.5, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) })
			c(w.barB, 0.5, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.9), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) })
			w.subs.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.9, -22.0)
			if w.cam then
				w.cam.mode = "cut"
			end
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCut")
			end)
			R:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcCut", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
				pcall(w.cutStep)
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local X = w.song
				local q = os.clock()
				while X and not X.IsLoaded and os.clock() - q < 2.5 do
					task.wait()
				end
				task.wait(0.25)
				if w.cut ~= l then
					return
				end
				if X and X.IsLoaded then
					X.TimePosition = 0
					X:Play()
				end
				l.t0 = os.clock()
				l.running = true
			end)
		end
		function w.cutEnd(X)
			local q = w.cut
			if not q then
				return
			end
			w.cut = nil
			pcall(function()
				R:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCut")
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if w.song then
					w.song:Stop()
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if q.tCur then
					q.tCur:Stop(0.3)
				end
			end)
			for u, u in ipairs(q.words) do
				pcall(function()
					u.h:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			pcall(function()
				q.actor:Destroy()
			end)
			G.parts.PulseNpcActor = nil
			w.faceAt, w.actorNeck, w.actorTalking, w.talking = nil, nil, false, false
			pcall(function()
				w.subs.Visible = false
				w.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				w.left.Visible = true
				w.opts.Visible = true
			end)
			if X or not w.isOpen then
				return
			end
			c(w.barT, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0) })
			c(w.barB, 0.45, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.93), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0) })
			local X, q = w.cam, workspace.CurrentCamera
			if X and q then
				local u, s = pcall(w.camShot)
				if u then
					X.shot = s
				end
				X.start, X.fovStart = V(q.CFrame), q.FieldOfView
				X.mode, X.t0 = "in", os.clock()
			end
			w.show("who")
		end
		function w.open()
			if w.isOpen or not (w.hrp and w.hrp.Parent) then
				return
			end
			pcall(w.danceStop)
			local X = w.ui()
			w.isOpen = true
			w.farN = 0
			w.hot = {}
			w.promptUi(false)
			if w.prompt then
				w.prompt.Enabled = false
			end
			w.chip.Text = _()
			w.fit()
			w.clearOpts(false)
			w.body.Text = ""
			X.Enabled = true
			w.barT.Position, w.barT.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0)
			w.barB.Position, w.barB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.07, 0)
			c(w.barT, 0.55, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.07) })
			c(w.barB, 0.55, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.93) })
			w.shade.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			c(w.shade, 0.6, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
			w.left.Position = w.leftPos(6)
			c(w.left, 0.55, { Position = w.leftPos(-18.0) })
			w.nameL.TextTransparency = 1
			w.chip.TextTransparency, w.chip.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
			w.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3)
			c(w.nameL, 0.45, { TextTransparency = 0 })
			c(w.chip, 0.45, { TextTransparency = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
			c(w.line, 0.7, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 3) })
			r("rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", 0.45)
			pcall(w.camOn)
			pcall(w.hideOn)
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(w.cutPreload)
			end)
			task.delay(0.25, function()
				if w.isOpen then
					w.show("start")
				end
			end)
			if w.watch then
				w.watch:Disconnect()
			end
			w.watch = R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				local X, V = w.myRoot(), w.hrp
				if not (X and V and V.Parent) or (X.Position - V.Position).Magnitude > 14 then
					w.farN = (w.farN or 0) + 1
					if w.farN >= 6 then
						w.close()
						return
					end
				else
					w.farN = 0
				end
				if w.vp() ~= w.fitVP then
					w.fit()
				end
			end)
			if w.keys then
				w.keys:Disconnect()
			end
			local X = {
				[Enum.KeyCode.One] = 1,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = 2,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = 3,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = 4,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Five] = 5,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Six] = 6,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Seven] = 7,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Eight] = 8,
				[Enum.KeyCode.Nine] = 9,
			}
			w.keys = K.InputBegan:Connect(function(K, V)
				if V or not w.isOpen then
					return
				end
				local V = X[K.KeyCode]
				if V and w.hot[V] then
					w.hot[V]()
				end
			end)
		end
		function w.close()
			if not w.isOpen then
				return
			end
			pcall(w.cutEnd, true)
			w.isOpen = false
			w.talking = false
			w.seq += 1
			w.hot = {}
			if w.watch then
				w.watch:Disconnect()
				w.watch = nil
			end
			if w.keys then
				w.keys:Disconnect()
				w.keys = nil
			end
			local X = w.gui
			if X then
				c(w.barT, 0.38, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
				c(w.barB, 0.38, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
				c(w.shade, 0.35, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				c(w.nameL, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				c(w.chip, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				c(w.line, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				w.body.Text = ""
				w.clearOpts(true)
				task.delay(0.42, function()
					if not w.isOpen and X.Parent then
						X.Enabled = false
					end
				end)
			end
			pcall(w.camOff)
			pcall(w.hideOff)
			w.gesture("wave")
			task.delay(0.4, function()
				if w.prompt and w.prompt.Parent and not w.isOpen and not (w.dance and w.dance.noPrompt) then
					w.prompt.Enabled = true
				end
			end)
		end

		function w.songReady(X)
			if X.data and not X.asset then
				return false
			end
			for c, c in ipairs(X.tracks or {}) do
				if not c.asset then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end
		function w.prepSongs()
			if w.prepBusy then
				return
			end
			w.prepBusy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for X, X in ipairs(w.SONGS) do
					if X.data and not X.asset then
						pcall(w.trackAsset, X)
					end
					for c, c in ipairs(X.tracks or {}) do
						if not c.asset then
							c.asset = w.fileAsset(c.file, c.data)
						end
					end
				end
				if not w.tvNoise then
					w.tvNoise = w.fileAsset("PulseHub/tv_noise_v1.png", w.TVNOISE)
				end
				w.prepBusy = false
			end)
		end
		function w.trackAsset(X)
			if X.asset then
				return X.asset
			end
			if not X.data then
				return false
			end
			X.asset = w.fileAsset(X.file, X.data)
			return X.asset or false
		end
		function w.joints()
			if w.jm and w.jmModel == w.model then
				return w.jm
			end
			local X = {}
			for c, c in ipairs(w.model and w.model:GetDescendants() or {}) do
				if c:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or c:IsA("Motor6D") then
					X[c.Name] = c
				end
			end
			w.jm, w.jmModel = X, w.model
			return X
		end
		local function X(c)
			c = math.clamp(c, 0, 1)
			return c * c * (3 - 2 * c)
		end
		local function c(K, V, r, _, q)
			_, q = _ or 0.12, q or 0.15
			if K <= V - _ or K >= r + q then
				return 0
			end
			if K < V then
				return X((K - V + _) / _)
			end
			if K > r then
				return 1 - X((K - r) / q)
			end
			return 1
		end
		local function K(V, r, _)
			return V + (r - V) * _
		end
		local function V(r, _)
			local q = 0
			for u, u in ipairs(_) do
				q = math.max(q, c(r, u[1], u[2], u[3], u[4]))
			end
			return q
		end
		local function r(_)
			local q = math.max(0, _.dip)
			local u = math.acos(math.clamp(1 - q / 2.1, -1.0, 1))
			return {
				Root = CFrame.new(_.rx, -q + _.hop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, _.ryaw, _.rroll),
				RightHip = CFrame.Angles(u + _.stR, 0, 0),
				RightKnee = CFrame.Angles(-2.0 * u - _.stR * 1.6, 0, 0),
				RightAnkle = CFrame.Angles(u + _.stR * 0.4, 0, 0),
				LeftHip = CFrame.Angles(u + _.stL, 0, 0),
				LeftKnee = CFrame.Angles(-2.0 * u - _.stL * 1.6, 0, 0),
				LeftAnkle = CFrame.Angles(u + _.stL * 0.4, 0, 0),
				Waist = CFrame.Angles(_.wx, _.wy, _.wz),
				Neck = CFrame.Angles(_.nx, _.ny, _.nz),
				RightShoulder = CFrame.Angles(_.rsx, 0, _.rsz),
				RightElbow = CFrame.Angles(_.rex, 0, _.rez),
				RightWrist = CFrame.Angles(_.rwx, 0, _.rwz or 0),
				LeftShoulder = CFrame.Angles(_.lsx, 0, _.lsz),
				LeftElbow = CFrame.Angles(_.lex, 0, _.lez),
				LeftWrist = CFrame.Angles(_.lwx, 0, _.lwz or 0),
			}
		end
		w.POSES = {}
		function w.POSES.ugot(_, q)
			local u = q.period
			local s = (_ - q.phase) / u
			local h = math.floor(s)
			local Y = s - h
			local l = math.exp(-Y * 7)
			local x = math.sin(3.141592653589793 * s)
			local S = (_ < 3.45 and 0.5 or 1) * (_ > 13.9 and 1 - 0.55 * X((_ - 13.9) / 1.2) or 1)
			local k = h % 2 == 0
			local h = {
				rx = 0.1 * x * S,
				ryaw = 0.22 * x * S,
				rroll = 0.04 * x * S,
				dip = (0.08 + 0.2 * S) * l + 0.05,
				hop = 0,
				wx = -0.06 - 0.12 * l * S,
				wy = 0.12 * x * S,
				wz = -0.06 * x * S,
				nx = -0.25 * l * (0.5 + 0.6 * S),
				ny = 0.14 * x,
				nz = 0.06 * x,
				rsx = 0.35 + 0.28 * x * S,
				rsz = 0.2,
				rex = 1.05 + 0.35 * l,
				rez = 0,
				rwx = 0.2 * l,
				lsx = 0.35 - 0.28 * x * S,
				lsz = -0.2,
				lex = 1.05 + 0.35 * l,
				lez = 0,
				lwx = 0.2 * l,
				stR = 0,
				stL = 0,
			}
			local function S(y, Q)
				if y <= 0 then
					return
				end
				for E, I in pairs(Q) do
					h[E] = K(h[E], I, y)
				end
			end
			S(
				math.max(c(_, 1.15, 1.95), c(_, 3.08, 3.85), c(_, 10.84, 11.12, 0.1, 0.1)),
				{
					rsx = 1.5,
					rsz = 0.12,
					rex = 0.08,
					rwx = 0,
					wx = -0.18,
					nx = -0.12,
					lsx = 0.15,
					lsz = -0.15,
					lex = 1.6,
				}
			)
			local y = c(_, 3.62, 5.4)
			if y > 0 then
				local Q = math.exp(-Y * 2.6)
				local E, I = k and Q or 0, k and 0 or Q
				S(y, {
					rsx = K(0.5, 2.75, E),
					rsz = K(0.25, 0.35, E),
					rex = K(1.5, 0.15, E),
					lsx = K(0.5, 2.75, I),
					lsz = K(-0.25, -0.35, I),
					lex = K(1.5, 0.15, I),
					stL = k and math.sin(3.141592653589793 * Y) * 0.8 or 0,
					stR = k and 0 or math.sin(3.141592653589793 * Y) * 0.8,
					nx = -0.4 * l,
					wx = -0.15 - 0.15 * l,
				})
			end
			S(
				c(_, 5.42, 6.55),
				{
					rsx = 1.35,
					rsz = 0.55,
					rex = 0.1,
					lsx = 1.35,
					lsz = -0.55,
					lex = 0.1,
					wx = 0.1 - 0.12 * l,
					nx = 0.05 - 0.3 * l,
					ryaw = 0.3 * x,
				}
			)
			S(math.max(c(_, 6.62, 7.92), c(_, 15.22, 15.7, 0.1, 0.05)), {
				rsx = 0.55,
				rsz = -0.15,
				rex = 1.95,
				lsx = 0.55,
				lsz = 0.15,
				lex = 1.95,
				rwx = 0,
				lwx = 0,
				nz = 0.28 * math.sin(3.141592653589793 * s * 0.5),
				ny = 0.15 * x,
				wx = 0.05,
				wz = 0.12 * x,
			})
			local s = 0
			if _ >= 7.98 and _ <= 9.1 then
				s = 6.283185307179586 * X((_ - 7.98) / 0.97)
			end
			S(
				c(_, 7.98, 8.95, 0.08, 0.12),
				{
					rsx = 0.15,
					rsz = 1.45,
					rex = 0.15,
					lsx = 0.15,
					lsz = -1.45,
					lex = 0.15,
					nx = 0.15,
					wx = 0.08,
					dip = 0.05,
					ryaw = 0,
				}
			)
			local Y = c(_, 9.15, 10.6)
			if Y > 0 then
				local k = 0
				for y, y in ipairs(q.gimme) do
					if _ >= y then
						k = math.max(k, math.exp(-(_ - y) * 9))
					end
				end
				S(Y, {
					rsx = 1.3,
					rsz = 0.25,
					rex = 0.25 + 1.2 * k,
					rwx = -0.5 * k,
					lsx = 1.3,
					lsz = -0.25,
					lex = 0.25 + 1.2 * k,
					lwx = -0.5 * k,
					wx = 0.14,
					nx = 0.1 - 0.15 * k,
				})
			end
			S(
				c(_, 11.12, 11.8),
				{
					rsx = K(2.2, 2.9, l),
					rsz = 0.4,
					rex = 0.2,
					lsx = K(2.2, 2.9, l),
					lsz = -0.4,
					lex = 0.2,
					nx = 0.15 - 0.3 * l,
					hop = 0.25 * l,
				}
			)
			local q = c(_, 11.85, 13.72)
			if q > 0 then
				S(q, {
					rsx = (_ - 11.85) / u * 3.141592653589793,
					rsz = 0.18,
					rex = 0.05,
					lsx = 0.25,
					lsz = -0.55,
					lex = 1.7,
					nx = -0.5 * l,
					wx = -0.28 * l - 0.1,
					dip = 0.12 + 0.25 * l,
					ryaw = 0.15 * x,
				})
			end
			S(c(_, 13.72, 14.3, 0.08, 0.18), {
				rsx = 0.1,
				rsz = 2.65,
				rex = 0.05,
				lsx = 0.1,
				lsz = -2.65,
				lex = 0.05,
				nx = 0.25,
				ny = 0,
				nz = 0,
				wx = 0.15,
				wy = 0,
				wz = 0,
				ryaw = 0,
				rroll = 0,
				rx = 0,
				hop = _ >= 13.78 and 0.35 * math.exp(-(_ - 13.78) * 5) or 0,
			})
			S(c(_, 14.3, 15.2), {
				rsx = 0.1,
				rsz = 2.7,
				rex = 0.15,
				ryaw = 0.1 * x,
				rez = 0.55 * math.sin(_ * 13),
				lsx = 0.25,
				lsz = -0.2,
				lex = 0.9,
				ny = 0.1 * math.sin(_ * 3),
			})
			return r(h), s
		end
		function w.POSES.busik(_, q, u)
			local s = q.period
			local h = (_ - q.phase) / s
			local s = math.floor(h)
			local Y = h - s
			local l = math.exp(-Y * 7)
			local x = math.sin(3.141592653589793 * h * 0.5)
			local h = s % 2 == 0
			local s = 0
			for S, S in ipairs(q.lyr) do
				for q, q in ipairs(S.w) do
					local S = _ - q[1]
					if S >= 0 and S < 0.5 then
						s = math.max(s, math.exp(-S * 9))
					end
				end
			end
			local q = {
				rx = 0.06 * x,
				ryaw = 0.12 * x,
				rroll = 0.03 * x,

		function w.POSES.oldman(V)
			local _ = w.OLDPOSE
			local q = math.clamp(V * _.fps, 0, _.n - 1)
			local u = math.floor(q)
			local s = q - u
			local q = math.min(u + 1, _.n - 1)
			local h = {}
			for Y, Y in ipairs(w.OLDJ) do
				local l = _[Y]
				local x, S = u * 4, q * 4
				local k = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, l[x + 2] / 1000, l[x + 3] / 1000, l[x + 4] / 1000, l[x + 1] / 1000)
				local x = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, l[S + 2] / 1000, l[S + 3] / 1000, l[S + 4] / 1000, l[S + 1] / 1000)
				h[Y] = k:Lerp(x, s)
			end
			local Y = (_.dip[u + 1] + (_.dip[q + 1] - _.dip[u + 1]) * s) / 100
			local _ = 0
			if V >= 12.05 and V <= 13.2 then
				_ = -6.283185307179586 * X((V - 12.05) / 1.15)
			end
			if V >= 13.42 and V <= 14.3 then
				_ = -6.283185307179586 * X((V - 13.42) / 0.88)
			end
			local q = math.max(c(V, 12.2, 12.97, 0.12, 0.12), c(V, 13.53, 14.15, 0.06, 0.15))
			if q > 0 then
				for u, s in pairs(w.OLDNEUTRAL) do
					h[u] = h[u]:Lerp(s, q)
				end
				Y = K(Y, 0.1, q)
			end
			local q = math.max(c(V, 12.1, 13.2, 0.1, 0.15), c(V, 13.45, 14.3, 0.08, 0.15))
			if q > 0 then
				h.Root = h.Root:Lerp(CFrame.identity, q)
			end
			local q = c(V, 14.6, 15.4, 0.15, 0.1)
			if q > 0 then
				for V, u in pairs(w.OLDVISOR) do
					h[V] = h[V]:Lerp(u, q)
				end
				Y = K(Y, 0.12, q)
			end
			local V, q = h.RightHip * h.RightKnee, h.LeftHip * h.LeftKnee
			return {
				Root = CFrame.new(0, -math.max(0, Y), 0) * h.Root,
				Waist = h.Waist,
				Neck = h.Neck,
				RightShoulder = h.RightShoulder,
				RightElbow = h.RightElbow,
				RightWrist = CFrame.identity,
				LeftShoulder = h.LeftShoulder,
				LeftElbow = h.LeftElbow,
				LeftWrist = CFrame.identity,
				RightHip = h.RightHip,
				RightKnee = h.RightKnee,
				RightAnkle = CFrame.identity:Lerp(V.Rotation:Inverse(), 0.6),
				LeftHip = h.LeftHip,
				LeftKnee = h.LeftKnee,
				LeftAnkle = CFrame.identity:Lerp(q.Rotation:Inverse(), 0.6),
			},
				_
		end
