				if J.sheriff.shotSnd ~= "Off" and A - F > 0.15 then

					K(B(G, J.sheriff.shotSnd))
				end
				if J.sheriff.killSnd ~= "Off" and typeof(X) == "Instance" then
					local A
					pcall(function()
						local F = X
						while F and not (F:IsA("Model") and F:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
							F = F.Parent
						end
						if F and F ~= f.Character and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(F) then
							A = F
						end
					end)
					if A then
						task.delay(0.06, function()
							K(B(R, J.sheriff.killSnd))
						end)
					end
				end
				pcall(r)
			end)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local A = {
				["Custom Sounds"] = {
					ru = "Кастом звуки",
					uk = "Кастом звуки",
				},
				["Shot Sound"] = {
					ru = "Звук выстрела",
					uk = "Звук пострілу",
				},
				["Kill Sound"] = {
					ru = "Звук убийства",
					uk = "Звук вбивства",
				},
				["Preview Shot"] = {
					ru = "Прослушать выстрел",
					uk = "Прослухати постріл",
				},
				["Preview Kill"] = {
					ru = "Прослушать убийство",
					uk = "Прослухати вбивство",
				},
				["Sound Volume"] = {
					ru = "Громкость звуков",
					uk = "Гучність звуків",
				},
			}
			for F, f in pairs(A) do
				if T.data.ru then
					T.data.ru[F] = f.ru
				end
				if T.data.uk then
					T.data.uk[F] = f.uk
				end
			end
		end)
		a:Header("Custom Sounds")
		do
			local A = {}
			for F, F in ipairs(G) do
				A[#A + 1] = { code = F.code, label = F.label }
			end
			a:Dropdown({
				Text = "Shot Sound",
				Default = J.sheriff.shotSnd or "Off",
				TranslateOptions = false,
				Options = A,
				Callback = function(A)
					J.sheriff.shotSnd = A
					if A == "Off" then
						M("shot")
					else
						pcall(r)
					end
				end,
			})
			a:Button({
				Text = "Preview Shot",
				Callback = function()
					K(B(G, J.sheriff.shotSnd))
				end,
			})
			local G = {}
			for A, A in ipairs(R) do
				G[#G + 1] = { code = A.code, label = A.label }
			end
			a:Dropdown({
				Text = "Kill Sound",
				Default = J.sheriff.killSnd or "Off",
				TranslateOptions = false,
				Options = G,
				Callback = function(G)
					J.sheriff.killSnd = G
					if G == "Off" then
						M("kill")
					else
						pcall(r)
					end
				end,
			})
			a:Button({
				Text = "Preview Kill",
				Callback = function()
					K(B(R, J.sheriff.killSnd))
				end,
			})
			a:Slider({
				Text = "Sound Volume",
				Min = 0,
				Max = 100,
				Default = t.sheriff.sndVol or 60,
				Decimals = 0,
				Suffix = "%",
				Callback = function(G)
					J.sheriff.sndVol = G
					if J.sheriff.shotSnd ~= "Off" or J.sheriff.killSnd ~= "Off" then
						pcall(r)
					end
				end,
			})
		end
	end
end

		local q = a and a.Nova

		local H = (function(b, Z, P)

				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),

			local AM = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 0.35),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),

			local TM = false
			local function fM()
				if TM then

				task.spawn(function()
					local JM = os.clock()
					while #FM > 0 do
						local XM = os.clock()
						local tM = XM - JM
						JM = XM
						for JM = #FM, 1, -1.0 do
							local XM = FM[JM]
							if not XM.Parent or not XM:GetAttribute("spin") then
								table.remove(FM, JM)
							else

		function G(F)
			local B = V.roundtimer == true
			pcall(function()
				local U = getgenv().__pulseMM2Nova
				if U and U.SetWatermark then
					U:SetWatermark(V.pingfps == true or B)
				end
				if U and U.SetWatermarkTitle and not B then
					U:SetWatermarkTitle(nil)
				end
			end)
			if B then
				f()
			end
			B = false
			local U = B
			X.Visible = false
			if B then
				R.Visible = true
				a:Create(
					R,
					TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
					{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22) }
				):Play()
				f()
			else
				a:Create(
					R,
					TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
					{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }
				):Play()
				task.delay(0.2, function()
					if not V.roundtimer then
						pcall(function()
							R.Visible = false
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
			if U then
				if not t.Visible then
					t.Visible = true
					T.Visible = true
					if F then
						t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						t.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -6.0)
						a:Create(
							t,
							TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
							{ BackgroundTransparency = 0.16, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8) }
						):Play()
						T.ImageTransparency = 1
						a:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { ImageTransparency = 0.55 }):Play()
					end
				end
			else
				t.Visible = false
				T.Visible = false
			end
			do
				r()
			end
		end
		local function a(F)
			V.pingfps = F == true
			G(true)
			local F = getgenv().__pulsePfSettings
			if F and F.Get and F.Get() ~= V.pingfps and F.SetSilent then
				pcall(F.SetSilent, V.pingfps)
			end
		end
		local F = A:Toggle({
			Text = "Show Ping/Fps UI",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(T)
				a(T)
			end,
		})
		getgenv().__pulsePingFps = {
			get = function()
				return V.pingfps == true
			end,
			set = function(T)
				if F and F.Set then
					F.Set(T)
				else
					a(T)
				end
			end,
		}
		pcall(function()
			local F = {
				["Show Round Timer"] = {
					ru = "Показывать таймер раунда",
					uk = "Показувати таймер раунду",
				},
			}
			for T, f in pairs(F) do
				if J.data.ru then
					J.data.ru[T] = f.ru
				end
				if J.data.uk then
					J.data.uk[T] = f.uk
				end
			end
		end)
		A:Toggle({
			Text = "Show Round Timer",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(A)
				V.roundtimer = A == true
				G(true)
			end,
		})
		a(V.pingfps == true)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Trade Hub & Values (MM2 Godlies, Chromas, Ancients, Legendaries Value Calculator)
-- KEY: u
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["u"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t, R, B, U = G[3], G[5], G[10], G[4], G[7], G[2], G[1], G[0], G[8], G[6], G[9]
	return function()
		local G = {
			"godlies",
			"chromas",
			"ancients",
			"legendaries",
			"rares",
			"uncommons",
			"commons",
			"vintages",
			"misc",
			"pets",
		}
		local M = {
			godlies = 80,
			chromas = 30,
			commons = 150,
			uncommons = 100,
			rares = 80,
			legendaries = 40,
			ancients = 8,
			pets = 40,
		}
		a.trade = a.trade or {}
		if a.trade.value == nil then
			a.trade.value = false
		end
		local c = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local K, w = nil, "idle"
		local L = { t = 0, n = 0, busy = false, tries = 0, nextTry = 0, src = "" }
		getgenv().__pulseSV = L
		local function W(V)
			return (string.lower(tostring(V or "")):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
		end
		local function V(r)
			local _
			for q in tostring(r or ""):gmatch("%d%d%d%d%d+") do
				_ = q
			end
			return _
		end
		local function r(_)
			_ = tostring(_ or ""):gsub("<[^>]+>", " ")
			_ = _:gsub("&#(%d+);", function(q)
				local u = tonumber(q)
				return u and u < 1114112 and utf8.char(u) or ""
			end)
			_ = _:gsub("&#[xX](%x+);", function(q)
				local u = tonumber(q, 16)
				return u and u < 1114112 and utf8.char(u) or ""
			end)
			_ = _:gsub("&amp;", "&")
				:gsub("&quot;", '"')
				:gsub("&apos;", "'")
				:gsub("&nbsp;", " ")
				:gsub("&lt;", "<")
				:gsub("&gt;", ">")
			_ = _:gsub("%s+", " ")
			return (_:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
		end
		local function _(q, u, s)
			local h, Y, l = 0, 1, 0
			while true do
				local x = string.find(u, '<div class="itemcolumn"', Y, true)
				if not x then
					break
				end
				local S = string.find(u, '<div class="itemcolumn"', x + 23, true)
				local k = string.sub(u, x, (S or #u + 1) - 1)
				Y = S or #u + 1
				l += 1
				local u = tonumber(k:match('data%-value="([%d%.]+)"') or "")
				local Y = k:match('<div class="itemhead">(.-)</div>')
				if u and Y then
					local x = r(k:match('class="itemorigin">([^<]*)<') or "")
					if not (x:find("Deletion", 1, true) or u >= 500000) then
						h += 1
						s[#s + 1] = {
							c = q,
							n = r(Y),
							v = u,
							y = k:match('data%-year="(%d%d%d%d)"'),
							e = k:match('data%-event="([^"]+)"'),
							o = x ~= "" and x or nil,
							cl = k:match("Class %- <b>([^<]+)</b>"),
							dm = k:match('data%-demand="(%d+)"'),
						}
					end
				end
				if l % 60 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
			end
			return h
		end
		local function r(q)
			local u
			pcall(function()
				u = game:HttpGet(q)
			end)
			if type(u) == "string" and #u > 5000 and u:find("itemcolumn", 1, true) then
				return u
			end
			local u = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or request
			if type(u) == "function" then
				local s, h = pcall(u, {
					Url = q,
					Method = "GET",
					Headers = {
						["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0 Safari/537.36",
						["Accept"] = "text/html",
					},
				})
				local q = s and type(h) == "table" and (h.Body or h.body) or nil
				if type(q) == "string" and #q > 5000 and q:find("itemcolumn", 1, true) then
					return q
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function q()
			local u = {}
			for s, s in ipairs(G) do
				local G = r("https://supremevalues.com/mm2/" .. s)
				if not G then
					return nil
				end
				local r = _(s, G, u)
				if r < (M[s] or 1) then
					return nil
				end
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
			if #u < 650 then
				return nil
			end
			return u
		end
		local function G(M, r)
			r = r or {}
			r.uid = A.UserId
			local _ = c:JSONEncode(r)
			local r = {
				["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			}
			if getUpvalue(J) then
				local u = U.sha256hex(tostring(os.clock()) .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000000))):sub(1, 16)
				local U, s = pcall(getUpvalue(J), u, _)
				if U and type(s) == "string" then
					_ = c:JSONEncode({ e = s })
					r["X-Pulse-Enc"] = u
				end
			end
			local J, U = pcall(getUpvalue(t), {
				Url = "https://pulsehub.gg/pulse/sv/" .. M,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = r,
				Body = _,
			})
			if not J or type(U) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local J = U.Body or U.body or ""
			pcall(function()
				local t = U.Headers or U.headers
				local U
				if type(t) == "table" then
					for M, r in pairs(t) do
						if type(M) == "string" and M:lower() == "x-pulse-enc" then
							U = r
						end
					end
				end
				if U and getUpvalue(f) then
					local t = c:JSONDecode(J)
					if type(t) == "table" and type(t.e) == "string" then
						J = getUpvalue(f)(U, t.e)
					end
				end
			end)
			local f, t = pcall(function()
				return c:JSONDecode(J)
			end)
			if not f or type(t) ~= "table" or t.ok ~= true then
				return nil
			end
			return t
		end
		local function f()
			local J, t = pcall(function()
				if isfile and isfile("PulseHub/sv_values.json") then
					return c:JSONDecode(readfile("PulseHub/sv_values.json"))
				end
				return nil
			end)
			if J and type(t) == "table" and type(t.items) == "table" and tonumber(t.t) then
				return t
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function J(t, U)
			pcall(function()
				if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
					makefolder("PulseHub")
				end
				writefile("PulseHub/sv_values.json", c:JSONEncode({ t = t, items = U }))
			end)
		end
		local function t(U)
			local M
			pcall(function()
				M = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Database.Sync)
			end)
			if not (M and type(M.Item) == "table") then
				return nil
			end
			local c = M.Item
			local r = type(M.Pets) == "table" and M.Pets or {}
			local M, _ = {}, {}
			local function u(s, h)
				local Y = M[s]
				if not Y then
					Y = {}
					M[s] = Y
				end
				Y[#Y + 1] = h
			end
			for s, h in pairs(c) do
				if type(h) == "table" then
					local Y = tostring(h.ItemName or h.Name or "")
					local l = { "i", tostring(s), h }
					u(W(Y), l)
					local s = Y:gsub("%s*%d%d%d%d%s*$", "")
					if s ~= Y then
						u(W(s), l)
					end
				end
			end
			for s, h in pairs(r) do
				if type(h) == "table" then
					local Y = { "p", tostring(s), h }
					u("pet:" .. W(h.Name), Y)
					_[#_ + 1] = Y
				end
			end
			local u = {
				godlies = "Godly",
				ancients = "Ancient",
				legendaries = "Legendary",
				rares = "Rare",
				uncommons = "Uncommon",
				commons = "Common",
				vintages = "Classic",
			}
			local function s(h, Y)
				local l = {}
				for x, x in ipairs(h) do
					if Y(x) then
						l[#l + 1] = x
					end
				end
				return l
			end
			local h, Y = {}, 0
			for l, x in ipairs(U) do
				if l % 150 == 0 then
					task.wait()
				end
				local U = x.c
				local l = tonumber(x.v)
				if type(U) == "string" and l then
					local S = tostring(x.n or "")
					local k
					local y, Q = S:match("^(.-)%s*%((%a+)%)%s*$")
					if y and (Q == "Knife" or Q == "Gun") then
						k, S = Q, y
					end
					local y = x.y
					local Q, E = S:match("^(.-)%s*%((%d%d%d%d)%)%s*$")
					if Q then
						S, y = Q, E
					end
					if not y and x.o then
						y = tostring(x.o):match("(20%d%d)")
					end
					local Q = x.e
					local E = U == "chromas"
					if E then
						S = S:gsub("^Chroma%s+", ""):gsub("^C%.%s+", "")
					end
					local I = { S }
					local C = S:match("^(%a+) Papers$")
					if C then
						I[#I + 1] = "Box of " .. C .. " Wrapping Paper"
					end
					if S == "Ultra Wrap" then
						I[#I + 1] = "Box of Ultra Wrapping Paper"
					end
					if S:sub(-1.0) == "s" then
						I[#I + 1] = S:sub(1, -2.0)
					end
					if U == "legendaries" then
						local C = S:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$")
						if C then
							I[#I + 1] = C
						end
					end
					local function C(H)
						local n = H[3]
						if H[1] == "p" then
							if n.Chroma == true ~= E then
								return false
							end
							return U == "pets" or U == "chromas"
						end
						if U == "pets" then
							return false
						end
						if E then
							return n.Chroma == true
						end
						if n.Chroma then
							return false
						end
						if U == "misc" then
							return n.ItemType == "Misc" or n.Rarity == "Christmas" or n.Rarity == "Halloween"
						end
						return n.Rarity == u[U]
					end
					local u = {}
					for H, H in ipairs(I) do
						local I = s(M[(U == "pets" and "pet:" or "") .. W(H)] or {}, C)
						if E and #I == 0 then
							I = s(M["pet:" .. W(H)] or {}, C)
						end
						if #I > 0 then
							u = I
							break
						end
					end
					if U == "pets" and y then
						local U = W(S)
						if #s(u, function(M)
							return tostring(M[3].Year or "") == y
						end) == 0 then
							local M = s(_, function(_)
								return W(_[2]):sub(1, #U) == U and tostring(_[3].Year or "") == y and not _[3].Chroma
							end)
							if #M > 0 then
								u = M
							end
						end
					end
					local function U(M)
						local _ = s(u, M)
						if #_ > 0 then
							u = _
						end
					end
					if k then
						U(function(M)
							return M[3].ItemType == k
						end)
					end
					if #u > 1 and x.cl then
						U(function(M)
							return M[3].Rarity == x.cl
						end)
					end
					if #u > 1 then
						if y then
							local M = s(u, function(_)
								return tostring(_[3].Year or "") == y
							end)
							if #M > 0 then
								u = M
							else
								U(function(M)
									return not M[3].Year
								end)
							end
						else
							U(function(M)
								return not M[3].Year
							end)
						end
					end
					if #u > 1 then
						if Q then
							local M = s(u, function(_)
								return tostring(_[3].Event or "") == Q
							end)
							if #M > 0 then
								u = M
							else
								U(function(M)
									return not M[3].Event
								end)
							end
						else
							U(function(U)
								return not U[3].Event
							end)
						end
					end
					for U, U in ipairs(u) do
						local M = U[1] .. ":" .. U[2]
						local U = h[M]
						if not U then
							Y += 1
						end
						if not U or U.n >= #u then
							h[M] = { v = l, n = #u }
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local U, M, _ = {}, {}, {}
			for u, s in pairs(c) do
				if type(s) == "table" then
					local l = V(s.Image)
					if l and not U[l] then
						U[l] = "i:" .. tostring(u)
					end
				end
			end
			for u, s in pairs(c) do
				if type(s) == "table" and not s.Chroma and s.ItemID then
					local l = tostring(s.ItemID)
					if not U[l] then
						U[l] = "i:" .. tostring(u)
					end
				end
			end
			for u, s in pairs(r) do
				if type(s) == "table" then
					local l = V(s.Image)
					if l and not U[l] then
						U[l] = "p:" .. tostring(u)
					end
				end
			end
			local u = {}
			for s, l in pairs(c) do
				if type(l) == "table" and not l.Chroma then
					local x = W(l.ItemName) .. "|" .. tostring(l.ItemType)
					if not u[x] then
						u[x] = "i:" .. tostring(s)
					end
				end
			end
			for s, l in pairs(c) do
				if type(l) == "table" and l.Chroma then
					local x = u[W(l.ItemName) .. "|" .. tostring(l.ItemType)]
					if x then
						M[x] = "i:" .. tostring(s)
					end
				end
			end
			local u = {}
			for s, l in pairs(r) do
				if type(l) == "table" and not l.Chroma then
					u[W(l.Name)] = "p:" .. tostring(s)
				end
			end
			for s, l in pairs(r) do
				if type(l) == "table" and l.Chroma then
					local x = u[W(l.Name)]
					if x then
						M[x] = "p:" .. tostring(s)
					end
				end
			end
			local function u(s, l, x)
				local S = _[s]
				if not S then
					S = {}
					_[s] = S
				end
				S[#S + 1] = { key = l, chroma = x }
			end
			for s, l in pairs(c) do
				if type(l) == "table" and h["i:" .. tostring(s)] then
					u(W(l.ItemName), "i:" .. tostring(s), l.Chroma == true)
				end
			end
			for c, s in pairs(r) do
				if type(s) == "table" and h["p:" .. tostring(c)] then
					u(W(s.Name), "p:" .. tostring(c), s.Chroma == true)
				end
			end
			return { byKey = h, icon = U, chromaOf = M, byName = _, n = Y }
		end
		local function U(M, c, r)
			local _, u = pcall(t, c)
			if not (_ and u and u.n > 300) then
				return false
			end
			K = u
			L.t, L.n, L.src = tonumber(M) or os.time(), u.n, r or ""
			w = "ok"
			return true
		end
		local function t(M)
			if L.busy then
				return
			end
			local c = os.time()
			if not M and w == "ok" and c - L.t < 7200 then
				return
			end
			if not M and os.clock() < L.nextTry then
				return
			end
			L.busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local r = false
				pcall(function()
					local _ = f()
					local f = _
					if _ and c - _.t < 7200 and not M and w ~= "ok" then
						if U(_.t, _.items, "cache") then
							r = true
							return
						end
					end
					local M = G("get", { have = _ and _.t or 0 })
					if M and type(M.items) == "table" and tonumber(M.t) and (not f or tonumber(M.t) > f.t) then
						f = { t = tonumber(M.t), items = M.items }
						J(f.t, f.items)
					end
					if f and c - f.t < 7200 then
						if U(f.t, f.items, "server") then
							r = true
							return
						end
					end
					local M = q()
					if M then
						local c = os.time()
						J(c, M)
						if U(c, M, "site") then
							r = true
							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(G, "push", { items = M })
							end)
							return
						end
					end
					if f and (w ~= "ok" or f.t > L.t) and U(f.t, f.items, "old") then
						r = true
					end
				end)
				if r then
					L.tries, L.nextTry = 0, 0
				else
					if not K then
						w = "fail"
					end
					L.tries = math.min(L.tries + 1, 6)
					L.nextTry = os.clock() + 15 * 2 ^ L.tries
				end
				L.busy = false
			end)
		end
		local function G(f, J)
			if not K then
				return nil
			end
			local U = f:FindFirstChild("Tags")
			local M = U and U:FindFirstChild("Chroma")
			local U = M ~= nil and M.Visible == true
			local M = f:FindFirstChild("Container")
			local f = M and M:FindFirstChild("Icon")
			local M = f and V(f.Image)
			local f = M and K.icon[M]
			if f and U and K.chromaOf[f] then
				f = K.chromaOf[f]
			end
			local M = f and K.byKey[f]
			if M then
				return M.v
			end
			local f = K.byName[W(J)]
			if f then
				for J, J in ipairs(f) do
					if J.chroma == U then
						local f = K.byKey[J.key]
						if f then
							return f.v
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		L.valueOf = G
		L.load = t
		local f = { tiles = {}, tilesAt = {}, panelAt = 0 }
		getgenv().__pulseTV = f

		local V = Color3.fromRGB(226, 46, 58)

		local _ = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
		local function q(u)
			if u >= 1000000 then
				return string.format("%.2fM", u / 1000000)
			end
			if u >= 10000 then
				return string.format("%.1fK", u / 1000)
			end
			if u >= 1000 then
				return string.format("%.2fK", u / 1000)
			end
			if u >= 100 then
				return tostring(math.floor(u + 0.5))
			end
			if u >= 10 then
				return (string.format("%.1f", u):gsub("%.0$", ""))
			end
			return (string.format("%.2f", u):gsub("%.?0+$", ""))
		end
		local function u()

			return ({

		local function s(h, Y, l)
			local x = Instance.new(h)
			for h, S in pairs(Y) do
				x[h] = S
			end
			if x:IsA("GuiBase2d") then
				x.AutoLocalize = false
			end
			x.Parent = l
			return x
		end
		local function h(Y, l)
			return s("UICorner", { CornerRadius = typeof(l) == "UDim" and l or UDim.new(0, l) }, Y)
		end
		local function Y(l)
			local x, S = 1, l
			while S and not S:IsA("LayerCollector") do
				local l = S:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				if l then
					x = x * l.Scale
				end
				S = S.Parent
			end
			return math.max(x, 0.05)
		end
		local function l(x)
			while x and x:IsA("GuiObject") do
				if not x.Visible then
					return false
				end
				x = x.Parent
			end
			if x and x:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				return x.Enabled
			end
			return x ~= nil
		end
		f.tw = {}
		local function x(S, k, y)
			local Q = S .. "|" .. k .. "|" .. tostring(y.Weight)
			local E = f.tw[Q]
			if E then
				return E
			end
			local I, C = pcall(function()
				local H = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				H.Text, H.Font, H.Size, H.Width = S, y, k, 2000
				return J:GetTextBoundsAsync(H)
			end)
			E = I and C and math.ceil(C.X) or math.ceil(#S * k * 0.55)
			f.tw[Q] = E
			return E
		end
		local function J(S, k, y)
			S.BackgroundColor3 = k
			S.TextColor3 = y and Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24) or U
			local k = S:FindFirstChild("__PulseG") or s("UIGradient", { Name = "__PulseG", Rotation = 90 }, S)
			k.Color = ColorSequence.new(U, y and Color3.fromRGB(196, 199, 208) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 186, 190))
		end
		local function S(k, y, Q, E, I)
			local C = s("Frame", {
				Name = y,
				Position = Q,
				Size = UDim2.new(0, E, 0, 3),
				AnchorPoint = I and Vector2.new(1, 0) or Vector2.zero,
				BackgroundColor3 = V,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ZIndex = 42,
			}, k)
			h(C, 2)
			s("UIGradient", {
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, I and 0.85 or 0),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, I and 0 or 0.85),
				}),
			}, C)
			return C
		end
		local function k(y, Q, E)
			local I = y:FindFirstChild("Container") or y
			local y = I:FindFirstChild("__PulseIV")
			if y and y:GetAttribute("st") ~= "troll" then
				y:Destroy()
				y = nil
			end
			if not Q and not E then
				if y then
					y.Visible = false
				end
				return
			end
			local E = Y(I)
			local C = math.clamp(math.floor(I.AbsoluteSize.Y / E * 0.19 + 0.5), 14, 24)
			local E = Q and q(Q) or "?"
			local H = E .. "|" .. C
			if y and y:GetAttribute("k") == H then
				if not y.Visible then
					y.Visible = true
				end
				return
			end
			if not y then
				y = s("Frame", {
					Name = "__PulseIV",
					BackgroundColor3 = _,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 60,
				}, I)
				y:SetAttribute("st", "troll")
				h(y, 6)
				s("UIGradient", {
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.12),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.3),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					}),
				}, y)
				local _ = s("Frame", {
					Name = "Bar",
					BackgroundColor3 = V,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 61,
					Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -6.0),
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
				}, y)
				h(_, 2)
				s("TextLabel", {
					Name = "T",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = c,
					TextColor3 = U,
					TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					ZIndex = 61,
				}, y)
			end
			local _ = math.max(10, math.floor(C * 0.86 + 0.5))
			local I = x(E, _, c)
			y.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9 + I + math.floor(C * 1.1), C)
			y.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
			y.Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Q and V or Color3.fromRGB(150, 156, 170)
			y.T.Size = UDim2.new(0, I + 4, 1, 0)
			y.T.Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0.5, 0)
			y.T.TextSize = _
			y.T.Text = E
			y.T.TextColor3 = Q and U or M
			y:SetAttribute("k", H)
			y.Visible = true
		end
		local function _(y)
			local Q = y:FindFirstChild("ItemName")
			Q = Q and Q:FindFirstChild("Label")
			local E = Q and Q.Text or ""
			if E == "" or E:find("^Loading") then
				return nil
			end
			local Q = 1
			local I = y:FindFirstChild("Container")
			I = I and I:FindFirstChild("Amount")
			if I and I:IsA("TextLabel") and I.Text ~= "" then
				Q = tonumber(I.Text:match("%d+")) or 1
			end
			return E, Q
		end
		local function y(Q)
			local E = Q and Q:FindFirstChild("Container")
			if not E then
				return 0, 0, 0
			end
			local Q, I, C = 0, 0, 0
			for H, H in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
				if H:IsA("GuiObject") then
					local E, n = nil, 1
					if H.Visible then
						E, n = _(H)
					end
					if E then
						C = C + n
						local O = G(H, E)
						if O then
							Q = Q + O * n
							I = I + n
						end
						k(H, O, true)
					else
						k(H, nil, false)
					end
				end
			end
			return Q, I, C
		end
		local function Q(E)
			local I = E and E:FindFirstChild("Title")
			if not (I and I:IsA("TextLabel")) then
				return nil
			end
			local E = I:GetAttribute("__PulseOrig")
			if E and I.Text:find(" VALUE", 1, true) then
				I.Text = E
			end
			local E = I:FindFirstChild("__PulseG")
			if E then
				E:Destroy()
			end
			return I
		end
		local function E(I, C, H)
			local n = s("TextLabel", {
				Name = C,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				FontFace = c,
				Text = "",
				TextColor3 = U,
				ZIndex = H or 62,
				BackgroundColor3 = V,
			}, I)
			h(n, UDim.new(1, 0))
			J(n, V)
			return n
		end
		local function h(I, C, H)
			local n = math.max(10, math.floor(H * 0.6 + 0.5))
			I.Text, I.TextSize = C, n
			local O = x(C, n, c) + math.floor(H * 0.95)
			I.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(O, H)
			return O
		end
		local function I(C, H, n, O, N)
			local z = Q(C)
			local D = C:FindFirstChild("__PulseSum")
			if D and D:GetAttribute("st") ~= "troll" then
				D:Destroy()
				D = nil
			end
			local b = C:FindFirstChild("__PulseVerdict")
			if not z or O == 0 then
				if D then
					D.Visible = false
				end
				if b then
					b.Visible = false
				end
				return
			end
			if not D then
				D = E(C, "__PulseSum")
				D:SetAttribute("st", "troll")
			end
			local Z = Y(C)
			local P = math.clamp(math.floor(z.AbsoluteSize.Y / Z * 0.7 + 0.5), 18, 30)
			local i = h(D, q(H) .. (n < O and " +?" or ""), P)
			local H = (z.AbsolutePosition.X - C.AbsolutePosition.X + z.TextBounds.X) / Z + 12
			local n = (z.AbsolutePosition.Y - C.AbsolutePosition.Y + z.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) / Z
			D.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(H + 0.5), math.floor(n + 0.5))
			D.Visible = true
			if N then
				if not b then
					b = E(C, "__PulseVerdict")
				end
				h(b, N.text, P)
				J(b, N.col, N.dark)
				b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(H + i + 8 + 0.5), math.floor(n + 0.5))
				b.Visible = true
			elseif b then
				b.Visible = false
			end
		end
		local function C(H, n)
			local O = u()
			local N = n - H
			local z = math.max(H, 0.0001)
			if math.abs(N) <= math.max(0.02 * math.max(H, n), 0.005) then
				return { key = "even", text = O.even, col = U, dark = true, diff = N }
			end
			local n = H > 0 and math.floor(math.abs(N) / z * 100 + 0.5) or nil
			local H = N > 0 and "+" or "-"
			local z = H .. q(math.abs(N)) .. (n and "  " .. H .. math.min(n, 99999) .. "%" or "")
			if N > 0 then
				return { key = "win", text = O.win, sub = z, col = r, diff = N }
			end
			return { key = "loss", text = O.loss, sub = z, col = V, diff = N }
		end
		local function V(r)
			local H = s("Frame", {
				Name = "__PulsePanel",
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8),
				Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -24.0, 0.25, -14.0),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ZIndex = 40,
			}, r)
			H:SetAttribute("v", 4)
			local function r(n, O, N, z, D)
				return s("TextLabel", {
					Name = n,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = O,
					TextColor3 = z or U,
					Text = "",
					TextXAlignment = N or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
					ZIndex = 42,
					TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					TextStrokeTransparency = D or 1,
				}, H)
			end
			r("GiveL", K, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, M)
			r("GiveV", c, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, U, 0.6)
			r("GiveS", W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, M)
			r("GetL", K, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, M)
			r("GetV", c, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, U, 0.6)
			r("GetS", W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, M)
			S(H, "GiveLine", UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), 72, false)
			S(H, "GetLine", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), 72, true)
			s("ImageLabel", {
				Name = "Face",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=9631028060&w=150&h=150",
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
				ZIndex = 42,
			}, H)
			local M = E(H, "Verdict", 43)
			M.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			r("Src", W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Color3.fromRGB(120, 124, 138))
			r("Inv", W, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Color3.fromRGB(120, 124, 138))
			return H
		end
		local function M(W, r)
			local H = W:FindFirstChild("__PulsePanel")
			if H and H:GetAttribute("v") ~= 4 then
				H:Destroy()
				H = nil
			end
			if not H then
				H = V(W)
			end
			local W = u()
			local V = Y(H)
			local Y, n = H.AbsoluteSize.X / V, H.AbsoluteSize.Y / V
			if Y < 40 or n < 30 then
				return
			end
			local V = n / 120
			local function n(O, N, z, D, b, Z, P)
				O.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(N), math.floor(z))
				O.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(D), math.floor(b))
				O.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(Z))
				O.Text = P
			end
			local O = Y * 0.36
			local function N(z, D)
				local b = z .. " " .. W.items
				if D > 0 then
					b = b .. " · " .. D .. " " .. W.unk
				end
				return b
			end
			n(H.GiveL, 0, 4 * V, O, 15 * V, 14 * V, W.give)
			n(H.GiveV, 0, 18 * V, O, 42 * V, 44 * V, q(r.mine))
			H.GiveLine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.floor(62 * V))
			H.GiveLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(math.min(72, O * 0.5)), 3)
			n(H.GiveS, 0, 68 * V, O, 14 * V, 13 * V, N(r.mt, r.mt - r.mk))
			n(H.GetL, Y - O, 4 * V, O, 15 * V, 14 * V, W.get)
			n(H.GetV, Y - O, 18 * V, O, 42 * V, 44 * V, q(r.theirs))
			H.GetLine.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Y), math.floor(62 * V))
			H.GetLine.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(math.min(72, O * 0.5)), 3)
			n(H.GetS, Y - O, 68 * V, O, 14 * V, 13 * V, N(r.tt, r.tt - r.tk))
			local N = math.floor(math.min(58 * V, Y * 0.16))
			H.Face.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(N, N)
			H.Face.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Y / 2), math.floor(38 * V))
			local N = H.Verdict
			if r.mt + r.tt == 0 then
				N.Visible = false
				H.Face.ImageTransparency = 0.55
				H.Face.Rotation = 0
			else
				local z = C(r.mine, r.theirs)
				h(N, z.text .. (z.sub and "   " .. z.sub or ""), math.floor(24 * V))
				J(N, z.col, z.dark)
				N.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Y / 2), math.floor(95 * V))
				N.Visible = true
				H.Face.ImageTransparency = z.key == "loss" and 0.45 or 0
				H.Face.Rotation = z.key == "win" and -8.0 or 0
			end
			local J = ""
			if L.t > 0 then
				local N = math.max(0, os.time() - L.t)
				J = "supremevalues · "
					.. (N < 3600 and math.floor(N / 60) .. " " .. W.mn or math.floor(N / 3600) .. " " .. W.hr)
			end
			n(H.Src, Y - O, 108 * V, O, 12 * V, 11 * V, J)
			n(H.Inv, 0, 108 * V, O, 12 * V, 11 * V, r.inv and r.inv > 0 and W.mine .. " " .. q(r.inv) or "")
			H.Visible = true
		end
		local function J()
			local W = A:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			if not W then
				return nil
			end
			for V, V in ipairs({ "TradeGUI", "TradeGUI_Phone" }) do
				local r = W:FindFirstChild(V)
				if r and r.Enabled then
					local W = r:FindFirstChild("Container")
					local V = W and W:FindFirstChild("Trade")
					if V and V.Visible ~= false then
						return r, W, V
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function W(V, r, Y)
			local H = os.clock()
			local n = f.tiles[r]
			if n and f.tilesAt[r] and H - f.tilesAt[r] < (Y or 1.5) and f.tilesRoot and f.tilesRoot[r] == V then
				return n
			end
			n = {}
			for Y, Y in ipairs(V:GetDescendants()) do
				if Y.Name == "ItemName" and Y:IsA("GuiObject") then
					local O = Y.Parent
					if O and O:FindFirstChild("Container") then
						n[#n + 1] = O
					end
				end
			end
			f.tiles[r], f.tilesAt[r] = n, H
			f.tilesRoot = f.tilesRoot or {}
			f.tilesRoot[r] = V
			return n
		end
		local function V(r)
			local Y = 0
			for H, H in ipairs(r) do
				if H.Parent and H.Visible ~= false then
					local r, n = _(H)
					local _ = r and G(H, r) or nil
					if _ then
						Y = Y + _ * n
					end
					k(H, _, false)
				end
			end
			return Y
		end
		local function G(r)
			if not r then
				return
			end
			for _, _ in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
				if
					_.Name == "__PulseIV"
					or _.Name == "__PulseSum"
					or _.Name == "__PulseVerdict"
					or _.Name == "__PulsePanel"
					or _.Name == "__PulseDiff"
					or _.Name == "__PulseInvBadge"
				then
					pcall(function()
						_:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function r()
			local _ = A and A:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			if not _ then
				return
			end
			for Y, Y in ipairs({ "TradeGUI", "TradeGUI_Phone" }) do
				local k = _:FindFirstChild(Y)
				if k then
					local _ = k:FindFirstChild("Container")
					local Y = _ and _:FindFirstChild("Trade")
					for k, k in ipairs({ "YourOffer", "TheirOffer" }) do
						pcall(Q, Y and Y:FindFirstChild(k))
					end
					G(_)
				end
			end
			f.tiles, f.tilesAt = {}, {}
		end
		local function _()
			local Y = A and A:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			if not Y then
				return
			end
			for k, k in ipairs({ "MainGUI", "MainMobile" }) do
				local Q = Y:FindFirstChild(k)
				local k = Q and Q:FindFirstChild("Game")
				k = k and k:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
				if k then
					G(k)
				end
			end
			local k = Y:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI")
			local Q = k and k:FindFirstChild("Container")
			Q = Q and Q:FindFirstChild("Items")
			if Q then
				G(Q)
			end
			local k = Y:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI_Phone")
			local Y = k and k:FindFirstChild("Container")
			Y = Y and Y:FindFirstChild("Items")
			if Y then
				G(Y)
			end
			f.tiles, f.tilesAt = {}, {}
		end
		F(function()
			pcall(r)
			pcall(_)
		end)
		local function G(F, f, Y)
			local k = F:FindFirstChild("__PulseInvBadge")
			if k and k:GetAttribute("st") ~= "troll" then
				k:Destroy()
				k = nil
			end
			if f + Y <= 0 then
				if k then
					k.Visible = false
				end
				return
			end
			local Q = u()
			if not k then
				k = s("Frame", {
					Name = "__PulseInvBadge",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					ZIndex = 70,
				}, F)
				k:SetAttribute("st", "troll")
				s("TextLabel", {
					Name = "N",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = c,
					TextColor3 = U,
					TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55,
					ZIndex = 71,

		local G = R:Note({ Text = "supremevalues.com" })
		local function A()
			local F = a.ui and a.ui.lang or "en"
			local a = ({
				ru = {
					"Цены",
					"загрузка",
					"недоступны",
					"мин",
					"ч",
					"назад",
					"предметов",
				},
				uk = {
					"Ціни",
					"завантаження",
					"недоступні",
					"хв",
					"год",
					"тому",
					"предметів",
				},
			})[F] or {
				"Values",
				"loading",
				"unavailable",
				"min",
				"h",
				"ago",
				"items",
			}
			if w ~= "ok" then
				return a[1] .. ": " .. (w == "fail" and not L.busy and a[3] or a[2])
			end
			local F = math.max(0, os.time() - L.t)
			local f = F < 3600 and math.floor(F / 60) .. " " .. a[4] or math.floor(F / 3600) .. " " .. a[5]
			return string.format("%s: %d %s · %s %s · supremevalues.com", a[1], L.n, a[7], f, a[6])
		end
		task.spawn(function()

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - Bomb Jump (Bomb Jump, Auto Bomb)
-- KEY: m
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["m"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X = G[1], G[3], G[6], G[0], G[4], G[5], G[2]
	return function()
		pcall(function()
			local G = {
				["Bomb Jump"] = {
					ru = "Бомба-прыжок",
					uk = "Бомба-стрибок",
				},
				["Auto Bomb Jump"] = {
					ru = "Бомба-прыжок",
					uk = "Бомба-стрибок",
				},
			}
			for t, R in pairs(G) do
				if A.data.ru then
					A.data.ru[t] = R.ru
				end
			end
		end)
		local function G()
			local A = a.Character
			local t = A and A:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local R = A and A:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (t and R and t.Health > 0) then
				return
			end
			local A
			if t.UseJumpPower == false then
				A = math.sqrt(2 * (workspace.Gravity or 196.2) * math.max(t.JumpHeight or 7.2, 1))
			else
				A = math.max(t.JumpPower or 50, 50)
			end
			getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil = math.max(tonumber(getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil) or 0, os.clock() + 1.5)
			local B = R.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			R.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(B.X, A, B.Z)
			pcall(function()
				t:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end)
		end
		local function A()
			local t = a.Character
			local R = t and t:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")
			if R then
				return R, true
			end
			local t = a:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			if t then
				local R = t:FindFirstChild("Toys")
				local B = R and R:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or t:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")
				if B then
					return B, false
				end
			end
			return nil, false
		end
		local function t()
			local R = a.Character
			local B = R and R:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (R and B) then
				return nil
			end
			local B = R:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or A()
			if not B then
				return nil
			end
			pcall(function()
				B.Parent = R
			end)
			task.wait(0.08)
			B = R:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or B
			pcall(function()
				local A = B:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				local U = R:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or R:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
				if A and U and not U:FindFirstChild("RightGrip") then
					A.Anchored = false
					local M = Instance.new("Weld")
					M.Name = "RightGrip"
					M.Part0 = U
					M.Part1 = A
					M.C0 = U.Name == "RightHand" and CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0)
						or CFrame.new(0, -1.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-1.5707963267948966, 0, 0)
					M.C1 = B.Grip
					M.Parent = U
				end
			end)
			return B.Parent == R and B or nil
		end
		local function A(R)
			local B = t()
			local U = B and B:FindFirstChild("Remote")
			if not U then
				return false
			end
			getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil = math.max(tonumber(getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil) or 0, os.clock() + 2)
			pcall(function()
				U:FireServer(CFrame.new(R), 50)
			end)
			return true
		end
		local function R(B)
			local function U(M)
				if M.Name == "FakeBomb" and M:IsA("Tool") then
					T(M.Activated, function()
						if f.bombJump then
							G()
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			for M, M in ipairs(B:GetChildren()) do
				U(M)
			end
			T(B.ChildAdded, U)
		end
		if a.Character then
			R(a.Character)
		end
		T(a.CharacterAdded, function(B)
			task.wait(0.3)
			R(B)
		end)
		local R = false
		getgenv().__pulseAutoBombJump = function()
			if R then
				return
			end
			R = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local B = a.Character
				local a = B and B:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if a then
					t()
					task.wait(0.1)
					G()
					task.wait(0.12)
					A(a.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
					task.wait(0.22)
					G()
				end
				R = false
			end)
		end
		X:Toggle({
			Text = "Bomb Jump",
			Default = F.bombJump,
			Callback = function(G)
				f.bombJump = G == true
			end,
			Settings = function()
				do
					local G = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(f.bombJumpKey)
					X:Keybind({
						Text = "Bomb Jump",
						Default = G,
						Active = function()
							return R
						end,
						Callback = function(a)
							G = a
							f.bombJumpKey = a and a.Name or ""
						end,
					})
					T(J.InputBegan, function(a, A)
						if not getgenv().__pulseBindReady() then
							return
						end
						if getgenv().__pulseBindHit(a, G) then
							local G = getgenv().__pulseAutoBombJump
							if G then
								pcall(G)
							end
						end
					end)
				end
			end,
		})
	end
end

			local function y(Q, E, I)
				local C = E and E.active
				local H = C and E.icon or ""
				if Q.img.Image ~= H then
					Q.img.Image = H
				end
				Q.img.Visible = C == true
				Q.empty.Visible = not C
				local H = C and E.name or "—"
				if Q.name.Text ~= H then
					Q.name.Text = H
				end
				local H = C and string.upper(E.mode or "") or ""
				if Q.mode.Text ~= H then
					Q.mode.Text = H
				end
				local H = E and E.idle
				local n = C and not H and E.votes or 0
				local O = H and "–" or tostring(n)
				if Q.key.label.Text ~= O then
					Q.key.label.Text = O
					Q.key.chip.Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(Q.keyMin or 28, #O * (Q.keyCw or 8) + (Q.keyPad or 16)), Q.keyH or 22)
				end
				local O = L.idx == Q.i and (L.busy or L.done > 0 and C)
				Q.pipRow.Visible = O == true
				if O then
					local N = math.clamp(L.want, 1, 10)
					S(Q, N)
					local S = math.floor(L.done * N / math.max(L.want, 1) + 0.000001)
					if Q.pipOn ~= S then
						Q.pipOn = S
						local N = u("Accent", Color3.fromRGB(214, 68, 88))
						for z, D in ipairs(Q.pips) do
							if z <= S then
								l(D, 0.25, { BackgroundColor3 = N, BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
							else
								D.BackgroundColor3 = K
								D.BackgroundTransparency = 0.62
							end
						end
					end
				else
					Q.pipOn = -1.0
				end
				local S = C and not H and n > 0 and n == I and not O
				Q.lead.Visible = S == true
				local S = O and "Accent" or "Muted"
				if Q.tone ~= S then
					Q.tone = S
					r(Q.mode, "TextColor3", S, K)
					r(Q.key.stroke, "Color", O and "Accent" or "Glass", K)
					Q.key.stroke.Transparency = O and 0.25 or (Q.keyIdle or 0.82)
				end
				if O then
					local S = "+" .. L.done .. "/" .. L.want
					if Q.mode.Text ~= S then
						Q.mode.Text = S
					end
				end
				local S = u("Accent", Color3.fromRGB(214, 68, 88))
				local I = u("Glass", K)
				local n = Q.hover and C and not H
				Q.stroke.Color = (O or n) and S or I

				Q.img.ImageTransparency = L.busy and not O and 0.55 or (E and E.idle and 0.45 or 0)
			end

								N, b = Z, i
							end
						end
					end

					end

					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 40),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -20.0, 0, 84),
					ZIndex = 7,
				}, J)
				local F = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
				F.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
				F.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
				F.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
				F.Parent = R
				for F = 1, 3 do
					_[F] = k(R, F, 8)
				end
				local F, R, M, w = false, nil, nil, nil
				c(X.InputBegan, function(X)
					if
						X.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or X.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						F, R, M, w = true, X.Position, G.Position, X
						local r
						r = X.Changed:Connect(function()
							if X.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
								F = false
								r:Disconnect()
								A.vote.pos = { x = G.Position.X.Offset, y = G.Position.Y.Offset }
							end
						end)
					end
				end)
				c(f.InputChanged, function(f)
					if not F then
						return
					end
					if w and w.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
						if f ~= w then
							return
						end
					elseif
						f.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						and f.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						return
					end
					local F = f.Position - R
					local f = a.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
					local a = math.clamp(M.X.Offset + F.X, 4, math.max(4, f.X - G.AbsoluteSize.X - 4))
					local X = math.clamp(M.Y.Offset + F.Y, 4, math.max(4, f.Y - G.AbsoluteSize.Y - 4))
					G.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(a, X)
				end)
			end
			pcall(T)
			B(function()
				pcall(function()
					if G then
						G:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end)
			local a = false
			local F = false
			task.spawn(function()
				while isAlive(t) do
					pcall(function()
						local T = {}
						for f = 1, 3 do
							T[f] = V(f)
						end
						local f = false
						for X = 1, 3 do
							if T[X] and T[X].active then
								f = true
							end
						end
						if f then
							local X, t = {}, type(A.vote.last) == "table"
							for R = 1, 3 do
								local B = T[R]
								X[R] = { n = B and B.name or "", i = B and B.icon or "" }
								local B = t and A.vote.last[R]
								if not (type(B) == "table" and B.n == X[R].n and B.i == X[R].i) then
									t = false
								end
							end
							if not t and X[1].n ~= "" and X[2].n ~= "" and X[3].n ~= "" then
								A.vote.last = X
							end
						else
							local X = A.vote.last
							if type(X) == "table" then
								for t = 1, 3 do
									local R = X[t]
									if type(R) == "table" and type(R.n) == "string" and R.n ~= "" then
										T[t] = {
											active = true,
											idle = true,
											name = R.n,
											icon = L.iconFor and L.iconFor(R.n) or R.i,
											mode = "",
											votes = 0,
										}
									end
								end
							end
						end
						if f and not F then
							L.startT = os.clock()
							if not L.busy then
								L.idx, L.done, L.status = nil, 0, ""
							end
						elseif not f and F then
							L.startT = nil
						end
						F = f
						S(x, T)
						S(_, T)
						local F = Q(f)
						if E and E.Text ~= F then
							E.Text = F
						end
						if G then
							local T = A.vote.panel ~= false and (f or L.busy)
							if T ~= a then
								a = T
								if T then
									G.Visible = true
									J.GroupTransparency = 1
									if U then
										U.ImageTransparency = 1
									end
									if W then
										W.ImageTransparency = 1
									end
									l(J, 0.28, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
									if U then
										l(U, 0.28, { ImageTransparency = 0.5 })
									end
									if W then
										l(W, 0.28, { ImageTransparency = 0.45 })
									end
								else
									l(J, 0.22, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
									if U then
										l(U, 0.22, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
									end
									if W then
										l(W, 0.22, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
									end
									task.delay(0.24, function()
										if not a and G then
											G.Visible = false
										end
									end)
								end
							end
							if a then
								if y.Text ~= F then
									y.Text = F
								end
								local G = tostring(A.vote.count or 10)
								if H.Text ~= G then
									H.Text = G
								end
								n.Visible = L.busy
								C.BackgroundColor3 = u(L.busy and "Accent" or (f and "Success" or "Faint"), K)
							end
						end
					end)
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Farming - Coin Collector (Auto Coin Collection)
-- KEY: o
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["o"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X = G[3], G[4], G[1], G[2], G[0], G[5], G[6]
	return function()
		pcall(function()
			local G = {
				["Anti Coin"] = {
					ru = "Анти-монеты",
					uk = "Анти-монети",
				},
				["Coin leaked, strict mode on"] = {
					ru = "Монета засчиталась, включена жёсткая защита",
					uk = "Монета зарахувалась, увімкнено жорсткий захист",
				},
			}
			for t, R in pairs(G) do
				if f.data.ru then
					f.data.ru[t] = R.ru
				end
				if f.data.uk then
					f.data.uk[t] = R.uk
				end
			end
		end)
		local G = { n = 0, leaks = 0, strict = false }
		getgenv().__pulseAntiCoinInfo = G
		getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin = false
		local t = game:GetService("Workspace")
		local R = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local B = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local U = false
		local function M(c)
			if not c:IsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end
			if R[c] == nil then
				R[c] = c.CanTouch
			end
			if c.CanTouch then
				c.CanTouch = false
				G.n += 1
			end
		end
		local function c()
			for K, K in ipairs(t:GetChildren()) do
				local w = K:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
				if w then
					for K, K in ipairs(w:GetChildren()) do
						pcall(M, K)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local function K()
			local w = T.Character
			if not w then
				return
			end
			for L, L in ipairs(w:GetChildren()) do
				if L:IsA("BasePart") then
					if B[L] == nil then
						B[L] = L.CanTouch
					end
					if L.CanTouch then
						pcall(function()
							L.CanTouch = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local function w()
			for L, W in pairs(R) do
				if L.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						L.CanTouch = W
					end)
				end
				R[L] = nil
			end
			for R, L in pairs(B) do
				if R.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						R.CanTouch = L
					end)
				end
				B[R] = nil
			end
			G.strict = false
		end
		a(function()
			U = false
			getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin = false
			w()
		end)
		A(t.DescendantAdded, function(a)
			if not U then
				return
			end
			local t = a.Parent
			if t and t.Name == "CoinContainer" then
				pcall(M, a)
			end
		end)
		A(T.CharacterAdded, function()
			if not (U and G.strict) then
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.5)
			pcall(K)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			local a
			while getUpvalue(X)() and not a do
				local T = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
				a = T and T:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
				if not a then
					task.wait(1)
				end
			end
			local T = a and a:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected")
			if not T then
				return
			end
			A(T.OnClientEvent, function()
				if not U then
					return
				end
				G.leaks += 1
				if not G.strict then
					G.strict = true
					pcall(K)
					pcall(function()
						J.W:Notify({
							Title = f.tr("Anti Coin"),
							Text = f.tr("Coin leaked, strict mode on"),
							Kind = "error",
							Duration = 3,
						})
					end)
				end
			end)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(X) do
				task.wait(0.5)
				if U then
					pcall(c)
					if G.strict then
						pcall(K)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local function a(A)
			U = A == true
			getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin = U
			if U then
				pcall(c)
			else
				w()
			end
		end
		G.set = a
		F:Toggle({ Text = "Anti Coin", Default = false, Callback = a })
	end
end

		V.makeSet = function(a)
			local x = V.frame(V.root(), "Player_" .. tostring(a.UserId), 2)
			x.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			local a = V.frame(x, "Box", 3)
			local S = V.make("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, a)
			local k = V.stroke(a, 1.5)
			local y = V.make("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, k)
			local Q = V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0) }, a)
			local E = V.frame(x, "Glow", 2)
			local I = V.stroke(E, 6)
			local C = V.make("UICorner", {}, E)
			local H = V.frame(x, "BoxOutline", 2)
			local n = V.stroke(H, 3.5)
			local O = V.make("UICorner", {}, H)
			local N = {
				layer = x,
				box = a,
				edge = k,
				round = Q,
				glow = E,
				glowStroke = I,
				glowRound = C,
				fillGradient = S,
				outer = H,
				outerStroke = n,
				outerRound = O,
				edgeGradient = y,
				corners = {},
				cornerGlow = {},
				cornerEdge = {},
				bones = {},
				hp = V.makeBar(x, "Health"),
				look = V.line(x, "Look"),
				tracer = V.line(x, "Tracer"),
			}
			for a = 1, 8 do
				N.corners[a] = V.line(x, "Corner" .. a)
				N.cornerGlow[a] = V.line(x, "CornerGlow" .. a)
				N.cornerGlow[a].frame.ZIndex = 2
				N.cornerEdge[a] = V.frame(x, "CornerEdge" .. a, 3)
			end
			for a = 1, #V.BONES.R15 do
				local S = V.line(x, "Bone" .. a)
				V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, S.frame)
				N.bones[a] = S
			end

			N.head.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, N.head)
			N.headStroke = V.stroke(N.head, 1.5)

		end

		V.modelRoot = function()
			local a = L.CurrentCamera
			if not a then
				return nil
			end
			if r.modelFolder and r.modelFolder.Parent == a then
				return r.modelFolder
			end
			if r.modelFolder then
				pcall(function()
					r.modelFolder:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			for x, x in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
				if x.Name == "PulseESPModels" then
					pcall(function()
						x:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			r.modelFolder = V.make("Folder", { Name = "PulseESPModels" }, a)
			return r.modelFolder
		end
		V.poolFor = function(a, x)
			r.pool = r.pool or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local S = r.pool[a]
			if not S then
				S = {}
				r.pool[a] = S
			end
			local a = S[x]
			if not a then
				a = { at = os.clock(), items = {} }
				S[x] = a
			end
			return a
		end
		V.poolKey = function(a)
			local x = a.Size
			local S = a.Name .. "|" .. a.ClassName .. "|" .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", x.X, x.Y, x.Z)
			if a.ClassName == "MeshPart" then
				S = S .. "|" .. tostring(a.MeshId)
			else
				local x = a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
				if x then
					local a = x.Scale
					S = S
						.. "|"
						.. tostring(x.MeshId)
						.. "|"
						.. x.MeshType.Name
						.. "|"
						.. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", a.X, a.Y, a.Z)
				end
			end
			return S
		end
		V.poolPurge = function(a)
			if not r.pool then
				return
			end
			for x, x in pairs(r.pool) do
				for S, k in pairs(x) do
					if a == nil or S == a then
						for a, a in pairs(k.items) do
							for k, k in ipairs(a) do
								pcall(function()
									k:Destroy()
								end)
							end
						end
						x[S] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end
		V.poolSweep = function()
			if not r.pool then
				return
			end
			local a = os.clock()
			for x, x in pairs(r.pool) do
				for S, k in pairs(x) do
					local y = type(S) ~= "table" and S.Parent == nil
					if y or a - k.at > 45 then
						for a, a in pairs(k.items) do
							for k, k in ipairs(a) do
								pcall(function()
									k:Destroy()
								end)
							end
						end
						x[S] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end
		V.modelDropIn = function(a, x)
			local S = a[x]
			if S then
				for k, k in ipairs(S.conns or {}) do
					pcall(function()
						k:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				local k = S.kind ~= "Wireframe" and S.keys and V.poolFor(a, x) or nil
				for y, Q in ipairs(S.clones) do
					local E = k and S.keys[y]
					if E and Q.Parent ~= nil then
						pcall(function()
							Q.Transparency = 1
						end)
						local S = k.items[E]
						if not S then
							S = {}
							k.items[E] = S
						end
						S[#S + 1] = Q
					else
						pcall(function()
							Q:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
				if k then
					k.at = os.clock()
				end
			end
			a[x] = nil
		end
		V.modelDrop = function(a)
			V.modelDropIn(r.models, a)
			V.modelDropIn(r.halos, a)
		end
		V.cloneable = function(a)
			local x = r.partKinds
			local S = a.ClassName
			local k = x[S]
			if k == nil then
				k = a:IsA("BasePart")
				x[S] = k
			end
			if not k or a.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
				return false
			end
			if a.Transparency >= 0.95 or a.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 0.95 then
				return false
			end
			if a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer") then
				return false
			end
			local x = a:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
			if x and x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
		V.modelBroken = function(a)
			return a.char.Parent == nil
		end
		V.modelBuild = function(a, x, S, k, y)
			local Q = tostring(x):match("^[^@]+")
			local E = {
				material = x,
				kind = Q,
				spec = S,
				char = a,
				root = a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or a:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or a:FindFirstChild(
					"Torso"
				),
				sources = {},
				clones = {},
				sizes = {},
				meshes = {},
				scales = {},
				cfs = {},
				boxes = {},
				keys = {},
				shown = nil,
				scale = 1,
				conns = {},
			}
			if Q == "Wireframe" then
				y = nil
			end
			for x, x in ipairs(a:GetDescendants()) do
				if V.cloneable(x) then
					local I = y and V.poolKey(x) or nil
					local C = I and y.items[I]
					local y = C and table.remove(C)
					while y and y.Parent ~= k do
						pcall(function()
							y:Destroy()
						end)
						y = table.remove(C)
					end
					local C, H
					if y then
						C = y:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
						if C then
							local n = x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
							H = n and n.Scale or C.Scale
						end
					else
						local n = x.Archivable
						x.Archivable = true
						local O, N = pcall(function()
							return x:Clone()
						end)
						x.Archivable = n
						if O and N then
							y = N
							if y:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") then
								for n, n in ipairs(y:GetChildren()) do
									if n:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
										C = n
										n.TextureId = ""
									else
										n:Destroy()
									end
								end
							else
								y:ClearAllChildren()
							end
							if C then
								H = C.Scale
							end
							if y:IsA("MeshPart") then
								pcall(function()
									y.TextureID = ""
								end)
							end
							y.Name = "M"
						end
					end
					if y then
						local n = #E.clones + 1
						if C and C.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
							E.meshes[n], E.scales[n] = C, H * S[2]
							C.Scale = E.scales[n]
						else
							E.sizes[n] = x.Size * S[2]
							y.Size = E.sizes[n]
						end
						y.Anchored, y.CanCollide, y.CanQuery, y.CanTouch, y.CastShadow =
							true, false, false, false, false
						y.Material, y.Reflectance, y.Transparency = S[1], S[4], 1
						if Q == "Wireframe" and x.Parent == a and x.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
							E.boxes[n] = V.make(
								"SelectionBox",
								{ Adornee = y, LineThickness = 0.02, SurfaceTransparency = 1, Transparency = 1 },
								y
							)
						end
						if y.Parent ~= k then
							y.Parent = k
						end
						E.sources[n], E.clones[n], E.keys[n] = x, y, I
					end
				end
			end
			local function x(S)
				if S:IsA("BasePart") or S:IsA("Accessory") or S:IsA("WrapLayer") or S:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					if not E.dirty then
						E.dirty = os.clock()
					end
				end
			end
			E.conns[1] = a.DescendantAdded:Connect(x)
			E.conns[2] = a.DescendantRemoving:Connect(x)
			return E
		end
		V.modelResize = function(a, x)
			a.scale = x
			for S, k in ipairs(a.clones) do
				local y = a.meshes[S]
				if y then
					y.Scale = a.scales[S] * x
				else
					k.Size = a.sizes[S] * x
				end
			end
			for S, S in pairs(a.boxes) do
				S.LineThickness = 0.02 * x
			end
		end
		V.modelPaint = function(a, x, S, k)
			local y, Q = a.clones, a.sources
			local E = a.kind or a.material
			local I = V.chamsSpeed or 1
			local C = a.root
			local a = C and C.Parent and C.Position.Y or 0
			local C, H
			if E == "Gradient" then
				C, H = V.chamTone(V.tone(V.chamsGradA)), V.chamTone(V.tone(V.chamsGradB))
			end
			for n = 1, #y do
				local O = y[n]
				local y = x
				if E == "Iridescent" then
					y = Color3.fromHSV((k * 0.12 * I + n * 0.012) % 1, 0.38, 1)
				elseif E == "Gradient" then
					local x = Q[n]
					local Q = 0.5
					if x and x.Parent then
						Q = math.clamp((x.Position.Y - (a - 3)) / 5.6, 0, 1)
					end
					if V.chamsGradScroll then
						Q = math.abs((Q + k * 0.2 * I) % 1 * 2 - 1)
					end
					y = H:Lerp(C, Q)
				end
				O.Color = y
				O.Transparency = S
			end
		end
		V.modelShow = function(a, x, S, k)
			if not x then
				if a.shown ~= false then
					for x, x in ipairs(a.clones) do
						x.Transparency = 1
					end
					for x, x in pairs(a.boxes) do
						x.Transparency = 1
					end
					a.shown = false
				end
				return
			end
			local x = os.clock()
			local y = a.shown == true
			if y and x - (a.propsAt or 0) < 0.03333333333333333 then
				return
			end
			local Q = 1 - math.clamp(a.spec[3] * k, 0, 1)
			local k = a.kind or a.material
			a.propsAt = x
			if k == "Wireframe" then
				a.shown = true
				if not y or a.lastTint ~= S or math.abs((a.lastTr or -1.0) - Q) >= 0.01 then
					a.lastTint, a.lastTr = S, Q
					for E, E in pairs(a.boxes) do
						E.Color3 = S
						E.Transparency = Q
					end
				end
				return
			end
			if k == "Iridescent" or k == "Gradient" then
				a.shown = true
				a.lastTint, a.lastTr = nil, nil
				V.modelPaint(a, S, Q, x)
				return
			end
			local x = not y or a.lastTint ~= S
			local k = not y or math.abs((a.lastTr or -1.0) - Q) >= 0.01
			if not (x or k) then
				return
			end
			a.shown = true
			local y = a.clones
			if x then
				a.lastTint = S
				for x = 1, #y do
					y[x].Color = S
				end
			end
			if k then
				a.lastTr = Q
				for a = 1, #y do
					y[a].Transparency = Q
				end
			end
		end
		V.modelPlaceStore = function(a, x, S, k)
			for y, y in pairs(a) do
				local a = y.root
				local Q = not (a and a.Parent)
				if y.shown and S and a and a.Parent then
					if y.view ~= nil then
						Q = y.view == false
					else
						local E = a.Position
						if (E - x).Magnitude > 12 then
							local I = S:WorldToViewportPoint(E)
							local S, E = k.X * 0.35, k.Y * 0.35
							Q = I.Z < -6.0 or I.X < -S or I.X > k.X + S or I.Y < -E or I.Y > k.Y + E
						end
					end
				end
				if y.shown and Q then
					if not y.parked then
						y.parked = true
						local S, k = CFrame.new(0, 30000, 0), {}
						for E = 1, #y.clones do
							k[E] = S
						end
						pcall(function()
							L:BulkMoveTo(y.clones, k, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
						end)
					end
				end
				if y.shown and not Q then
					y.parked = nil
					if V.chamsThrough and a and a.Parent then
						local S = math.max((a.Position - x).Magnitude, 0.01)
						local a = math.min(1, r.modelDepth / S)
						local k = y.scale
						if a >= 1 then
							if k < 1 then
								V.modelResize(y, 1)
							end
						elseif k >= 1 then
							V.modelResize(y, a)
						else
							local Q = S * k
							if Q < r.modelDepth * 0.76 or Q > r.modelDepth * 1.3 then
								V.modelResize(y, a)
							end
						end
					elseif y.scale ~= 1 then
						V.modelResize(y, 1)
					end
					local a = y.scale
					local S, k = y.cfs, y.sources
					if a < 1 then
						local Q = x * (1 - a)
						for x = 1, #k do
							local E = k[x].CFrame
							S[x] = E.Rotation + (E.Position * a + Q)
						end
					else
						for a = 1, #k do
							S[a] = k[a].CFrame
						end
					end
					pcall(L.BulkMoveTo, L, y.clones, S, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
				end
			end
		end
		V.modelPlace = function()
			local a = L.CurrentCamera
			if not a then
				return
			end
			local x = a.CFrame.Position
			local S = a.ViewportSize
			V.modelPlaceStore(r.models, x, a, S)
			V.modelPlaceStore(r.halos, x, a, S)
		end
		V.placeBind = function()
			if r.placeBound then
				return
			end
			r.placeBound = "PulseESP2ModelPlace"
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep(r.placeBound)
			end)
			G:BindToRenderStep(r.placeBound, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
				pcall(V.modelPlace)
			end)
		end
		V.placeUnbind = function()
			if not r.placeBound then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep(r.placeBound)
			end)
			r.placeBound = nil
		end
		V.modelStep = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q, E, I, C)
			local H = os.clock()
			local n = a[x]
			local O = n == nil
				or n.char ~= S
				or n.material ~= E
				or V.modelBroken(n)
				or n.dirty ~= nil and H - n.dirty > 0.35
			if O then
				if not k then
					if n then
						V.modelDropIn(a, x)
					end
					return
				end
				if (r.budget or 0) <= 0 then
					if n and n.char == S then
						n.view = C
						V.modelShow(n, k, y, Q)
					end
					return
				end
				r.budget -= 1
				V.modelDropIn(a, x)
				local H = V.modelRoot()
				if not (H and E and I) then
					return
				end
				n = V.modelBuild(S, E, I, H, V.poolFor(a, x))
				a[x] = n
				V.placeBind()
			end
			n.view = C
			V.modelShow(n, k, y, Q)
		end
		V.dropCham = function(a)
			local x = r.highlights[a]
			if x then
				pcall(function()
					x:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			r.highlights[a] = nil
			r.chamState[a] = nil
			if r.models[a] or r.halos[a] then
				V.modelDrop(a)
			end
		end
		V.clearChams = function()
			for a in pairs(r.highlights) do
				V.dropCham(a)
			end
			for a in pairs(r.models) do
				V.modelDrop(a)
			end
			for a in pairs(r.halos) do
				V.modelDrop(a)
			end
		end
		V.fxDrop = function(a)
			local x = r.fx[a]
			if not x then
				return
			end
			for S, S in pairs(x.objs) do
				pcall(function()
					S:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			r.fx[a] = nil
		end
		V.fxClear = function()
			for a in pairs(r.fx) do
				V.fxDrop(a)
			end
			if r.fxFolder then
				pcall(function()
					r.fxFolder:Destroy()
				end)
				r.fxFolder = nil
			end
		end
		V.fxFolder = function()
			local a = L.CurrentCamera
			if not a then
				return nil
			end
			if r.fxFolder and r.fxFolder.Parent == a then
				return r.fxFolder
			end
			for x, x in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
				if x.Name == "PulseESPFX" then
					pcall(function()
						x:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			r.fxFolder = V.make("Folder", { Name = "PulseESPFX" }, a)
			return r.fxFolder
		end
		V.fxWanted = function(a)
			if V.fxTargets == "Murderer" then
				return a == "Murderer"
			end
			if V.fxTargets == "Armed" then
				return a == "Murderer" or a == "Sheriff" or a == "Hero"
			end
			return true
		end
		V.SPARKS = {
			Sparkles = {
				tex = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
				size = 0.35,
				life = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4),
				speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.6),
				acc = Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0),
				spread = 180,
			},
			Embers = {
				tex = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds",
				size = 0.55,
				life = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1),
				speed = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2.6),
				acc = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0),
				spread = 25,
			},
			Stardust = {
				tex = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
				size = 0.18,
				life = NumberRange.new(1.4, 2.4),
				speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.6),
				acc = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0),
				spread = 180,
			},
		}
		V.fxStep = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q)
			local E = V.murderBeam and k == "Murderer"
			if not (V.sparkles or V.skyBeam or E or V.trail) or not V.fxWanted(k) then
				V.fxDrop(a)
				return
			end
			local k = r.fx[a]
			if k and k.char ~= x then
				V.fxDrop(a)
				k = nil
			end
			local I = os.clock()
			if k and k.still and k.colour == y and I - k.at < 0.2 then
				return
			end
			if not k then
				k = { char = x, objs = {} }
				r.fx[a] = k
			end
			local x = k.objs
			local C = a.UserId % 97 * 0.13
			local function a(...)
				for H, H in ipairs({ ... }) do
					if x[H] then
						pcall(function()
							x[H]:Destroy()
						end)
						x[H] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			if V.sparkles then
				local H = V.SPARKS[V.sparkleStyle] or V.SPARKS.Sparkles
				if
					not (x.att and x.att.Parent == S and x.pe and x.pe.Parent == x.att)
					or x.peStyle ~= V.sparkleStyle
				then
					a("att", "pe")
					x.att = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPSparkAtt" }, S)
					x.pe = V.make("ParticleEmitter", {
						Name = "PulseESPSparks",
						Texture = H.tex,
						LightEmission = 1,
						LightInfluence = 0,
						Size = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, H.size),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
						}),
						Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
						}),
						Lifetime = H.life,
						Speed = H.speed,
						SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(H.spread, H.spread),
						Acceleration = H.acc,
						Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
						ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume,
					}, x.att)
					x.peStyle = V.sparkleStyle
					x.peColour = nil
				end
				if x.peColour ~= y then
					x.pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4), y)
					x.peColour = y
				end
				if x.pe.Rate ~= V.sparkleRate then
					x.pe.Rate = V.sparkleRate
				end
			else
				a("att", "pe")
			end
			if V.skyBeam then
				if not (x.sky and x.sky.Parent and x.sa0 and x.sa0.Parent == S and x.sa1 and x.sa1.Parent == S) then
					a("sky", "sa0", "sa1")
					x.sa0 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPSky0" }, S)
					x.sa1 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPSky1", Position = Vector3.new(0, 70, 0) }, S)
					x.sky = V.make("Beam", {
						Name = "PulseESPSkyBeam",
						Attachment0 = x.sa0,
						Attachment1 = x.sa1,
						FaceCamera = true,
						LightEmission = 1,
						LightInfluence = 0,
						Segments = 1,
						Width0 = 1.1,
						Width1 = 0.25,
					}, S)
				end
				x.sky.Color = ColorSequence.new(y)
				local H = 1 - 0.55 * Q * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(I * 2 + C))
				x.sky.Transparency =
					NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, H), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
			else
				a("sky", "sa0", "sa1")
			end
			if E then
				local C = U.Character and U.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if C then
					if not (x.mb and x.mb.Parent and x.ma0 and x.ma0.Parent == C and x.ma1 and x.ma1.Parent == S) then
						a("mb", "ma0", "ma1")
						x.ma0 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPBeamFrom" }, C)
						x.ma1 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPBeamTo" }, S)
						x.mb = V.make("Beam", {
							Name = "PulseESPMurderBeam",
							Attachment0 = x.ma0,
							Attachment1 = x.ma1,
							FaceCamera = true,
							LightEmission = 1,
							LightInfluence = 0,
							Segments = 1,
							Width0 = 0.08,
							Width1 = 0.18,
						}, S)
					end
					x.mb.Color = ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3), y)
					local C = 1 - 0.8 * Q * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(I * 5))
					x.mb.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, C),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C * 0.7),
					})
				else
					a("mb", "ma0", "ma1")
				end
			else
				a("mb", "ma0", "ma1")
			end
			if V.trail then
				local Q = math.clamp(V.trailWidth or 1.2, 0.1, 4) * 0.5
				if
					not (x.trl and x.trl.Parent == S and x.ta0 and x.ta0.Parent == S and x.ta1 and x.ta1.Parent == S)
					or x.trlStyle ~= V.trailStyle
					or x.trlW ~= Q
				then
					a("trl", "ta0", "ta1")
					x.ta0 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPTrail0", Position = Vector3.new(0, Q, 0) }, S)
					x.ta1 = V.make("Attachment", { Name = "PulseESPTrail1", Position = Vector3.new(0, -Q, 0) }, S)
					local C = V.trailStyle == "Neon"
					local H = V.trailStyle == "Ribbon"
					x.trl = V.make("Trail", {
						Name = "PulseESPTrail",
						Attachment0 = x.ta0,
						Attachment1 = x.ta1,
						FaceCamera = true,
						LightEmission = C and 1 or 0.35,
						LightInfluence = 0,
						MinLength = 0.05,
						WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, H and 0.85 or 0.15),
						}),
						Transparency = H and NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.5),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
						}) or NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C and 0.05 or 0.25),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
						}),
					}, S)
					x.trlStyle, x.trlW, x.trlColour = V.trailStyle, Q, nil
				end
				if x.trl.Lifetime ~= V.trailLife then
					x.trl.Lifetime = V.trailLife
				end
				if x.trlColour ~= y then
					x.trl.Color = V.trailStyle == "Neon" and ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(_, 0.45), y)
						or ColorSequence.new(y)
					x.trlColour = y
				end
			else
				a("trl", "ta0", "ta1")
			end
			k.at, k.colour, k.still = I, y, not (V.skyBeam or E)
		end
		V.labelsHide = function(a)
			local x = r.labels[a]
			if x then
				x.sig = nil
				h(x.top, "Visible", false)
				h(x.bottom, "Visible", false)
				if x.side then
					h(x.side, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
		end
		V.labelsDrop = function(a)
			local x = r.labels[a]
			if not x then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				x.top:Destroy()
			end)
			pcall(function()
				x.bottom:Destroy()
			end)
			if x.side then
				pcall(function()
					x.side:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			r.labels[a] = nil
		end
		V.labelsClear = function()
			if r.labelGui then
				pcall(function()
					r.labelGui:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			r.labelGui = nil
			r.labels = {}
		end
		V.release = function(a)
			local x = r.objects[a]
			if x then
				pcall(function()
					x.layer:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			r.objects[a] = nil
			r.retryAt[a] = nil
			V.dropCham(a)
			V.poolPurge(a)
			V.fxDrop(a)
			V.radarDrop(a)
			V.labelsDrop(a)
		end
		V.clear = function()
			for a in pairs(r.objects) do
				V.release(a)
			end
			V.clearChams()
			V.poolPurge()
			V.fxClear()
			if r.modelFolder then
				pcall(function()
					r.modelFolder:Destroy()
				end)
				r.modelFolder = nil
			end
			V.placeUnbind()
			V.radarClear()
			V.labelsClear()
			if r.gui then
				pcall(function()
					r.gui:Destroy()
				end)
				r.gui = nil
			end
			table.clear(r.retryAt)
		end
		V.hideAll = function()
			V.clearChams()
			for a in pairs(r.fx) do
				V.fxDrop(a)
			end
			for a, x in pairs(r.objects) do
				V.hideSet(x, true)
				V.radarHide(a)
				V.labelsHide(a)
			end
			r.hidden = true
		end
		V.prune = function()
			local a = {}
			for x, x in ipairs(B:GetPlayers()) do
				a[x] = true
			end
			for x in pairs(r.objects) do
				if not a[x] then
					V.release(x)
				end
			end
			for x in pairs(r.highlights) do
				if not a[x] then
					V.dropCham(x)
				end
			end
			for x in pairs(r.radar) do
				if not a[x] then
					V.radarDrop(x)
				end
			end
			for x in pairs(r.labels) do
				if not a[x] then
					V.labelsDrop(x)
				end
			end
			for x in pairs(r.fx) do
				if not a[x] then
					V.fxDrop(x)
				end
			end
		end
		V.WEIGHTS = {
			Regular = Enum.FontWeight.Regular,
			Medium = Enum.FontWeight.Medium,
			SemiBold = Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold,
			Bold = Enum.FontWeight.Bold,
			Heavy = Enum.FontWeight.Heavy,

		V.ck = function(a)
			return math.floor(a.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(a.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(a.B * 255 + 0.5)
		end
		V.tone = function(a)
			local x, S = (V.brightness or 100) / 100, (V.saturation or 100) / 100
			if x == 1 and S == 1 then
				return a
			end
			local k = r.toneCache
			if not k or r.toneB ~= x or r.toneS ~= S then
				k = {}
				r.toneCache, r.toneB, r.toneS, r.toneN = k, x, S, 0
			end
			local y = V.ck(a)
			local Q = k[y]
			if Q then
				return Q
			end
			local Q, E, I = a:ToHSV()
			local a = I * x
			local x = Color3.fromHSV(Q, math.clamp(E * S, 0, 1), math.clamp(a, 0, 1))
			if a > 1 then
				x = x:Lerp(_, math.clamp((a - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6))
			end
			r.toneN = (r.toneN or 0) + 1
			if r.toneN > 4096 then
				r.toneCache = nil
			end
			k[y] = x
			return x
		end
		V.ink = function(a, x, S)
			if a == "Custom" then
				return V.tone(x or _)
			end
			if a == "White" then
				return V.tone(_)
			end
			if a == "Light" then
				return S:Lerp(_, 0.45)
			end
			if a == "Dark" then
				return S:Lerp(q, 0.5)
			end
			return S
		end
		V.lw = function(a)
			return (tonumber(a) or 1) * (V.lineScale or 100) / 100 * (r.lwk or 1)
		end
		V.tsz = function(a)
			return math.max(6, math.floor((tonumber(a) or 12) * (V.textScale or 100) / 100 + 0.5))
		end
