		V.applyPalette = function(a)
			local x = V.PALETTES[a]
			if not x then
				return
			end
			V.murdererColour, V.sheriffColour, V.heroColour, V.innocentColour, V.noRoleColour =
				table.unpack(x, 1, 5)
			V.syncUI()
		end
		V.gradAt = function(a, x, S)
			if V.boxGradStyle == "Role Fade" then
				return a:Lerp(_, 0.25):Lerp(a, S)
			end
			return a:Lerp(x, S)
		end
		V.boxSeq = function(a, x)
			r.boxSeqCache = r.boxSeqCache or {}
			local S = V.boxGradStyle == "Role Fade"
			local k = S and -V.ck(a) - 1 or V.ck(a) * 16777216 + V.ck(x)
			local y = r.boxSeqCache[k]
			if y then
				return y
			end
			local y = S and ColorSequence.new(a:Lerp(_, 0.25), a) or ColorSequence.new(a, x)
			r.boxSeqN = (r.boxSeqN or 0) + 1
			if r.boxSeqN > 512 then
				r.boxSeqCache, r.boxSeqN = {}, 0
			end
			r.boxSeqCache[k] = y
			return y
		end
		V.FILL_SEQ = {
			Solid = NumberSequence.new(0),
			["Fade Down"] = NumberSequence.new(0, 1),
			["Fade Up"] = NumberSequence.new(1, 0),
		}
		V.boxAnimK = function(a)
			local x = V.boxAnim
			if x ~= "Pulse" and x ~= "Breathe" then
				return 1, 0
			end
			local S = os.clock() * (V.boxAnimSpeed or 1) + (a and a.UserId % 89 * 0.37 or 0)
			if x == "Pulse" then
				return 0.7 + 0.3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(S * 4.2)), 0
			end
			return 1, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(S * 2.6)
		end
		V.segPool = function(a, x)
			local S = a.layer
			for k = #a.corners + 1, x do
				a.corners[k] = V.line(S, "Corner" .. k)
				a.cornerGlow[k] = V.line(S, "CornerGlow" .. k)
				a.cornerGlow[k].frame.ZIndex = 2
				a.cornerEdge[k] = V.frame(S, "CornerEdge" .. k, 3)
			end
		end
		V.segHide = function(a, x)
			for S = x or 1, #a.corners do
				h(a.corners[S].frame, "Visible", false)
				h(a.cornerGlow[S].frame, "Visible", false)
				h(a.cornerEdge[S], "Visible", false)
			end
		end
		V.WHITE_SEQ = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		V.INFO_SETS = {
			A = {
				textFont = "Arimo",
				textSize = 12,
				nameWeight = "Regular",
				textShadow = true,
				distance = true,
				infoLayout = "Weapon Under",
				infoFont = "Arimo",
				infoSize = 9,
				infoCase = "UPPER",
				textOutlineAlpha = 100,
			},
			B = {
				textFont = "Source Sans",
				textSize = 13,
				nameWeight = "Bold",
				textOutlineAlpha = 85,
				distance = true,
				infoLayout = "Side Flags",
				infoFont = "Source Sans",
				infoSize = 10,
				infoCase = "UPPER",
			},
			Arrows = { offscreen = true, radarStyle = "Arrow", arrowPulse = true, arrowSize = 11, ringRadius = 300 },
			Walls = { chamsThrough = true, chamsRange = 300, chamsHiddenDark = 30 },
		}
		V.mix = function(...)
			local a = {}
			for x, x in ipairs({ ... }) do
				local S = type(x) == "string" and V.INFO_SETS[x] or x
				for x, k in pairs(S) do
					a[x] = k
				end
			end
			return a
		end
		V.innerFrame = function(a)
			if a.inner then
				return a.inner
			end
			a.inner = V.frame(a.layer, "BoxInner", 3)
			a.innerStroke = V.stroke(a.inner, 1)
			a.innerRound = V.make("UICorner", {}, a.inner)
			a.innerGrad = V.make("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90 }, a.innerStroke)
			return a.inner
		end
		V.upper = function(a)
			local x = r.upperCache
			if not x or (r.upperN or 0) > 3000 then
				x = {}
				r.upperCache, r.upperN = x, 0
			end
			local S = x[a]
			if S then
				return S
			end
			local S = V.upperRaw(a)
			x[a] = S
			r.upperN = (r.upperN or 0) + 1
			return S
		end
		V.upperRaw = function(a)
			local x = string.upper(a)
			if not string.find(x, "[\208\209]") then
				return x
			end
			local a = {}
			for S, S in utf8.codes(x) do
				if S >= 1072 and S <= 1103 then
					S -= 32
				elseif S == 1105 then
					S = 1025
				end
				a[#a + 1] = utf8.char(S)
			end
			return table.concat(a)
		end
		V.caseOf = function(a)
			if V.nameCase == "UPPER" then
				return V.upper(a)
			end
			if V.nameCase == "lower" then
				return string.lower(a)
			end
			return a
		end
		V.ROLE_SHORT = { Murderer = "M", Sheriff = "S", Hero = "H", Innocent = "I" }
		V.roleLabel = function(a)
			local x = M.tr(a)
			if V.roleStyle == "Short" then
				return V.ROLE_SHORT[a] or x:sub(1, 1)
			end
			if V.roleStyle == "Upper" then
				return V.upper(x)
			end
			return x
		end
		V.distText = function(a)
			local x = math.max(tonumber(a) or 0, 0)
			local a
			if V.distUnit == "Meters" then
				local S = x * 0.28
				a = S < 10 and -(math.floor(S * 10 + 0.5) + 1) or math.floor(S + 0.5) + 1000000
			else
				a = math.floor(x + 0.5)
			end
			local S = r.distCache
			if not S or (r.distN or 0) > 4000 then
				S = {}
				r.distCache, r.distN = S, 0
			end
			local k = S[a]
			if k then
				return k
			end
			local k = V.distTextRaw(x)
			S[a] = k
			r.distN = (r.distN or 0) + 1
			return k
		end
		V.distTextRaw = function(a)
			if V.distUnit == "Meters" then
				local x = math.max(a, 0) * 0.28
				if x < 10 then
					return string.format("%.1f m", x)
				end
				return tostring(math.floor(x + 0.5)) .. " m"
			end
			return tostring(math.floor(math.max(a, 0) + 0.5)) .. " st"
		end
		V.chamTone = function(a)
			local x = (V.chamsBright or 100) / 100
			if x > 1 then
				return a:Lerp(_, math.clamp((x - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6))
			end
			if x < 1 then
				return a:Lerp(q, math.clamp(1 - x, 0, 0.85))
			end
			return a
		end
		V.withSame = function(a)
			local x = { "Same" }
			for S, S in ipairs(a) do
				x[#x + 1] = S
			end
			return x
		end
		V.healthColor = function(a)
			return V.healthLow:Lerp(V.healthHigh, math.clamp(a, 0, 1))
		end
		V.roleBase = function(a)
			if a == "Murderer" then
				return V.murdererColour
			end
			if a == "Sheriff" then
				return V.sheriffColour
			end
			if a == "Hero" then
				return V.heroColour
			end
			if a == "Innocent" then
				return V.innocentColour
			end
			return V.noRoleColour
		end
		V.roleColour = function(a)
			return V.tone(V.roleBase(a))
		end
		V.COLOR_MODES = {
			"Role",
			"Rainbow",
			"Custom",
			"Distance",
			"Visibility",
		}
		V.color = function(a, x, S, S, S)
			local k = V.roleBase(a)
			local a = V.colorMode
			if a == "Rainbow" then
				k = Color3.fromHSV(
					os.clock() * 0.09 * (V.rainbowSpeed or 1) % 1,
					math.clamp((V.rainbowSat or 65) / 100, 0, 1),
					1
				)
			elseif a == "Custom" then
				k = V.customColour
			elseif a == "Distance" then
				k = V.nearColour:Lerp(V.farColour, math.clamp((S or 0) / math.max(V.maxDist, 1), 0, 1))
			elseif a == "Visibility" then
				k = x and V.seenColour or V.hiddenColour
			end
			if V.visCheck and V.dimHidden and not x and V.hiddenStyle == "Grey" then
				k = V.hiddenColour
			end
			return V.tone(k)
		end
		V.alpha = function(a, x)
			local S = V.visCheck and V.dimHidden and not x and V.hiddenStyle ~= "Grey" and 0.72 or 1
			if V.fade then
				local x = V.maxDist * math.clamp(V.fadeFrom, 10, 95) / 100
				if a > x then
					S = S * math.clamp(1 - (a - x) / math.max(V.maxDist - x, 1), 0.45, 1)
				end
			end
			return S * math.clamp((V.opacity or 100) / 100, 0.05, 1)
		end
		V.boundsOf = function(a, x)
			local S = r.bounds[a]
			local k = os.clock()
			if not S or k - S.at > 0.15 then
				local y, Q
				local E = r.partKinds
				for I, I in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
					local C = I.ClassName
					local H = E[C]
					if H == nil then
						H = I:IsA("BasePart")
						E[C] = H
					end
					if H then
						local E = I.Size.Y * 0.5
						local C = I.Position.Y
						local I, H = C + E, C - E
						if y == nil or I > y then
							y = I
						end
						if Q == nil or H < Q then
							Q = H
						end
					end
				end
				local E = x.Position.Y
				S = { at = k, top = (y or E + 3) - E, bottom = (Q or E - 3) - E }
				r.bounds[a] = S
			end
			return S.top, S.bottom
		end
		V.project = function(a, x)
			local S, k = V.boundsOf(a, x)
			local a = x.Position
			local x = V.vpt(Vector3.new(a.X, a.Y + S + 0.12, a.Z))
			local S = V.vpt(Vector3.new(a.X, a.Y + k - 0.08, a.Z))
			if x.Z <= 0.08 or S.Z <= 0.08 then
				return nil
			end
			local a = W.ViewportSize
			local k = math.abs(S.Y - x.Y)
			if k < 2 or k > a.Y * 4 then
				return nil
			end
			local y = k * math.clamp((V.boxWidth or 50) / 100, 0.2, 1)
			local Q = (x.X + S.X) * 0.5 - y * 0.5
			local E = math.min(x.Y, S.Y)
			if Q + y < 0 or Q > a.X or E + k < 0 or E > a.Y then
				return nil
			end
			if y < 12 then
				Q, y = Q - (12 - y) * 0.5, 12
			end
			if k < 22 then
				E, k = E - (22 - k) * 0.5, 22
			end
			return { x = Q, y = E, w = y, h = k }
		end
		V.smoothRect = function(a, x, S, k)
			local y = math.clamp(V.smooth, 0, 95) / 100
			local Q = y > 0 and 1 - y ^ (math.clamp(S or 0.016666666666666666, 0.001, 0.1) * 60) or 1
			k = k or Vector2.new(x.x + x.w * 0.5, x.y + x.h * 0.5)
			local S = { x = x.x - k.X, y = x.y - k.Y, w = x.w, h = x.h }
			local x = a.rect and a.rel
			if x then
				local y = math.abs(S.x - x.x) + math.abs(S.y - x.y) + math.abs(S.w - x.w) + math.abs(S.h - x.h)
				if y < math.max(W.ViewportSize.X, W.ViewportSize.Y) * 0.35 then
					S.x = x.x + (S.x - x.x) * Q
					S.y = x.y + (S.y - x.y) * Q
					S.w = x.w + (S.w - x.w) * Q
					S.h = x.h + (S.h - x.h) * Q
				end
			end
			a.rel = S
			local x = { x = k.X + S.x, y = k.Y + S.y, w = S.w, h = S.h }
			a.rect = x
			return {
				x = math.floor(x.x + 0.5),
				y = math.floor(x.y + 0.5),
				w = math.max(1, math.floor(x.w + 0.5)),
				h = math.max(1, math.floor(x.h + 0.5)),
			}
		end
		V.drawSeg = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q, E, I, C)
			local H = a.frame
			local n = s(1 - I)
			if a.styleColour ~= E or a.styleTr ~= n then
				a.styleColour, a.styleTr = E, n
				h(H, "Rotation", 0)
				h(H, "AnchorPoint", Vector2.zero)
				h(H, "BackgroundColor3", E)
				h(H, "BackgroundTransparency", n)
				h(a.stroke, "Transparency", 1)
			end
			l(H, "Position", S, k)
			l(H, "Size", y, Q)
			h(H, "Visible", true)
			if x then
				local E = C == true
				h(x, "Visible", E)
				if E then
					local E = math.max(1, math.floor((V.outlineSize or 2) * 0.5 + 0.5))
					l(x, "Position", S - E, k - E)
					l(x, "Size", y + E * 2, Q + E * 2)
					local S = s(1 - math.min(I * 0.9 * math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65) / 65, 0, 1.5), 0.95))
					local k = V.outlineCol or q
					if a.edgeTr ~= S or a.edgeCol ~= k then
						a.edgeTr, a.edgeCol = S, k
						h(x, "BackgroundColor3", k)
						h(x, "BackgroundTransparency", S)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		V.drawBox = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q)
			local E = V.boxStyle or "Corners"
			if a.role == "Murderer" and V.murdBox and V.murdBox ~= "Same" then
				E = V.murdBox
			end
			local I = V.box == true and not a.boxOff
			local C = E == "Corners" or E == "Brackets"
			local H = I and not C
			local n = V.boxGlow == true or Q == true
			local O = H and E ~= "Double" and V.outline == true and V.outlineInner == true
			if not I or not C then
				V.segHide(a, 1)
			end
			if a.inner and not (H and (E == "Double" or O)) then
				h(a.inner, "Visible", false)
			end
			h(a.box, "Visible", I)
			h(a.glow, "Visible", H and n)
			h(a.outer, "Visible", H and V.outline)
			if not I then
				return
			end
			local I, N = V.boxAnimK(y)
			if N > 0 then
				local y = math.floor(N * 2 + 0.5)
				if y > 0 then
					x = { x = x.x - y, y = x.y - y, w = x.w + y * 2, h = x.h + y * 2 }
				end
			end
			local y = math.floor(tonumber(V.boxPad) or 0)
			if y ~= 0 then
				x = { x = x.x - y, y = x.y - y, w = math.max(4, x.w + y * 2), h = math.max(4, x.h + y * 2) }
			end
			local y = k * I
			local k = V.ink(V.boxColMode, V.boxCol, S)
			local S = V.gradient and V.tone(V.gradientColour) or k
			local I = V.lw(V.boxThickness) * (Q and (V.focusScale or 160) / 100 or 1)
			local N, z = UDim2.fromOffset(x.x, x.y), UDim2.fromOffset(x.w, x.h)
			h(a.box, "Position", N)
			h(a.box, "Size", z)
			local D = (E == "Rounded" or E == "Double") and UDim.new(0, math.clamp(V.boxRound, 0, 20)) or UDim.new(0, 0)
			h(a.round, "CornerRadius", D)
			h(a.glowRound, "CornerRadius", D)
			h(a.outerRound, "CornerRadius", D)
			local D = math.floor(V.boxGradAngle or 90) % 360
			if H and V.outline then
				h(a.outer, "Position", N)
				h(a.outer, "Size", z)
				h(a.outerStroke, "Color", V.outlineCol or q)
				h(a.outerStroke, "Thickness", I + (V.outlineSize or 2))
				h(a.outerStroke, "Transparency", s(1 - y * math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65) / 100, 0, 1)))
			end
			h(a.box, "BackgroundColor3", _)
			h(a.box, "BackgroundTransparency", V.boxFill and s(1 - math.clamp(V.boxFillAlpha / 100, 0, 1) * y) or 1)
			if V.boxFill then
				local b = V.ink(V.fillColMode, V.fillCol, k)
				local Z = V.gradient and S or b
				local P = (V.gradient and 1 or 2) * 1000000000000000 + V.ck(b) * 16777216 + V.ck(Z)
				if a.fillKey ~= P or a.fillGS ~= V.boxGradStyle then
					a.fillKey, a.fillGS = P, V.boxGradStyle
					a.fillGradient.Color = V.gradient and V.boxSeq(b, Z) or ColorSequence.new(b)
				end
				local b = V.fillStyle or "Solid"
				if a.fillStyleOn ~= b then
					a.fillStyleOn = b
					a.fillGradient.Transparency = V.FILL_SEQ[b] or V.FILL_SEQ.Solid
					a.fillGradient.Rotation = 90
				end
			end
			if H then
				local b = V.ck(k) * 16777216 + V.ck(S)
				if a.edgeKey ~= b or a.edgeGS ~= V.boxGradStyle or a.edgeG ~= V.gradient then
					a.edgeKey, a.edgeGS, a.edgeG = b, V.boxGradStyle, V.gradient
					a.edgeGradient.Color = V.gradient and V.boxSeq(k, S) or ColorSequence.new(k)
					if a.innerGrad then
						a.innerGrad.Color = a.edgeGradient.Color
					end
				end
				local b = V.gradient and V.boxGradStyle == "Role Fade"
				if a.edgeFade ~= b then
					a.edgeFade = b
					a.edgeGradient.Transparency = b and NumberSequence.new(0, 0.7) or NumberSequence.new(0)
				end
				h(a.edgeGradient, "Rotation", D)
				h(a.edge, "Color", _)
				h(a.edge, "Thickness", math.clamp(I, 0.5, 8))
				h(a.edge, "Transparency", s(1 - y))
			else
				h(a.edge, "Transparency", 1)
			end
			local b = V.pulse and 0.72 + math.sin(os.clock() * V.pulseSpeed * 3.141592653589793 * 2) * 0.28 or 1
			if Q and not V.pulse then
				b = 0.75 + math.sin(os.clock() * 5) * 0.25
			end
			local Z = V.ink(V.glowColMode, V.glowCol, k)
			local P = math.clamp(V.glowStrength / 100, 0, 0.6)
			if Q and not V.boxGlow then
				P = 0.3
			end
			local Q = y * P * b
			if H and n then
				h(a.glow, "Position", N)
				h(a.glow, "Size", z)
				h(a.glowStroke, "Color", Z)
				h(a.glowStroke, "Thickness", I + V.lw(V.glowSize or 5))
				h(a.glowStroke, "Transparency", s(1 - Q))
			end
			if H and E == "Double" then
				local H = V.innerFrame(a)
				if a.innerGrad.Color ~= a.edgeGradient.Color then
					a.innerGrad.Color = a.edgeGradient.Color
				end
				local N = math.floor(I + 2.5)
				l(H, "Position", x.x + N, x.y + N)
				l(H, "Size", math.max(2, x.w - N * 2), math.max(2, x.h - N * 2))
				h(a.innerRound, "CornerRadius", UDim.new(0, math.max(0, math.clamp(V.boxRound, 0, 20) - N)))
				h(a.innerStroke, "Color", _)
				h(a.innerStroke, "Thickness", math.max(1, I * 0.6))
				h(a.innerStroke, "Transparency", s(1 - y * 0.45))
				h(a.innerGrad, "Rotation", D)
				h(H, "Visible", true)
			elseif O then
				local H = V.innerFrame(a)
				if a.innerGrad.Color ~= V.WHITE_SEQ then
					a.innerGrad.Color = V.WHITE_SEQ
				end
				local O = math.max(1, math.floor((V.outlineSize or 1) * 0.5 + 0.5))
				l(H, "Position", x.x + O, x.y + O)
				l(H, "Size", math.max(2, x.w - O * 2), math.max(2, x.h - O * 2))
				h(
					a.innerRound,
					"CornerRadius",
					UDim.new(0, E == "Rounded" and math.max(0, math.clamp(V.boxRound, 0, 20) - O) or 0)
				)
				h(a.innerStroke, "Color", V.outlineCol or q)
				h(a.innerStroke, "Thickness", O)
				h(a.innerStroke, "Transparency", s(1 - y * math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65) / 100, 0, 1)))
				h(H, "Visible", true)
			end
			if C then
				local C, H, O, N = x.x, x.y, x.w, x.h
				local x = math.max(1, math.floor(I + 0.5))
				local I =
					math.min(math.max(math.min(O, N) * math.clamp(V.cornerSize, 5, 50) / 100, 4), math.min(O, N) * 0.45)
				I = math.max(x + 1, math.floor(I + 0.5))
				local z = a.segs
				if not z then
					z = {}
					a.segs = z
				end
				local D = 0
				local function b(P, i, d, g)
					D += 1
					local o = z[D]
					if not o then
						o = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
						z[D] = o
					end
					o[1], o[2], o[3], o[4] = P, i, d, g
				end
				if E == "Corners" then
					b(C, H, I, x)
					b(C, H, x, I)
					b(C + O - I, H, I, x)
					b(C + O - x, H, x, I)
					b(C, H + N - x, I, x)
					b(C, H + N - I, x, I)
					b(C + O - I, H + N - x, I, x)
					b(C + O - x, H + N - I, x, I)
				else
					local E = math.max(x + 1, math.floor(math.min(I, O * 0.3) + 0.5))
					b(C, H, x, N)
					b(C, H, E, x)
					b(C, H + N - x, E, x)
					b(C + O - x, H, x, N)
					b(C + O - E, H, E, x)
					b(C + O - E, H + N - x, E, x)
				end
				V.segPool(a, D)
				local x = math.max(2, math.floor(V.lw(V.glowSize or 5) * 0.4 + 0.5))
				for E = 1, D do
					local I = z[E]
					local C = k
					if V.gradient then
						C = V.gradAt(k, S, math.clamp((I[2] + I[4] * 0.5 - H) / math.max(N, 1), 0, 1))
					end
					if n then
						V.drawSeg(
							a.cornerGlow[E],
							nil,
							I[1] - x,
							I[2] - x,
							I[3] + x * 2,
							I[4] + x * 2,
							V.glowColMode == "ESP" and C or Z,
							Q,
							false
						)
					else
						h(a.cornerGlow[E].frame, "Visible", false)
					end
					V.drawSeg(a.corners[E], a.cornerEdge[E], I[1], I[2], I[3], I[4], C, y, V.outline)
				end
				V.segHide(a, D + 1)
			end
		end
		V.drawBar = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q, E)
			local I, C = math.clamp(V.barThickness, 2, 12), math.clamp(V.barGap, 2, 12)
			local H = S ~= "Bottom"
			local n, O, N, z = x.x, x.y, I, x.h
			if S == "Left" then
				n = n - C - I
			elseif S == "Right" then
				n = n + x.w + C
			else
				O, N, z = x.y + x.h + C, x.w, I
			end
			a.back.Position, a.back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(n, O), UDim2.fromOffset(N, z)
			a.back.BackgroundTransparency, a.back.Visible = 1 - E * 0.8, true
			a.stroke.Transparency = V.outline and 1 - E * 0.7 or 1
			a.fill.Position = H and UDim2.fromScale(0, 1 - k) or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			a.fill.Size = H and UDim2.fromScale(1, k) or UDim2.fromScale(k, 1)
			a.fill.BackgroundColor3, a.fill.BackgroundTransparency = Q, 1 - E
			a.fill.Visible = k > 0
			a.gradient.Enabled = V.healthStyle == "Gradient"
			a.gradient.Rotation = H and 270 or 0
			a.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 205, 224), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			for Q, I in ipairs(a.separators) do
				I.Visible = V.healthStyle == "Segmented"
				I.BackgroundColor3, I.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 21), 1 - E * 0.9
				I.Position = H and UDim2.fromScale(0, Q / 10) or UDim2.fromScale(Q / 10, 0)
				I.Size = H and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1) or UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
			end
			a.number.Visible = V.healthNum
			if V.healthNum then
				local Q = math.clamp(V.infoSize, 9, 20)
				local I = S == "Left" and n - 14 - 3 or n + N + 14 + 3
				local C = H and O + z * (1 - k) or O + z * 0.5
				a.number.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				a.number.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(I, C)
				a.number.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, Q + 4)
				a.number.Text, a.number.TextSize = tostring(y), Q
				a.number.TextTransparency = 1 - E
				a.number.TextStrokeTransparency = V.textOutline and 1 - E * 0.85 or 1
			end
			return S == "Bottom" and O + z + 4 or x.y + x.h + 4
		end
		V.drawBars = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q)
			local E = math.clamp(k > 0 and S / k or 0, 0, 1)
			local k = V.smoothHealth and 1 - math.exp(-12.0 * math.clamp(Q or 0.016666666666666666, 0, 0.1)) or 1
			a.hpRatio = a.hpRatio and a.hpRatio + (E - a.hpRatio) * k or E
			a.hp.back.Visible, a.hp.number.Visible = false, false
			local k = x.y + x.h + 5
			if V.health then
				k = math.max(
					k,
					V.drawBar(a.hp, x, V.healthPosition, a.hpRatio, math.floor(S + 0.5), V.healthColor(E), y)
				)
			end
			return k
		end
		V.vxy = function(a)
			if r.pok then
				local x = r.pcf:PointToObjectSpace(a)
				local S = -x.Z
				if S > 0.08 then
					return r.pcx + x.X / S * r.pf, r.pcy - x.Y / S * r.pf, S
				end
			end
			local x = W:WorldToViewportPoint(a)
			return x.X, x.Y, x.Z
		end
		V.vpt = function(a)
			if r.pok then
				local x = r.pcf:PointToObjectSpace(a)
				local S = -x.Z
				if S > 0.08 then
					return Vector3.new(r.pcx + x.X / S * r.pf, r.pcy - x.Y / S * r.pf, S)
				end
			end
			return W:WorldToViewportPoint(a)
		end
		V.inView = function(a, x, S)
			if (a - x).Magnitude <= 12 then
				return true, nil
			end
			local x = V.vpt(a)
			local a, k = S.X * 0.35, S.Y * 0.35
			return not (x.Z < -6.0 or x.X < -a or x.X > S.X + a or x.Y < -k or x.Y > S.Y + k), x
		end
		V.cham = function(a, x, S, k, y, Q, E)
			if not V.chams then
				V.dropCham(a)
				return
			end
			local I = r.genv.__pulseRemoteSkin
			local C = I and I.list[a] and I.list[a].model
			if C and C.Parent then
				x = C
			end
			local I = r.highlights[a]
			if I == nil or I.Parent == nil then
				I = V.make("Highlight", { Name = "PulseESP2Cham", Enabled = false }, V.holder() or x)
				r.highlights[a] = I
				r.chamState[a] = nil
			end
			if Q == false then
				local C = r.chamState[a]
				local H, n = r.models[a], r.halos[a]
				if C and C.adorned == nil and not (H and H.shown) and not (n and n.shown) then
					return
				end
			end
			local C = V.chamsThrough
			if C and (V.chamsRange or 60) < 300 then
				local H = x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				C = H ~= nil and (H.Position - (r.camPos or W.CFrame.Position)).Magnitude <= (V.chamsRange or 60)
			end
			local H = os.clock()
			local n = V.roleColour(S)
			local O = math.clamp((tonumber(V.chamsHiddenDark) or 30) / 100, 0, 0.9)
			local N = k and (V.chamsRole and n or V.chamsColour) or (V.chamsRole and n:Lerp(q, O) or V.chamsHidden)
			local z
			if V.chamsRole and V.chamsEdgeRole ~= false then
				z = k and n:Lerp(_, 0.25) or n:Lerp(q, O * 0.6)
			else
				z = k and V.chamsEdge or V.chamsEdgeHidden
			end
			local n = r.chamState[a]
			if n == nil then
				n = { fill = N, edge = z, seen = k, flash = 0, born = H, at = H }
				r.chamState[a] = n
			end
			local O = math.clamp(H - n.at, 0, 0.1)
			n.at = H
			local D = 1 - math.exp(-10.0 * O)
			n.fill = Y(n.fill:Lerp(N, D), N)
			n.edge = Y(n.edge:Lerp(z, D), z)
			if k and not n.seen and V.chamsFlash then
				n.flash = 1
			end
			n.seen = k
			n.flash = math.max(0, n.flash - O * 2.2)
			local Y = V.chamsAnim ~= "None"
			local O = Y and 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(H * V.chamsSpeed * 3.141592653589793 * 2 + a.UserId % 89 * 0.41) or 0
			local Y, N, z = 1, 1, n.fill
			if V.chamsAnim == "Pulse" then
				Y = 0.45 + 0.55 * O
			elseif V.chamsAnim == "Breathe" then
				N = 0.3 + 0.7 * O
			elseif V.chamsAnim == "Flow" then
				z = n.fill:Lerp(V.chamsFlow, O)
			end
			if n.flash > 0 then
				z = z:Lerp(_, n.flash * 0.55)
			end
			z = V.chamTone(z)
			local O = math.clamp((H - n.born) / 0.35, 0, 1)
			local D = math.clamp(V.chamsAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
			if V.chamsStyle == "Outline" then
				D = 0
			end
			if V.chamsStyle == "Soft" then
				D = D * 0.65
			end
			local b = V.chamsStyle == "Glow"
			local Z, P
			if b then
				Z, P = "Core", V.CORE
			else
				local i = V.chamsMaterial
				if S == "Murderer" and V.murdMat and V.murdMat ~= "Same" then
					i = V.murdMat
				elseif (S == "Sheriff" or S == "Hero") and V.sheriffMat and V.sheriffMat ~= "Same" then
					i = V.sheriffMat
				end
				if V.MATERIALS[i] then
					Z, P = i, V.MATERIALS[i]
				end
			end
			local S = Z
			local i = math.clamp((V.chamsShell or 100) / 100, 1, 1.4)
			if Z and i ~= 1 then
				P = { P[1], P[2] * i, P[3], P[4] }
				Z = Z .. "@" .. tostring(math.floor(i * 100 + 0.5))
			end
			local i = (k or C) and Q ~= false
			if Z then
				local k = z
				if b then
					k = z:Lerp(_, 0.08)
				elseif S == "Glow" or S == "Glow Outline" then
					k = z:Lerp(q, 0.42)
				end
				V.modelStep(
					r.models,
					a,
					x,
					i,
					k,
					y * O * Y * (b and math.clamp((V.glowCore or 85) / 100, 0, 1) or 1),
					Z,
					P,
					Q
				)
			elseif r.models[a] then
				V.modelDropIn(r.models, a)
			end
			if b or V.chamsOverlay then
				local k = math.clamp(V.glowHalo / 100, 0, 1)
				local P = 0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(H * 2.2 + a.UserId % 89 * 0.41)
				V.modelStep(
					r.halos,
					a,
					x,
					i and k * 0.44 >= 0.07 and (k >= 0.28 or (E or 0) <= 110),
					z,
					y * O * k * P * 2.2,
					"Halo",
					V.HALO,
					Q
				)
			elseif r.halos[a] then
				V.modelDropIn(r.halos, a)
			end
			local a, k = n.edge, V.chamsOutline and 1 - y * O * V.chamsEdgeAlpha / 100 * N or 1
			if S == "Glow Outline" then
				a, k = z, 1 - y * O * N
			end
			if b then
				a, k = z:Lerp(_, 0.45), 1 - y * O * 0.55 * N
			end
			local S = Z and 1 or s(1 - math.clamp(D * Y + n.flash * 0.35, 0, 1) * y * O)
			local Y = s(k)
			if Q ~= false and not (S >= 0.995 and Y >= 0.995) then
				if n.adorned ~= x then
					I.Adornee = x
					n.adorned = x
				end
				h(I, "FillColor", z)
				h(I, "OutlineColor", a)
				h(I, "FillTransparency", S)
				h(I, "OutlineTransparency", Y)
				h(I, "DepthMode", C and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded)
				h(I, "Enabled", true)
			else
				if n.adorned ~= nil then
					I.Adornee = nil
					n.adorned = nil
				end
				h(I, "Enabled", false)
			end
		end
		V.ringPoint = function(a)
			local Y = W.ViewportSize
			local x = Y * 0.5
			local S = W.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(a)
			local a = Vector2.new(S.X, S.Z)
			if a.Magnitude < 0.001 then
				a = Vector2.new(0, -1.0)
			end
			a = a.Unit
			local S = V.radarStyle == "Avatar"
			local k = math.clamp(V.arrowSize, 5, 26) * (S and 3 or 2)
			local y = k * 0.5 * (S and 1 or 1.4142135623730951)
			local S = math.max(y, V.ringText and 36 or 0) + 4
			local k = y + (V.ringText and 19 or 0) + 4
			local y = math.max(0, math.min(Y.X * 0.5 - S, Y.Y * 0.5 - k))
			local Q = math.clamp(V.ringRadius, math.min(60, y), y)
			if V.markerPos == "Screen Edge" then
				local y, E = math.max(20, Y.X * 0.5 - S - 26), math.max(20, Y.Y * 0.5 - k - 26)
				local Y = math.min(y / math.max(math.abs(a.X), 0.0001), E / math.max(math.abs(a.Y), 0.0001))
				return x + a * Y, math.deg(math.atan2(a.Y, a.X)) + 90
			end
			return x + a * Q, math.deg(math.atan2(a.Y, a.X)) + 90
		end
		V.ARROW = {
			fill = "",
			rim = "",
			shade = "",
		}
		V.arrowTexture = function(a)
			r.arrowTex = r.arrowTex or {}
			local Y = r.arrowTex[a]
			if Y ~= nil then
				return Y or nil
			end
			r.arrowTex[a] = false
			local Y = V.ARROW[a]
			if not (Y and type(getcustomasset) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function") then
				return nil
			end
			local x, S = pcall(function()
				local k = K(Y)
				if type(k) ~= "string" or #k < 60 then
					return nil
				end
				if type(makefolder) == "function" and not (type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder("PulseHub")) then
					pcall(makefolder, "PulseHub")
				end
				local K = "PulseHub/esp-arrow-" .. a .. "-" .. tostring(#k) .. ".png"
				if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(K)) then
					writefile(K, k)
				end
				return getcustomasset(K)
			end)
			if x and type(S) == "string" and S ~= "" then
				r.arrowTex[a] = S
				return S
			end
			return nil
		end
		V.arrowLayers = function(a)
			local K, Y, x = V.arrowTexture("shade"), V.arrowTexture("rim"), V.arrowTexture("fill")
			if not (K and Y and x) then
				return nil
			end
			local function S(k, y, Q, E)
				return V.make("ImageLabel", {
					Name = k,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Image = y,
					ImageColor3 = E,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.45, 1.45),
					ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
					ZIndex = Q,
					Visible = false,
				}, a)
			end
			local a = S("ArrowShade", K, 11, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
			a.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
			local K = S("ArrowRim", Y, 12, Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
			local Y = S("ArrowFill", x, 13, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			V.make(
				"UIGradient",
				{ Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(184, 184, 184)) },
				Y
			)
			return { shade = a, rim = K, fill = Y }
		end
		V.ARROW_STYLES = { "Arrow", "Avatar", "Dot" }
		V.radarShow = function(a, K, Y, x, S, k)
			local y = r.radar[a]
			if y == nil or y.frame.Parent == nil then
				local Q = V.frame(V.root(), "Radar_" .. tostring(a.UserId), 10)
				Q.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				Q.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 38)
				V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Q)
				local E = V.stroke(Q, 1)
				local I = V.make("ImageLabel", {
					Name = "Avatar",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(a.UserId) .. "&w=60&h=60",
					ZIndex = 11,
				}, Q)
				V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, I)
				local C = V.stroke(I, 1.5)
				local H = V.make("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					Text = "▲",
					RichText = false,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
					TextScaled = true,
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
					ZIndex = 11,
				}, Q)
				local n = V.arrowLayers(Q)
				local O = V.make("TextLabel", {
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 3),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 16),
					TextSize = 11,
					Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
					RichText = false,
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
					ZIndex = 11,
				}, Q)
				y = { frame = Q, image = I, edge = C, arrow = H, text = O, layers = n, dotStroke = E }
				r.radar[a] = y
			end
			local Q = V.radarStyle or "Arrow"
			local E = Q == "Avatar"
			local I = Q == "Dot"
			local C = not E and not I
			local H = math.clamp(V.arrowSize, 5, 26) * (E and 3 or 2)
			if I then
				H = H * 0.5
			end
			if V.arrowPulse then
				H = H * (1 + 0.12 * math.sin(os.clock() * 4 + a.UserId % 89 * 0.4))
			end
			H = math.max(4, math.floor(H + 0.5))
			local n = math.floor(Y * 2 + 0.5) / 2
			local Y = s(1 - k)
			l(y.frame, "Position", math.floor(K.X + 0.5), math.floor(K.Y + 0.5))
			l(y.frame, "Size", H, H)
			local K = y.layers
			local H = V.ringText or V.arrowName
			local O = y.sig
			if
				not O
				or O.ver ~= (r.labelVer or 0)
				or O.style ~= Q
				or O.color ~= x
				or O.alpha ~= k
				or O.showText ~= H
			then
				if not O then
					O = {}
					y.sig = O
				end
				O.ver, O.style, O.color, O.alpha, O.showText = r.labelVer or 0, Q, x, k, H
				h(y.image, "Visible", E)
				h(y.arrow, "Visible", C and not K)
				if K then
					h(K.shade, "Visible", C)
					h(K.rim, "Visible", C)
					h(K.fill, "Visible", C)
					if C then
						h(K.fill, "ImageColor3", x)
						h(K.fill, "ImageTransparency", Y)
						h(K.rim, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - k * 0.85))
						h(K.shade, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - k * 0.5))
					end
				end
				h(y.image, "ImageTransparency", Y)
				if I then
					h(y.frame, "BackgroundColor3", x)
					h(y.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", Y)
					h(y.dotStroke, "Color", V.outlineCol or q)
					h(y.dotStroke, "Transparency", s(1 - k * 0.5))
				else
					h(y.frame, "BackgroundColor3", Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 38))
					h(y.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", E and s(1 - k * 0.92) or 1)
					h(y.dotStroke, "Transparency", 1)
				end
				h(y.edge, "Color", x)
				h(y.edge, "Transparency", Y)
				if C and not K then
					h(y.arrow, "TextColor3", x)
					h(y.arrow, "TextTransparency", Y)
				end
				h(y.text, "Visible", H)
				if H then
					h(y.text, "TextColor3", x)
					h(y.text, "TextTransparency", Y)
				end
			end
			if C then
				if K then
					h(K.shade, "Rotation", n)
					h(K.rim, "Rotation", n)
					h(K.fill, "Rotation", n)
				else
					h(y.arrow, "Rotation", n)
				end
			end
			if H then
				local K = ""
				if V.arrowName then
					K = (V.formatName(a))
				end
				if V.ringText then
					K = K ~= "" and K .. "  " .. V.distText(S) or V.distText(S)
				end
				h(y.text, "Text", K)
			end
			h(y.frame, "Visible", true)
		end
		V.hideInner = function(a)
			h(a.box, "Visible", false)
			h(a.glow, "Visible", false)
			h(a.outer, "Visible", false)
			V.segHide(a, 1)
			if a.inner then
				h(a.inner, "Visible", false)
			end
			for K = 1, #a.bones do
				h(a.bones[K].frame, "Visible", false)
			end
			if a.boneGlows then
				for K = 1, #a.boneGlows do
					h(a.boneGlows[K].frame, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
			if a.joints then
				for K = 1, #a.joints do
					h(a.joints[K].frame, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
			h(a.head, "Visible", false)
			h(a.look.frame, "Visible", false)
			h(a.hp.back, "Visible", false)
			h(a.hp.number, "Visible", false)
		end
		V.boneGlow = function(a, K)
			a.boneGlows = a.boneGlows or {}
			local Y = a.boneGlows[K]
			if not Y then
				Y = V.line(a.layer, "BoneGlow" .. K)
				Y.frame.ZIndex = 3
				V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Y.frame)
				a.boneGlows[K] = Y
			end
			return Y
		end
		V.jointDraw = function(a, K, Y, x, S)
			return V.jointDrawXY(a, K, Y.X, Y.Y, x, S)
		end
		V.jointDrawXY = function(a, K, Y, x, S, k)
			a.joints = a.joints or {}
			local y = a.joints[K]
			if not y then
				local Q = V.frame(a.layer, "Joint" .. K, 5)
				Q.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, Q)
				y = { frame = Q, stroke = V.stroke(Q, 1) }
				a.joints[K] = y
			end
			local a = math.max(2, math.floor(V.lw(V.jointSize or 3) + 0.5))
			l(y.frame, "Position", math.floor(Y + 0.5), math.floor(x + 0.5))
			l(y.frame, "Size", a, a)
			h(y.frame, "BackgroundColor3", S)
			h(y.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", s(1 - k))
			if V.outline then
				h(y.stroke, "Enabled", true)
				h(y.stroke, "Color", V.outlineCol or q)
				h(y.stroke, "Transparency", s(1 - k * 0.5))
			else
				h(y.stroke, "Enabled", false)
				h(y.stroke, "Transparency", 1)
			end
			h(y.frame, "Visible", true)
		end
		V.boneBase = function(a, K)
			if a.seen == false then
				return V.tone(V.boneHidden)
			end
			if V.boneRole then
				return K
			end
			return V.tone(V.boneColour)
		end
		V.SKEL = {
			R15 = {
				pts = {
					{ "Head" },
					{ "UpperTorso", "NeckRigAttachment", j = true },
					{
						"UpperTorso",
						"WaistRigAttachment",
					},
					{
						"LowerTorso",
						"LeftHipRigAttachment",
						"RightHipRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"LeftUpperArm",
						"LeftShoulderRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"LeftLowerArm",
						"LeftElbowRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{ "LeftHand", "LeftGripAttachment" },
					{
						"RightUpperArm",
						"RightShoulderRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"RightLowerArm",
						"RightElbowRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"RightHand",
						"RightGripAttachment",
					},
					{
						"LeftUpperLeg",
						"LeftHipRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"LeftLowerLeg",
						"LeftKneeRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{ "LeftFoot", "LeftFootAttachment" },
					{
						"RightUpperLeg",
						"RightHipRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{
						"RightLowerLeg",
						"RightKneeRigAttachment",
						j = true,
					},
					{ "RightFoot", "RightFootAttachment" },
				},
				bones = {
					{ 1, 2 },
					{ 2, 3 },
					{ 3, 4 },
					{ 2, 5 },
					{ 5, 6 },
					{ 6, 7 },
					{ 2, 8 },
					{ 8, 9 },
					{ 9, 10 },
					{ 4, 11 },
					{ 11, 12 },
					{ 12, 13 },
					{ 4, 14 },
					{ 14, 15 },
					{ 15, 16 },
				},
			},
			R6 = {
				pts = {
					{ "Head" },
					{ "Torso", 0, 0.5, j = true },
					{ "Torso", 0, -0.5, j = true },
					{ "Left Arm", 0, 0.25, j = true },
					{ "Left Arm", 0, -0.5 },
					{ "Right Arm", 0, 0.25, j = true },
					{ "Right Arm", 0, -0.5 },
					{ "Left Leg", 0, 0.5, j = true },
					{ "Left Leg", 0, -0.5 },
					{ "Right Leg", 0, 0.5, j = true },
					{ "Right Leg", 0, -0.5 },
				},
				bones = {
					{ 1, 2 },
					{ 2, 3 },
					{ 2, 4 },
					{ 4, 5 },
					{ 2, 6 },
					{ 6, 7 },
					{ 3, 8 },
					{ 8, 9 },
					{ 3, 10 },
					{
				10, 11,
					},
				},
			},
		}
		V.skelRefs = function(a, K)
			local Y = {}
			for x, S in ipairs(K.pts) do
				local K = false
				local k = a:FindFirstChild(S[1])
				if k and k:IsA("BasePart") then
					local a, y = S[2], S[3]
					if type(a) == "number" then
						K = { part = k, x = a, y = y }
					elseif type(a) == "string" then
						local S = k:FindFirstChild(a)
						local a = y and k:FindFirstChild(y)
						if S and S:IsA("Attachment") then
							K = { att = S, att2 = a and a:IsA("Attachment") and a or nil }
						else
							K = { part = k }
						end
					else
						K = { part = k }
					end
				end
				Y[x] = K
			end
			return Y
		end
		V.skelPos = function(a)
			local K = a.att
			if K then
				if a.att2 then
					return (K.WorldPosition + a.att2.WorldPosition) * 0.5
				end
				return K.WorldPosition
			end
			local K = a.part
			if a.x then
				local Y = K.Size
				return K.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(Y.X * a.x, Y.Y * a.y, 0))
			end
			return K.Position
		end
		V.headSize = function(a)
			local K = math.floor(math.clamp(a.w * 0.28 * (V.headScale or 100) / 100, 3, 120) + 0.5)
			if (V.headStyle or "Ring") == "Dot" then
				K = math.max(4, math.floor(K * 0.35 + 0.5))
			end
			return K
		end
		V.drawBoneXY = function(a, K, Y, x, S, k, y, Q, E)
			local I, C = x - K, S - Y
			local H = a.frame
			local n = math.sqrt(I * I + C * C)
			local O = n < 60 and 1 or 4
			local N, z = math.floor((K + x) * 0.5 + 0.5), math.floor((Y + S) * 0.5 + 0.5)
			local K, Y = math.max(math.floor(n + 0.5), 1), math.max(1, math.floor(y + 0.5))
			local x = math.floor(math.deg(math.atan2(C, I)) * O + 0.5) / O
			local S = s(1 - Q)
			if a.px ~= N or a.py ~= z then
				a.px, a.py = N, z
				H.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(N, z)
			end
			if a.w ~= K or a.h ~= Y then
				a.w, a.h = K, Y
				H.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(K, Y)
			end
			if a.rot ~= x then
				a.rot = x
				H.Rotation = x
			end
			if a.col ~= k then
				a.col = k
				H.BackgroundColor3 = k
			end
			if a.tr ~= S then
				a.tr = S
				H.BackgroundTransparency = S
			end
			local K = a.stroke
			if E then
				local Y = V.outlineCol or q
				local x = s(1 - math.min(Q * 1.15 * math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65) / 65, 0, 1.5), 1))
				if a.sOn ~= true then
					a.sOn = true
					K.Enabled = true
				end
				if a.sCol ~= Y then
					a.sCol = Y
					K.Color = Y
				end
				if a.sTr ~= x then
					a.sTr = x
					K.Transparency = x
				end
			elseif a.sOn ~= false then
				a.sOn, a.sTr = false, 1
				K.Enabled = false
				K.Transparency = 1
			end
			h(H, "Visible", true)
		end
		V.drawSkeleton = function(a, K, Y, x, S, k)
			local k = V.skeleton == true and not a.skelOff
			if not (k or not a.bonesOff) then
				return
			end
			a.bonesOff = not k
			local y, Q, E = 0, 0, 0
			if k then
				local k = K:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and V.SKEL.R15 or V.SKEL.R6
				local I = os.clock()
				local C = a.sk
				if not C or C.char ~= K or C.rig ~= k or I - C.at > 2 then
					C = { char = K, rig = k, at = I, refs = V.skelRefs(K, k) }
					a.sk = C
				end
				local K = r.skelXY
				if not K then
					K = { x = {}, y = {}, ok = {} }
					r.skelXY = K
				end
				local I, H, n = K.x, K.y, K.ok
				local K = C.refs
				local C, O = V.vxy, V.skelPos
				for N = 1, #K do
					local z = K[N]
					local K = false
					if z then
						local D, b, Z = C(O(z))
						if Z > 0.08 then
							I[N], H[N], K = D, b, true
						end
					end
					n[N] = K
				end
				local K = V.boneBase(a, x)
				local x = math.max(1, math.floor(V.lw(V.boneThick) + 0.5))
				local C = S * math.clamp((V.boneAlpha or 100) / 100, 0, 1)
				local S = V.boneStyle == "Soft Glow" and not V.perfOn()
				local O = math.floor(x * 2.6 + 1.5)
				local N = O * 0.5
				local z = C * 0.16
				local D, b
				local Z
				if V.boneGrad then
					D, b = V.tone(V.boneTop), V.tone(V.boneBottom)
					Z = r.skelTC
					if not Z or r.skelTCa ~= D or r.skelTCb ~= b then
						Z = {}
						r.skelTC, r.skelTCa, r.skelTCb = Z, D, b
					end
				end
				local P, i = Y.y, math.max(Y.h, 1)
				local d = 0
				if V.headDot then
					local g = V.headStyle or "Ring"
					d = V.headSize(Y) * 0.5 + (g == "Dot" and 0.5 or V.lw(1.5) * 0.5)
				end
				local Y = k.bones
				local g = V.outline and not S and x >= 2
				local o = x * 0.5
				local p = a.bones
				local m = V.drawBoneXY
				for j = 1, #Y do
					local e = Y[j]
					local Y, j = e[1], e[2]
					if n[Y] and n[j] then
						local e, v, GM, aM = I[Y], H[Y], I[j], H[j]
						local j, AM = GM - e, aM - v
						local FM = math.sqrt(j * j + AM * AM)
						local TM = Y == 1 and d or 0
						if FM > TM + 0.75 then
							local Y, d = j / FM, AM / FM
							local j, AM
							if TM > 0 then
								j, AM = e + Y * TM, v + d * TM
							else
								j, AM = e - Y * o, v - d * o
							end
							local FM = K
							if D then
								local fM = math.floor(math.clamp(((v + aM) * 0.5 - P) / i, 0, 1) * 40 + 0.5)
								FM = Z[fM]
								if not FM then
									FM = D:Lerp(b, fM / 40)
									Z[fM] = FM
								end
							end
							y += 1
							m(p[y], j, AM, GM + Y * o, aM + d * o, FM, x, C, g)
							if S then
								E += 1
								local x, S = j, AM
								if TM <= 0 then
									x, S = e - Y * N, v - d * N
								end
								m(V.boneGlow(a, E), x, S, GM + Y * N, aM + d * N, FM, O, z, false)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if V.joints then
					local Y = k.pts
					for x = 1, #Y do
						if n[x] and Y[x].j then
							Q += 1
							local Y = K
							if D then
								local K = math.floor(math.clamp((H[x] - P) / i, 0, 1) * 40 + 0.5)
								Y = Z[K]
								if not Y then
									Y = D:Lerp(b, K / 40)
									Z[K] = Y
								end
							end
							V.jointDrawXY(a, Q, I[x], H[x], Y, C)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local K = a.bones
			for Y = y + 1, #K do
				h(K[Y].frame, "Visible", false)
			end
			if a.boneGlows then
				for K = E + 1, #a.boneGlows do
					h(a.boneGlows[K].frame, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
			if a.joints then
				for K = Q + 1, #a.joints do
					h(a.joints[K].frame, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
		end
		V.drawHead = function(a, K, Y, x, S, k)
			local k = false
			if V.headDot then
				local y = V.vpt(K.Position)
				if y.Z > 0.08 then
					local K = V.headStyle or "Ring"
					local Q = V.headSize(Y)
					local Y = V.skeleton and V.boneBase(a, x) or x
					local x = V.ink(V.headColMode, V.headCol, Y)
					l(a.head, "Position", math.floor(y.X + 0.5), math.floor(y.Y + 0.5))
					l(a.head, "Size", Q, Q)
					h(a.head, "BackgroundColor3", x)
					local Y = 0
					if K == "Filled" then
						Y = math.clamp((V.headFill or 25) / 100, 0, 1)
					elseif K == "Dot" then
						Y = 1
					end
					h(a.head, "BackgroundTransparency", Y > 0 and s(1 - S * Y) or 1)
					h(a.headStroke, "Color", K == "Dot" and (V.outlineCol or q) or x)
					h(a.headStroke, "Thickness", K == "Dot" and 1 or V.lw(1.5))
					h(a.headStroke, "Transparency", K == "Dot" and (V.outline and s(1 - S * 0.5) or 1) or s(1 - S))
					k = true
				end
			end
			h(a.head, "Visible", k)
		end
		V.tracerOrigin = function()
			local a = W.ViewportSize
			if V.tracerFrom == "Top" then
				return Vector2.new(a.X * 0.5, 2)
			end
			if V.tracerFrom == "Middle" then
				return a * 0.5
			end
			if V.tracerFrom == "Mouse" then
				return w:GetMouseLocation()
			end
			if V.tracerFrom == "Character" then
				local K = U.Character and U.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if K then
					local w = W:WorldToViewportPoint(K.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0))
					if w.Z > 0.08 then
						return Vector2.new(w.X, w.Y)
					end
				end
			end
			return Vector2.new(a.X * 0.5, a.Y - 2)
		end
		V.tracerHide = function(a)
			h(a.tracer.frame, "Visible", false)
		end
		V.tracerDraw = function(a, K, w, Y, x, S, S)
			if V.tracerMurderer and S ~= "Murderer" then
				V.tracerHide(a)
				return
			end
			local S = V.tracerRole and Y or V.tone(V.tracerColour)
			local Y = V.tracerStyle == "Fade"
			V.drawLine(a.tracer, K, w, S, V.lw(V.tracerThickness), x * V.tracerAlpha / 100, V.outline and not Y)
			if Y or a.tracerGrad then
				if not a.tracerGrad then
					a.tracerGrad = V.make("UIGradient", {
						Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.95),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.4),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
						}),
					}, a.tracer.frame)
				end
				h(a.tracerGrad, "Enabled", Y)
			end
		end
		V.visible = function(a, K, w)
			local Y = RaycastParams.new()
			Y.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local x = { w, L.CurrentCamera }
			if U.Character then
				x[#x + 1] = U.Character
			end
			Y.FilterDescendantsInstances = x
			Y.IgnoreWater = true
			local w = K.Position - a
			if w.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				return true
			end
			for K = 1, 6 do
				local K = L:Raycast(a, w, Y)
				if K == nil then
					return true
				end
				if K.Instance.Transparency < 0.3 then
					return false
				end
				x[#x + 1] = K.Instance
				Y.FilterDescendantsInstances = x
			end
			return false
		end
		V.roleOf = function(a, K)
			if type(a) == "table" then
				return a.FakeRole
			end
			local w = K and K[a.Name]
			local K = w and w.Role or nil
			if w and (w.Dead == true or w.Killed == true) then
				K = nil
			end
			if K == "Innocent" then
				local w = os.clock()
				local Y = r.heroAt[a]
				if Y == nil then
					Y = { at = -1.0, hero = false }
					r.heroAt[a] = Y
				end
				if w - Y.at > 0.12 then
					Y.at = w
					local w = a.Character
					local x = a:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
					Y.hero = (w and w:FindFirstChild("Gun") or x and x:FindFirstChild("Gun")) and true or false
				end
				if Y.hero then
					K = "Hero"
				end
			end
			if K ~= "Murderer" and K ~= "Sheriff" and K ~= "Hero" and K ~= "Innocent" then
				K = nil
			end
			return K
		end
		V.roleShown = function(a)
			if a == "Murderer" then
				return V.murderer
			end
			if a == "Sheriff" then
				return V.sheriff
			end
			if a == "Hero" then
				return V.hero
			end
			if a == "Innocent" then
				return V.innocent
			end
			return V.noRole
		end
		V.weaponScan = function(a, K)
			local w = a.Character
			local Y = a:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			if w then
				if w:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
					return "Knife", true
				end
				if w:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
					return "Gun", true
				end
			end
			if Y then
				if Y:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
					return "Knife", false
				end
				if Y:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
					return "Gun", false
				end
			end
			if K == "Murderer" then
				return "Knife", false
			end
			if K == "Sheriff" or K == "Hero" then
				return "Gun", false
			end
			return nil, false
		end
		V.weaponOf = function(a, K)
			local w = os.clock()
			local Y = r.weaponAt[a]
			local x = a.Character
			if Y and w - Y.at < 0.15 and Y.role == K and Y.char == x then
				return Y.name, Y.equipped
			end
			local S, k = V.weaponScan(a, K)
			if not Y then
				Y = {}
				r.weaponAt[a] = Y
			end
			Y.at, Y.role, Y.char, Y.name, Y.equipped = w, K, x, S, k
			return S, k
		end
		V.partsOf = function(a)
			local K = os.clock()
			local w = r.parts[a]
			if w then
				if w.root and w.hum then
					if K - w.at < 1 and w.root.Parent == a and w.hum.Parent == a then
						return w
					end
				elseif K - w.at < 0.25 then
					return w
				end
			else
				w = {}
				r.parts[a] = w
			end
			w.at = K
			w.hum = a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			w.root = a:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or a:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or a:FindFirstChild("Torso")
			w.head = a:FindFirstChild("Head") or w.root
			return w
		end
		V.updatePlayer = function(a, K, w)
			local Y = r.objects[a]
			local x = a.Character
			local S = V.roleOf(a, w)
			local w = x and V.partsOf(x)
			local k = w and w.hum
			local y = w and w.root
			local Q = x and y and k and k.Health > 0 and V.roleShown(S)
			local k = r.camPos
			local E = Q and (y.Position - k).Magnitude or 0
			if not Q or E > V.maxDist then
				if Y then
					Y.dx = nil
				end
				V.hideSet(Y, true)
				V.dropCham(a)
				V.fxDrop(a)
				V.radarHide(a)
				V.labelsHide(a)
				return
			end
			if not Y or not Y.layer.Parent then
				Y = V.makeSet(a)
				r.objects[a] = Y
			end
			if Y.character ~= x then
				Y.rect, Y.rel, Y.hpRatio = nil, nil, nil
				Y.character = x
			end
			local Q = w.head or y
			local w = os.clock()
			local I, C = V.inView(y.Position, k, r.vp)
			if (V.visCheck or (V.chams or V.skeleton) and I) and (Y.seenAt == nil or w - Y.seenAt > 0.12) then
				Y.seen, Y.seenAt = V.visible(k, Q, x), w
			end
			local w = not V.visCheck or Y.seen ~= false
			local k = V.color(S, w, 1, a, E)
			local H = V.alpha(E, w)
			local w = V.murdererFocus == true and S == "Murderer"
			local n = V.limits == true
			local function O(N)
				return n and (tonumber(N) or 0) > 0 and E > N
			end
			r.lwk = V.distScale and math.clamp(90 / math.max(E, 1), 0.55, 1.6) or 1
			Y.role = S
			Y.boxOff = O(V.boxMaxDist)
			Y.skelOff = O(V.skelMaxDist)
			local n = O(V.nameMaxDist)
			local N = type(a) == "table" and a.Ghost == true
			if N or O(V.chamsMaxDist) then
				V.dropCham(a)
			else
				V.cham(a, x, S, Y.seen ~= false, H, I, E)
			end
			if N then
				V.fxDrop(a)
			else
				V.fxStep(a, x, y, S, k, H)
			end
			local I = V.project(x, y)
			if not I then
				Y.dx = nil
				V.labelsHide(a)
				local O, z = V.ringPoint(y.Position)
				if V.offscreen then
					V.radarShow(a, O, z, k, E, H)
				else
					V.radarHide(a)
				end
				if V.tracer then
					V.hideInner(Y)
					Y.rect, Y.rel = nil, nil
					V.tracerDraw(Y, V.tracerOrigin(), O, k, H, a, S)
					h(Y.layer, "Visible", true)
				else
					V.hideSet(Y, true)
				end
				return
			end
			h(Y.layer, "Visible", true)
			local O = C or V.vpt(y.Position)
			local y = Y.dx
			if
				y
				and V.skipFrames ~= false
				and y.n < 1
				and y.char == x
				and I.h < 160
				and y.color == k
				and y.alpha == H
				and y.focus == w
				and math.abs(O.X - y.x) < 1
				and math.abs(O.Y - y.y) < 1
				and math.abs(I.h - y.h) < 1
				and math.abs(I.w - y.w) < 1
			then
				y.n += 1
				y.dt += K
				return
			end
			local C = K + (y and y.dt or 0)
			if not y then
				y = {}
				Y.dx = y
			end
			y.n, y.dt, y.char, y.x, y.y, y.h, y.w, y.color, y.alpha, y.focus = 0, 0, x, O.X, O.Y, I.h, I.w, k, H, w
			I = V.smoothRect(Y, I, C, O.Z > 0.08 and Vector2.new(O.X, O.Y) or nil)
			if I.h < (V.perfOn() and 48 or 26) then
				Y.skelOff = true
			end
			V.drawBox(Y, I, k, H, a, w)
			V.radarHide(a)
			V.drawSkeleton(Y, x, I, k, H, a)
			V.drawHead(Y, Q, I, k, H, a)
			local K = false
			if V.lookLine then
				local x = V.vpt(Q.Position)
				local y = V.vpt(Q.Position + Q.CFrame.LookVector * V.lookLength)
				if x.Z > 0.08 and y.Z > 0.08 then
					V.drawLine(
						Y.look,
						Vector2.new(x.X, x.Y),
						Vector2.new(y.X, y.Y),
						V.ink(V.lookColMode, V.lookCol, k, a),
						V.lw(V.lookThick or 1.5),
						H,
						V.outline
					)
					K = true
				end
			end
			if not K then
				h(Y.look.frame, "Visible", false)
			end
			local K, x = V.weaponOf(a, S)
			if n then
				V.labelsHide(a)
			else
				V.labelsUpdate(a, I, {
					alpha = H,
					colour = k,
					role = S,
					roleColour = V.roleColour(S),
					weapon = K,
					equipped = x,
					distance = E,
					infoY = I.y + I.h + 5,
					focus = w,
					ghostTag = N and a.GhostTag or nil,
				})
			end
			if V.tracer then
				local K = I.y + I.h
				if V.tracerTo == "Center" then
					K = I.y + I.h * 0.5
				elseif V.tracerTo == "Head" then
					K = I.y
				end
				V.tracerDraw(Y, V.tracerOrigin(), Vector2.new(I.x + I.w * 0.5, K), k, H, a, S)
			else
				V.tracerHide(Y)
			end
		end
		V.perfOn = function()
			if V.perfMode == false then
				return false
			end
			if V.perfMode == true then
				return true
			end
			local a = r.touchPerf
			if a == nil then
				a = false
				pcall(function()
					local K = game:GetService("UserInputService")
					a = K.TouchEnabled and not K.KeyboardEnabled or getgenv().NOVA_FORCE_TOUCH == true
				end)
				r.touchPerf = a
			end
			return a
		end
		V.step = function(a)
			if not V.on then
				if not r.hidden then
					V.hideAll()
				end
				if not r.pruneAt or os.clock() >= r.pruneAt then
					r.pruneAt = os.clock() + 1
					V.prune()
				end
				return
			end
			W = L.CurrentCamera or W
			if W == nil then
				V.hideAll()
				return
			end
			if not r.poolSweepAt or os.clock() >= r.poolSweepAt then
				r.poolSweepAt = os.clock() + 5
				pcall(V.poolSweep)
			end
			r.hidden = false
			r.budget = 1
			r.camCF = W.CFrame
			r.camPos = r.camCF.Position
			r.vp = W.ViewportSize
			r.pcf, r.pcx, r.pcy = r.camCF, r.vp.X * 0.5, r.vp.Y * 0.5
			r.pf = r.pcy / math.tan(math.rad(W.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
			r.pok = false
			do
				local K = r.camPos + r.camCF.LookVector * 20 + r.camCF.RightVector * 3 + r.camCF.UpVector * 2
				local w = W:WorldToViewportPoint(K)
				local Y = r.pcf:PointToObjectSpace(K)
				local K = -Y.Z
				if K > 0.08 then
					local x, S = r.pcx + Y.X / K * r.pf, r.pcy - Y.Y / K * r.pf
					r.pok = math.abs(x - w.X) < 0.5 and math.abs(S - w.Y) < 0.5 and math.abs(K - w.Z) < 0.05
				end
			end
			local K = getUpvalue(T) and getUpvalue(T)() or {}
			local w = {}
			r.frameN = (r.frameN or 0) + 1
			r.skipDt = r.skipDt or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local Y = V.perfOn()
			local x = 0
			for S, S in ipairs(PulsePlayers()) do
				if S ~= U then
					w[S] = true
					x += 1
					if Y and (x + r.frameN) % 2 == 1 and r.objects[S] ~= nil then
						r.skipDt[S] = (r.skipDt[S] or 0) + a
					elseif not r.retryAt[S] or os.clock() >= r.retryAt[S] then
						local Y = a + (r.skipDt[S] or 0)
						r.skipDt[S] = nil
						local x, k = pcall(V.updatePlayer, S, Y, K)
						if not x then
							r.lastError = tostring(k)
							r.retryAt[S] = os.clock() + 0.5
							V.hideSet(r.objects[S], true)
							V.dropCham(S)
							V.fxDrop(S)
							V.radarHide(S)
							V.labelsHide(S)
						else
							r.retryAt[S] = nil
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local Y = V.extraPlayers
			if type(Y) == "table" then
				for x, x in ipairs(Y) do
					w[x] = true
					local Y, S = pcall(V.updatePlayer, x, a, K)
					if not Y then
						r.lastError = tostring(S)
					end
				end
			end
			r.pok = false
			for a in pairs(r.objects) do
				if not w[a] then
					V.release(a)
				end
			end
		end
		V.clean = function(a)
			if type(a) ~= "string" then
				return ""
			end
			return (a:gsub("[%z\001-\031\127]", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
		end
		V.formatNameBuild = function(a)
			local K = V.clean(a.Name)
			local w = V.clean(a.DisplayName)
			if K == "" then
				K = w
			end
			if K == "" then
				K = "Player"
			end
			if w == "" then
				w = K
			end
			if V.nameMode == "Display name" then
				return w, ""
			end
			if V.nameMode == "Both" then
				return w, w ~= K and "@" .. K or ""
			end
			return K, ""
		end
		V.formatName = function(a)
			local K, w, Y = a.Name, a.DisplayName, V.nameMode
			local x = r.names[a]
			if x and x.name == K and x.display == w and x.mode == Y then
				return x.main, x.second
			end
			local S, k = V.formatNameBuild(a)
			if not x then
				x = {}
				r.names[a] = x
			end
			x.name, x.display, x.mode, x.main, x.second = K, w, Y, S, k
			return S, k
		end

		V.fontEnum = function()
			if r.fontEnumFor == V.textFont and r.fontEnumVal then
				return r.fontEnumVal
			end
			local a = V.FONT_ENUM[V.textFont]
			local K, w = pcall(function()
				return a and Enum.Font[a]
			end)
			r.fontEnumFor, r.fontEnumVal = V.textFont, K and w or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			return r.fontEnumVal
		end
		V.fontFace = function(a)
			local K = r.faceFast[V.textFont]
			local w = K and K[a]
			if w then
				return w
			end
			local w = V.fontFaceBuild(a)
			if not K then
				K = {}
				r.faceFast[V.textFont] = K
			end
			K[a] = w
			return w
		end
		V.fontFaceBuild = function(a)
			r.faces = r.faces or {}
			local K = tostring(V.textFont) .. tostring(a)
			if r.faces[K] then
				return r.faces[K]
			end
			local w = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
			if V.textFont == "Gotham" then
				w = "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
			elseif V.textFont == "Code" then
				w = "rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json"
			elseif V.textFont == "Source Sans" then
				w = "rbxasset://fonts/families/SourceSansPro.json"
			elseif V.textFont == "Montserrat" then
				w = "rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json"
			elseif V.FONT_ENUM[V.textFont] then
				local Y, x = pcall(function()
					return Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font[V.FONT_ENUM[V.textFont]])
				end)
				if Y and x and a then
					local S, k = pcall(Font.new, x.Family, a)
					if S and k then
						x = k
					end
				end
				r.faces[K] = Y and x or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
				return r.faces[K]
			end
			local Y, x = pcall(Font.new, w, a or Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
			r.faces[K] = Y and x or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
			return r.faces[K]
		end

		V.gradStops = function(a)
			if V.textGradStyle == "Custom" then
				return { V.textGradA, V.textGradB }
			end
			if V.textGradStyle == "ESP Color" or V.textGradStyle == "Role" or not V.GRAD_STYLES[V.textGradStyle] then
				return { _, a or _ }
			end
			return V.GRAD_STYLES[V.textGradStyle]
		end
		V.gradSeq = function(a)
			local K = V.textGradStyle
			local w
			if V.GRAD_STYLES[K] then
				w = K
			elseif K == "Custom" then
				w = "custom" .. tostring(V.textGradA) .. tostring(V.textGradB)
			else
				w = math.floor(a.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536
					+ math.floor(a.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256
					+ math.floor(a.B * 255 + 0.5)
			end
			r.gradCache = r.gradCache or {}
			r.gradFrameCache = r.gradFrameCache or {}
			local K
			if V.textGradAnim then
				K = r.gradFrameCache[w]
			else
				K = r.gradCache[w]
			end
			if K then
				return K
			end
			local K = V.gradStops(a)
			local a = #K
			if a < 2 then
				K = { K[1] or _, K[1] or _ }
				a = 2
			end
			if not V.textGradAnim then
				local Y = {}
				for x, S in ipairs(K) do
					Y[#Y + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((x - 1) / (a - 1), S)
				end
				local x = ColorSequence.new(Y)
				r.gradCache[w] = x
				return x
			end
			local Y = {}
			for x = 1, a do
				Y[x] = K[x]
			end
			if a == 2 then
				Y[3] = K[1]
				a = 3
			end
			local K = r.gradPhase or 0
			local x = {}
			for S = 0, 8 do
				local k = S / 8
				local S = (k + K) % 1 * a
				local K = math.floor(S) % a + 1
				local y = K % a + 1
				x[#x + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k, Y[K]:Lerp(Y[y], S - math.floor(S)))
			end
			local a = ColorSequence.new(x)
			r.gradFrameCache[w] = a
			return a
		end
		V.gradTick = function(a)
			a = a or 0
			r.gradPhase = ((r.gradPhase or 0) + a * 0.25 * (tonumber(V.textGradSpeed) or 1)) % 1
			r.gradAcc = (r.gradAcc or 0) + a
			if r.gradAcc >= 0.03333333333333333 or r.gradFrameCache == nil then
				r.gradAcc = 0
				r.gradFrameCache = {}
			end
		end

		V.labelMeasure = function(a, K, w, Y, x, S)
			local k = a.measures[K]
			if k and k.text == w and k.size == Y and k.font == x and k.limit == S then
				return k.width, k.height
			end
			r.textService = r.textService or game:GetService("TextService")
			local k, y = pcall(function()
				return r.textService:GetTextSize(w, Y, x, Vector2.new(100000, 100000))
			end)
			local Q = k and math.ceil(y.X) or math.min(S, #w * Y * 0.55)
			local E = k and math.ceil(y.Y) or Y + 3
			Q = math.min(math.max(Q + 2, 1), S)
			E = math.max(E + 2, Y + 3)
			a.measures[K] = { text = w, size = Y, font = x, limit = S, width = Q, height = E }
			return Q, E
		end

		V.labelExtra = function(a, K)
			local w = a.slots[K]
			if w then
				return w
			end
			w = V.make("TextLabel", {
				Name = K,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Active = false,
				RichText = false,
				TextScaled = false,
				TextWrapped = false,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
				TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13),
				Text = "",
				ZIndex = 3,
				Visible = false,
			}, a.bottom)
			a.slots[K] = w
			return w
		end
		V.labelStroke = function(a, K, w, Y)
			a.ustrokes = a.ustrokes or {}
			local x = a.ustrokes[K]
			if not w then
				if x then
					h(x, "Enabled", false)
				end
				return
			end
			if not x then
				x = V.make("UIStroke", {
					Name = "TextStroke",
					ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
					LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
				}, K)
				a.ustrokes[K] = x
			end
			h(x, "Enabled", true)
			h(x, "Thickness", math.clamp(tonumber(V.strokeSize) or 1, 0.5, 4))
			h(x, "Color", V.strokeCol or q)
			h(x, "Transparency", Y)
		end
		V.fontEnumOf = function(a)
			r.fontEnums = r.fontEnums or {}
			local K = r.fontEnums[a]
			if K then
				return K
			end
			local w = V.FONT_ENUM[a]
			local Y, x = pcall(function()
				return w and Enum.Font[w]
			end)
			K = Y and x or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
			r.fontEnums[a] = K
			return K
		end
		V.fontFaceOf = function(a, K)
			local w = V.textFont
			V.textFont = a
			local a, Y = pcall(V.fontFace, K)
			V.textFont = w
			return a and Y or nil
		end
		V.flagsUpdate = function(a, K, w, Y, x, S, k, y, Q, E)
			local I = a.side
			if #w == 0 then
				if I then
					h(I, "Visible", false)
				end
				return
			end
			if not I or I.Parent == nil then
				local C = V.labelRoot()
				if not C then
					return
				end
				I = V.make(
					"Frame",
					{ Name = "Flags", BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = false, Visible = false },
					C
				)
				a.side, a.flagSlots = I, {}
			end
			local C = a.flagSlots
			local H = Y + 2
			local n = 0
			for O, O in ipairs(w) do
				O.w = V.labelMeasure(a, O.slot, O.text, Y, x, k)
				if O.w > n then
					n = O.w
				end
			end
			local a = math.floor(V.lw(V.boxThickness) + 0.5)
				+ (V.box and V.outline and math.floor((V.outlineSize or 2) + 0.5) or 0)
				+ 3
			local x = K.x + K.w + a
			if x + n > Q.X - E then
				x = K.x - a - n
			end
			local a = math.clamp(K.y - 2, E, math.max(E, Q.Y - E - H * #w))
			l(I, "Position", math.floor(x + 0.5), math.floor(a + 0.5))
			l(I, "Size", n, H * #w)
			h(I, "Visible", true)
			local a = {}
			for K, x in ipairs(w) do
				local w = C[x.slot]
				if not w then
					w = V.make("TextLabel", {
						Name = x.slot,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Active = false,
						RichText = false,
						TextScaled = false,
						TextWrapped = false,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
						TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 8, 13),
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 3,
					}, I)
					C[x.slot] = w
				end
				a[x.slot] = true
				y(w, x.text, Y, x.colour, 0, (K - 1) * H, n, H, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, S)
			end
			for K, w in pairs(C) do
				if not a[K] then
					h(w, "Visible", false)
				end
			end
		end
		V.labelsUpdate = function(a, K, w)
			if not K or not w or (w.alpha or 1) <= 0 then
				V.labelsHide(a)
				return
			end
			local Y = W.ViewportSize
			if Y.X < 12 or Y.Y < 12 then
				V.labelsHide(a)
				return
			end
			local W = V.labelSet(a)
			if not W then
				return
			end
			do
				local x, S = "", ""
				if V.name then
					x, S = V.formatName(a)
				end
				local k = V.distance and type(w.distance) == "number" and V.distText(w.distance) or ""
				local y, Q, E, I =
					math.floor(K.x + 0.5), math.floor(K.y + 0.5), math.floor(K.w + 0.5), math.floor(K.h + 0.5)
				local C = math.floor((w.infoY or 0) + 0.5)
				local H = W.sig
				if
					H
					and H.ver == (r.labelVer or 0)
					and H.rx == y
					and H.ry == Q
					and H.rw == E
					and H.rh == I
					and H.iy == C
					and H.alpha == w.alpha
					and H.colour == w.colour
					and H.role == w.role
					and H.roleColour == w.roleColour
					and H.weapon == w.weapon
					and H.equipped == w.equipped
					and H.focus == w.focus
					and H.ghost == w.ghostTag
					and H.dist == k
					and H.main == x
					and H.sec == S
					and H.vx == Y.X
					and H.vy == Y.Y
					and H.lang == M.lang
				then
					if V.textGrad == true then
						local n = V.gradSeq(w.colour or _)
						for O, N in pairs(W.grads) do
							if O.Text ~= "" then
								h(N, "Color", n)
							end
						end
					end
					return
				end
				if not H then
					H = {}
					W.sig = H
				end
				H.ver, H.rx, H.ry, H.rw, H.rh, H.iy = r.labelVer or 0, y, Q, E, I, C
				H.alpha, H.colour, H.role, H.roleColour = w.alpha, w.colour, w.role, w.roleColour
				H.weapon, H.equipped, H.focus, H.ghost = w.weapon, w.equipped, w.focus, w.ghostTag
				H.dist, H.main, H.sec, H.vx, H.vy, H.lang = k, x, S, Y.X, Y.Y, M.lang
			end
			local x = math.clamp(w.alpha or 1, 0, 1)
			local S = s(math.clamp(0.35 + x * 0.65, 0, 1))
			local k = w.colour or _
			local y = V.textMatch and k or V.tone(V.nameColour)
			local Q = V.textMatch and k or V.tone(V.infoColour)
			local E = V.tsz(math.clamp(tonumber(V.textSize) or 12, 9, 28)) + (w.focus and 2 or 0)
			local I = V.tsz(math.clamp(tonumber(V.infoSize) or 10, 8, 24))
			local C = math.min(math.max(tonumber(V.labelWidth) or 240, 40), math.max(1, Y.X - 8))
			local H = K.x + K.w * 0.5
			local n = V.textOutline == false and 1
				or s(1 - S * math.clamp((tonumber(V.textOutlineAlpha) or 60) / 100, 0, 1))
			local O = V.textOutline ~= false and (tonumber(V.strokeSize) or 0) > 0
			local N = V.textShadow == true
			local function z(D, b, Z, P)
				local i = math.clamp(H - b * 0.5, 4, math.max(4, Y.X - 4 - b))
				P = math.clamp(P, 4, math.max(4, Y.Y - 4 - Z))
				l(D, "Position", math.floor(i + 0.5), math.floor(P + 0.5))
				l(D, "Size", b, Z)
				h(D, "Visible", true)
				return P
			end
			local function H(D, b, Z, P, i, d, g, o, p, m)
				h(D, "Visible", b ~= "")
				local j = D == W.name
				if b == "" then
					if j and W.nameShadow then
						h(W.nameShadow, "Visible", false)
					end
					return
				end
				m = m or V.fontFace(p or Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
				h(D, "Text", b)
				h(D, "FontFace", m)
				h(D, "TextSize", Z)
				local p = N and j
				if j then
					local N = W.nameShadow
					if p then
						if not N then
							N = V.make("TextLabel", {
								Name = "NameShadow",
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Active = false,
								RichText = false,
								TextScaled = false,
								TextWrapped = false,
								TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
								TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
								TextColor3 = q,
								TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
								Text = "",
								ZIndex = 2,
							}, W.top)
							W.nameShadow = N
						end
						h(N, "Text", b)
						h(N, "FontFace", m)
						h(N, "TextSize", Z)
						h(N, "TextTransparency", s(1 - S * 0.85))
						l(N, "Position", i + 1, d + 1)
						l(N, "Size", g, o)
						h(N, "Visible", true)
					elseif N then
						h(N, "Visible", false)
					end
				end
				local q = W.grads and W.grads[D]
				if q then
					local N = V.textGrad == true
					h(q, "Enabled", N)
					if N then
						h(q, "Color", V.gradSeq(k))
						h(q, "Rotation", tonumber(V.textGradAngle) or 0)
						P = _
					end
				end
				h(D, "TextColor3", P)
				h(D, "TextTransparency", 1 - S)
				V.labelStroke(W, D, O and not p, n)
				h(D, "TextStrokeTransparency", (O or p) and 1 or n)
				l(D, "Position", i, d)
				l(D, "Size", g, o)
			end
			local q = V.fontEnum()
			local n = w.infoY or K.y + K.h + 4
			if V.name then
				local O = V.plate and (V.plateStyle or "Flat") or nil
				local N = O == "HUD"
				local D, b, Z = false, false, false
				local P = O == "Underline"
				local i = O == "Minimal"
				local d = O ~= nil and not P and not i
				local O, g = V.formatName(a)
				O = V.caseOf(O)
				if g ~= "" then
					g = V.caseOf(g)
				end
				local a = N and 11 or (D and 12 or (d and 9 or (i and 11 or 2)))
				local o = d and 4 or (P and 2 or 0)
				local p = math.max(1, C - a * 2)
				local m, j = V.labelMeasure(W, "name", O, E, q, p)
				local e, v = 0, 0
				if g ~= "" then
					e, v = V.labelMeasure(W, "handle", g, I, q, p)
				end
				local p = V.nameIcon
						and w.role
						and V.ROLE_ICONS[w.role]
						and math.max(10, math.floor(E * 1.05 + 0.5))
					or 0
				local GM = p > 0 and 4 or 0
				local aM = math.min(C, math.max(m + p + GM, e) + a * 2)
				local m = j + v + o * 2 + (P and 2 or 0)
				local e
				if V.namePos == "Below" then
					e = z(W.top, aM, m, n)
					n = e + m + 2
				else
					z(W.top, aM, m, K.y - (tonumber(V.nameOffset) or 3) - m)
				end
				local e = V.tone(V.plateColour)
				local AM = b and _ or e
				local e = d and math.clamp(V.plateAlpha / 100, 0, 1) * x * (b and 0.2 or 1) or 0
				h(W.top, "BackgroundColor3", AM)
				h(W.top, "BackgroundTransparency", e > 0 and s(1 - e) or 1)
				local e = math.max(0, tonumber(V.plateBorder) or 1)
				local FM = N and u or (b and _ or k)
				local TM = 0
				if N then
					TM = x * 0.4
				elseif Z then
					TM = x * 0.95
				elseif b then
					TM = x * 0.5
				elseif d then
					TM = x * 0.24
				end
				h(W.stroke, "Color", FM)
				h(W.stroke, "Thickness", Z and math.max(1.5, e * 2) or math.max(e, 0.5))
				h(W.stroke, "Transparency", TM > 0 and (e > 0 or Z) and s(1 - TM) or 1)
				local b
				if N then
					b = UDim.new(0, 0)
				elseif D then
					b = UDim.new(1, 0)
				else
					b = UDim.new(0, math.clamp(tonumber(V.plateRadius) or 5, 0, 16))
				end
				h(W.corner, "CornerRadius", b)
				local D = N or P or i
				h(W.accent, "Visible", D)
				if D and not W.accentCorner then
					W.accentCorner = V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, W.accent)
				end
				if D then
					h(W.accent, "BackgroundColor3", k)
					h(W.accent, "BackgroundTransparency", s(1 - x * 0.9))
					if P then
						l(W.accent, "Position", math.floor(aM * 0.12), m - 2)
						l(W.accent, "Size", math.max(2, math.floor(aM * 0.76)), 2)
					elseif i then
						local D = math.max(4, math.floor(j * 0.38 + 0.5))
						l(W.accent, "Position", 1, o + math.floor((j - D) * 0.5 + 0.5))
						l(W.accent, "Size", D, D)
					else
						l(W.accent, "Position", 0, 0)
						l(W.accent, "Size", 3, m)
					end
				end
				h(W.contour, "Visible", N)
				h(W.vignette, "Visible", N)
				if N then
					h(W.contour, "ImageColor3", k)
					h(W.contour, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - 0.34 * x))
					h(W.vignette, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - 0.55 * x))
				end
				local N = V.plateGrad == true and d
				if N or W.plateGradObj then
					if not W.plateGradObj then
						W.plateGradObj = V.make("UIGradient", { Name = "PlateGradient", Rotation = 0 }, W.top)
					end
					h(W.plateGradObj, "Enabled", N)
					if N then
						local N = V.ck(AM) * 16777216 + V.ck(k)
						if W.plateGradKey ~= N then
							W.plateGradKey = N
							W.plateGradObj.Color = ColorSequence.new(k:Lerp(AM, 0.45), AM)
						end
					end
				end
				local N = V.WEIGHTS[V.nameWeight or "SemiBold"] or Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold
				if p > 0 then
					if not W.nameIconImg then
						W.nameIconImg = V.make("ImageLabel", {
							Name = "RoleIcon",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
							ZIndex = 4,
							Visible = false,
						}, W.top)
					end
					local D = V.ROLE_ICONS[w.role]
					if W.nameIconName ~= D then
						W.nameIconName = D
						pcall(function()
							f.Nova.Icons.apply(W.nameIconImg, D)
						end)
						if r.pc[W.nameIconImg] then
							r.pc[W.nameIconImg].Visible = nil
						end
					end
					l(W.nameIconImg, "Position", a, o + math.floor((j - p) * 0.5 + 0.5))
					l(W.nameIconImg, "Size", p, p)
					h(W.nameIconImg, "ImageColor3", w.roleColour or k)
					h(W.nameIconImg, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - S))
					h(W.nameIconImg, "Visible", true)
				elseif W.nameIconImg then
					h(W.nameIconImg, "Visible", false)
				end
				H(W.name, O, E, y, a + p + GM, o, math.max(1, aM - a * 2 - p - GM), j, N)
				H(W.handle, g, I, Q, a, o + j, math.max(1, aM - a * 2), v)
			else
				h(W.top, "Visible", false)
			end
			local a = math.clamp(K.h / 110, 0.75, 1)
			local y = math.max(math.floor((I + 1) * a + 0.5), 9)
			local E = math.max(math.floor((I + 4) * a + 0.5), 11)
			local I = math.max(math.floor(5 * a + 0.5), 3)
			local a = V.infoLayout or "Under Box"
			local O = V.infoFont and V.infoFont ~= "Same" and V.infoFont or nil
			local N = O and V.fontFaceOf(O, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold) or nil
			local D = O and V.fontEnumOf(O) or q
			local q = V.infoCase == "UPPER"
			local function O(b)
				if q then
					return V.upper(b)
				end
				return b
			end
			local q = (w.roleColour or k):Lerp(_, 0.2)
			local _ = V.weaponIcon and w.weapon
			local k, b = {}, {}
			if w.ghostTag then
				V.labelExtra(W, "ghost")
				k[#k + 1] = { slot = "ghost", text = O(w.ghostTag), colour = q, pad = 12 }
			end
			if a == "Side Flags" or a == "Weapon Under" then
				if V.roleText and w.role then
					b[#b + 1] = { slot = "f_role", text = O(V.roleLabel(w.role)), colour = q }
				end
				if _ then
					local Z = w.equipped and Q or Q:Lerp(u, 0.55)
					if a == "Side Flags" then
						b[#b + 1] = { slot = "f_weapon", text = O(M.tr(w.weapon)), colour = Z }
					else
						V.labelExtra(W, "wtext")
						k[#k + 1] = { slot = "wtext", text = O(M.tr(w.weapon)), colour = Z }
					end
				end
				if V.distance and type(w.distance) == "number" then
					b[#b + 1] = { slot = "f_dist", text = O(V.distText(w.distance)), colour = Q }
				end
			else
				if V.roleText and w.role then
					k[#k + 1] = { slot = "role", text = O(V.roleLabel(w.role)), colour = q }
				end
				if _ then
					local a = V.weaponStyle or "Icon"
					if a ~= "Text" then
						k[#k + 1] = {
							slot = "weapon",
							icon = w.weapon == "Knife" and "sword" or "crosshair",
							colour = w.roleColour,
							dim = not w.equipped,
						}
					end
					if a ~= "Icon" then
						V.labelExtra(W, "wtext")
						k[#k + 1] = {
							slot = "wtext",
							text = O(M.tr(w.weapon)),
							colour = w.equipped and q or w.roleColour:Lerp(u, 0.5),
						}
					end
				end
				if V.distance and type(w.distance) == "number" then
					k[#k + 1] = { slot = "dist", text = O(V.distText(w.distance)), colour = Q }
				end
			end
			V.flagsUpdate(W, K, b, y, D, N, C, H, Y, 4)
			local a = {}
			local K, w = 0, 0
			for _, q in ipairs(k) do
				a[q.slot] = true
				if q.text then
					q.w, q.h = V.labelMeasure(W, q.slot, q.text, y, D, C)
					if q.pad then
						q.w = math.min(q.w + q.pad, C)
					end
				else
					q.w, q.h = E, E
				end
				K = K + q.w + (_ > 1 and I or 0)
				w = math.max(w, q.h)
			end
			for _, q in pairs(W.slots) do
				if not a[_] then
					h(q, "Visible", false)
					local a = W.shadows[q]
					if a then
						h(a, "Visible", false)
					end
				end
			end
			if K <= 0 or w <= 0 then
				h(W.bottom, "Visible", false)
				return
			end
			local a = V.infoBg and 6 or 0
			z(W.bottom, K + a * 2, w + (V.infoBg and 2 or 0), n - 1)
			if V.infoBg or W.infoCorner then
				if not W.infoCorner then
					W.infoCorner = V.make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) }, W.bottom)
				end
				h(W.bottom, "BackgroundColor3", V.tone(V.plateColour))
				h(
					W.bottom,
					"BackgroundTransparency",
					V.infoBg and s(1 - math.clamp((V.infoBgAlpha or 55) / 100, 0, 1) * x) or 1
				)
			end
			local K = a
			for a, a in ipairs(k) do
				local _ = W.slots[a.slot]
				local q = math.floor((w - a.h) * 0.5 + 0.5)
				if a.text then
					H(_, a.text, y, a.colour, K, q, a.w, a.h, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold, N)
				else
					if W.icon ~= a.icon then
						W.icon = a.icon
						pcall(function()
							f.Nova.Icons.apply(_, a.icon)
						end)
						if r.pc[_] then
							r.pc[_].Visible = nil
						end
					end
					local w = a.dim and 0.72 or 1
					l(_, "Position", K, q)
					l(_, "Size", a.w, a.h)
					h(_, "ImageColor3", a.colour)
					h(_, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - S * w))
					h(_, "Visible", true)
					local u = W.shadows[_]
					if u then
						if W.shadeIcon ~= a.icon then
							W.shadeIcon = a.icon
							u.Image, u.ImageRectOffset, u.ImageRectSize = _.Image, _.ImageRectOffset, _.ImageRectSize
						end
						l(u, "Position", K + 1, q + 1)
						l(u, "Size", a.w, a.h)
						h(u, "ImageTransparency", s(1 - S * 0.7 * w))
						h(u, "Visible", V.textOutline ~= false)
					end
				end
				K = K + a.w + I
			end
		end
		V.defaults = {}
		for a, K in pairs(V) do
			if type(K) ~= "function" and type(K) ~= "table" then
				V.defaults[a] = K
			end
		end
		V.styles = {
