		V.applyPreset = function(a)
			r.labelVer = (r.labelVer or 0) + 1
			local K
			for w, w in ipairs(V.styles) do
				if w.name == a then
					K = w
					break
				end
			end
			if not K then
				return
			end
			local a = {
				on = true,
				maxDist = true,
				murderer = true,
				sheriff = true,
				hero = true,
				innocent = true,
				noRole = true,
				murdererColour = true,
				sheriffColour = true,
				heroColour = true,
				innocentColour = true,
				noRoleColour = true,
				nameMode = true,
			}
			for w, W in pairs(V.defaults) do
				if not a[w] then
					V[w] = W
				end
			end
			for a, w in pairs(K.values) do
				V[a] = w
			end
			V.style = K.name
			V.on = true
			if not V.chams then
				V.clearChams()
			end
			if not V.offscreen then
				V.radarClear()
			end
			for a in pairs(r.fx) do
				V.fxDrop(a)
			end
			for a, a in pairs(r.labels) do
				a.measures = {}
			end
			V.syncUI()
		end
		V.syncUI = function()
			r.labelVer = (r.labelVer or 0) + 1
			for a, K in pairs(r.handles) do
				pcall(function()
					local w = V[a]
					if K.kind == "t" then
						K.h.SetSilent(w == true)
					elseif K.kind == "s" then
						K.h.Set(w)
					elseif K.kind == "d" then
						K.h.Set(w)
					elseif K.kind == "c" then
						K.h.Set(w)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		V.onChange = function(a)
			r.labelVer = (r.labelVer or 0) + 1
			if a == "on" and not V.on then
				V.hideAll()
			end
			if a == "chams" and not V.chams or a == "chamsMaterial" or a == "chamsStyle" then
				V.clearChams()
			end
			if a == "offscreen" and not V.offscreen then
				V.radarClear()
			end
			if a == "radarStyle" then
				V.radarClear()
			end
			if a == "fxTargets" or a == "sparkleStyle" then
				for K in pairs(r.fx) do
					V.fxDrop(K)
				end
			end
			if a == "textGradStyle" or a == "textGradAnim" then
				r.gradCache = {}
			end
			if a == "textFont" or a == "textSize" or a == "infoSize" or a == "nameMode" then
				r.faces = {}
				for K, K in pairs(r.labels) do
					K.measures = {}
				end
			end
			if a == "brightness" or a == "saturation" or a == "boxGradStyle" then
				r.boxSeqCache, r.boxStops, r.toneCache = nil, nil, nil
				for K, K in pairs(r.objects) do
					K.edgeKey, K.fillKey = nil, nil
				end
			end
			if a == "chamsShell" then
				V.clearChams()
			end
			if a == "boxStyle" or a == "box" then
				for K, K in pairs(r.objects) do
					pcall(V.hideInner, K)
				end
			end
			if a == "radarStyle" or a == "arrowGlow" then
				V.radarClear()
			end
			if a == "trail" or a == "trailStyle" or a == "trailWidth" then
				for K in pairs(r.fx) do
					V.fxDrop(K)
				end
			end
			if
				a == "textScale"
				or a == "nameCase"
				or a == "nameWeight"
				or a == "distUnit"
				or a == "roleStyle"
				or a == "plateStyle"
			then
				for a, a in pairs(r.labels) do
					a.measures = {}
				end
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			local a = { by = {}, last = {}, leak = {}, far = 1000000, keep = 20 }
			getgenv().__pulseDesyncGhost = a
			local function K(w)
				return w.X ~= w.X or w.Y ~= w.Y or w.Z ~= w.Z or w.Magnitude > a.far
			end
			local function w()
				local L = Instance.new("Model")
				L.Name = "PulseGhost"
				local function W(_, q, u)
					local s = Instance.new("Part")
					s.Name, s.Size, s.Anchored, s.CanCollide, s.CanQuery, s.CanTouch, s.Transparency =
						_, q, true, false, false, false, 1
					s.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, u, 0)
					s.Parent = L
					return s
				end
				local _ = W("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), 0)
				W("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), 2.25)
				W("Feet", Vector3.new(2, 1, 1), -2.5)
				local W = Instance.new("Humanoid")
				W.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				W.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
				W.Parent = L
				L.PrimaryPart = _
				return L
			end
			local function L(W)
				local _ = a.by[W]
				if not _ then
					local q = w()
					_ = { model = q }
					_.fake = {
						Name = W.Name,
						DisplayName = W.DisplayName,
						UserId = W.UserId,
						Character = q,
						Ghost = true,
						FindFirstChild = function(w, w)
							return W:FindFirstChild(w)
						end,
					}
					a.by[W] = _
				end
				return _
			end
			local function w(W)
				local _ = a.by[W]
				if _ then
					pcall(function()
						_.model:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				a.by[W] = nil
			end
			local function W(_)
				local q = _
				for _ = 1, 6 do
					if not q then
						return nil
					end
					local _ = B:GetPlayerFromCharacter(q)
					if _ then
						return _, q
					end
					q = q.Parent
				end
				return nil
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local _ = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
				local q = _:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
				q = q and q:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
				q = q and q:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
				if not q then
					return
				end
				t(q.OnClientEvent, function(_, q, u)
					if typeof(_) ~= "Instance" then
						return
					end
					if typeof(q) == "CFrame" then
						q = q.Position
					end
					if typeof(u) == "CFrame" then
						u = u.Position
					end
					if typeof(q) ~= "Vector3" or K(q) then
						return
					end
					local s, h = W(_)
					if not s or s == U then
						return
					end
					local W = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not (W and K(W.Position)) then
						return
					end
					local W = q - Vector3.new(0, 1.25, 0)
					if typeof(u) == "Vector3" then
						local _ = Vector3.new(u.X - q.X, 0, u.Z - q.Z)
						if _.Magnitude > 0.1 then
							_ = _.Unit
							W = W - _ * 3.45 - _:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * 1.4
						end
					end
					a.leak[s] = { p = W, t = os.clock(), ch = h }
				end)
			end)
			t(G.Heartbeat, function()
				if not V.on then
					if V.extraPlayers then
						V.extraPlayers = nil
					end
					return
				end
				local W = os.clock()
				local _
				local q, u
				for s, s in ipairs(PulsePlayers()) do
					if s ~= U then
						local U = s.Character
						local h = U and PulseFC(U, "HumanoidRootPart")
						local Y = h and PulseFCC(U, "Humanoid")
						if h and Y and Y.Health > 0 then
							local Y = h.Position
							local h = a.last[s]
							if not K(Y) then
								if not h then
									h = {}
									a.last[s] = h
								end
								h.p, h.t, h.ch = Y, W, U
							else
								local K, Y
								if h and h.ch == U then
									K, Y = h.p, h.t
								end
								local h = a.leak[s]
								if h and h.ch == U and (not Y or h.t > Y) then
									K, Y = h.p, h.t
								end
								if K and W - Y < a.keep then
									_ = _ or (getUpvalue(T) and getUpvalue(T)() or {})
									q = q or {}
									u = u or {}
									local T = L(s)
									local U = math.floor(W - Y)
									T.fake.Name = s.Name
									T.fake.DisplayName = s.DisplayName
									T.fake.GhostTag = U >= 1 and "DESYNC " .. U .. "s" or "DESYNC"
									T.fake.FakeRole = V.roleOf(s, _)
									if T.at ~= K then
										T.at = K
										pcall(function()
											T.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(K))
										end)
									end
									u[s] = true
									q[#q + 1] = T.fake
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if next(a.by) then
					for T in pairs(a.by) do
						if not (u and u[T]) then
							w(T)
						end
					end
				end
				if W - (a.gcAt or 0) > 1 then
					a.gcAt = W
					for T in pairs(a.last) do
						if not T.Parent then
							a.last[T] = nil
							a.leak[T] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				V.extraPlayers = q
			end)
			A(function()
				V.extraPlayers = nil
				for A in pairs(a.by) do
					w(A)
				end
			end)
		end)

		a.wrap = function(A, T)
			local B = F._curSub
			if a.LEG[A] then
				F._curSub = a.LEG[A]
			end
			local A, U = pcall(T)
			F._curSub = B
			if A then
				return U
			end
			warn("[PulseESP] " .. tostring(U))
			return nil
		end
		a.rowOf = function(A)
			if not (A and A.Row) then
				return nil
			end
			local T = F:LastSection()
			if T and T.Rows then
				for B, B in ipairs(T.Rows) do
					if B.Frame == A.Row then
						return B
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		a.setVisible = function(A, T, B)
			if A and A.SetVisible then
				if A.selfHidden ~= not B then
					A.SetVisible(B)
				end
			elseif T and T.Row then
				T.Row.Visible = B
			end
		end
		local function A(T, B, U)
			local K = a.wrap(T, function()
				return F:Toggle({
					Text = B,
					Default = V[T] == true,
					Settings = U,
					Callback = function(B)
						V[T] = B == true
						V.onChange(T)
					end,
				})
			end)
			G[T] = { h = K, kind = "t" }
			return K
		end
		local function T(B, U, K, w, L, W)
			local r = a.wrap(B, function()
				return F:Slider({
					Text = U,
					Min = K,
					Max = w,
					Default = V[B],
					Decimals = L or 0,
					Suffix = W or "",
					Callback = function(U)
						V[B] = U
						V.onChange(B)
					end,
				})
			end)
			G[B] = { h = r, kind = "s" }
			return r
		end
		local function B(U, K, w)
			local L = {}
			for W, W in ipairs(w) do
				L[#L + 1] = { code = W, label = W }
			end
			local w = a.wrap(U, function()
				return F:Dropdown({
					Text = K,
					Options = L,
					Default = V[U],
					Callback = function(K)
						if K ~= nil then
							V[U] = K
							V.onChange(U)
						end
					end,
				})
			end)
			G[U] = { h = w, kind = "d" }
			return w
		end
		local function U(K, w)
			local L = a.wrap(K, function()
				return F:Colorpicker({
					Text = w,
					Default = V[K],
					Callback = function(w)
						if typeof(w) == "Color3" then
							V[K] = w
						end
					end,
				})
			end)
			G[K] = { h = L, kind = "c" }
			return L
		end

		a.grid = function(K, w, L)
			local W = X(
				"Frame",
				{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
				F:Container()
			)
			local r = X("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / K, -math.ceil(6 * (K - 1) / K), 0, w or 30),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}, W)
			if L then
				local function _()
					local q = f.W
					local u = q and q.Scale and q.Scale.Scale or 1
					local q = W.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(u, 0.1)
					if q < 40 then
						return
					end
					local u = math.clamp(math.floor((q + 6) / (L + 6)), 1, K)
					r.CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / u, -math.ceil(6 * (u - 1) / u), 0, w or 30)
				end
				t(W:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), _)
				task.defer(_)
			end
			return W
		end
		a.fitState = {}
		a.fitText = function(K)
			local w = a.fitState[K]
			if not w then
				w = {}
				a.fitState[K] = w
			end
			if w.busy then
				w.again = true
				return
			end
			w.busy = true
			task.spawn(function()
				repeat
					w.again = false
					local L = 12
					for W, W in ipairs(K) do
						if W.l and not W.base then
							W.base = W.l.TextSize
						end
						if W.base and W.base > L then
							L = W.base
						end
					end
					for W = math.floor(L), 8, -1.0 do
						for L, L in ipairs(K) do
							if L.l then
								L.l.TextSize = W
							end
						end
						task.wait()
						local L = true
						for W, W in ipairs(K) do
							if W.l and W.l.AbsoluteSize.X > 1 and not W.l.TextFits then
								L = false
								break
							end
						end
						if L then
							break
						end
					end
				until not w.again
				w.busy = false
			end)
		end
		a.paintChip = function(K)
			if K.paint then
				return K.paint(K)
			end
			local w = a.NV
			local L = K.on == true
			w.paint(K.b, "BackgroundColor3", L and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
			w.Motion.tween(K.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = L and 0.82 or 0 })
			w.paint(K.st, "Color", (L or K.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
			w.Motion.tween(
				K.st,
				"Quick",
				{ Transparency = L and 0.1 or (K.hover and 0.45 or 0.86), Thickness = L and 1.5 or 1 }
			)
			w.paint(K.l, "TextColor3", (L or K.hover) and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")
			if K.chk then
				w.Motion.tween(K.chk, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = L and 0 or 1 })
			end
			if K.sw then
				if K.dotOf then
					K.sw.BackgroundColor3 = K.dotOf()
				end
				K.sw.BackgroundTransparency = K.dim and not L and 0.65 or 0
			end
		end

		a.currentLook = function()
			if V.chamsStyle == "Glow" then
				return "Glow"
			end
			if V.MATERIALS[V.chamsMaterial] then
				for K, K in ipairs(a.LOOKS) do
					if K[3] == V.chamsMaterial and K[2] == "Solid" then
						return K[1]
					end
				end
			end
			for K, K in ipairs(a.LOOKS) do
				if K[3] == "Flat" and K[2] == V.chamsStyle then
					return K[1]
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		a.pickLook = function(K)
			local function w(L, W)
				local r = G[L]
				if r and r.h then
					pcall(r.h.Set, W)
				end
				if V[L] ~= W then
					V[L] = W
					V.onChange(L)
				end
			end
			w("chamsStyle", K[2])
			if K[3] then
				w("chamsMaterial", K[3])
			end
			if K[2] == "Glow" and (V.glowHalo or 0) < 25 and G.glowHalo and G.glowHalo.h then
				G.glowHalo.h.Set(60)
			end
			if not V.chams and G.chams and G.chams.h then
				G.chams.h.Set(true)
			end
		end

		F:Group({ Title = "ESP Presets", Side = "Right" })
		do
			local G, J = a.NV, f.W
			local f = {
				order = {
					"Prime",
					"Box",
					"Glow Box",
					"Corners",
					"Outline",
					"Flat",
					"Shaded",
					"Metallic",
					"Chrome",
					"Glass",
					"Crystal",
					"Bubble",

					"Neon Rim",
					"Animated",

					"Wireframe",
					"Lava",
					"Skeleton",
					"Text",
					"Full",
				},
				tiles = {},
				cw = 168,
				ch = 210,
				cols = 6,
			}
			pcall(function()
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile("PulseHub/esp_presets_v3.jpg")) then
					f.data = getgenv().__pulseData.take("esp_presets")
					if not f.data then
						return
					end
					local c
					for K, K in ipairs({
						crypt and crypt.base64decode,
						base64decode,
						base64_decode,
						base64 and base64.decode,
					}) do
						if type(K) == "function" then
							local w, L = pcall(K, f.data)
							if w and type(L) == "string" and #L > 0 then
								c = L
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if not c then
						local K = {}
						for w = 1, 64 do
							K[string.byte("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", w)] = w
								- 1
						end
						local w, L = {}, 0
						local W = f.data
						for r = 1, #W - 3, 4 do
							local _, q, u, s = string.byte(W, r, r + 3)
							local W = (K[_] or 0) * 262144 + (K[q] or 0) * 4096 + (K[u] or 0) * 64 + (K[s] or 0)
							local K, r, _ = math.floor(W / 65536) % 256, math.floor(W / 256) % 256, W % 256
							L += 1
							if u == 61 then
								w[L] = string.char(K)
							elseif s == 61 then
								w[L] = string.char(K, r)
							else
								w[L] = string.char(K, r, _)
							end
						end
						c = table.concat(w)
					end
					pcall(function()
						if type(isfolder) == "function" and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
							makefolder("PulseHub")
						end
					end)
					writefile("PulseHub/esp_presets_v3.jpg", c)
				end
				local c = getcustomasset("PulseHub/esp_presets_v3.jpg")
				if type(c) == "string" and #c > 0 then
					f.atlas = c
				end
			end)
			f.data = nil
			f.index = {}
			for c, K in ipairs(f.order) do
				f.index[K] = c
			end
			local c = X(
				"Frame",
				{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 },
				F:Container()
			)
			local K = X("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 120),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}, c)
			local function w()
				if J and J.Scaling then
					if J._scalingDefer then
						J:_scalingDefer(w)
					end
					return
				end
				local L = J and J.Scale and J.Scale.Scale or 1
				local J = c.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(L, 0.1)
				if J < 60 then
					return
				end
				local L = J >= 420 and 4 or 3
				local W = math.floor((J - 8 * (L - 1)) / L)
				K.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(W, math.floor(W * f.ch / f.cw + 0.5))
			end
			t(c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), w)
			task.defer(w)
			f.paint = function(J)
				local K = V.style == J.key
				G.paint(J.st, "Color", (K or J.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
				G.Motion.tween(
					J.st,
					"Quick",
					{ Transparency = K and 0.05 or (J.hover and 0.4 or 0.8), Thickness = K and 2 or 1 }
				)
				G.paint(J.plate, "BackgroundColor3", K and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
				G.Motion.tween(J.plate, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = K and 0.15 or 0.2 })
				G.paint(J.l, "TextColor3", K and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")
			end
			for J, K in ipairs(V.styles) do
				local w = K.name
				local K =
					X("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = J }, c)
				R(K, 12)
				G.Theme.bind(K, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
				local J = X(
					"ImageLabel",
					{
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
						ZIndex = 2,
					},
					K
				)
				R(J, 12)
				local c = f.index[w]
				if f.atlas and c then
					J.Image = f.atlas
					J.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((c - 1) % f.cols * f.cw, math.floor((c - 1) / f.cols) * f.ch)
					J.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(f.cw, f.ch)
				end
				local J = X("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -5.0),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -10.0, 0, 20),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 3,
				}, K)
				R(J, 6)
				local R = G.label({
					Parent = J,
					Text = M.tr(w),
					Font = G.Font.Semi(),
					Size = 11,
					Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0),
					Box = UDim2.new(1, -12.0, 1, 0),
					Truncate = true,
					Color = "Muted",
				})

					R.TextWrapped = true
					R.TextScaled = true
					X("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 11, MinTextSize = 7 }, R)
					M.bind(R, w)
				end)
				local M = X(
					"UIStroke",
					{ Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border },
					K
				)
				G.Theme.bind(M, "Color", "Glass")
				local X = { key = w, b = K, st = M, plate = J, l = R, hover = false }

				end)

					f.paint(X)

					for G, G in ipairs(f.tiles) do

					end
				end)
				f.paint(X)
			end
			a.presetTiles = f
		end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - InfJump & AntiFling (Infinite Jump, Anti-Fling)
-- KEY: X
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["X"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f = G[2], G[3], G[4], G[0], G[1]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		A(G.JumpRequest, function()
			if T.infJump then
				local G = F.Character
				local A = G and G:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if A and A.Health > 0 then
					pcall(function()
						A:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
					end)
				end
			end
		end)
		a:ToggleKey({
			Text = "Infinite Jumps",
			Default = f.infJump,
			Bind = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(T.infJumpKey or ""),
			Callback = function(G)
				T.infJump = G == true
			end,
			OnBind = function(G)
				T.infJumpKey = G and G.Name or ""
			end,
		})
		a:Toggle({
			Text = "Anti-Fling",
			Default = f.antiFling,
			Callback = function(G)
				T.antiFling = G == true
			end,
		})
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Crypto - RC4 Cipher (RC4 S-Box Stream Cipher)
-- KEY: e
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["e"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function(G, A)
		local F = {}
		for T = 0, 255 do
			F[T] = T
		end
		local T = 0
		for f = 0, 255 do
			T = (T + F[f] + G:byte(f % #G + 1)) % 256
			F[f], F[T] = F[T], F[f]
		end
		local G, T, f = {}, 0, 0
		for J = 1, #A do
			T = (T + 1) % 256
			f = (f + F[T]) % 256
			F[T], F[f] = F[f], F[T]
			G[J] = string.char(a(A:byte(J), F[(F[T] + F[f]) % 256]))
		end
		return table.concat(G)
	end
end

					if t and t.IsPlaying then

					end

			end)

				D = _ > 0 and 1 or #O
			else
				D = (N - 1 + _) % #O + 1
			end
			n(O[D].id)
		end

					Size = 12,
					Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38),
					Box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
					AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
					Color = "Faint",
				})
				pcall(function()
					K.bind(w, "No songs")
				end)
				return
			end
			for B, K in ipairs(u) do
				local w = tostring(K.id)
				local r = R("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50),
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					LayoutOrder = B,
				}, U)
				F(r, 11)
				W(r, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
				local U = R("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				}, r)
				F(U, 9)
				local u = t(B)
				R("UIGradient", {
					Color = ColorSequence.new(
						Color3.fromHSV(u, 0.45, 0.95),
						Color3.fromHSV((u + 0.08) % 1, 0.78, 0.52)
					),
					Rotation = 45,
				}, U)
				local t = f.icon({
					Parent = U,
					Icon = "music",
					Size = 16,
					Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Color = "OnAccent",
					Z = 3,
				})
				local B = R("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					ZIndex = 4,
				}, U)
				F(B, 9)
				local u = f.icon({
					Parent = U,
					Icon = "play",
					Size = 15,
					Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Color = "OnAccent",
					Z = 5,
				})
				u.ImageTransparency = 1
				local h = R("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 14),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 5,
				}, U)
				local U = {}
				for C = 1, 3 do
					local O = R("Frame", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, (C - 1) * 5, 1, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 5),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						ZIndex = 6,
					}, h)
					F(O, 1)
					W(O, "BackgroundColor3", "OnAccent")
					U[C] = O
				end
				local C = f.label({
					Parent = r,
					Text = Y(K),
					Font = f.Font.Semi(),
					Size = 13,
					Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 8),
					Box = UDim2.new(1, -102.0, 0, 18),
					Truncate = true,
					Color = "Text",
				})
				local Y = 54
				local O = a(r, K.lang)
				if O then
					O.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					O.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 30)
					O.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 11)
					Y = 76
				end
				f.label({
					Parent = r,
					Text = l(K),
					Font = f.Font.Medium(),
					Size = 11,
					Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(Y, 28),
					Box = UDim2.new(1, -(Y + 48), 0, 14),
					Truncate = true,
					Color = "Faint",
				})
				local a = R("TextButton", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -9.0, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Visible = M,
				}, r)
				F(a, 9)
				W(a, "BackgroundColor3", "Danger")
				local F = f.icon({
					Parent = a,
					Icon = "trash-2",
					Size = 14,
					Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Color = "Muted",
					Z = 2,
				})
				local R = {
					e = K,
					id = w,
					row = r,
					note = t,
					shade = B,
					ovi = u,
					eq = h,
					rb = U,
					ttl = C,
					db = a,
					dbi = F,
					hover = false,
				}
				x[#x + 1] = R
				r.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					R.hover = true
					V(R)
				end)
				f.U.leave(r, function()
					R.hover = false
					V(R)
				end)
				r.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					pcall(function()
						f.Sound.play("tick")
					end)
					if I and E == w then
						X()
						H()
					else
						n(w)
					end
				end)
				a.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					R.dbHover = true
					V(R)
				end)
				f.U.leave(a, function()
					R.dbHover = false
					V(R)
				end)
				a.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					if R.armed then
						q(K)
						return
					end
					R.armed = true
					V(R)
					task.delay(2, function()
						if R.armed and R.row.Parent then
							R.armed = false
							V(R)
						end
					end)
				end)
				if not A.info[w] then
					z(w)
				end
			end
			k()
		end
		s()
		S()
		y()
		Q()
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(T) do
				task.wait(0.18)
				if I then
					for a, a in ipairs(_) do
						J(a, 0.18, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, math.random(6, 28)) })
					end
					for a, a in ipairs(x) do
						if a.eq.Visible then
							for F, F in ipairs(a.rb) do
								J(F, 0.18, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, math.random(3, 14)) })
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(T) do
				task.wait(0.5)
				pcall(c)
				pcall(function()
					local a = L()
					if a and a.IsPlaying and math.abs(a.Volume - (A.volume or 50) / 100) > 0.01 then
						a.Volume = (A.volume or 50) / 100
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local a = getgenv().__pulseGameSoundsUI
			if a then
				a(G)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Utility - Base64 Decoder
-- KEY: U
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["U"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function(G)
		G = G:gsub("[^%w%+%/%=]", "")
		local A, F, T, f, J = a, string.byte, string.char, math.floor, table.concat
		local a, X = {}, 0
		local t, R = {}, 0
		local B, U = 0, 0
		local M, c = #G, 1
		while c <= M do
			local K = false
			if U == 0 and c + 3 <= M then
				local M, w, L, W = F(G, c, c + 3)
				local V, r, _, q = A[M], A[w], A[L], A[W]
				if V and r and _ and q then
					local M = ((V * 64 + r) * 64 + _) * 64 + q
					R = R + 1
					t[R] = T(f(M / 65536), f(M / 256) % 256, M % 256)
					c = c + 4
					K = true
				end
			end
			if not K then
				local M = A[F(G, c)]
				c = c + 1
				if M then
					B = B * 64 + M
					U = U + 6
					if U >= 8 then
						U = U - 8
						local G = U == 4 and 16 or (U == 2 and 4 or 1)
						R = R + 1
						t[R] = T(f(B / G))
						B = B % G
					end
				end
			end
			if R >= 512 then
				X = X + 1
				a[X] = J(t, "", 1, R)
				R = 0
			end
		end
		if R > 0 then
			X = X + 1
			a[X] = J(t, "", 1, R)
		end
		return J(a)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Utility - Hash & Hex Formatter
-- KEY: l
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["l"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function()
		local G, A = bit32.band, bit32.rshift
		local F = math.floor
		local function T(f)
			while #f > 1 and f[#f] == 0 do
				f[#f] = nil
			end
			return f
		end
		local function f(J)
			J = J:gsub("%s", "")
			if #J % 4 ~= 0 then
				J = string.rep("0", 4 - #J % 4) .. J
			end
			local X = {}
			for t = #J, 1, -4.0 do
				X[#X + 1] = tonumber(J:sub(t - 3, t), 16)
			end
			return T(X)
		end
		local function J(X)
			local t = {}
			for R = #X, 1, -1.0 do
				t[#t + 1] = string.format("%04x", X[R])
			end
			local X = table.concat(t):gsub("^0+", "")
			return X == "" and "0" or X
		end
		local function X(t, R)
			if #t ~= #R then
				return #t > #R and 1 or -1.0
			end
			for B = #t, 1, -1.0 do
				if t[B] ~= R[B] then
					return t[B] > R[B] and 1 or -1.0
				end
			end
			return 0
		end
		local function t(R, B)
			local U = {}
			for M = 1, #R + #B do
				U[M] = 0
			end
			for M = 1, #R do
				local c, K = 0, R[M]
				if K ~= 0 then
					for R = 1, #B do
						local w = U[M + R - 1] + K * B[R] + c
						U[M + R - 1] = G(w, 65535)
						c = F(w / 65536)
					end
					local R = M + #B
					while c > 0 do
						local B = U[R] + c
						U[R] = G(B, 65535)
						c = F(B / 65536)
						R = R + 1
					end
				end
			end
			return T(U)
		end
		local function R(B)
			local U, M = {}, 0
			for c = 1, #B do
				local K = B[c] * 2 + M
				U[c] = G(K, 65535)
				M = A(K, 16)
			end
			if M > 0 then
				U[#U + 1] = M
			end
			return U
		end
		local function B(U, M)
			local c, K = {}, 0
			for w = 1, #U do
				local L = U[w] - K - (M[w] or 0)
				if L < 0 then
					L = L + 65536
					K = 1
				else
					K = 0
				end
				c[w] = L
			end
			return T(c)
		end
		local function U(M, c)
			if X(M, c) < 0 then
				local K = {}
				for w = 1, #M do
					K[w] = M[w]
				end
				return K
			end
			local K = { 0 }
			local w = 0
			for L = #M * 16 - 1, 0, -1.0 do
				K = R(K)
				local W = M[F(L / 16) + 1] or 0
				if G(A(W, L % 16), 1) == 1 then
					K[1] = K[1] + 1
				end
				T(K)
				if X(K, c) >= 0 then
					K = B(K, c)
				end
				w = w + 1
				if w >= 200 then
					w = 0
					if coroutine.isyieldable() then
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			end
			return K
		end
		local function M(c, K, w)
			local L = -1.0
			for W = 0, #K * 16 - 1 do
				if G(A(K[F(W / 16) + 1] or 0, W % 16), 1) == 1 then
					L = W
				end
			end
			local W = { 1 }
			if L < 0 then
				return W
			end
			local V = U(c, w)
			for c = 0, L do
				local r = K[F(c / 16) + 1] or 0
				if G(A(r, c % 16), 1) == 1 then
					W = U(t(W, V), w)
				end
				if c < L then
					V = U(t(V, V), w)
				end
			end
			return W
		end
		local function t(c, K, w, L, W)
			local V = {}
			for r = 1, L + 2 do
				V[r] = 0
			end
			for r = 1, L do
				local _ = c[r] or 0
				local c = 0
				for r = 1, L do
					local q = V[r] + _ * (K[r] or 0) + c
					c = F(q / 65536)
					V[r] = q - c * 65536
				end
				local K = V[L + 1] + c
				c = F(K / 65536)
				V[L + 1] = K - c * 65536
				V[L + 2] = V[L + 2] + c
				local r = V[1] * W % 65536
				K = V[1] + r * w[1]
				c = F(K / 65536)
				for W = 2, L do
					K = V[W] + r * w[W] + c
					c = F(K / 65536)
					V[W - 1] = K - c * 65536
				end
				K = V[L + 1] + c
				c = F(K / 65536)
				V[L] = K - c * 65536
				V[L + 1] = V[L + 2] + c
				V[L + 2] = 0
			end
			V[L + 2] = nil
			T(V)
			if X(V, w) >= 0 then
				V = B(V, w)
			end
			return V
		end
		local function T(c, K, w)
			if #w < 2 or w[1] % 2 == 0 then
				return M(c, K, w)
			end
			local L = -1.0
			for W = 0, #K * 16 - 1 do
				if G(A(K[F(W / 16) + 1] or 0, W % 16), 1) == 1 then
					L = W
				end
			end
			if L < 0 then
				return { 1 }
			end
			local W = #w
			local V = 1
			for r = 1, 5 do
				V = V * (2 - w[1] * V % 65536) % 65536
			end
			local r = (65536 - V) % 65536
			local V = { 1 }
			local _ = 0
			for q = 1, 32 * W do
				V = R(V)
				if X(V, w) >= 0 then
					V = B(V, w)
				end
				_ = _ + 1
				if _ >= 1024 then
					_ = 0
					if coroutine.isyieldable() then
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			end
			local R = X(c, w) >= 0 and U(c, w) or c
			local X = t(R, V, w, W, r)
			local R = t({ 1 }, V, w, W, r)
			for B = L, 0, -1.0 do
				R = t(R, R, w, W, r)
				if G(A(K[F(B / 16) + 1] or 0, B % 16), 1) == 1 then
					R = t(R, X, w, W, r)
				end
			end
			return t(R, { 1 }, w, W, r)
		end
		local function G(A, X)
			local t = X - #A - 3
			if t < 8 then
				return nil
			end
			local X = {}
			for R = 1, t do
				local t = math.random(1, 255)
				X[R] = string.char(t)
			end
			return "\000\002" .. table.concat(X) .. "\000" .. A
		end
		function a.encrypt(A, X, t)
			local R, B = f(X), f(t)
			local t = F(#X / 2)
			local F = G(A, t)
			if not F then
				return nil, ""
			end
			local G = F:gsub(".", function(A)
				return string.format("%02x", A:byte())
			end)
			local A = T(f(G), B, R)
			local G = J(A)
			if #G % 2 == 1 then
				G = "0" .. G
			end
			G = string.rep("0", t * 2 - #G) .. G
			return (G:gsub("%x%x", function(G)
				return string.char(tonumber(G, 16))
			end))
		end
		a._fromHex, a._toHex, a._modexp, a._slowModexp = f, J, T, M
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Invisibility (Character Invisibility Mode)
-- KEY: T
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["T"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X = G[5], G[0], G[3], G[6], G[2], G[4], G[1]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("RunService")
		local t = false
		local R, B
		local U = {}
		local M
		local c
		local K = false
		local w = false
		local L, W
		local V, r, _ = 0, nil, false
		local function q(u)
			V = math.max(V, os.clock() + (u or 0.5))
			if r then
				return
			end
			r = f(G.Stepped, function()
				local u, s = R, B
				if os.clock() > V or not (u and s and s.Parent) or u.Health <= 0 then
					if r then
						pcall(function()
							r:Disconnect()
						end)
						r = nil
					end
					return
				end
				if u.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					return
				end
				_ = not _
				pcall(function()
					s.CFrame = s.CFrame
						* CFrame.new(0, _ and 0.03 or -0.03, 0)
						* CFrame.Angles(0, _ and 0.01 or -0.01, 0)
				end)
			end)
		end
		local function V()
			local r = X.Character
			if not r then
				R, B, U = nil, nil, {}
				return
			end
			R = r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			B = r:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			U = {}
			for _, _ in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
				if _:IsA("BasePart") and _.Transparency == 0 then
					local r = _.Name == "Head" or _.Parent ~= nil and _.Parent:IsA("Accessory") or false
					U[#U + 1] = { p = _, near = r }
				end
			end
		end
		local function r(_)
			pcall(function()
				for u, u in ipairs(U) do
					if u.p and u.p.Parent then
						u.p.LocalTransparencyModifier = _ and 0.5 or 0
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		local function _()
			local u = a.CurrentCamera
			if not u then
				return false, nil
			end
			local s = u.CFrame.Position
			if X.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
				return true, s
			end
			local u = X.Character
			local h = u and u:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if h and (h.Position - s).Magnitude < 1.5 then
				return true, s
			end
			return false, s
		end
		local function u()
			if not t then
				return
			end
			t = false
			w = false
			pcall(function()
				if getgenv().__pulseInvis then
					getgenv().__pulseInvis.active, getgenv().__pulseInvis.real = false, nil
				end
			end)
			if M then
				pcall(function()
					M:Disconnect()
				end)
				M = nil
			end
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisRestore")
			end)
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisGhost")
			end)
			r(false)
			local s = B
			if s and s.Parent then
				local h = c or s.CFrame
				pcall(function()
					s.CFrame = h
				end)
				pcall(function()
					s.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					s.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end)
				q(0.5)
			end
		end
		A(function()
			pcall(u)
		end)
		local A, s
		local h = Vector3.new(0, -5.0, 0)
		local function Y()
			if t then
				return
			end
			V()
			if not (R and B) then
				return
			end
			t = true
			w = false
			r(true)
			M = f(G.Heartbeat, function()
				if not t then
					return
				end
				local r, l = R, B
				if not (r and l and l.Parent) or l.Parent ~= X.Character or r.Health <= 0 then
					local R = getgenv().__pulseInvis
					if R then
						R.active, R.real = false, nil
					end
					return
				end
				pcall(function()
					local R = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseAfRevert")
					if R then
						pcall(R)
					end
					local R = r.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
					local r = false
					do
						if not A then
							A = RaycastParams.new()
							A.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
						end
						local x = X.Character
						if s ~= x then
							s = x
							A.FilterDescendantsInstances = { x }
						end
						r = a:Raycast(l.Position, h, A) ~= nil
					end
					local a = getgenv().__pulseInvis or {}
					a.active = true
					a.grounded = r
					getgenv().__pulseInvis = a
					local A = l.CFrame
					local s = -200000.0
					if r and not R then
						K = not K
						if K then
							s = -199999.5
						end
					end
					L = A
					c = A
					a.real = A
					a.realAt = os.clock()
					if (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseInvisPause) or 0) > os.clock() then
						return
					end
					local a = A * CFrame.new(0, s, 0)
					l.CFrame = a
					W = l.Position
					w = true
				end)
			end)
			pcall(function()
				J("PulseInvisRestore", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
					if w and B and B.Parent and L then
						if not W or (B.Position - W).Magnitude < 2 then
							pcall(function()
								B.CFrame = L
							end)
						end
						w = false
					end
				end)
			end)
			q(0.5)
			pcall(function()
				J("PulseInvisGhost", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
					if not t then
						return
					end
					local a, A = _()
					pcall(function()
						for J, J in ipairs(U) do
							local R = J.p
							if R and R.Parent then
								local B = 0.5
								if a then
									if J.near then
										B = 1
									else
										local a = A and (R.Position - A).Magnitude or 99
										if a < 1.2 then
											B = 1
										elseif a < 2.4 then
											B = math.max(0.5, 1 - (a - 1.2) / 1.2)
										end
									end
								end
								R.LocalTransparencyModifier = B
							end
						end
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end
		f(X.CharacterAdded, function()
			local a = T.invis.on == true
			t = false
			w = false
			if M then
				pcall(function()
					M:Disconnect()
				end)
				M = nil
			end
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisRestore")
			end)
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseInvisGhost")
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local G = X.Character
				if G then
					pcall(function()
						G:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)
					end)
					pcall(function()
						G:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
					end)
				end
				task.wait(0.4)
				V()
				if a and T.invis.on and X.Character then
					Y()
				end
			end)
		end)
		F:Sub("General")
		F:Group({ Title = "Movement", Side = "Right" })
		local G
		G = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(T.invis.key)
		F:ToggleKey({
			Text = "Invisible",
			Default = false,
			Bind = G,
			Callback = function(G)
				T.invis.on = G == true
				if G then
					Y()
				else
					u()
				end
			end,
			OnBind = function(G)
				T.invis.key = G and G.Name or ""
			end,
		})
		getgenv().__pulseSetInvis = function(G)
			G = G == true
			if G == (T.invis.on == true) then
				return
			end
			T.invis.on = G
			if G then
				Y()
			else
				u()
			end
		end
		getgenv().__pulseGetInvis = function()
			return T.invis.on == true
		end
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Scanner - Inventory & Weapons (Backpack Knife & Gun Detection)
-- KEY: _
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["_"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t, R = G[6], G[2], G[4], G[7], G[5], G[0], G[8], G[1], G[3]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("Players")
		local B, U = pcall(function()
			return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CurrentRoundClient)
		end)
		if not B then
			U = nil
		end
		local function B()
			return t.Character
		end
		local function U()
			local M = B()
			return M and PulseFC(M, "HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		local function M()
			local c = B()
			local K = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			return K ~= nil and K.Health > 0
		end
		local function c()
			return isAlive(F)
		end
		local function F()
			local K = getgenv().__pulseDuel
			if K and K.on then
				local K = t.Character
				local w = PulseFC(t, "Backpack")
				return (K and PulseFC(K, "Knife")) ~= nil or (w and PulseFC(w, "Knife")) ~= nil
			end
			local K = c()[t.Name]
			return K ~= nil and K.Role ~= nil and tostring(K.Role):lower():find("murder") ~= nil
		end
		local function K(w, L)
			if w == t then
				return false
			end
			local W = getgenv().__pulseDuel
			if W and W.on then
				if not W.foes[w.Name] then
					return false
				end
				return W.alive(w) ~= nil
			end
			local W = L[w.Name]
			if not W then
				return false
			end
			if W.Dead == true then
				return false
			end
			if W.Killed == true then
				return false
			end
			local L = w.Character
			local w = L and L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not w or w.Health <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
		local function w()
			local L = B()
			return L and L:FindFirstChild("Knife")
		end
		local function L()
			local W = t:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			if W then
				local V = W:FindFirstChild("Knife")
				if V and V:IsA("Tool") and B() then
					V.Parent = B()
					return true
				end
			end
			return w() ~= nil
		end
		local W = {
			"HumanoidRootPart",
			"UpperTorso",
			"Torso",
			"LowerTorso",
			"Head",
		}
		local function V()
			local r = w()
			if not r then
				return nil, nil
			end
			return r, r:FindFirstChild("Handle") or r:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
		end
		local function r(_)
			if not _ then
				return
			end
			local q = _.Parent
			if not q then
				return
			end
			local _, u = V()
			if not _ then
				return
			end
			if u and firetouchinterest then
				for V, V in ipairs(W) do
					local W = q:FindFirstChild(V)
					if W then
						pcall(function()
							firetouchinterest(u, W, 0)
							firetouchinterest(u, W, 1)
							firetouchinterest(W, u, 0)
							firetouchinterest(W, u, 1)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			pcall(function()
				_:Activate()
			end)
		end
		local function W(V)
			if not V then
				return
			end
			if not F() or not M() then
				return
			end
			if not w() and not L() then
				return
			end
			local _ = G:FindFirstChild(V)
			if not _ or not K(_, c()) then
				return
			end
			local V = _.Character
			task.spawn(function()
				for _ = 1, 6 do
					local _ = V:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local q = V:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not (_ and _.Health > 0 and q and U()) then
						break
					end
					r(q)
				end
			end)
		end
		local V = false
		local _ = false
		local q = false
		local u = 20
		task.spawn(function()
			local s
			local function h()
				if s then
					pcall(function()
						s:Destroy()
					end)
					s = nil
				end
			end
			while isAlive(A) do
				task.wait(0.05)
				local Y = U()
				if q and false and Y and F() and M() then
					if not (s and s.Parent) then
						s = Instance.new("Part")
						s.Name = "PulseAuraRing"
						s.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
						s.Anchored = true
						s.CanCollide = false
						s.CanQuery = false
						s.CanTouch = false
						s.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
						s.Transparency = 0.82
						s.Parent = f
					end
					pcall(function()
						s.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, u * 2, u * 2)
						s.CFrame = CFrame.new(Y.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0))
							* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
					end)
				else
					h()
				end
			end
		end)
		getgenv().__pulseSetKillAll = function(f)
			V = f == true
		end
		getgenv().__pulseGetKillAll = function()
			return V
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(A) do
				if (V or _ or q) and F() and M() and (w() or L()) then
					local f = c()
					local s = B()
					local B = s and s:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local s = {}
					local function h(Y, l, x)
						if not K(Y, f) then
							return
						end
						local S = Y.Character
						local Y = S and S:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if not Y then
							return
						end
						if l then
							if not B then
								return
							end
							if (Y.Position - B.Position).Magnitude > x then
								return
							end
						end
						s[Y] = true
					end
					if V then
						for B, B in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
							h(B, false, 50)
						end
					elseif _ then
						for B, B in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
							local Y = B.Character
							local l = B:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
							local x = f and f[B.Name]
							local f = Y and Y:FindFirstChild("Gun")
								or l and l:FindFirstChild("Gun")
								or type(x) == "table" and tostring(x.Role) == "Sheriff"
							if f then
								h(B, false, 50)
							end
						end
					end
					if q then
						for f, f in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
							h(f, true, u)
						end
					end
					for f in pairs(s) do
						r(f)
					end
					task.wait()
				else
					task.wait(0.2)
				end
			end
		end)
		local f = {
			on = false,
			mode = "Smart",
			fov = 360,
			maxDist = 250,
			wall = true,
			predict = true,
			lead = 100,
			sticky = true,
			show = true,
			auto = false,
			autoRange = 70,
			autoMin = 55,
			speed = 96,
			throws = 0,
			speedN = 0,
			lastMs = 0,
			curScore = 0,
			lastThrow = 0,
			hist = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
			hcache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		}
		getgenv().__pulseKnifeAim = f
		pcall(function()
			getgenv().__pulseKnifeBypass = true
		end)
		local B = game:GetService("RunService")
		local r = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local s = game:GetService("Stats")
		pcall(function()
			if isfile("PulseHub/mm2_knife.json") then
				local h = r:JSONDecode(readfile("PulseHub/mm2_knife.json"))
				if type(h) == "table" and tonumber(h.speed) then
					f.speed = math.clamp(tonumber(h.speed), 85, 108)
				end
			end
		end)
		local function h()
			pcall(function()
				if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
					makefolder("PulseHub")
				end
				writefile("PulseHub/mm2_knife.json", r:JSONEncode({ speed = f.speed }))
			end)
		end
		local function r()
			local Y = getgenv().__pulseAimX
			if
				type(Y) == "table"
				and Y.alive
				and Y.sample
				and Y.speedFactor
				and Y.lagOf
				and Y.moveParams
				and Y.hypotheses
				and Y.taus
				and Y.mode
				and Y.bodyModel
				and Y.hitsBody
			then
				return Y
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function Y()
			local l, x = pcall(function()
				return s.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
			end)
			if l and x and x == x then
				return math.clamp(x / 1000, 0, 1)
			end
			return 0.08
		end
		local function s(l, x)
			if x then
				return x.sample(l)
			end
			local x = PulseFC(l, "HumanoidRootPart")
			local S = PulseFCC(l, "Humanoid")
			if not (x and S) then
				return nil
			end
			return {
				t = os.clock(),
				p = x.Position,
				cf = x.CFrame,
				md = S.MoveDirection,
				ws = S.WalkSpeed,
				st = S:GetState(),
				air = S.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air,
				jump = S.Jump,
				hh = S.HipHeight,
				jp = 50,
			}
		end
		local function l(x, S)
			local k = #x
			local y = x[1]
			if S <= 0 or k < 2 then
				return y.p
			end
			local Q = x[k]
			if S >= Q.tau then
				return Q.p
			end
			local E = x[2].tau - y.tau
			if E > 0.000001 then
				local y, I = x[math.floor(S / E) + 1], x[math.floor(S / E) + 2]
				if y and I and y.tau <= S and I.tau >= S then
					return y.p:Lerp(I.p, (S - y.tau) / math.max(0.000001, I.tau - y.tau))
				end
			end
			for y = 2, k do
				if x[y].tau >= S then
					local k, E = x[y - 1], x[y]
					return k.p:Lerp(E.p, (S - k.tau) / math.max(0.000001, E.tau - k.tau))
				end
			end
			return Q.p
		end
		a(B.Heartbeat, function()
			if not (f.on or f.auto) then
				return
			end
			local x = U()
			if not x or not F() then
				return
			end
			local S = r()
			local k = os.clock()
			local y = x.Position
			local x = f.maxDist + 80
			for Q, Q in ipairs(PulsePlayers()) do
				if Q ~= t then
					local E = Q.Character
					local Q = E and PulseFC(E, "HumanoidRootPart")
					if Q and (Q.Position - y).Magnitude <= x then
						local x = f.hist[E]
						if not x then
							x = {}
							f.hist[E] = x
						end
						local y = x[#x]
						if y and k - y.t > 0.4 then
							table.clear(x)
							y = nil
						end
						if not y or k - y.t >= 0.004166666666666667 then
							local k = s(E, S)
							if k then
								x[#x + 1] = k
								while #x > 2 and k.t - x[1].t > 3 do
									table.remove(x, 1)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		a(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(a)
			if a.Name ~= "BladePosition" or not a:IsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local x = {}
				for S = 1, 30 do
					B.Heartbeat:Wait()
					if not a.Parent then
						break
					end
					x[#x + 1] = { os.clock(), a.Position }
				end
				if #x < 12 then
					return
				end
				local a = {}
				for B = 2, #x do
					if (x[B][2] - x[B - 1][2]).Magnitude > 0.02 then
						a[#a + 1] = B
					end
				end
				if #a < 5 then
					return
				end
				local B, S = x[a[2]], x[a[#a]]
				local a = S[1] - B[1]
				if a < 0.15 then
					return
				end
				local x = (S[2] - B[2]).Magnitude / a
				if x > 85 and x < 108 then
					f.speed = f.speed * 0.9 + x * 0.1
					f.speedN += 1
					if f.speedN % 5 == 0 then
						h()
					end
				end
			end)
		end)
		local a = RaycastParams.new()
		a.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		a.RespectCanCollide = true
		a.IgnoreWater = true
		local function B()
			local h = w()
			local x = h and h:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if x then
				return x.Position
			end
			local h = U()
			return h and h.Position or nil
		end
		local function U(h, x)
			local S = {}
			for k, k in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
				if k.Character then
					S[#S + 1] = k.Character
				end
			end
			a.FilterDescendantsInstances = S
			local S, k = pcall(function()
				return workspace:Raycast(h, x - h, a)
			end)
			return S and k ~= nil
		end
		local function a(h, x)
			local S = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local k = S and S.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
			local S = {}
			for y, y in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
				if K(y, x) then
					local G = y.Character
					local K = G and G:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if K then
						local Q = K.Position - h
						local h = Q.Magnitude
						if h <= f.maxDist and h > 0.5 then
							local E = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(k:Dot(Q.Unit), -1.0, 1)))
							if f.fov >= 360 or E <= f.fov * 0.5 then
								local k = x[y.Name]
								local x = k and k.Role and tostring(k.Role):lower() or ""
								local k = x:find("sheriff") ~= nil or x:find("hero") ~= nil
								local x
								if f.mode == "Crosshair" then
									x = -E
								elseif f.mode == "Nearest" then
									x = -h
								elseif f.mode == "Sheriff" then
									x = (k and 1000 or 0) - E - h * 0.05
								else
									x = -E - h * 0.12 + (k and 14 or 0)
								end
								if f.sticky and f.cur == G then
									x += f.mode == "Nearest" and 12 or 8
								end
								S[#S + 1] = { c = G, plr = y, hrp = K, dist = h, score = x }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(S, function(G, K)
				return G.score > K.score
			end)
			return S
		end
		local function G(K)
			local h = { parts = {}, detached = {}, rot = K.rot, nCore = K.nCore, rad = K.rad + 0.55 }
			local x = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			for S, k in ipairs(K.parts) do
				h.parts[S] = { rel = k.rel, half = k.half + x, core = k.core }
			end
			if K.bcf then
				h.bcf, h.bhalf = K.bcf, K.bhalf + x
			end
			return h
		end
		local function K(h, x, S, k, y)
			local Q = os.clock()
			local E = f.hcache[x]
			if E and not y and Q - E.at < 0.22 and E.horizon >= k - 0.05 then
				return E
			end
			local y, I = h.k, h.shift
			h.k = h.speedFactor(S)
			h.shift = h.lagOf(x)
			local C = S[#S].t
			local H, n = pcall(h.hypotheses, S, C, k, h.moveParams())
			if H and type(n) == "table" and #n > 0 then
				pcall(function()
					local O = h.mdTrust and h.mdTrust(S, C) or 1
					if O < 0.98 then
						for N, N in ipairs(n) do
							if
								N.kind == "md"
								or N.kind == "mdE"
								or N.kind == "mdL"
								or N.kind == "mdNJ"
								or N.kind == "mdv"
								or N.kind == "mdJe"
								or N.kind == "mdJl"
							then
								N.w = N.w * math.max(O, 0.03)
							end
						end
					end
					if
						h.arc3
						and k < 1
						and (h.mode(S) == "nr" or (h.kinVel(S, C, 0.08) or Vector3.zero).Magnitude > 28)
					then
						local N = h.arc3(S, C, k)
						if N then
							local z = 0
							for D, D in ipairs(n) do
								if D.w > z then
									z = D.w
								end
							end
							n[#n + 1] = { kind = "arc3", w = math.max(z * 0.8, 0.15), traj = N }
						end
					end
					local N = h.anomaly and h.anomaly(S, C)
					if N and h.resolverHyps then
						local z = h.lastTrust
						h.lastTrust = O
						n = h.resolverHyps(S, C, k, n, N)
						h.lastTrust = z
					end
					local S = 0
					for O, O in ipairs(n) do
						S += O.w
					end
					if S > 0 then
						for O, O in ipairs(n) do
							O.w = O.w / S
						end
					end
				end)
			end
			h.k, h.shift = y, I
			if not H or type(n) ~= "table" or #n == 0 then
				return nil
			end
			table.sort(n, function(S, y)
				return S.w > y.w
			end)
			local S = h.bodyModel(x, true)
			E = { at = Q, tNow = C, hyps = n, horizon = k, body = S and G(S) or nil }
			f.hcache[x] = E
			return E
		end
		local function G(h, x, S)
			local k = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not k then
				return nil
			end
			local y = f.speed
			local Q = r()
			local r = f.hist[h]
			local E = math.clamp(f.lead / 100, 0, 3)
			local I = k.Position
			local function k(C, H)
				if f.wall and U(x, C) then
					return nil
				end
				return C, H, (C - x).Magnitude / y
			end
			if not f.predict then
				return k(I, 0.6)
			end
			if not (Q and r and #r >= 8) then
				local C = r and r[#r] or s(h, nil)
				if not C then
					return nil
				end
				local s = Vector3.new(C.md.X, 0, C.md.Z) * C.ws
				local H = (Q and (Q.L or 0.15) or Y() + 0.1) * E
				local Y = C.p
				for n = 1, 5 do
					Y = C.p + s * (H + (Y - x).Magnitude / y)
				end
				return k(Y, 0.35)
			end
			local s = math.clamp((I - x).Magnitude / y + 0.6, 0.7, 2.2)
			local Y = K(Q, h, r, s, S >= 1)
			if not Y then
				return k(I, 0.3)
			end
			local K, s = Y.hyps, Y.body
			local h = math.clamp(os.clock() - Y.tNow, 0, 0.5)
			local Y = Q.taus(Q.mode(r), nil, 1)
			local r = {}
			if S >= 1 or #Y < 5 then
				r = Y
			else
				r = { Y[2], Y[math.ceil(#Y / 2)], Y[#Y - 1] }
			end
			local Y = 0
			for C, C in ipairs(r) do
				Y += C.w
			end
			if Y <= 0 then
				return k(I, 0.3)
			end
			local C = S >= 1 and 8 or 4
			local H = {}
			for n, O in ipairs(K) do
				if n > C then
					break
				end
				for K, K in ipairs(r) do
					H[#H + 1] = { w = O.w * K.w / Y, traj = O.traj, Ls = K.tau + h }
				end
			end
			local K = 0
			for r, r in ipairs(H) do
				K += r.w
			end
			if K <= 0 then
				return k(I, 0.3)
			end
			local r = {}
			local function h(Y, k)
				for C, C in ipairs(r) do
					if (C.p - Y).Magnitude < 0.7 then
						C.w += k
						return
					end
				end
				r[#r + 1] = { p = Y, w = k }
			end
			local Y, k, C = 0, 0, 0
			for n, n in ipairs(H) do
				local O = l(n.traj, n.Ls)
				for N = 1, 4 do
					O = l(n.traj, n.Ls + (O - x).Magnitude / y)
				end
				n.p = O
				h(O, n.w)
				Y += O.X * n.w
				k += O.Y * n.w
				C += O.Z * n.w
			end
			table.sort(r, function(n, O)
				return n.w > O.w
			end)
			local n = S >= 1 and 6 or 3
			while #r > n do
				table.remove(r)
			end
			h(Vector3.new(Y / K, k / K, C / K), 0.001)
			local function h(Y)
				local k = Y - x
				local Y = k.Magnitude
				if Y < 0.5 then
					return 0
				end
				k = k / Y
				local C = 0
				for n, n in ipairs(H) do
					local H = Y / y
					local Y = l(n.traj, n.Ls + H)
					for O = 1, 2 do
						H = math.max(0, (Y - x):Dot(k) / y)
						Y = l(n.traj, n.Ls + H)
					end
					local l
					if s then
						l = Q.hitsBody(s, Y, x, k, (Y - x).Magnitude + 3) ~= nil
					else
						local s = Y - x
						l = (s - k * math.max(0, s:Dot(k))).Magnitude < 1.9
					end
					if l then
						C += n.w
					end
				end
				return C / K
			end
			for K, K in ipairs(r) do
				K.s = h(K.p)
			end
			table.sort(r, function(K, s)
				if math.abs(K.s - s.s) > 0.02 then
					return K.s > s.s
				end
				return K.w > s.w
			end)
			local K
			for s, s in ipairs(r) do
				if not f.wall or not U(x, s.p) then
					K = s
					break
				end
			end
			if not K then
				return nil
			end
			if S >= 1 and K.s < 0.9 then
				local r = K.p - x
				if r.Magnitude > 1 then
					r = r.Unit
					local s = r:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
					s = s.Magnitude > 0.001 and s.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
					local Y = s:Cross(r)
					for r, r in ipairs({ s * 0.7, -s * 0.7, Y * 0.7, -Y * 0.7 }) do
						local s = K.p + r
						local r = h(s)
						if r > K.s + 0.03 and (not f.wall or not U(x, s)) then
							K = { p = s, s = r, w = K.w }
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local U = K.p
			if E ~= 1 then
				U = I + (U - I) * E
			end
			return U, K.s, (U - x).Magnitude / y
		end
		local function U()
			if not (f.on and F() and M()) then
				return nil
			end
			local K = os.clock()
			if f.cache and K - (f.cacheT or 0) < 0.035 then
				return f.cache
			end
			local r = B()
			if not r then
				return nil
			end
			local s = a(r, c())
			local h = os.clock()
			for Y = 1, math.min(#s, 4) do
				local l = s[Y]
				local s, Y = G(l.c, r, 1)
				if s then
					f.cur, f.curScore, f.curPoint = l.c, Y, s
					f.cache, f.cacheT = s, K
					f.lastAim = { t = K, O = r, P = s, c = l.c, sc = Y }
					f.lastMs = (os.clock() - h) * 1000
					return s
				end
			end
			f.cur = nil
			return nil
		end
		f.aim = U
		f.solve = G
		f.pick = a
		f.origin = B

			local Y = f.show and s and s:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				end)
			end

			K.Enabled = true

			if T then
				T.Text = h
			end
		end

					getgenv().__pulseShotHold = math.max(tonumber(getgenv().__pulseShotHold) or 0, os.clock() + 0.45)
					local Y = os.clock()
					while os.clock() - Y < (K.fireDelay or 0.05) do
						game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end
			end)
			f.lastThrow = os.clock()
			f.throws += 1
			pcall(function()
				getgenv().__pulseKnifeBypass = true
			end)
			pcall(function()
				h:FireServer(s.CFrame, CFrame.new(t))
			end)
			return true
		end

					getgenv().__pulseThrowWS = { mouse = T, tgt = c, origMouse = t, origTarget = B }

				end
			end)

							end,
						})
						G:Toggle({
							Text = "Show Other Knives",
							Default = false,
							Callback = function(F)
								A.others = F == true
							end,
						})
						G:Button({
							Text = "Preview Knife Tracer",
							Callback = function()
								task.spawn(function()
									pcall(a.knifePreview)
								end)
							end,
						})
					end,
				})
			end
		end
		G:Header("Kill Player")
		G:PlayerList({
			ExcludeLocal = true,
			Momentary = true,
			ActionIcon = "skull",
			OnSelect = function(G)
				if G then
					W(G.Name)
				end
			end,
		})
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Math - Random Number Helper
-- KEY: Y
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["Y"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function()
		local G = getUpvalue(a)
		local A = 86955
		A = A * G
		G = 12691199
		A = A + G
		G = 16777216
		A = A % G
		setUpvalue(a, A)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Management - Teams (Team 1 & Team 2 Helper)
-- KEY: f
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["f"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X = G[4], G[3], G[0], G[2], G[5], G[6], G[1]
	return function()
		local G = { on = false, mates = {}, foes = {}, at = 0, cur = nil }
		getgenv().__pulseDuel = G
		local t = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		local function R(B)
			if type(B) ~= "table" then
				return
			end
			local U
			for M, M in ipairs({ "Team1", "Team2" }) do
				if type(B[M]) == "table" and B[M][X.Name] ~= nil then
					U = M
				end
			end
			local M, c = {}, {}
			for K, K in ipairs({ "Team1", "Team2" }) do
				if type(B[K]) == "table" then
					for w in pairs(B[K]) do
						if w ~= X.Name then
							if U and K == U then
								M[w] = true
							else
								c[w] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			G.mates, G.foes, G.mine, G.at, G.cur = M, c, U, os.clock(), nil
			G.on = next(c) ~= nil
		end
		local function B()
			G.on, G.mates, G.foes, G.cur = false, {}, {}, nil
		end
		G.apply, G.stop = R, B
		task.spawn(function()
			local U = J:WaitForChild("Remotes", 20)
			local J = U and U:WaitForChild("CustomGames", 20)
			if J then
				local M = J:FindFirstChild("DuelStarted")
				if M then
					F(M.OnClientEvent, function(M)
						pcall(R, M)
					end)
				end
				local R = J:FindFirstChild("DuelFinished")
				if R then
					F(R.OnClientEvent, function()
						task.delay(0.5, B)
					end)
				end
			end
			local J = U and U:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
			local R = J and J:FindFirstChild("RoundEndFade")
			if R then
				F(R.OnClientEvent, function()
					B()
				end)
			end
		end)
		local function F(J)
			local R = false
			for U, U in pairs(J) do
				if type(U) == "table" and (U.Team == "Team1" or U.Team == "Team2") then
					R = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not R then
				return false
			end
			local R = J[X.Name]
			local U = type(R) == "table" and R.Team or nil
			local R, M = {}, {}
			for c, K in pairs(J) do
				if c ~= X.Name and type(K) == "table" then
					if U and K.Team == U then
						R[c] = true
					else
						M[c] = true
					end
				end
			end
			if not G.on then
				G.at, G.cur = os.clock(), nil
			end
			G.mates, G.foes, G.mine = R, M, U
			G.on = next(M) ~= nil
			return true
		end
		G.fromRoles = F
		task.spawn(function()
			local J
			while isAlive(f) do
				pcall(function()
					local f = getUpvalue(A)()
					local R = type(f) == "table" and next(f) ~= nil
					if R then
						J = nil
						if not F(f) and G.on and os.clock() - G.at > 2 then
							B()
						end
					elseif G.on then
						J = J or os.clock()
						if os.clock() - J > 3 then
							B()
						end
					end
				end)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
		a(function()
			B()
			getgenv().__pulseDuel = nil
		end)
		G.alive = function(a)
			local F = a.Character
			local f = F and F:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (F and f and f.Health > 0 and F:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
				return nil
			end
			local f = getUpvalue(A)()[a.Name]
			if f and (f.Dead == true or f.Killed == true) then
				return nil
			end
			return F
		end
		G.isFoe = function(a)
			return G.on and a ~= X and G.foes[a.Name] == true
		end
		G.pick = function(a)
			if not G.on then
				return nil
			end
			local A = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not A then
				return nil
			end
			local F, f = A.CFrame.Position, A.CFrame.LookVector
			if t.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
				local J, X = pcall(function()
					local R = t:GetMouseLocation()
					return A:ViewportPointToRay(R.X, R.Y)
				end)
				if J and X then
					F, f = X.Origin, X.Direction.Unit
				end
			end
			local A, J, X, t
			for R, R in ipairs(T:GetPlayers()) do
				if G.isFoe(R) then
					local T = G.alive(R)
					if T and (not a or a(T)) then
						local B = T.HumanoidRootPart.Position - F
						local F = B.Magnitude
						if F > 0.01 then
							local U = math.acos(math.clamp(f:Dot(B / F), -1.0, 1)) + F * 0.0005
							if R == G.cur then
								t = U
							end
							if not X or U < X then
								A, J, X = R, T, U
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if G.cur and t and A ~= G.cur and X > t - (G.stick or 0.06) then
				return G.cur, G.cur.Character
			end
			if not a then
				G.cur = A
			end
			return A, J
		end
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Management - Players (Player List & Utilities)
-- KEY: S
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["S"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T = G[1], G[0], G[2], G[3]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("Players")
		local f, J = pcall(function()
			return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.CurrentRoundClient)
		end)
		if not f then
			J = nil
		end
		local function f()
			local J = a.Character
			return J and J:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		local function J()
			return isAlive(T)
		end
		local function T(X)
			for t, R in pairs(J()) do
				if type(R) == "table" and R.Role and tostring(R.Role):lower():find(X) and R.Dead ~= true then
					return t
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function J(X)
			local t = f()
			if t and X then
				pcall(function()
					t.CFrame = X
				end)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end
		local function f(X)
			if not X then
				return false
			end
			local t = G:FindFirstChild(X)
			if not t or t == a then
				return false
			end
			local G = t.Character
			local a = G and G:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not a then
				return false
			end
			return J(a.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5))
		end
		local function G()
			local a = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
			local X
			if a then
				local t = a:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
				if t then
					X = t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
				end
				X = X or a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
			end
			X = X or workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
			if X then
				return J(X.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
			end
			return false
		end
		local function a()
			for X, X in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				if
					X:IsA("Model")
					and not string.find(X.Name, "Lobby", 1, true)
					and (X:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") or X:FindFirstChild("Spawns"))
				then
					return X
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function X()
			local t = a()
			if not t then
				pcall(function()
					F.W:Notify({
						Title = A.tr("No map loaded"),
						Kind = "warning",
						Duration = 2.5,
					})
				end)
				return false
			end
			local a = {}
			local A = t:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
			if A then
				for R, R in ipairs(A:GetChildren()) do
					if R:IsA("BasePart") then
						a[#a + 1] = R
					end
				end
			end
			if #a > 0 then
				return J(a[math.random(1, #a)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
			end
			local a = t:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
			local A = a and a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if A then
				return J(CFrame.new(A.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
			end
			return J(t:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
		end
		local a = F:Tab("Teleport", "location-pin-map")
		a:Columns()
		a:Group({ Title = "TP Role", Side = "Left" })
		a:Button({
			Text = "Tp Lobby",
			Callback = function()
				G()
			end,
		})
		a:Button({
			Text = "Tp Map",
			Callback = function()
				X()
			end,
		})
		a:Button({
			Text = "Tp Murderer",
			Callback = function()
				f(T("murder"))
			end,
		})
		a:Button({
			Text = "Tp Sheriff",
			Callback = function()
				f(T("sheriff") or T("hero"))
			end,
		})
		a:Group({ Title = "TP Player", Side = "Right" })
		a:PlayerList({
			ExcludeLocal = true,
			Momentary = true,
			ActionIcon = "map-pin",
			OnSelect = function(G)
				if G then
					f(G.Name)
				end
			end,
		})
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Utility - Data Table Accessor
-- KEY: g
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["g"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function(G)
		if G == nil then
			return G
		end
		local A = a.data[a.lang]
		if A then
			local a = A[G]
			if a then
				return a
			end
		end
		return G
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Troll - Fling Engine (Player Fling & Lightning Strike)
-- KEY: O
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["O"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t, R = G[7], G[4], G[6], G[3], G[8], G[0], G[1], G[2], G[5]
	return function()
		local G = T:Tab("Fling Players", "lightning-bolt")
		local B = game:GetService("Players")
		local U = game:GetService("Workspace")
		local M = B.LocalPlayer
		local c = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local K = game:GetService("RunService")
		local w
		local function L()
			if w and w.Parent then
				return w
			end
			local W = c:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			local c = W and W:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
			if c then
				w = c:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
			end
			return w
		end
		local c = {}
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(A) do
				local w = L()
				if w then
					local L, W = pcall(function()
						return w:InvokeServer()
					end)
					if L and type(W) == "table" then
						c = W
					end
				end
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
		local function w(L)
			local W = c[L.Name]
			return type(W) == "table" and W or nil
		end
		local function c(L)
			local W = w(L)
			if W and W.Role then
				local L = tostring(W.Role):lower()
				if L:find("murder") then
					return "murderer"
				end
				if L:find("sheriff") then
					return "sheriff"
				end
				if L:find("hero") then
					return "hero"
				end
				if L:find("innocent") then
					return "innocent"
				end
			end
			return ""
		end
		local function L(W)
			local V = w(W)
			return V ~= nil and (V.Dead == true or V.Killed == true)
		end
		local function w(W)
			if L(W) then
				return X.tr("Dead")
			end
			local V = c(W)
			if V == "murderer" then
				return X.tr("Murderer")
			end
			if V == "sheriff" then
				return X.tr("Sheriff")
			end
			if V == "hero" then
				return X.tr("Hero")
			end
			if V == "innocent" then
				return X.tr("Innocent")
			end
			return X.tr("Lobby")
		end
		local function W(V)
			if L(V) then
				return 8
			end
			local r = c(V)
			if r == "murderer" then
				return 0
			end
			if r == "sheriff" then
				return 1
			end
			if r == "hero" then
				return 2
			end
			if r == "innocent" then
				return 3
			end
			return 9
		end
		local function V(r)
			if L(r) then
				return Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 128)
			end
			local _ = c(r)
			if _ == "murderer" then
				return Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 72)
			end
			if _ == "sheriff" then
				return Color3.fromRGB(96, 152, 255)
			end
			if _ == "hero" then
				return Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60)
			end
			if _ == "innocent" then
				return Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 120)
			end
			return Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
		end
		local r = false
		local _ = { busy = false, fpdh = nil }
		local function q()
			local u, s = pcall(function()
				return M:GetNetworkPing()
			end)
			return u and tonumber(s) or 0.08
		end
		local function u(s, h, Y)
			Y = Y or {}
			if _.busy then
				return false, "busy"
			end
			if not (s and s.Parent) then
				return false, "no-target"
			end
			local l = PulseFCC(s, "Humanoid")
			local x = PulseFC(s, "HumanoidRootPart") or PulseFC(s, "Head")
			if not (l and x) or l.Health <= 0 then
				return false, "dead"
			end
			local S = M.Character
			local k = S and PulseFCC(S, "Humanoid")
			local y = S and PulseFC(S, "HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (k and y) or k.Health <= 0 then
				return false, "me"
			end
			_.busy = true
			h = tonumber(h) or 0.8
			local Q = getgenv()
			Q.__pulseManualFling, Q.__pulseTouchFlinging = true, true
			Q.__pulseInvisPause = os.clock() + h + 1.5
			if _.fpdh == nil then
				_.fpdh = U.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
			end
			local E = Y.home or y.CFrame
			local I = U.CurrentCamera
			local C = I and I.CameraSubject
			local H, n = true, false
			pcall(function()
				H = k:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated)
			end)
			pcall(function()
				n = k.PlatformStand
			end)
			pcall(function()
				U.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0
			end)
			pcall(function()
				k:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
			end)
			if Y.cam ~= false then
				pcall(function()
					if I then
						I.CameraSubject = l
					end
				end)
			end
			local Y = {}
			pcall(function()
				for O, O in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
					if O:IsA("BasePart") then
						Y[#Y + 1] = { O, O.CanCollide }
					end
				end
			end)
			local function O()
				for N = 1, #Y do
					local z = Y[N][1]
					if z.Parent and z.CanCollide then
						pcall(function()
							z.CanCollide = false
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			O()
			local N = tonumber(rawget(Q, "__pulseFlingDownV")) or 120000
			local z = x.Position.Y
			local D = rawget(Q, "__pulseAimX")
			local b = D and tonumber(D.L) or 0.16
			local D = tonumber(rawget(Q, "__pulseFlingLead")) or math.clamp(b + q() * 2 + 0.05, 0.15, 0.6)
			local q = { 1.4, 0.5, 2.3, 0.9 }
			local b = 0
			do
				local Z, P = pcall(function()
					return l.MoveDirection.Magnitude * l.WalkSpeed
				end)
				b = Vector3.new(x.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, x.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude
				if Z and P > 2 or b > 3 then
					h = math.max(h, 1.2)
				end
			end
			_.leadMem = _.leadMem or {}
			local Z = B:GetPlayerFromCharacter(s)
			local P = Z and Z.UserId
			local Z = P and _.leadMem[P] or nil
			local i = Z and math.huge or 0
			local i = {}
			local d = 1
			local g = nil
			local o = tonumber(rawget(Q, "__pulseFlingMaxSpeed")) or 20
			local p, m = 0.6, 1.6
			if Z then
				p, m = math.max(0.3, Z - 0.25), Z + 0.25
			end
			local Z, p = nil, nil
			local m = { 0, 0.3, 0.55, 0.8 }
			local j = nil
			local e = Vector3.zero
			local v = os.clock()
			local GM, aM, AM = 0, false, "timeout"
			local FM, TM = 0, z
			local fM, fM, JM, XM = nil, nil, x.Position, false
			local tM = RaycastParams.new()
			tM.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			tM.FilterDescendantsInstances = { S, s }
			pcall(function()
				tM.RespectCanCollide = true
			end)
			local RM, BM
			BM = K.Stepped:Connect(function()
				if aM then
					return
				end
				pcall(function()
					y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = e
					y.AssemblyAngularVelocity = e
				end)
				O()
			end)
			RM = K.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if aM then
					return
				end
				GM += 1
				if not (s.Parent and x.Parent) or l.Health <= 0 then
					aM, AM = true, "gone"
					return
				end
				if not y.Parent or k.Health <= 0 then
					aM, AM = true, "me"
					return
				end
				local O = x.Position
				if (O - JM).Magnitude > 60 then
					aM, AM = true, "tp-target"
					return
				end
				JM = O
				if fM and (y.Position - fM).Magnitude > 30 then
					aM, AM, XM = true, "tp-me", true
					return
				end
				local JM = x.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				if JM.Y < FM then
					FM = JM.Y
				end
				if O.Y < TM then
					TM = O.Y
				end
				if O.Y < z - 25 then
					aM, AM = true, "down"
					return
				end
				if JM.Y < -250.0 then
					aM, AM = true, "falling"
					return
				end
				if os.clock() - v > h then
					aM = true
					return
				end
				if g and (y.Position - g).Magnitude > 60 and (O - g).Magnitude > 55 then
					aM, AM = true, "far"
					return
				end
				local UM = Vector3.new(JM.X, 0, JM.Z)
				local JM, MM, cM = pcall(function()
					return l.MoveDirection, l.WalkSpeed
				end)
				local l = UM
				if JM and MM and MM.Magnitude > 0.1 then
					local JM = Vector3.new(MM.X, 0, MM.Z).Unit * math.clamp(tonumber(cM) or 16, 0, 60)
					if UM.Magnitude > 40 then
						l = UM
					else
						l = JM:Lerp(UM, 0.25)
					end
				end
				local JM = l.Magnitude > 2
				local UM
				local MM = os.clock()
				if JM then
					local cM = O
					if not j or not p then
						j = cM
					else
						local KM = 30 * math.clamp(MM - p, 0.004166666666666667, 0.05)
						local wM = Vector3.new(cM.X - j.X, 0, cM.Z - j.Z)
						if wM.Magnitude > KM then
							wM = wM.Unit * KM
						end
						j = Vector3.new(j.X + wM.X, cM.Y, j.Z + wM.Z)
					end
					local cM = GM % 8
					d = m[cM % 4 + 1]
					local m = l * d
					if m.Magnitude > 25 then
						m = m.Unit * 25
					end
					if m.Magnitude > 0.1 then
						local KM, wM = pcall(function()
							return U:Raycast(j, m, tM)
						end)
						if KM and wM then
							m = m.Unit * math.max(0, wM.Distance - 1.5)
						end
					end
					i[#i + 1] = { MM, d }
					while #i > 0 and MM - i[1][1] > 1.2 do
						table.remove(i, 1)
					end
					O = j + m
