					h(_.btnSt, i, { Transparency = g and 1 or 0.78 })
					h(_.ic, i, { ImageColor3 = g and P or x })
					h(_.nm, i, { TextTransparency = o and 0.45 or 0 })
					h(_.av, i, { ImageTransparency = o and 0.55 or 0 })
				end
				U.paintRow = r
				local function _(P)
					local i = { plr = P, hover = false }
					local d = l("TextButton", {
						Name = "Row",
						Text = "",
						AutoButtonColor = false,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Q),
						ZIndex = 8,
					}, Y)
					local g = l("Frame", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 0),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						ZIndex = 9,
					}, d)
					l("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, g)
					s(g, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
					local s = l("Frame", {
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -5.0, 1, 0),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						ZIndex = 8,
					}, d)
					local o = l("Frame", {
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						BackgroundColor3 = x,
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.92,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						ZIndex = 8,
					}, s)
					l("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, o)
					l("UIGradient", {
						Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.3),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.85),
						}),
					}, o)
					local p = l("ImageLabel", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Q - 8, Q - 8),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 44),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. P.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48",
						ZIndex = 9,
					}, s)
					l("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, p)
					local m = l("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150) }, p)
					local j = Q + 1
					local e = l("TextLabel", {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(j, 2),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -(j + 62), 0, 15),
						FontFace = q.Font.Semi(),
						TextSize = 11,
						TextColor3 = x,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						Text = P.DisplayName,
						ZIndex = 10,
					}, s)
					local v = l("TextLabel", {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(j, 16),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -(j + 29), 0, 11),
						FontFace = q.Font.Medium(),
						TextSize = 9,
						TextColor3 = S,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						RichText = true,
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 10,
					}, s)
					local j = l("TextLabel", {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
						Position = UDim2.new(1, -29.0, 0, 4),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 12),
						FontFace = q.Font.Medium(),
						TextSize = 9,
						TextColor3 = S,
						TextTransparency = 0.2,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 10,
					}, s)
					local S = l("TextButton", {
						Text = "",

						BorderSizePixel = 0,

					l("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, S)

						if not P.Parent then
							return

							q.Sound.play("click")

					d.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
						i.hover = false
						r(i)
					end)
					r(i, true)
					return i

				local function s()
					local l = 0
					for x in pairs(U.rows) do
						l += 1
					end
					f.Visible = false
					Y.Visible = not T.fold and l > 0
					local f = l > 0 and l * Q + (l - 1) * E or 34
					local Y = (T.fold or l == 0) and y or y + math.min(f + 4, I - y - H) + H
					h(n, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(k, Y) })
				end
				U.refresh = function()
					if not n.Visible then
						return
					end
					local f = M.Character and PulseFC(M.Character, "HumanoidRootPart")
					local h, Y, l = {}, 0, 0
					local x = {}
					for S, S in ipairs(B:GetPlayers()) do
						if S ~= M then
							x[#x + 1] = S
						end
					end
					local B = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseFlingMock")
					if type(B) == "table" then
						for M, M in ipairs(B) do
							x[#x + 1] = M
						end
					end
					local B = {}
					for M, M in ipairs(x) do
						local x = L(M)
						l += 1
						if not x then
							Y += 1
						end
						if not (T.hideDead and (x or c(M) == "")) then
							B[#B + 1] = M
						end
					end
					do
						local M = X.tr(l == 0 and "No players" or "No targets")
						if C.Text ~= M then
							C.Text = M
						end
					end
					table.sort(B, function(X, M)
						local c, x = W(X), W(M)
						if c ~= x then
							return c < x
						end
						return X.DisplayName:lower() < M.DisplayName:lower()
					end)
					local X = false
					for M, c in ipairs(B) do
						h[c] = true
						local x = U.rows[c]
						if not x then
							x = _(c)
							U.rows[c] = x
							X = true
						end
						x.fr.LayoutOrder = M
						local M = L(c)
						local L = V(c)
						x.ring.Color = L
						local _ = '<font color="'
							.. z(L)
							.. '"><b>'
							.. tostring(w(c)):upper()
							.. "</b></font>  @"
							.. c.Name
						if x.sub.Text ~= _ then
							x.sub.Text = _
						end
						if x.nm.Text ~= c.DisplayName then
							x.nm.Text = c.DisplayName
						end
						local L = c.Character and PulseFC(c.Character, "HumanoidRootPart")
						local _ = ""
						if f and L then
							local S = (L.Position - f.Position).Magnitude
							_ = S >= 100000 and "far"
								or S >= 1000 and string.format("%.1fk", S / 1000)
								or tostring(math.floor(S + 0.5)) .. "st"
						end
						if x.dist.Text ~= _ then
							x.dist.Text = _
						end
						local f = Z(c)
						if x.dead ~= M or x.on ~= f then
							x.dead, x.on = M, f
							r(x)
						end
					end
					for f, M in pairs(U.rows) do
						if not h[f] then
							U.rows[f] = nil
							pcall(function()
								M.fr:Destroy()
							end)
							X = true
						end
					end
					if U.target and not Z(U.target) then
						U.target = nil
					end
					local f = tostring(Y) .. "/" .. tostring(l)
					if N.Text ~= f then
						N.Text = f
					end
					if X or U.lastN ~= #B then
						U.lastN = #B
						s()
					end
				end
				U.setHide = function(f, X)
					T.hideDead = f == true
					u()
					if not X and U.syncHide then
						pcall(U.syncHide, T.hideDead)
					end
					pcall(U.refresh)
				end
				O.Activated:Connect(function()
					pcall(function()
						q.Sound.play("click")
					end)
					T.fold = not T.fold
					q.Icons.apply(D, T.fold and "chevron-down" or "chevron-up")
					s()
				end)
				b.Activated:Connect(function()
					pcall(function()
						q.Sound.play("click")
					end)
					U.setHide(not T.hideDead)
				end)
				do
					local f, X, B, M
					J.InputBegan:Connect(function(J)
						if
							J.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
							and J.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
						then
							return
						end
						f, X, B, M = true, J.Position, n.Position, J
						local c
						c = J.Changed:Connect(function()
							if J.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
								f = false
								c:Disconnect()
								T.x, T.y = math.floor(n.Position.X.Offset), math.floor(n.Position.Y.Offset)
							end
						end)
					end)
					a(F.InputChanged, function(a)
						if not f then
							return
						end
						if not q.U.sameMove(a, M) then
							return
						end
						local F = a.Position - X
						local a = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
						local f = math.clamp(B.X.Offset + F.X, 4, math.max(4, a.X - n.AbsoluteSize.X - 4))
						local J = math.clamp(B.Y.Offset + F.Y, 4, math.max(4, a.Y - n.AbsoluteSize.Y - 4))
						n.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(f, J)
					end)
				end
				pcall(function()
					q.Theme.onChange(function(a)
						if a ~= "Accent" or not n.Parent then
							return
						end
						for a, a in pairs(U.rows) do
							pcall(r, a)
						end
						pcall(u)
					end)
				end)
				U.setOn = function(a)
					T.on = a == true
					n.Visible = T.on
					if T.on then
						pcall(U.refresh)
						s()
					end
				end
				task.spawn(function()
					while getUpvalue(A)() and n.Parent do
						if n.Visible then
							pcall(U.refresh)
						end
						task.wait(0.4)
					end
				end)
				t(function()
					pcall(function()
						n:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		local a
		G:Toggle({
			Text = "Fling Panel",
			Default = type(R.flingPanel) == "table" and R.flingPanel.on == true,
			Callback = function(A)
				if U.setOn then
					U.setOn(A)
				end
			end,
			Settings = function()
				a = G:Toggle({
					Text = "Hide Dead",
					Default = type(R.flingPanel) == "table" and R.flingPanel.hideDead == true,
					Callback = function(A)
						if U.setHide then
							U.setHide(A, true)
						end
					end,
				})
			end,
		})
		U.syncHide = function(A)
			if a and a.SetSilent then
				a.SetSilent(A)
			end
		end
		G:PlayerList({
			ExcludeLocal = true,
			Momentary = true,
			ActionIcon = "zap",
			Refresh = 0.5,
			SubText = function(G)
				return w(G)
			end,
			SubColor = function(G)
				return V(G)
			end,
			SortKey = function(G)
				return W(G)
			end,
			OnSelect = function(G)
				if G then
					K(G)
				end
			end,
		})
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Automation & AutoFarm (Auto Kill, Kill Aura, Pick Gun, Auto Steal, Respawn, Anti-Fling)
-- KEY: v
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["v"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t, R = G[1], G[6], G[8], G[2], G[7], G[0], G[3], G[5], G[4]
	return function()
		getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_VERSION = (getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_VERSION or 0) + 1
		local G = getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_VERSION
		local function B()
			return getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_VERSION == G
		end
		getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT = true
		local G = game:GetService("Players")
		local U = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local M = game:GetService("RunService")
		local c = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local K = workspace
		local w = G.LocalPlayer
		T.farm = T.farm or {}
		if tonumber(T.farm.speed) == nil then
			T.farm.speed = 21
		end
		local function L()
			return math.clamp(tonumber(T.farm.speed) or 21, 8, 22)
		end
		local W = false
		local V = false
		local r = false
		local _ = 0
		local q = 0
		local u = 0
		local s = false
		local h = 0
		local Y = nil
		local l = {}
		local x = false
		local S = false
		local k = 0
		local y = false
		local Q = false
		local E = false
		local I = false
		local C = false
		local H = nil
		local n = false
		local O = false
		local N = 0
		local z = true
		local D = false
		local b = 0
		local Z = 0
		local P = {}
		local i = nil
		local function d()
			i = nil
		end
		A(function()
			W = false
			b = b + 1
			Z = Z + 1
		end)
		local g = 0
		local o = 0
		local p = true
		local m = true
		local function j()
			if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				local e = {
					respawnOnFull = Q,
					antiFling = E,
					avoidMurder = I,
					autoFling = n,
					killAura = z,
					pickGun = p,
					shootOnFull = m,
					totalCoins = q,
				}
				writefile("PulseFarmMM2_config.json", c:JSONEncode(e))
			end)
		end
		local function e()
			if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if not isfile("PulseFarmMM2_config.json") then
					return
				end
				local v = c:JSONDecode(readfile("PulseFarmMM2_config.json"))
				if type(v) ~= "table" then
					return
				end
				if type(v.respawnOnFull) == "boolean" then
					Q = v.respawnOnFull
				end
				if type(v.antiFling) == "boolean" then
					E = v.antiFling
				end
				if type(v.avoidMurder) == "boolean" then
					I = v.avoidMurder
				end
				if type(v.autoFling) == "boolean" then
					n = v.autoFling
				end
				if type(v.killAura) == "boolean" then
					z = v.killAura
				end
				if type(v.pickGun) == "boolean" then
					p = v.pickGun
				end
				if type(v.shootOnFull) == "boolean" then
					m = v.shootOnFull
				end
				if type(v.totalCoins) == "number" then
					q = v.totalCoins
				end
			end)
		end
		e()
		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				task.wait(5)
				if s then
					s = false
					j()
				end
			end
		end)
		local e = nil
		local function v(GM, aM)
			if type(http_request) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local AM, FM = pcall(http_request, {
				Url = GM,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					["Accept"] = "application/json",
				},
				Body = aM,
			})
			if not AM then
				return false, "http_request threw: " .. tostring(FM)
			end
			if type(FM) ~= "table" then
				return false, "http_request returned " .. type(FM)
			end
			local GM = FM.StatusCode or FM.Status or FM.status_code or 0
			return GM >= 200 and GM < 300, GM
		end
		local function GM(aM, AM)
			if type(request) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local FM, TM = pcall(request, {
				Url = aM,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					["Accept"] = "application/json",
				},
				Body = AM,
			})
			if not FM then
				return false, "request threw: " .. tostring(TM)
			end
			if type(TM) ~= "table" then
				return false, "request returned " .. type(TM)
			end
			local aM = TM.StatusCode or TM.Status or TM.status_code or 0
			return aM >= 200 and aM < 300, aM
		end
		local function aM(AM, FM)
			local TM, fM = pcall(function()
				c:PostAsync(AM, FM, Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson, false)
			end)
			if TM then
				return true, 200
			end
			return false, "PostAsync threw: " .. tostring(fM)
		end
		local AM = {
			{ name = "http_request", fn = v },
			{ name = "request", fn = GM },
			{ name = "HttpService:PostAsync", fn = aM },
		}
		local function v(GM, aM)
			local FM, TM = pcall(function()
				return c:JSONEncode(aM)
			end)
			if not FM then
				return false, "JSONEncode failed: " .. tostring(TM)
			end
			do
				local aM = {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					["Accept"] = "application/json",
				}
				local FM = TM
				if getUpvalue(t) then
					local fM = F.sha256hex(tostring(os.clock()) .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000000))):sub(1, 16)
					local F, JM = pcall(getUpvalue(t), fM, TM)
					if F and type(JM) == "string" then
						FM = c:JSONEncode({ e = JM })
						aM["X-Pulse-Enc"] = fM
					end
				end
				local F, t, c = pcall(function()
					return getUpvalue(R)({ Url = GM, Method = "POST", Headers = aM, Body = FM })
				end)
				if F and type(t) == "table" then
					local F = t.StatusCode or t.Status or t.status_code or 0
					if F > 0 then
						return F >= 200 and F < 300, F
					end
				end
				if c == "spy" then
					return false, "spy gate"
				end
			end
			if e then
				for F, F in ipairs(AM) do
					if F.name == e then
						local t, R = F.fn(GM, TM)
						if t == nil then
							e = nil
							break
						end
						return t, R
					end
				end
			end
			local F = nil
			for t, t in ipairs(AM) do
				local R, c = t.fn(GM, TM)
				if R == true then
					e = t.name
					return true, c
				elseif R == false then
					if not F then
						F = t.name .. ": " .. tostring(c)
					end
				end
			end
			for t, t in ipairs(AM) do
				local R = t.fn(GM, TM)
				if R ~= nil then
					e = t.name
					return false, F or "all backends failed"
				end
			end
			S = true
			return false, "no http backend"
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(2)
			local F = 0
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				pcall(function()
					local t = _ - F
					if t < 0 then
						t = 0
					end
					local R = { user_id = w.UserId, username = w.Name, delta = t, place_id = game.PlaceId }
					local t, c = v("https://pulsehub.gg/farm/heartbeat", R)
					x = t
					k = tick()
					if t then
						F = _
					end
				end)
				if S then
					task.wait(60)
				else
					task.wait(5)
				end
			end
		end)
		do
			local F = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local t = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			local R = {
				BodyVelocity = function(c)
					c.MaxForce = t
					c.Velocity = t
				end,
				BodyAngularVelocity = function(c)
					c.MaxTorque = t
					c.AngularVelocity = t
				end,
				BodyForce = function(c)
					c.Force = t
				end,
				BodyThrust = function(c)
					c.Force = t
				end,
				BodyGyro = function(c)
					c.MaxTorque = t
				end,
				BodyPosition = function(c)
					c.MaxForce = t
				end,
				RocketPropulsion = function(c)
					c.MaxThrust = 0
					c:Abort()
				end,
				LinearVelocity = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
				AngularVelocity = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
				VectorForce = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
				Torque = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
				AlignPosition = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
				AlignOrientation = function(c)
					c.Enabled = false
				end,
			}
			local function c()
				return T.antiFling and getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT
			end
			local function x()
				return O or getgenv().__pulseManualFling or getgenv().__pulseTouchFlinging
			end
			local function S(k)
				local e = getgenv().__pulseFlingTargetChar
				return e and k:IsDescendantOf(e)
			end
			local function k(e)
				if F[e] or not e:IsA("BasePart") then
					return
				end
				local v
				v = J(e:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"), function()
					if not isAlive(f) then
						pcall(function()
							v:Disconnect()
						end)
						return
					end
					if c() and e.CanCollide and not S(e) then
						pcall(function()
							e.CanCollide = false
						end)
					end
				end, true)
				F[e] = true
				if c() and not S(e) then
					pcall(function()
						e.CanCollide = false
					end)
				end
			end
			local F, e = {}, {}
			local v = { HumanoidRootPart = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, Torso = true, Head = true }
			local GM = {}
			local function aM(AM)
				local FM = AM.ClassName
				local TM = GM[FM]
				if TM == nil then
					TM = AM:IsA("BasePart")
					GM[FM] = TM
				end
				return TM
			end
			local function GM(AM)
				if not (AM and AM.Parent) then
					return
				end
				local FM, TM = {}, {}
				for fM, fM in ipairs(AM:GetDescendants()) do
					if aM(fM) then
						FM[#FM + 1] = fM
						if v[fM.Name] and fM.Parent == AM then
							TM[#TM + 1] = fM
						end
					end
				end
				F[AM] = FM
				e[AM] = TM
			end
			local function AM(FM)
				for TM, TM in ipairs(FM:GetDescendants()) do
					k(TM)
				end
				GM(FM)
				J(FM.DescendantAdded, function(TM)
					k(TM)
					if aM(TM) then
						local k = F[FM]
						if k then
							k[#k + 1] = TM
						else
							GM(FM)
						end
						if v[TM.Name] and TM.Parent == FM then
							local k = e[FM]
							if k then
								k[#k + 1] = TM
							end
						end
					end
				end, true)
				J(FM.AncestryChanged, function()
					if not FM.Parent then
						F[FM] = nil
						e[FM] = nil
					end
				end, true)
			end
			local function k(v)
				if v == w then
					return
				end
				if v.Character then
					AM(v.Character)
				end
				J(v.CharacterAdded, function(v)
					AM(v)
				end)
			end
			for v, v in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
				k(v)
			end
			J(G.PlayerAdded, k)
			J(G.PlayerRemoving, function(k)
				if k.Character then
					F[k.Character] = nil
					e[k.Character] = nil
				end
			end)
			local function k(v)
				for GM, AM in pairs(v) do
					if GM.Parent then
						for FM = 1, #AM do
							local TM = AM[FM]
							if TM.CanCollide and TM.Parent and not S(TM) then
								TM.CanCollide = false
							end
						end
					else
						v[GM] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			local function v()
				local GM = w.Character
				local AM = GM and PulseFC(GM, "HumanoidRootPart")
				local GM = AM and AM.Position
				for AM, FM in pairs(F) do
					if AM.Parent then
						local TM = FM
						if GM then
							local fM = PulseFC(AM, "HumanoidRootPart")
							if fM and (fM.Position - GM).Magnitude > 60 then
								TM = e[AM] or FM
							end
						end
						for GM = 1, #TM do
							local FM = TM[GM]
							if FM.CanCollide and FM.Parent and not S(FM) then
								FM.CanCollide = false
							end
						end
					else
						F[AM] = nil
						e[AM] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			getgenv().__pulseAfNoCollide = v
			local e, v, GM
			local AM, FM = nil, 0
			local TM = {}
			local fM, JM = nil, {}
			local XM, tM, RM = {}, nil, 0
			local function BM(UM)
				local MM = R[UM.ClassName]
				if not MM or UM:GetAttribute("PulseMine") or not c() then
					return
				end
				if getgenv().__pulseNoDelete then
					return
				end
				local cM, KM = UM.Parent, 0
				while cM and cM ~= e and KM < 6 do
					if cM:IsA("Tool") then
						return
					end
					if cM.Name == "Pet" then
						return
					end
					cM = cM.Parent
					KM = KM + 1
				end
				pcall(MM, UM)
				task.defer(function()
					pcall(function()
						UM:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
			local function UM(MM)
				for cM, cM in ipairs(TM) do
					pcall(function()
						cM:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				TM = {}
				e, AM = MM, nil
				FM = os.clock() + 2
				v = MM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				GM = MM:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				task.spawn(function()
					v = v or MM:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
					GM = GM or MM:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
				end)
				for cM, cM in ipairs(MM:GetDescendants()) do
					BM(cM)
				end
				TM[#TM + 1] = J(MM.DescendantAdded, BM)
			end
			if w.Character then
				UM(w.Character)
			end
			J(w.CharacterAdded, UM)
			local function UM()
				local MM = v and v.WalkSpeed or 16
				local cM =
					math.max(tonumber(getgenv().__pulseBhopSpeed) or 0, tonumber(getgenv().__pulseGlitchSpeed) or 0)
				local KM = T.fly and T.fly.on == true
				local wM = KM and (T.fly.speed or 60) or 0
				local T = 50
				if v then
					if v.UseJumpPower == false then
						T = math.max((v.JumpHeight or 7.2) * 12, 50)
					else
						T = math.max(v.JumpPower or 50, 50)
					end
				end
				local LM = KM or x()
				if not LM and (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseBombJumpUntil) or 0) > os.clock() then
					LM = true
				end
				if not LM and GM then
					if fM ~= GM then
						local WM = GM
						fM, JM = WM, {}
						for VM, VM in ipairs(WM:GetChildren()) do
							if R[VM.ClassName] ~= nil then
								JM[VM] = true
							end
						end
						TM[#TM + 1] = J(WM.ChildAdded, function(VM)
							if fM == WM and R[VM.ClassName] ~= nil then
								JM[VM] = true
							end
						end)
						TM[#TM + 1] = J(WM.ChildRemoved, function(R)
							if fM == WM then
								JM[R] = nil
							end
						end)
					end
					for R in pairs(JM) do
						if R.Parent ~= GM then
							JM[R] = nil
						elseif R:GetAttribute("PulseMine") then
							LM = true
							break
						end
					end
				end
				return math.max(MM, cM, wM) + 10, KM and math.max(wM, 160) or T + 20, LM
			end
			local function T()
				if not (v and GM and v.Parent and GM.Parent and v.Health > 0) then
					return
				end
				local R, TM, fM = UM()
				if fM then
					return
				end
				if GM.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 24 then
					GM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = t
				end
				local fM = GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local JM = Vector3.new(fM.X, 0, fM.Z)
				local MM = v.MoveDirection
				local cM = math.clamp(fM.Y, -260.0, TM)
				local KM = JM
				local wM = v.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
				if wM then
					local LM = v:GetState()
					if LM == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or LM == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
						wM = false
					end
				end
				local LM = getgenv().__pulseBhopChain == true
				if MM.Magnitude > 0.1 then
					local WM = Vector3.new(MM.X, 0, MM.Z).Unit
					local MM = JM:Dot(WM)
					local VM = (JM - WM * MM).Magnitude
					if MM > R or VM > (wM and not LM and 6 or R) then
						KM = WM * math.clamp(MM, 0, R)
					end
				elseif wM and LM then
					if JM.Magnitude > R then
						KM = JM.Unit * R
					end
				elseif wM then
					if JM.Magnitude > 8 then
						KM = t
					end
				elseif JM.Magnitude > R then
					KM = JM.Unit * R
				end
				if KM ~= JM or cM ~= fM.Y then
					GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(KM.X, cM, KM.Z)
				end
				if e then
					local fM = math.max(R, TM) + 60
					local R = GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					if R.Magnitude > fM then
						GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = R.Unit * fM
					end
					local R = os.clock()
					if tM ~= e or R >= RM then
						tM, RM = e, R + 0.25
						local R = GM.AssemblyRootPart
						local TM = 0
						for JM, JM in ipairs(e:GetChildren()) do
							if JM ~= GM and aM(JM) and JM.AssemblyRootPart ~= R then
								TM = TM + 1
								XM[TM] = JM
							end
						end
						for R = #XM, TM + 1, -1.0 do
							XM[R] = nil
						end
					end
					for R = 1, #XM do
						local TM = XM[R]
						if TM.Parent == e then
							local R = TM.AssemblyLinearVelocity
							if R.Magnitude > fM then
								TM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = R.Unit * fM
							end
							if TM.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 30 then
								TM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = t
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local function R()
				if not (GM and GM.Parent) then
					return
				end
				local TM = GM.Position
				if TM.Y > -5000.0 then
					AM = TM
				end
			end
			local function TM(fM)
				if not (v and GM and v.Parent and GM.Parent and v.Health > 0) then
					return
				end
				local JM, XM, tM = UM()
				if tM then
					return
				end
				local tM = GM.Position
				local RM = GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local MM = math.max(JM, XM, 260)
				if AM and os.clock() > FM then
					local JM = (tM - AM).Magnitude
					local XM = MM * math.max(fM, 0.016666666666666666) * 1.7 + 14
					if JM > XM and (RM.Magnitude > MM * 1.4 + 40 or tM.Y < -60.0) then
						pcall(function()
							GM.CFrame = CFrame.new(AM) * (GM.CFrame - GM.CFrame.Position)
							GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = t
							GM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = t
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function fM(JM)
				if not c() or x() then
					return false
				end
				if not (v and GM and v.Parent and GM.Parent and v.Health > 0) then
					return false
				end
				local v, XM, tM = UM()
				if tM then
					return false
				end
				local tM = GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local RM = GM.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
				local UM = math.max(v, XM, 260)
				if tM.Magnitude <= UM * 1.4 + 40 and RM <= 250 then
					return false
				end
				pcall(function()
					if AM and os.clock() > FM then
						local v = (GM.Position - AM).Magnitude
						if v > UM * math.max(JM or 0, 0.016666666666666666) * 1.7 + 3 then
							GM.CFrame = CFrame.new(AM) * (GM.CFrame - GM.CFrame.Position)
						end
					end
					GM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = t
					GM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = t
				end)
				pcall(k, F)
				getgenv().__pulseAfReverts = (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseAfReverts) or 0) + 1
				return true
			end
			getgenv().__pulseAfRevert = function()
				return fM(0.016666666666666666)
			end
			A(function()
				getgenv().__pulseAfRevert = nil
			end)
			J(M.Stepped, function()
				if not c() then
					return
				end

					pcall(t)
				end
				if x() then

			J(M.Heartbeat, function(t)
				if not c() then
					AM = nil

				if x() then
					return
				end

			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local T = 0
				while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() and isAlive(f) do
					if c() then
						T = T + 1
						pcall(function()
							if not x() then
								k(F)
								if T % 10 == 0 then
									for F, F in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
										if F ~= w and F.Character then
											for T, T in ipairs(F.Character:GetDescendants()) do
												if aM(T) and T.CanCollide and not S(T) then
													T.CanCollide = false
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							if e and e.Parent then
								for F, F in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
									BM(F)
								end
							end
						end)
					end
					task.wait(0.5)
				end
			end)
		end
		local function F()
			local T = G.LocalPlayer

		local function T()

		local function f()

		local function t()

		local function R(c)
			if getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin then
				return false
			end
			if not c or not c.Parent then
				return false
			end
			if not c:IsA("BasePart") then
				return false

				return false
			end

		end
		local c = U:FindFirstChild("Remotes")

		end
		local U = c and c:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")

				U = c:WaitForChild("Gameplay", 20)
			end)

		local c = U and U:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
		local function c()
			if rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseRoleFarmHold") then
				return false
			end
			local x, S = pcall(getUpvalue(a))
			if not x or type(S) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			local x = S[w.Name]
			if not x then
				return false
			end
			if x.Dead == true then
				return false
			end
			if x.Killed == true then
				return false
			end
			if not x.Role then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
		local function x()
			local S, k = pcall(getUpvalue(a))
			if not S or type(k) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			local S = k[w.Name]
			if not S then
				return false
			end
			if S.Dead == true then
				return false
			end
			if S.Killed == true then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
		local function S()
			local k, e = pcall(getUpvalue(a))
			if not k or type(e) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			local k = e[w.Name]
			if not k or not k.Role then
				return false
			end
			return tostring(k.Role):lower():find("murder") ~= nil
		end
		local function k()
			H = nil
			local e, v = pcall(getUpvalue(a))
			if not e or type(v) ~= "table" then
				return
			end
			for e, GM in pairs(v) do
				if type(GM) == "table" and GM.Role then
					local v = tostring(GM.Role):lower()
					if v:find("murder") and GM.Dead ~= true then
						local v = G:FindFirstChild(e)
						if v and v ~= w then
							H = v
						end
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local function e()
			if not n or O then
				return
			end
			if tick() - g < 8 then
				return
			end
			local v = H
			if not v or not v.Parent or v == w then
				return
			end
			local GM = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseFlingPlayer")
			if type(GM) == "function" then
				O = true
				g = tick()
				local aM = E
				E = false
				pcall(GM, v)
				repeat
					task.wait(0.1)
				until rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseManualFling") ~= true
				E = aM
				O = false
				return
			end
			local GM = v.Character
			if not GM then
				return
			end
			local v = GM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local aM = GM:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local AM = GM:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not v or v.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			if v.Sit then
				return
			end
			local GM = aM or AM
			if not GM then
				return
			end
			local aM = F()
			local FM = f()
			local TM = T()
			if not aM or not FM or not TM then
				return
			end
			O = true
			y = false
			r = true
			Z = Z + 1
			local fM = E
			E = false
			local JM = b
			local XM = GM.Position
			task.spawn(function()
				local tM = TM.CFrame
				local RM = K.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
				local BM = K.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject
				local UM = true
				pcall(function()
					UM = FM:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated)
				end)
				local MM
				local cM = false
				local function KM()
					if cM then
						return
					end
					cM = true
					pcall(function()
						if MM then
							MM:Destroy()
						end
					end)
					pcall(function()
						K.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = RM
					end)
					pcall(function()
						K.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = BM
					end)
					pcall(function()
						FM:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, UM)
					end)
					E = fM
					r = false
					O = false
				end
				local fM, fM = pcall(function()
					pcall(function()
						K.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0
					end)
					pcall(function()
						K.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = AM or GM
					end)
					MM = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
					MM.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					MM.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
					MM:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
					MM.Parent = TM
					pcall(function()
						FM:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
					end)
					local function AM(fM, cM, wM)
						if not fM or not fM.Parent then
							return
						end
						if not aM.Parent or not TM.Parent then
							return
						end
						pcall(function()
							TM.CFrame = CFrame.new(fM.Position) * cM * wM
							aM:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(fM.Position) * cM * wM)
							TM.Velocity = Vector3.new(90000000, 900000000, 90000000)
							TM.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(900000000, 900000000, 900000000)
						end)
					end
					local fM = tick()
					local cM = 0
					while tick() - fM < 2 do
						if not n then
							break
						end
						if not W then
							break
						end
						if JM ~= b then
							break
						end
						if not GM.Parent then
							break
						end
						if v.Health <= 0 then
							break
						end
						if not TM.Parent or FM.Health <= 0 then
							break
						end
						local fM = (GM.Position - XM).Magnitude
						if fM > 80 then
							break
						end
						if GM.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
							cM = cM + 100
							AM(
								GM,
								CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + v.MoveDirection * GM.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25,
								CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cM), 0, 0)
							)
							task.wait()
							AM(
								GM,
								CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + v.MoveDirection * GM.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25,
								CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cM), 0, 0)
							)
							task.wait()
							AM(
								GM,
								CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + v.MoveDirection * GM.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25,
								CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cM), 0, 0)
							)

								v.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

								v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		local function AM(FM, fM, JM)
			local XM = Y(FM)
			local tM = (XM.hide - fM).Magnitude + math.max(0, FM.Position.Y - XM.hide.Y) * 1.2
			if XM.exposed then
				tM = tM + 25
			end
			if JM then
				local fM = (FM.Position - JM).Magnitude
				if fM < 24 then
					tM = tM + (I and 1000000 or 300)
				elseif fM < 48 then
					tM = tM + (48 - fM) * 2
				end
			end
			return tM
		end
		local function FM(fM, JM)

					for h, h in ipairs(BM:GetChildren()) do
						local BM = U.pending[h]
						if R(h) and (U.skip[h] or 0) < RM and not BM then
							local RM = AM(h, fM, JM)
							if not tM or RM < tM then
								XM, tM = h, RM
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			if XM and I and tM >= 1000000 then
				return nil
			end
			return XM, tM
		end

					pcall(function()

				RM.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
				RM.P = 30000

			local BM = tM - d.Position
			local tM = BM.Magnitude
			if tM < 0.05 then
				JM.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			else
				JM.Velocity = BM.Unit * math.min(L(), tM / math.max(RM, 0.016666666666666666))
			end
			local JM = Vector3.new(BM.X, 0, BM.Z)
			if XM and JM.Magnitude > 0.4 then
				XM.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(d.Position, d.Position + JM.Unit)
			end
			return tM

		local s = 0
		local function tM(RM)
			for BM, UM in pairs(U.pending) do
				if type(UM) == "table" then
					if not R(BM) then
						U.pending[BM] = nil
						U.gapT = math.min(6, U.gapT + 0.08)
						U.ok = (U.ok or 0) + 1
					elseif RM > UM.t then
						U.pending[BM] = nil
						U.gapT = math.max(1, U.gapT - 0.25)
						U.miss = (U.miss or 0) + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

			local UM = os.clock()
			if W and V and t() and not O and not y and U.phase ~= "idle" then
				U.cfLost = U.cfLost or UM
				if UM - U.cfLost < 1.5 then
					local MM, cM = T(), f()
					if MM and cM then
						local KM = h(MM, cM, false)
						KM.Velocity = Vector3.zero
					end
					return
				end
			else
				U.cfLost = nil
			end
			if not (W and V and y and t()) or O then
				if U.phase ~= "idle" then
					fM()
				end
				return
			end
			tM(UM)
			local tM, UM, MM = F(), T(), f()
			if not (tM and UM and MM) then
				return
			end
			if getgenv().__pulseManualFling or getgenv().__pulseTouchFlinging then
				if U.phase ~= "idle" then
					fM()
				end
				return
			end
			r = true
			local cM = os.clock()
			local KM = Z()
			local wM = U.gunTarget
			if wM and not (wM.Parent and p) then
				U.gunTarget, wM = nil, nil
			end
			local LM = KM and not wM and m and K() and TM() ~= nil
			local WM, VM = h(UM, MM, LM)
			if KM and not wM then
				U.phase = "full"
				U.coin = nil
				if not U.hold or (U.hold - UM.Position).Magnitude > 60 then
					U.hold = JM(UM)
				end
				i(UM, WM, VM, U.hold, BM)
				return
			end
			U.hold = nil
			local h = TM()
			local TM = wM
			if not TM then
				local MM = U.coin
				if MM and not R(MM) then
					if U.phase == "rise" and U.riseFrom then
						U.learn[#U.learn + 1] = MM.Position.Y - UM.Position.Y
						if #U.learn > 60 then
							table.remove(U.learn, 1)
						end
					end
					U.got += 1
					MM = nil
					U.coin = nil
					U.phase = "go"
				end
				if not MM or U.phase == "go" and cM - (U.pickT or 0) > 0.3 then
					U.pickT = cM
					local KM, LM = FM(UM.Position, h)
					if KM and KM ~= MM then
						if not MM or not R(MM) or LM + 6 < AM(MM, UM.Position, h) then
							MM = KM
							U.coin = KM
							U.phase = "go"
							U.goT = cM
							U.tries += 1
						end
					end
				end
				TM = MM
			end
			if not TM then
				local R = JM(UM)
				i(UM, WM, VM, R, BM)
				U.phase = "wait"
				return
			end
			local R = Y(TM)
			if U.phase ~= "rise" then
				if U.phase ~= "go" then
					U.phase, U.goT = "go", cM
				end
				local Y = i(UM, WM, VM, R.hide, BM)
				if Y < 0.7 then
					U.phase = "rise"
					U.riseFrom = cM
					U.dwellFrom = nil
				elseif cM - (U.goT or cM) > Y / math.max(L(), 1) + 4 then
					l[TM] = true
					task.delay(30, function()
						l[TM] = nil
					end)
					U.coin, U.gunTarget = nil, nil
					U.fails += 1
					U.phase = "go"
				end
				return
			end
			if h and TM ~= wM then
				local L = Vector3.new(TM.Position.X - h.X, 0, TM.Position.Z - h.Z).Magnitude
				if L < 12 then
					U.skip[TM] = cM + 3
					U.coin = nil
					U.phase = "go"
					return
				end
			end
			local L = U.att[TM] or 0
			local h = math.max(0.6, U.gapT - 0.45 * L)
			local Y = Vector3.new(R.hide.X, math.max(TM.Position.Y - h, R.hide.Y), R.hide.Z)
			local R = i(UM, WM, VM, Y, BM)
			if cM - s >= 0.03333333333333333 then
				s = cM
				v(tM, TM)
			end
			if R < 0.3 then
				U.dwellFrom = U.dwellFrom or cM
				if cM - U.dwellFrom >= 0.1 + (TM == wM and 0.25 or 0) then
					U.att[TM] = L + 1
					if L + 1 >= 4 then
						l[TM] = true
						task.delay(30, function()
							l[TM] = nil
						end)
						U.fails += 1
					else
						U.pending[TM] = { t = cM + 0.9, gap = h }
					end
					if TM == wM then
						U.gunTarget = nil
					end
					U.coin, U.dwellFrom = nil, nil
					U.phase = "go"
					return
				end
			end
			if cM - (U.riseFrom or cM) > 1.4 then
				l[TM] = true
				task.delay(30, function()
					l[TM] = nil
				end)
				if TM == wM then
					U.gunTarget = nil
				end
				U.coin = nil
				U.fails += 1
				U.phase = "go"
			end
		end
		J(M.Heartbeat, function(J)
			if not getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT or not B() then
				return
			end
			local R, M = pcall(RM, J)
			if not R then
				U.err = tostring(M)
				pcall(fM)
			end
		end)
		A(function()
			pcall(fM)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				task.wait(0.15)
				pcall(function()
					if not (W and p and V and t()) then
						U.gunTarget, U.gunSince = nil, nil
						return
					end
					local A = XM()
					if not A or K() or not d() then
						U.gunTarget, U.gunSince = nil, nil
						return
					end
					if U.gunSeen ~= A then
						U.gunSeen, U.gunSince = A, os.clock()
					end
					v(F(), A)
					if os.clock() - U.gunSince > 0.8 and U.gunTarget ~= A then
						U.gunTarget = A
						U.info[A] = nil
						U.phase = "go"
						U.goT = os.clock()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		local function A()
			local F = f()
			if F and F.Health > 0 then
				r = false
				y = false
				F.Health = 0
				N = tick()
				table.clear(P)
			end
		end
		local function F()
			local J = w.Character
			return J and J:FindFirstChild("Knife")
		end
		local function J()
			local R = w:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
			if R then
				local M = R:FindFirstChild("Knife")
				if M and M:IsA("Tool") and w.Character then
					M.Parent = w.Character
					return true
				end
			end
			return F() ~= nil
		end
		local function R()
			local M = w.Character
			local L = M and M:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local s = M and M:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not L or not s or s.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			if not F() and not J() then
				return
			end
			local J = L.Position
			for J, J in ipairs(G:GetPlayers()) do
				if J ~= w and J.Character then
					local G = J.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
					local M = J.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if G and G.Health > 0 and M then
						local G = F()
						local F = G and (G:FindFirstChild("Handle") or G:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
						if G and F and firetouchinterest then
							for M, M in ipairs({
								"HumanoidRootPart",
								"UpperTorso",
								"Torso",
								"LowerTorso",
								"Head",
							}) do
								local w = J.Character:FindFirstChild(M)
								if w then
									pcall(function()
										firetouchinterest(F, w, 0)
										firetouchinterest(F, w, 1)
										firetouchinterest(w, F, 0)
										firetouchinterest(w, F, 1)
									end)
								end
							end
							pcall(function()
								G:Activate()
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				pcall(function()
					if V and t() then
						D = S()
					else
						D = false
					end
					if W and t() then
						y = c()
						if y then
							V = true
						end
					else
						y = false
					end
					if y then
						o = 0
					elseif o == 0 then
						o = tick()
					end
					if W and V and t() and (I or n) then
						k()
					else
						H = nil
					end
				end)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				task.wait(1)
				pcall(function()
					if not W then
						return
					end
					if not V then
						return
					end
					if not t() then
						return
					end
					if D then
						return
					end
					if y then
						return
					end
					if x() then
						return
					end
					if o == 0 or tick() - o < 4 then
						return
					end
					if not n then
						return
					end
					if O then
						return
					end
					if tick() - g < 8 then
						return
					end
					k()
					local G = H
					if not G then
						return
					end
					local F = G.Character
					local G = F and F:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local J = F and F:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not J or not G or G.Health <= 0 then
						return
					end
					e()
				end)
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				task.wait(1)
				pcall(function()
					local G = T()
					local F = f()
					if G and F and not r and not O then
						local T = G:FindFirstChild("PulseFarmBV")
						local f = G:FindFirstChild("PulseFarmBG")
						if T or f or F.PlatformStand then
							if T then
								pcall(function()
									T:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							if f then
								pcall(function()
									f:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							pcall(function()
								F.PlatformStand = false
								G.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
								G.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

								end

						end
					end
				end)

		task.spawn(function()
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				task.wait(0.05)
				pcall(function()
					if not W or not t() or not Z() then
						return
					end

							U.shootT = os.clock()

						task.wait(0.4)

							A()
						end

		task.spawn(function()
			local G = {}
			while getgenv().PULSE_FARM_MM2_HEARTBEAT and B() do
				table.insert(G, { tick(), _ })
				while #G > 1 and tick() - G[1][1] > 30 do
					table.remove(G, 1)
				end
				if #G >= 2 then
					local a, A = G[1], G[#G]
					local G = A[1] - a[1]
					if G > 0 then
						u = math.max(0, math.floor((A[2] - a[2]) / G * 60 + 0.5))
					end
				end
				task.wait(2)
			end
		end)
		local G = false
		local function a(A)
			W = A
			local F = getgenv().__pulseAntiCoinInfo
			if A and getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin and F and type(F.set) == "function" then
				G = true
				pcall(F.set, false)
			elseif not A and G then
				G = false
				if F and type(F.set) == "function" then
					pcall(F.set, true)
				end
			end
			if A then
				C = true
				r = false
				O = false
				b = b + 1
				g = 0
				if V and n then
					task.spawn(function()
						task.wait(0.2)
						GM()
					end)
				end
			else
				r = false
			end
		end
		local farmAPI = {
			setEnabled = function(G)
				a(G)
			end,
			getEnabled = function()
				return W
			end,
			setRespawn = function(G)
				Q = G
				j()
			end,
			getRespawn = function()
				return Q
			end,
			setAntiFling = function(G)
				E = G
				j()
			end,
			getAntiFling = function()
				return E
			end,
			setAvoid = function(G)
				I = G
				if not G then
					H = nil
				end
				j()
			end,
			getAvoid = function()
				return I
			end,
			setAutoFling = function(G)
				n = G
				j()
			end,
			getAutoFling = function()
				return n
			end,
			setKillAura = function(G)
				z = G
				j()
			end,
			getKillAura = function()
				return z
			end,
			setPickGun = function(G)
				p = G == true
				j()
			end,
			getPickGun = function()
				return p
			end,
			setShootFull = function(G)
				m = G == true
				j()
			end,
			getShootFull = function()
				return m
			end,
			getSession = function()
				return _
			end,
			getTotal = function()
				return q
			end,
			getRate = function()
				return u
			end,
			getStatus = function()
				if not V then
					return "waiting"
				elseif y and Z() then
					return "full"
				elseif y then
					return "farming"
				else
					return "spectating"
				end
			end,
		}
		setUpvalue(X, farmAPI)
		getgenv().__pulseFarmAPI = farmAPI
	end
end

			end

			local J = #T
			local X = T:sub(-2.0) == "==" and 2 or (T:sub(-1.0) == "=" and 1 or 0)

			local X = buffer.create(math.max(t, 0))

					T.SoundId = f.id
				end
				T.Volume = f.vol
				T:SetAttribute("PulseOrigSound", nil)
				T:SetAttribute("PulseOrigVol", nil)
				return
			end
			T:SetAttribute("PulseOrigSound", f.id)
			T:SetAttribute("PulseOrigVol", f.vol)
			if J == "Off" then
				T.Volume = 0
				return
			end
			local X = G.find(G.LIBOF[f.kind], J)
			if X then
				if T.SoundId ~= X[2] then
					T.SoundId = X[2]
				end
				T.Volume = f.vol * G.cfg.vol / 100
			end
		end
		G.track = function(T)
			if not T:IsA("Sound") then
				return
			end
			if G.orig[T] then
				G.set(T)
				return
			end
			local f = T:GetAttribute("PulseOrigSound") or T.SoundId
			local J = G.KIND[G.idOf(f) or ""]
			if not J then
				return
			end
			G.orig[T] = { id = f, vol = tonumber(T:GetAttribute("PulseOrigVol")) or T.Volume, kind = J }
			G.conns[#G.conns + 1] = T.Played:Connect(function()
				local f = G.orig[T]
				local J = f and G.find(G.LIBOF[f.kind], G.cfg[f.kind])
				if J and J[3] then
					G.cap(T, J[3])
				end
			end)
			G.set(T)
		end
		G.refresh = function()
			for T in pairs(G.orig) do
				if T.Parent then
					pcall(G.set, T)
				else
					G.orig[T] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		G.END_LIFE = 10
		G.END_VOL = 0.4
		G.playOwn = function(T, f)
			if G.own then
				pcall(function()
					G.own:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			local J = game:GetService("SoundService")
			local X = Instance.new("Sound")
			X.Name = "PulseEndMusic"
			X.SoundId = G.asset(T)
			X.Volume = G.END_VOL * G.cfg.vol / 100
			X.Looped = false
			X.PlayOnRemove = false
			if not f then
				X.SoundGroup = J:FindFirstChild("Music")
				Instance.new("NumberValue", X).Value = X.Volume
			end
			X.Parent = J
			G.own = X
			X.Ended:Once(function()
				pcall(function()
					X:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
			X:Play()
			task.delay(G.END_LIFE, function()
				pcall(function()
					X:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
			return X
		end
		G.playEnd = function(T)
			if not G.won then
				return
			end
			local f = G.cfg.win
			if f == "Game" or f == nil then
				return
			end
			local J = G.find("finish", f)
			if f ~= "Off" and not J then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				T.Volume = 0
				T:Stop()
			end)
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(function()
					T:Stop()
				end)
			end)
			if J then
				G.playOwn(J[2], false)
			end
		end
		G.preview = function(T, f)
			if f == "Off" then
				return
			end
			local J = G.find(G.LIBOF[T], f)
			if T == "win" then
				if J then
					G.playOwn(J[2], true)
				else
					G.playOwn("rbxassetid://13934589675", true)
				end
				return
			end
			local f = J and J[2] or T == "roll" and "rbxassetid://179235828" or "rbxassetid://179287602"
			local T = Instance.new("Sound")
			T.SoundId = f
			T.Volume = 0.5 * G.cfg.vol / 100
			T.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
			T:Play()
			task.delay(J and J[3] or 6, function()
				pcall(function()
					G.TS:Create(T, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
				end)
				task.wait(0.55)
				pcall(function()
					T:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local T = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
			local f = T:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 30)
			if not f or not getUpvalue(F)() then
				return
			end
			for T, T in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
				if T:IsA("Sound") then
					pcall(G.track, T)
				end
			end
			G.conns[#G.conns + 1] = f.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(T)
				if T:IsA("Sound") then
					task.defer(function()
						pcall(G.track, T)
					end)
				end
			end)
			G.conns[#G.conns + 1] = f.ChildAdded:Connect(function(T)
				if not T:IsA("Sound") then
					return
				end
				local f = os.clock() - G.wonAt < 2 and T.SoundGroup ~= nil and T.SoundGroup.Name == "Music"
				if not (f or G.END_IDS[G.idOf(T.SoundId) or ""]) then
					return
				end
				G.endSound, G.endAt = T, os.clock()
				if os.clock() - G.wonAt < 3 then
					G.endPending = false
					pcall(G.playEnd, T, false)
				else
					G.endPending = true
				end
			end)
			local T = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes", 30)
			T = T and T:WaitForChild("Gameplay", 30)
			local f = T and T:WaitForChild("VictoryScreen", 30)
			if not f or not getUpvalue(F)() then
				return
			end
			G.conns[#G.conns + 1] = f.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(F, F, T)
				local f = G.WIN[tostring(F)]
				G.won = f ~= nil and f[tostring(T)] == true
				G.wonAt = os.clock()
				local F = G.endSound
				if G.endPending and F and F.Parent and os.clock() - G.endAt < 1.5 then
					G.endPending = false
					pcall(G.playEnd, F, true)
				end
			end)
		end)
		a(function()
			for a, a in ipairs(G.conns) do
				pcall(function()
					a:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
			G.cfg.roll, G.cfg.reveal = "Game", "Game"
			G.refresh()
			if G.own then
				pcall(function()
					G.own:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			getgenv().__pulseGameSoundsUI = nil
		end)
		pcall(function()

				["Game Sounds"] = {
					ru = "Звуки игры",
					uk = "Звуки гри",
				},
				["Role Roll Sound"] = {
					ru = "Звук рулетки ролей",

				end

				end

		end)

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - NoClip (Collision Bypass)
-- KEY: N
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["N"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f = G[2], G[1], G[0], G[4], G[3]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("RunService")
		local J = {}
		local X, t, R, B = nil, {}, nil, false
		F(G.Stepped, function()
			if A.noclip and A.noclip.on then
				local G = f.Character
				if G then
					if G ~= X or B then
						if G ~= X then
							X = G
							if R then
								for f, f in ipairs(R) do
									pcall(function()
										f:Disconnect()
									end)
								end
							end
							R = {
								F(G.DescendantAdded, function()
									B = true
								end),
								F(G.DescendantRemoving, function()
									B = true
								end),
							}
						end
						B = false
						t = {}
						for F, F in ipairs(G:GetDescendants()) do
							if F:IsA("BasePart") then
								t[#t + 1] = F
							end
						end
					end
					for G = 1, #t do
						local F = t[G]
						if F.CanCollide then
							if J[F] == nil then
								J[F] = true
							end
							F.CanCollide = false
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local function G()
			for F, f in pairs(J) do
				if F and F.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						F.CanCollide = f
					end)
				end
				J[F] = nil
			end
		end
		local F = a:ToggleKey({
			Text = "No Clip",
			Default = T.noclip.on,
			Bind = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(A.noclip.key or ""),
			Callback = function(a)
				A.noclip.on = a == true
				if not a then
					G()
				end
			end,
			OnBind = function(a)
				A.noclip.key = a and a.Name or ""
			end,
		})
		getgenv().__pulseSetNoclip = function(a)
			a = a == true
			if F and F.Set then
				pcall(F.Set, a)
			else
				A.noclip.on = a
				if not a then
					G()
				end
			end
		end
		getgenv().__pulseGetNoclip = function()
			return A.noclip and A.noclip.on == true
		end
	end
end

					{ tex = "bolt", w = 3.4, spd = 5, br = 4, a = 1, mix = 0.3, wrap = 9 },
					{ tex = "core", w = 0.8, spd = 4, br = 3, a = 1, mix = 0.8 },

				Plasma = {

				Fire = {

					{ tex = "dust", w = 3.2, spd = 3, br = 3.5, a = 1, mix = 0.3, wrap = 5 },
					{ tex = "core", w = 0.8, spd = 3, br = 3, a = 1, mix = 0.75 },

			local K = {
				"Energy",
				"Laser",
				"Lightning",
				"Plasma",
				"Fire",
				"Smoke",
				"Stardust",
			}
			local function w(L)
				G.log[#G.log + 1] = string.format("%.2f %s", os.clock(), L)
				if #G.log > 30 then
					table.remove(G.log, 1)
				end
			end
			local function L()
				local W = X.ui and tonumber(X.ui.stretch) or 0
				if W <= 0 then
					return 0
				end
				return -math.log(math.max(0.1, 1 - W / 100 * 0.6), 2)
			end
			local function W()
				local V = X.ui and tonumber(X.ui.stretch) or 0
				if V <= 0 then
					return 1
				end
				return 1 / math.max(0.3, 1 - V / 100 * 0.6)
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local X = {}
				for V, V in pairs(M) do
					local r = Instance.new("Decal")
					r.Texture = V
					X[#X + 1] = r
				end
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(X)
				end)
				for V, V in ipairs(X) do
					pcall(function()
						V:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end)
			local function X()
				local V = table.remove(G.pool)
				if V and V.b.Parent and V.a0.Parent and V.a1.Parent then
					return V
				end
				local r = Instance.new("Attachment")
				r.Name = "PulseTracerA"
				r.Parent = U
				local _ = Instance.new("Attachment")
				_.Name = "PulseTracerB"
				_.Parent = U
				local q = Instance.new("Beam")
				q.Name = "PulseTracer"
				q.Attachment0, q.Attachment1 = r, _
				q.FaceCamera = true
				q.LightEmission, q.LightInfluence = 1, 0
				q.Enabled = false
				q.Parent = U
				V = { a0 = r, a1 = _, b = q }
				G.made[#G.made + 1] = V
				return V
			end
			local function V(r)
				r.b.Enabled = false
				if #G.pool < 160 then
					G.pool[#G.pool + 1] = r
				else
					pcall(function()
						r.b:Destroy()
						r.a0:Destroy()
						r.a1:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			local r = RaycastParams.new()
			r.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			pcall(function()
				r.RespectCanCollide = true
			end)
			local _ = -10.0
			local function q()
				if os.clock() - _ > 1 then
					_ = os.clock()
					local _ = {}
					for u, u in ipairs(R:GetPlayers()) do
						if u.Character then
							_[#_ + 1] = u.Character
						end
					end
					local u = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if u then
						_[#_ + 1] = u
					end
					r.FilterDescendantsInstances = _
				end
				return r
			end
			local function r(_, u)
				local s = u - _
				local h = s.Magnitude
				if h < 0.05 then
					return nil
				end
				local Y = s / h
				local s = _
				for _ = 1, 5 do
					local _ = workspace:Raycast(s, u - s, q())
					if not _ then
						return nil
					end
					local h = _.Instance
					local l = 0
					pcall(function()
						l = h.Transparency
					end)
					if l < 0.85 then
						return _
					end
					s = _.Position + Y * 0.05
					if (u - s):Dot(Y) <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function _(u)
				if #u <= 2 then
					return u
				end
				local s = { u[1] }
				local h = 1
				while h < #u do
					local Y = #u
					while Y > h + 1 and r(u[h], u[Y]) do
						Y -= 1
					end
					s[#s + 1] = u[Y]
					h = Y
				end
				return s
			end
			local function u(s)
				if #s <= 2 then
					return s
				end
				local h = { s[1] }
				local Y = 0
				for l = 1, #s - 1 do
					Y += (s[l + 1] - s[l]).Magnitude
				end
				local l = math.max(2.2, Y / 44)
				for Y = 1, #s - 1 do
					local x = s[math.max(1, Y - 1)]
					local S, k = s[Y], s[Y + 1]
					local y = s[math.min(#s, Y + 2)]
					local Y = math.clamp(math.floor((k - S).Magnitude / l + 0.5), 2, 16)
					for l = 1, Y do
						local Q = l / Y
						local Y, l = Q * Q, Q * Q * Q
						h[#h + 1] = 0.5
							* (2 * S + (k - x) * Q + (2 * x - 5 * S + 4 * k - y) * Y + (3 * S - x - 3 * k + y) * l)
					end
				end
				h[#h] = s[#s]
				return h
			end
			local s = { 3, 6, 10, 15, 22, 32 }
			local h = { 0.5, 0.35, 0.65, 0.2, 0.8 }
			local function Y(l, x)
				if not r(l, x) then
					return { l, x }, "direct"
				end
				local S = x - l
				local k = S.Unit
				local y = k:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
				y = y.Magnitude < 0.1 and Vector3.xAxis or y.Unit
				local Q = y:Cross(k).Unit
				local E = { Q, y, -y, (Q + y).Unit, (Q - y).Unit, -Q }
				local y, Q
				for I, I in ipairs(s) do
					for C, C in ipairs(h) do
						local h = l + S * C
						for S, S in ipairs(E) do
							local C = h + S * I
							local h = (C - l).Magnitude + (x - C).Magnitude
							if (not Q or h < Q) and not r(l, C) and not r(C, x) then
								y, Q = C, h
							end
						end
					end
					if y then
						return { l, y, x }, "one"
					end
				end
				local h, S = r(l, x), r(x, l)
				if h and S then
					local y, I = {}, {}
					for C, C in ipairs(s) do
						for s, s in ipairs(E) do
							local E = h.Position - k * 1.5 + s * C
							if not r(l, E) then
								y[#y + 1] = E
							end
							local h = S.Position + k * 1.5 + s * C
							if not r(h, x) then
								I[#I + 1] = h
							end
						end
					end
					local s = 0
					local h
					for S, S in ipairs(y) do
						for k, k in ipairs(I) do
							local y = (S - l).Magnitude + (k - S).Magnitude + (x - k).Magnitude
							if not Q or y < Q then
								s += 1
								if s > 500 then
									break
								end
								if not r(S, k) then
									h, Q = { S, k }, y
								end
							end
						end
						if s > 500 then
							break
						end
					end
					if h then
						return { l, h[1], h[2], x }, "two"
					end
				end
				return nil, "none"
			end
			local function r(s, h)
				local l, x = pcall(function()
					local S = B:CreatePath({
						AgentRadius = 1.5,
						AgentHeight = 5,
						AgentCanJump = true,
						AgentCanClimb = true,
						WaypointSpacing = 6,
					})
					S:ComputeAsync(s - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), h - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
					if S.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
						return nil
					end
					local B = { s }
					for k, k in ipairs(S:GetWaypoints()) do
						B[#B + 1] = k.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
					end
					B[#B + 1] = h
					return B
				end)
				if not l or type(x) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local B = 0
				for l = 1, #x - 1 do
					B += (x[l + 1] - x[l]).Magnitude
				end
				if B > (h - s).Magnitude * 4 + 40 then
					return nil
				end
				return x
			end
			local function B(s, h)
				local l = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				l.Rate = 0
				l.LightEmission, l.LightInfluence = 1, 0
				l.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
				l.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0)
				l.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
				for x, S in pairs(h) do
					pcall(function()
						l[x] = S
					end)
				end
				local h = L()
				if h > 0 then
					pcall(function()
						l.Squash = NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(h, -3.0, 3))
					end)
					l.Rotation, l.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0), NumberRange.new(0)
				end
				l.Parent = s
				return l
			end
			local function L(s)
				local h = Instance.new("Attachment")
				h.Name = "PulseTracerFx"
				h.WorldPosition = s
				h.Parent = U
				return h
			end
			local function U(s, h, l, l, x)
				local S = Instance.new("PointLight")
				S.Color, S.Range, S.Brightness, S.Shadows = h, l, 3.5, false
				S.Parent = s
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("TweenService")
						:Create(
							S,
							TweenInfo.new(x, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
							{ Brightness = 0 }
						)
						:Play()
				end)
			end
			local function s(h, l)
				local x = L(h)
				local h = ColorSequence.new(l:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.55), l)
				B(x, {
					Texture = M.star,

				B(x, {

					Color = h,
					Size = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1.8),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.4),
					}),
					Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					}),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.14),
					Brightness = 3,
				}):Emit(1)
				U(x, l, 2, 9, 0.12)
				task.delay(0.5, function()
					pcall(function()
						x:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
			local function h(l, x)
				local S = L(l)
				local l = ColorSequence.new(x:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.6), x)
				B(S, {
					Texture = M.star,

				B(S, {

					Size = NumberSequence.new({

				B(S, {

					Size = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 2.6),
