				U(S, x, 3, 12, 0.3)
				task.delay(1.2, function()
					pcall(function()
						S:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
			local function U(l)
				l = l or {}
				local x = G.rainbow
				if l.rainbow ~= nil then
					x = l.rainbow
				end
				if x then
					local x = os.clock() * 0.18 % 1
					return Color3.fromHSV(x, 0.7, 1), Color3.fromHSV((x + 0.18) % 1, 0.75, 1)
				end
				return l.col or G.col, l.col2 or G.col2
			end
			local function l(x, S)
				S = S or {}
				if #x < 2 then
					return
				end
				while #G.live >= 8 do
					local k = table.remove(G.live, 1)
					for y, y in ipairs(k.rows) do
						for Q, Q in ipairs(y) do
							V(Q)
						end
					end
					if k.head then
						pcall(function()
							k.head:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
				local k = { 0 }
				for y = 2, #x do
					k[y] = k[y - 1] + (x[y] - x[y - 1]).Magnitude
				end
				local y = k[#k]
				if y < 0.5 then
					return
				end
				local Q = c[S.style or G.style] or c.Energy
				local E, I = U(S)
				local U = (S.width or G.width or 100) / 100 * W()
				local W = {}
				for C, H in ipairs(Q) do
					local n = {}
					for O = 1, #x - 1 do
						local N = X()
						local X = N.b
						X.Texture = M[H.tex]
						if H.wrap then
							X.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
							X.TextureLength = H.wrap * U
						else
							X.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
							X.TextureLength = 1
						end
						X.TextureSpeed = H.spd
						X.Brightness = H.br
						X.Segments = #x == 2 and 24 or 4
						X.ZOffset = C * 0.05
						N.a0.WorldPosition = x[O]
						N.a1.WorldPosition = x[O + 1]
						X.Enabled = false
						n[O] = N
					end
					W[C] = n
				end
				local X = {
					pts = x,
					cum = k,
					L = y,
					t0 = os.clock(),
					rows = W,
					style = Q,
					col = E,
					col2 = I,
					wk = U,
					speed = math.max(40, S.speed or G.speed or 520),
					life = math.max(0.2, S.life or G.life or 1.2),
					impact = S.impact,
					landed = false,
				}
				X.tail = S.tail or math.clamp(y * 0.45, 8, 60)
				X.clearHead = S.clearHead
				if S.muzzle then
					pcall(s, x[1], E)
				end
				local W = L(x[1])
				B(W, {
					Texture = M.dot,
					Color = ColorSequence.new(E:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)),
					Size = NumberSequence.new(2.8 * U),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(y / X.speed + 0.05),
					LockedToPart = true,
					Brightness = 5,
					ZOffset = 1,
				}):Emit(1)
				B(W, {
					Texture = M.star,
					Color = ColorSequence.new(E:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)),
					Size = NumberSequence.new(3.4 * U),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(y / X.speed + 0.05),
					LockedToPart = true,
					Brightness = 4,
					ZOffset = 1.1,
				}):Emit(1)
				X.trail = B(W, {
					Texture = M.dot,
					Color = ColorSequence.new(E:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3), I),
					Size = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.32 * U),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
					}),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 5),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
					Drag = 4,
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.42),
					Rate = 70,
					Brightness = 3,
				})
				X.head = W
				G.live[#G.live + 1] = X
				if S.cb then
					task.spawn(S.cb, X)
				end
				return X
			end
			local function X(B, U)
				local M, L = B.cum, B.pts
				if U <= 0 then
					return L[1], 1
				end
				if U >= B.L then
					return L[#L], #L - 1
				end
				local B, W = 1, #M
				while W - B > 1 do
					local s = (B + W) // 2
					if M[s] <= U then
						B = s
					else
						W = s
					end
				end
				local W = M[B + 1] - M[B]
				local s = W > 0 and (U - M[B]) / W or 0
				return L[B]:Lerp(L[B + 1], s), B
			end
			local B = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local function U()
				local M = G.live
				if #M == 0 then
					return
				end
				local L = os.clock()
				local W = 1
				while W <= #M do
					local s = M[W]
					local x = L - s.t0
					local L, S = s.L, s.speed
					local k = math.min(L, x * S)
					local y = x * S - s.tail
					local Q = L / S
					if not s.landed and k >= L then
						s.landed = true
						if s.trail then
							s.trail.Rate = 0
						end
						if s.clearHead and s.head then
							for S, S in ipairs(s.head:GetChildren()) do
								if S:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and S ~= s.trail then
									pcall(function()
										S:Clear()
									end)
								end
							end
						end
						if s.impact then
							pcall(h, s.pts[#s.pts], s.col)
						end
					end
					local S = 0.38
					if x > Q then
						S = 0.38 * math.clamp(1 - (x - Q) / s.life, 0, 1) ^ 1.5
					end
					local E = x > Q + s.life and y >= L
					if E then
						for x, x in ipairs(s.rows) do
							for Q, Q in ipairs(x) do
								V(Q)
							end
						end
						pcall(function()
							s.head:Destroy()
						end)
						table.remove(M, W)
					else
						local M = X(s, k)
						s.head.WorldPosition = M
						local V = math.max(k - y, 0.01)
						local function x(Q)
							local E = 0
							if Q >= y and Q <= k + 0.001 then
								E = ((Q - y) / V) ^ 1.4
							end
							return math.max(E, S)
						end
						local V = #s.pts == 2
						for Q, E in ipairs(s.rows) do
							local I = s.style[Q]
							local Q = I.a
							for C, H in ipairs(E) do
								local E, n = s.cum[C], s.cum[C + 1]
								if E >= k or S <= 0.004 and n <= y then
									if H.b.Enabled then
										H.b.Enabled = false
									end
								else
									local S = math.min(n, k)
									if n > k then
										H.a1.WorldPosition = M
									else
										H.a1.WorldPosition = s.pts[C + 1]
									end
									local M = {}
									local k = V and 9 or 2
									for V = 0, k - 1 do
										local y = V / (k - 1)
										local V = E + (S - E) * y
										M[#M + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(y, math.clamp(1 - x(V) * Q, 0, 1))
									end
									local V = H.b
									V.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(M)
									local M = 0.9 * I.w * s.wk * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.max(x(E), 0))
									local k = 0.9 * I.w * s.wk * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.max(x(S), 0))
									V.Width0, V.Width1 = M, k
									local M = s.col2:Lerp(s.col, E / L):Lerp(B, I.mix)
									local x = s.col2:Lerp(s.col, S / L):Lerp(B, I.mix)
									V.Color = ColorSequence.new(M, x)
									if not V.Enabled then
										V.Enabled = true
									end
								end
							end
						end
						W += 1
					end
				end
			end
			A(T.Heartbeat, function()
				pcall(U)
			end)
			local function B(U, M, L, W, V)
				V = V or {}
				local function s()
					return { impact = L, muzzle = W, speed = V.speed, life = V.life, cb = V.cb }
				end
				if (M - U).Magnitude > 700 then
					M = U + (M - U).Unit * 700
				end
				if G.method == "Path Finder" then
					local L = os.clock()
					local W, V = Y(U, M)
					if W then
						W = _(W)
						w(string.format("PF %s pts=%d %.1fms", V, #W, (os.clock() - L) * 1000))
						return l(u(W), s())
					end
					task.spawn(function()
						local L = os.clock()
						local W = r(U, M)
						if W then
							W = _(W)
							w(string.format("PF nav pts=%d %.1fms", #W, (os.clock() - L) * 1000))
							l(u(W), s())
						else
							w("PF fallback straight")
							l({ U, M }, s())
						end
					end)
					return
				end
				return l({ U, M }, s())
			end
			G.build = B
			G.find = Y
			local function U(M, L, W)
				local V = M and M:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local M = V and V:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
				if M then
					return M.WorldPosition
				end
				if typeof(L) == "Instance" and L:IsA("BasePart") then
					return L.Position
				end
				if typeof(W) == "Vector3" then
					return W
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function M(L, W, V, r)
				if not G.on or typeof(V) ~= "Vector3" then
					return
				end
				local r = typeof(L) == "Instance" and L or nil
				while r and not (r:IsA("Model") and r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
					r = r.Parent
				end
				local _ = r ~= nil and r == J.Character
				if not _ and not G.others then
					return
				end
				local u = U(r, L, W)
				if not u then
					return
				end
				w((_ and "ME " or "OTHER ") .. math.floor((V - u).Magnitude))
				B(u, V, G.impact, G.muzzle)
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local w = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
				local L = w and w:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
				local w = L and L:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
				if not (w and w:IsA("RemoteEvent")) or not getUpvalue(f)() then
					return
				end
				A(w.OnClientEvent, function(...)
					local w = { ... }
					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(M, table.unpack(w))
					end)
				end)
			end)
			local M = {
				on = false,
				style = "Energy",
				col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 90),
				col2 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 70),
				rainbow = false,
				width = 100,
				life = 1.2,
				impact = true,
				flash = true,
				others = false,
				live = {},
				log = {},
			}
			G.knife = M
			G.styles = K
			M.opts = function(w)
				local L = {
					style = M.style,
					col = M.col,
					col2 = M.col2,
					rainbow = M.rainbow,
					width = M.width,
					speed = 96,
					life = M.life,
					clearHead = true,
					tail = 40,
				}
				for W, V in pairs(w or {}) do
					L[W] = V
				end
				return L
			end
			local function w(L)
				M.log[#M.log + 1] = string.format("%.2f %s", os.clock(), L)
				if #M.log > 30 then
					table.remove(M.log, 1)
				end
			end
			local L = RaycastParams.new()
			L.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			pcall(function()
				L.RespectCanCollide = true
			end)
			local function W(V, r, _)
				local u = {}
				for s, s in ipairs(R:GetPlayers()) do
					if s.Character then
						u[#u + 1] = s.Character
					end
				end
				local s = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if s then
					u[#u + 1] = s
				end
				u[#u + 1] = _
				L.FilterDescendantsInstances = u
				local _, u = V, 600
				for V = 1, 6 do
					local V = workspace:Raycast(_, r * u, L)
					if not V then
						return nil
					end
					local L = 0
					pcall(function()
						L = V.Instance.Transparency
					end)
					if L < 0.85 then
						return V.Position
					end
					u -= (V.Position - _).Magnitude + 0.05
					_ = V.Position + r * 0.05
					if u <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function L(V)
				local r = V:FindFirstChild("HandleLink") or V:WaitForChild("HandleLink", 2)
				local V = r and r.Value
				if typeof(V) ~= "Instance" then
					return nil, nil
				end
				local r = V
				while r and not (r:IsA("Model") and r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
					r = r.Parent
				end
				if r then
					return R:GetPlayerFromCharacter(r), V
				end
				local r = V:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Backpack")
				local _ = r and r.Parent
				return _ and _:IsA("Player") and _ or nil, V
			end
			local function V(r, _)
				if r.kDone then
					return
				end
				r.kDone = true
				_ = math.clamp(_, 0.5, r.L)
				if _ < r.L - 1 then
					local u = r.kOrigin + r.kDir * _
					r.pts[#r.pts] = u
					r.cum[#r.cum] = _
					r.L = _
					r.impact = M.impact
					if r.landed and M.impact then
						pcall(h, u, r.col)
					end
				end
				w(string.format("END s=%.1f", _))
			end
			local function r()
				local _ = os.clock()
				for u = #M.live, 1, -1.0 do
					local s = M.live[u]
					local h = pcall(function()
						local Y = s.kBlade
						if Y and Y.Parent then
							local x = (Y.Position - s.kOrigin):Dot(s.kDir)
							if x > s.kLast then
								s.kLast = x
							end
						end
						local x = s.kObj.Parent ~= nil and (Y == nil or Y.Parent ~= nil)
						local Y = _ - s.t0
						if not x then
							V(s, math.max(s.kLast + 0.6, 0.5))
						elseif Y > 8 then
							V(s, Y * s.speed)
						elseif s.landed and s.L < 599 and Y > s.L / s.speed + 0.4 then
							s.pts[#s.pts] = s.kOrigin + s.kDir * 600
							s.cum[#s.cum] = 600
							s.L = 600
							s.landed = false
							s.impact = false
							if s.trail then
								s.trail.Rate = 70
							end
							w("EXTEND")
						end
					end)
					if not h or s.kDone then
						table.remove(M.live, u)
					end
				end
			end
			local function V(_)
				if not M.on then
					return
				end
				local u, s = L(_)
				local L = u == J
				if not L and not M.others then
					return
				end
				local u = _:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or _:WaitForChild("BladePosition", 2)
				local h = _:FindFirstChild("KnifeVisual") or _:WaitForChild("KnifeVisual", 0.5)
				local Y = h and h:GetAttribute("Direction")
				if typeof(Y) ~= "Vector3" then
					Y = _:GetAttribute("Direction")
				end
				if typeof(Y) ~= "Vector3" or Y.Magnitude < 0.01 then
					return
				end
				Y = Y.Unit
				local x = h and h:IsA("BasePart") and h or u and u:IsA("BasePart") and u or nil
				if not x then
					return
				end
				local h = os.clock()
				local S = x.Position
				local x = 0
				if typeof(s) == "Instance" and s:IsA("BasePart") then
					x = math.clamp((S - s.Position):Dot(Y), 0, 15)
				end
				local s = S - Y * x
				local S = W(s, Y, _)
				local W = l({ s, S or s + Y * 600 }, M.opts({ impact = S ~= nil and M.impact, muzzle = M.flash }))
				if not W then
					return
				end
				W.t0 = h - x / W.speed
				W.kObj, W.kBlade, W.kOrigin, W.kDir, W.kLast = _, u, s, Y, 0
				M.live[#M.live + 1] = W
				w(
					string.format(
						"%s d0=%.1f wall=%s",
						L and "ME" or "OTHER",
						x,
						S and math.floor((S - s).Magnitude) or "-"
					)
				)
			end
			A(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetInstanceAddedSignal("ThrowingKnife"), function(w)
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(V, w)
				end)
			end)
			A(T.Heartbeat, function()
				if #M.live > 0 then
					pcall(r)
				end
			end)
			local A = game:GetService("UserInputService")
			local w = game:GetService("StarterGui")
			local function L()
				local W = { guis = {}, core = {}, mouse = A.MouseIconEnabled }
				local V = {}
				local r = J:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
				if r then
					V[#V + 1] = r
				end
				if a and a ~= r then
					V[#V + 1] = a
				end
				for a, a in ipairs(V) do
					for V, V in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
						if V:IsA("LayerCollector") and V.Enabled then
							if pcall(function()
								V.Enabled = false
							end) then
								W.guis[#W.guis + 1] = V
							end
						end
					end
				end
				for a, a in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
					if a ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
						local V, r = pcall(function()
							return w:GetCoreGuiEnabled(a)
						end)
						if V then
							W.core[a] = r
						end
					end
				end
				pcall(function()
					w:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, false)
				end)
				local a, V = pcall(function()
					return w:GetCore("TopbarEnabled")
				end)
				if a and V ~= false then
					W.topbar = true
					pcall(function()
						w:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", false)
					end)
				end
				pcall(function()
					A.MouseIconEnabled = false
				end)
				W.glass, W.fx = {}, {}
				local a = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if a then
					for V, V in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
						if V:IsA("BasePart") and V.Name == "NovaGlass" then
							W.glass[#W.glass + 1] = { V, V.LocalTransparencyModifier }
							pcall(function()
								V.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				for a, a in ipairs(game:GetService("Lighting"):GetChildren()) do
					if
						(a:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") or a:IsA("BlurEffect"))
						and a.Enabled
						and (a.Name == "NovaDepth" or a.Name == "MenuBlur")
					then
						W.fx[#W.fx + 1] = a
						pcall(function()
							a.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
				return W
			end
			local function a(W)
				for V, V in ipairs(W.guis) do
					pcall(function()
						if V.Parent then
							V.Enabled = true
						end
					end)
				end
				for V, r in pairs(W.core) do
					pcall(function()
						w:SetCoreGuiEnabled(V, r)
					end)
				end
				if W.topbar then
					pcall(function()
						w:SetCore("TopbarEnabled", true)
					end)
				end
				pcall(function()
					A.MouseIconEnabled = W.mouse
				end)
				for A, A in ipairs(W.glass or {}) do
					pcall(function()
						A[1].LocalTransparencyModifier = A[2]
					end)
				end
				for A, A in ipairs(W.fx or {}) do
					pcall(function()
						if A.Parent then
							A.Enabled = true
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			local function A(w, W, V)
				local r, _
				for u, u in ipairs(R:GetPlayers()) do
					if u ~= J and u.Character then
						local R = u.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local s = u.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if R and s and s.Health > 0 then
							local u = (R.Position - w).Magnitude
							if u > 12 and u < 260 and (not _ or u < _) then
								r, _ = R.Position, u
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if r then
					return r
				end
				local R = V.CFrame.LookVector
				local V = Vector3.new(R.X, 0, R.Z)
				V = V.Magnitude > 0.1 and V.Unit or W.CFrame.LookVector
				local R = workspace:Raycast(w, V * 140 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), q())
				return R and R.Position or w + V * 140
			end
			G.preview = function(R, w)
				if G.previewing then
					return
				end
				local W = J.Character
				local V = W and W:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local r = W and W:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local _ = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if not (V and _) then
					return
				end
				G.previewing = true
				local q = w and w.from or U(W, nil, nil) or (V.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.4, 1.25, -3.45)).Position
				local U = typeof(R) == "Vector3" and R or A(q, V, _)
				local A = L()
				local R = { _.CameraType, _.CameraSubject }
				local L
				if w then
					local W = {}
					for V, u in pairs(w) do
						W[V] = u
					end
					W.cb = function(w)
						L = w
					end
					l({ q, U }, W)
				else
					B(q, U, true, true, {
						speed = 80,
						life = 1.8,
						cb = function(B)
							L = B
						end,
					})
				end
				local B = os.clock()
				while not L and os.clock() - B < 2 do
					task.wait()
				end
				local function B()
					pcall(function()
						T:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseTracerCam")
					end)
					pcall(function()
						_.CameraType = R[1] or Enum.CameraType.Custom
						_.CameraSubject = r and r.Parent and r or R[2]
					end)
					a(A)
					G.previewing = false
				end
				if not L then
					B()
					return
				end
				local a, A = _.CFrame.Position, q
				local R = (U - q).Magnitude > 0.1 and (U - q).Unit or Vector3.zAxis
				local U = L.pts[#L.pts]
				_.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				local w = pcall(function()
					T:BindToRenderStep("PulseTracerCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(W)
						if not G.previewing then
							return
						end
						local V = os.clock() - L.t0
						local r = math.min(L.L, V * L.speed)
						local q, u
						if r < L.L then
							local s = X(L, r)
							local h = X(L, math.min(L.L, r + 4))
							local X = h - s
							if X.Magnitude > 0.05 then
								R = X.Unit
							end
							local X = R:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
							X = X.Magnitude > 0.1 and X.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
							q = s - R * 5.5 + Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0) + X * 5
							u = s + R * 2.5
						else
							local X = V - L.L / L.speed
							local V = Vector3.new(-R.X, 0, -R.Z)
							V = V.Magnitude > 0.1 and V.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
							local R = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis, X * 0.7) * (V * 9)
							q = U + R + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
							u = U
						end
						local X = r < L.L
						a = a:Lerp(q, 1 - math.exp(-(W or 0.016) * (X and 14 or 6)))
						A = A:Lerp(u, 1 - math.exp(-(W or 0.016) * (X and 18 or 8)))
						_.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, A)
					end)
				end)
				if not w then
					B()
					return
				end
				local a = L.L / L.speed
				local A = os.clock()
				while os.clock() - A < math.min(a + 1.5, 9) and G.previewing and isAlive(f) do
					task.wait()
				end
				B()
			end
			G.knifePreview = function()
				local a = J.Character
				local A = a and (a:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or a:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
				return G.preview(
					nil,
					M.opts({
						impact = M.impact,
						muzzle = M.flash,
						life = math.max(M.life, 1.2),
						from = A and A.Position or nil,
					})
				)
			end
			t(function()
				if G.previewing then
					G.previewing = false
					pcall(function()
						T:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseTracerCam")
					end)
				end
				for a, a in ipairs(G.live) do
					pcall(function()
						a.head:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				G.live = {}
				for a, a in ipairs(G.made) do
					pcall(function()
						a.b:Destroy()
						a.a0:Destroy()
						a.a1:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				G.made, G.pool = {}, {}
			end)
			F:Header("Bullet Tracers")
			F:Toggle({
				Text = "Bullet Tracers",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(a)
					G.on = a == true
				end,
				Settings = function()
					F:Dropdown({
						Text = "Tracer Method",
						Default = "Classic",
						Options = {
							{ code = "Classic", label = "Classic" },
							{
								code = "Path Finder",
								label = "Path Finder",
							},
						},
						Callback = function(a)
							G.method = a
						end,
					})
					local a = {}
					for A, A in ipairs(K) do
						a[#a + 1] = { code = A, label = A }
					end
					F:Dropdown({
						Text = "Tracer Style",
						Default = "Energy",
						Options = a,
						Callback = function(a)
							if c[a] then
								G.style = a
							end
						end,
					})
					F:Colorpicker({
						Text = "Tracer Color",
						Default = G.col,
						Callback = function(a)
							if typeof(a) == "Color3" then
								G.col = a
							end
						end,
					})
					F:Colorpicker({
						Text = "Tail Color",
						Default = G.col2,
						Callback = function(a)
							if typeof(a) == "Color3" then
								G.col2 = a
							end
						end,
					})
					F:Toggle({
						Text = "Rainbow Tracers",
						Default = false,
						Callback = function(a)
							G.rainbow = a == true
						end,
					})
					F:Slider({
						Text = "Tracer Width",
						Min = 40,
						Max = 250,
						Default = 100,
						Decimals = 0,
						Suffix = "%",
						Callback = function(a)
							G.width = tonumber(a) or 100
						end,
					})
					F:Slider({
						Text = "Tracer Speed",
						Min = 150,
						Max = 1500,
						Default = 520,
						Decimals = 0,
						Suffix = " st/s",
						Callback = function(a)
							G.speed = tonumber(a) or 520
						end,
					})
					F:Slider({
						Text = "Tracer Duration",
						Min = 0.3,
						Max = 4,
						Default = 1.2,
						Decimals = 1,
						Suffix = " s",
						Callback = function(a)
							G.life = tonumber(a) or 1.2
						end,
					})
					F:Toggle({
						Text = "Impact Effect",
						Default = true,
						Callback = function(a)
							G.impact = a == true
						end,
					})
					F:Toggle({
						Text = "Muzzle Flash",
						Default = true,
						Callback = function(a)
							G.muzzle = a == true
						end,
					})
					F:Toggle({
						Text = "Show Other Shots",
						Default = false,
						Callback = function(a)
							G.others = a == true
						end,
					})
					F:Button({
						Text = "Preview Tracer",
						Callback = function()
							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(G.preview)
							end)
						end,
					})
				end,
			})
		end)()
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - Speed & Physics (WalkSpeed, WorldStep)
-- KEY: y
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["y"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t, R = G[4], G[6], G[3], G[5], G[0], G[8], G[1], G[7], G[2]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("RunService")
		if type(t.fakepos) ~= "table" then
			t.fakepos = {}
		end
		local B = t.fakepos
		if B.on == nil then
			B.on = false
		end
		if tonumber(B.power) == nil then
			B.power = 5
		end
		if B.vel == nil then
			B.vel = true
		end
		if B.md == nil then
			B.md = true
		end
		if B.side == nil then
			B.side = true
		end
		local U = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		local M = { active = false, off = U }
		getgenv().__pulseFakePos = M

				math.clamp(N.Y, -32767.0, 32767),
				math.clamp(N.Z, -32767.0, 32767)

		local function N(z, D)
			local b = B.dir or "Random"
			if b == "Underground" then
				return Vector3.new(n() * D * 0.15, -D, n() * D * 0.15)
			elseif b == "Sky" then
				return Vector3.new(n() * D * 0.15, D, n() * D * 0.15)
			elseif b == "Spin" then
				t.a = (t.a + 0.9 + math.random() * 0.6) % 6.283185307179586
				return Vector3.new(math.cos(t.a) * D, n() * D * 0.35, math.sin(t.a) * D)
			elseif b == "Jitter" then
				if not t.d or z >= t.dUntil then
					local b = Vector3.new(n(), n() * 0.4, n())
					t.d = b.Magnitude > 0.1 and b.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
					t.dUntil = z + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.25
				end
				t.flip = -t.flip
				return t.d * (D * 1.6 * t.flip)
			end
			return Vector3.new(
				(math.random() < 0.5 and -1.0 or 1) * D,
				n() * D,
				(math.random() < 0.5 and -1.0 or 1) * D
			)
		end
		local function n(z, D)

			if math.abs(w) > 3 then
				Y = w > 0 and -1.0 or 1

			elseif B.side ~= false then
				if K >= l then
					Y = S:Dot(X) > 0 and 1 or -1.0
				end
			elseif K >= l then

				l = K + 0.6 + math.random() * 1.2
			end

				q = W.MoveDirection

			end

		end
		local function T(r, _)
			if #w == 0 then
				return true
			end
			local q = _ - r
			local _ = math.max(q:Dot(q), 0.000001)
			local u = a.nearR or 2
			for s = 1, #w do
				local h = w[s]
				for w, w in ipairs({ 1.5, 0, -1.5 }) do
					local s = h + Vector3.new(0, w, 0)
					local w = math.clamp((s - r):Dot(q) / _, 0, 1)
					if (r + q * w - s).Magnitude < u then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
			return true
		end
		local function w(r, _, q, u)
			local s = (r * q).Position
			local h = r * _
			if not W(h, s) then
				return false
			end
			if u then
				for u = 1, #K do
					if not W(r * (_ + K[u]), s) then
						return false
					end
				end
				if not T(h, s) then
					return false
				end

						local K, L = u * _, (u * q).Position
						if not W(K, L) or not T(K, L) then
							return false
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return true
		end

		local function _(q, u, s)
			local h = Vector3.new(q.LookVector.X, 0, q.LookVector.Z)
			if h.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				h = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
			end
			local Y = math.atan2(-h.X, -h.Z)
			local h = q.Position
			if c then
				local q = CFrame.new(h) * CFrame.Angles(0, Y + c, 0)
				if w(q, u, s, true) then
					return q
				end
			end
			for q = 1, 23 do
				local l = math.ceil(q / 2) * (q % 2 == 1 and 1 or -1.0) * 3.141592653589793 / 12
				local q = CFrame.new(h) * CFrame.Angles(0, Y + l, 0)
				if w(q, u, s, false) and w(q, u, s, true) then
					c = l
					return q
				end
			end
			for c, c in ipairs({ 1, 2, 3 }) do
				for q = 0, 7 do
					local l = q * 3.141592653589793 / 4
					local q = h + Vector3.new(math.cos(l), 0, math.sin(l)) * c
					if
						not workspace:Raycast(h, q - h, X)
						and #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(q), Vector3.new(1.6, 4.2, 1.6), L) == 0
					then
						for c = 0, 11 do
							local h = CFrame.new(q) * CFrame.Angles(0, Y + c * 3.141592653589793 / 6, 0)
							if w(h, u, s, false) and w(h, u, s, true) then
								return h
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		local function c()

					K.hum.AutoRotate = K.autoRot

		local function q()
			local u = K.cf
			if not u then
				return
			end
			local s = K.r
			if not (s and s.Parent) then
				c()
				return
			end

			s.CFrame = CFrame.new(h) * u.Rotation
			if K.fixedPos then
				s.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, s.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
			end
		end
		local function u()

			if not s or T() or getgenv().__pulseMuzzleOff then
				if K.cf then
					c()
				end
				a.at, a.guarding = nil, false
				return
			end

				X.FilterDescendantsInstances = { s }

			end

						a.nextFind = T + (a.findGap or 0.1)

							K.autoRot, K.hum = x.AutoRotate, x
						end

							or nil

						a.guardFrames += 1
					end

				c()
			end

				if a.blocked or not a.at or W then
					a.clearSince = T
				end
				a.blocked = false
			else
				if not a.blocked then
					a.blockedAt = T
				end
				a.blocked = true
				a.blockedFrames += 1
			end
			a.at = T
		end
		local function T()
			local X = pcall(A)
			if not X then
				I()
			end
		end
		f(G.Heartbeat, function()
			I()
			pcall(q)
			if B.on then
				task.defer(T)
			end
		end)
		f(G.PreSimulation, function()
			I()
			pcall(q)
			if not pcall(u) then
				a.at = nil
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFakePos")
		end)
		pcall(function()
			F("PulseFakePos", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, I)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseMuzzleHold")
		end)
		pcall(function()
			F("PulseMuzzleHold", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
				pcall(q)
			end)
		end)
		f(R.CharacterAdded, function(A)
			E(A)
		end)
		if R.Character then
			E(R.Character)
		end
		J(function()
			I()
			pcall(c)
			a.alive = false
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFakePos")
			end)
			pcall(function()
				G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseMuzzleHold")
			end)
			M.active = false
			M.off = U
		end)
	end
end

		local function n(O)
			local N = math.max(0, C() - (tonumber(O) or 0))
			if N < 60 then
				return Q("now")
			end
			if N < 3600 then
				return string.format(Q("%dm"), N // 60)
			end
			if N < 86400 then
				return string.format(Q("%dh"), N // 3600)
			end
			if N < 5184000 then
				return string.format(Q("%dd"), N // 86400)
			end
			return os.date("%d.%m.%y", tonumber(O) or 0)
		end
		local function C(O)
			O = tonumber(O) or 0
			if O >= 1000000 then
				return string.format("%.1fM", O / 1000000)
			end
			if O >= 1000 then
				return string.format("%.1fk", O / 1000)
			end
			return tostring(math.floor(O))
		end

		function y.api(N, z)
			z = z or {}
			z.uid = A.UserId
			local A = W:JSONEncode(z)
			local z = {
				["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			}
			if getUpvalue(a) then
				local D = X.sha256hex(tostring(os.clock()) .. tostring(math.random(1, 1000000000))):sub(1, 16)
				local X, b = pcall(getUpvalue(a), D, A)
				if X and type(b) == "string" then
					A = W:JSONEncode({ e = b })
					z["X-Pulse-Enc"] = D
				end
			end
			local a, X = pcall(getUpvalue(R), {
				Url = "https://pulsehub.gg/pulse/cfg/" .. N,
				Method = "POST",
				Headers = z,
				Body = A,
			})
			if not a or type(X) ~= "table" then
				return nil, "net"
			end
			local a = X.Body or X.body or ""
			pcall(function()
				local A = X.Headers or X.headers
				local X
				if type(A) == "table" then
					for R, N in pairs(A) do
						if type(R) == "string" and R:lower() == "x-pulse-enc" then
							X = N
						end
					end
				end
				if X and getUpvalue(f) then
					local A = W:JSONDecode(a)
					if type(A) == "table" and type(A.e) == "string" then
						a = getUpvalue(f)(X, A.e)
					end
				end
			end)
			local A, f = pcall(function()
				return W:JSONDecode(a)
			end)
			if not A or type(f) ~= "table" then
				return nil, "net"
			end
			if f.banned == true then
				local a = getgenv().__pulseBanKick
				if a then
					pcall(a)
				end
				return nil, "net"
			end
			if f.ok ~= true then
				return nil, f.err or "net"
			end
			return f
		end
		pcall(function()
			if isfile and isfile("PulseHubMM2/cfg_fav.json") then
				local a = W:JSONDecode(readfile("PulseHubMM2/cfg_fav.json"))
				if type(a) == "table" then
					for A, A in ipairs(a) do
						if tonumber(A) then
							y.favs[tonumber(A)] = true

					makefolder("PulseHubMM2")

				writefile("PulseHubMM2/cfg_fav.json", W:JSONEncode(a))
			end)
		end

				G.U.leave(R, function()
					L(R, "BackgroundColor3", q, "Quick")
					w(X, "Quick", { Scale = 1 })
				end)
			end
			T(R.MouseButton1Down, function()
				w(X, "Quick", { Scale = 0.96 })
			end)
			T(R.MouseButton1Up, function()
				w(X, "Quick", { Scale = 1 })
			end)
			if f.click then
				T(R.MouseButton1Click, f.click)
			end
			return R, N, H
		end
		function a.confirm(A, f, X, R)
			local q = false
			T(A.MouseButton1Click, function()
				if not q then
					q = true
					if f then
						f.Text = Q("Sure?")
					end
					task.delay(2.5, function()
						q = false
						if f and f.Parent then
							f.Text = Q(X)
						end
					end)
					return
				end
				q = false
				if f then
					f.Text = Q(X)
				end
				R()
			end)
		end
		function a.tag(A, f, X, R)
			local q = J("Frame", {
				Name = "Tag",
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, R or 22),
				AutomaticSize = r,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,

			local A = G.label({
				Parent = q,
				Text = "",
				Font = G.Font.Semi(),
				Size = 11,
				Box = UDim2.fromOffset(0, R or 22),
				Auto = r,
				Color = "Text",
				Z = (X or 3) + 1,
			})
			local f = { c = q, l = A }
			function f.set(A)
				f.c.Visible = A ~= nil
				if not A then
					return
				end
				local X = k[A] or "Muted"
				f.l.Text = Q(A)
				L(f.c, "BackgroundColor3", X == "Muted" and "Text" or X, h)
				f.c.BackgroundTransparency = X == "Muted" and 0.9 or 0.84
				L(f.l, "TextColor3", X == "Muted" and "Muted" or X, h)
			end
			return f
		end

		function y.paintPill(X, R, q, q)
			local u = tonumber(q.v) or 0
			if u > 0 then
				X.Text = string.format("%.1f", tonumber(q.r) or 0)
				R.Text = C(u)
				R.Visible = true
			else
				X.Text = Q("No votes")
				R.Visible = false
			end
		end
		function y.paintCard(X)
			local R = X.item
			if not R then
				return
			end
			X.title.Text = tostring(R.t or "")
			if X.uid ~= R.u then
				X.uid = R.u
				X.av.Image = O(R.u)
			end
			y.paintPill(X.pVal, X.pCnt, X.pill, R)
			local q, u = tostring(R.n or ""), tostring(R.dn or "")
			X.author.Text = u ~= "" and u or "@" .. q
			X.age.Text = n(R.c)
			X.dls.Text = C(R.dl)
			if R.st == 3 then
				X.state.set("Hidden")
				L(X.state.c, "BackgroundColor3", "Danger", h)
				L(X.state.l, "TextColor3", "Danger", h)
			else
				X.state.set(nil)
			end
			local q = type(R.g) == "table" and R.g or {}
			for u, Y in ipairs(X.tags) do
				Y.set(q[u] and tostring(q[u]) or nil)
			end
			local q = y.favs[R.id] == true
			L(X.favI, "ImageColor3", q and "Warning" or "Muted", "Quick")
			L(X.fav, "BackgroundColor3", q and "Elevated" or "Surface", "Quick")
			X.get.Visible = not R.own
			X.getL.Text = Q(R.got and "Got" or "Get")
			pcall(G.Icons.apply, X.getI, R.got and "check" or "download")
		end
		function y.toggleFav(X)
			if y.favs[X.id] then
				y.favs[X.id] = nil
			else
				y.favs[X.id] = true
			end
			y.saveFavs()
			if y.view == "saved" and not y.favs[X.id] then
				task.defer(y.render)
			end
		end
		function y.render()
			local X = y.items
			for R, q in ipairs(X) do
				local u = y.cards[R]
				if not u then
					u = y.makeCard()
					y.cards[R] = u
				end
				u.item = q
				u.card.LayoutOrder = R
				u.card.Visible = not (y.view == "saved" and not y.favs[q.id])
				y.paintCard(u)
			end
			for R = #X + 1, #y.cards do
				y.cards[R].card.Visible = false
				y.cards[R].item = nil
			end
			f.moreB.Visible = y.more and y.view == "all"
			local R = 0
			for q = 1, #X do
				if y.cards[q].card.Visible then
					R += 1
				end
			end
			f.search.PlaceholderText = (y.all or 0) > 0 and string.format(Q("Search configs  ·  %d"), y.all)
				or Q("Search configs or players")
			f.mineL.Text = string.format(Q("Published %d/%d"), y.mineCount, y.maxLive)
			for q, u in ipairs(f.mineDots) do
				L(u, "BackgroundColor3", q <= y.mineCount and "Accent" or "Elevated", "Quick")
			end
			f.empty.Visible = not y.loading and R == 0
			if f.empty.Visible then
				local R = y.err and "No connection"
					or y.view == "saved" and "No saved configs"
					or y.view == "mine" and "No published configs"
					or y.q ~= "" and "Nothing found"
					or "No configs yet"
				f.eText.Text = Q(R)
				f.ePub.Visible = not y.err and y.view == "mine"
				pcall(
					G.Icons.apply,
					f.eIcon,
					y.view == "saved" and "star"
						or (y.view == "mine" and "upload" or (y.q ~= "" and "search" or "library"))
				)
			end
			if y.loading and #X == 0 then
				f.empty.Visible = true
				f.ePub.Visible = false
				f.eText.Text = Q("Loading")
				pcall(G.Icons.apply, f.eIcon, "refresh-cw")
			end
		end
		function y.load(X)
			y.gen += 1
			local R = y.gen
			if X then
				y.page = 0
				y.items = {}
			end
			y.loading = true
			y.err = nil
			y.loadedAt = os.clock()
			pcall(y.render)
			task.spawn(function()
				local X, q
				if y.view == "mine" then
					X, q = y.api("mine", {})
				elseif y.view == "saved" then
					local u = {}
					for Y in pairs(y.favs) do
						u[#u + 1] = Y
					end
					X, q = y.api("list", { ids = u, sort = y.sort })
				else
					X, q = y.api("list", { q = y.q, sort = y.sort, page = y.page })
				end
				if R ~= y.gen then
					return
				end
				y.loading = false
				if not X then
					y.err = q or "net"
					pcall(y.render)
					if y.page > 0 then
						E(I(q), nil, "danger")
					end
					return
				end
				y.mod = X.mod == true or y.mod
				local R = type(X.items) == "table" and X.items or {}
				if y.view == "mine" then
					y.maxLive = tonumber(X.max) or y.maxLive
					local q = 0
					for u, u in ipairs(R) do
						if u.st == 0 or u.st == 3 then
							q += 1
						end
					end
					y.mineCount = q
				end
				if y.view == "saved" then
					local q = {}
					for u, u in ipairs(R) do
						q[u.id] = true
					end
					local u = false
					for Y in pairs(y.favs) do
						if not q[Y] then
							y.favs[Y] = nil
							u = true
						end
					end
					if u then
						y.saveFavs()
					end
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(R) do
					table.insert(y.items, q)
				end
				y.more = X.more == true
				y.total = tonumber(X.total) or #y.items
				if X.all ~= nil then
					y.all = tonumber(X.all) or y.all
				end
				pcall(y.render)
			end)
		end
		function y.setView(X, R)
			y.view = X
			for q, u in pairs(f.segBtns) do
				local Y = q == X
				w(u.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = Y and 0 or 1 })
				L(u.lb, "TextColor3", Y and "Text" or "Muted", "Quick")
			end
			f.tool.Visible = X == "all"
			f.mineBar.Visible = X == "mine"
			f.relayout()
			y.closeOverlay()
			if R then
				y.items = {}
				pcall(y.render)
			else
				y.load(true)
			end
		end
		for X, R in pairs(f.segBtns) do
			T(R.b.MouseEnter, function()
				if y.view ~= X then
					L(R.lb, "TextColor3", "Text", "Quick")
				end
			end)
			G.U.leave(R.b, function()
				if y.view ~= X then
					L(R.lb, "TextColor3", "Muted", "Quick")
				end
			end)

					pcall(function()
						G.Sound.play("tick")
					end)
					y.setView(X)
				end
			end)
		end

		function X.canRate()
			local A = y.detail
			return A ~= nil and not A.own and not A.od and A.got == true
		end
		function X.paintRate(A)
			local F = y.detail
			local R = A or F and tonumber(F.my) or 0
			local A = X.canRate()
			for F, _ in ipairs(X.rateBtns) do
				L(_.ic, "ImageColor3", F <= R and "Warning" or (A and "Muted" or "Faint"), "Quick")
			end
		end
		function X.paintDetail()
			local A = y.detail
			if not A then
				return
			end
			X.dTitle.Text = tostring(A.t or "")
			local F, R = tostring(A.dn or ""), tostring(A.n or "")
			X.dAuthor.Text = F ~= "" and F ~= R and F .. "  ·  @" .. R or "@" .. R
			if X.dAvUid ~= A.u then
				X.dAvUid = A.u
				X.dAv.Image = O(A.u)
			end
			local F = tonumber(A.v) or 0
			X.tRate.v.Text = F > 0 and string.format("%.1f", tonumber(A.r) or 0) or "—"
			X.tRate.l.Text = C(F) .. " " .. Q("votes")
			X.tDl.v.Text = C(A.dl)
			X.tDl.l.Text = Q("downloads")
			X.tAge.v.Text = n(A.c)
			X.tAge.l.Text = Q("published")
			X.dDesc.Text = tostring(A.d or "")
			X.dDescBox.Visible = X.dDesc.Text ~= ""
			local F = type(A.g) == "table" and A.g or {}
			for R, _ in ipairs(X.dTags) do
				_.set(F[R] and tostring(F[R]) or nil)
			end
			X.dTagsRow.Visible = #F > 0
			if A.own then
				X.rateState.Text = Q("Your config")
			elseif A.od then
				X.rateState.Text = Q("Published from this device")
			elseif not A.got then
				X.rateState.Text = Q("Download to rate")
			elseif (tonumber(A.my) or 0) > 0 then
				X.rateState.Text = string.format(Q("Your rating: %d"), tonumber(A.my))
			else
				X.rateState.Text = ""
			end
			X.paintRate(nil)
			X.aGet.Visible = not A.own
			X.aApply.Size = A.own and UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, -4.0, 1, 0)
			X.aGetL.Text = Q(A.got and "Downloaded" or "Download")
			pcall(G.Icons.apply, X.aGetI, A.got and "check" or "download")
			X.aRep.Visible = not A.own and not A.od
			X.aDel.Visible = A.own or y.mod
			X.aBan.Visible = y.mod and not A.own
			local F = y.favs[A.id] == true
			L(X.aFavI, "ImageColor3", F and "Warning" or "Text", "Quick")
			X.aFavL.Text = Q(F and "In saved" or "Add to saved")
			L(X.dFavI, "ImageColor3", F and "Warning" or "Muted", "Quick")
		end
		function y.openDetail(A)
			y.detail = A
			X.paintDetail()
			X.dScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			X.show(X.detail)
		end
		function y.findCard(A)
			for F, F in ipairs(y.cards) do
				if F.item and F.item.id == A then
					return F
				end
			end
		end
		function y.merge(A, F)
			if type(F) ~= "table" then
				return
			end
			for R, _ in pairs(F) do
				A[R] = _
			end
			local F = y.findCard(A.id)
			if F then
				y.paintCard(F)
			end
			if y.detail == A then
				X.paintDetail()
			end
		end
		function y.download(A, F)
			local R, _ = y.api("get", { id = A.id })
			if not R then
				E(I(_), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			y.merge(A, R.item)
			local _ = R.data
			if type(_) ~= "table" or type(_.s) ~= "table" then
				E(I("data"), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			local q = B.localApi
			local u = q and q.add(tostring(A.t or "Config"), _, R.key ~= "" and R.key or nil) or tostring(A.t)
			if F then
				local A, F = B.applyData(_)
				if A == false then
					E(tostring(F or I("data")), nil, "danger")
					return
				end
				E(Q("Config applied"), u, "success")
			else
				E(Q("Added to My configs"), u, "success")
			end
		end
		function y.copyKey(A)
			local F, R = y.api("get", { id = A.id })
			if not F then
				E(I(R), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			y.merge(A, F.item)
			local A = tostring(F.key or "")
			if A == "" then
				E(I("data"), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			if V and pcall(V, A) then
				E(Q("Key copied"), A, "success")
			else
				E(Q("Clipboard unavailable"), A, "warning")
			end
		end
		function y.rate(A, F)
			local R, V = y.api("rate", { id = A.id, stars = F })
			if not R then
				E(I(V), nil, (V == "dl_first" or V == "own" or V == "own_dev") and "warning" or "danger")
				return
			end
			y.merge(A, { r = R.r, v = R.v, my = R.my })
			E(Q("Rating saved"), tostring(F) .. "/5", "success")
		end
		function y.report(A)
			local F, R = y.api("report", { id = A.id })
			if not F then
				E(I(R), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			E(Q("Report sent"), nil, "success")
		end
		function y.remove(A, F)
			local R, V = y.api("delete", { id = A.id, ban = F and true or nil })
			if not R then
				E(I(V), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			E(Q("Removed"), tostring(A.t or ""), "warning")
			y.closeOverlay()
			y.load(true)
		end
		X.pub, X.pScroll = X.panel("Publish")
		local A = { idx = 1, tags = {} }
		do
			local F = X.topbar(X.pScroll, "Publish config")
			local R = J("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				AutomaticSize = r,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.84,
				ZIndex = 22,
			}, F)
			U(R, 8)
			t(R, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
			J("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9) }, R)
			A.count = G.label({
				Parent = R,
				Text = "",
				Font = G.Font.Bold(),
				Size = 12,
				Box = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				Auto = r,
				Color = "Accent",
				Z = 23,
			})
			X.caption(X.pScroll, 2, "Config")
			local F = X.box(X.pScroll, 3, 44)
			local R = a.button(F, {
				icon = "chevron-left",
				size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
				padX = 0,
				z = 22,
				iconSize = 16,
				pos = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
				base = "Surface",
				iconColor = "Accent",
			})
			local V = a.button(F, {
				icon = "chevron-right",
				size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
				padX = 0,
				z = 22,
				iconSize = 16,
				anchor = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				pos = UDim2.new(1, -5.0, 0, 5),
				base = "Surface",
				iconColor = "Accent",
			})
			G.icon({
				Parent = F,
				Icon = "folder",
				Size = 15,
				Pos = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0.5, 0),
				Anchor = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Color = "Muted",
				Z = 22,
			})
			A.name = G.label({
				Parent = F,
				Text = "",
				Font = G.Font.Semi(),
				Size = 14,
				Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 0),
				Box = UDim2.new(1, -122.0, 1, 0),
				Truncate = true,
				Color = "Text",
				Z = 22,
			})
			T(R.MouseButton1Click, function()
				A.step(-1.0)
			end)
			T(V.MouseButton1Click, function()
				A.step(1)
			end)
			A.tCount = X.caption(X.pScroll, 4, "Title")
			local F
			F, A.title = a.field(X.pScroll, { ph = "Legit sheriff", order = 5, z = 22 })
			A.dCount = X.caption(X.pScroll, 6, "Description")
			local F
			F, A.desc = a.field(X.pScroll, { multi = true, ph = "", order = 7, z = 22, size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 84) })
			A.gCount = X.caption(X.pScroll, 8, "Tags")
			local F = X.row(X.pScroll, 9)
			a.hlist(F, 6, nil, true)
			A.tagBtns = {}
			for R, V in ipairs(S) do
				local _ = k[V] or "Muted"
				local q = J("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
					AutomaticSize = r,
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					LayoutOrder = R,
					ZIndex = 22,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
				}, F)
				U(q, 10)
				t(q, "BackgroundColor3", _ == "Muted" and "Text" or _)
				local F = a.stroke(q, 1)
				J("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 11) }, q)
				a.hlist(q, 5)
				local J = G.icon({
					Parent = q,
					Icon = "check",
					Size = 13,
					Color = _ == "Muted" and "Text" or _,
					Z = 23,
				})
				J.LayoutOrder = 1
				J.Visible = false
				local t = G.label({
					Parent = q,
					Text = Q(V),
					Font = G.Font.Semi(),
					Size = 12,
					Box = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
					Auto = r,
					Color = _ == "Muted" and "Muted" or _,
					Z = 23,
				})
				t.LayoutOrder = 2
				A.tagBtns[V] = { b = q, l = t, st = F, ck = J, tone = _ }
				T(q.MouseButton1Click, function()
					if A.tags[V] then
						A.tags[V] = nil
					else
						local F = 0
						for J in pairs(A.tags) do
							F += 1
						end
						if F >= 4 then
							E(Q("Up to 4 tags"), nil, "warning")
							return
						end
						A.tags[V] = true
					end
					pcall(function()
						G.Sound.play("tick")
					end)
					A.paintTags()
				end)
			end
			local G = X.row(X.pScroll, 10, 42)
			A.go, A.goL = a.button(G, {
				text = "Publish",
				icon = "upload",
				kind = "accent",
				size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42),
				z = 22,
				radius = 12,
				textSize = 14,
			})
			T(A.go.MouseButton1Click, function()
				task.spawn(A.submit)
			end)
			T(A.title:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
				if #A.title.Text > 32 then
					A.title.Text = A.title.Text:sub(1, 32)
				end
				A.tCount.Text = #A.title.Text .. "/32"
			end)
			T(A.desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
				if #A.desc.Text > 240 then
					A.desc.Text = A.desc.Text:sub(1, 240)
				end
				A.dCount.Text = #A.desc.Text .. "/240"
			end)
		end
		function A.paintTags()
			local G = 0
			for a, F in pairs(A.tagBtns) do
				local J = A.tags[a] == true
				if J then
					G += 1
				end
				w(F.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = J and 0.72 or 0.9 })
				w(F.st, "Quick", { Transparency = J and 0.35 or 1 })
				L(F.st, "Color", F.tone == "Muted" and "Text" or F.tone, h)
				F.ck.Visible = J
			end
			A.gCount.Text = G .. "/4"
		end
		function A.localList()
			local G = B.localApi
			local a = {}
			for F, F in ipairs(G and G.list() or {}) do
				if not F.builtin and type(F.data) == "table" and type(F.data.s) == "table" then
					a[#a + 1] = F
				end
			end
			return a
		end
		function A.step(G)
			local a = A.localList()
			if #a == 0 then
				return
			end
			A.idx = (A.idx - 1 + G) % #a + 1
			A.show(a)
		end
		function A.show(G)
			G = G or A.localList()
			local a = G[A.idx]
			A.entry = a
			A.name.Text = a and tostring(a.name) or "-"
			if a then
				local G = tostring(a.name):sub(1, 32)
				if A.title.Text == "" or A.autoTitle == A.title.Text then
					A.title.Text = #G >= 3 and G or ""
					A.autoTitle = A.title.Text
				end
			end
		end
		function A.strip(G)
			local a, F = pcall(function()
				return W:JSONDecode(W:JSONEncode(G))
			end)
			if not a or type(F) ~= "table" or type(F.s) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local G = F.s
			if type(G.vote) == "table" then
				G.vote.last = nil
			end
			if type(G.music) == "table" then
				G.music.custom = nil
			end
			if type(F.nova) == "table" then
				F.nova.winPos, F.nova.touchPos, F.nova.touchSize = nil, nil, nil
			end
			if type(G.ui) == "table" then
				for a in pairs(B.PERSONAL_UI or {}) do
					G.ui[a] = nil
				end
			end
			if type(G.ctrl) == "table" then
				for a in pairs(G.ctrl) do
					if type(a) ~= "string" or a:sub(1, 2) == "__" or (B.PERSONAL_CTRL or {})[a] then
						G.ctrl[a] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			return {
				v = 1,
				game = "mm2",
				s = G,
				fa = type(F.fa) == "string" and F.fa or nil,
				vis = type(F.vis) == "table" and F.vis or nil,
				skins = type(F.skins) == "string" and F.skins or nil,
				nova = type(F.nova) == "table" and F.nova or nil,
			}
		end
		function A.submit()
			if A.busy then
				return
			end
			local G = A.entry
			if not G then
				E(Q("Create a config in Settings first"), nil, "warning")
				return
			end
			local a = A.title.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			if #a < 3 or #a > 32 then
				E(I("title"), nil, "warning")
				return
			end
			local F = A.desc.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			local J = {}
			for t, t in ipairs(S) do
				if A.tags[t] then
					J[#J + 1] = t
				end
			end
			local t = A.strip(G.data)
			if not t then
				E(I("data"), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			A.busy = true
			A.goL.Text = Q("Loading")
			local G, R = y.api("publish", { title = a, desc = F, tags = J, data = t })
			A.busy = false
			A.goL.Text = Q("Publish")
			if not G then
				E(I(R), nil, "danger")
				return
			end
			E(Q("Published"), a, "success")
			A.title.Text, A.desc.Text, A.autoTitle = "", "", nil
			A.tags = {}
			A.paintTags()
			y.setView("mine")
		end
		function A.paintCount()
			A.count.Text = string.format("%d/%d", y.mineCount, y.maxLive)
		end
		function y.openPublish(G)
			local a = A.localList()
			A.idx = 1
			if G then
				for F, J in ipairs(a) do
					if J.name == G then
						A.idx = F
					end
				end
			end
			A.show(a)
			A.paintTags()
			A.paintCount()
			X.pScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
			X.show(X.pub)
			if #a == 0 then
				E(Q("Create a config in Settings first"), nil, "warning")
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local G = y.api("mine", {})
				if G and type(G.items) == "table" then
					local a = 0
					for F, F in ipairs(G.items) do
						if F.st == 0 or F.st == 3 then
							a += 1
						end
					end
					y.mineCount, y.maxLive = a, tonumber(G.max) or y.maxLive
					A.paintCount()
					pcall(y.render)
				end
			end)
		end
		T(f.pub.MouseButton1Click, function()
			y.openPublish(nil)
		end)
		T(f.ePub.MouseButton1Click, function()
			y.openPublish(nil)
		end)
		B.openPublish = function(G)
			pcall(function()
				if c.Current ~= K then
					c:SelectTab(K)
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if c.IsOpen == false and c.Open then
					c:Open()
				end
			end)
			y.openPublish(G)
		end
		pcall(function()
			table.insert(getgenv().__pulseNovaLangHooks, function()
				for G, G in pairs(f.segBtns) do
					G.lb.Text = Q(G.text)
				end
				local G = { top = "Top", new = "New", popular = "Popular" }
				f.sortL.Text = Q(G[y.sort] or "Top")
				for G, a in pairs(A.tagBtns) do
					a.l.Text = Q(G)
				end
				pcall(y.render)
				if y.detail then
					X.paintDetail()
				end
			end)
		end)
		y.setView("all", true)
		task.spawn(function()
			local G = false
			while isAlive(M) do
				local a = c.Current == K and c.IsOpen ~= false
				if a and not y.loading then
					local A = os.clock() - y.loadedAt
					if not G and A > 8 or A > 90 then
						y.load(true)
					end
				end
				G = a
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: UI - Stroke & Styling Helper
-- KEY: R
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["R"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a = G[0]
	return function(G, A, F, T)
		local f = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		f.Color = A or a.STROKE
		f.Thickness = F or 1
		f.Transparency = T or 0
		f.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		f.Parent = G
		return f
	end
end

		local function Y(l)
			l = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(l) or 0))
			if l < 60 then
				return "<1m"
			end
			local x = math.floor(l / 60)
			if x < 60 then
				return x .. "m"
			end
			local l = math.floor(x / 60)
			if l < 24 then
				return string.format("%dh %dm", l, x % 60)
			end
			return string.format("%dd %dh", math.floor(l / 24), l % 24)
		end
		local function l()

		local function G(T)
			local f = {}
			for X, X in ipairs(T) do
				if not L.info[X] and not L.asked[X] then
					L.asked[X] = true
					f[#f + 1] = X
				end
			end
			if #f == 0 then
				return
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				for T = 1, #f, 100 do
					local X = {}
					for U = T, math.min(#f, T + 99) do
						X[#X + 1] = f[U]
					end
					local T, f = pcall(function()
						return w:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(X)
					end)
					if T and type(f) == "table" then
						for T, T in ipairs(f) do
							if type(T) == "table" and T.Id then
								L.info[tonumber(T.Id)] = {
									dn = tostring(T.DisplayName or T.Username or ""),
									un = tostring(T.Username or ""),
								}
							end
						end
					else
						for T, T in ipairs(X) do
							L.asked[T] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				pcall(L.render)
			end)
		end
		function L.render()
			L.lastRender = os.clock()
			local T, f = {}, 0
			local X = ""
			pcall(function()
				X = a.job()
			end)
			if L.data and type(L.data.servers) == "table" then
				for U, U in ipairs(L.data.servers) do
					local c = type(U) == "table" and tonumber(U.n) or 0
					local w = type(U) == "table" and tonumber(U.m) or 0
					if
						type(U) == "table"
						and type(U.job) == "string"
						and U.job ~= X
						and not L.bad[U.job]
						and type(U.users) == "table"
						and c < w
					then
						local X = false
						for W, W in ipairs(U.users) do
							local V = tonumber(W.uid)
							if V and V ~= J.UserId then
								T[#T + 1] = {
									uid = V,
									t = tonumber(W.t) or 0,
									job = U.job,
									n = c,
									m = w,
									role = (W.role == "owner" or W.role == "mod") and W.role or nil,
									ord = #T + 1,
								}
								X = true
							end
						end
						if X then
							f += 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local X = { owner = 2, mod = 1 }
			table.sort(T, function(U, c)
				local w, W = X[U.role or ""] or 0, X[c.role or ""] or 0
				if w ~= W then
					return w > W
				end
				return U.ord < c.ord
			end)
			local X = {}
			local U = l()
			for c, w in ipairs(T) do
				local W = L.rows[c]
				if not W then
					W = C()
					L.rows[c] = W
				end
				W.entry = w
				W.card.LayoutOrder = c
				W.card.Visible = true
				if W.uid ~= w.uid then
					W.uid = w.uid
					W.av.Image = s(w.uid)
				end
				local c = L.info[w.uid]
				W.name.Text = c and c.dn ~= "" and c.dn or "User " .. tostring(w.uid)
				W.handle.Text = c and c.un ~= "" and "@" .. c.un or ""
				W.up.Text = w.t > 0 and Y(U - w.t) or "-"
				W.cnt.Text = string.format("%d/%d", w.n, w.m)
				if W.setRole then
					pcall(W.setRole, w.role)
				end
				if not c then
					X[#X + 1] = w.uid
				end
			end
			for U = #T + 1, #L.rows do
				L.rows[U].card.Visible = false
				L.rows[U].entry = nil
			end
			if #X > 0 then
				G(X)
			end
			pcall(L.paintHead, L.data ~= nil and #T or nil, f)
		end
		function L.fetch(G)
			if L.loading then
				return
			end
			local T = os.clock() - L.lastFetch
			if T < (G and 3 or 8) then
				return
			end
			L.loading = true
			L.lastFetch = os.clock()
			M(E, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Rotation = E.Rotation + 360 })
			task.spawn(function()
				local G, T = pcall(a.post, "/pulse/servers", { uid = J.UserId, p = game.PlaceId })
				L.loading = false
				if G and type(T) == "table" and type(T.servers) == "table" then
					L.data, L.err = T, false
				else
					L.err = true
				end
				pcall(L.render)
			end)
		end
		function L.tpMethods(G)
			local T = game.PlaceId
			return {
				function()
					K:TeleportToPlaceInstance(T, G, J)
				end,
				function()
					K:TeleportToPlaceInstance(T, G)
				end,
			}
		end
		function L.join(G)
			if L.joining then
				return
			end
			if (tonumber(G.n) or 0) >= (tonumber(G.m) or 0) then
				x(F.tr("Server is full"), nil, "warning")
				return
			end
			L.joining = true
			L.lastJob = G.job
			L.tpStarted, L.tpFailed, L.tpWhy = false, nil, nil
			local T = {}
			L.joinTok = T
			local f = L.info[G.uid]
			x(F.tr("Teleporting"), f and f.dn or nil, "info")
			task.spawn(function()
				local f = L.tpMethods(G.job)
				for X, U in ipairs(f) do
					if L.joinTok ~= T or not getUpvalue(A)() then
						return
					end
					L.tpFailed = nil
					local f, M = pcall(U)
					if not f then
						L.tpFailed = "error"
						L.tpWhy = tostring(M)
					end
					local f = os.clock() + (X == 1 and 7 or 6)
					while os.clock() < f and L.joinTok == T and not L.tpStarted and not L.tpFailed do
						task.wait(0.2)
					end
					if L.joinTok ~= T or L.tpStarted or L.tpFailed == "final" then
						return
					end
				end
				if L.joinTok ~= T then
					return
				end
				L.joinTok = nil
				L.joining = false
				local f = "https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId="
					.. tostring(game.PlaceId)
					.. "&gameInstanceId="
					.. tostring(G.job)
				local G = false
				pcall(function()
					local X = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
					if type(X) == "function" then
						X(f)
						G = true
					end
				end)
				local f = L.tpWhy and F.tr("Roblox replied") .. ": " .. L.tpWhy
					or F.tr("Roblox did not respond to the teleport")
				x(
					F.tr("Couldn't join this server"),
					f .. (G and ". " .. F.tr("Join link copied, open it in your browser") or ""),
					"warning",
					12
				)
			end)
			task.delay(45, function()
				if L.joinTok == T then
					L.joinTok = nil
					L.joining = false
				end
			end)
		end
		t(J.OnTeleport, function(G)
			if not L.joining then
				return
			end
			if
				G == Enum.TeleportState.Started
				or G == Enum.TeleportState.InProgress
				or G == Enum.TeleportState.WaitingForServer
			then
				L.tpStarted = true
			elseif G == Enum.TeleportState.Failed then
				L.tpStarted = false
				L.tpFailed = L.tpFailed or "failed"
				L.tpWhy = L.tpWhy or "TeleportState.Failed"
			end
		end)
		t(K.TeleportInitFailed, function(G, G, T)
			if not L.joining then
				return
			end
			if G == Enum.TeleportResult.IsTeleporting then
				return
			end
			local f = tostring(T or G)
			local T = L.lastJob
			L.tpStarted = false
			if T and (f:lower():find("private") or G == Enum.TeleportResult.Unauthorized) then
				L.joining, L.joinTok, L.tpFailed = false, nil, "final"
				L.bad[T] = true
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(a.post, "/pulse/private", { uid = J.UserId, job = T })
				end)
				pcall(L.render)
				x(F.tr("Private server"), F.tr("Hidden from the list"), "warning")
				return
			end
			if
				G == Enum.TeleportResult.GameFull
				or G == Enum.TeleportResult.GameEnded
				or G == Enum.TeleportResult.GameNotFound
			then
				L.joining, L.joinTok, L.tpFailed = false, nil, "final"
				if T and G ~= Enum.TeleportResult.GameFull then
					L.bad[T] = true
					pcall(L.render)
				end
				x(F.tr("Teleport failed"), f, "error")
				return
			end
			L.tpFailed = f
			L.tpWhy = f
		end)
		t(Q.MouseButton1Click, function()
			L.fetch(true)
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while isAlive(A) do
				if R.Current == B and R.IsOpen ~= false then
					L.fetch(false)
					if os.clock() - L.lastRender > 30 then
						pcall(L.render)
					end
				end
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - Flight (Classic Fly, CFrame Fly, Swim Fly)
-- KEY: q
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["q"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t = G[3], G[4], G[5], G[7], G[6], G[0], G[1], G[2]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("RunService")
		local R = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		local B = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		local U = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		local M = Enum.HumanoidStateType
		local c, K = false, false
		local w = 0
		X(R.JumpRequest, function()
			w = os.clock()
		end)
		X(R.InputBegan, function(L, W)
			if W or L.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
				return
			end
			if L.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
				c = true
			elseif L.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
				K = true
			end
		end)
		X(R.InputEnded, function(R)
			if R.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
				c = false
			elseif R.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
				K = false
			end
		end)
		local R = {
			"Classic",
			"CFrame",
			"Swim",
			"Air Walk",
			"Glide",
		}
		local L = {}
		local W = { vel = B, bank = 0, lastUp = 0 }
		local function V(r)
			local _ = F.CurrentCamera
			local q = r.MoveDirection
			local r = B
			local u = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
			if _ then
				local s = _.CFrame
				local _ = s.LookVector
				local h = Vector3.new(_.X, 0, _.Z)
				if h.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					u = h.Unit
				end
				if q.Magnitude > 0 then
					local h = s.RightVector
					local s = Vector3.new(h.X, 0, h.Z)
					if s.Magnitude > 0.01 then
						s = s.Unit
					else
						s = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
					end
					r = _ * q:Dot(u) + s * q:Dot(s)
				end
			end
			local _ = 0
			if c or os.clock() - w < 0.15 then
				_ = _ + 1
			end
			if K then
				_ = _ - 1
			end
			return r, _, u
		end
		local function c(K)
			if not W.bv or W.bv.Parent ~= K then
				if W.bv then
					pcall(function()
						W.bv:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				local w = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				w.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
				w.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
				w:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
				w.Parent = K
				W.bv = w
			end
			if not W.gyro or W.gyro.Parent ~= K then
				if W.gyro then
					pcall(function()
						W.gyro:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				local w = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
				w.P = 90000
				w.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9000000000, 9000000000, 9000000000)
				w.CFrame = K.CFrame
				w:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
				w.Parent = K
				W.gyro = w
				W.gyroCF = K.CFrame
			end
		end
		local function K(w, r, _)
			W.states = W.states or {}
			local function q(u)
				if W.states[u] ~= nil then
					return
				end
				local s, h = pcall(function()
					return w:GetStateEnabled(u)
				end)
				W.states[u] = not (s and h == false)
			end
			for u, u in ipairs(r) do
				q(u)
				pcall(function()
					w:SetStateEnabled(u, false)
				end)
			end
			if _ then
				q(_)
				pcall(function()
					w:SetStateEnabled(_, true)
				end)
			end
		end
		local function w(r, _)
			local q, u = pcall(function()
				return r:GetState()
			end)
			if q and u ~= _ then
				pcall(function()
					r:ChangeState(_)
				end)
			end
		end
		local function r()
			local _, q = W.hum, W.states
			W.states = nil
			if not (_ and q) then
				return
			end
			for u, s in pairs(q) do
				pcall(function()
					_:SetStateEnabled(u, s)
				end)
			end
			if _.Parent and _.Health > 0 then
				pcall(function()
					_:ChangeState(M.Freefall)
				end)
			end
		end
		local function _(q, u)
			if not u.PlatformStand then
				pcall(function()
					u.PlatformStand = true
				end)
			end
			W.stand = true
			local s = q:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			if s and not s.Disabled then
				pcall(function()
					s.Disabled = true
				end)
				W.animOff = true
			end
			local q = u:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if q then
				for u, u in ipairs(q:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					pcall(function()
						u:Stop(0)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		local function q(u, s, h, Y, l, x)
			local S = Vector3.new(s.X, 0, s.Z)
			local s = Vector3.new(h.X, 0, h.Z)
			local h = S.Magnitude > 0.01 and S.Unit or (s.Magnitude > 0.5 and s.Unit or Y)
			local s = u.Position
			local u = CFrame.lookAt(s, s + h)
			if x then
				u = u * x
			end
			W.gyroCF = W.gyroCF and W.gyroCF:Lerp(u, math.min(1, 8 * l)) or u
			W.gyro.CFrame = W.gyroCF
		end
		local function u(s, h)
			if s.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
				return h.Size.Y / 2 + 2
			end
			return s.HipHeight + h.Size.Y / 2
		end
		local function s()
			local h = W.hum
			local Y = h and h.Parent
			r()
			if W.bv then
				pcall(function()
					W.bv:Destroy()
				end)
				W.bv = nil
			end
			if W.gyro then
				pcall(function()
					W.gyro:Destroy()
				end)
				W.gyro = nil
			end
			if W.plat then
				pcall(function()
					W.plat:Destroy()
				end)
				W.plat = nil
			end
			if W.stand and h then
				pcall(function()
					h.PlatformStand = false
				end)
			end
			if W.animOff and Y then
				local r = Y:FindFirstChild("Animate")
				if r then
					pcall(function()
						r.Disabled = false
					end)
				end
			end
			W.stand, W.animOff = false, false
			W.method, W.hum, W.hrp = nil, nil, nil
			W.gyroCF, W.level, W.pos, W.yaw, W.face = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
			W.vel, W.bank, W.lastUp = B, 0, 0
		end
		T(function()
			pcall(s)
		end)
		L.Classic = {
			start = function(T, r)
				c(r)
				K(T, { M.Freefall })
				pcall(function()
					T:ChangeState(M.Running)
				end)
			end,
			step = function(T, r, h, Y, l, x, S, k)
				c(r)
				_(h, T)
				local T = l + U * x
				local h = T.Magnitude > 0.01 and T.Unit * k or B
				W.bv.Velocity = h
				q(r, l, h, S, Y)
			end,
		}
		L.CFrame = {
			start = function(T, r)
				K(T, { M.Freefall, M.FallingDown, M.Ragdoll, M.Jumping })
				W.pos = r.Position
			end,
			step = function(T, r, h, h, Y, l, x, S)
				w(T, M.Running)
				local T = r.Position
				if not W.pos or (T - W.pos).Magnitude > 8 then
					W.pos = T
				end
				local T = Y + U * l
				if T.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					W.pos = W.pos + T.Unit * S * h
				end
				local T = r.CFrame.LookVector
				local l = Vector3.new(T.X, 0, T.Z)
				l = l.Magnitude > 0.01 and l.Unit or x
				local T = Vector3.new(Y.X, 0, Y.Z)
				local Y = T.Magnitude > 0.01 and T.Unit or l
				local T = l:Lerp(Y, math.min(1, 10 * h))
				if T.Magnitude < 0.01 then
					T = Y
				end
				r.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(W.pos, W.pos + T.Unit)
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = B
				r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = B
			end,
		}
		L.Swim = {
			start = function(T, r)
				c(r)
				K(T, {
					M.Freefall,
					M.Running,
					M.RunningNoPhysics,
					M.Landed,
					M.Jumping,
					M.Climbing,
					M.FallingDown,
					M.GettingUp,
					M.Ragdoll,
				}, M.Swimming)
				w(T, M.Swimming)
			end,
			step = function(T, r, h, h, Y, l, x, S)
				c(r)
				w(T, M.Swimming)
				local T = Y + U * l
				local l = T.Magnitude > 0.01 and T.Unit * S or B
				W.vel = W.vel:Lerp(l, math.min(1, 9 * h))
				W.bv.Velocity = W.vel
				q(r, Y, W.vel, x, h)
			end,
		}
		L["Air Walk"] = {
			start = function(T, r)
				K(T, { M.Jumping, M.Freefall, M.FallingDown, M.Ragdoll })
				W.level = r.Position.Y - u(T, r)
			end,
			step = function(T, r, q, q, h, h, Y, Y)
				if not (W.plat and W.plat.Parent) then
					local l = Instance.new("Part")
					l.Name = "PulseAirWalk"
					l.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
					l.Anchored = true
					l.CanTouch = false
					l.CastShadow = false
					l.Transparency = 1
					l:SetAttribute("PulseMine", true)
					l.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, W.level - 0.5, r.Position.Z)
					l.Parent = F
					W.plat = l
				end
				w(T, M.Running)
				local F = math.clamp(Y, 10, 120)
				local w = r.Position
				local Y = w.Y - u(T, r)
				if h ~= 0 then
					W.level = W.level + h * F * q
					local q = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(q.X, h * F, q.Z)
				else
					if W.lastUp ~= 0 then
						local F = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
						r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(F.X, 0, F.Z)
					end
					if T.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and Y > W.level + 0.2 then
						W.level = Y
					end
				end
				W.lastUp = h
				W.plat.CFrame = CFrame.new(w.X, W.level - 0.5, w.Z)
			end,
		}
		L.Glide = {
			start = function(F, T)
				c(T)
				K(F, { M.Freefall })
				pcall(function()
					F:ChangeState(M.Running)
				end)
			end,
			step = function(F, T, M, K, w, r, q, u)
				c(T)
				_(M, F)
				local F = w + U * r
				local U = F.Magnitude > 0.01 and F.Unit * u or B
				local F = U.Magnitude > 0.01 and 2.2 or 1.6
				W.vel = W.vel:Lerp(U, 1 - math.exp(-F * K))
				if U.Magnitude < 0.01 and W.vel.Magnitude < 0.3 then
					W.vel = B
				end
				W.bv.Velocity = W.vel
				local F = Vector3.new(W.vel.X, 0, W.vel.Z)
				local B = F.Magnitude
				if B > 1 then
					W.face = F.Unit
				end
				local F = W.face or q
				local U = math.clamp(W.vel.Magnitude / math.max(u, 1), 0, 1)
				local M = math.atan2(W.vel.Y, math.max(B, 0.001))
				local B = math.clamp(U * (1.1344640137963142 - M * 0.6), 0, 2.007128639793479)
				local M = math.atan2(-F.X, -F.Z)
				local c = 0
				if W.yaw then
					local w = (M - W.yaw + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793
					c = w / math.max(K, 0.004166666666666667)
				end
				W.yaw = M
				local M = math.clamp(c * 0.3, -0.75, 0.75) * U
				W.bank = W.bank + (M - W.bank) * (1 - math.exp(-6.0 * K))
				local U = T.Position
				local T = CFrame.lookAt(U, U + F) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, W.bank) * CFrame.Angles(-B, 0, 0)
				W.gyroCF = W.gyroCF and W.gyroCF:Lerp(T, math.min(1, 8 * K)) or T
				W.gyro.CFrame = W.gyroCF
			end,
		}
		X(G.Stepped, function(G, G)
			if not (J.fly and J.fly.on) then
				getgenv().__pulseFlyActive = false
				if W.method then
					s()
				end
				return
			end
			local F = tonumber(J.fly.speed) or 60
			getgenv().__pulseFlyActive = true
			getgenv().__pulseFlySpeed = F
			local T = t.Character
			local X = T and T:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local t = T and T:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not (X and t and X.Health > 0) then
				if W.method then
					s()
				end
				return
			end
			local B = L[J.fly.method] and J.fly.method or "Classic"
			if W.method ~= B or W.hum ~= X or W.hrp ~= t then
				if W.method then
					s()
				end
				W.method, W.hum, W.hrp = B, X, t
				L[B].start(X, t)
			end
			G = math.clamp(tonumber(G) or 0.016666666666666666, 0, 0.1)
			local U, M, c = V(X)
			L[B].step(X, t, T, G, U, M, c, F)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			local G = {
				["Fly Method"] = {
					ru = "Метод полёта",
					uk = "Метод польоту",
				},
				["Air Walk"] = {
					ru = "Ходьба по воздуху",
					uk = "Ходьба повітрям",
				},
				["Glide"] = {
					ru = "Планирование",
					uk = "Планування",
				},
			}
			for F, T in pairs(G) do
				if A.data.ru then
					A.data.ru[F] = T.ru
				end
				if A.data.uk then
					A.data.uk[F] = T.uk
				end
			end
		end)
		local G
		G = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(J.fly.key)
		f:ToggleKey({
			Text = "Fly",
			Default = a.fly.on,
			Bind = G,
			Callback = function(G)
				J.fly.on = G == true
			end,
			OnBind = function(G)
				J.fly.key = G and G.Name or ""
			end,
			Settings = function()
				f:Slider({
					Text = "Fly Speed",
					Min = 10,
					Max = 300,
					Default = a.fly.speed or 60,
					Decimals = 0,
					Callback = function(G)
						J.fly.speed = G
					end,
				})
				local G = {}
				for A, A in ipairs(R) do
					table.insert(G, { code = A, label = A })
				end
				f:Dropdown({
					Text = "Fly Method",
					Options = G,
					Default = a.fly.method or "Classic",
					Callback = function(G)
						if L[G] then
							J.fly.method = G
						end
					end,
				})
			end,
		})
	end
end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: NovaLib UI Framework (Window, Tabs, Sections, Controls, Colorpicker, Keybinds, Themes)
-- KEY: z
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["z"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A = G[0], G[1]
	return function()
		if a.NovaLib then
			return a.NovaLib
		end
		local G, F = pcall(function()
			return (function()
				local T = { Version = "1.0.0", Windows = {}, Conns = {} }
				function T.tr(f)
					return f
				end
				function T.trace(f)
					local J, X = pcall(getgenv)
					if J and X and X.NOVA_TRACE and appendfile then
						pcall(
							appendfile,
							"PulseHub/nova_trace.txt",
							string.format("%.3f %s\n", os.clock(), tostring(f))
						)
					end
				end
				local f = game:GetService("Players")
				local J = game:GetService("TweenService")
				local X = game:GetService("UserInputService")
				local t = game:GetService("RunService")
				local R = game:GetService("TextService")
				local B = game:GetService("HttpService")
				local U = game:GetService("Lighting")
				local M = f.LocalPlayer
				T.Services = {
					Players = f,
					TweenService = J,
					UserInputService = X,
					RunService = t,
					TextService = R,
					HttpService = B,
					Lighting = U,

					local t, B = {}, {}
					function f.newReg()
						local U = {}
						table.insert(t, U)
						return U
					end
					local function U(c, K)
						local w = c.Parent
						if w == nil then
							return false
						end
						local L = K[w]
						if L == nil then
							L = c:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui") ~= nil
							K[w] = L
						end
						return L
					end
					function f.sweep()
						local c = {}
						for K, K in ipairs(t) do
							for w in pairs(K) do
								c[#c + 1] = w
								c[#c + 1] = K
							end
						end
						local K = {}
						local w = os.clock()
						for L = 1, #c, 2 do
							local W, V = c[L], c[L + 1]
							if V[W] ~= nil then
								local c, L = pcall(U, W, K)
								if c and L then
									B[W] = nil
								elseif B[W] then
									V[W] = nil
									B[W] = nil
								else
									B[W] = true
								end
							end
							if os.clock() - w > 0.001 then
								task.wait()
								w = os.clock()
								K = {}
							end
						end
					end
					function f.regCount()
						local B = 0
						for U, U in ipairs(t) do
							for t in pairs(U) do
								B += 1
							end
						end
						return B
					end
					function f.startSweep()
						if f.sweeping then
							return
						end
						f.sweeping = true
						task.spawn(function()
							while true do
								task.wait(15)
								local t = false
								for B, B in ipairs(T.Windows) do
									if not B.Destroyed then
										t = true
									end
								end
								f.sweep()
								if not t then
									f.sweeping = false
									return
								end
							end
						end)
					end

					f.cornerReg = f.newReg()

					function f.new(B, U, c)
						local K = Instance.new(B)
						local w
						for L, W in pairs(U or {}) do
							if L == "Parent" then
								w = W
							else
								K[L] = W
							end
						end
						for U, U in ipairs(c or {}) do
							U.Parent = K
						end
						if t[B] then
							local t = K.FontFace
							local U = K.TextSize
							f.textReg[K] = { weight = t.Weight, style = t.Style, size = U }
							if f.textScale ~= 1 then
								K.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(U * f.textScale + 0.5))
							end
						elseif B == "UICorner" then
							local t = K.CornerRadius
							f.cornerReg[K] = t
							if f.radiusMult ~= 1 and t.Scale == 0 then
								K.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(t.Offset * f.radiusMult + 0.5))
							end
						end
						if w then
							K.Parent = w
						end
						return K
					end
					function f.setTextSize(t, B)
						local U = f.textReg[t]
						if U then
							U.size = B
						end
						t.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(B * f.textScale + 0.5))
					end
					function f.corner(t, B)
						return f.new(
							"UICorner",
							{ CornerRadius = typeof(B) == "UDim" and B or UDim.new(0, B or 8), Parent = t }
						)

							t.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(B.Offset * f.radiusMult + 0.5))
						end

							Thickness = U or 1,
							Transparency = c or 0,
							ApplyStrokeMode = K or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
							Parent = t,

							PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, U or B or 0),
