					function f.clamp(t, B, U)
						if t < B then
							return B
						end
						if t > U then
							return U
						end
						return t
					end
					function f.round(t, B)
						local U = 10 ^ (B or 0)
						return math.floor(t * U + 0.5) / U
					end
					function f.fmt(t, B)
						B = B or 0
						if B <= 0 then
							return tostring(math.floor(t + 0.5))
						end
						return string.format("%." .. B .. "f", t)

							local w = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
							w.Text = tostring(t)

							w.Size = U
							w.Width = 10000
							return R:GetTextBoundsAsync(w)
						end)
						if c and K then
							return K.X

							pcall(function()

								local B = Instance.new("Folder")
								B.Parent = t
								B:Destroy()
							end)
							if not R then
								t = nil
							end
						end
						if typeof(t) ~= "Instance" then
							t = M:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

							if syn and syn.protect_gui then

							end
						end)

							return X == t
						end
						if t then
							return X.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						end

						if t and t.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
							return X == t

						if typeof(t) ~= "Instance" then
							return nil
						end
						if type(R) == "string" then
							R = f.Presets[R] or f.Presets.Base
						end
						if not f.enabled then
							for U, M in pairs(B) do
								pcall(function()
									t[U] = M
								end)
							end
							return nil
						end
						local U, M = pcall(J.Create, J, t, R, B)
						if U and M then
							M:Play()
							return M
						end
						for J, R in pairs(B) do
							pcall(function()
								t[J] = R
							end)
						end
						return nil
					end
					function f.ripple(J, t, R)
						if not f.enabled or typeof(J) ~= "Instance" then
							return
						end
						local B, U = J.AbsolutePosition, J.AbsoluteSize
						local M = U / 2
						if R then
							local R = X.mouse()
							M = Vector2.new(X.clamp(R.X - B.X, 0, U.X), X.clamp(R.Y - B.Y, 0, U.Y))
						end
						local R = math.max(U.X, U.Y) * 1.6
						local B = X.new("Frame", {
							Name = "Ripple",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M.X, M.Y),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
							BackgroundColor3 = t or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.8,
							ZIndex = J.ZIndex + 5,
							Parent = J,
						})
						X.corner(B, UDim.new(1, 0))
						f.tween(
							B,
							TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
							{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(R, R), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }
						)
						task.delay(0.5, function()
							B:Destroy()
						end)
					end

						if #U == 0 then
							if R then
								R()
							end
							return
						end

						task.spawn(function()
							local J = os.clock()
							for R, R in ipairs(U) do
								local U = R:GetDescendants()
								for R = 1, #U do
									if f.names[X] ~= B then
										f.busy -= 1
										return
									end
									t(U[R])
									if R % 40 == 0 and os.clock() - J > f.budget then
										task.wait()
										J = os.clock()
									end
								end
							end
							f.busy -= 1
						end)

								J(X[f])
							end
						end

					function f.get(R, B)
						R = R or Enum.FontWeight.Medium
						B = B or Enum.FontStyle.Normal
						local U = f.id .. "|" .. R.Name .. "|" .. B.Name
						if not X[U] then
							local M, c = pcall(Font.new, t(f.id), R, B)
							X[U] = M and c or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
						end
						return X[U]
					end
					f.Regular = function()
						return f.get(Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
					end
					f.Medium = function()
						return f.get(Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
					end
					f.Semi = function()
						return f.get(Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)
					end
					f.Bold = function()
						return f.get(Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
					end
					f.Heavy = function()
						return f.get(Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold)
					end
					function f.fontOne(X)
						local t = J.textReg[X]
						if t then
							pcall(function()
								X.FontFace = f.get(t.weight, t.style)
							end)
						end
					end
					function f.sizeOne(X)
						local t = J.textReg[X]
						if t then
							pcall(function()
								X.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(t.size * J.textScale + 0.5))
							end)
						end
					end
					function f.setFamily(X)
						for t, t in ipairs(f.Families) do
							if t[1] == X or t[2] == X then
								f.name, f.id = t[1], t[2]
								T.Refresh.run("font", f.fontOne, function()
									for X in pairs(J.textReg) do
										if X.Parent then
											f.fontOne(X)
										end
									end
								end)
								return true
							end
						end
						return false
					end
					function f.setScale(X)
						J.textScale = math.clamp(X, 0.8, 1.3)
						T.Refresh.run("textsize", f.sizeOne, function()
							for X in pairs(J.textReg) do
								if X.Parent then
									f.sizeOne(X)
								end
							end
						end)
					end
				end

						f.module = {
							GetAsset = function(U)
								local M = R[U] or R[t[U] or ""]
								local t = M and B[M]
								if not t then
									return nil
								end
								local R = string.split(t, ",")
								return {
									IconName = U,
									Url = J[tonumber(R[1])],
									ImageRectSize = X,
									ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(tonumber(R[2]), tonumber(R[3])),
								}
							end,
						}
						local J = f.waiting
						f.waiting = {}
						for X, X in ipairs(J) do
							pcall(X)
						end
						return f.module
					end
					function f.resolve(J)
						if not J or J == "" then
							return nil
						end
						if type(J) == "number" or tostring(J):match("^%d+$") then
							return {
								Url = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(J),
								ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero,
								ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero,
							}
						end
						if tostring(J):match("^rbx") then
							return { Url = tostring(J), ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero, ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero }
						end
						if not f.module then
							f.load()
						end
						if not f.module then
							return nil
						end
						local X, t = pcall(f.module.GetAsset, J)
						if X and type(t) == "table" then
							return t
						end
						return nil
					end
					function f.apply(J, X)
						if typeof(J) ~= "Instance" then
							return
						end
						local function t()
							local R = f.resolve(X)
							if R then
								J.Image = R.Url
								J.ImageRectOffset = R.ImageRectOffset or Vector2.zero
								J.ImageRectSize = R.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero
								J.Visible = true
							end
						end
						if not f.module then
							f.load()
						end
						t()
					end
				end
				do
					local f = {
						volume = 0.5,
						enabled = true,
						cache = {},
						folder = "PulseHub/nova",
					}
					T.Sound = f
					local function J(X)
						if X < -1.0 then
							return -1.0
						end
						if X > 1 then
							return 1
						end
						return X
					end
					local function X(t)
						local R = #t
						local B = {
							"RIFF",
							string.pack("<I4", 36 + R * 2),
							"WAVE",
							"fmt ",
							string.pack("<I4I2I2I4I4I2I2", 16, 1, 1, 22050, 44100, 2, 16),
							"data",
							string.pack("<I4", R * 2),
						}
						local U = table.create(R)
						for M = 1, R do
							local R = math.floor(J(t[M]) * 32767)
							U[M] = string.pack("<i2", R)
						end
						return table.concat(B) .. table.concat(U)
					end
					local function J(t)
						local R = t.dur
						local B = math.floor(22050 * R)
						local U = table.create(B)
						local M = {}
						for c = 1, B do
							local B = (c - 1) / 22050
							local K = B / R
							local R = 0
							for w, L in ipairs(t.tones) do
								local W = L.f0 + (L.f1 - L.f0) * math.min(1, K / (L.glide or 1))
								M[w] = (M[w] or 0) + 6.283185307179586 * W / 22050
								local K = math.exp(-B * (L.decay or 30)) * math.min(1, B / (L.attack or 0.002))
								if L.start and B < L.start then
									K = 0
								end
								if L.start and B >= L.start then
									K = math.exp(-(B - L.start) * (L.decay or 30))
										* math.min(1, (B - L.start) / (L.attack or 0.002))
								end
								R = R + math.sin(M[w]) * K * (L.amp or 0.5)
							end
							if t.noise then
								R = R + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * t.noise * math.exp(-B * 90)
							end
							U[c] = R
						end
						return U
					end

						notify = {

								{ f0 = 1175, f1 = 1175, decay = 9, amp = 0.3 },

					}
					function f.asset(t)
						if f.cache[t] ~= nil then
							return f.cache[t]
						end
						f.cache[t] = false
						local R, B = pcall(function()
							if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then
								return nil
							end
							if isfolder and makefolder then
								if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
									makefolder("PulseHub")
								end
								if not isfolder(f.folder) then
									makefolder(f.folder)
								end
							end
							local U = f.folder .. "/" .. t .. ".wav"
							if not (isfile and isfile(U)) then
								writefile(U, X(J(f.specs[t])))
							end
							return getcustomasset(U)
						end)
						if R and B then
							f.cache[t] = B
						end
						return f.cache[t]
					end
					function f.play(J, X)
						if not f.enabled or f.volume <= 0 then
							return
						end
						local t = f.asset(J)
						if not t then
							return
						end
						local J = f.host
						if not J then
							return
						end
						local R = Instance.new("Sound")
						R.SoundId = t
						R.Volume = f.volume * (X or 1)
						R.Parent = J
						R:Play()
						task.delay(1, function()
							R:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					function f.preload()
						task.spawn(function()
							for J in pairs(f.specs) do
								pcall(f.asset, J)
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				do
					local f = {}
					T.Store = f
					local J = T.Services.HttpService
					function f.new(f)
						local X = { path = f, data = {}, dirty = false }
						pcall(function()
							if f and isfile and readfile and isfile(f) then
								local t = J:JSONDecode(readfile(f))
								if type(t) == "table" then
									X.data = t
								end
							end
						end)
						function X.get(t, R)
							local B = X.data[t]
							if B == nil then
								return R
							end
							return B
						end
						function X.set(t, R)
							if X.data[t] == R then
								return
							end
							X.data[t] = R
							X.save()
						end
						function X.save()
							if X.dirty then
								return
							end
							X.dirty = true
							task.delay(0.6, function()
								X.dirty = false
								pcall(function()
									if not (f and writefile) then
										return
									end
									if isfolder and makefolder then
										if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
											makefolder("PulseHub")
										end
										if not isfolder("PulseHub/nova") then
											makefolder("PulseHub/nova")
										end
									end
									writefile(f, J:JSONEncode(X.data))
								end)
							end)
						end
						return X
					end
				end
				do
					local f = T.Refresh
					table.insert(f.full, function(J)
						T.Theme.applyOne(J)
					end)
					table.insert(f.full, T.U.radiusOne)
					table.insert(f.full, T.Font.fontOne)
					table.insert(f.full, T.Font.sizeOne)
				end
				do
					local f = { cache = {}, folder = "PulseHub/nova/tex", version = "v7" }
					T.Tex = f
					local J
					local function X(t)
						if not J then
							J = table.create(256)
							for R = 0, 255 do
								local B = R
								for U = 1, 8 do
									if bit32.band(B, 1) == 1 then
										B = bit32.bxor(3988292384, bit32.rshift(B, 1))
									else
										B = bit32.rshift(B, 1)
									end
								end
								J[R] = B
							end
						end
						local R = buffer.fromstring(t)
						local t = 4294967295
						for B = 0, buffer.len(R) - 1 do
							t = bit32.bxor(J[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(t, buffer.readu8(R, B)), 255)], bit32.rshift(t, 8))
						end
						return bit32.bxor(t, 4294967295)
					end
					local function J(t, R)
						return string.pack(">I4", #R) .. t .. R .. string.pack(">I4", X(t .. R))
					end
					function f.encode(X, t, R)
						local B = X * 4 + 1
						local U = buffer.create(B * t)
						local B = 0
						for M = 0, t - 1 do
							buffer.writeu8(U, B, 0)
							B += 1
							for c = 0, X - 1 do
								local K, w, L, W = R(c, M)
								buffer.writeu8(U, B, math.clamp(math.floor(K + 0.5), 0, 255))
								buffer.writeu8(U, B + 1, math.clamp(math.floor(w + 0.5), 0, 255))
								buffer.writeu8(U, B + 2, math.clamp(math.floor(L + 0.5), 0, 255))
								buffer.writeu8(U, B + 3, math.clamp(math.floor(W + 0.5), 0, 255))
								B += 4
							end
						end
						local R = buffer.len(U)
						local B, M = 1, 0
						for c = 0, R - 1 do
							B = (B + buffer.readu8(U, c)) % 65521
							M = (M + B) % 65521
						end
						local c = { "x\001" }
						local K = 0
						while K < R do
							local w = math.min(65535, R - K)
							local L = K + w >= R and 1 or 0
							table.insert(c, string.char(L) .. string.pack("<I2I2", w, bit32.bxor(w, 65535)))
							table.insert(c, buffer.readstring(U, K, w))
							K += w
						end
						table.insert(c, string.pack(">I4", M * 65536 + B))
						local R = string.pack(">I4I4", X, t) .. "\008\006\000\000\000"
						return "\137PNG\r\n\026\n" .. J("IHDR", R) .. J("IDAT", table.concat(c)) .. J("IEND", "")
					end
					local function J(X, t, R)
						local B = math.clamp((R - X) / (t - X), 0, 1)
						return B * B * (3 - 2 * B)
					end
					local function X(t, R, B, U, M, c, K)
						local w = math.abs(t - B) - (M - K)
						local t = math.abs(R - U) - (c - K)
						local R, B = math.max(w, 0), math.max(t, 0)
						return math.sqrt(R * R + B * B) + math.min(math.max(w, t), 0) - K
					end
					local function t(R)
						return math.clamp(0.5 - R, 0, 1)
					end
					local function R(B, U, M)
						local c = math.sin(B * 127.1 + U * 311.7 + M * 74.7) * 43758.5453
						return c - math.floor(c)
					end
					local function B(U)
						return function(M, c)
							local K = 0
							for w, w in ipairs(U) do
								local U, L = (M - w[1]) / w[3], (c - w[2]) / w[4]
								K += w[5] * math.exp(-(U * U + L * L))
							end
							return K
						end
					end
					f.specs = {
						grain = {
							w = 128,
							h = 128,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(U, M)
									local c = R(U, M, 3.3) * 0.7 + R(U * 0.5, M * 0.5, 9.1) * 0.3
									return 255, 255, 255, c * c * 64
								end
							end,
						},
						glow = {
							w = 256,
							h = 256,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = math.sqrt(((R + 0.5) / 128 - 1) ^ 2 + ((U + 0.5) / 128 - 1) ^ 2)
									local R = math.max(0, 1 - M)
									return 255, 255, 255, R ^ 2.3 * 255
								end
							end,
						},
						vignette = {
							w = 256,
							h = 256,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M, c = (R + 0.5) / 128 - 1, (U + 0.5) / 128 - 1
									local R = math.sqrt(M * M * 0.8 + c * c)
									return 0, 0, 0, J(0.45, 1.35, R) * 255
								end
							end,
						},
						knob = {
							w = 128,
							h = 128,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M, c = R + 0.5 - 64, U + 0.5 - 64
									local R = math.sqrt(M * M + c * c)
									local U = math.clamp(63 - R + 0.5, 0, 1)
									local K = 1 - 0.2 * ((c + 63) / 126)
									K = K * (1 - 0.14 * math.clamp((R - 52) / 11, 0, 1))
									local R, w = (M + 14) / 34, (c + 30) / 22
									local M = math.max(0, 1 - (R * R + w * w))
									K = math.min(1, K + 0.1 * M ^ 1.5)
									return 255 * K, 255 * K, 255 * K, 255 * U
								end
							end,
						},
						pillfill = {
							w = 96,
							h = 48,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * t(X(R + 0.5, U + 0.5, 48, 24, 48, 24, 24))
								end
							end,
						},
						trackshade = {
							w = 96,
							h = 48,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M, c = R + 0.5, U + 0.5
									local R = X(M, c, 48, 24, 48, 24, 24)
									local U = -R
									local M = t(R)
									local R = c / 48
									local c = math.clamp(1.15 - 1.6 * R, 0, 1)
									local K = 0.55 * (1 - J(0, 11, U)) * c + 0.16 * (1 - J(0, 5, U))
									K = math.clamp(K, 0, 0.7)
									local c = 0.1 * (1 - J(0, 5, U)) * math.clamp((R - 0.5) * 3, 0, 1)
									local R = K + c * (1 - K)
									local U = R > 0 and 255 * c * (1 - K) / R or 0
									return U, U, U, 255 * R * M
								end
							end,
						},
						dots = {
							w = 24,
							h = 24,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = math.sqrt((R + 0.5 - 12) ^ 2 + (U + 0.5 - 12) ^ 2)
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * math.clamp(1.25 - M, 0, 1)
								end
							end,
						},
						grid = {
							w = 40,
							h = 40,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = (R == 0 or U == 0) and 1 or 0
									if R == 0 and U == 0 then
										M = 1
									end
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * M
								end
							end,
						},
						diag = {
							w = 20,
							h = 20,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = (R + U) % 10 / 10
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * (1 - J(0.12, 0.3, math.abs(M - 0.06) * 2))
								end
							end,
						},
						crosses = {
							w = 32,
							h = 32,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M, c = math.abs(R + 0.5 - 16), math.abs(U + 0.5 - 16)
									local R = M < 0.9 and c < 4.2 or c < 0.9 and M < 4.2
									return 255, 255, 255, R and 255 or 0
								end
							end,
						},
						scan = {
							w = 4,
							h = 4,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, R)
									return 255, 255, 255, R == 0 and 255 or 0
								end
							end,
						},
						stripes = {
							w = 32,
							h = 32,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = math.sin((R + U) / 16 * 3.141592653589793 * 2) * 0.5 + 0.5
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * M * M
								end
							end,
						},
						checker = {
							w = 16,
							h = 16,
							tile = true,
							px = function()
								return function(R, U)
									local M = (math.floor(R / 8) + math.floor(U / 8)) % 2 == 0 and 74 or 52
									return M, M, M + 4, 255
								end
							end,
						},
						meshA = {
							w = 256,
							h = 160,
							px = function()
								local R = B({
									{ 0.12, 0.18, 0.42, 0.55, 1 },
									{ 0.62, 0.05, 0.32, 0.4, 0.6 },
									{ 0.88, 0.72, 0.4, 0.55, 0.9 },
									{ 0.35, 0.95, 0.5, 0.35, 0.55 },
								})
								return function(U, M)
									local c = math.clamp(R((U + 0.5) / 256, (M + 0.5) / 160), 0, 1)
									local R, K = (U + 0.5) / 256, (M + 0.5) / 160
									local U = J(0, 0.2, R) * J(0, 0.2, 1 - R) * J(0, 0.2, K) * J(0, 0.2, 1 - K)
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * c ^ 1.15 * U
								end
							end,
						},
						meshB = {
							w = 256,
							h = 160,
							px = function()
								local R = B({
									{ 0.85, 0.15, 0.36, 0.5, 0.95 },
									{ 0.2, 0.85, 0.45, 0.5, 0.85 },
									{ 0.55, 0.5, 0.3, 0.3, 0.35 },
								})
								return function(B, U)
									local M = math.clamp(R((B + 0.5) / 256, (U + 0.5) / 160), 0, 1)
									local R, c = (B + 0.5) / 256, (U + 0.5) / 160
									local B = J(0, 0.2, R) * J(0, 0.2, 1 - R) * J(0, 0.2, c) * J(0, 0.2, 1 - c)
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * M ^ 1.15 * B
								end
							end,
						},
						shadow9 = {
							w = 96,
							h = 96,
							slice = Rect.new(40, 40, 56, 56),
							px = function()
								return function(R, B)
									local U = X(R + 0.5, B + 0.5, 48, 48, 16, 16, 10)
									local R = 1 / (1 + math.exp(U / 4.6))
									return 0, 0, 0, 255 * R * 0.9
								end
							end,
						},
					}
					local R = { 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 15, 19, 24, 30, 38 }
					local B = { rim9 = 14, gloss9 = 14, tile9 = 15, plate9 = 14 }
					f.buckets = R
					f.kinds = B
					f.tracked = T.U.newReg()
					local function U(M, c)
						local K = c + 4
						local w = math.max(64, 2 * K + 24)
						local L = w / 2
						local W = w / 64
						local V
						if M == "rim9" then
							V = function()
								return function(r, _)
									local q, u = r + 0.5, _ + 0.5
									local r = X(q, u, L, L, L - 0.6, L - 0.6, c)
									local _ = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(r + 0.5) / 1.05, 0, 1)
									local r = 0.95 - 0.86 * J(0, w, u)
									local u = 0.75 + 0.25 * (1 - math.abs(q - L) / L)
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * _ * r * u
								end
							end
						elseif M == "gloss9" then
							V = function()
								return function(r, _)
									local q, u = r + 0.5, _ + 0.5
									local r = X(q, u, L, L, L, L, c)
									local _ = t(r)
									local q = 1 - J(0, 34 * W, u)
									local s = (1 - J(0, 2.4, -r)) * (1 - J(0, 34 * W, u))
									local W = 0.2 * q + 0.16 * s
									return 255, 255, 255, 255 * W * _
								end
							end
						elseif M == "tile9" then
							V = function()
								return function(M, W)
									local r, _ = M + 0.5, W + 0.5
									local M = X(r, _, L, L, L, L, c)
									local W = t(M)
									local r = 1 - 0.24 * J(0, w, _)
									r = math.min(1, r + 0.16 * (1 - J(0, 3.2, _)))
									r = r * (1 - 0.1 * (1 - J(0, 3, -M)) * J(w * 0.47, w, _))
									return 255 * r, 255 * r, 255 * r, 255 * W
								end
							end
						else
							V = function()
								return function(M, W)
									local r, _ = M + 0.5, W + 0.5
									local M = X(r, _, L, L, L, L, c)
									local X = t(M)
									local t = 1 - 0.1 * J(0, w, _)
									return 255 * t, 255 * t, 255 * t, 255 * X
								end
							end
						end
						return { w = w, h = w, slice = Rect.new(K, K, w - K, w - K), px = V }
					end
					function f.resolve(J, X)
						local t = X * T.U.radiusMult
						local X, M = R[1], math.huge
						for c, c in ipairs(R) do
							local K = math.abs(math.log(math.max(t, 0.5) / c))
							if K < M then
								X, M = c, K
							end
						end
						return J .. "@" .. X, math.max(t / X, 0.3)
					end
					function f.cleanup()
						pcall(function()
							if not (listfiles and delfile and isfolder and isfolder(f.folder)) then
								return
							end
							for J, J in ipairs(listfiles(f.folder)) do
								if J:match("_v%d+%.png$") and not J:match("_" .. f.version .. "%.png$") then
									pcall(delfile, J)
								end
							end
						end)
					end
					function f.get(J)
						local X = f.cache[J]
						if X ~= nil then
							return X or nil
						end
						f.cache[J] = false
						local X = f.specs[J]
						if not X then
							local t, M = string.match(J, "^(%a+%d)@(%d+)$")
							if t and B[t] then
								X = U(t, tonumber(M))
								f.specs[J] = X
							end
						end
						if not X then
							return nil
						end
						local t, U = pcall(function()
							if not (writefile and getcustomasset and buffer) then
								return nil
							end
							if isfolder and makefolder then
								if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
									makefolder("PulseHub")
								end
								if not isfolder("PulseHub/nova") then
									makefolder("PulseHub/nova")
								end
								if not isfolder(f.folder) then
									makefolder(f.folder)
								end
							end
							local M = f.folder .. "/" .. string.gsub(J, "@", "_r") .. "_" .. f.version .. ".png"
							if not (isfile and isfile(M)) then
								writefile(M, f.encode(X.w, X.h, X.px()))
							end
							return getcustomasset(M)
						end)
						if t and U then
							f.cache[J] = U
						end
						return f.cache[J] or nil
					end
					function f.image(J, X, t)
						t = t or {}
						local U = B[X] and X or nil
						local M, c, K
						if U then
							M = B[U] * (t.SliceScale or 0.5)
							c, K = f.resolve(U, M)
						else
							c = X
						end
						local w = f.get(c)
						if not w then
							return nil
						end
						local L = f.specs[c]
						local c = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
						c.Name = t.Name or "Tex_" .. X
						c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						c.BorderSizePixel = 0
						c.Image = w
						if L.slice then
							c.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
							c.SliceCenter = L.slice
							c.SliceScale = K or t.SliceScale or 0.5
						elseif L.tile then
							c.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
							c.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(L.w, L.h)
						end
						for X, K in pairs(t) do
							if X ~= "Name" and X ~= "SliceScale" and X ~= "Parent" then
								c[X] = K
							end
						end
						c.Parent = J
						if U then
							f.tracked[c] = { kind = U, base = M }
						end
						return c
					end
					function f.retarget(J)
						local X = f.tracked[J]
						if not X then
							return
						end
						local t, U = f.resolve(X.kind, X.base)
						local X = f.get(t)
						local M = f.specs[t]
						if X and M then
							J.Image = X
							J.SliceCenter = M.slice
							J.SliceScale = U
						end
					end
					function f.setRadius()
						T.Refresh.run("texradius", f.retarget, function()
							for J in pairs(f.tracked) do
								f.retarget(J)
							end
						end)
					end
					table.insert(T.Refresh.full, f.retarget)
					function f.preload()
						if f.preloading then
							return
						end
						f.preloading = true
						f.cleanup()
						task.spawn(function()
							for J in pairs(f.specs) do
								pcall(f.get, J)
								task.wait()
							end
							for J in pairs(B) do
								for X, X in ipairs(R) do
									pcall(f.get, J .. "@" .. X)
									task.wait()
								end
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				do
					local f, J, X, t, R, B, U = T.U, T.Motion, T.Theme, T.Font, T.Icons, T.Sound, T.Tex
					local M, c, K = f.new, J.tween, X.bind
					local w, L = T.Services.UserInputService, T.Services.RunService
					local L = {}
					L.__index = L

						"Aurora",

						"Scanlines",
						"Noise",
						"Plain",
					}
					local function W(V)
						local r = M("TextLabel", {
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,

							TextYAlignment = V.AlignY or Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,

							ZIndex = V.Z or 1,

							Parent = V.Parent,

					end

						local _ = M("ImageLabel", {

					function T.tile(r, _)
						local q = U.image(r, _.Tex or "tile9", {
							Name = _.Name or "Tile",
							Size = _.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
							Position = _.Pos or UDim2.new(),
							AnchorPoint = _.Anchor or Vector2.zero,
							SliceScale = _.SliceScale or 0.5,
							ImageTransparency = _.Alpha or 0,
							ZIndex = _.Z or 1,
						})
						if q then
							K(q, "ImageColor3", _.Color or "Accent")
							return q, true
						end
						local q = M("Frame", {
							Name = _.Name or "Tile",
							Size = _.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
							Position = _.Pos or UDim2.new(),
							AnchorPoint = _.Anchor or Vector2.zero,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							BackgroundTransparency = _.Alpha or 0,
							ZIndex = _.Z or 1,
							Parent = r,
						})
						f.corner(q, _.Radius or math.floor(15 * (_.SliceScale or 0.5) + 0.5))
						K(q, "BackgroundColor3", _.Color or "Accent")
						return q, false
					end
					function T:CreateWindow(r)
						r = r or {}
						local _ = setmetatable({}, L)
						_.Tabs, _.TabList, _.Groups = {}, {}, {}
						_.Conns = {}
						_.Popups, _.Floats = {}, {}
						_.Key = r.Key or Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
						_.Size = r.Size or Vector2.new(860, 620)
						_.MinSize = r.MinSize or Vector2.new(660, 420)
						_.IsOpen = false
						_.FloatZ = 10
						_.Initial = tostring(r.Initial or string.sub(r.Title or "N", 1, 1))
						_.LogoAsset, _.LogoGlow = r.Logo, r.LogoGlow

					function L:_buildBackdrop()

					function L:_applyBackground()
						local r = self.BgLayers
						if not r then
							return
						end
						local _, q = self.BgStyle, self.BgIntensity
						local function u(s)
							return math.clamp(1 - (1 - s) * q, 0, 1)
						end
						local q = _ == "Aurora"
						if r.meshA then
							r.meshA.ImageTransparency = u(q and 0.84 or 0.965)
						end
						if r.meshB then
							r.meshB.ImageTransparency = u(q and 0.9 or 0.975)
						end
						if r.auraA then
							r.auraA.ImageTransparency = u(q and 0.84 or 0.9)
						end
						if r.auraB then
							r.auraB.ImageTransparency = u(q and 0.9 or 0.94)
						end
						local q = R[_]
						if q then
							local R = U.get(q.tex)
							if R then
								r.pattern.Image = R
								r.pattern.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
								local R = U.specs[q.tex]
								r.pattern.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(R.w, R.h)
								r.pattern.ImageTransparency = u(q.alpha)
							end
						else
							r.pattern.ImageTransparency = 1
						end
						if r.grain then
							r.grain.ImageTransparency = u(_ == "Noise" and 0.55 or 0.82)
						end
					end
					function L:SetBackground(R)
						T.trace("SetBackground")
						for r, r in ipairs(L.BackgroundStyles) do
							if r == R then
								self.BgStyle = R
								self.State.set("bgStyle", R)
								self:_applyBackground()
								return
							end
						end
					end
					function L:SetBackgroundIntensity(R)
						T.trace("SetBackgroundIntensity")
						self.BgIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(R) or 1, 0, 1.5)
						self.State.set("bgIntensity", self.BgIntensity)
						self:_applyBackground()
					end
					function L:SetOpacity(R)
						T.trace("SetOpacity")
						self.Opacity = math.clamp(tonumber(R) or 1, 0.5, 1)
						self.State.set("opacity", self.Opacity)
						self.Win.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - self.Opacity
						if self.Sidebar then
							self.Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + (1 - self.Opacity) * 0.7
						end
					end
					function L:SetCornerRadius(R)
						T.trace("SetCornerRadius")
						R = math.clamp(tonumber(R) or 1, 0, 2)
						self.State.set("radius", R)
						f.setRadius(R)
						U.setRadius()
					end
					function L:SetFont(R)
						T.trace("SetFont")
						if t.setFamily(R) then
							self.State.set("font", t.name)
						end
					end
					function L:SetTextScale(R)
						T.trace("SetTextScale")
						R = math.clamp(tonumber(R) or 1, 0.8, 1.3)
						self.State.set("textScale", R)
						t.setScale(R)
					end
					function L:SetSounds(R)
						B.enabled = R == true
						self.State.set("sounds", B.enabled)
					end
					function L:SetVolume(R)
						B.volume = math.clamp(tonumber(R) or 0.5, 0, 1)
						self.State.set("volume", B.volume)
					end
					function L:SetMotion(R)
						J.enabled = R == true
						self.State.set("motion", J.enabled)
					end
					function L:SetTooltips(R)
						self.TooltipsOn = R == true
						self.State.set("tooltips", self.TooltipsOn)
						if not self.TooltipsOn then
							self:HideTip()
						end
					end
					function L:SetLauncher(R)
						self.LauncherOn = R == true
						self.State.set("launcher", self.LauncherOn)
						if self.Launcher then
							self.Launcher.Visible = self.LauncherOn and not (self.IsTouch and self.IsOpen)
						end
					end
					function L:SetAccent(R)
						T.trace("SetAccent")
						if typeof(R) ~= "Color3" then
							return
						end
						X.set("Accent", R)
						self.State.set("accent", R:ToHex())
					end
					function L:_syncFooter()
						local R = T.keyName and T.keyName(self.Key) or self.Key.Name
						if self.FooterKey then
							self.FooterKey.Text = R
						end
						if self.LauncherParts and self.LauncherParts.key then
							self.LauncherParts.key.Text = R
						end
						if self.SidebarCollapsed and self.FooterText then
							self.FooterText.TextTransparency = 1
							self.FooterChip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
							self.FooterChip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
						end
					end
					function L:SetBase(R)
						T.trace("SetBase")
						if X.setBase(R) then
							self.State.set("base", R)
							self.State.set("panel", nil)
							self.PanelColor = nil
						end
					end
					function L:SetPanelColor(R)
						T.trace("SetPanelColor")
						if typeof(R) ~= "Color3" then
							return
						end
						self.PanelColor = R
						self.State.set("panel", R:ToHex())
						X.base = "Custom"
						if self._panelQueued then
							return
						end
						self._panelQueued = true
						task.delay(0.06, function()
							self._panelQueued = false
							if self.PanelColor and not self.Destroyed then
								X.setMany(X.panelFrom(self.PanelColor))
								X.base = "Custom"
							end
						end)
					end
					function L:OnKeyChanged(R)
						self.KeyListeners = self.KeyListeners or {}
						table.insert(self.KeyListeners, R)
					end
					function L:SetKey(R)
						if typeof(R) == "EnumItem" and R.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
							self.Key = R
							self.State.set("menuKey", R.Name)
							self:_syncFooter()
							for r, r in ipairs(self.KeyListeners or {}) do
								task.spawn(pcall, r, R)
							end
						end
					end
					function L:SetTitle(R, r)
						if R then
							self.TitleLabel.Text = R
						end
						if r then
							self.SubtitleLabel.Text = r
						end
					end
					function L:ResetAppearance()
						for R, R in ipairs({
							"accent",
							"radius",
							"font",
							"textScale",
							"scale",
							"autoFit",
							"blur",
							"bgStyle",
							"bgIntensity",
							"opacity",
							"tooltips",
							"launcher",
							"base",
							"cardStyle",
							"density",
							"watermark",
							"keybindList",
							"sidebarWidth",
							"panel",
						}) do
							self.State.data[R] = nil
						end
						self.State.save()
						self.PanelColor = nil
						local R = self.StateDefaults
						if type(R) == "table" then
							if R.base then
								self:SetBase(R.base)
							end
							if R.panel then
								pcall(function()
									self:SetPanelColor(Color3.fromHex(R.panel))
								end)
							end
							if R.accent then
								pcall(function()
									self:SetAccent(Color3.fromHex(R.accent))
								end)
							end
							self:SetCornerRadius(tonumber(R.radius) or 1)
							if R.font then
								self:SetFont(R.font)
							end
							self:SetTextScale(tonumber(R.textScale) or 1)
							self:SetScale(tonumber(R.scale) or self.DefaultScale)
							self:SetAutoFit(R.autoFit ~= false)
							self:SetBlur(R.blur == true)
							if R.bgStyle then
								self:SetBackground(R.bgStyle)
							end
							self:SetBackgroundIntensity(tonumber(R.bgIntensity) or 1)
							if R.cardStyle then
								self:SetCardStyle(R.cardStyle)
							end
							if R.density then
								self:SetDensity(R.density)
							end
							self:SetSidebarWidth(tonumber(R.sidebarWidth) or self.DefaultSidebarWidth)
							self:SetOpacity(tonumber(R.opacity) or 1)
							if R.groupLabels ~= nil and self.SetGroupLabels then
								self:SetGroupLabels(R.groupLabels)
							end
							if self.SetTooltips then
								self:SetTooltips(R.tooltips ~= false)
							end
							if R.launcher ~= nil and self.SetLauncher then
								self:SetLauncher(R.launcher)
							end
							self.State.save()
							if self.OnReset then
								pcall(self.OnReset)
							end
							return
						end
						X.setBase("Midnight")
						X.set("Accent", X.Presets.Crimson)
						self:SetCornerRadius(1)
						self:SetFont("Builder Sans")
						self:SetTextScale(1)
						self:SetScale(self.DefaultScale)
						self:SetAutoFit(true)
						self:SetBlur(false)
						self:SetBackground("Aurora")
						self:SetBackgroundIntensity(1)
						self:SetCardStyle("Glass")
						self:SetDensity("Comfortable")
						self:SetSidebarWidth(self.DefaultSidebarWidth)
						self:SetOpacity(1)
						self.State.data.accent = nil
						self.State.data.radius = nil
						self.State.data.font = nil
						self.State.data.textScale = nil
						self.State.data.scale = nil
						self.State.data.blur = nil
						self.State.data.bgStyle = nil
						self.State.data.bgIntensity = nil
						self.State.data.opacity = nil
						self.State.save()
						if self.OnReset then
							pcall(self.OnReset)
						end
					end

					function L:_drag(X)
						if typeof(X) ~= "Instance" then
							return
						end
						local R, r, _, q
						X.InputBegan:Connect(function(X)
							if not f.isClick(X) then
								return
							end
							R, r, _, q = true, X.Position, self.Root.Position, X
							local u
							u = X.Changed:Connect(function()
								if X.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
									R = false
									u:Disconnect()
									self:_savePos()
								end
							end)
						end)
						f.connect(w.InputChanged, function(X)
							if R and f.sameMove(X, q) then
								local R = X.Position - r
								self.Root.Position = UDim2.new(_.X.Scale, _.X.Offset + R.X, _.Y.Scale, _.Y.Offset + R.Y)
							end
						end, self.Conns)
					end
					function L:_savePos()
						if not (self.State and self.Root) then
							return
						end
						local X = self.Root.Position
						if math.abs(X.X.Scale - 0.5) > 0.001 or math.abs(X.Y.Scale - 0.5) > 0.001 then
							return
						end
						pcall(
							self.State.set,
							self.IsTouch and "touchPos" or "winPos",
							{ math.floor(X.X.Offset + 0.5), math.floor(X.Y.Offset + 0.5) }
						)
					end
					function L:_resize(X)
						local R, r, _, q, u
						X.InputBegan:Connect(function(X)
							if not f.isClick(X) then
								return
							end
							R, r, _, q, u =
								true,
								X.Position,
								self.Root.AbsoluteSize / math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1),
								self.Root.Position,
								X
							local s
							s = X.Changed:Connect(function()
								if X.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
									R = false
									s:Disconnect()
									if self.IsTouch then
										self.TouchSize = self.Size
										if self.State then
											pcall(
												self.State.set,
												"touchSize",
												{ math.floor(self.Size.X + 0.5), math.floor(self.Size.Y + 0.5) }
											)
										end
									elseif self.State then
										pcall(
											self.State.set,
											"size",
											{ math.floor(self.Size.X + 0.5), math.floor(self.Size.Y + 0.5) }
										)
									end
									self:_savePos()
								end
							end)
						end)
						f.connect(w.InputChanged, function(X)
							if R and f.sameMove(X, u) then
								local R = (X.Position - r) / math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
								local X, r = self.MinSize.X, self.MinSize.Y
								if self.IsTouch then
									local u = workspace.CurrentCamera
									local s = u and u.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
									local u = math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
									X, r = 360, 240
									R = Vector2.new(
										math.min(R.X, (s.X - 16) / u - _.X),
										math.min(R.Y, (s.Y - 16) / u - _.Y)
									)
								end
								local u = math.max(X, _.X + R.X)
								local X = math.max(r, _.Y + R.Y)
								self.Size = Vector2.new(u, X)
								self.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(u, X)
								local R = self.Scale.Scale
								self.Root.Position = UDim2.new(
									q.X.Scale,
									q.X.Offset + (u - _.X) * R / 2,
									q.Y.Scale,
									q.Y.Offset + (X - _.Y) * R / 2
								)
							end
						end, self.Conns)
					end
					function L:_syncLayers()
						local X = math.max((self.AutoScale or 1) * self.UserScale, 0.1)
						for R, R in ipairs({ { self.FloatLayer, self.FloatScale }, { self.PopLayer, self.PopScale } }) do
							R[2].Scale = X
							R[1].Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 / X, 1 / X)
						end
					end
					function T.screenFactor(X)
						if not X then
							local R = workspace.CurrentCamera
							X = R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1000)
						end
						local R = math.min(X.X / 1920, X.Y / 1000)
						if math.abs(R - 1) < 0.04 then
							R = 1
						end
						return f.clamp(R, 0.5, 1.3)
					end
					function L:_placeOnScreen(X)
						local R = workspace.CurrentCamera
						local r = R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
						X = X or self.Root.Position
						local R = (self.AutoScale or 1) * self.UserScale
						local _ = Vector2.new(self.Root.Size.X.Offset, self.Root.Size.Y.Offset) * R
						local R = X.X.Scale * r.X + X.X.Offset
						local q = X.Y.Scale * r.Y + X.Y.Offset
						local u, s, h = _.X / 2, _.Y / 2, 8
						local Y = _.X + h * 2 >= r.X and r.X / 2 or math.clamp(R, u + h, r.X - u - h)
						local u = _.Y + h * 2 >= r.Y and r.Y / 2 or math.clamp(q, s + h, r.Y - s - h)
						if math.abs(Y - R) < 0.5 and math.abs(u - q) < 0.5 then
							return X
						end
						return UDim2.new(
							X.X.Scale,
							math.floor(X.X.Offset + (Y - R) + 0.5),
							X.Y.Scale,
							math.floor(X.Y.Offset + (u - q) + 0.5)
						)
					end
					function L:OnScreenScale(X)
						table.insert(self.ScaleHooks, X)
						local R = workspace.CurrentCamera
						local r, _ = pcall(X, self.OverlayScale or 1, R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720))
						if r and _ == false then
							local R = table.find(self.ScaleHooks, X)
							if R then
								table.remove(self.ScaleHooks, R)
							end
						end
					end
					function L:SetAutoFit(X)
						T.trace("SetAutoFit")
						self.AutoFit = X == true
						self.State.set("autoFit", self.AutoFit)
						if not self.AutoFit and not self.IsTouch then
							self.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(self.Size.X, self.Size.Y)
						end
						if self._applyScale then
							self._applyScale(true)
						end
					end
					function L:_autoScale()
						local X = workspace.CurrentCamera
						local function R(r)
							local r = X and X.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
							local _ = self.AutoFit and T.screenFactor(r) or 1
							self.ScreenFactor = _
							self.OverlayScale = self.AutoFit and f.clamp(_, 0.6, 1.2) or 1
							if self.IsTouch then
								local q = f.clamp((r.Y - 16) / 440, 0.55, 1)
								local u = f.clamp(q * self.UserScale / math.max(self.DefaultScale or 1, 0.1), 0.45, 1.3)
								local q = math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.X, (r.X - 16) / u))
								local s = math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.Y, (r.Y - 16) / u))
								local h = self.TouchSize
								local Y, l
								if h then
									Y = math.floor(f.clamp(h.X, math.min(360, q), q))
									l = math.floor(f.clamp(h.Y, math.min(240, s), s))
								else
									Y = math.min(q, math.floor(r.X * 0.72 / u))
									l = math.min(s, math.floor(r.Y * 0.86 / u))
								end
								if self.Size.X ~= Y or self.Size.Y ~= l then
									self.Size = Vector2.new(Y, l)
									self.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Y, l)
								end
								self.AutoScale = u / math.max(self.UserScale, 0.1)
							elseif self.AutoFit then
								local q = math.max(self.UserScale, 0.1)
								local u = math.max(q * _, math.min(0.6, q))
								local _, s = r.X - 24, r.Y - 24
								local h, Y = self.Size.X, self.Size.Y
								h = math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.X, h), math.min(h, math.floor(_ / u)))
								Y = math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.Y, Y), math.min(Y, math.floor(s / u)))
								local l = math.min(1, _ / (h * u), s / (Y * u))
								local _ = UDim2.fromOffset(h, Y)
								if self.Root.Size ~= _ then
									self.Root.Size = _
								end
								self.AutoScale = f.clamp(u * l, 0.3, 1.8) / q
							else
								local _ = math.min(1, (r.X - 30) / self.Size.X, (r.Y - 30) / self.Size.Y)
								self.AutoScale = f.clamp(_, 0.45, 1)
							end
							self.Scale.Scale = self.AutoScale * self.UserScale
							self.ToastScale.Scale = f.clamp(math.min(self.OverlayScale, r.X / 900), 0.55, 1.2)
							self:_syncLayers()
							if not self.Scaling and not self.HomePos then
								local _ = self:_placeOnScreen(self.Root.Position)
								if _ ~= self.Root.Position then
									self.Root.Position = _
								end
							end
							for _ = #self.ScaleHooks, 1, -1.0 do
								local q, u = pcall(self.ScaleHooks[_], self.OverlayScale, r)
								if q and u == false then
									table.remove(self.ScaleHooks, _)
								end
							end
						end
						R()
						if X then
							f.connect(X:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), R, self.Conns)
						end
						self._applyScale = R
					end
					function L:SetScale(X)
						T.trace("SetScale")
						self.UserScale = f.clamp(tonumber(X) or 1, 0.6, 1.5)
						self.State.set("scale", self.UserScale)
						if self._applyScale then
							self._applyScale(true)
						end
					end
					function L:_launcher(X)

						f.list(
							Y,
				9,
							Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,

							Name = "Logo",

							Parent = Y,
						})
						if X.Logo then
							M("ImageLabel", {
								Name = "Mark",
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
								Image = X.Logo,
								ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
								ZIndex = 29,
								Parent = l,
							})
						else
							T.tile(l, {
								Name = "Face",
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								Color = "Accent",
								SliceScale = 0.5,
								Z = 28,
							})
							W({
								Parent = l,
								Text = tostring(X.Initial or string.sub(X.Title or "N", 1, 1)),
								Font = t.Heavy(),
								Size = 15,
								Box = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
								Color = "OnAccent",
								Z = 30,
							})

							Parent = Y,
							Text = tostring(X.Title or "Nova"),
							Font = t.Bold(),
							Size = 14,
							Box = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
							Auto = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							Z = 29,
							Name = "Title",
						})
						l.LayoutOrder = 2
						local X, x
						if not self.IsTouch then
							X = M("Frame", {
								Name = "Key",
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
								AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
								LayoutOrder = 3,
								ZIndex = 29,
								Parent = Y,
							})
							K(X, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
							f.corner(X, 6)
							f.pad(X, 0, 7, 0, 7)
							K(f.stroke(X, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 0.88), "Color", "Glass")
							x = W({
								Parent = X,
								Text = T.keyName and T.keyName(self.Key) or self.Key.Name,
								Font = t.Semi(),
								Size = 11,
								Box = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
								Auto = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
								Color = "Muted",
								Z = 30,
							})
						end
						local X = M("Frame", {
							Name = "Orb",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
							LayoutOrder = 4,
							ZIndex = 29,
							Parent = Y,
						})
						K(X, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
						f.corner(X, UDim.new(1, 0))
						local W = f.stroke(X, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 0.85)
						K(W, "Color", "Glass")
						local Y = V({
							Parent = X,
							Icon = "chevron-down",
							Size = 15,
							Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Color = "Muted",
							Z = 30,
						})
						self.LauncherParts = {
							btn = r,
							card = u,
							orb = X,
							orbStroke = W,
							chev = Y,
							glow = s,
							rim = h,
							key = x,
							scale = _,
							shadow = q,
						}
						local function X()
							local W = math.max(_.Scale, 0.1)
							local V = math.ceil(u.AbsoluteSize.X / W)
							if V > 0 and r.Size.X.Offset ~= V then
								r.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(V, 42)
							end
						end
						u:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(X)
						task.defer(X)
						local X = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						local W = TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						local V, u, s, x, S = false, false, nil, nil, nil
						r.InputBegan:Connect(function(k)
							if not f.isClick(k) then
								return
							end
							u, V, s, x, S = true, false, k.Position, r.Position, k
							c(_, X, { Scale = self.LauncherBase * 0.95 })
						end)
						f.connect(w.InputChanged, function(X)
							if u and f.sameMove(X, S) then
								local k = X.Position - s
								if k.Magnitude > 6 then
									V = true
								end
								if V then
									local X = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
									local s = math.clamp(x.X.Offset + k.X, 4, math.max(4, X.X - r.AbsoluteSize.X - 4))
									local y = math.clamp(x.Y.Offset + k.Y, 4, math.max(4, X.Y - r.AbsoluteSize.Y - 4))
									r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s, y)
								end
							end
						end, self.Conns)
						f.connect(w.InputEnded, function(X)
							if u and f.sameEnd(X, S) then
								u = false
								c(_, W, { Scale = self.LauncherBase })
								if V then
									R.set(
										"launcherPos",
										{ math.floor(r.Position.X.Offset), math.floor(r.Position.Y.Offset) }
									)
								else
									B.play("click")
									self:Toggle()
								end
							end
						end, self.Conns)
						r.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
							if h then
								c(h, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.2 })
							end
							if q then
								c(q, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.35 })
							end
							if not u then
								c(_, "Quick", { Scale = self.LauncherBase * 1.03 })
							end
							T.paint(l, "TextColor3", "Text", "Quick")
							if not self.IsOpen then
								T.paint(Y, "ImageColor3", "Text", "Quick")
							end
						end)
						f.leave(r, function()
							if h then
								c(h, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.45 })
							end
							if q then
								c(q, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.5 })
							end
							if not u then
								c(_, W, { Scale = self.LauncherBase })
							end
							if not self.IsOpen then
								T.paint(Y, "ImageColor3", "Muted", "Quick")
							end
						end)
						self.Launcher = r
						self:OnScreenScale(function(X)
							if not r.Parent then
								return false
							end
							self.LauncherBase = X
							if not u then
								_.Scale = X
							end
							task.defer(function()
								local X = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
								local R = r.Position
								local W = math.clamp(R.X.Offset, 4, math.max(4, X.X - r.AbsoluteSize.X - 4))
								local V = math.clamp(R.Y.Offset, 4, math.max(4, X.Y - r.AbsoluteSize.Y - 4))
								if W ~= R.X.Offset or V ~= R.Y.Offset then
									r.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W, V)
								end
							end)
						end)
						self:_launcherState(false, true)
					end
					function L:_launcherState(X, R)
						local W = self.LauncherParts
						if not W then
							return
						end
						local V = R and TweenInfo.new(0)
							or TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						c(W.chev, V, { Rotation = X and 180 or 0 })
						T.paint(W.chev, "ImageColor3", X and "Accent" or "Muted", V)
						T.paint(W.orb, "BackgroundColor3", X and "Accent" or "Elevated", V)
						c(W.orb, V, { BackgroundTransparency = X and 0.8 or 0.35 })
						T.paint(W.orbStroke, "Color", X and "Accent" or "Glass", V)
						c(W.orbStroke, V, { Transparency = X and 0.45 or 0.85 })
						if W.glow then
							c(W.glow, V, { ImageTransparency = X and 0.62 or 0.85 })
						end
					end
					function L:_input()
						f.connect(w.InputBegan, function(X)
							if self.Destroyed or self.Listening then
								return
							end
							if X.KeyCode == self.Key and self.Key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
								if w:GetFocusedTextBox() then
									return
								end
								self:Toggle()
							end
						end, self.Conns)
						f.connect(T.Services.RunService.RenderStepped, function()
							if not self.Tip.Visible then
								return
							end
							local X = w:GetMouseLocation()
							local R = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
							local w = self.Tip.AbsoluteSize
							local W = math.min(X.X + 14, R.X - w.X - 6)
							local V = math.min(X.Y + 18, R.Y - w.Y - 6)
							self.Tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W, V)
						end, self.Conns)
					end
					function L:ShowTip(X)
						if not X or X == "" or not self.TooltipsOn or self.IsTouch then
							return
						end
						self.TipToken = (self.TipToken or 0) + 1
						local R = self.TipToken
						task.delay(0.35, function()
							if self.TipToken ~= R or self.Destroyed then
								return
							end
							self.TipLabel.Text = T.tr(X)
							self.Tip.Visible = true
							self.Tip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							self.TipLabel.TextTransparency = 1
							c(self.Tip, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
							c(self.TipLabel, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 0 })
						end)
					end
					function L:HideTip()
						self.TipToken = (self.TipToken or 0) + 1
						self.Tip.Visible = false
					end
					function L:_acrylicStep()
						local X, R, w = self.AcrylicPart, self.AcrylicMesh, workspace.CurrentCamera
						if not (X and R and w) then
							return
						end
						if X.Parent ~= w then
							X.Parent = w
						end
						local W = self.Root
						local V, r = W.AbsolutePosition, W.AbsoluteSize
						if not W.Visible or r.X < 8 or r.Y < 8 then
							R.Scale = Vector3.zero
							return
						end
						local W = math.floor(14 * (f.radiusMult or 1) * math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1) * 0.3 + 0.5) + 2
						local function _(q, u)
							local s = w:ScreenPointToRay(q, u)
							return s.Origin + s.Direction * 0.001
						end
						local q = _(V.X + W, V.Y + W)
						local u = _(V.X + r.X - W, V.Y + W)
						local s = _(V.X + r.X - W, V.Y + r.Y - W)
						local W = w.CFrame
						X.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((q + s) / 2, W.XVector, W.YVector, W.ZVector)
						R.Scale = Vector3.new((u - q).Magnitude, (u - s).Magnitude, 0)
					end
					function L:_blur(X)
						local R = T.Services.RunService
						self.AcrylicToken = (self.AcrylicToken or 0) + 1
						local w = self.AcrylicToken
						if X and self.BlurEnabled and not self.Destroyed then
							local X = workspace.CurrentCamera
							if not X then
								return
							end
							if not (self.AcrylicDof and self.AcrylicDof.Parent) then
								self.AcrylicDof = M("DepthOfFieldEffect", {
									Name = "NovaDepth",
									FarIntensity = 0,
									FocusDistance = 51.6,
									InFocusRadius = 50,
									NearIntensity = 0,
									Parent = T.Services.Lighting,
								})
							end
							if not (self.AcrylicPart and self.AcrylicPart.Parent) then
								local W = Instance.new("Part")
								W.Name = "NovaGlass"
								W.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
								W.Transparency = 0.98
								W.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
								W.Anchored = true
								W.CanCollide = false
								W.CanQuery = false
								W.CanTouch = false
								W.CastShadow = false
								W.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0)
								local V = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
								V.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick
								V.Scale = Vector3.zero
								V.Parent = W
								W.Parent = X
								self.AcrylicPart, self.AcrylicMesh = W, V
							end
							if not self.AcrylicBound then
								self.AcrylicBound = "NovaAcrylic_" .. tostring(self.Gui and self.Gui.Name or "Nova")
								pcall(function()
									R:UnbindFromRenderStep(self.AcrylicBound)
								end)
								R:BindToRenderStep(self.AcrylicBound, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
									self:_acrylicStep()
								end)
							end
							c(self.AcrylicDof, "Slow", { NearIntensity = 1 })
							return
						end
						if self.AcrylicDof then
							c(self.AcrylicDof, "Quick", { NearIntensity = 0 })
						end
						local function X()
							if self.AcrylicToken ~= w then
								return
							end
							if self.AcrylicBound then
								local w = self.AcrylicBound
								self.AcrylicBound = nil
								pcall(function()
									R:UnbindFromRenderStep(w)
								end)
							end
							if self.AcrylicPart then
								pcall(function()
									self.AcrylicPart:Destroy()
								end)
								self.AcrylicPart, self.AcrylicMesh = nil, nil
							end
							if self.AcrylicDof then
								pcall(function()
									self.AcrylicDof:Destroy()
								end)
								self.AcrylicDof = nil
							end
						end
						if self.Destroyed then
							X()
						else
							task.delay(0.22, X)
						end
					end
					function L:SetBlur(X)
						T.trace("SetBlur")
						self.BlurEnabled = X == true
						self.State.set("blur", self.BlurEnabled)
						if self.IsOpen then
							self:_blur(self.BlurEnabled)
						end
					end
					local X = TweenInfo.new(0.44, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					local R = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					local w = TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					local W = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					function L:_launcherPoint()
						local V = self.Launcher
						if not (V and V.Visible and V.Parent and J.enabled) then
							return nil
						end
						local J = V.AbsolutePosition + V.AbsoluteSize / 2 - self.Gui.AbsolutePosition
						return UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(J.X), math.floor(J.Y))
					end
					function L:_scalingDefer(J)
						self.ScaleDeferred = self.ScaleDeferred or {}
						self.ScaleDeferred[J] = true
					end
					function L:_endScaling()
						self.Scaling = false
						local J = self.ScaleDeferred
						self.ScaleDeferred = nil
						if J then
							for V in pairs(J) do
								pcall(V)
							end
						end
					end
					function L:_stopGenie()
						for J, J in ipairs({ "GeniePos", "GenieScale" }) do
							if self[J] then
								pcall(function()
									self[J]:Cancel()
								end)
								self[J] = nil
							end
						end
					end
					function L:Open()
						T.trace("Open")
						if self.Destroyed or self.IsOpen then
							return
						end
						self.IsOpen = true
						self.OpenToken = (self.OpenToken or 0) + 1
						local J = self.OpenToken
						self:_stopGenie()
						local V = self:_placeOnScreen(self.HomePos or self.Root.Position)
						self.HomePos = nil
						self.Root.Position = V
						local r = self.GenieAnim and self:_launcherPoint() or nil
						if self.IsTouch and self.Launcher then
							self.Launcher.Visible = false
						end
						local _ = self.AutoScale * self.UserScale
						self.Win.GroupTransparency = 1
						if r then
							self.Scaling = true
							self.Root.Position = r
							self.Scale.Scale = _ * 0.12
							self:_syncLayers()
							self.Root.Visible = true
							self.FloatLayer.Visible = true
							self.GeniePos = c(self.Root, X, { Position = V })
							self.GenieScale = c(self.Scale, X, { Scale = _ })
							c(self.Win, w, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
							task.delay(X.Time + 0.03, function()
								if self.OpenToken == J then
									self:_endScaling()
								end
							end)
						else
							self:_endScaling()
							self.Scale.Scale = _
							self:_syncLayers()
							self.Root.Visible = true
							self.FloatLayer.Visible = true
							c(self.Win, w, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
						end
						if self.WindowShadow then
							self.WindowShadow.ImageTransparency = 1
							c(self.WindowShadow, "Slow", { ImageTransparency = 0.45 })
						end
						self:_blur(true)
						self:_launcherState(true)
						B.play("open")
						if not self.Current and self.TabList[1] then
							self:SelectTab(self.TabList[1])
						end
						task.defer(function()
							self:_layoutTabs(false)
						end)
					end
					function L:Close()
						T.trace("Close")
						if self.Destroyed or not self.IsOpen then
							return
						end
						self.IsOpen = false
						self.OpenToken = (self.OpenToken or 0) + 1
						local J = self.OpenToken
						self:ClosePopups()
						self:HideTip()
						self:_stopGenie()
						if self.Launcher then
							self.Launcher.Visible = self.LauncherOn
						end
						local X = self.AutoScale * self.UserScale
						local w = self.GenieAnim and self:_launcherPoint() or nil
						local V = 0.2
						if w then
							self.Scaling = true
							self.HomePos = self.Root.Position
							self.GeniePos = c(self.Root, R, { Position = w })
							self.GenieScale = c(self.Scale, R, { Scale = X * 0.12 })
							c(self.Win, W, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
							V = R.Time + 0.03
							local R = self.LauncherParts
							if R then
								task.delay(0.24, function()
									if self.OpenToken ~= J then
										return
									end
									c(
										R.scale,
										TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
										{ Scale = self.LauncherBase * 1.08 }
									)
									task.delay(0.12, function()
										c(
											R.scale,
											TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
											{ Scale = self.LauncherBase }
										)
									end)
								end)
							end
						else
							c(self.Win, "Exit", { GroupTransparency = 1 })
						end
						if self.WindowShadow then
							c(self.WindowShadow, "Exit", { ImageTransparency = 1 })
						end
						self:_blur(false)
						self:_launcherState(false)
						B.play("close")
						task.delay(V, function()
							if self.IsOpen or self.OpenToken ~= J then
								return
							end
							self:_stopGenie()
							self.Root.Visible = false
							if self.HomePos then
								self.Root.Position = self.HomePos
								self.HomePos = nil
							end
							self.Scale.Scale = X
							task.defer(function()
								if not self.IsOpen and self.OpenToken == J then
									self:_endScaling()
								end
							end)
						end)
					end
					function L:RegistryCount()
						return f.regCount()
					end
					function L:Toggle()
						if self.IsOpen then
							self:Close()
						else
							self:Open()
						end
					end
					function L:Destroy()
						if self.Destroyed then
							return
						end
						self.Destroyed = true
						self:_blur(false)
						for J, J in ipairs(self.Conns) do
							pcall(function()
								J:Disconnect()
							end)
						end
						pcall(function()
							self.Gui:Destroy()
						end)
						pcall(function()
							self.Parking:Destroy()
						end)
						if self.OnDestroy then
							pcall(self.OnDestroy)
						end
					end
					function L:ClosePopups()
						for J, J in ipairs(self.Popups) do
							pcall(J.close)
						end
						self.Popups = {}
						self.Catcher.Visible = false
					end
					function L:OpenPopup(J)
						T.trace("OpenPopup")
						self:ClosePopups()
						table.insert(self.Popups, J)
						self.Catcher.Visible = true
					end
					function L:PointerOverUI()
						if self.Destroyed then
							return false
						end
						local J = f.mouse()
						local function X(R)
							if not R or not R.Visible then
								return false
							end
							local w, W = R.AbsolutePosition, R.AbsoluteSize
							return J.X >= w.X and J.X <= w.X + W.X and J.Y >= w.Y and J.Y <= w.Y + W.Y
						end
						if self.IsOpen and X(self.Root) then
							return true
						end
						for J, J in ipairs({ self.FloatLayer, self.PopLayer }) do
							for R, R in ipairs(J:GetChildren()) do
								if R:IsA("GuiObject") and X(R) then
									return true
								end
							end
						end
						if X(self.KeybindFrame) or X(self.WatermarkFrame) or X(self.FlingFrame) then
							return true
						end
						return X(self.Launcher)
					end
					T.WindowClass.PopIn = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					T.WindowClass.PopOut = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					function L:PopupShell(J, X)
						local R = M("Frame", {
							Name = "PopupFrame",

							Name = "Popup",

							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							GroupTransparency = 1,

					function L:PopupPlace(J, X, R, U)
						local w = math.max(self.PopScale.Scale, 0.1)
						local W = self.PopLayer.AbsolutePosition
						local V = (J.AbsolutePosition - W) / w
						local W = J.AbsoluteSize / w
						local J = self.PopLayer.AbsoluteSize / w
						local w = U == "left" and V.X or V.X + W.X - X
						w = math.clamp(w, 8, math.max(8, J.X - X - 8))
						local X = V.Y + W.Y + 6
						local W = false
						if X + R > J.Y - 8 then
							X = math.max(8, V.Y - R - 6)
							W = true
						end
						return w, X, U == "left" and 0 or 1, W and 1 or 0
					end

					local X = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					local R = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					function L:PopupReveal(U, w, W, V)
						local r = V and 1 or 0
						if W then
							W.Scale = 1
						end
						w.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, r)
						w.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, r)
						w.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
						w.GroupTransparency = 1
						c(w, J, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
						c(w, X, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
						local X = U:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
						if X then
							X.ImageTransparency = 1
							c(X, J, { ImageTransparency = 0.4 })
						end
					end
					function L:PopupConceal(J, X)
						c(X, R, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), GroupTransparency = 1 })
						local X = J:FindFirstChild("Shadow")
						if X then
							c(X, R, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
						end
					end
					function L:PopupOrigin(J, X, R)
						J.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(X or 0.5, R or 0.5)
						J.Position = UDim2.fromScale(X or 0.5, R or 0.5)
					end

					function L:_ensureGroup()

					function L:SetGroupCollapsed(X, W)
						if type(X) == "string" then
							for s, s in ipairs(self.Groups) do
								if s.Key == X then
									X = s
									break
								end
							end
						end
						if type(X) ~= "table" then
							return
						end
						X.Collapsed = W == true
						local W = self.State.get("groups", {})
						if type(W) ~= "table" then
							W = {}
						end
						W[X.Key] = X.Collapsed or nil
						self.State.data.groups = W
						self.State.save()
						if X.Chev then
							M(X.Chev, "Base", { Rotation = X.Collapsed and -90.0 or 0 })
						end
						self:_layoutTabs(true)
					end
					local function X(W, s)
						if type(W) ~= "table" then
							return math.huge
						end
						for l, n in ipairs(W) do
							if n == s then
								return l
							end
						end
						return math.huge
					end
