							end
							if self.Current ~= W then
								R.play("click", 0.8)
							end
							self:SelectTab(W)
						end)
						local s = self.State.get("tabOrder", {})
						local E = type(s) == "table" and s[l.Key] or nil
						local s = X(E, W.Name)
						local n = #l.Tabs + 1
						if s ~= math.huge then
							for O, N in ipairs(l.Tabs) do
								if X(E, N.Name) > s then
									n = O
									break
								end
							end
						end
						table.insert(l.Tabs, n, W)
						self:_layoutTabs(false)
					end
					function L:_styleTab(X, W, s)
						if not X.Row then
							return
						end
						local l = s and "Base" or TweenInfo.new(0)
						local s, E = X.TileProp, X.TileAlphaProp
						if W then
							Q(X.Tile, s, "Accent", l)
							M(X.Tile, l, { [E] = 0 })
							Q(X.IconImg, "ImageColor3", "OnAccent", l)
							Q(X.Label, "TextColor3", "Text", l)
							local W = self.SidebarCollapsed
							M(X.Bg, l, { BackgroundTransparency = W and 1 or 0.42 })
							Q(X.BgStroke, "Color", "Accent", l)
							M(X.BgStroke, l, { Transparency = W and 1 or 0.72 })
							if X.Glow then
								M(X.Glow, l, { ImageTransparency = 0.5 })
							end
						else
							Q(X.Tile, s, "Elevated", l)
							M(X.Tile, l, { [E] = H(self, X.Hover) })
							Q(X.IconImg, "ImageColor3", X.Hover and "Text" or "Muted", l)
							Q(X.Label, "TextColor3", X.Hover and "Text" or "Muted", l)
							M(X.Bg, l, { BackgroundTransparency = X.Hover and 0.6 or 1 })
							M(X.BgStroke, l, { Transparency = 1 })
							if X.Glow then
								M(X.Glow, l, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
							end
						end
					end
					local function X(W, s, l, E, H)
						local n = W.Row
						W.TargetY = s
						W.RowToken = (W.RowToken or 0) + 1
						local O = W.RowToken
						local N = UDim2.fromOffset(8, s)
						local s = UDim2.new(1, -16.0, 0, H)
						if not E then
							n.Position, n.Size = N, s
							n.GroupTransparency = l and 1 or 0
							n.Visible = not l
							return
						end
						if not l then
							n.Visible = true
						end
						M(n, y, { Position = N, Size = s, GroupTransparency = l and 1 or 0 })
						if l then
							task.delay(0.36, function()
								if W.RowToken == O then
									n.Visible = false
								end
							end)
						end
					end
					function L:_layoutTabs(W)
						if not self.TabCanvas then
							return
						end
						if not J.enabled then
							W = false
						end
						local J = self.SidebarCollapsed
						local s = J and h or self.RowH
						local l = self.GroupLabels ~= false
						local E = 4
						for H, H in ipairs(self.Groups) do
							if H.Row and not l then
								H.Row.Visible = false
								H.Row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, E)
								H.Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16.0, 0, 0)
							elseif H.Row then
								H.Row.Visible = true
								local n = J and (H == C(self) and 6 or x) or self.CapH
								H.Row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, E)
								if W then
									M(H.Row, y, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, E), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16.0, 0, n) })
								else
									H.Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16.0, 0, n)
								end
								E += n
							end
							local x = H.Collapsed and not J and l
							local J = E
							for y, y in ipairs(H.Tabs) do
								if y ~= self.DraggingTab then
									X(y, x and J or E, x, W, s)
								end
								if not x then
									E += s + Y
								end
							end
							if #H.Tabs > 0 and not x and l then
								E += 4
							end
						end
						self.TabCanvas.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, E + 6)
					end
					function L:SetGroupLabels(J)
						J = J ~= false
						if J == (self.GroupLabels ~= false) then
							return
						end
						self.GroupLabels = J
						self.State.set("groupLabels", J)
						if J and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
							for X, X in ipairs(self.Groups) do
								if X.Row then
									X.Label.TextTransparency, X.Chev.ImageTransparency = 1, 1
									M(X.Label, "Base", { TextTransparency = 0 })
									M(X.Chev, "Base", { ImageTransparency = 0 })
								end
							end
						end
						self:_layoutTabs(true)
						if self.OnGroupLabels then
							pcall(self.OnGroupLabels, J)
						end
					end
					function L:_revealTab(J)
						local X, W = self.TabScroll, J and J.Row
						if not X or not W then
							return
						end
						local J = W.Position.Y.Offset
						local s = J + W.Size.Y.Offset
						local W = X.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
						local l = X.CanvasPosition.Y
						local x = l
						if J - 6 < l then
							x = math.max(0, J - 6)
						elseif s + 6 > l + W then
							x = s + 6 - W
						end
						if math.abs(x - l) < 1 then
							return
						end
						M(X, "Base", { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, x) })
					end
					function L:SetSidebarCollapsed(J, X)
						J = J == true
						if J == self.SidebarCollapsed and not X then
							return
						end
						self.SidebarCollapsed = J
						self.State.set("sidebarCollapsed", J)
						local W = J and _ or self.ExpandedWidth
						self.SidebarWidth = W
						local s = X and TweenInfo.new(0)
							or TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						M(self.Sidebar, s, { Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 1, 0) })
						self.Main.Size = UDim2.new(1, -W, 1, 0)
						M(self.Main, s, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W, 0) })
						M(self.SidebarEdge, s, { Position = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, 0) })
						self.SidebarEdge.Visible = not J
						local W = X and TweenInfo.new(0) or "Base"
						local l = I(J)
						M(self.LogoButton, s, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(l.logoX, l.logoY) })
						M(self.SearchField.Parent, s, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, l.searchY) })
						M(
							self.TabClip,
							s,
							{
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, l.tabTop),
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(l.tabTop + l.foot + 2)),
							}
						)
						M(self.Footer, s, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, l.foot) })
						M(self.TitleLabel, W, { TextTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
						M(self.SubtitleLabel, W, { TextTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
						M(self.FooterText, W, { TextTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
						M(self.FooterChip, s, {
							AnchorPoint = J and Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) or Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
							Position = J and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) or UDim2.new(1, -14.0, 0.5, 1),
						})
						self.FoldButton.Visible = not J
						self.SearchField.Parent.Visible = true
						self.SearchField.Visible = not J
						self.SearchTile.Visible = J
						for l, l in ipairs(self.Groups) do
							if l.Row then
								M(l.Label, W, { TextTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
								M(l.Chev, W, { ImageTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
								M(l.Line, W, { BackgroundTransparency = J and (C(self) == l and 1 or 0.88) or 1 })
							end
							for x, x in ipairs(l.Tabs) do
								local l = J and S or self.TileS
								local y = J and (_ - 16 - S) / 2 or 6
								x.BgGrad.Enabled, x.StrokeGrad.Enabled = not J, not J
								M(x.Tile, s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(l, l), Position = UDim2.new(0, y, 0.5, 0) })
								M(x.IconImg, s, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(J and k or 16, J and k or 16) })
								self:_styleTab(x, self.Current == x, not X)
								M(x.Label, W, { TextTransparency = J and 1 or 0 })
								if x.Glow then
									M(x.Glow, s, { Position = UDim2.new(0, y + l / 2, 0.5, 0) })
								end
								if x.Badge then
									if J then
										M(
											x.Badge,
											s,
											{
												Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
												Position = UDim2.new(0, y + l - 2, 0.5, -l / 2 + 4),
											}
										)
										M(x.BadgeLabel, W, { TextTransparency = 1 })
										M(x.BadgeRing, W, { Transparency = 0 })
									else
										M(x.Badge, s, {
											Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x.BadgeWidth, 18),
											Position = UDim2.new(1, -9.0, 0.5, 0),
										})
										M(x.BadgeLabel, W, { TextTransparency = 0 })
										M(x.BadgeRing, W, { Transparency = 1 })
									end
								end
							end
						end
						self:_layoutTabs(not X)
						if self.OnSidebarChanged then
							pcall(self.OnSidebarChanged, J)
						end
					end
					function L:SetDensity(J)
						local X = false
						for W, W in ipairs(L.Densities) do
							if W == J then
								X = true
							end
						end
						if not X then
							return
						end
						self.Density = J
						self.State.set("density", J)
						L.applyDensity(self)
						if not self.SidebarCollapsed then
							for J, J in ipairs(self.Groups) do
								for X, X in ipairs(J.Tabs) do
									local J = self.TileS
									M(X.Tile, "Base", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(J, J) })
									M(X.Label, "Base", {
										Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.LabelX, 0),
										Size = UDim2.new(1, -(self.LabelX + 10), 1, 0),
									})
									if X.Glow then
										M(X.Glow, "Base", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 6 + J / 2, 0.5, 0) })
									end
								end
							end
						end
						self:_layoutTabs(true)
					end
					function L:SetSidebarWidth(J, X)
						T.trace("SetSidebarWidth")
						local W = math.min(u, math.max(q, (self.Size and self.Size.X or 860) - 420))
						J = math.clamp(tonumber(J) or r, q, W)
						self.ExpandedWidth = J
						if not X then
							self.State.set("sidebarWidth", math.floor(J + 0.5))
						end
						if self.OnSidebarWidth then
							pcall(self.OnSidebarWidth, J)
						end
						if self.SidebarCollapsed then
							return
						end
						self.SidebarWidth = J
						local W = X and TweenInfo.new(0)
							or TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						M(self.Sidebar, W, { Size = UDim2.new(0, J, 1, 0) })
						self.Main.Size = UDim2.new(1, -J, 1, 0)
						M(self.Main, W, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(J, 0) })
						M(self.SidebarEdge, W, { Position = UDim2.new(0, J, 0, 0) })
					end
					function L:ToggleSidebar()
						self:SetSidebarCollapsed(not self.SidebarCollapsed)
					end
					local function J(X)
						return (f.at(X.PressInput).Y - X.TabCanvas.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(X.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
					end
					function L:_reorderMove()
						local X = self.PressTab
						if not X and not self.DraggingTab then
							return
						end
						if not self.DraggingTab then
							local W = f.at(self.PressInput)
							if self.IsTouch and os.clock() - (self.PressTime or 0) < 0.35 then
								if (W - self.PressAt).Magnitude >= 9 then
									self.PressTab = nil
								end
								return
							end
							if (W - self.PressAt).Magnitude < 9 then
								return
							end
							self.DraggingTab = X
							self.DragOffset = J(self) - (X.TargetY or 0)
							X.Row.ZIndex = 10
							self:HideTip()
							M(X.Bg, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 })
							Q(X.BgStroke, "Color", "Accent", "Quick")
							M(X.BgStroke, "Quick", { Transparency = 0.35 })
							if X.Glow then
								M(X.Glow, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.5 })
							end
							R.play("tick")
						end
						local X = self.DraggingTab
						if not X then
							return
						end
						self:_tabPopFeedback(X)
						local W = X.Group
						local r = self.SidebarCollapsed and h or self.RowH
						local _ = W.Tabs[1] and W.Tabs[1].TargetY or 0
						local q = _
						local u = _ + math.max(0, #W.Tabs - 1) * (r + Y)
						local s = math.clamp(J(self) - self.DragOffset, q - 8, u + 8)
						X.Row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, s)
						local J = s + r / 2
						local q = 1
						local u = _
						for _ = 1, #W.Tabs do
							if W.Tabs[_] ~= X then
								if J > u + r / 2 then
									q += 1
								end
								u += r + Y
							end
						end
						q = math.clamp(q, 1, #W.Tabs)
						local J
						for r, _ in ipairs(W.Tabs) do
							if _ == X then
								J = r
							end
						end
						if J and J ~= q then
							table.remove(W.Tabs, J)
							table.insert(W.Tabs, q, X)
							self:_layoutTabs(true)
							R.play("tick", 0.6)
						end
					end
					function L:_tabPopFeedback(J)
						local X = f.at(self.PressInput)
						local W = self.Sidebar.AbsolutePosition.X + self.Sidebar.AbsoluteSize.X
						local r = X.X > W + 46 * math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1) and #J.Sections > 0
						if not self.TabGhost then
							local W = U("CanvasGroup", {
								Name = "TabGhost",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 44),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								GroupTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = 400,
								Parent = self.FloatLayer,
							})
							c(W, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
							f.corner(W, 14)
							local U = B.image(
								W,
								"rim9",
								{ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), SliceScale = 1, ImageTransparency = 0.3, ZIndex = 402 }
							)
							if U then
								c(U, "ImageColor3", "Accent")
							else
								c(f.stroke(W, V, 1, 0.4), "Color", "Accent")
							end
							local U = B.image(self.FloatLayer, "shadow9", {
								Name = "TabGhostShadow",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 100),
								SliceScale = 1,
								ImageTransparency = 1,
								Visible = false,
								ZIndex = 399,
							})
							T.tile(W, {
								Name = "Tile",
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
								Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
								Color = "Accent",
								Z = 401,
							})
							local B = w({
								Parent = W,
								Icon = "layout-panel-top",
								Size = 15,
								Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
								Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Color = "OnAccent",
								Z = 403,
							})
							local c = K({
								Parent = W,
								Text = "",
								Font = t.Semi(),
								Size = 13,
								Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 0),
								Box = UDim2.new(1, -52.0, 1, 0),
								Truncate = true,
								Z = 403,
							})
							self.TabGhost = { Frame = W, Shadow = U, Icon = B, Label = c }
						end
						local t = self.TabGhost
						local B = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
						local U = (X - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / B
						t.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(U.X + 96, U.Y)
						if t.Shadow then
							t.Shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(U.X + 96, U.Y + 6)
						end
						if r ~= self.TabPopIntent then
							self.TabPopIntent = r
							t.Label.Text = J.Label and J.Label.Text or J.Name
							if J.IconImg and J.IconImg.Image ~= "" then
								t.Icon.Image, t.Icon.ImageRectOffset, t.Icon.ImageRectSize =
									J.IconImg.Image, J.IconImg.ImageRectOffset, J.IconImg.ImageRectSize
								t.Icon.Visible = true
							end
							if r then
								t.Frame.Visible = true
								if t.Shadow then
									t.Shadow.Visible = true
								end
								R.play("click", 0.7)
							end
							M(t.Frame, "Base", { GroupTransparency = r and 0 or 1 })
							if t.Shadow then
								M(t.Shadow, "Base", { ImageTransparency = r and 0.45 or 1 })
							end
							M(J.Row, "Quick", { GroupTransparency = r and 0.45 or 0 })
							if not r then
								task.delay(0.2, function()
									if not self.TabPopIntent then
										t.Frame.Visible = false
										if t.Shadow then
											t.Shadow.Visible = false
										end
									end
								end)
							end
						end
					end
					function L:_reorderEnd()
						local J = self.DraggingTab
						self.PressTab = nil
						if not J then
							return
						end
						self.DraggingTab = nil
						self.LastDragEnd = os.clock()
						if self.TabPopIntent then
							self.TabPopIntent = false
							local X = self.TabGhost
							if X then
								M(X.Frame, "Quick", { GroupTransparency = 1 })
								if X.Shadow then
									M(X.Shadow, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 1 })
								end
								task.delay(0.2, function()
									X.Frame.Visible = false
									if X.Shadow then
										X.Shadow.Visible = false
									end
								end)
							end
							M(J.Row, "Quick", { GroupTransparency = 0 })
							local X = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
							local t = (f.at(self.PressInput) - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / X
							self:FloatTab(J, t - Vector2.new(80, 20))
						end
						J.Row.ZIndex = 1
						self:_styleTab(J, self.Current == J, true)
						self:_layoutTabs(true)
						local f = {}
						for J, J in ipairs(self.Groups) do
							local X = {}
							for t, t in ipairs(J.Tabs) do
								table.insert(X, t.Name)
							end
							f[J.Key] = X
						end
						self.State.data.tabOrder = f
						self.State.save()
						if self.OnTabOrder then
							pcall(self.OnTabOrder, f)
						end
					end
				end
				do
					local f, J, X, t, R, R, B = T.U, T.Motion, T.Theme, T.Font, T.Icons, T.Sound, T.Tex
					local U, M, c = f.new, J.tween, X.bind
					local K, w, L = T.label, T.icon, T.paint
					local W = T.WindowClass
					local V = T.Services.UserInputService
					local r = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					local _ = {}
					_.__index = _
					T.TabClass = _
					local q = {}
					q.__index = q
					T.SectionClass = q
					local u = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					function W:Tab(s)
						if type(s) == "string" then
							s = { Name = s }
						end
						s = s or {}
						local h = setmetatable({}, _)
						h.Window = self
						h.Name = s.Name or "Tab " .. #self.TabList + 1
						h.Title = s.Title or h.Name
						h.Desc = s.Desc or ""
						h.Icon = s.Icon
						h.Rows, h.Sections, h.Pages, h.Loads = {}, {}, {}, {}
						h.Columns = s.Columns or 2
						self.Tabs[h.Name] = h
						table.insert(self.TabList, h)
						self:_addTabRow(h, s)
						local s = U("CanvasGroup", {
							Name = h.Name,
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = false,
							Parent = self.Parking or self.Body,
						})
						h.Frame = s
						h.RefreshGen = T.Refresh.gen
						h.PageHost = U(
							"Frame",
							{ Name = "Pages", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = s }
						)
						return h
					end
					function _:_setActive(s)
						self.Window:_styleTab(self, s, true)
					end
					function W:SelectTab(s)
						T.trace("SelectTab")
						if type(s) == "string" then
							s = self.Tabs[s]
						end
						if not s or s == self.Current then
							return
						end
						local h = self.Current
						self.Current = s
						self:ClosePopups()
						if s.Group and s.Group.Collapsed and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
							self:SetGroupCollapsed(s.Group, false)
						end
						if h then
							self:_styleTab(h, false, true)
							local Y = h.Frame
							M(Y, "Quick", { GroupTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-14.0, 0) })
							task.delay(0.16, function()
								if self.Current ~= h then
									Y.Visible = false
									if self.Parking then
										Y.Parent = self.Parking
										h.RefreshGen = T.Refresh.gen
									end
								end
							end)
						end
						self:_styleTab(s, true, true)
						self:_revealTab(s)
						local h = s.Frame
						if h.Parent ~= self.Body then
							h.Parent = self.Body
							if s.RefreshGen ~= T.Refresh.gen then
								T.Refresh.sync(h)
								s.RefreshGen = T.Refresh.gen
							end
						end
						h.Visible = true
						h.GroupTransparency = 1
						h.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
						M(h, "Base", { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) })
						task.delay(0.2, function()
							if self.Current == s then
								s:_balanceActive()
							end
						end)
						self.HeaderTitle.Text = s.Title
						self.HeaderDesc.Text = s.Desc or ""
						if self.OnTabChanged then
							pcall(self.OnTabChanged, s)
						end
					end
					local s, h, Y, l, x = 46, 7, 40, 360, "  ›  "
					local S = { tab = 30, sub = 22, section = 10, row = 0 }
					local function k(y)
						y = string.lower(tostring(y or ""))
						y = string.gsub(y, "<[^>]->", "")
						y = string.gsub(y, "\208([\144-\159])", function(Q)
							return "\208" .. string.char(string.byte(Q) + 32)
						end)
						y = string.gsub(y, "\208([\160-\175])", function(Q)
							return "\209" .. string.char(string.byte(Q) - 32)
						end)
						y = string.gsub(y, "\208([\129\132\134\135])", function(Q)
							return "\209" .. string.char(string.byte(Q) + 16)
						end)
						return y
					end
					local function y(Q)
						return (string.gsub(tostring(Q or ""), "<[^>]->", ""))
					end
					local function Q(E)
						E = string.gsub(E, "&", "&amp;")
						E = string.gsub(E, "<", "&lt;")
						E = string.gsub(E, ">", "&gt;")
						return E
					end
					local function E(I, C, H)
						local n, O = string.find(k(I), C, 1, true)
						if not n then
							return Q(I)
						end
						return Q(string.sub(I, 1, n - 1))
							.. '<font color="#'
							.. H
							.. '">'
							.. Q(string.sub(I, n, O))
							.. "</font>"
							.. Q(string.sub(I, O + 1))
					end
					function W:_searchSubLabel(I, C)
						local H = C and C.Key
						if not H or H == "_" or not I.SubButtons then
							return nil
						end
						local C = I.SubButtons[H]
						return y(C and C.Label and C.Label.Text or H)
					end
					function W:_searchCollect()
						local I = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(self.TabList) do
							local H = y(C.Label and C.Label.Text or C.Name)
							local n = k(H .. " " .. tostring(C.Name))
							table.insert(
								I,
								{ kind = "tab", tab = C, title = H, path = T.tr("Tab"), hay = n, titleL = k(H) }
							)
							if C.SubDefs and C.SubButtons then
								for O, O in ipairs(C.SubDefs) do
									local N = C.SubButtons[O.key]
									local z = y(N and N.Label and N.Label.Text or O.label or O.key)
									table.insert(I, {
										kind = "sub",
										tab = C,
										sub = O.key,
										title = z,
										path = H,
										hay = k(z .. " " .. tostring(O.key)) .. " " .. n,
										titleL = k(z),
									})
								end
							end
							for n, n in ipairs(C.Sections) do
								if not n.Hidden and n.TitleLabel and not n.ParentSection then
									local O = self:_searchSubLabel(C, n.Page)
									local N = y(n.TitleLabel.Text)
									local z = O and H .. x .. O or H
									table.insert(I, {
										kind = "section",
										tab = C,
										sec = n,
										title = N,
										path = z,
										hay = k(N .. " " .. tostring(n.Key) .. " " .. z),
										titleL = k(N),
									})
								end
							end
							for n, n in ipairs(C.Rows) do
								local O = n.row
								if
									O
									and O.Title
									and not O.selfHidden
									and not O.parentHidden
									and O.Frame
									and O.Frame.Parent
								then
									local N, z, D = n.sec, {}, true
									while N and N.ParentSection do
										if N.OwnerRow and (N.OwnerRow.selfHidden or N.OwnerRow.parentHidden) then
											D = false
										end
										table.insert(z, N)
										N = N.ParentSection
									end
									local n = y(O.Title.Text)
									if D and N and not N.Hidden and n ~= "" then
										local D = { H }
										local H = self:_searchSubLabel(C, N.Page)
										if H then
											table.insert(D, H)
										end
										if N.TitleLabel then
											table.insert(D, y(N.TitleLabel.Text))
										end
										for H = #z, 1, -1.0 do
											local b = z[H].OwnerRow
											if b and b.Title then
												table.insert(D, y(b.Title.Text))
											end
										end
										local y = table.concat(D, x)
										local x = (O.Desc and O.Desc.Text or "")
											.. " "
											.. tostring(O.Opts and O.Opts.Text or "")
										if O.SearchOptions then
											local H, D = pcall(O.SearchOptions)
											if H and type(D) == "string" then
												x = x .. " " .. D
											end
										end
										table.insert(I, {
											kind = "row",
											tab = C,
											sec = N,
											row = O,
											chain = z,
											title = n,
											path = y,
											hay = k(n .. " " .. x .. " " .. y),
											titleL = k(n),
										})
									end
								end
							end
						end
						return I
					end
					function W:_searchRank(x)
						local y = k(x)
						y = string.gsub(y, "^%s+", "")
						y = string.gsub(y, "%s+$", "")
						if y == "" then
							return {}, y
						end
						local x = {}
						for k in string.gmatch(y, "%S+") do
							table.insert(x, k)
						end
						local k, I = {}, {}
						for C, C in ipairs(self:_searchCollect()) do
							local H = 0
							local n = string.find(C.titleL, y, 1, true)
							if n == 1 then
								H = 120
							elseif n then
								H = 70
							end
							local O, N = true, n ~= nil
							for n, n in ipairs(x) do
								if string.find(C.titleL, n, 1, true) then
									H += 18
									N = true
								elseif string.find(C.hay, n, 1, true) then
									H += 4
								else
									O = false
									break
								end
							end
							if O and (N or C.kind ~= "row") then
								local x = C.kind .. "|" .. C.title .. "|" .. C.path
								if not I[x] then
									I[x] = true
									C.score = H + S[C.kind] - #C.titleL / 40
									table.insert(k, C)
								end
							end
						end
						table.sort(k, function(x, S)
							return x.score > S.score
						end)
						while #k > Y do
							table.remove(k)
						end
						return k, y
					end
					function W:_searchClose()
						local Y = self.SearchPop
						if not Y then
							return
						end
						self.SearchPop = nil
						self:PopupConceal(Y.Frame, Y.Shell)
						task.delay(0.18, function()
							pcall(function()
								Y.Frame:Destroy()
							end)
						end)
					end
					function W:_searchOpen(Y)
						if self.SearchPop then
							return self.SearchPop
						end
						local x, S, k = self:PopupShell(l, Y)
						x.Name = "SearchResults"
						local y = U("ScrollingFrame", {
							Name = "List",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -10.0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ScrollBarThickness = 2,
							CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
							ZIndex = 61,
							Parent = S,
						})
						c(y, "ScrollBarImageColor3", "Faint")
						f.list(y, 2)
						f.pad(y, 0, 5, 0, 5)
						local I = K({
							Parent = S,
							Text = T.tr("Nothing found"),
							Font = t.Medium(),
							Size = 13,
							Color = "Muted",
							AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
							Box = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							Z = 62,
						})
						I.Visible = false
						local C = { Frame = x, Shell = S, List = y, Empty = I, Rows = {}, Items = {}, Sel = 1, H = Y }
						self.SearchPop = C
						local y, I, H, H = self:PopupPlace(self.SearchField, l, Y, "left")
						x.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(y, I)
						self:PopupReveal(x, S, k, H == 1)
						table.insert(self.Popups, {
							close = function()
								if self.SearchPop == C then
									self:_searchClose()
								end
							end,
						})
						return C
					end
					function W:_searchSelect(Y)
						local x = self.SearchPop
						if not x or #x.Rows == 0 then
							return
						end
						Y = math.clamp(Y, 1, #x.Rows)
						x.Sel = Y
						for S, k in ipairs(x.Rows) do
							M(k, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = S == Y and 0.84 or 1 })
						end
						local S = x.List
						local x = math.max(self.PopScale.Scale, 0.1)
						local k = (Y - 1) * (s + 2)
						local Y = S.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / x
						local x = S.CanvasPosition.Y
						if k < x then
							S.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, k)
						elseif Y > 1 and k + s > x + Y then
							S.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, k + s - Y)
						end
					end
					function W:_searchRender(Y, x)
						local S = self.SearchPop
						if not S then
							return
						end
						for k, k in ipairs(S.Rows) do
							k:Destroy()
						end
						S.Rows, S.Items = {}, Y
						S.Empty.Visible = #Y == 0
						local k = X.resolve("Accent"):ToHex()
						for y, I in ipairs(Y) do
							local C = U("TextButton", {
								Name = "Result",
								Text = "",
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, s),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								LayoutOrder = y,
								ZIndex = 62,
								Parent = S.List,
							})
							c(C, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
							f.corner(C, 9)
							local H = U("Frame", {
								Name = "Tile",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),

								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),

								BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
								ZIndex = 63,
								Parent = C,
							})
							c(H, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")

							w({

								Icon = I.tab.Icon or "search",

								Color = "Accent",

							K({

								Parent = C,
								Text = Q(I.path),
								Rich = true,

								Size = 11,
								Color = "Muted",

								Box = UDim2.new(1, -58.0, 0, 15),
								Truncate = true,
								Z = 63,
							})
							C.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
								if S.Sel ~= y then
									self:_searchSelect(y)
								end
							end)
							C.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
								self:_searchJump(I)
							end)
							table.insert(S.Rows, C)
						end
						local x = #Y == 0 and 56 or math.min(#Y, h) * (s + 2) + 8
						if S.H ~= x then
							S.H = x
							M(
								S.Frame,
								TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
								{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(l, x) }
							)
						end
						S.List.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
						S.Sel = 1
						self:_searchSelect(1)
					end
					function W:_searchFlash(Y)
						if not Y or not Y.Parent then
							return
						end
						local l = U("Frame", {
							Name = "SearchFlash",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = 0,
							Parent = Y,
						})
						c(l, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
						f.corner(l, 10)
						local Y = f.stroke(l, r, 1.5, 1)
						c(Y, "Color", "Accent")
						local x = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
						local S = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
						task.spawn(function()
							for k = 1, 2 do
								M(l, x, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 })
								M(Y, x, { Transparency = 0.25 })
								task.wait(0.24)
								M(l, S, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
								M(Y, S, { Transparency = 1 })
								task.wait(0.56)
							end
							l:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					function W:_searchScroll(Y, l)
						if not Y or Y.Floating then
							return
						end
						local x = Y.Page and Y.Page.Scroll
						if not x or not l or not l.Parent then
							return
						end
						local Y = math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
						local S = (l.AbsolutePosition.Y - x.AbsolutePosition.Y) / Y + x.CanvasPosition.Y
						local l = x.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / Y
						local k = math.max(0, x.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y / Y - l)
						local Y = math.clamp(S - l * 0.3, 0, k)
						M(
							x,
							TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
							{ CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, Y) }
						)
					end
					function W:_searchJump(Y)
						if not Y or not Y.tab then
							return
						end
						local l = Y.tab
						self:_searchClose()
						self.SearchBox.Text = ""
						pcall(function()
							self.SearchBox:ReleaseFocus()
						end)
						R.play("click")
						if self.Current ~= l then
							self:SelectTab(l)
						end
						if Y.kind == "tab" then
							return
						end
						local x = Y.sec
						local S = Y.sub or x and x.Page and x.Page.Key
						if S and l.SubButtons and l.SubButtons[S] and l.ActiveSub ~= S then
							l:SelectSub(S)
						end
						if Y.kind == "sub" then
							return
						end
						if x and x.Collapsed then
							x:SetCollapsed(false)
						end
						local l = Y.chain or {}
						for S = #l, 1, -1.0 do
							local k = l[S].OwnerToggle
							if k and k.SetDrawer and k.IsDrawerOpen and not k:IsDrawerOpen() then
								k:SetDrawer(true)
							end
						end
						local l = Y.kind == "row" and Y.row.Frame or x and x.Wrap
						local S = Y.kind == "row" and Y.row.Frame or x and x.Card
						task.delay(0.4, function()
							if self.Destroyed or not l or not l.Parent then
								return
							end
							self:_searchScroll(x, l)
							task.delay(0.35, function()
								self:_searchFlash(S)
							end)
						end)
					end
					function W:Search(Y)
						T.trace("Search")
						if self.Query ~= "" then
							for l, l in ipairs(self.TabList) do
								for x, x in ipairs(l.Rows) do
									if x.searchHidden then
										x.searchHidden = false
										x.refresh()
									end
								end
								for x, x in ipairs(l.Sections) do
									x:_refreshVisibility()
								end
								if l.Label and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
									M(l.Label, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 0 })
								end
								if l.IconImg then
									M(l.IconImg, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0 })
								end
							end
						end
						self.Query = ""
						local l = tostring(Y or "")
						if not string.find(l, "%S") then
							self:_searchClose()
							return
						end
						local Y, x = self:_searchRank(l)
						local l = #Y == 0 and 56 or math.min(#Y, h) * (s + 2) + 8
						self:_searchOpen(l)
						self:_searchRender(Y, x)
					end
					function _:_page(s)
						s = s or "_"
						local h = self.Pages[s]
						if h then
							return h
						end
						local Y = self.Columns == 1 or self.PageColumns ~= nil and self.PageColumns[s] == 1
						local l = self.SubBar and 48 or 0
						local x = U("CanvasGroup", {
							Name = "Clip_" .. tostring(s),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, l),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -l),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = s == "_" or s == self.ActiveSub,
							Parent = self.PageHost,
						})
						local l = U("ScrollingFrame", {
							Name = "Page_" .. tostring(s),
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ScrollBarThickness = 3,
							ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,
							CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
							AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
							Parent = x,
						})
						local S = U("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Parent = x })
						local function k()
							if self.Window.Scaling then
								self.Window:_scalingDefer(k)
								return
							end
							local y = x.AbsoluteSize.Y
							if y < 60 then
								return
							end
							local Q = math.clamp(l.CanvasPosition.Y / 12, 0, 1)
							local E = math.clamp(
								(l.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - l.CanvasPosition.Y - l.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y) / 12,
				0,
								1
							)
							local I = math.min(22 / y, 0.3)
							S.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Q * 0.9),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(I, 0),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1 - I, 0),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, E * 0.9),
							})
						end
						l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(k)
						l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteCanvasSize"):Connect(k)
						l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(k)
						task.defer(k)
						c(l, "ScrollBarImageColor3", "Faint")
						f.pad(l, 6, 0, 22, 0)
						local S = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Columns",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -44.0, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Parent = l,
						})
						local k = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Left",
							Size = UDim2.new(Y and 1 or 0.5, Y and 0 or -8.0, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Parent = S,
						})
						f.list(k, 16)
						local y = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Right",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
							Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -8.0, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Visible = not Y,
							Parent = S,
						})
						f.list(y, 16)
						h = { Root = x, Scroll = l, Left = k, Right = y, Load = { 0, 0 }, Key = s, Cols = S, One = Y }
						local x =
							U("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 16), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
						local Q = false
						local function E()
							if self.Window.Scaling then
								self.Window:_scalingDefer(E)
								return
							end
							local I = math.max(self.Window.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
							local C = l.AbsoluteSize.X / I
							local I = not Y and C < 440
							if I == Q then
								return
							end
							Q = I
							if I then
								k.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
								y.AnchorPoint, y.Position, y.Size = Vector2.zero, UDim2.new(), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
								k.LayoutOrder, y.LayoutOrder = 1, 2
								x.Parent = S
							else
								x.Parent = nil
								k.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -8.0, 0, 0)
								y.AnchorPoint, y.Position, y.Size =
									Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -8.0, 0, 0)
							end
						end
						l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(E)
						task.defer(E)
						self.Pages[s] = h
						return h
					end
					function _:SubTabs(s)
						if self.SubBar then
							return
						end
						local h = {}
						for Y, Y in ipairs(s or {}) do
							if type(Y) == "string" then
								Y = { key = Y, label = Y }
							end
							if type(Y) == "table" and Y.key then
								table.insert(h, Y)
							end
						end
						if #h == 0 then
							return
						end
						self.SubDefs = h
						for s, s in ipairs(h) do
							if s.Columns then
								self.PageColumns = self.PageColumns or {}
								self.PageColumns[s.key] = s.Columns
							end
						end
						local s = U("Frame", {
							Name = "SubBar",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Parent = self.Frame,
						})
						self.SubBar = s
						local Y = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Shell",
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 6),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Parent = s,
						})
						c(Y, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface")
						f.corner(Y, 11)
						c(f.stroke(Y, r, 1, 0.9), "Color", "Glass")
						local l = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Pill",
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 30),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							ZIndex = 2,
							Parent = Y,
						})
						c(l, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
						f.corner(l, 9)
						c(f.stroke(l, r, 1, 0.88), "Color", "Glass")
						self.SubPill = l
						local l = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Row",
							Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = 3,
							Parent = Y,
						})
						f.list(
							l,
				2,
							Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
							Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
						)
						f.pad(l, 3, 3, 3, 3)
						self.SubButtons = {}
						for x, S in ipairs(h) do
							local k = U("TextButton", {
								Name = S.key,
								Text = "",
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
								AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
								LayoutOrder = x,
								ZIndex = 4,
								Parent = l,
							})
							local l = f.pad(k, 0, 15, 0, 15)
							local x = K({
								Parent = k,
								Text = S.label or S.key,
								Font = t.Semi(),
								Size = 13,
								Box = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
								Auto = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
								Color = "Muted",
								Z = 4,
							})
							local y = f.textReg[x]
							self.SubButtons[S.key] =
								{ Button = k, Label = x, Def = S, Pad = l, Base = y and y.size or 13 }
							k.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
								if self.ActiveSub ~= S.key then
									L(x, "TextColor3", "Text", "Quick")
								end
								R.play("hover", 0.4)
							end)
							f.leave(k, function()
								if self.ActiveSub ~= S.key then
									L(x, "TextColor3", "Muted", "Quick")
								end
							end)
							k.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
								if self.ActiveSub ~= S.key then
									R.play("tick")
								end
								self:SelectSub(S.key)
							end)
						end
						for l, l in pairs(self.Pages) do
							l.Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48)
							l.Root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -48.0)
						end
						self.ActiveSub = h[1].key
						local function h()
							self:_placePill(true)
						end
						Y:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
							self:_queueFitSubs()
							if self.Window.Scaling then
								self.Window:_scalingDefer(h)
								return
							end
							h()
						end)
						s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
							self:_queueFitSubs()
						end)
						task.defer(function()
							self:_placePill(true)
						end)
						self:_queueFitSubs()
					end
					function _:_queueFitSubs()
						if self.FitQueued then
							return
						end
						self.FitQueued = true
						task.delay(0.06, function()
							self.FitQueued = false
							local s = self.Window
							if not s or s.Destroyed then
								return
							end
							if s.Scaling then
								s:_scalingDefer(function()
									self:_queueFitSubs()
								end)
								return
							end
							pcall(self._fitSubs, self)
						end)
					end
					function _:_fitSubs()
						local s, h = self.SubBar, self.SubPill
						local Y = h and h.Parent
						if not (s and Y and self.SubButtons) then
							return
						end
						local h = Y.AbsoluteSize.Y / 36
						if h <= 0.01 then
							return
						end
						local l = s.AbsoluteSize.X / h
						if l < 60 then
							return
						end
						if not self.SubFitAvail or math.abs(self.SubFitAvail - l) > 2 then
							self.SubFitAdj = 1
						end
						self.SubFitAvail = l
						local x = self.SubFitAdj or 1
						local S, k = 0, 0
						for y, y in pairs(self.SubButtons) do
							local Q = y.Label.TextSize
							if Q <= 0 then
								return
							end
							S += 1
							k += y.Label.AbsoluteSize.X / h * (y.Base * f.textScale) / Q
						end
						if S == 0 or k <= 0 then
							return
						end
						k = k / x
						local h = (S - 1) * 2 + 6
						local x, y, Q = 22, 15, 1
						if k + S * 30 + h + 44 > l then
							x = 10
							y = math.floor((l - x * 2 - h - k) / (2 * S))
							if y >= 6 then
								y = math.min(y, 15)
							else
								y = 6
								Q = (l - x * 2 - h - S * 12) / k
								if Q < 0.75 then
									y, x = 3, 4
									Q = (l - x * 2 - h - S * 6) / k
								end
								Q = math.clamp(Q, 0.6, 1)
							end
						end
						local h = false
						if Y.Position.X.Offset ~= x then
							Y.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 6)
							h = true
						end
						for l, l in pairs(self.SubButtons) do
							if l.Pad and l.Pad.PaddingLeft.Offset ~= y then
								l.Pad.PaddingLeft, l.Pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, y), UDim.new(0, y)
								h = true
							end
							local S = math.max(8, math.floor(l.Base * Q + 0.5))
							local k = f.textReg[l.Label]
							if k and k.size ~= S then
								k.size = S
								t.sizeOne(l.Label)
								h = true
							end
						end
						self.SubFit = { margin = x, pad = y, f = Q }
						if h then
							task.defer(function()
								self:_placePill(true)
							end)
						end
						task.delay(0.08, function()
							if not (Y.Parent and s.Parent) then
								return
							end
							local h = Y.AbsoluteSize.Y / 36
							if h <= 0.01 then
								return
							end
							local l = (Y.AbsolutePosition.X + Y.AbsoluteSize.X - s.AbsolutePosition.X) / h
							if l > s.AbsoluteSize.X / h - 2 and (self.SubFitAdj or 1) > 0.8 then
								self.SubFitAdj = (self.SubFitAdj or 1) - 0.04
								pcall(self._fitSubs, self)
							end
						end)
					end
					function _:_placePill(s)
						local h = self.SubButtons and self.SubButtons[self.ActiveSub]
						if not h or not self.SubPill or not self.SubPill.Parent then
							return
						end
						local Y = self.SubPill.Parent
						local l = Y.AbsoluteSize.Y / 36
						if l <= 0.01 then
							return
						end
						local x = (h.Button.AbsolutePosition.X - Y.AbsolutePosition.X) / l
						local Y = h.Button.AbsoluteSize.X / l
						if Y <= 1 then
							return
						end
						local h = { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Y, 30) }
						if s then
							self.SubPill.Position, self.SubPill.Size = h.Position, h.Size
						else
							M(self.SubPill, TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), h)
						end
						for h, Y in pairs(self.SubButtons) do
							L(
								Y.Label,
								"TextColor3",
								h == self.ActiveSub and "Text" or "Muted",
								s and TweenInfo.new(0) or "Quick"
							)
						end
					end
					function _:SelectSub(s)
						if not self.SubButtons or not self.SubButtons[s] or s == self.ActiveSub then
							return
						end
						local h = self.ActiveSub
						self.ActiveSub = s
						self.Window:ClosePopups()
						self:_placePill(false)
						local Y = self.Pages[h]
						local h = self:_page(s)
						if Y then
							Y.Root.Visible = false
						end
						h.Root.Visible = true
						h.Root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 48)
						M(h.Root, "Base", { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48) })
						task.delay(0.2, function()
							if self.ActiveSub == s then
								self:_balanceActive()
							end
						end)
						if self.OnSubChanged then
							pcall(self.OnSubChanged, s)
						end
					end
					function _:_balance(s, h)
						if not s or s.One or self.Columns == 1 then
							return
						end
						local Y = self.Window
						if Y.Destroyed or not s.Root.Visible then
							return
						end
						if Y.Scaling then
							if (h or 0) < 12 then
								task.delay(0.25, function()
									self:_balance(s, (h or 0) + 1)
								end)
							end
							return
						end
						local l = math.max(Y.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
						local Y, x = {}, 0
						for S, k in ipairs(self.Sections) do
							if k.Page == s and not k.ParentSection and k.Wrap and k.Wrap.Parent then
								table.insert(Y, { sec = k, k = S })
								if not k.Pinned and not k.Floating then
									x += 1
								end
							end
						end
						if x == 0 then
							return
						end
						local x = {}
						for S, S in ipairs(Y) do
							local k = S.sec
							local S = 0
							if k.Floating then
								S = k.Slot and k.Slot.Visible and k.Slot.AbsoluteSize.Y / l or 0
							elseif not k.Hidden and k.Wrap.Visible then
								S = k.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.Y / l
								if S < 2 then
									if (h or 0) < 12 then
										task.delay(0.25, function()
											self:_balance(s, (h or 0) + 1)
										end)
									end
									return
								end
							end
							x[k] = S
						end
						local h = { 0, 0 }
						for l, l in ipairs(Y) do
							local S = l.sec
							local k
							if S.Pinned or S.Floating then
								k = S.Side or 1
							else
								k = h[1] <= h[2] + 1 and 1 or 2
								local y = k == 1 and s.Left or s.Right
								if S.Wrap.Parent ~= y then
									S.Wrap.Parent = y
								end
								S.Side = k
							end
							local y = S.Floating and S.Slot or S.Wrap
							if y then
								y.LayoutOrder = l.k
							end
							if x[S] > 0 then
								h[k] += x[S] + 16
							end
						end
						s.BalancedCount = #Y
					end
					function _:_balanceActive(s)
						local h = self.Pages[self.ActiveSub or "_"] or self.Pages._
						if not h then
							return
						end
						local Y = 0
						for l, l in ipairs(self.Sections) do
							if l.Page == h and not l.ParentSection then
								Y += 1
							end
						end
						if not s and h.BalancedCount == Y then
							return
						end
						self:_balance(h)
					end
					function _:_queueBalance(s)
						if s.BalanceQueued then
							return
						end
						s.BalanceQueued = true
						task.delay(0.4, function()
							s.BalanceQueued = false
							if self.Window.Current == self and s.Root.Visible then
								self:_balanceActive()
							end
						end)
					end

						function x._sync()

					function q:SetTitle(_)
						self.TitleLabel.Text = tostring(_)
					end
					function q:_refreshVisibility()
						local _ = false
						for s, s in ipairs(self.Rows) do
							if s.Frame.Visible then
								_ = true
								break
							end
						end
						local s = self.Window.Query or ""
						if self.Floating then
							self.Wrap.Visible = not self.Hidden
						else
							self.Wrap.Visible = not self.Hidden and (s == "" or _)
						end
					end
					function q:SetVisible(_)
						self.Hidden = not _
						self:_refreshVisibility()
					end
					function q:SetCollapsed(_, s)
						_ = _ == true
						if _ == self.Collapsed then
							return
						end
						self.Collapsed = _
						local h = self.Window
						local Y = h.State.get("collapsed", {})
						if type(Y) ~= "table" then
							Y = {}
						end
						Y[self.Key] = _ or nil
						h.State.data.collapsed = Y
						h.State.save()
						local Y, l = self.Body, self.Content
						local x = math.max(h.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
						self.BodyToken = (self.BodyToken or 0) + 1
						local h = self.BodyToken
						local S = (s or not J.enabled) and TweenInfo.new(0) or "Base"
						M(self.Chev, S, { Rotation = _ and -90.0 or 0 })
						M(self.HeadLine, S, { BackgroundTransparency = _ and 1 or 0.5 })
						local J = math.ceil(l.AbsoluteSize.Y / x) + 16
						if _ then
							Y.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
							Y.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, s and 0 or J)
							if not s then
								M(Y, u, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) })
							end
						else
							Y.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
							if s then
								Y.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
								Y.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
							else
								M(Y, u, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, J) })
								task.delay(0.34, function()
									if self.BodyToken == h and not self.Collapsed then
										Y.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
										Y.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
									end
								end)
							end
						end
					end
					function q:IsCollapsed()
						return self.Collapsed == true
					end
					function q:Float(J)
						self.Window:FloatSection(self, J)
					end
					function q:Dock()
						self.Window:DockSection(self)
					end
					function q:_row(J)
						self.Order += 1
						self.Tab.Loads[self.Page.Key] = (self.Tab.Loads[self.Page.Key] or 0) + 1
						if not self.ParentSection then
							self.Page.Load[self.Side] += 1
						end
						local _ = self.Window
						local q = J.Desc
						local u = self.Nested == true
						local s = J.Height or (q and (u and 46 or 50) or (u and 33 or 38))
						local h = (J.Indent or 0) * 14

							Name = J.Name or "Row",

							BackgroundTransparency = 1,

							Parent = J.Parent or self.Content,
						})
						local l = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Hover",

							local x = U("Frame", {

								Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -16.0),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								Parent = Y,
							})
							c(x, "BackgroundColor3", X.accentSoft(0.45))
							f.corner(x, UDim.new(1, 0))
						end
						local x = { Frame = Y, Hover = l, Section = self, Opts = J, Indent = h }
						local S = 10 + h
						x.Title = K({
							Parent = Y,
							Text = J.Text or "",
							Font = t.Medium(),
							Size = u and 13 or 14,
							Color = u and function(u)
								return u.Text:Lerp(u.Muted, 0.22)
							end or nil,
							Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(S, q and 8 or 0),
							Box = UDim2.new(1, -(S + (J.Reserve or 70)), 0, q and 18 or s),
							Truncate = true,
							Rich = J.Rich,
						})
						if q then
							x.Desc = K({
								Parent = Y,
								Text = q,
								Font = t.Regular(),
								Size = 12,
								Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(S, 27),
								Box = UDim2.new(1, -(S + (J.Reserve or 70)), 0, 16),
								Color = "Muted",
								Truncate = true,
							})
						end
						x.Right = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Right",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(1, -10.0, 0.5, 0),
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							ZIndex = 2,
							Parent = Y,
						})
						f.list(
							x.Right,
				8,
							Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
							Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
						)
						local function q()
							if _.Scaling then
								_:_scalingDefer(q)
								return
							end
							local u = math.max(_.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
							if x.OnWidth then
								x.OnWidth(Y.AbsoluteSize.X / u)
							end
							if J.Reserve == 0 or not x.Right.Visible then
								return
							end
							local s = x.Right.AbsoluteSize.X / u
							local h = Y.AbsoluteSize.X / u - S - s - 16
							x.Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(h, 40), x.Title.Size.Y.Scale, x.Title.Size.Y.Offset)
							if x.Desc then
								x.Desc.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(h, 40), 0, 16)
							end
						end
						x.fitTitle = q
						x.Right:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(q)
						Y:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(q)
						task.defer(q)
						x.selfHidden = false
						x.parentHidden = false
						x.searchHidden = false
						local q = { sec = self, searchHidden = false, row = x }
						function q.text()
							local u = x.Title and x.Title.Text or ""
							if x.Desc then
								u = u .. " " .. x.Desc.Text
							end
							if x.SearchExtra then
								u = u .. " " .. x.SearchExtra()
							end
							return string.lower(u)
						end
						function x.isVisible()
							return not (x.selfHidden or x.parentHidden or q.searchHidden)
						end
						function q.refresh()
							Y.Visible = x.isVisible()
							if x.OnRefresh then
								x.OnRefresh()
							end
						end
						x.Entry = q
						table.insert(self.Tab.Rows, q)
						table.insert(self.Rows, x)
						function x.setHover(u)
							M(l, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = u and 0.55 or 1 })
						end
						Y.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
							x.setHover(true)
							if J.Tooltip then
								_:ShowTip(J.Tooltip)
							end
						end)
						f.leave(Y, function()
							x.setHover(false)
							if J.Tooltip then
								_:HideTip()
							end
						end)
						function x.SetText(J)
							x.Title.Text = tostring(J)
						end
						function x.SetDesc(J)
							if x.Desc then
								x.Desc.Text = tostring(J)
							end
						end
						function x.SetVisible(J)
							x.selfHidden = not J
							q.refresh()
							self:_refreshVisibility()
						end
						function x.SetParentHidden(J)
							x.parentHidden = J == true
							q.refresh()
							self:_refreshVisibility()
						end
						function x.hit()
							local J = U("TextButton", {
								Name = "Hit",
								Text = "",
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								ZIndex = 1,
								Parent = Y,
							})
							return J
						end
						return x
					end
					W.CardStyles = {
						"Glass",
						"Frosted",
						"Tinted",
						"Flat",
					}
					function W:_applyCardStyle(J)
						local _ = self.CardStyle or "Glass"
						local q = J.Card
						if not q then
							return
						end
						local u = X.resolve("Accent")
						if _ == "Flat" then
							q.BackgroundTransparency = 0
							J.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(r)
							if J.Gloss then
								J.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 1
							end
							if J.Grain then
								J.Grain.ImageTransparency = 1
							end
						elseif _ == "Frosted" then
							q.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
							J.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(r, Color3.fromRGB(220, 222, 230))
							if J.Gloss then
								J.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.72
							end
							if J.Grain then
								J.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.9
							end
						elseif _ == "Tinted" then
							q.BackgroundTransparency = 0.03
							J.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(r:Lerp(u, 0.05), r:Lerp(u, 0.34))
							if J.Gloss then
								J.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.88
							end
							if J.Grain then
								J.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.94
							end
						else
							q.BackgroundTransparency = 0.03
							J.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(r, Color3.fromRGB(208, 210, 218))
							if J.Gloss then
								J.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.9
							end
							if J.Grain then
								J.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.94
							end
						end
					end
					function W:SetCardStyle(J)
						T.trace("SetCardStyle")
						for X, X in ipairs(W.CardStyles) do
							if X == J then
								self.CardStyle = J
								self.State.set("cardStyle", J)
								for J, J in ipairs(self.TabList) do
									for X, X in ipairs(J.Sections) do
										self:_applyCardStyle(X)
									end
								end
								return
							end
						end
					end
					function W:_nextZ()
						self.FloatZ += 1
						return self.FloatZ
					end
					function W:_initCards()
						f.connect(V.InputChanged, function(J)
							if self.CardPress and f.sameMove(J, self.CardPress.input) then
								self:_cardMove()
							end
						end, self.Conns)
						f.connect(V.InputEnded, function(J)
							if f.sameEnd(J, self.CardPress and self.CardPress.input) then
								self:_cardEnd()
							end
						end, self.Conns)
					end
					function W:_cardPress(J, X)
						self.CardPress = { sec = J, at = f.at(X), t = os.clock(), input = X }
						if J.Floating then
							J.Wrap.ZIndex = self:_nextZ()
						end
					end
					function W:_cardMove()
						local J = self.CardPress
						if not J then
							return
						end
						local X = J.sec
						local V = f.at(J.input)
						local _ = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
						if not self.CardDrag then
							local q = (V - J.at).Magnitude
							if X.Floating then
								if q < 4 then
									return
								end
							else
								if self.IsTouch and os.clock() - J.t < 0.35 then
									if q >= 10 then
										self.CardPress = nil
									end
									return
								end
								if q < 12 or os.clock() - J.t < 0.08 then
									return
								end
								local J = (X.Card.AbsolutePosition - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / _
								self:FloatSection(X, J)
								R.play("click", 0.8)
							end
							local J = (X.Wrap.AbsolutePosition - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / _
							self.CardDrag = {
								sec = X,
								grab = (V - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / _ - J,
								fresh = not X.WasFloating,
							}
							self:HideTip()
							M(X.Shadow, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = 0.25 })
						end
						local J = self.CardDrag
						local q = (V - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / _ - J.grab
						local J = self.FloatLayer.AbsoluteSize / _
						local V = X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize / _
						q = Vector2.new(math.clamp(q.X, 8 - V.X + 80, J.X - 80), math.clamp(q.Y, 4, J.Y - 40))
						X.Wrap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(q.X, q.Y)
						if X.Slot and X.SlotStroke then
							local J = X.Slot.AbsolutePosition + X.Slot.AbsoluteSize / 2
							local V = X.Wrap.AbsolutePosition
								+ Vector2.new(X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, math.min(X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2, 40))
							local q = self.IsOpen and X.Tab == self.Current and (J - V).Magnitude < 110 * _
							if q ~= X.NearSlot then
								X.NearSlot = q
								M(X.SlotStroke, "Quick", { Transparency = q and 0.2 or 0.86 })
								if X.SlotGlow then
									M(X.SlotGlow, "Quick", { ImageTransparency = q and 0.7 or 1 })
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function W:_cardEnd()
						local J = self.CardPress
						self.CardPress = nil
						local J = self.CardDrag
						if not J then
							return
						end
						self.CardDrag = nil
						self.LastCardDrag = os.clock()
						local X = J.sec
						M(X.Shadow, "Base", { ImageTransparency = 0.3 })
						if X.NearSlot then
							X.NearSlot = false
							self:DockSection(X)
							return
						end
						local J = X.Wrap.Position
						local V = self.State.get("floats", {})
						if type(V) ~= "table" then
							V = {}
						end
						V[X.Key] = { math.floor(J.X.Offset), math.floor(J.Y.Offset) }
						self.State.data.floats = V
						self.State.save()
					end
					function W:FloatSection(J, X)
						T.trace("FloatSection")
						if J.Floating or self.Destroyed then
							return
						end
						local V, _ = J.Wrap, J.Card
						local _ = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
						local q = V.AbsoluteSize / _
						local u = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Slot",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(44, q.Y)),
							LayoutOrder = V.LayoutOrder,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Parent = V.Parent,
						})
						local s = U("Frame", {
							Name = "Ghost",
							Size = UDim2.new(1, -4.0, 1, -4.0),
							Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
							Parent = u,
						})
						c(s, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface")
						f.corner(s, 14)
						J.SlotStroke = f.stroke(s, r, 1, 0.86)
						c(J.SlotStroke, "Color", "Accent")
						J.SlotGlow = B.image(u, "glow", {
							Name = "Glow",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 60, 1, 60),
							ImageTransparency = 1,
						})
						if J.SlotGlow then
							c(J.SlotGlow, "ImageColor3", "Accent")
						end
						local r = w({
							Parent = s,
							Icon = "picture-in-picture-2",
							Size = 20,
							Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42),
							Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Color = "Faint",
						})
						K({
							Parent = s,
							Text = T.tr("Floating · drag back to dock"),
							Font = t.Medium(),
							Size = 12,
							Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.42),
							Box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
							AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
							Color = "Faint",
						}).Position =
							UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.42, 16)
						J.Slot = u
						V.Parent = self.FloatLayer
						V.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.floor(q.X), 0, math.floor(q.Y))
						local r = X or (V.AbsolutePosition - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / _
						V.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.X, r.Y)
						V.ZIndex = self:_nextZ()
						J.Floating = true
						J.WasFloating = true
						table.insert(self.Floats, J)
						if J.Shadow then
							J.Shadow.ImageTransparency = 0.3
						end
						if J.Rim then
							J.Rim.ImageTransparency = 0.3
						end
						local X = U("TextButton", {
							Name = "Dock",
							Text = "",
							AutoButtonColor = false,
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
							LayoutOrder = 9,
							ZIndex = 7,
							Parent = J.Accessory,
						})
						local V, V = T.tile(X, {
							Name = "Face",
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							Color = "Elevated",
							Alpha = 0.3,
							Z = 7,
						})
						local V = w({
							Parent = X,
							Icon = "undo-2",
							Size = 13,
							Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Color = "Muted",
							Z = 8,
						})
						X.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
							L(V, "ImageColor3", "Text", "Quick")
							self:ShowTip("Return to window")
						end)
						f.leave(X, function()
							L(V, "ImageColor3", "Muted", "Quick")
							self:HideTip()
						end)
						X.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
							self:HideTip()
							R.play("click")
							self:DockSection(J)
						end)
						J.DockButton = X
						J:_refreshVisibility()
						local X = self.State.get("floats", {})
						if type(X) ~= "table" then
							X = {}
						end
						X[J.Key] = { math.floor(r.X), math.floor(r.Y) }
						self.State.data.floats = X
						self.State.save()
						self:_refreshTabState(J.Tab)
					end
					function W:FloatTab(J, X)
						T.trace("FloatTab")
						if type(J) == "string" then
							J = self.Tabs[J]
						end
						if not J or self.Destroyed then
							return
						end
						local L = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
						local V = self.FloatLayer.AbsoluteSize / L
						local L = Vector2.new(math.max(12, X.X), math.max(12, X.Y))
						local X = self.Parking and J.Frame.Parent == self.Parking
						if X then
							J.Frame.Visible = false
							J.Frame.Parent = self.Body
							if J.RefreshGen ~= T.Refresh.gen then
								T.Refresh.sync(J.Frame)
								J.RefreshGen = T.Refresh.gen
							end
						end
						local r, _, q = L.X, L.Y, 0
						local u = math.min(L.X + 640, V.X - 24)
						for s, s in ipairs(J.Sections) do
							if not s.Floating and not s.Hidden then
								local h = s.Wrap.AbsoluteSize / math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)
								if r + h.X > u and r > L.X then
									r = L.X
									_ += q + 14
									q = 0
								end
								self:FloatSection(
									s,
									Vector2.new(
										math.clamp(r, 8, math.max(8, V.X - h.X - 8)),
										math.clamp(_, 8, math.max(8, V.Y - 80))
									)
								)
								r += h.X + 14
								q = math.max(q, h.Y)
							end
						end
						if X and self.Current ~= J then
							J.Frame.Parent = self.Parking
						end
						self:_refreshTabState(J)
					end
					function W:DockTab(J)
						T.trace("DockTab")
						if type(J) == "string" then
							J = self.Tabs[J]
						end
						if not J then
							return
						end
						for X, X in ipairs(J.Sections) do
							if X.Floating then
								self:DockSection(X)
							end
						end
						self:_refreshTabState(J)
					end
					function W:_refreshTabState(J)
						if not J or not J.PageHost then
							return
						end
						local X, L = 0, 0
						for V, V in ipairs(J.Sections) do
							if not V.Hidden then
								X += 1
								if V.Floating then
									L += 1
								end
							end
						end
						local V = X > 0 and L == X
						if V and not J.EmptyState then
							local X = U("Frame", {
								Name = "Popped",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 150),
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								ZIndex = 3,
								Parent = J.PageHost,
							})
							local L = B.image(X, "glow", {
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.35),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 200),
								ImageTransparency = 0.86,
								ZIndex = 2,
							})
							if L then
								c(L, "ImageColor3", "Accent")
							end
							w({
								Parent = X,
								Icon = "picture-in-picture-2",
								Size = 30,
								Pos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 28),
								Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Color = "Faint",
								Z = 4,
							})
							K({
								Parent = X,
								Text = T.tr("Panels are floating"),
								Font = t.Semi(),
								Size = 14,
								Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 56),
								Box = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
								AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
								Color = "Muted",
								Z = 4,
								Name = "Caption",
							})
							local w = U("TextButton", {
								Name = "DockAll",
								Text = "",
								AutoButtonColor = false,
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
								Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 92),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 34),
								ZIndex = 4,
								Parent = X,
							})
							T.tile(w, {
								Name = "Face",
								Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
								Color = "Accent",
								SliceScale = 0.6,
								Z = 4,
							})
							local L = B.image(

					end

								if math.abs(z) > 10 and math.abs(z) > math.abs(k) then
									H = nil

									U(E, "Quick", { Scale = 1.3 })
									V(x, "TextColor3", "Text", "Quick")
								end
								return
							end
							if Y and f.sameMove(S, Q) then
								if O then
									D(S.Position)
								else
									N(S.Position)
								end
							end
						end, self.Window.Conns)
						f.connect(w.InputEnded, function(S)
							if H and S == H.input then
								H = nil
							end
							if Y and f.sameEnd(S, Q) then
								Y = false
								O = nil
								U(E, "PopSmall", { Scale = 1 })
								V(x, "TextColor3", "Muted", "Quick")

							end

					local function _(s)
						local h = {}
						for Y, Y in ipairs(s or {}) do
							if type(Y) == "table" then
								table.insert(h, {
									value = Y.code ~= nil and Y.code or Y.value or Y[1],
									label = tostring(Y.label or Y.Text or Y.code or Y.value or Y[2] or Y[1]),
								})
							else
								table.insert(h, { value = Y, label = tostring(Y) })
							end
						end
						return h
					end

					function L:SyncAppearance()
						local f = self.AppearanceRefs
						if not f then
							return
						end
						local R = self.State
						f.scale:SetSilent(self.UserScale)
						if f.autofit then
							f.autofit:SetSilent(self.AutoFit)
						end
						f.radius:SetSilent(tonumber(R.get("radius", 1)) or 1)
						f.textScale:SetSilent(tonumber(R.get("textScale", 1)) or 1)
						f.font:SetSilent(t.name)
						f.opacity:SetSilent(self.Opacity)
						f.density:SetSilent(self.Density)
						f.sbWidth:SetSilent(self.ExpandedWidth)
						f.compact:SetSilent(self.SidebarCollapsed == true)
						if f.groupLabels then
							f.groupLabels:SetSilent(self.GroupLabels ~= false)
						end
						f.palette:Set(nil, true)
						for t, U in pairs(X.Presets) do
							if U:ToHex() == X.tokens.Accent:ToHex() then
								f.palette:Set(t, true)
							end
						end
						f.accent:SetSilent(X.tokens.Accent)
						f.base:SetSilent(X.base)
						f.panel:SetSilent(self.PanelColor or X.tokens.Background)
						f.cards:SetSilent(self.CardStyle)
						f.bg:SetSilent(self.BgStyle)
						f.bgInt:SetSilent(self.BgIntensity)
						f.blur:SetSilent(self.BlurEnabled)
						f.motion:SetSilent(J.enabled)
						f.sounds:SetSilent(B.enabled)
						f.volume:SetSilent(B.volume)
						f.tips:SetSilent(self.TooltipsOn)

					local function _(q, u, s, h)
						if h then
							if q <= u then
								return "Success"
							elseif q <= s then
								return "Warning"
							end
							return "Danger"
						end
						if q >= u then
							return "Success"
						elseif q >= s then
							return "Warning"
						end
						return "Danger"
					end

							end)
						end

					function w:_kbDirty()
						if self.KbPending or self.Destroyed then
							return
						end

						task.defer(function()
							self.KbPending = false
							if self.KeybindFrame and not self.Destroyed then
								self:_kbRebuild()
							end
						end)
					end

								self:_buildKeybindList()
							end
							self.KeybindFrame.Visible = true
							self:_kbRebuild(true)

							self:_kbCancel()
							self.KeybindFrame.Visible = false
						end
					end
					function w:_kbCapture(S)
						if self.KbCap == S then
							return
						end
						self:_kbCancel()
						self.KbCap = S
						S.capture(true)
						task.defer(function()
							if self.KbCap == S then
								self.Listening = true
							end
						end)
					end
					function w:_kbCancel()
						local S = self.KbCap
						if not S then
							return
						end
						self.KbCap = nil
						S.capture(false)
						task.defer(function()
							if not self.KbCap then
								self.Listening = false
							end
						end)
					end

							O = H and tostring(O) or ""

								Z.Text = O
								local H = Y(O)
								if H ~= v then
									v = H
									T.Icons.apply(D, H)
								end
							end
							local Y, H = x(y.active)
							H = Y and H == true
							local Y = Q.key ~= n and Q.key ~= nil and not E
							local E = Q.key == nil ~= (n == nil)
							Q.key = n
							if H ~= Q.on or l or E then
								Q.on = H
								b(l)
							end
							if k.KbCap ~= Q then
								local E = n and T.keyName(n) or "—"
								if E ~= Q.keyTxt then
									Q.keyTxt = E
									GM(E, l)
								end
							end
							return Y
						end

					function w:_kbRebuild(f)
						local J = self.KeybindFrame
						if not J or self.Destroyed then
							return
						end
						local X = {}
						for t, t in ipairs(self.KeybindEntries or {}) do
							local R, B = true, true
							if t.alive then
								R, B = x(t.alive)
							end
							if not R or B ~= false then
								table.insert(X, t)
							end
						end
						self.KeybindEntries = X
						local t, R, B = self.KbRows, {}, {}
						local U, c, w = 0, 0, 0
						for L, W in ipairs(X) do
							local X, V = x(W.key)
							if not X or typeof(V) ~= "EnumItem" then
								V = nil
							end
							local X, r = x(W.name)
							local h = X and tostring(r) or ""
							local X = h .. "|" .. (V and tostring(V) or (self.KbEdit and "" or "-"))
							local r = self.KbCap ~= nil and self.KbCap.entry == W
							local Y
							if self.IsTouch then
								X = h
								Y = type(W.toggle) == "function" and h ~= "" and not R[X]
							else
								Y = r or V ~= nil and not R[X] or self.KbEdit and W.set ~= nil and h ~= "" and not R[X]
							end
							if Y then
								R[X] = true
								B[W] = true
								local X = t[W]
								if not X then
									X = S(self, W)
									t[W] = X
								else
									X.refresh()
								end
								X.frame.LayoutOrder = ((V or self.IsTouch) and 0 or 100000) + L
								U += 1
								if V or self.IsTouch then
									c += 1
									if X.on then
										w += 1
									end
								end
							end
						end
						local X = {}
						for R in pairs(t) do
							if not B[R] then
								table.insert(X, R)
							end
						end
						for R, R in ipairs(X) do
							local X = t[R]
							t[R] = nil
							if self.KbCap == X then
								self:_kbCancel()
							end
							X.frame:Destroy()
						end
						self.KbEmpty.Visible = U == 0
						self:_kbCount(w, c)
						local X = self.KbFold == true
						self.KeybindList.Visible = not X
						local t = U > 0 and U * q + (U - 1) * u or 18
						local R = X and _ or _ + math.min(5 + t + 6, s)
						local X = UDim2.fromOffset(K, R)
						if f or not J.Visible then
							J.Size = X
						else
							M(J, "Base", { Size = X })
						end
					end
				end
				return T
			end)()
		end)
		if not G or type(F) ~= "table" then
			warn("[PulseHub] Nova: " .. tostring(F))
			return nil
		end
		a.NovaLib = F
		pcall(function()
			F.tr = function(G)
				return A.tr(G)
			end
		end)
		return F
	end
end

			if W(_) > q then

				_ = _:sub(1, (u or #_ + 1) - 1) .. "…"
			end
			return _
		end
		local function _(q)
			return (
				tostring(q)
					:gsub("&", "&amp;")
					:gsub("<", "&lt;")
					:gsub(">", "&gt;")
					:gsub('"', "&quot;")
					:gsub("'", "&apos;")
			)
		end

		function L.badge()
			local WM, VM = U.Badge, U.BadgeLabel
			if not (WM and VM) then
				return
			end
			local rM = L.unread
			WM.Visible = rM > 0
			if rM > 0 then
				local _M = rM > 99 and "99+" or tostring(rM)
				VM.Text = _M
				local VM = math.max(20, #_M * 6.4 + 12)
				U.BadgeWidth = VM
				if not B.SidebarCollapsed then
					WM.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(VM, 18)
				end
			end
		end

		function L.status()
			local WM, VM
			if L.state == "ok" then
				WM, VM = "Success", tostring(math.max(L.online, 1)) .. " " .. F.tr("online")
			elseif L.state == "off" then
				WM, VM = "Danger", F.tr("No connection")
			else
				WM, VM = D.meta, F.tr("Connecting") .. "…"
			end
			e.Text = VM
			K(aM, "BackgroundColor3", WM, "Quick")
			K(e, "TextColor3", L.state == "off" and "Danger" or D.meta, "Quick")
		end

					c(

			end

		function L.faces()
			local e, GM = {}, {}
			for aM = #L.msgs, 1, -1.0 do
				local WM = L.msgs[aM].uid
				if not e[WM] then
					e[WM] = true
					GM[#GM + 1] = WM
					if #GM >= 5 then
						break
					end
				end
			end
			for e = 1, 5 do
				local aM, WM = GM[e], v[e]
				if aM then
					if not WM then
						WM = T(
							"ImageLabel",
							{
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								LayoutOrder = 10 - e,
								ZIndex = 10 - e,
							},
							j
						)
						A(WM, 15)
						M(WM, "BackgroundColor3", D.bub)
						local j = T("UIStroke", { Thickness = 2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, WM)
						M(j, "Color", D.board)
						v[e] = WM
					end
					local j = q(aM)
					if WM.Image ~= j then
						WM.Image = j
						M(WM, "BackgroundColor3", u(aM))
					end
					WM.Visible = true
				elseif WM then
					WM.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
		local function j()
			return m.CanvasPosition.Y >= m.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - m.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y - 40
		end
		local function e()
			m.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1000000)
		end
		local function v()
			local GM = m.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / N() - 20 - 36 - 18
			if GM < 160 then
				GM = 600
			end
			return math.floor(math.clamp(GM * 0.74, 200, 520))
		end
		L.mw = v()
		local function GM()
			local aM = v()
			if aM == L.mw then
				return
			end
			L.mw = aM
			for v, v in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				if v.ui and v.ui.resize then
					pcall(v.ui.resize, aM)
				end
			end
		end

		local function v(GM)
			local aM, WM = pcall(os.date, "%H:%M", math.floor(tonumber(GM) or os.time()))
			return aM and WM or ""
		end
		local function GM(aM)
			local WM, VM = pcall(os.date, "%Y%j", math.floor(tonumber(aM) or os.time()))
			return WM and VM or "0"
		end
		local function aM(WM)
			local VM = os.time()
			local rM = GM(WM)
			if rM == GM(VM) then
				return F.tr("Today")
			end
			if rM == GM(VM - 86400) then
				return F.tr("Yesterday")
			end
			local rM, _M = pcall(os.date, "%d.%m", math.floor(tonumber(WM) or VM))
			return rM and _M or ""
		end
		local function WM(VM)
			local rM = MM.Text
			local _M = "@" .. tostring(VM) .. " "
			if rM ~= "" and rM:sub(-1.0) ~= " " then
				_M = " " .. _M
			end
			MM.Text = rM .. _M
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(function()
					MM:CaptureFocus()
					MM.CursorPosition = #MM.Text + 1
				end)
			end)
		end
