		local function _M(qM)
			local uM = qM == "react" and s or h
			local h = qM == "react" and 6 or 8
			local sM = math.ceil(#uM / h)
			local hM, YM, lM = 38, 3, 9

				"Frame",

					CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(YM, YM),

				local hM = T("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, uM)

					c(hM, "Quick", { Scale = 1.12 })

					c(uM, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
					c(hM, "Quick", { Scale = 1 })
				end)

					end)

						end

							MM.Text = MM.Text .. YM
						end

							pcall(function()
								MM:CaptureFocus()
								MM.CursorPosition = #MM.Text + 1
							end)
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
			rM[qM] = { frame = sM, scale = SM, w = xM, h = h }
			return rM[qM]
		end
		function L.closePicker()
			local h = L.pick
			L.pick = nil
			VM.Visible = false
			for qM, qM in pairs(rM) do
				qM.frame.Visible = false
			end
			if h and h.m and h.m.ui and h.m.ui.settleBar then
				h.m.ui.settleBar()
			end
		end
		function L.openPicker(h, qM, uM)
			L.closePicker()
			local sM = rM[h] or _M(h)
			local rM = N()
			local _M, hM = o.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsoluteSize
			local YM, lM = qM.AbsolutePosition, qM.AbsoluteSize
			local qM
			if h == "insert" then
				qM = (YM.X - _M.X) / rM
			else
				qM = (YM.X + lM.X - _M.X) / rM - sM.w
			end
			local xM = (YM.Y + lM.Y - _M.Y) / rM + 6
			local lM = hM.Y / rM - (H + 20)
			if h == "insert" or xM + sM.h > lM then
				xM = (YM.Y - _M.Y) / rM - sM.h - 8
			end
			qM = math.clamp(qM, 8, math.max(8, hM.X / rM - sM.w - 8))
			xM = math.max(8, xM)
			sM.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(qM), math.floor(xM))
			sM.scale.Scale = 0.88
			sM.frame.Visible = true
			VM.Visible = true
			c(sM.scale, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 })
			L.pick = { mode = h, m = uM }
		end
		a(VM.MouseButton1Click, function()
			L.closePicker()
		end)

		function L.add(s, l)
			if L.rows[s.id] then
				return
			end
			local k = L.msgs[#L.msgs]
			local I
			if k == nil or GM(k.ts) ~= GM(s.ts) then
				L.order += 1
				I = h(s.ts, L.order)
			end
			local h = k ~= nil and I == nil and k.uid == s.uid and not k.failed and not s.rp and s.ts - k.ts < 180
			s.ui = aM(s, h, l)
			s.ui.div = I
			L.msgs[#L.msgs + 1] = s
			L.rows[s.id] = s
			while #L.msgs > 150 do
				local s = table.remove(L.msgs, 1)
				L.rows[s.id] = nil
				pcall(function()
					s.ui.frame:Destroy()
					if s.ui.div then
						s.ui.div:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end
			FM.Visible = false
		end
		function L.rebuild()
			for s, s in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				pcall(function()
					s.ui.frame:Destroy()
					if s.ui.div then
						s.ui.div:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end
			local s = L.msgs
			L.msgs, L.rows = {}, {}
			for h, h in ipairs(s) do
				L.add(h, false)
			end
			FM.Visible = #L.msgs == 0
			L.faces()
		end
		function L.drop(s)
			for h, l in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				if l == s then
					table.remove(L.msgs, h)
					break
				end
			end
			L.rows[s.id] = nil
			pcall(function()
				s.ui.frame:Destroy()
				if s.ui.div then
					s.ui.div:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			FM.Visible = #L.msgs == 0
		end
		local function s(h)
			local l = {}
			for k in pairs(h) do
				l[#l + 1] = k
			end
			table.sort(l)
			local k = {}
			for I, I in ipairs(l) do
				local l = {}
				for C, C in ipairs(h[I]) do
					l[#l + 1] = C
				end
				table.sort(l)
				k[#k + 1] = I .. ":" .. table.concat(l, ",")
			end
			return table.concat(k, "|")
		end
		function L.setRx(h, l)
			if s(l) == s(h.rx) then
				return
			end
			local s = {}
			for k, I in pairs(l) do
				if #I > #(h.rx[k] or {}) then
					s[k] = true
				end
			end
			h.rx = l
			if h.ui and h.ui.renderR then
				h.ui.renderR(s)
			end
		end
		function L.bind(s, h)
			if L.rows[h.id] and L.rows[h.id] ~= s then
				L.drop(s)
				return
			end
			L.rows[s.id] = nil
			s.id, s.ts, s.pending = h.id, h.ts, false
			s.name, s.dn, s.role = h.name, h.dn, h.role
			s.rt, s.rp = h.rt, h.rp or s.rp
			L.rows[s.id] = s
			if h.role ~= "" then
				L.myRole = h.role
			end
			if s.ui then
				if s.ui.text then
					c(s.ui.text, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 0 })
				end
				if s.ui.time then
					c(s.ui.time, "Quick", { TextTransparency = s.ui.timeT or 0 })
				end
				if s.ui.setTime then
					s.ui.setTime(v(s.ts))
				end
			end
		end
		local s = {
			rate = "Too fast",
			dupe = "Already sent",
			link = "Links are not allowed",
			muted = "You are muted",
			long = "Message is too long",
			net = "Server unavailable",
			lang = "Wrong language for this chat",
			denied = "No rights",
			gone = "Message not found",
			nohwid = "No HWID for this message",
		}
		function L.fail(h, l)
			h.pending, h.failed = false, true
			if h.ui and h.ui.text then
				K(h.ui.text, "TextColor3", "Danger", "Quick")
				c(h.ui.text, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 0 })
			end
			if h.ui and h.ui.bubble then
				local k = h.ui.bubble:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if k then
					M(k, "Color", "Danger")
					k.Transparency = 0.3
				end
			end
			J(F.tr("Not sent"), F.tr(s[l] or "Server unavailable"), "error")
			task.delay(5, function()
				if h.ui and h.ui.frame.Parent then
					c(h.ui.bubble, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
					c(h.ui.text, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 1 })
					c(h.ui.time, "Quick", { TextTransparency = 1 })
					task.wait(0.25)
					L.drop(h)
				end
			end)
		end
		local function h(l, k)
			local I = l.rx[k]
			local C = false
			if I then
				for n, b in ipairs(I) do
					if b == w then
						table.remove(I, n)
						C = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
			if not C then
				I = I or {}
				I[#I + 1] = w
				l.rx[k] = I
			end
			if l.rx[k] and #l.rx[k] == 0 then
				l.rx[k] = nil
			end
			if l.ui and l.ui.renderR then
				l.ui.renderR(not C and { [k] = true } or nil)
			end
		end
		function L.react(l, k)
			if l.id < 0 or l.failed then
				return
			end
			local I = os.clock()
			if I - L.lastRx < 0.2 then
				return
			end
			L.lastRx = I
			h(l, k)
			task.spawn(function()
				local I = V("/pulse/chat/react", { uid = w, id = l.id, emoji = k })
				if type(I) == "table" and I.ok == true and type(I.r) == "table" then
					local C = {}
					for n, b in pairs(I.r) do
						local Z = {}
						for P, P in ipairs(type(b) == "table" and b or {}) do
							local b = tonumber(P)
							if b then
								Z[#Z + 1] = b
							end
						end
						if #Z > 0 then
							C[n] = Z
						end
					end
					L.setRx(l, C)
				else
					h(l, k)
					local h = type(I) == "table" and I.err or "net"
					J(F.tr("Reaction failed"), F.tr(s[h] or "Server unavailable"), "error")
				end
			end)
		end
		local function h(l)
			local k = {}
			if type(l) ~= "table" then
				return k
			end
			for I, C in pairs(l) do
				if type(I) == "string" and type(C) == "table" then
					local l = {}
					for n, n in ipairs(C) do
						local C = tonumber(n)
						if C then
							l[#l + 1] = C
						end
					end
					if #l > 0 then
						k[I] = l
					end
				end
			end
			return k
		end
		local function l(k)
			if type(k) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local I, C = tonumber(k.id), tonumber(k.uid)
			if not (I and C) then
				return nil
			end
			local function n(b, Z)
				return (tostring(b or ""):gsub("%c", " ")):sub(1, Z)
			end
			local b = k.role
			local Z = k.rp
			if type(Z) == "table" then
				Z = {
					id = tonumber(Z.id) or 0,
					uid = tonumber(Z.uid) or 0,
					name = n(Z.name, 32),
					dn = n(Z.dn, 40),
					text = n(Z.text, 120),
				}
			else
				Z = nil
			end
			return {
				id = I,
				uid = C,
				name = n(k.name, 32),
				dn = n(k.dn, 40),
				text = n(k.text, 600),
				ts = tonumber(k.ts) or os.time(),
				role = (b == "owner" or b == "mod") and b or "",
				rt = tonumber(k.rt) or 0,
				rp = Z,
				rx = h(k.r),
			}
		end
		local function k(I)
			for C, C in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				if C.pending and C.text == I then
					return C
				end
			end
			return nil
		end
		function L.scrollTo(I)
			if not (I and I.ui and I.ui.frame.Parent) then
				return false
			end
			local C = I.ui.frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - m.AbsolutePosition.Y + m.CanvasPosition.Y
			L.stick = false
			m.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, C - m.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y * 0.3))
			task.defer(function()
				L.stick = j()
			end)
			return true
		end
		function L.jumpTo(I)
			local C = L.rows[I]
			if not C then
				J("Pulse Chat", F.tr("Message is too old"), "info")
				return
			end
			L.scrollTo(C)
			if C.ui and C.ui.flash then
				C.ui.flash()
			end
		end
		function L.goto(I)
			if not B.IsOpen then
				pcall(function()
					B:Open()
				end)
			end
			if B.Current ~= U then
				pcall(function()
					B:SelectTab(U)
				end)
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local C = os.clock()
				while m.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y < 10 and os.clock() - C < 2 do
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				task.wait(0.25)
				local C = L.rows[I]
				if C and L.scrollTo(C) then
					if C.ui.flash then
						C.ui.flash()
					end
				else
					L.stick = true
					e()
				end
			end)
		end
		function L.notifyPings(I)
			if #I == 0 then
				return
			end
			local function C(n)
				return function()
					L.goto(n.id)
				end
			end
			if #I > 2 then
				local n = I[1].m
				pcall(function()
					B:Notify({
						Title = tostring(#I) .. " " .. F.tr("new pings"),
						Text = _(r(n.text, 90)),
						Icon = "at-sign",
						Kind = "info",
						Duration = 8,
						OnClick = C(n),
					})
				end)
				return
			end
			for n, n in ipairs(I) do
				local I = n.m
				local b = d(I) .. "  ·  " .. F.tr(n.kind == "reply" and "Reply to you" or "Mention")
				pcall(function()
					B:Notify({
						Title = b,
						Text = _(r(I.text, 110)),
						Icon = n.kind == "reply" and "reply" or "at-sign",
						Kind = "info",
						Duration = 8,
						OnClick = C(I),
					})
				end)
			end
		end
		function L.apply(I)
			local C = LM()
			local n = not L.loaded
			local b = L.stick
			local Z = 0
			local P = {}
			for i, i in ipairs(type(I.msgs) == "table" and I.msgs or {}) do
				local m = l(i)
				if m then
					if m.id > L.last then
						L.last = m.id
					end
					if not L.rows[m.id] then
						local i = m.uid == w and k(m.text)
						if i then
							L.bind(i, m)
							L.setRx(i, m.rx)
						else
							L.add(m, not n)
							Z += 1
							if m.uid == w and m.role ~= "" then
								L.myRole = m.role
							end
							if not n and m.uid ~= w then
								if not C then
									L.unread += 1
								end
								local k = L.pingKind(m)
								if k then
									if C then
										if m.ui and m.ui.flash then
											m.ui.flash()
										end
									else
										P[#P + 1] = { m = m, kind = k }
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local k = false
			for C, C in ipairs(type(I.del) == "table" and I.del or {}) do
				local i = L.rows[tonumber(C) or -1.0]
				if i then
					for C, m in ipairs(L.msgs) do
						if m == i then
							table.remove(L.msgs, C)
							break
						end
					end
					L.rows[i.id] = nil
					pcall(function()
						i.ui.frame:Destroy()
						if i.ui.div then
							i.ui.div:Destroy()
						end
					end)
					k = true
				end
			end
			if k then
				L.rebuild()
			end
			for C, C in ipairs(type(I.rx) == "table" and I.rx or {}) do
				local i = type(C) == "table" and L.rows[tonumber(C.id) or -1.0]
				if i then
					L.setRx(i, h(C.r))
				end
			end
			if tonumber(I.rs) then
				L.rs = tonumber(I.rs)
			end
			L.online = tonumber(I.online) or L.online
			L.loaded = true
			FM.Visible = #L.msgs == 0
			if Z > 0 and not b and not n then
				TM.Visible = true
			end
			if Z > 0 or n or k then
				L.faces()
			end
			if n then
				L.stick = true
				task.defer(e)
			end
			L.badge()
			L.notifyPings(P)
		end
		local function h()
			local k = RM.Position
			task.spawn(function()
				for I, I in ipairs({ -6.0, 5, -4.0, 3, -2.0, 0 }) do
					RM.Position = k + UDim2.fromOffset(I, 0)
					task.wait(0.03)
				end
				RM.Position = k
			end)
			K(BM, "Color", "Danger", "Quick")
			task.delay(0.45, function()
				K(BM, "Color", MM:IsFocused() and D.acc or D.line, "Quick")
			end)
		end
		function L.send()
			local k = X(MM.Text)
			if k == "" then
				return
			end
			if W(k) > 200 then
				h()
				return
			end
			if k:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and not L.langOk(L.chan, k) then
				h()
				L.langHint(true)
				return
			end
			local I = os.clock()
			if I - L.lastSend < 1.05 then
				h()
				return
			end
			L.lastSend = I
			MM.Text = ""
			L.tmp -= 1
			local h = L.reply
			local I
			if h and h.id > 0 then
				I = { id = h.id, uid = h.uid, name = h.name, dn = h.dn, text = r(h.text, 90) }
			end
			local r = {
				id = L.tmp,
				uid = w,
				name = R.Name,
				dn = R.DisplayName,
				text = k,
				ts = os.time(),
				role = L.myRole or "",
				pending = true,
				rt = I and I.id or 0,
				rp = I,
				rx = {},
			}
			L.stick = true
			L.add(r, false)
			L.faces()
			if I then
				L.setReply(nil)
			end
			pcall(function()
				G.Sound.play("tick")
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local h = V("/pulse/chat/send", {
					uid = w,
					name = R.Name,
					dn = R.DisplayName,
					text = k,
					rt = I and I.id or nil,
					ch = L.chan,
					k = k:sub(1, 1) == "/" and L.key or nil,
				})
				if type(h) == "table" and h.ok == true and type(h.msg) == "table" then
					local R = l(h.msg)
					if R then
						L.bind(r, R)
					end
				elseif type(h) == "table" and h.ok == true then
					L.drop(r)
					if h.info then
						J("Pulse Chat", tostring(h.info), "success")
					end
				else
					L.fail(r, type(h) == "table" and h.err or "net")
				end
				L.kick = true
			end)
		end
		local function R()
			if MM.Text:find("[\r\n]") then
				MM.Text = MM.Text:gsub("[\r\n]", "")
				return
			end
			local r = W(MM.Text)
			if r > 200 then
				local W = utf8.offset(MM.Text, 201)
				if W then
					MM.Text = MM.Text:sub(1, W - 1)
				end
				return
			end
			cM.Text = r >= 150 and tostring(r) .. "/200" or ""
			pcall(L.langHint, false)
			K(cM, "TextColor3", r >= 190 and "Danger" or (r >= 170 and "Warning" or D.meta), "Quick")
			c(KM, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = X(MM.Text) == "" and 0.5 or 0 })
		end
		R()
		a(MM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), R)
		a(MM.Focused, function()
			K(BM, "Color", D.acc, "Quick")
			c(BM, "Quick", { Transparency = 0.35 })
		end)
		a(MM.FocusLost, function(R)
			K(BM, "Color", D.line, "Quick")
			c(BM, "Quick", { Transparency = 0.88 })
			if R then
				L.send()
				task.delay(0.06, function()
					pcall(function()
						MM.Text = MM.Text:gsub("[\r\n]", "")
						MM:CaptureFocus()
					end)
				end)
			end
		end)
		a(KM.MouseButton1Click, function()
			L.send()
		end)
		a(KM.MouseEnter, function()
			c(wM, "Quick", { Scale = 1.06 })
		end)
		pcall(function()
			G.U.leave(KM, function()
				c(wM, "Quick", { Scale = 1 })
			end)
		end)
		a(KM.MouseButton1Down, function()
			c(wM, "Quick", { Scale = 0.92 })
		end)
		a(KM.MouseButton1Up, function()
			c(wM, "Quick", { Scale = 1.06 })
		end)
		pcall(function()
			table.insert(F.onChange, function()
				pcall(L.placeholder)
				L.status()
			end)
		end)
		local R = 0
		pcall(function()
			G.Theme.onChange(function()
				if B.Destroyed then
					return
				end
				R += 1
				local W = R
				task.delay(0.15, function()
					if W ~= R or B.Destroyed then
						return
					end
					for R, R in ipairs(L.msgs) do
						if R.ui and R.ui.restyle then
							pcall(R.ui.restyle)
						end
					end
					if L.reply then
						pcall(L.setReply, L.reply)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end)
		f.chat = type(f.chat) == "table" and f.chat or {}
		L.chan = (f.chat.ch == "ru" or f.chat.ch == "en") and f.chat.ch
			or (f.ui and (f.ui.lang == "ru" or f.ui.lang == "uk") and "ru" or "en")
		L.gen = 0
		L.seen = { ru = -1.0, en = -1.0 }
		L.lasts = { ru = 0, en = 0 }
		L.onl = { ru = 0, en = 0 }
		function L.langOk(R, W)
			local r = tostring(W or ""):gsub("@[%w_]+", " ")
			local W, h, l = 0, 0, 0
			for k, k in utf8.codes(r) do
				if k >= 65 and k <= 90 or k >= 97 and k <= 122 or k >= 192 and k <= 591 and k ~= 215 and k ~= 247 then
					W += 1
				elseif k >= 1024 and k <= 1327 then
					h += 1
				elseif
					k >= 880 and k <= 1023
					or k >= 1328 and k <= 8191
					or k >= 12352 and k <= 40959
					or k >= 44032 and k <= 55215
				then
					l += 1
				end
			end
			if l > 0 then
				return false
			end
			if R == "ru" then
				return W == 0
			end
			return h == 0
		end
		local R = {
			ru = {
				ru = "Здесь только русский",
				en = "Здесь только английский",
			},
			uk = {
				ru = "Тут лише російська",
				en = "Тут лише англійська",
			},
			en = {
				ru = "Russian only here",
				en = "English only here",
			},
		}
		local W = T("Frame", {
			Name = "LangHint",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -(H + 16)),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
			AutomaticSize = x,

			W

		T("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 11), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 11) }, W)
		local r = T("TextLabel", {

		function L.langHint(h)
			local Y = X(MM.Text)
			local X = Y ~= "" and Y:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and not L.langOk(L.chan, Y)
			local l = f.ui and R[f.ui.lang] or R.en
			r.Text = l[L.chan] or ""
			if X or h and Y ~= "" then
				W.Visible = true
				K(BM, "Color", "Danger", "Quick")
			elseif W.Visible then
				W.Visible = false
				K(BM, "Color", MM:IsFocused() and D.acc or D.line, "Quick")
			end
		end
		function L.placeholder()
			local X = f.ui and f.ui.lang
			local R = string.upper(L.chan)
			MM.PlaceholderText = X == "ru" and "Сообщение в " .. R .. "…"
				or X == "uk" and "Повідомлення в " .. R .. "…"
				or "Message in " .. R .. "…"
		end
		function L.paintTabs()
			for X, R in pairs(AM) do
				local W = X == L.chan
				c(R.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = W and 0 or 1 })
				R.t.TextColor3 = W and z(D.onAcc) or z(D.meta)
				R.c.TextColor3 = R.t.TextColor3
				local r = tonumber(L.onl[X]) or 0
				R.c.Text = r > 0 and tostring(r) or ""
				R.c.Visible = r > 0
				R.dot.Visible = not W and (L.seen[X] or -1.0) >= 0 and (L.lasts[X] or 0) > (L.seen[X] or 0)
			end
		end
		function L.meta(X)
			if type(X.lasts) == "table" then
				for R, R in ipairs({ "ru", "en" }) do
					local W = tonumber(X.lasts[R]) or 0
					L.lasts[R] = W
					if (L.seen[R] or -1.0) < 0 and R ~= L.chan then
						L.seen[R] = W
					end
				end
			end
			if type(X.onl) == "table" then
				L.onl.ru, L.onl.en = tonumber(X.onl.ru) or 0, tonumber(X.onl.en) or 0
			end
			if type(X.me) == "table" then
				local R = L.staff
				L.staff = X.me.staff == true
				L.myRole = (X.me.role == "owner" or X.me.role == "mod") and X.me.role or L.myRole
				if L.modBtn then
					L.modBtn.Visible = L.staff and L.myRole == "owner"
				end
				if L.staff ~= R then
					for X, X in ipairs(L.msgs) do
						if X.ui and X.ui.bar then
							pcall(function()
								X.ui.bar:Destroy()
							end)
							X.ui.bar = nil
							X.ui.barOn = false
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		function L.setChan(X)
			if X == L.chan or X ~= "ru" and X ~= "en" then
				return
			end
			L.seen[L.chan] = math.max(L.seen[L.chan] or 0, L.last)
			L.chan = X
			f.chat.ch = X
			L.gen += 1
			pcall(L.closePicker)
			pcall(L.setReply, nil)
			for R, R in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				pcall(function()
					R.ui.frame:Destroy()
					if R.ui.div then
						R.ui.div:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end
			L.msgs, L.rows = {}, {}
			L.last, L.rs, L.loaded = 0, 0, false
			L.seen[X] = math.max(L.seen[X] or 0, L.lasts[X] or 0)
			FM.Visible = false
			TM.Visible = false
			L.stick = true
			L.faces()
			L.placeholder()
			L.langHint(false)
			L.paintTabs()
			pcall(function()
				G.Sound.play("tick")
			end)
			L.kick = true
		end
		for X, R in pairs(AM) do

				end
			end)
		end

		function L.surface()
			local X = B.CardStyle or "Glass"
			local R = math.clamp(tonumber(B.Opacity) or 1, 0.5, 1)
			local W = X == "Frosted" and 0.32 or 0.03
			local r = math.clamp(W + (1 - R) * 0.9, 0, 0.8)
			p.BackgroundTransparency = r
			RM.BackgroundTransparency = r
			fM.BackgroundTransparency = r
			if L.panelFrame and L.panelFrame.Parent then
				L.panelFrame.BackgroundTransparency = r
			end
			L.bubT = math.clamp((1 - R) * 0.55 + (X == "Frosted" and 0.18 or 0), 0, 0.55)
			for X, X in ipairs(L.msgs) do
				if X.ui and X.ui.bubble then
					X.ui.bubble.BackgroundTransparency = L.bubT
				end
			end
			pcall(L.paintTabs)
		end
		pcall(L.surface)
		pcall(function()
			for X, X in ipairs({
				"SetOpacity",
				"SetCardStyle",
				"SetBase",
				"SetAccent",
				"SetPanelColor",
			}) do
				local R = B[X]
				if type(R) == "function" then
					B[X] = function(X, ...)
						local W = table.pack(R(X, ...))
						task.defer(function()
							pcall(L.surface)
						end)
						return table.unpack(W, 1, W.n)
					end
				end
			end
		end)

			local function W(r, h, Y)
				local l = f.ui and f.ui.lang or "en"

			function L.saveKey(f)
				f = tostring(f or ""):gsub("%s", "")
				if #f < 32 or #f > 128 or not f:match("^%x+$") then
					return false
				end
				L.key = f
				pcall(function()
					if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("PulseHubMM2") then
						makefolder("PulseHubMM2")
					end
					writefile("PulseHubMM2/staff.key", f)
				end)
				return true
			end

			function L.modCall(f)
				f.uid = w
				f.k = L.key
				local r = V("/pulse/chat/mod", f)
				if type(r) == "table" and r.err == "key" then
					L.key = nil
				end
				return r
			end
			local function f(r)
				local h = type(r) == "table" and r.err or "net"
				return F.tr(s[h] or "Server unavailable")
			end
			function L.closeMod()
				if X then
					X:Destroy()
					X = nil
				end
				if L.modFor then
					VM.Visible = false
				end
				L.modFor = nil
			end
			local function F(r, s, h)
				L.closePicker()
				if X then
					X:Destroy()
				end
				X = T("Frame", { Name = "ModMenu", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, h), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 40 }, o)
				A(X, 12)
				M(X, "BackgroundColor3", D.pop)
				local Y = T(
					"UIStroke",
					{ Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border },
					X
				)
				M(Y, "Color", D.line)
				local Y = N()
				local l, k = o.AbsolutePosition, o.AbsoluteSize
				local I, C = r.AbsolutePosition, r.AbsoluteSize
				local n = math.clamp((I.X + C.X - l.X) / Y - s, 8, math.max(8, k.X / Y - s - 8))
				local s = (I.Y + C.Y - l.Y) / Y + 6
				if s + h > k.Y / Y - (H + 20) then
					s = (I.Y - l.Y) / Y - h - 6
				end
				X.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(n), math.floor(math.max(8, s)))
				local s = T("UIScale", { Scale = 0.92 }, X)
				c(s, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 })
				VM.Visible = true
				L.modFor = r
				return X
			end

					{ FillDirection = Q, VerticalAlignment = E, Padding = UDim.new(0, 5), SortOrder = y },

									end
									M(H, "BackgroundColor3", D.chip)
									M(H, "TextColor3", D.text)
								end
							end)
							return
						end
						C(Y[1])
					end)
				end

			function L.modAct(K, s, h)
				L.closeMod()
				task.spawn(function()
					local Y = { op = s, id = K.id }
					for l, k in pairs(h or {}) do
						Y[l] = k
					end
					local h = L.modCall(Y)
					if type(h) == "table" and h.ok == true then
						J(
							"Pulse Chat",
							W("Готово", "Готово", "Done") .. " · " .. tostring(h.name or d(K)),
							"success"
						)
						if s == "del" or s == "ban" then
							L.kick = true
						end
						if R and R.Parent then
							pcall(L.panelLoad)
						end
					else
						J("Pulse Chat", f(h), "error")
					end
				end)
			end
			function L.openMod(K, s)
				if not L.key then
					L.keyPrompt(K, function()
						L.openMod(K, s)
					end)
					return
				end
				local h = L.myRole == "owner"
				local Y = s.uid ~= w and s.role ~= "owner" and s.role ~= "mod"
				local l = Y and 73 + 52 * (h and 2 or 1) - 6 + 8 or 42
				local k = F(K, 268, l)
				local F = 5
				X(
					k,
					F,
				268,
					"trash",
					W(
						"Удалить сообщение",
						"Видалити повідомлення",
						"Delete message"
					),
					true,
					function()
						L.modAct(s, "del")
					end
				)
				F += 32
				if Y then
					X(k, F, 268, "volume-2", W("Снять мут", "Зняти мут", "Unmute"), false, function()
						L.modAct(s, "unmute")
					end)
					F += 36
					r(k, F, 268, W("МУТ", "МУТ", "MUTE"), false, {
						{ 10, W("10м", "10х", "10m") },
						{ 60, W("1ч", "1г", "1h") },
						{ 1440, W("1д", "1д", "1d") },
						{ 0, true },
					}, function(X)
						L.modAct(s, "mute", { min = X })
					end)
					F += 52
					if h then
						r(k, F, 268, W("БАН ПО HWID", "БАН ЗА HWID", "BAN BY HWID"), true, {
							{ 1, W("1ч", "1г", "1h") },
							{ 24, W("1д", "1д", "1d") },
							{ 168, W("7д", "7д", "7d") },
							{ 720, W("30д", "30д", "30d") },
							{ 0, true },
						}, function(F)
							L.modAct(s, "ban", { hours = F })
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			a(VM.MouseButton1Click, function()
				L.closeMod()
			end)
			local F = "bans"
			local X = { bans = {}, mutes = {} }
			local function K(r)
				r = tonumber(r) or 0
				if r <= 0 then
					return W("навсегда", "назавжди", "forever")
				end
				local s, h = pcall(os.date, "%d.%m %H:%M", math.floor(r))
				return W("до ", "до ", "until ") .. (s and h or "?")
			end
			function L.closePanel()
				if not R then
					return
				end
				local r = R
				R = nil
				L.panelFrame = nil
				p.Visible = true
				pcall(function()
					r:Destroy()
				end)
			end
			function L.panelRender()
				if not (R and R.Parent) then
					return
				end
				local r = R:FindFirstChild("List")
				for s, s in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
					if s:IsA("GuiObject") then
						s:Destroy()
					end
				end
				local s = X[F] or {}
				for h, Y in pairs(L.panelSeg or {}) do
					local l = h == F
					c(Y.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = l and 0 or 1 })
					Y.t.TextColor3 = l and z(D.onAcc) or z(D.meta)
					Y.t.Text = Y.label .. "  " .. tostring(#(X[h] or {}))
				end
				R.Empty.Visible = #s == 0 and not R.Status.Visible
				for h, Y in ipairs(s) do
					local s = tonumber(Y.uid) or 0
					local l = T(
						"Frame",
						{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = h, ZIndex = 37 },
						r
					)
					A(l, 12)
					M(l, "BackgroundColor3", D.bub)
					l.BackgroundTransparency = L.bubT or 0
					local r = T("ImageLabel", {
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Image = s > 0 and q(s) or "",
						ZIndex = 38,
					}, l)
					A(r, 18)
					M(r, "BackgroundColor3", s > 0 and u(s) or D.chip)
					if s <= 0 then
						G.icon({
							Parent = r,
							Icon = "fingerprint-pattern",
							Size = 18,
							Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
							Color = D.meta,
							Z = 39,
						})
					end
					local r = Y.dn and Y.dn ~= "" and tostring(Y.dn)
						or Y.name and Y.name ~= "" and tostring(Y.name)
						or "HWID " .. tostring(Y.hwid or Y.key or "?"):sub(1, 8)
					local q = T("TextLabel", {
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 9),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -180.0, 0, 19),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						RichText = true,
						TextSize = 15,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						ZIndex = 38,
					}, l)
					q.FontFace = G.Font.Heavy()
					M(q, "TextColor3", D.text)
					q.Text = _(r)
						.. (
							Y.name
								and Y.name ~= ""
								and Y.name ~= r
								and '  <font transparency="0.45">@' .. _(Y.name) .. "</font>"
							or ""
						)
					local _ = T("TextLabel", {
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 30),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -180.0, 0, 16),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						TextSize = 12,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						ZIndex = 38,
					}, l)
					_.FontFace = G.Font.Medium()
					M(_, "TextColor3", D.meta)
					local q = { K(Y["until"]) }
					if s > 0 then
						q[#q + 1] = "id " .. tostring(s)
					end
					if Y.hwid and s > 0 then
						q[#q + 1] = "hwid " .. tostring(Y.hwid):sub(1, 8)
					end
					if type(Y.reason) == "string" and Y.reason ~= "" then
						q[#q + 1] = Y.reason
					end
					_.Text = table.concat(q, "  ·  ")
					local K = F == "bans"
							and W("Разбанить", "Розбанити", "Unban")
						or W("Снять мут", "Зняти мут", "Unmute")
					local _ = T("TextButton", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(1, -10.0, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 32),
						AutoButtonColor = false,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Text = K,
						TextSize = 13,
						ZIndex = 38,
					}, l)
					_.FontFace = G.Font.Heavy()
					A(_, 16)
					M(_, "BackgroundColor3", D.acc)
					M(_, "TextColor3", D.onAcc)
					local q = false
					a(_.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if q then
							return
						end
						q = true
						_.Text = "…"
						local u = F
						task.spawn(function()
							local s
							if u == "bans" then
								s = L.modCall({ op = "unban", hwid = Y.hwid })
							else
								s = L.modCall({ op = "unmute", key = Y.key })
							end

								pcall(L.panelLoad)
							else
								J("Pulse Chat", f(s), "error")
								q = false
								if _.Parent then
									_.Text = K
								end
							end
						end)
					end)
				end
			end
			function L.panelLoad()
				if not (R and R.Parent) then
					return
				end
				local J = R
				J.Status.Text = W("Загрузка…", "Завантаження…", "Loading…")
				J.Status.Visible = true
				J.Empty.Visible = false
				local K = L.modCall({ op = "list" })
				if R ~= J or not J.Parent then
					return
				end
				if type(K) == "table" and K.ok == true then
					X.bans = type(K.bans) == "table" and K.bans or {}
					X.mutes = type(K.mutes) == "table" and K.mutes or {}
					J.Status.Visible = false
					L.panelRender()
				else
					J.Status.Text = f(K)
					if type(K) == "table" and K.err == "key" then
						L.closePanel()
						L.keyPrompt(L.modBtn, function()
							L.openPanel()
						end)
					end
				end
			end

					a(q.MouseButton1Click, function()
						if F ~= _ then
							F = _
							pcall(function()
								G.Sound.play("tick")
							end)
							L.panelRender()
						end
					end)
					a(q.MouseEnter, function()
						if _ ~= F then
							c(q, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 0.82 })
						end
					end)
					G.U.leave(q, function()
						if _ ~= F then
							c(q, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
						end
					end)
				end
				L.panelSeg = K
				local F = g(
					f,
					"x",
				32, 16,
					{ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16.0, 0, O / 2), Bg = D.chip, Z = 38 }
				)
				a(F.MouseButton1Click, function()
					L.closePanel()
				end)
				local F = g(
					f,
					"refresh-cw",
				28, 14,
					{ AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 19), Bg = D.chip, Z = 38 }
				)
				a(F.MouseButton1Click, function()
					task.spawn(L.panelLoad)
				end)
				task.defer(function()
					if J.Parent then
						F.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16 + math.ceil(J.TextBounds.X / N()) + 8, 0, 19)
					end
				end)
				local F = T("Frame", {
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, O - 1),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,

				}, f)

					Name = "List",

					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -O),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ScrollBarThickness = 4,
					ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5,
					CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
					AutomaticCanvasSize = S,
					ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
					ZIndex = 37,
				}, f)
				M(F, "ScrollBarImageColor3", D.meta)
				T("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = y }, F)
				T("UIPadding", {
					PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14),
					PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10),
					PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12),
				}, F)
				local F = T("TextLabel", {
					Name = "Status",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, O / 2),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -40.0, 0, 20),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					TextSize = 15,
					Text = "",
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 38,
				}, f)
				F.FontFace = G.Font.Semi()
				M(F, "TextColor3", D.meta)
				local F = T("Frame", {
					Name = "Empty",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, O / 2),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 86),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 38,
				}, f)
				local J = T("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ZIndex = 38,
				}, F)
				A(J, 17)
				M(J, "BackgroundColor3", D.field)
				G.icon({
					Parent = J,
					Icon = "shield-check",
					Size = 24,
					Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Color = D.meta,
					Z = 39,
				})
				local A = T("TextLabel", {
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = W("Никого нет", "Нікого немає", "Nobody here"),
					TextSize = 15,
					ZIndex = 38,
				}, F)
				A.FontFace = G.Font.Semi()
				M(A, "TextColor3", D.meta)
				R = f
				L.panelFrame = f
				p.Visible = false
				L.panelRender()
				task.spawn(L.panelLoad)
			end
			a(L.modBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
				L.openPanel()
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			local G = B.OnTabChanged
			B.OnTabChanged = function(a)
				if G then
					G(a)
				end
				if a == U then
					L.unread = 0
					L.badge()
					L.kick = true
					L.stick = true
					task.defer(e)
				else
					L.closePicker()
				end
			end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(1.5)
			while httpRequest() and o.Parent and not B.Destroyed do
				local G, a = L.chan, L.gen
				local A = V("/pulse/chat/poll", { uid = w, after = L.loaded and L.last or 0, rs = L.rs, ch = G })
				if type(A) == "table" and A.ok == true then
					L.fails = 0
					if L.state ~= "ok" then
						L.state = "ok"
					end
					pcall(L.meta, A)
					if G == L.chan and a == L.gen then
						local a, F = pcall(L.apply, A)
						if not a then
							L.lastErr = tostring(F)
						end
						L.seen[G] = math.max(L.seen[G] or 0, L.last)
					end
					pcall(L.paintTabs)
				else
					L.fails += 1
					if L.fails >= 2 then
						L.state = "off"
					end
				end
				L.status()
				local G = LM() and 1.5 or 4
				if L.fails >= 3 then
					G = math.max(G, 12)
				end
				local a = os.clock()
				while httpRequest() and os.clock() - a < G do
					if L.kick then
						L.kick = false
						break
					end
					if L.unread > 0 and LM() then
						L.unread = 0
						L.badge()
					end
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

		local function c(K, w)
			if type(K) ~= "table" or type(w) ~= "table" then
				return
			end
			for L in pairs(K) do
				if w[L] == nil then
					K[L] = nil
				end
			end
			for L, W in pairs(w) do
				if type(W) == "table" then
					if type(K[L]) ~= "table" then
						K[L] = {}
					end
					c(K[L], W)
				else
					K[L] = W
				end

				F("SetBase", w.base)

		end
		local function F()
			for w, w in ipairs(R) do
				pcall(function()
					if isfile and isfile(w) and delfile then
						delfile(w)
					end
				end)
			end
			local R = J.ui and J.ui.lang
			local w = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseBakedCfg")
			local L, W =
				pcall(A.applyData, { v = 1, game = "mm2", s = M(type(w) == "table" and w or {}), reset = true })
			pcall(function()
				if type(J.ui) ~= "table" then
					J.ui = {}
				end
				c(J.ui, getUpvalue(f).ui or {})
				if R then
					J.ui.lang = R
				end
				if J.ui.theme then
					T(J.ui.theme)
				end
			end)
			K()
			if L then
				U(t.tr("Settings reset"), nil, "success")
			else
				U("Reset", tostring(W), "error")
			end
		end
		local function T()
			pcall(function()
				local f = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseCleanup")
				if type(f) == "table" then
					getgenv().__pulseCleanup = {}
					for R, R in ipairs(f) do
						pcall(R)
					end
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				getgenv().PULSE_HUB_GEN = (getgenv().PULSE_HUB_GEN or 0) + 1
			end)
			pcall(function()
				G:Destroy()
			end)
		end
		a:Header("General", "Left")

			Default = X.afk.on,

				J.afk.on = f
			end,
		})

		a:Sub("Configs")
		local F = setclipboard or toclipboard or syn and syn.set_clipboard

		if type(T) ~= "table" then
			T = {}
		end
		pcall(function()
			local f = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseBakedCfg")

			local f
			for X = #T, 1, -1.0 do
				if T[X].name == "Pulse CFG" then

				table.insert(T, 1, { name = "Pulse CFG", data = J, builtin = true })

			A.saveList(T)
		end)
		local f = T[1] and T[1].name or nil
		local function J()
			local X = {}
			for R, R in ipairs(T) do
				table.insert(X, { code = R.name, label = tostring(R.name) })
			end
			return X
		end
		local function X(R)
			for B, M in ipairs(T) do
				if M.name == R then

				end

			return nil, nil
		end
		a:Header("My configs", "Left")
		local R
		pcall(function()
			local B = a:LastSection()

		A.localApi = {
			list = function()
				return T

				local c = tostring(J or "Config"):sub(1, 40)
				local J, K = c, 1

				A.saveList(T)
				f = J
				B()

			end,
		}
		a:Button({
			Text = "Apply",
			Callback = function()
				local J = X(f)
				if not J then
					U("Config not found", nil, "danger")
					return

		a:Button({

		a:Button({
			Text = "Copy key",
			Callback = function()
				local J = X(f)

					return

					U("Key copied", tostring(J.key), "success")
				else
					U("Clipboard unavailable", tostring(J.key), "warning")
				end

		})
		a:Button({
			Text = "Publish",
			Callback = function()
				local J = X(f)
				if not J then
					U("Config not found", nil, "danger")
					return

				if J.builtin then
					U("Built-in config", tostring(J.name), "warning")
					return

		})
		a:Button({
			Text = "Delete",
			DoubleClick = true,
			Callback = function()
				local J, J = X(f)
				if not J then
					return
				end
				table.remove(T, J)
				A.saveList(T)
				f = T[1] and T[1].name or nil
				B()
				U("Config deleted", nil, "warning")
			end,
		})
		a:Header("New config", "Right")
		local J = ""
		pcall(function()
			local R = a:LastSection()
			local M = R:Input({
				Text = t.tr("New config"),
				Placeholder = "legit",
				Callback = function(R)
					J = tostring(R or "")
				end,
				Live = true,
			})
			t.bind(M.Title, "New config")
		end)
		a:Button({
			Text = "Create config",
			Callback = function()
				local R = J:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
				if R == "" then
					U("Enter a config name first", nil, "warning")
					return
				end
				if #R > 40 then
					R = R:sub(1, 40)
				end
				U("Uploading config...", nil, "info")
				task.spawn(function()
					local J = A.snapshot()
					local M = nil
					pcall(function()
						M = A.upload(R, J)
					end)
					local c = X(R)
					if c then
						c.data = J
						c.key = M or c.key
					else
						table.insert(T, 1, { name = R, key = M, data = J })
					end
					A.saveList(T)
					f = R
					B()
					U("Config created", M and tostring(M) or R, "success")
				end)
			end,
		})
		a:Header("Import", "Right")
		local T = ""
		pcall(function()
			local f = a:LastSection()
			local J = f:Input({
				Text = t.tr("Config key"),
				Placeholder = "Pulse_XXXX",
				Callback = function(f)
					T = tostring(f or "")
				end,
				Live = true,
			})
			t.bind(J.Title, "Config key")
		end)
		a:Button({
			Text = "Import config",
			Callback = function()
				local f = T:gsub("%s+", "")
				if f == "" then
					U("Enter a config key", nil, "warning")
					return
				end
				U("Fetching config...", nil, "info")
				task.spawn(function()
					local T, J = A.fetch(f)
					if not T then
						U(J == "not_found" and "Config not found" or tostring(J or "Fetch failed"), nil, "danger")
						return
					end
					local J = A.localApi.add(T.name, T.data, f)
					U("Config imported", tostring(J), "success")
				end)
			end,
		})
		table.insert(A.applyHooks, function()
			pcall(function()
				G:SyncAppearance()
			end)
		end)
		a:Sub("About")
		a:Header("Pulse Hub", "Left")
		a:Note({ Text = "Pulse Hub for Murder Mystery 2" })
		a:Note({ Text = "Version: v1.0" })
		local function A(T)
			local f = syn and syn.request or http and http.request or http_request or request
			if type(f) ~= "function" then
				return false
			end
			local J = game:GetService("HttpService")
			local X = J:JSONEncode({
				cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
				args = { code = T },
				nonce = J:GenerateGUID(false),
			})
			for T = 6463, 6472 do
				local J, t = pcall(f, {
					Url = ("http://127.0.0.1:%d/rpc?v=1"):format(T),
					Method = "POST",
					Headers = {
						["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
						["Origin"] = "https://discord.com",
					},
					Body = X,
				})
				if J and type(t) == "table" and tonumber(t.StatusCode) == 200 then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		getgenv().__pulseDiscordInvite = A
		pcall(function()
			local T
			if writefile and getcustomasset then
				if not (isfile and isfile("PulseHubMM2/discord_logo_v1.png")) then
					local f
					for J, J in ipairs({
						crypt and crypt.base64decode,
						base64decode,
						base64_decode,
						base64 and base64.decode,
					}) do
						if type(J) == "function" then
							local X, t = pcall(
								J,
								""
							)
							if X and type(t) == "string" and #t > 100 then
								f = t
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if f then
						pcall(function()
							if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("PulseHubMM2") then
								makefolder("PulseHubMM2")
							end
						end)
						pcall(writefile, "PulseHubMM2/discord_logo_v1.png", f)
					end
				end
				local f, J = pcall(getcustomasset, "PulseHubMM2/discord_logo_v1.png")
				if f and type(J) == "string" and J ~= "" then
					T = J
				end
			end
			G:AddHeaderButton({
				Name = "Discord",
				Image = T,
				Icon = T == nil and "message-circle" or nil,
				ImageSize = Vector2.new(19, 14),
				Tip = "Discord",
				HoverColor = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242),
				Callback = function()
					if F and pcall(F, "https://discord.gg/pulsezone") then
						U("Discord", "Link copied: discord.gg/pulsezone", "success")
					else
						U("Discord", "discord.gg/pulsezone", "warning")
					end
				end,
			})
		end)
		a:Button({
			Text = "Join Discord",
			Callback = function()
				task.spawn(function()
					if not A("pulsezone") and F then
						pcall(F, "discord.gg/pulsezone")
					end
				end)
			end,
		})
		local G = tostring(getgenv().__pulseHWID or "unavailable")
		a:Header("Your HWID", "Right")
		a:Note({ Text = G })
		a:Button({
			Text = "Copy HWID",

				if writefile then

			pcall(A, "pulsezone")

end

-- =========================================================================
-- MODULE: Movement - Bhop & Emotes (Bhop, SpinBot, Emote Dances)
-- KEY: G
-- =========================================================================
PulseModules["G"] = function(G)
	-- Upvalues unpacked from caller environment G
	local a, A, F, T, f, J, X = G[5], G[2], G[1], G[3], G[6], G[4], G[0]
	return function()
		local G = game:GetService("RunService")
		local t = false
		local R, B, U = 0, 0, false
		local function M(c)
			local K = c.LookVector
			return math.atan2(-K.X, -K.Z)
		end
		local function c()
			local K = a.CurrentCamera
			return K and M(K.CFrame) or 0
		end
		local function K(w, L)
			B += L
			if B >= 1 / math.max(w, 0.5) then
				B = 0
				return true
			end
			return false
		end
		local w = {
			Helicopter = { yaw = 2.4, emote = { 10714347453, 1 } },
			["Break Dance"] = { yaw = 1.8, emote = { 10714003221, 1.3 } },
			["Top Rock"] = { yaw = 1, emote = { 10714336041, 1.4 } },
			["Air Dance"] = { yaw = 1.4, emote = { 10713957138, 1.5 } },
			["Hero Flip"] = { yaw = 1.2, emote = { 10714360164, 1.2 } },
			Twirl = { yaw = 2.2, emote = { 10714293450, 1.5 } },
			Jacks = { yaw = 1.6, emote = { 10714375667, 1.6 } },
			Floss = { yaw = 1.2, emote = { 10714340543, 1.4 } },
			Tantrum = { yaw = 1.5, emote = { 10714340558, 1.5 } },
			Robot = { yaw = 0.8, emote = { 10714392151, 1.3 } },
		}
		local function L(W, V)
			local r = F.spin.mode or "Smooth"
			local _ = math.clamp(tonumber(F.spin.speed) or 10, 1, 100)
			R += V
			local R = M(W.CFrame)
			local M = w[r]
			if M then
				return R + _ * M.yaw * V
			end
			if r == "Jitter" then
				if K(_ * 0.6, V) then
					U = not U
				end
				return c() + (U and 1.3089969389957472 or -1.3089969389957472)
			end
			if r == "Backwards" then
				return c() + 3.141592653589793
			end
			return R + _ * V
		end
		local R = { char = nil, tracks = {}, track = nil }
		getgenv().__pulseSpinAnim = { anim = w, sa = R }
		local function M()
			local c = R.track
			R.track = nil
			if c then
				pcall(function()
					c:Stop(0.25)
				end)
			end
		end
		local function c(K, W, V, r)
			if R.char ~= K then
				M()
				R.char, R.tracks = K, {}
			end
			local K = R.tracks[V[1]]
			if not K then
				local _, q = pcall(function()
					local u = W:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or W
					local W = Instance.new("Animation")
					W.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. V[1]
					local s = u:LoadAnimation(W)
					s.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
					s.Looped = true
					return s
				end)
				if not _ or not q then
					return
				end
				K = q
				R.tracks[V[1]] = K
			end
			if R.track ~= K then
				M()
				R.track = K
				pcall(function()
					K:Play(0.25)
				end)
			end
			local W = math.clamp(V[2] * (0.8 + r / 50), 0.5, 4)
			pcall(function()
				if math.abs(K.Speed - W) > 0.01 then
					K:AdjustSpeed(W)
				end
			end)
		end
		f(G.Stepped, function()
			local K = F.spin and F.spin.on and w[F.spin.mode or ""] or nil
			if not K then
				if R.track then
					M()
				end
				return
			end
			local w = A.Character
			local W = w and PulseFCC(w, "Humanoid")
			if not (W and W.Health > 0) or PulseFC(w, "Gun") ~= nil then
				if R.track then
					M()
				end
				return
			end
			c(w, W, K.emote, math.clamp(tonumber(F.spin.speed) or 10, 1, 100))
		end)
		local R = 0
		local M = 0
		local c = true
		local K, w = 0, 0
		local W
		local function V()
			if not F.bhopSound then
				return
			end
			if not W then
				W = {}
				for r, r in ipairs({ 7338942417, 7338942345, 7338942259, 7338942180 }) do
					local _, q = pcall(function()
						local u = Instance.new("Sound")
						u.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. r
						u.Volume = 2
						u.Parent = a
						return u
					end)
					if _ and q then
						W[#W + 1] = q
					end
				end
			end
			if #W > 0 then
				local a = W[math.random(1, #W)]
				pcall(function()
					a:Play()
				end)
			end
		end
		f(G.Heartbeat, function(G)
			if not (F.spin and F.spin.on) and not F.bhop and not t then
				if getgenv().__pulseBhopChain then
					R, K, w = 0, 0, 0
					getgenv().__pulseBhopSpeed = 0
					getgenv().__pulseBhopChain = false
				end
				return
			end
			local a = A.Character
			local A = a and PulseFCC(a, "Humanoid")
			local f = a and PulseFC(a, "HumanoidRootPart")
			if F.spin and F.spin.on then
				if A and f and A.Health > 0 then
					t = true
					pcall(function()
						A.AutoRotate = false
						if os.clock() < (tonumber(getgenv().__pulseShotHold) or 0) then
							return
						end
						local a = L(f, G)
						if a then
							f.CFrame = CFrame.new(f.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0)
						end
					end)
				end
			elseif t then
				t = false
				if A and f then
					pcall(function()
						A.AutoRotate = true
						f.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					end)
				end
			end
			local G
			pcall(function()
				G = A:GetState()
			end)
			local a = G == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
			if F.bhop and A and f and A.Health > 0 and not getgenv().__pulseTouchFlinging and not a then
				local a = getgenv().__pulseInvis
				local t
				if a and a.active then
					t = a.grounded
				else
					t = A.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
						and G ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
						and G ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
				end
				local G = os.clock()
				local a = f.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local L = F.bhopPower or 5
				local W = A.WalkSpeed
				if t and not c then
					M = G
				elseif not t and c and a.Y > 2 then
					local r = A.MoveDirection
					if r.Magnitude > 0.1 then
						if R > 0 and G - M <= 0.25 then
							R = R + 2 + L * 1.2
						else
							R = math.max(R, W + 2 + L)
						end
						V()
					end
				end
				if t and G - M > 0.3 then
					R = 0
				end
				local V = A.MoveDirection
				local A = V.Magnitude > 0.1
				if R > 0 and A then
					local A = math.max(W * (2 + 0.4 * L), 100)
					if R > A then
						R = A
					end
					if not t or G - M <= 0.25 then
						local A = Vector3.new(V.X, 0, V.Z).Unit
						local M = math.max(R, tonumber(getgenv().__pulseGlitchCur) or 0)
						f.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(A.X * M, a.Y, A.Z * M)
					end
				end
				c = t
				if R > 0 then
					K = math.max(K, R + 2 + L * 1.2)
					w = G + 0.5
				elseif G > w then
					K = 0
				end
				getgenv().__pulseBhopSpeed = math.max(R, K, W + 2 + L)
				getgenv().__pulseBhopChain = R > 0 or G <= w
			else
				c = true
				R = 0
				if K > 0 and os.clock() <= w then
					getgenv().__pulseBhopSpeed = K
					getgenv().__pulseBhopChain = true
				else

			local function l(x)
				for S, S in ipairs({
					crypt and crypt.base64decode,
					base64decode,
					base64_decode,
					base64 and base64.decode,
				}) do
					if type(S) == "function" then
						local k, y = pcall(S, x)
						if k and type(y) == "string" and #y > 0 then
							return y
						end
					end
				end
				local S = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
				local k = {}
				for y = 1, 64 do
					k[S:sub(y, y)] = y - 1
				end
				local S = {}
				x = x:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", "")
				local y = 1
				while y <= #x do
					local Q = k[x:sub(y, y)] or 0
					local E = k[x:sub(y + 1, y + 1)] or 0
					local I, C = k[x:sub(y + 2, y + 2)], k[x:sub(y + 3, y + 3)]
					S[#S + 1] = string.char(Q * 4 + math.floor(E / 16))
					if I then
						S[#S + 1] = string.char(E % 16 * 16 + math.floor(I / 4))
						if C then
							S[#S + 1] = string.char(I % 4 * 64 + C)
						end
					end
					y += 4
				end
				return table.concat(S)
			end
			pcall(function()
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				pcall(function()
					if type(isfolder) == "function" and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
						makefolder("PulseHub")
					end
				end)
				for x, S in pairs(Y) do
					pcall(function()
						local k = "PulseHub/killfx_" .. x .. "_v2.png"
						if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(k)) then
							writefile(k, l(S))
						end
						local l = getcustomasset(k)
						if type(l) == "string" and #l > 0 then
							u[x] = l
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
			Y = nil
