			local l = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(4)
				if not q.alive then
					return
				end
				local x, S = {}, {}
				for k, k in ipairs({ u, Y }) do
					for y, y in pairs(k) do
						if type(y) == "string" and y ~= "" and not S[y] then
							S[y] = true
							x[#x + 1] = y
						end
					end
				end
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(x)
				end)
			end)
			local function x()
				local S = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if q.folder and q.folder.Parent == S then
					return q.folder
				end
				q.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
				q.folder.Name = "PulseKillFX"
				q.folder.Parent = S
				return q.folder
			end
			local function S(k, y)
				local Q = Instance.new("Part")
				Q.Anchored, Q.CanCollide, Q.CanQuery, Q.CanTouch, Q.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
				Q.Transparency, Q.Size, Q.CFrame = 1, y or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), k
				Q.Parent = x()
				return Q
			end
			local function k(y, Q)
				return task.delay(y / q.ts, Q)
			end
			local function y(Q)
				return task.wait(Q / q.ts)
			end
			local function Q(E, I)
				k(I, function()
					pcall(function()
						E:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
			local function E(I, C, H, n, O)
				local N =
					r:Create(I, TweenInfo.new(C / q.ts, n or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, O or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), H)
				N:Play()
				return N
			end
			local function r(...)
				local I, C = { ... }, {}
				for H = 1, #I, 2 do
					C[#C + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(I[H], I[H + 1])
				end
				return NumberSequence.new(C)
			end
			local function I(C, H)
				return ColorSequence.new(C, H or C)
			end
			local function C(H, n, O, N)
				local z = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				z.Enabled = false
				z.LightEmission, z.LightInfluence, z.Brightness = 1, 0, 2
				z.Speed = NumberRange.new(0)
				for D, b in pairs(n) do
					z[D] = b
				end
				if h[z.Texture] and z.LightEmission < 1 then
					z.LightEmission = 1
				end
				z.TimeScale = q.ts
				z.Parent = H
				k(N or 0, function()
					if z.Parent then
						z:Emit(O)
					end
				end)
				return z
			end
			local function H(n, O, N, z, D)
				local b = Instance.new("PointLight")
				b.Color, b.Brightness, b.Range, b.Shadows = O, N, z, false
				b.Parent = n
				E(b, D, { Brightness = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
			end
			local function n(O, N, z, D, b)
				if not q.sound then
					return nil
				end
				local Z
				pcall(function()
					Z = Instance.new("Sound")
					Z.SoundId = O
					Z.Volume = math.clamp(q.volume / 100, 0, 1) * (N or 1)
					Z.PlaybackSpeed = z or 1
					Z.RollOffMaxDistance = 200
					Z.Parent = D or x()
					Z:Play()
					if b then
						k(b, function()
							if Z.Parent then
								E(Z, 0.4, { Volume = 0 })
							end
						end)
						Q(Z, b + 0.5)
					else
						Q(Z, 5)
					end
				end)
				return Z
			end
			local function O(N)
				for z, z in ipairs(N:GetDescendants()) do
					if s(z, "BasePart") then
						pcall(function()
							z.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						end)
						pcall(function()
							z.CollisionGroup = "Characters"
						end)
					elseif s(z, "Decal") then
						pcall(function()
							z.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function N(z)
				local D = q.origOf[z]
				if D and D.Parent then
					O(D)
				end
				if not q.taken[z] then
					O(z)
				end
			end
			local function z(D)
				local b = D:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
					or D:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
					or D:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not b then
					return false
				end
				if q.forceTake or b.Anchored then
					return true
				end
				local D, Z = pcall(isnetworkowner, b)
				if D and type(Z) == "boolean" then
					return Z
				end
				return true
			end
			local function D(b, Z)
				if not q.origOf[b] or q.taken[b] or not b.Parent then
					return false
				end
				if Z then
					local Z = q.ctxOf[b]
					if not (Z and Z.ghostTakes) then
						return false
					end
				end
				return z(b)
			end
			local function z(b, Z, P, i, d)
				local g = {}
				if D(b, true) then
					q.taken[b] = true
					for o, o in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
						if
							s(o, "BasePart")
							and o.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
							and o.Transparency < 0.95
							and not o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer")
						then
							local p = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
							if not (p and p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true)) then
								g[#g + 1] = o
							end
						end
					end
					for o, o in ipairs(g) do
						for p, p in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
							if p:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
								if not d then
									pcall(function()
										p.TextureId = ""
									end)
								end
							elseif not (d and (p:IsA("Decal") or p:IsA("SurfaceAppearance"))) then
								pcall(function()
									p:Destroy()
								end)
							end
						end
						if o:IsA("MeshPart") and not d then
							pcall(function()
								o.TextureID = ""
							end)
						end
						o.Anchored, o.CanCollide, o.CanQuery, o.CanTouch, o.CastShadow =
							true, false, false, false, false
						if Z then
							o.Material = Z
						end
						if P then
							o.Color = P
						end
						if i then
							o.Transparency = i
						end
						if not d then
							o.Reflectance = 0
						end
						pcall(function()
							o.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
						end)
						o.Name = "G"
					end
					for o, o in ipairs(g) do
						o.Parent = x()
					end
					O(b)
					return g
				end
				for o, o in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
					if
						s(o, "BasePart")
						and o.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
						and o.Transparency < 0.95
						and not o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer")
					then
						local b = o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
						if not (b and b:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true)) then
							local b, p = pcall(function()
								local m = o.Archivable
								o.Archivable = true
								local j = o:Clone()
								o.Archivable = m
								return j
							end)
							if b and p then
								for b, b in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
									if b:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
										if not d then
											b.TextureId = ""
										end
									elseif not (d and (b:IsA("Decal") or b:IsA("SurfaceAppearance"))) then
										b:Destroy()
									end
								end
								if p:IsA("MeshPart") and not d then
									pcall(function()
										p.TextureID = ""
									end)
								end
								p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow =
									true, false, false, false, false
								if Z then
									p.Material = Z
								end
								if P then
									p.Color = P
								end
								p.Transparency = i or o.Transparency
								if not d then
									p.Reflectance = 0
								end
								p.Name = "G"
								p.Parent = x()
								g[#g + 1] = p
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return g
			end
			local function b(Z, P, i)
				for d, d in ipairs(Z) do
					local Z = { Transparency = 1 }
					if i then
						for g, o in pairs(i(d)) do
							Z[g] = o
						end
					end
					E(d, P, Z, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					for Z, Z in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
						if Z:IsA("Decal") then
							E(Z, P, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
						end
					end
					Q(d, P + 0.1)
				end
			end
			local function Z(P, i, d, g, o, p)
				for m = 1, i do
					local i = Instance.new("WedgePart")
					i.Anchored, i.CanCollide, i.CanQuery, i.CanTouch, i.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
					i.Material, i.Color, i.Transparency, i.Reflectance = g, d, 0.15, 0.25
					local d = math.random() * 0.6 + 0.25
					i.Size = Vector3.new(d * 0.4, d, d * 0.8)
					local d = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 1.4 - 0.7, math.random() - 0.5)
						* Vector3.new(2, 4, 1.2)
					i.CFrame = CFrame.new(P + d)
						* CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6.3, math.random() * 6.3, math.random() * 6.3)
					i.Parent = x()
					local g = (d.Magnitude > 0.05 and d.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
						* (o * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6))
					local o = CFrame.new(P + d + g + Vector3.new(0, -2.5 - math.random() * 2, 0))
						* CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 9, math.random() * 9, math.random() * 9)
					E(i, p, { CFrame = o }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
					E(i, p, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					Q(i, p + 0.1)
				end
			end
			local function P(i, d, g)
				local o = RaycastParams.new()
				o.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				o.RespectCanCollide = true
				local p = {}
				for m, m in pairs(d or {}) do
					if typeof(m) == "Instance" then
						p[#p + 1] = m
					end
				end
				local d = workspace:FindFirstChild("PulseKillBodies")
				if d then
					p[#p + 1] = d
				end
				local d = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if d then
					p[#p + 1] = d
				end
				o.FilterDescendantsInstances = p
				local d = i + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
				for i = 1, 8 do
					local i = workspace:Raycast(d, Vector3.new(0, -(g or 60), 0), o)
					if not i then
						return nil
					end
					local d = i.Instance
					local g = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					local m = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if d.Transparency < 0.9 and not m then
						return i.Position, i.Normal
					end
					p[#p + 1] = m and g or d
					o.FilterDescendantsInstances = p
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function i(d, g)
				local o = P(d, g)
				return o and o.Y or d.Y - 3
			end
			local function d(g, o, p, m, j, e, v)
				return C(g, {
					Texture = o,
					Color = I(p),
					Size = r(0, m, 1, j),
					Transparency = r(0, 0, 0.7, 0.4, 1, 1),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(e),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01),
					EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top,
					Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,
					Brightness = v or 3,
				}, 1)
			end
			local function g(o, p, m, j, e, v, GM, aM)
				local AM = math.abs(p.Z) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				local FM = p:Cross(AM).Unit
				local AM = CFrame.fromMatrix(o, FM, p)
				for o = 1, aM or 3 do
					local p = m * (1 - (o - 1) * 0.3)
					local aM = o == 1 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
						or Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * m * 0.35, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * m * 0.35)
					local m = Instance.new("Part")
					m.Anchored, m.CanCollide, m.CanQuery, m.CanTouch, m.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
					m.Transparency = 1
					m.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.05, 0.2)
					m.CFrame = AM
						* CFrame.new(aM + Vector3.new(0, 0.02 + o * 0.012, 0))
						* CFrame.Angles(0, math.random() * 6.28, 0)
					local aM = Instance.new("Decal")
					aM.Texture = GM and not h[GM] and GM or u.splat
					aM.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
					aM.Color3 = j:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), (o - 1) * 0.15)
					aM.Transparency = 0.02 + (o - 1) * 0.1
					aM.Parent = m
					m.Parent = x()
					k((o - 1) * 0.07, function()
						if m.Parent then
							E(m, v or 0.9, { Size = Vector3.new(p, 0.05, p) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
						end
					end)
					k(e, function()
						if aM.Parent then
							E(aM, 1.4, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
						end
					end)
					Q(m, e + 1.5)
				end
			end
			local function h(o, p, m, j, e, v, GM, aM)
				local AM, FM = P(o, e)
				if AM then
					g(AM, FM, p, m, j, v, GM, aM)
				end
			end
			local o = Color3.fromRGB(125, 0, 12)
			local function p(m, j)
				if m and m.torso and m.torso.Parent then
					return m.torso.Position
				end
				return j
			end
			local function m(j)
				for e, e in ipairs(j) do
					pcall(function()
						e:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			local function j(e, v, GM, aM, AM, FM)
				local TM = (v - e).Magnitude
				if TM < 0.01 then
					v = e + Vector3.new(0, 0.01, 0)
					TM = 0.01
				end
				local fM = (v - e).Unit
				local JM = Instance.new("Part")
				JM.Anchored, JM.CanCollide, JM.CanQuery, JM.CanTouch, JM.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
				JM.Material, JM.Color, JM.Transparency = AM or Enum.Material.Neon, aM, FM or 0
				JM.Size = Vector3.new(GM, GM, TM)
				JM.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
					(e + v) / 2,
					v,
					math.abs(fM.Y) > 0.98 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				)
				JM.Parent = x()
				return JM
			end
			local function e(v, GM, aM, AM, FM, TM, fM)
				TM = TM or 12
				local JM = GM - v
				local XM = JM.Unit
				local tM = { v }
				for RM = 1, TM - 1 do
					local BM = RM / TM
					local TM = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 2
					TM = TM - XM * TM:Dot(XM)
					tM[#tM + 1] = v + JM * BM + TM * FM * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.sin(BM * 3.141592653589793))
				end
				tM[#tM + 1] = GM
				local v = {}
				for GM = 1, #tM - 1 do
					v[#v + 1] = j(tM[GM], tM[GM + 1], AM, fM or l)
					v[#v + 1] = j(tM[GM], tM[GM + 1], AM * 3.2, aM, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.72)
				end
				return v, tM
			end
			local function v(GM, aM, AM)
				local FM = os.clock()
				local TM
				TM = _.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
					local fM = math.clamp((os.clock() - FM) * q.ts / GM, 0, 1)
					local GM, FM = pcall(aM, fM)
					if not GM then
						q.driveError = tostring(FM)
					end
					if fM >= 1 or not GM or not q.alive then
						TM:Disconnect()
						if AM then
							local GM, aM = pcall(AM)
							if not GM then
								q.driveError = tostring(aM)
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				return TM
			end
			local function GM(aM, AM, FM, TM, fM)
				local JM = Instance.new("Part")
				JM.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
				JM.Anchored, JM.CanCollide, JM.CanQuery, JM.CanTouch, JM.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
				JM.Material, JM.Color, JM.Transparency = TM or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, FM, fM or 0
				JM.Size = Vector3.new(0.04, AM, AM)
				JM.CFrame = aM * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
				JM.Parent = x()
				return JM
			end
			local function aM(AM, FM, TM, fM)
				return CFrame.new(FM) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(TM, fM) * CFrame.new(-FM) * AM
			end
			local function AM(FM, TM)
				local fM = pcall(function()
					workspace:BulkMoveTo(FM, TM, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
				end)
				if not fM then
					for fM, JM in ipairs(FM) do
						pcall(function()
							JM.CFrame = TM[fM]
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			local function FM(TM, fM, JM, XM, tM, RM)
				local BM = fM - TM
				local fM = BM.Magnitude
				local UM = BM.Unit
				local BM = math.abs(UM.Z) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				local MM = CFrame.fromMatrix(TM, UM:Cross(BM).Unit, UM)
				local TM = {}
				for BM = 0, 3 do
					local cM = Instance.new("WedgePart")
					cM.Anchored, cM.CanCollide, cM.CanQuery, cM.CanTouch, cM.CastShadow =
						true, false, false, false, false
					cM.Material, cM.Color, cM.Reflectance = RM, tM, 0.15
					cM.Size = Vector3.new(JM, fM, XM)
					cM.CFrame = MM * CFrame.Angles(0, BM * 3.141592653589793 / 2, 0) * CFrame.new(0, fM / 2, -XM / 2)
					cM.Parent = x()
					TM[#TM + 1] = cM
				end
				return TM, UM, fM
			end
			local TM = { list = {}, bound = false, restore = nil }
			local function fM()
				pcall(function()
					_:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseKillShakeA")
				end)
				pcall(function()
					_:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseKillShakeB")
				end)
				if TM.restore then
					local JM = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if JM then
						pcall(function()
							JM.CFrame = TM.restore
						end)
					end
					TM.restore = nil
				end
				TM.list = {}
				TM.bound = false
			end
			local function JM(XM, tM, RM)
				if not q.shake or not q.alive then
					return
				end
				local BM = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if not BM then
					return
				end
				local UM = tM * math.clamp(1.2 - (BM.CFrame.Position - XM).Magnitude / 75, 0, 1)
				if UM < 0.05 then
					return
				end
				TM.list[#TM.list + 1] = { t0 = os.clock(), amp = UM, dur = RM, seed = math.random() * 50 }
				if TM.bound then
					return
				end
				TM.bound = true
				_:BindToRenderStep("PulseKillShakeA", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, function()
					if TM.restore then
						local XM = workspace.CurrentCamera
						if XM then
							XM.CFrame = TM.restore
						end
						TM.restore = nil
					end
					if #TM.list == 0 then
						fM()
					end
				end)
				_:BindToRenderStep("PulseKillShakeB", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
					local XM = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not XM then
						return
					end
					local tM, RM, BM = 0, 0, 0
					local UM = os.clock()
					for MM = #TM.list, 1, -1.0 do
						local cM = TM.list[MM]
						local KM = (UM - cM.t0) * q.ts / cM.dur
						if KM >= 1 then
							table.remove(TM.list, MM)
						else
							local MM = cM.amp * (1 - KM) ^ 2
							local KM = (UM - cM.t0) * 24
							tM += math.noise(KM, cM.seed) * MM * 2.2
							RM += math.noise(cM.seed, KM) * MM * 2.2
							BM += math.noise(KM, cM.seed + 9.3) * MM
						end
					end
					if tM ~= 0 or RM ~= 0 or BM ~= 0 then
						TM.restore = XM.CFrame
						XM.CFrame = XM.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tM), math.rad(RM), math.rad(BM))
					end
				end)
			end
			local TM = {
				"LuaSourceContainer",
				"Tool",
				"ForceField",
				"BillboardGui",
				"SurfaceGui",
				"Sound",
				"ParticleEmitter",
				"Trail",
				"Beam",
				"Highlight",
				"Light",
				"Fire",
				"Smoke",
				"Sparkles",
				"BodyMover",
				"SelectionBox",
				"ProximityPrompt",
				"ClickDetector",
				"Animator",
			}
			local XM = {}
			for tM, tM in ipairs({
				"Script",
				"LocalScript",
				"ModuleScript",
				"Tool",
				"ForceField",
				"BillboardGui",
				"SurfaceGui",
				"Sound",
				"ParticleEmitter",
				"Trail",
				"Beam",
				"Highlight",
				"PointLight",
				"SpotLight",
				"SurfaceLight",
				"Fire",
				"Smoke",
				"Sparkles",
				"BodyVelocity",
				"BodyGyro",
				"BodyPosition",
				"BodyForce",
				"BodyAngularVelocity",
				"BodyThrust",
				"RocketPropulsion",
				"SelectionBox",
				"ProximityPrompt",
				"ClickDetector",
				"Animator",
			}) do
				XM[tM] = true
			end
			local tM = {}
			local function RM(BM)
				local UM = BM.ClassName
				local MM = tM[UM]
				if MM == nil then
					MM = XM[UM] == true
					if not MM then
						for XM, XM in ipairs(TM) do
							if BM:IsA(XM) then
								MM = true
								break
							end
						end
					end
					tM[UM] = MM
				end
				return MM
			end
			local function TM(XM)
				if D(XM) then
					q.taken[XM] = true
					for D, D in ipairs(XM:GetDescendants()) do
						if RM(D) then
							pcall(function()
								D:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					for D, D in ipairs(XM:GetDescendants()) do
						if s(D, "BasePart") or s(D, "Decal") then
							pcall(function()
								D.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
							end)
						end
					end
					local D = XM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if D then
						pcall(function()
							D.RequiresNeck, D.BreakJointsOnDeath, D.EvaluateStateMachine = false, false, false
							D.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
							D.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
						end)
					end
					XM.Name = "PulseKillBody"
					return XM
				end
				local D = XM.Archivable
				XM.Archivable = true
				local tM, BM = pcall(function()
					return XM:Clone()
				end)
				pcall(function()
					XM.Archivable = D
				end)
				if not tM or not BM then
					return nil
				end
				for D, D in ipairs(BM:GetDescendants()) do
					if RM(D) then
						pcall(function()
							D:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
				local D = BM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if D then
					pcall(function()
						D.RequiresNeck, D.BreakJointsOnDeath, D.EvaluateStateMachine = false, false, false
						D.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
						D.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
						D.MaxHealth, D.Health = 100, 100
					end)
				end
				BM.Name = "PulseKillBody"
				return BM
			end
			local function D(XM)
				local tM = TM(XM.char)
				if not tM then
					return z(XM.char, nil, nil, nil, true), nil
				end
				for XM, XM in ipairs(tM:GetDescendants()) do
					if XM:IsA("JointInstance") or XM:IsA("WeldConstraint") or XM:IsA("Constraint") then
						pcall(function()
							XM.Enabled = false
						end)
					end
				end
				local XM = {}
				for RM, RM in ipairs(tM:GetDescendants()) do
					if s(RM, "BasePart") then
						RM.Anchored, RM.CanCollide, RM.CanQuery, RM.CanTouch, RM.CastShadow =
							true, false, false, false, false
						if RM.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or RM.Transparency >= 0.95 then
							RM.Transparency = 1
						else
							XM[#XM + 1] = RM
						end
					end
				end
				tM.Parent = x()
				Q(tM, 9)
				return XM, tM
			end
			local function XM()
				if q.bodies and q.bodies.Parent == workspace then
					return q.bodies
				end
				q.bodies = Instance.new("Folder")
				q.bodies.Name = "PulseKillBodies"
				q.bodies.Parent = workspace
				return q.bodies
			end
			local function tM(RM, BM, UM, MM, cM, KM)
				local wM = TM(RM.char)
				if not wM then
					return nil
				end
				local TM = wM:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local function LM(WM, VM)
					if WM and VM and WM:IsA("BasePart") and VM:IsA("BasePart") then
						local rM = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
						rM.Part0, rM.Part1 = WM, VM
						rM.Parent = WM
					end
				end
				local WM = {}
				local function VM(rM, _M)
					return WM[rM] and WM[rM][_M] or WM[_M] and WM[_M][rM]
				end
				local function rM(_M, qM)
					WM[_M] = WM[_M] or {}
					WM[_M][qM] = true
				end
				local WM
				do
					local _M, qM, uM = {}, {}, {}
					for sM, sM in ipairs(wM:GetDescendants()) do
						local hM = sM.ClassName
						if hM == "BallSocketConstraint" then
							_M[#_M + 1] = sM
						elseif hM == "Motor6D" then
							qM[#qM + 1] = sM
						elseif hM == "AnimationConstraint" then
							uM[#uM + 1] = sM
						end
					end
					WM = _M
					for _M, _M in ipairs(qM) do
						WM[#WM + 1] = _M
					end
					for _M, _M in ipairs(uM) do
						WM[#WM + 1] = _M
					end
				end
				for _M, _M in ipairs(WM) do
					if _M:IsA("Motor6D") then
						local WM, qM = _M.Part0, _M.Part1
						if WM and qM and WM ~= TM and qM ~= TM and not VM(WM, qM) then
							rM(WM, qM)
							local uM = Instance.new("Attachment")
							uM.CFrame = _M.C0
							uM.Parent = WM
							local sM = Instance.new("Attachment")
							sM.CFrame = _M.C1
							sM.Parent = qM
							local hM = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
							hM.Attachment0, hM.Attachment1 = uM, sM
							hM.LimitsEnabled, hM.UpperAngle = true, 60
							hM.TwistLimitsEnabled, hM.TwistLowerAngle, hM.TwistUpperAngle = true, -45.0, 45
							hM.Parent = WM
							LM(WM, qM)
						end
						_M:Destroy()
					elseif _M:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
						local WM, qM = _M.Attachment0, _M.Attachment1
						local uM, sM = WM and WM.Parent, qM and qM.Parent
						if
							uM
							and sM
							and uM:IsA("BasePart")
							and sM:IsA("BasePart")
							and uM ~= TM
							and sM ~= TM
							and not VM(uM, sM)
						then
							rM(uM, sM)
							local hM = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
							hM.Attachment0, hM.Attachment1 = WM, qM
							hM.LimitsEnabled, hM.UpperAngle = true, 60
							hM.TwistLimitsEnabled, hM.TwistLowerAngle, hM.TwistUpperAngle = true, -45.0, 45
							hM.Parent = uM
							LM(uM, sM)
						end
						_M:Destroy()
					elseif _M:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and _M.Attachment0 and _M.Attachment1 then
						local WM, qM = _M.Attachment0.Parent, _M.Attachment1.Parent
						if WM and qM and VM(WM, qM) then
							_M:Destroy()
						else
							if WM and qM then
								rM(WM, qM)
							end
							_M.Enabled = true
							_M.LimitsEnabled, _M.UpperAngle = true, 60
							_M.TwistLimitsEnabled, _M.TwistLowerAngle, _M.TwistUpperAngle = true, -45.0, 45
							pcall(function()
								_M.MaxFrictionTorque = 0
							end)
							pcall(function()
								_M.Restitution = 0
							end)
							LM(WM, qM)
						end
					end
				end
				if TM then
					TM:Destroy()
				end
				local TM, LM = {}, {}
				for WM, WM in ipairs(wM:GetDescendants()) do
					if s(WM, "BasePart") then
						local VM = WM:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
						WM.Anchored, WM.CanQuery, WM.CanTouch = false, false, false
						WM.CanCollide = not VM
						WM.Massless = VM == true
						pcall(function()
							WM.CollisionGroup = "Ragdolls"
						end)
						TM[#TM + 1] = WM
						if not VM then
							LM[#LM + 1] = WM
						end
					end
				end
				local WM = wM ~= RM.char and RM.char or RM.orig
				for RM, RM in ipairs(WM and WM.Parent and WM:GetDescendants() or {}) do
					if s(RM, "BasePart") then
						pcall(function()
							RM.CanCollide = false
							RM.CollisionGroup = "Characters"
						end)
					end
				end
				wM.Parent = XM()
				for RM, RM in ipairs(LM) do
					RM.CanCollide = true
				end
				local RM = wM:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or wM:FindFirstChild("Torso") or LM[1]
				local WM = { model = wM, parts = TM, body = LM, torso = RM, head = wM:FindFirstChild("Head") }
				local VM = wM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if VM then
					pcall(function()
						VM.PlatformStand = true
						VM:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
					end)
				end
				local function VM()
					for rM, rM in ipairs(LM) do
						pcall(function()
							rM.CanCollide = true
							rM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = BM
						end)
					end
					if UM and RM then
						pcall(function()
							RM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = UM
						end)
					end
					if cM then
						pcall(cM, WM)
					end
				end
				local function RM()
					VM()
					local UM = 0
					local LM
					LM = _.Stepped:Connect(function()
						UM += 1
						if wM.Parent then
							VM()
						end
						if UM >= 2 then
							LM:Disconnect()
						end
					end)
				end
				if KM then
					for UM, UM in ipairs(TM) do
						UM.Anchored = true
					end
					WM.release = function(UM, KM)
						if WM.released or not wM.Parent then
							return
						end
						WM.released = true
						if UM then
							BM = UM
						end
						if KM then
							cM = KM
						end
						for BM, BM in ipairs(TM) do
							BM.Anchored = false
						end
						RM()
					end
				else
					WM.release = function() end
					RM()
				end
				MM = MM or 2.8
				k(MM, function()
					for RM, RM in ipairs(TM) do
						if RM.Parent then
							E(RM, 0.5, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
							for TM, TM in ipairs(RM:GetChildren()) do
								if TM:IsA("Decal") then
									E(TM, 0.5, { Transparency = 1 })
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				Q(wM, MM + 0.6)
				return WM
			end
			local function TM(RM)
				local BM = RM.killer and RM.killer.Parent and RM.killer.Position
					or workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
					or RM.root + Vector3.new(0, 0, 5)
				local UM = RM.root - BM
				UM = Vector3.new(UM.X, 0, UM.Z)
				return UM.Magnitude > 0.05 and UM.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0), BM
			end
			local function RM(BM)
				return Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * BM
			end
			local function BM(UM, MM, cM, KM, wM, LM, WM)
				local VM = (MM - UM).Magnitude
				if VM < 0.01 then
					return nil
				end
				local rM = Instance.new("Part")
				rM.Anchored, rM.CanCollide, rM.CanQuery, rM.CanTouch, rM.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
				rM.Material, rM.Color, rM.Transparency = LM or Enum.Material.Neon, wM, WM or 0
				rM.Size = Vector3.new(cM, 0.04, VM + 0.03)
				rM.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((UM + MM) / 2, MM, KM)
				rM.Parent = x()
				return rM
			end
			local function UM(MM, cM, KM, wM, LM, WM, VM, rM, _M, qM, uM)
				local sM = cM:Cross(KM).Unit
				local hM = {}
				for YM = 0, 14 do
					local lM = LM + (WM - LM) * YM / 14
					hM[YM] = MM + (cM * math.cos(lM) + KM * math.sin(lM)) * wM
				end
				for cM = 1, 14 do
					local KM = math.sin(3.141592653589793 * (cM - 0.5) / 14) ^ 0.7
					local wM, LM = hM[cM - 1], hM[cM]
					local WM = ((wM + LM) / 2 - MM).Unit
					k(_M * (cM - 1) / 14, function()
						if not q.alive then
							return
						end
						local MM = BM(
							wM + WM * rM * KM * 0.3,
							LM + WM * rM * KM * 0.3,
							math.max(0.04, rM * KM * 0.55),
							sM,
							uM or l
						)
						local cM = BM(wM, LM, math.max(0.1, rM * KM * 1.6), sM, VM, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.45)
						for BM, BM in pairs({ MM, cM }) do
							k(qM, function()
								if BM.Parent then
									E(BM, 0.22, {
										Transparency = 1,
										Size = Vector3.new(0.02, BM.Size.Y, BM.Size.Z),
										CFrame = BM.CFrame + WM * 0.7,
									}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
								end
							end)
							Q(BM, qM + 0.3)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			local function BM(MM, cM, KM, wM, LM, WM, VM, rM, _M, qM, uM)
				local sM = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local hM = sM and sM.CFrame or CFrame.new()
				local sM = math.rad(_M or 0)
				local _M = (hM.LookVector * math.cos(sM) + hM.RightVector * math.sin(sM)).Unit
				local sM = math.rad(cM)
				local cM = hM.RightVector * math.cos(sM) + hM.UpVector * math.sin(sM)
				cM = (cM - _M * cM:Dot(_M)).Unit
				if uM then
					cM = -cM
				end
				local uM = _M:Cross(cM).Unit
				local _M = MM - uM * KM * math.cos(wM)
				UM(_M, uM, cM, KM, -wM, wM, LM, WM, VM, rM, qM)
			end
			local function MM(cM, KM)
				for wM = 0, (KM or 7) - 1 do
					k(wM * 0.055, function()
						n(wM % 2 == 0 and Y.click or Y.switch, 0.8, 0.6 + math.random() * 1.6, cM)
					end)
				end
				n(Y.flash, 0.6, 0.7, cM)
				n(Y.shutter, 0.5, 0.8, cM)
			end
			local function cM(KM, wM, LM, WM, VM)
				local rM = Instance.new("Highlight")
				rM.FillColor, rM.OutlineColor = wM, LM or wM
				rM.FillTransparency, rM.OutlineTransparency = WM or 0.5, VM or 0
				rM.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
				rM.Adornee = KM
				rM.Parent = KM
				return rM
			end
			local function KM(wM, LM)
				local WM = S(CFrame.new(wM), Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4))
				local wM = Instance.new("Attachment")
				wM.Parent = WM
				Q(WM, LM or 4)
				return WM, wM
			end
			local function wM(LM, WM, VM, rM)
				local _M, qM = KM(LM)
				C(qM, {
					Texture = u.core,
					Color = I(l, WM),
					Size = r(0, VM * 0.2, 1, VM),
					Transparency = r(0, 0, 1, 1),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.35),
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					Brightness = rM or 5,
					ZOffset = 1,
				}, 2)
				H(_M, WM, 10, math.min(60, VM * 3), 0.5)
				return _M, qM
			end
			local function LM(WM, VM, rM, _M, qM)
				local uM, sM = KM(WM)
				C(sM, {
					Texture = qM or u.fsparks,
					Color = I(l, VM),
					Size = r(0, 0.5, 1, 0),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(_M * 0.5, _M),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
					Drag = 3,
					Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -25.0, 0),
					Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel,
					Brightness = 5,
				}, rM)
				return uM, sM
			end
			local function WM(VM, rM, _M, qM, uM)
				local sM = S(CFrame.new(VM), Vector3.new(2, 0.5, 2))
				C(sM, {
					Texture = u.smokeFB,
					FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,
					FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot,
					Color = I(rM),
					Size = r(0, (uM or 2) * 0.6, 1, (uM or 2) * 1.6),
					Transparency = r(0, 0.2, 0.7, 0.45, 1, 1),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(qM * 0.4, qM),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(85, 85),
					Drag = 3,
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
					LightEmission = 0,
					LightInfluence = 1,
					Brightness = 1,
				}, _M)
				Q(sM, 2.5)
				return sM
			end
			local function VM(rM, _M, qM, uM, sM, hM, YM)
				local lM = P(rM, YM)
				local YM = S(CFrame.new((lM or rM) + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)), Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.4))
				local rM = Instance.new("Attachment")
				rM.Parent = YM
				local lM = d(rM, hM or u.ringEdge, _M, qM, uM, sM, 3)
				Q(YM, sM + 0.5)
				return lM, YM
			end
			local function rM(_M, qM, uM, sM, hM, YM, lM, xM)
				local xM = XM()
				local SM = {}
				for kM = 1, qM do
					local qM = Instance.new("Part")
					local yM = hM * (0.5 + math.random())
					qM.Size = Vector3.new(yM, yM * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), yM * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.5))
					qM.Material, qM.Color = sM or Enum.Material.Slate, uM
					qM.CanQuery, qM.CanTouch = false, false
					pcall(function()
						qM.CollisionGroup = "Ragdolls"
					end)
					qM.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						_M + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, math.random() * 0.8, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5)
					) * CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
					qM.Parent = xM
					SM[kM] = qM
					local _M = (lM or 2) + math.random() * 0.6
					k(_M, function()
						if qM.Parent then
							E(qM, 0.4, { Size = qM.Size * 0.2, Transparency = 1 })
						end
					end)
					Q(qM, _M + 0.5)
				end
				local function _M()
					for qM, qM in ipairs(SM) do
						if qM.Parent then
							local uM = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5)
							uM = uM.Magnitude > 0.05 and uM.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
							qM.AssemblyLinearVelocity = uM * YM * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.6)
								+ Vector3.new(0, YM * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), 0)
							qM.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RM(8)
						end
					end
				end
				_M()
				local qM
				qM = _.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					qM:Disconnect()
					_M()
				end)
				return SM
			end
			local function _M(qM, uM, sM)
				local hM = Instance.new("Beam")
				hM.Attachment0, hM.Attachment1 = qM, uM
				hM.FaceCamera, hM.LightEmission, hM.LightInfluence, hM.Segments = true, 1, 0, 12
				for uM, YM in pairs(sM) do
					hM[uM] = YM
				end
				hM.Parent = qM.Parent
				return hM
			end
			local function qM(uM, sM, hM)
				if not (uM and sM and hM) then
					return nil
				end
				for YM, YM in ipairs(uM.model:GetDescendants()) do
					if YM:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
						local uM = YM.Attachment0 and YM.Attachment0.Parent
						local lM = YM.Attachment1 and YM.Attachment1.Parent
						if uM == sM and lM == hM or uM == hM and lM == sM then
							return YM
						end
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function uM(sM, hM, YM)
				if not (sM and hM and YM) then
					return
				end
				for lM, lM in ipairs(sM.model:GetDescendants()) do
					if lM:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
						local sM = lM.Attachment0 and lM.Attachment0.Parent
						local xM = lM.Attachment1 and lM.Attachment1.Parent
						if sM == hM and xM == YM or sM == YM and xM == hM then
							lM:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local function sM(hM, YM, lM)
				if not (hM and hM.Parent) then
					return nil
				end
				local xM = Instance.new("Part")
				xM.Size = Vector3.new(hM.Size.X * 0.8, 0.05, hM.Size.Z * 0.8)
				xM.Material, xM.Color = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(160, 0, 14)
				xM.CanCollide, xM.CanQuery, xM.CanTouch, xM.Massless, xM.CastShadow = false, false, false, true, false
				xM.CFrame = hM.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (YM and 1 or -1.0) * (hM.Size.Y / 2 - 0.02), 0)
				xM.Parent = lM or hM.Parent
				local lM = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				lM.Part0, lM.Part1 = hM, xM
				lM.Parent = xM
				local hM = C(xM, {
					Texture = u.splat,
					Color = I(Color3.fromRGB(190, 0, 25), Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 10)),
					Size = r(0, 0.35, 1, 0.14),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 11),
					SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25),
					Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -55.0, 0),
					EmissionDirection = YM and Enum.NormalId.Top or Enum.NormalId.Bottom,
					Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
					LightEmission = 0,
					Brightness = 1,
				}, 8)
				hM.Rate = 55
				hM.Enabled = true
				k(0.9, function()
					if hM.Parent then
						hM.Enabled = false
					end
				end)
				k(1.1, function()
					if xM.Parent then
						E(xM, 0.5, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 0, 5), Transparency = 1 })
					end
				end)
				return xM
			end
			local function hM(YM, lM, xM, SM, kM)
				local yM = {}
				for QM, QM in ipairs(YM) do
					local YM, EM = pcall(function()
						return QM:Clone()
					end)
					if YM and EM then
						for YM, YM in ipairs(EM:GetChildren()) do
							if YM:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
								YM.TextureId = ""
							else
								YM:Destroy()
							end
						end
						pcall(function()
							if EM:IsA("MeshPart") then
								EM.TextureID = ""
							end
						end)
						EM.Anchored, EM.CanCollide, EM.CanQuery, EM.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
						EM.Material, EM.Color, EM.Reflectance, EM.Transparency = lM, xM, kM or 0, 1
						EM.Parent = x()
						yM[#yM + 1] = EM
						E(EM, SM, { Transparency = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
					end
					E(QM, SM, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
					for YM, YM in ipairs(QM:GetChildren()) do
						if YM:IsA("Decal") then
							E(YM, SM, { Transparency = 1 })
						end
					end
				end
				return yM
			end
			local function YM(lM, xM, SM, kM, yM)
				local QM = {}
				local function EM(IM, CM, HM, nM)
					local OM = Instance.new(IM)
					OM.Anchored, OM.CanCollide, OM.CanQuery, OM.CanTouch, OM.CastShadow =
						true, false, false, false, false
					OM.Size, OM.Color, OM.Material, OM.Transparency = CM, HM, nM, yM or 0
					OM.Reflectance = nM == Enum.Material.Metal and 0.35 or 0
					OM.Parent = x()
					QM[#QM + 1] = OM
				end
				EM("WedgePart", Vector3.new(0.06, SM, kM / 2), lM, xM)
				EM("WedgePart", Vector3.new(0.06, SM, kM / 2), lM, xM)
				EM("Part", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.1, kM + 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(40, 36, 34), Enum.Material.Metal)
				EM("Part", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.7, 0.17), Color3.fromRGB(60, 34, 20), Enum.Material.Wood)
				local lM = {
					CFrame.new(0, SM / 2, -kM / 4),
					CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0) * CFrame.new(0, SM / 2, -kM / 4),
					CFrame.new(0, -0.05, 0),
					CFrame.new(0, -0.45, 0),
				}
				return QM, lM
			end
			local function lM(xM, SM)
				local kM = math.abs(SM.Z) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				return CFrame.fromMatrix(xM, SM:Cross(kM).Unit, SM)
			end
			local function xM(SM, kM, yM)
				for QM, EM in ipairs(SM) do
					if EM.Parent then
						EM.CFrame = yM * kM[QM]
					end
				end
			end
			local function SM(kM)
				local yM = kM.killer
				local kM = yM and yM.Parent
				if kM and kM:IsA("Model") and kM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					return kM
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function kM(yM, QM)
				if not (yM and yM.torso) then
					return nil
				end
				local EM = 0
				for IM, IM in ipairs(yM.body) do
					EM += IM:GetMass()
				end
				local IM = Instance.new("Attachment")
				IM.Parent = yM.torso
				local CM = Instance.new("VectorForce")
				CM.Attachment0 = IM
				CM.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
				CM.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
				CM.Force = Vector3.new(0, EM * workspace.Gravity * QM, 0)
				CM.Parent = yM.torso
				return CM
			end
			local function yM(QM)
				for EM, EM in ipairs(QM.model:GetDescendants()) do
					if EM:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
						EM:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
			local function QM()
				local EM = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local IM = EM and EM.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
				local EM = Vector3.new(IM.X, 0, IM.Z)
				EM = EM.Magnitude > 0.05 and EM.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0)
				return EM, Vector3.new(-EM.Z, 0, EM.X)
			end
			local function EM(IM, CM, HM, nM, OM, NM, zM, DM)
				local bM = RaycastParams.new()
				bM.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				bM.RespectCanCollide = true
				local ZM = { workspace.CurrentCamera, XM() }
				for PM, PM in pairs(OM or {}) do
					if typeof(PM) == "Instance" then
						ZM[#ZM + 1] = PM
					end
				end
				bM.FilterDescendantsInstances = ZM
				for OM = 1, CM do
					local CM = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 1.2 - 0.8, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
						* (nM or 14)
					local nM = workspace:Raycast(IM, CM, bM)
					if nM and nM.Instance.Transparency < 0.9 then
						local IM = nM.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
						if not (IM and IM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
							local IM = typeof(HM) == "function" and HM(OM) or HM
							local CM, HM = NM or 1.2, zM or 3
							k(nM.Distance / 45, function()
								g(nM.Position, nM.Normal, CM + math.random() * (HM - CM), IM, DM or 3, 0.12, u.splat, 2)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local IM = {}

					local HM = MM.part.Position

					local HM = nM.Magnitude
					if HM < 0.1 then
						return
					end
					local OM = nM / HM
					local nM = math.max(1, math.floor(HM * CM / 0.42))
					for CM = 1, math.max(nM, #MM.links) do
						local HM = MM.links[CM]
						if not HM and CM <= nM then
							HM = Instance.new("Part")
							HM.Anchored, HM.CanCollide, HM.CanQuery, HM.CanTouch, HM.CastShadow =
								true, false, false, false, false

							HM.Parent = x()
							MM.links[CM] = HM
						end
						if HM then
							if CM <= nM then
								local nM = MM.from + OM * (CM - 0.5) * 0.42
								HM.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(nM, nM + OM)
									* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, CM % 2 == 0 and 1.5707963267948966 or 0)

							end
						end
					end

					end

						)

					if #aM >= 20 then

					end

							{ part = UM(0.62 * YM, sM[1], 0.1), side = -1.0, z = -0.1 * YM, r = 0.3 * YM },
							{ part = UM(0.62 * YM, sM[1], 0.1), side = 1, z = -0.1 * YM, r = 0.3 * YM },

								* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, uM.side * aM)
								* CFrame.new(uM.side * uM.r, 0, 0)
								* e
						end
						local e = math.clamp((sM - 2.5) / 0.7, 0, 1)
						if e > 0 then
							for aM, aM in ipairs(MM.wings) do
								aM.part.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * e
							end

						end

				end, function()

					m(o)
				end)

					end

				end

					local UM = (aM - e).Magnitude

						p.Transparency = 1
						return
					end
					p.Size = Vector3.new(BM, BM, UM)
					p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
						(e + aM) / 2,
						aM,
						math.abs((aM - e).Unit.Y) > 0.98 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					)
				end

						o(z[12 + g], MM[e[1]], MM[e[2]], 0.1)
					end

						o(z[24 + d], UM[d], MM[d], 0.06)
					end

								* p[d].cf.Rotation
								* CFrame.Angles(aM * 3, aM * 2, 0)

						end
					end

					m(Z)

					C(z, {
						Texture = u.square,
						Color = I(l, b),
						Size = r(0, 0.35, 1, 0),

						Speed = NumberRange.new(10, 22),

						Drag = 3,
						Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 90),
						Brightness = 5,
					}, 50)

						Texture = u.ring,

				d.CFrame = CFrame.new(D + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
				d.Parent = x()
				local g = C(d, {
					Texture = u.star4,
					Color = I(l),
					Size = r(0, 0, 0.5, 0.8, 1, 0),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3),
					Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere,
					Brightness = 6,
					ZOffset = 1,
				}, 0)
				g.Rate = 25
				g.Enabled = true
				local o = Instance.new("Attachment")
				o.Parent = d
				local p = {}
				for j, e in ipairs(z) do
					local GM = S(CFrame.new(b + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)), Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
					local aM = Instance.new("Attachment")
					aM.Parent = GM
					local XM = _M(
						o,
						aM,
						{ Width0 = 0.25, Width1 = 1.6, Color = I(e), Transparency = r(0, 0.45, 1, 0.6), Segments = 1 }
					)
					local o = Instance.new("PointLight")
					o.Color, o.Range, o.Brightness, o.Shadows = e, 6, 2, false
					o.Parent = GM
					p[j] = { sp = GM, bm = XM, ph = j / #z * 6.283, r = 3 + j % 3 }
				end
				local o = Z and cM(Z.model, z[1], l, 0.5, 0.2)
				local j = 0
				v(2.1, function(e)
					local GM = e * 2.1
					local e = math.min(1, GM / 0.3)
					d.CFrame = CFrame.new(D + Vector3.new(0, 3 * (1 - e), 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, GM * 3, 0)
					for e, e in ipairs(p) do
						local aM = e.ph + GM * 2.5
						e.sp.CFrame = CFrame.new(b + Vector3.new(math.cos(aM) * e.r, 0.2, math.sin(aM) * e.r))
					end
					if o and o.Parent then
						o.FillColor = z[math.floor(GM * 7) % #z + 1]
					end
					if GM >= j and Z and Z.torso and Z.torso.Parent then
						j = GM + 0.25
						for b, b in ipairs(Z.body) do
							pcall(function()
								b.AssemblyLinearVelocity = b.AssemblyLinearVelocity
									+ Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.8, math.random() - 0.5) * 9
							end)
						end
						n(Y.bounce, 0.35, 1 + math.floor(GM * 4) % 2 * 0.3)
					end
				end, function()
					g.Enabled = false
					if _ then
						pcall(function()
							_:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					for _, _ in ipairs(p) do
						pcall(function()
							_.bm:Destroy()
						end)
						Q(_.sp, 0)
					end
					if o then
						E(o, 0.4, { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 })
					end
					E(d, 0.4, { CFrame = d.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Transparency = 1 })
					Q(d, 0.45)
					local _, _ = KM(D)
					for D, D in ipairs(z) do
						C(_, {
							Texture = u.square,
							Color = I(D),
							Size = r(0, 0.22, 1, 0.18),
							Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2),
							Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 18),
							SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180),
							Drag = 2.5,
							Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -14.0, 0),
							Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360),
							RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-400.0, 400),
							LightEmission = 0.2,
							LightInfluence = 0.6,
							Brightness = 1.6,
						}, 10)
					end
					n(Y.chimes, 0.6, 1.4, nil, 2)
					n(Y.partyHorn2, 0.5, 1.3)
				end)
				n(Y.partyHorn2, 0.5, 0.9)
			end
			IM.Earthquake = function(_)
				local z, D = TM(_)
				local b = _.root
				local Z = Vector3.new(D.X, b.Y, D.Z)
				local D = Vector3.new(b.X - Z.X, 0, b.Z - Z.Z)
				local d = math.min(D.Magnitude, 26)
				local g = D.Magnitude > 0.5 and D.Unit or z
				Z = b - g * d
				local z = tM(_, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), nil, 3.8, nil, true)
				N(_.char)
				local D = math.max(4, math.floor(d / 2.2))
				for b = 1, D do
					k(b * 0.045, function()
						local o = Z + g * (d * b / D)
						local Z = P(o + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), _.ignore)
						if not Z then
							return
						end
						local P = b == D
						local D = P and 7 or 2 + math.random() * 2.5
						local d = P and 2.6 or 1.1 + math.random() * 0.8
						local p = Instance.new("Part")
						p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, true
						p.Size, p.Material, p.Color =
							Vector3.new(d, D, d),
							Enum.Material.Slate,
							Color3.fromRGB(105, 98, 92):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(70, 64, 60), math.random())
						local d = CFrame.Angles(
							(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
							math.random() * 6.28,
							(math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3
						)
						p.CFrame = CFrame.new(Z - Vector3.new(0, D / 2 + 0.2, 0)) * d
						p.Parent = x()
						E(
							p,
				0.12,
							{ CFrame = CFrame.new(Z + Vector3.new(0, D / 2 - 0.4, 0)) * d },
							Enum.EasingStyle.Back
						)
						WM(Z, Color3.fromRGB(140, 130, 120), 3, 5, 1.5)
						h(o, 2.4, Color3.fromRGB(30, 26, 24), 2.2, _.ignore, 0.1, u.cracks, 1)
						if b % 2 == 0 then
							n(Y.rockCrack, 0.5, 0.9 + math.random() * 0.4)
						end
						k(1.5, function()
							if p.Parent then
								E(
									p,
				0.45,
									{ CFrame = p.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, D, 0) },
									Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
									Enum.EasingDirection.In
								)
							end
						end)
						Q(p, 2.1)
						if P then
							if z then
								z.release(Vector3.new(0, 70, 0) + g * 10, nil)
								pcall(function()
									z.torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RM(9)
								end)
							end
							WM(Z, Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 130), 14, 10, 2.5)
							rM(
								Z + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
				14,
								Color3.fromRGB(95, 88, 82),
								Enum.Material.Slate,
				0.45, 26,
								1.8
							)
							VM(Z, Color3.fromRGB(210, 200, 190), 2, 20, 0.5, nil, _.ignore)
							n(Y.quake, 0.9, 0.7)
							n(Y.rockCrack, 1, 0.7)
							JM(Z, 1.8, 0.4)
						end
					end)
				end
				JM(_.root, 1, 0.9)
			end
			IM.Glacier = function(_)
				local h = Color3.fromRGB(170, 225, 255)
				local z = i(_.root, _.ignore)
				local D = tM(_, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), nil, 3.8, nil, true)
				N(_.char)
				local N = Vector3.new(_.root.X, z - 0.3, _.root.Z)
				local _ = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 3.5, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
				local z = {}
				local b, Z = FM(N, N + _ * 12, 0.9, 1.4, h, Enum.Material.Ice)
				for P, P in ipairs(b) do
					P.Transparency, P.Reflectance = 0.1, 0.25
					local b = P.CFrame
					P.CFrame = b - Z * 12.5
					E(P, 0.22, { CFrame = b }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
					z[#z + 1] = P
				end
				for b = 1, 6 do
					local Z = b / 6 * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.4
					local P = N + Vector3.new(math.cos(Z) * 2.8, 0, math.sin(Z) * 2.8)
					local d = P + Vector3.new(math.cos(Z) * 1.2, 3 + math.random() * 2.5, math.sin(Z) * 1.2)
					local Z, g, o = FM(P, d, 0.35, 0.6, h:Lerp(l, 0.3), Enum.Material.Ice)
					for P, P in ipairs(Z) do
						P.Transparency = 0.15
						local Z = P.CFrame
						P.CFrame = Z - g * (o + 0.3)
						k(0.05 + b * 0.03, function()
							if P.Parent then
								E(P, 0.18, { CFrame = Z }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
							end
						end)
						z[#z + 1] = P
					end
				end
				if D then
					local b = {}
					for Z, P in ipairs(D.parts) do
						b[Z] = P.CFrame
					end
					v(0.22, function(Z)
						local P = 1 - (1 - Z) ^ 2
						local Z = _ * 7 * P
						local P = {}
						for d = 1, #D.parts do
							P[d] = b[d] + Z
						end
						AM(D.parts, P)
					end)
					local b = cM(D.model, h, l, 0.55, 0.2)
					k(1.2, function()
						if b.Parent then
							E(b, 0.3, { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 })
						end
					end)
				end
				WM(N + Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(225, 240, 255), 10, 6, 2.5)
				local E = S(CFrame.new(N + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)), Vector3.new(5, 8, 5))
				local S = C(E, {
					Texture = u.soft,
					Color = I(l),
					Size = r(0, 0.25, 1, 0),
					Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3),
					Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2),
					Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -4.0, 0),
					Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
					LightEmission = 0.3,
					Brightness = 2,
				}, 0)
				S.Rate = 40
				S.Enabled = true
				H(E, h, 5, 18, 1.4)
				k(1.3, function()
					S.Enabled = false
					Q(E, 1.2)
					m(z)
					rM(N + _ * 4, 30, h, Enum.Material.Ice, 0.55, 18, 1.8)
					if D then
						D.release(Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), nil)
					end
					wM(N + _ * 5, h, 12, 4)
					n(Y.iceShatter, 1, 0.8)
					n(Y.iceSplinter, 0.8, 0.7, nil, 1.8)
					JM(N, 1, 0.3)
				end)
				n(Y.iceSplinter, 1, 0.8, nil, 1.8)
				n(Y.quakeDebris, 0.7, 1.1)
				JM(N, 0.9, 0.3)
			end

			q.FX = IM
			q.context = function(r, _)
				local u = r:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					or r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
					or r:FindFirstChild("Torso")
				local h = r:FindFirstChild("Head") or u
				if not u then
					return nil
				end
				local Y = (r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or r:FindFirstChild("Torso") or u).Position
				return {
					char = r,
					root = u.Position,
					chest = Y,
					head = h.Position,
					killer = _,
					ignore = { a = r, b = L.Character, c = workspace.CurrentCamera },
				}
			end
			local r = {
				Shatter = true,
				Void = true,
				Reaper = true,
				Inferno = true,
				Shadow = true,
				Disintegrate = true,
				Freeze = true,
				Glitch = true,
				Thunder = true,
				Hologram = true,
				Crows = true,
				Nuke = true,
			}
			q.play = function(_, u, h, Y)
				if _ == "Random" or not IM[_] then
					_ = u[math.random(1, #u)]
				end
				local u = IM[_]
				local l = h and q.context(h, Y)
				if not (u and l) then
					return
				end
				l.orig = q.origOf[h]
				l.ignore.d = l.orig
				l.ghostTakes = r[_] or false
				if l.orig then
					q.ctxOf[h] = l
				end
				local r, _ = pcall(u, l)
				if not r then
					q.lastError = tostring(_)
				end
			end
			local function r(_)
				local u, h = pcall(function()
					local Y = _:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
					local l = _:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
					local S = _:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
					return table.concat({
						Y and Y:IsA("MeshPart") and Y.MeshId or "",
						l and l.ShirtTemplate or "",
						S and S.PantsTemplate or "",
					}, "|")
				end)
				return u and h or "||"
			end
			q.conns[#q.conns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(_)
				if _.Name ~= "Raggy" or not _:IsA("Model") then
					return
				end
				local u, h = os.clock(), {}
				for Y, Y in ipairs(q.raggies) do
					if u - Y.t < 6 and Y.m.Parent then
						h[#h + 1] = Y
					end
				end
				h[#h + 1] = { m = _, t = u }
				q.raggies = h
			end)
			q.findRaggy = function(_, u, h, Y)
				local l = os.clock() + (Y or 0.8)
				repeat
					local Y, S
					for k, k in ipairs(q.raggies) do
						if k.m.Parent and not q.origOf[k.m] and k.t >= h - 0.6 then
							local h = k.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or k.m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							if h then
								local Q = (h.Position - _).Magnitude
								if Q < 14 and (u == "||" or r(k.m) == u) and (not S or Q < S) then
									Y, S = k.m, Q
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if Y then
						return Y
					end
					task.wait()
				until os.clock() > l
				return nil
			end
			q.prune = function()
				for _, _ in ipairs({ q.origOf, q.taken, q.ctxOf }) do
					for u in pairs(_) do
						if not u.Parent then
							_[u] = nil
						end
					end
				end
			end
			q.weaponFor = function(_, u)
				local h = u[_.Name]
				local Y = h and h.Role
				if Y == "Murderer" then
					return "gun"
				end
				local h = _.Character and _.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				for Y, l in pairs(u) do
					if l.Role == "Murderer" then
						local u = V:FindFirstChild(Y)
						local Y = u and u.Character
						local u = Y and Y:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if u and h and (u.Position - h.Position).Magnitude < 12 then
							return "knife"
						end
						if Y and Y:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
							return "knife"
						end
					end
				end
				for u, u in ipairs(V:GetPlayers()) do
					if u ~= _ and u.Character and u.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
						return "gun"
					end
				end
				return "knife"
			end
			q.killerFor = function(_, u, h)
				local Y = _.Character and _.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local l, S
				for k, k in ipairs(V:GetPlayers()) do
					local Q = k ~= _ and k.Character
					if Q then
						local _ = u[k.Name]
						local u
						if h == "knife" then
							u = _ and _.Role == "Murderer"
						else
							u = Q:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
						end
						local _ = u
							and (
								Q:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
								or Q:FindFirstChild("Torso")
								or Q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							)
						if _ then
							local u = Y and (_.Position - Y.Position).Magnitude or 0
							if not S or u < S then
								l, S = _, u
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return l
			end
			q.isMine = function(_, u)
				local h = u[L.Name]
				local u = h and h.Role
				if _ == "knife" then
					return u == "Murderer"
				end
				local _ = L.Character
				local h = L:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
				return _ and _:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or h and h:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or u == "Sheriff"
			end
			q.shots, q.blades = {}, {}
			task.spawn(function()
				local _ = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
				local u = _ and _:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
				local _ = u and u:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
				if not (_ and _:IsA("RemoteEvent") and q.alive) then
					return
				end
				q.conns[#q.conns + 1] = _.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(_, u, u, h)
					local Y = typeof(_) == "Instance" and _ or nil
					while Y and not (Y:IsA("Model") and Y:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
						Y = Y.Parent
					end
					q.shots[#q.shots + 1] = {
						t = os.clock(),
						shooter = Y,
						hit = typeof(h) == "Instance" and h or nil,
						endP = typeof(u) == "Vector3" and u or nil,
					}
					if #q.shots > 16 then
						table.remove(q.shots, 1)
					end
				end)
			end)
			q.conns[#q.conns + 1] = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(_)
				if _.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" then
					return
				end
				task.spawn(function()
					local u = _:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or _:WaitForChild("BladePosition", 1)
					if not u and _:IsA("BasePart") then
						u = _
					end
					local h = os.clock()
					while u and u.Parent and _.Parent and q.alive and os.clock() - h < 6 do
						q.blades[#q.blades + 1] = { t = os.clock(), p = u.Position }
						if #q.blades > 300 then
							table.remove(q.blades, 1)
						end
						task.wait(0.03)
					end
				end)
			end)
			q.evidence = function(_, u, h)
				local Y = os.clock()
				for l = #q.shots, 1, -1.0 do
					local S = q.shots[l]
					if Y - S.t > 0.9 then
						break
					end
					if S.shooter ~= u then
						local l = S.hit and S.hit:IsDescendantOf(u)
						if not l and h and S.endP and (S.endP - h).Magnitude < 4.5 then
							l = true
						end
						if l then
							return "gun", S.shooter
						end
					end
				end
				if not h then
					return nil
				end
				for u, u in ipairs(V:GetPlayers()) do
					local l = u ~= _ and u.Character
					local _ = l and l:FindFirstChild("Knife") and l:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if _ and (_.Position - h).Magnitude < 12 then
						return "knife", l
					end
				end
				for _ = #q.blades, 1, -1.0 do
					local u = q.blades[_]
					if Y - u.t > 0.6 then
						break
					end
					if (u.p - h).Magnitude < 7 then
						return "knife", nil
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			q.waitEvidence = function(_, u, h)
				local Y = os.clock()
				while q.alive do
					local l, S = q.evidence(_, u, h)
					if l then
						return l, S
					end
					if os.clock() - Y > 0.35 then
						break
					end
					task.wait()
				end
				return nil
			end
			q.onDeath = function(_, u)
				if not q.on or not q.alive then
					return
				end
				local h = u:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or u:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local Y = u:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or h
				local l = Y and Y.Position
				local Y, S, k = h and h.Position, h and r(u), os.clock()
				local r, Q = q.waitEvidence(_, u, l)
				if not r or not q.alive or not q.on then
					return
				end
				local l = getUpvalue(R) and getUpvalue(R)() or {}
				if q.mine then
					if Q then
						if Q ~= L.Character then
							return
						end
					elseif not q.isMine(r, l) then
						return
					end
				end
				local R = Q
						and (Q:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or Q:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Q:FindFirstChild(
							"HumanoidRootPart"
						))
					or q.killerFor(_, l, r)

				if h then
					q.prune()
					local h, l, Q = Y, S, k
					local Y = q.findRaggy(h, l, Q)
					if Y then
						q.origOf[Y] = u
						O(u)
						_ = Y
					else
						task.spawn(function()
							local Y = q.findRaggy(h, l, Q, 4)
							if Y and q.alive then
								q.origOf[Y] = u
								q.taken[Y] = true
								O(Y)
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				if not q.alive then
					return
				end
				local u = os.clock()
				local h = math.max(u, q.slotAt or 0)
				q.slotAt = h + 0.03
				if h > u then
					task.wait(h - u)
				end
				if not q.alive then
					return
				end
				if r == "gun" then
					q.play(q.gun, q.GUN, _, R)
				else
					q.play(q.knife, q.KNIFE, _, R)
				end
			end
			q.hookChar = function(R, r)
				if q.hooked[r] then
					return
				end
				q.hooked[r] = true
				task.spawn(function()
					local _ = r:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)

						return
					end

							return

						if _ <= 0 then
							h()
						end
					end)

						if _ then
							return
						end
						for _, _ in ipairs(R) do
							_:Disconnect()
						end
						q.charConns[r] = nil
						q.hooked[r] = nil
					end)

							if type(o) ~= "table" then
								return o
							end

							if p == "V" then
								return Vector3.new(o[2], o[3], o[4])
							elseif p == "C" then
								return Color3.new(o[2], o[3], o[4])

									o[2],
									table.unpack(o, 3, 7),

								local m, j = pcall(function()
									return Enum[o[2]][o[3]]
								end)
								return m and j or nil
							elseif p == "CS" then
								local m = {}
								for j = 2, #o do
									local e = o[j]
									table.insert(m, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(e[1], Color3.new(e[2], e[3], e[4])))
								end
								local j, e = pcall(ColorSequence.new, m)
								return j and e or nil
							elseif p == "NS" then
								local m = {}
								for j = 2, #o do
									local e = o[j]
									table.insert(m, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(e[1], e[2], e[3] or 0))
								end
								local j, e = pcall(NumberSequence.new, m)
								return j and e or nil
							elseif p == "NR" then
								return NumberRange.new(o[2], o[3])
							end
							return nil

						local Q = { ChromaPart = true, ChromaDecal = true, ChromaFire = true }

									m.Part1 = aM
									m.C0 = d(p.r)

								for m, AM in pairs(p.a) do
									pcall(aM.SetAttribute, aM, m, g(AM))
								end
							end
							if p.t then
								for m, m in ipairs(p.t) do
									pcall(k.AddTag, k, aM, m)
								end

							for j, j in ipairs(p.k or {}) do
								local p = o(j, m, e, v, GM)
								if p then
									p.Parent = aM
								end
							end

						local function p(m, j)
							local e, v = {}, {}
							local GM = o(m, nil, e, v, j)
							if not GM then
								return nil
							end
							for o, o in ipairs(v) do

						local function o(m)
							if m.t then
								for j, j in ipairs(m.t) do
									if Q[j] then
										return true
									end
								end
							end
							for Q, Q in ipairs(m.k or {}) do
								if o(Q) then
									return true
								end
							end
							return false
						end
						local function Q(m, j)
							if not m.ch or o(m.d) then
								return
							end
							for o, o in ipairs(j:GetDescendants()) do
								if o:IsA("Decal") and o.Name:lower():find("chroma") then
									pcall(k.AddTag, k, o, "ChromaDecal")
								elseif o:IsA("Fire") then
									pcall(k.AddTag, k, o, "ChromaFire")
								end
							end
						end

							"ParticleEmitter",

						function N.template(o)
							if N.tpl[o] ~= nil then
								return N.tpl[o] or nil
							end
							while N.waitT[o] do
								task.wait()
							end
							if N.tpl[o] ~= nil then
								return N.tpl[o] or nil
							end
							N.waitT[o] = true
							local j = nil
							local e, v = pcall(function()
								return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. o)
							end)
							if e and type(v) == "table" and #v > 0 then
								j = Instance.new("Folder")
								for e, e in ipairs(v) do
									for v, v in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
										if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
											pcall(function()
												v.Disabled = true
											end)
										end
									end
									for v, v in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
										if
											v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
											or v:IsA("Sound")
											or v:IsA("LayerCollector")
											or v:IsA("Camera")
											or v:IsA("Animation")
											or v:IsA("RemoteEvent")
											or v:IsA("RemoteFunction")
											or v:IsA("BindableEvent")
											or v:IsA("ValueBase")
											or v:IsA("ClickDetector")
											or v:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
											or v:IsA("TouchTransmitter")
											or v:IsA("Humanoid")
											or v:IsA("SoundEffect")
											or v:IsA("Configuration")
										then
											pcall(function()
												v:Destroy()
											end)
										end
									end
									if e:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
										e:Destroy()
									else
										e.Parent = j
									end
								end
							end
							N.tpl[o] = j or false
							N.waitT[o] = nil
							return j
						end
						local function o(j, e)
							local v = {}
							for GM, GM in ipairs(j.Keypoints) do
								v[#v + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(GM.Time, GM.Value * e, GM.Envelope * e)
							end
							return NumberSequence.new(v)

						local function j(e, v)
							pcall(function()
								if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
									e.Size = o(e.Size, v)
									e.Speed = NumberRange.new(e.Speed.Min * v, e.Speed.Max * v)
									e.Acceleration = e.Acceleration * v
								elseif e:IsA("Beam") then
									e.Width0, e.Width1 = e.Width0 * v, e.Width1 * v
									e.CurveSize0, e.CurveSize1 = e.CurveSize0 * v, e.CurveSize1 * v
								elseif e:IsA("Trail") then
									e.WidthScale = o(e.WidthScale, 1)
								elseif e:IsA("Light") then
									e.Range = e.Range * math.max(v, 0.5)
								elseif e:IsA("Fire") then
									e.Size = e.Size * v
								end
							end)
						end
						function N.build(o)
							local e = o.cx
							local o = e and N.template(e.asset)
							if not o then
								return nil
							end
							local v = d(e.X)
							local GM = e.k
							local aM = Instance.new("Part")
							aM.Name = "PulseCX"
							aM.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
							aM.Transparency = 1
							aM.CanCollide, aM.CanQuery, aM.CanTouch, aM.Massless, aM.CastShadow =
								false, false, false, true, false
							local AM = Instance.new("BlockMesh")
							AM.Scale = Vector3.zero
							AM.Parent = aM
							local AM = o:Clone()
							local o = {}
							for FM, FM in ipairs(AM:GetDescendants()) do
								if FM:IsA("BasePart") then
									o[#o + 1] = FM
								end
							end
							for FM, FM in ipairs(o) do
								local o = FM.Transparency < 0.999
								for TM, TM in ipairs(FM:GetChildren()) do
									if
										TM:IsA("DataModelMesh")
										and not (TM:IsA("SpecialMesh") and TM.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh)
									then
										local fM = TM.Scale
										if math.max(fM.X, fM.Y, fM.Z) > 20 then
											o = false
										end
									end
								end
								if o and FM:IsA("BasePart") and math.max(FM.Size.X, FM.Size.Y, FM.Size.Z) > 30 then
									o = false
								end
								if not o then
									for TM, TM in ipairs(FM:GetDescendants()) do
										if m(TM) then
											o = true
											break
										end
									end
								end
								if o then
									local o = v:ToObjectSpace(FM.CFrame)
									for v, v in ipairs(FM:GetChildren()) do
										if
											v:IsA("JointInstance")
											or v:IsA("WeldConstraint")
											or v:IsA("NoCollisionConstraint")
											or v:IsA("RigidConstraint")
										then
											v:Destroy()
										end
									end
									FM.Anchored = false
									FM.CanCollide, FM.CanQuery, FM.CanTouch, FM.Massless, FM.CastShadow =
										false, false, false, true, false
									pcall(function()
										FM.AudioCanCollide = false
									end)
									FM.Size = FM.Size * GM
									for v, v in ipairs(FM:GetChildren()) do
										if v:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
											if v.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
												v.Scale = v.Scale * GM
											end
											v.Offset = v.Offset * GM
										elseif v:IsA("BlockMesh") or v:IsA("CylinderMesh") then
											v.Offset = v.Offset * GM
										elseif v:IsA("Attachment") then
											v.Position = v.Position * GM
										end
									end
									local v = Instance.new("Weld")
									v.Name = "PW"
									v.Part0 = aM
									v.Part1 = FM
									v.C0 = CFrame.new(o.Position * GM) * o.Rotation
									v.Parent = FM
									FM.Parent = aM
								end
							end
							AM:Destroy()
							for o, o in ipairs(aM:GetDescendants()) do
								if m(o) then
									j(o, GM)
								end
							end
							if e.glowOnly then
								for o, o in ipairs(aM:GetDescendants()) do
									if
										o:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
										or o:IsA("Fire")
										or o:IsA("Smoke")
										or o:IsA("Sparkles")
									then
										o:Destroy()
									end
								end
							end
							if e.burst then
								for o, o in ipairs(aM:GetDescendants()) do
									if o:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
										for j, j in ipairs(e.burst) do
											if o.Name:find(j) then
												o:SetAttribute("PulseBurst", o.Rate)
												o.Enabled = false
												break
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							aM:SetAttribute("PulseCX", true)
							return aM
						end
						local function o(j)
							return Color3.fromRGB(j[1], j[2], j[3])
						end
						N.RIGS = {
							sniper = {
								grip = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.3, -1.05),
								pitch = 0,
								lshift = Vector3.new(0.45, -0.05, -0.55),
								rshift = Vector3.new(-0.05, 0, -0.12),
							},
							rifle = {
								grip = Vector3.new(0.4, -0.02, -0.92),
								pitch = -7.0,
								lshift = Vector3.new(0.45, -0.1, -0.5),
								rshift = Vector3.new(-0.05, -0.05, -0.1),
							},
						}
						local function j(e, v)
							local GM = math.clamp(e:Dot(v), -1.0, 1)
							local aM = e:Cross(v)
							if aM.Magnitude < 0.000001 then
								if GM > 0 then
									return CFrame.identity
								end
								local v = math.abs(e.X) < 0.9 and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
								return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(e:Cross(v).Unit, 3.141592653589793)
							end
							return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(aM.Unit, math.acos(GM))
						end
						local function e(v, GM)
							local aM
							for AM, AM in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
								if AM.Name == GM then
									if
										AM:IsA("AnimationConstraint")
										and AM.Enabled
										and AM.Attachment0
										and AM.Attachment1
									then
										return { j = AM, c0 = AM.Attachment0.CFrame, c1 = AM.Attachment1.CFrame }
									elseif AM:IsA("Motor6D") and AM.Enabled and AM.Part0 and AM.Part1 then
										aM = { j = AM, c0 = AM.C0, c1 = AM.C1 }
									end
								end
							end
							return aM
						end
						local function v(GM, aM, AM, FM, TM)
							local fM, JM, XM = GM.sh, GM.el, GM.wr
							local GM = aM:VectorToWorldSpace(AM)
							local AM = aM * fM.c0 * fM.c1:Inverse() + GM
							local GM = (AM * fM.c1).Position
							local tM = (JM.c0.Position - fM.c1.Position).Magnitude
							local RM = (XM.c0.Position - JM.c1.Position).Magnitude
							local BM = (FM * XM.c1).Position
							local UM = BM - GM
							local BM = math.clamp(UM.Magnitude, math.abs(tM - RM) + 0.02, tM + RM - 0.002)
							local MM = UM.Magnitude > 0.0001 and UM.Unit or Vector3.new(0, -1.0, 0)
							local UM = GM + MM * BM
							local cM = (tM * tM - RM * RM + BM * BM) / (2 * BM)
							local RM = math.sqrt(math.max(tM * tM - cM * cM, 0))
							local tM = TM - MM * TM:Dot(MM)
							tM = tM.Magnitude > 0.0001 and tM.Unit or Vector3.new(0, -1.0, 0)
							local TM = GM + MM * cM + tM * RM
							local tM = (AM * JM.c0).Position
							local RM = CFrame.new(GM) * j((tM - GM).Unit, (TM - GM).Unit) * CFrame.new(-GM) * AM
							local GM = RM * JM.c0 * JM.c1:Inverse()
							local AM = (GM * JM.c1).Position
							local TM = (GM * XM.c0).Position
							local tM = CFrame.new(AM) * j((TM - AM).Unit, (UM - AM).Unit) * CFrame.new(-AM) * GM
							local j = (tM * XM.c0).Position
							local GM = CFrame.new(j - FM:VectorToWorldSpace(XM.c1.Position)) * FM.Rotation
							fM.j.Transform = fM.c0:Inverse() * aM:Inverse() * RM * fM.c1
							JM.j.Transform = JM.c0:Inverse() * RM:Inverse() * tM * JM.c1
							XM.j.Transform = XM.c0:Inverse() * tM:Inverse() * GM * XM.c1
						end
						function N.rigBase(j, GM)
							local aM = N.RIGS[j.rig]
							local AM, FM = GM.Size.X / 1.4, GM.Size.Y / 1.65
							local GM = Vector3.new(aM.grip.X * AM, aM.grip.Y * FM, aM.grip.Z * AM)
							return CFrame.new(GM)
								* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(aM.pitch), 0, 0)
								* CFrame.new(-Vector3.new(j.g[1], j.g[2], j.g[3]))
						end
						function N.hold(j, GM, GM, aM, AM)
							local FM = aM.cx
							local aM = E.Character
							local TM = aM and aM:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
							if not (FM and FM.rig and N.RIGS[FM.rig] and TM and AM) then
								return nil
							end
							local fM = N.rigBase(FM, TM)
							AM.Part0 = TM
							AM.C0 = fM
							local TM = N.RIGS[FM.rig]
							local JM
							local function XM()
								if JM then
									JM:Disconnect()
									JM = nil
								end
							end
							local function tM()
								XM()
								local RM = E.Character
								local BM = RM and RM:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
								local UM = RM
									and RM:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
									and RM.RightHand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
								if not (BM and UM) then
									return
								end
								local MM = {
									sh = e(RM, "RightShoulder"),
									el = e(RM, "RightElbow"),
									wr = e(RM, "RightWrist"),
								}
								local cM = {
									sh = e(RM, "LeftShoulder"),
									el = e(RM, "LeftElbow"),
									wr = e(RM, "LeftWrist"),
								}
								if not (MM.sh and MM.el and MM.wr and cM.sh and cM.el and cM.wr) then
									return
								end
								local e = CFrame.new(FM.g[1], FM.g[2], FM.g[3])
								local KM = FM.fore or { FM.g[1], FM.g[2] + 0.05, FM.g[3] - 0.7 }
								local FM = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.35, -0.82).Unit
								local wM = -FM
								local FM = (Vector3.yAxis - wM * Vector3.yAxis:Dot(wM)).Unit
								local LM = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(KM[1], KM[2], KM[3]), FM, wM)
								local FM = UM.CFrame:Inverse()
								JM = x.Stepped:Connect(function()
									if not (AM.Parent and AM.Part0 == BM and BM.Parent and j.Parent == RM) then
										return
									end
									local RM = BM.CFrame
									local BM = RM * AM.C0
									pcall(
										v,
										MM,
										RM,
										TM.rshift,
										BM * e * FM,
										RM:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0.7, -1.0, 0.6))
									)
									pcall(
										v,
										cM,
										RM,
										TM.lshift,
										BM * LM,
										RM:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(-0.7, -1.0, 0.3))
									)
								end)
								table.insert(GM.conns, JM)
							end
							table.insert(GM.conns, j.Equipped:Connect(tM))
							table.insert(GM.conns, j.Unequipped:Connect(XM))
							if j.Parent and j.Parent == aM then
								tM()
							end
							return fM
						end
						local j = {
							back = function(e)
								return 1 + 2.70158 * (e - 1) ^ 3 + 1.70158 * (e - 1) ^ 2
							end,
							out = function(e)
								return 1 - (1 - e) ^ 3
							end,
							inout = function(e)
								return e < 0.5 and 4 * e * e * e or 1 - (-2.0 * e + 2) ^ 3 / 2
							end,
						}
						N.DRAWS = {
							iai = {
				0.42,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.back(e)
									return v
										* CFrame.Angles(
											-0.3490658503988659 * GM,
											-2.6179938779914944 * GM,
											-1.2217304763960306 * GM
										)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							twirl = {
				0.62,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.out(e)
									local aM = 1 - j.back(e)
									return v
										* CFrame.Angles(-0.8726646259971648 * aM, 0, 0)
										* CFrame.Angles(0, -12.566370614359172 * GM, 0)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							toss = {
				0.58,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 4.6 * e * (1 - e)
									local aM = 1 - j.out(e)
									return CFrame.new(0, GM, 0)
										* v
										* CFrame.Angles(-6.283185307179586 * aM, 0, 0)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							spin = {
				0.6,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.out(e)
									local e = v * CFrame.new(0, 0.12, -0.12)
									return e * CFrame.Angles(12.566370614359172 * GM, 0, 0) * e:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							raise = {
				0.7,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.back(math.min(e / 0.7, 1))
									local aM = e > 0.72
											and e < 0.95
											and math.sin((e - 0.72) / 0.23 * 3.141592653589793)
										or 0
									return CFrame.new(0, -0.5 * GM, 0.12 * aM)
										* v
										* CFrame.Angles(-0.9599310885968813 * GM, 0.3490658503988659 * GM, 0)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							sideroll = {
				0.5,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.back(e)
									return v
										* CFrame.Angles(0, 0.6108652381980153 * GM, -1.5707963267948966 * GM)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							aktilt = {
				0.7,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.out(math.min(e / 0.62, 1))
									local aM = e > 0.62
											and math.sin((e - 0.62) / 0.38 * 3.141592653589793 * 3) * (1 - e) * 2.2
										or 0
									return v
										* CFrame.Angles(
											0.3490658503988659 * GM + 0.08726646259971647 * aM,
				0,
											1.3089969389957472 * GM
										)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
							heavy = {
				0.8,
								function(e, v)
									local GM = 1 - j.back(j.inout(e))
									return CFrame.new(0, -0.9 * GM, 0.3 * GM)
										* v
										* CFrame.Angles(-1.3089969389957472 * GM, 0, 0.2617993877991494 * GM)
										* v:Inverse()
								end,
							},
						}
						function N.animate(j, e, v, GM, aM)
							local AM = aM.cx
							local FM = v:FindFirstChild("PulseGrip")
							if not (AM and FM) then

							local o = aM.t == "Knife"
							local function aM(tM, RM)

							end
							local tM, RM, BM
							if o then
