							local aM = {}
							for JM, JM in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
								if JM:IsA("BasePart") then
									aM[#aM + 1] = JM
								end
							end
							local v, JM = 0, 0
							local function XM(UM)
								if FM.Parent then
									FM.C0 = UM
								end
							end
							local function UM(MM, cM, KM)
								v += 1
								local wM = v
								local LM = os.clock()
								local WM
								WM = x.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
									if wM ~= v or not FM.Parent then
										WM:Disconnect()
										return
									end
									local FM = math.clamp((os.clock() - LM) / MM, 0, 1)
									cM(FM)
									if FM >= 1 then
										WM:Disconnect()
										XM(TM)
										if KM then
											KM(wM)
										end
									end
								end)
								table.insert(GM.conns, WM)
								return wM
							end
							local FM = N.DRAWS[AM.draw] or N.DRAWS[o and "iai" or "toss"]
							local function MM()

									tM.Enabled = true
								end
								UM(FM[1], function(e)
									XM(TM * FM[2](e, fM))
									local FM = 1 - math.clamp(e / 0.15, 0, 1)
									for e, e in ipairs(aM) do

											e.LocalTransparencyModifier = FM
										end

								end, function(e)
									for FM, FM in ipairs(aM) do
										if FM.Parent then
											FM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
										end
									end
									if tM then
										task.delay(0.15, function()

										end)

										tM.Enabled = false
									end
								end)

							local function v()

									RM:Emit(12)

									end
								end)

								task.defer(MM)
							end

						Y.cx = N

							if e:IsA("BasePart") or e:IsA("Decal") then

						local function j(e)
							for v, v in ipairs(e or {}) do

									pcall(v[1].SetAttribute, v[1], v[2], v[3])
								else

										v[1][v[2]] = v[3]
									end)

						local e = {
							ParticleEmitter = true,
							Fire = true,
							Smoke = true,
							Sparkles = true,
							PointLight = true,
							SpotLight = true,
							SurfaceLight = true,
						}
						local function v(GM)
							local aM = {}
							local AM = GM and n[GM]

						local function GM(aM, AM, FM)
							local TM = v(FM)
							for v, v in ipairs(aM:GetChildren()) do
								if
									e[v.ClassName]

						local function e(v, aM)
							local AM = (aM or E).Character
							local aM = AM and AM:FindFirstChild("DisplayRef" .. v)
							local v = aM and aM.Value

						local v = { Knife = nil, Gun = nil }
						local aM = nil
						local function AM()
							local FM, TM = pcall(function()
								return i:InvokeServer(E)
							end)
							if
								FM
								and type(TM) == "table"
								and type(TM.Weapons) == "table"
								and type(TM.Weapons.Equipped) == "table"
							then
								v.Knife = TM.Weapons.Equipped.Knife
								v.Gun = TM.Weapons.Equipped.Gun
								local i = {}
								for FM, fM in pairs(type(TM.Weapons.Owned) == "table" and TM.Weapons.Owned or {}) do
									if type(FM) == "string" then
										i[FM] = true
									elseif type(fM) == "string" then
										i[fM] = true
									end
								end
								for FM, FM in pairs(type(TM.Uniques) == "table" and TM.Uniques or {}) do
									if type(FM) == "table" and FM.BaseItem then
										i[FM.BaseItem] = true
									end
								end
								aM = i
								if not s.__pulseSpawnedMig then
									s.__pulseSpawnedMig = true
									s.__pulseSpawned = type(s.__pulseSpawned) == "table" and s.__pulseSpawned or {}
									pcall(function()
										for FM, TM in pairs(O.Weapons.Owned) do
											if
												type(FM) == "string"
												and type(TM) == "number"
												and TM > 0
												and not i[FM]
												and n[FM]
												and s.__pulseSpawned[FM] == nil
											then
												s.__pulseSpawned[FM] = TM
											end
										end
									end)
								end
							end
						end
						local i = {}
						local function FM()
							pcall(function()
								if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
									makefolder("PulseHub")
								end
								writefile(
									"PulseHub/mm2_skins.json",
									y:JSONEncode({ Knife = i.Knife or false, Gun = i.Gun or false })
								)
							end)
						end
						local function TM()
							local fM, JM = pcall(function()
								return y:JSONDecode(readfile("PulseHub/mm2_skins.json"))
							end)
							if fM and type(JM) == "table" then
								for fM, fM in ipairs({ "Knife", "Gun" }) do
									if type(JM[fM]) == "string" and n[JM[fM]] then
										i[fM] = JM[fM]
									end
								end
							end
						end
						local function fM(JM)
							local XM, tM = pcall(function()
								return O.Weapons.Equipped[JM]
							end)
							return XM and tM or nil
						end
						local JM = {}
						local XM = {}
						Y.rm = { players = {}, tools = {} }
						local function tM(RM)
							local BM = JM[RM]
							if not BM then
								return
							end
							JM[RM] = nil
							for RM, RM in ipairs(BM.conns) do
								pcall(function()
									RM:Disconnect()
								end)
							end
							if BM.vis then
								pcall(function()
									BM.vis:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							j(BM.hidden)
						end
						local function RM(BM)
							for UM = 1, 60 do
								if not BM.Parent then
									return nil
								end
								local UM = BM:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RigidConstraint")
								if UM and UM.Attachment1 and UM.Attachment0 then
									return UM
								end
								task.wait(0.1)
							end
							return nil
						end
						local function BM(UM, MM)
							local cM = false
							for KM, KM in ipairs((MM.Parent or workspace):GetChildren()) do
								if KM.Name == "PulseSkin" .. UM and KM:GetAttribute("PulseOwner") ~= C then
									if (KM:GetAttribute("PulseBirth") or 0) > H then
										cM = true
									else
										pcall(function()
											KM:Destroy()
										end)
									end
								end
							end
							return cM
						end
						local UM = { Knife = 0, Gun = 0 }
						local function MM(cM)
							UM[cM] += 1
							local KM = UM[cM]
							local wM = fM(cM)
							local LM = E.Character
							local WM = LM and LM:FindFirstChild("DisplayRef" .. cM)
							local VM = WM and WM.Value
							local WM = JM[cM]
							if WM and WM.name == wM and WM.disp == VM and WM.vis and WM.vis.Parent then
								return
							end
							tM(cM)
							local WM = wM and n[wM]
							local rM = cM == "Knife" and Y.knifeBelt == true
							if not Y.enabled or not WM or not VM or wM == v[cM] and not rM then
								return
							end
							local _M = RM(VM)
							if not _M or UM[cM] ~= KM then
								return
							end
							if BM(cM, VM) then
								return
							end
							local RM = WM.cx and N.build(WM)
								or not WM.cx and p(WM.d, {
									skip = function(qM)
										return qM.c == "Beam" and qM.n == "CustomBeam"
									end,
								})
								or nil
							if not RM or UM[cM] ~= KM or not VM.Parent then
								if RM then
									RM:Destroy()
								end
								return
							end
							Q(WM, RM)
							GM(VM, RM, v[cM])
							RM.Name = "PulseSkin" .. cM
							RM:SetAttribute("PulseOwner", C)
							RM:SetAttribute("PulseBirth", H)
							local C = WM.a1 and d(WM.a1) or CFrame.identity
							local H = _M.Attachment1.CFrame * C:Inverse()
							local UM = VM
							local KM = nil
							local _M = LM and LM:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
							local qM = rM and _M and _M:FindFirstChild("KnifeBelt")
							if qM and qM:IsA("Attachment") then
								UM = _M
								KM = qM.Name
								local rM = getgenv().__pulseMountOrig
								H = (rM and rM(qM) or qM.CFrame) * C:Inverse()
							end
							local C = WM.cx and WM.cx.sling and LM and LM:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
							if C and C:IsA("BasePart") then
								UM = C
								KM = nil
								local LM = C.Size.Z / 2 + WM.cx.sling / 2 + 0.06
								H = CFrame.fromMatrix(
									Vector3.new(0, -0.15, LM),
									Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0),
									Vector3.new(0.866, 0.5, 0)
								)
							end
							RM.CFrame = UM.CFrame * H
							local C = Instance.new("Weld")
							C.Name = "PulseMount"
							C.Part0 = UM
							C.Part1 = RM
							C.C0 = H
							if KM then
								C:SetAttribute("PulseAnchor", KM)
							end
							C.Parent = RM
							RM.Parent = VM.Parent or workspace
							local C = {}
							local H = {}
							local function KM(LM)
								o(C, LM)
								if LM:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(C, {
										LM,
										"LocalTransparencyModifier",
										LM.LocalTransparencyModifier,
									})
									LM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								end
							end
							KM(VM)
							for LM, LM in ipairs(VM:GetDescendants()) do
								KM(LM)
							end
							table.insert(
								H,
								VM.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(LM)
									task.defer(KM, LM)
								end)
							)
							local KM = {}
							for LM, LM in ipairs(RM:GetDescendants()) do
								if LM:IsA("BasePart") or LM:IsA("Decal") then
									table.insert(KM, LM)
								end
							end
							table.insert(KM, RM)
							table.insert(
								H,
								VM.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
									if not VM.Parent then
										task.defer(MM, cM)
									end
								end)
							)
							JM[cM] = {
								name = wM,
								disp = VM,
								vis = RM,
								hidden = C,
								conns = H,
								parts = KM,
								ltm = -1.0,
								mount = UM,
							}
						end
						local function C(H, RM)
							if RM(H) then
								return H
							end
							for UM, UM in ipairs(H.k or {}) do
								local H = C(UM, RM)
								if H then
									return H
								end
							end
							return nil
						end
						local function H(RM, UM, cM)
							local KM = E:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
							local wM = KM and KM:FindFirstChild("BackpackUI")
							local KM = wM and wM:FindFirstChild("BackpackFrame")
							if not KM then
								return
							end
							for wM, wM in ipairs(KM:GetChildren()) do
								local KM = wM:FindFirstChild("Container")
								local wM = KM and KM:FindFirstChild("ToolIcon")
								local LM = KM and KM:FindFirstChild("NameLabel")
								if wM and LM and wM.Image == RM and (RM ~= "" or LM.Text == cM) then
									wM.Image = UM
									LM.Text = ""
								end
							end
						end
						local function RM(UM, cM)
							cM = cM or XM
							local KM = cM[UM]
							if not KM then
								return
							end
							cM[UM] = nil
							for cM, cM in ipairs(KM.conns) do
								pcall(function()
									cM:Disconnect()
								end)
							end
							if KM.track then
								pcall(function()
									KM.track:Stop(0)
								end)
							end
							if KM.vis then
								pcall(function()
									KM.vis:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							if KM.beam then
								pcall(function()
									KM.beam:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							j(KM.restore)
							if KM.handle then
								pcall(function()
									KM.handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end)
							end
							if UM.Parent and KM.oldTex ~= nil then
								pcall(function()
									UM.TextureId = KM.oldTex
								end)
								H(KM.newTex, KM.oldTex, UM.Name)
							end
						end
						local function UM(cM)
							if not cM:IsA("Tool") then
								return nil
							end
							if k:HasTag(cM, "Weapon_Gun") or cM.Name == "Gun" then
								return "Gun"
							end
							if k:HasTag(cM, "Weapon_Knife") or cM.Name == "Knife" then
								return "Knife"
							end
							return nil
						end
						local function cM(KM, wM)
							if not KM:IsA("BasePart") or KM.Name ~= "Handle" then
								return false
							end
							local LM = KM:FindFirstChild("VisualConstraint")
							return LM ~= nil
								and LM:IsA("RigidConstraint")
								and LM.Attachment0 ~= nil
								and LM.Attachment0.Parent == wM
						end
						local function KM(wM, LM)
							wM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
							table.insert(
								LM.conns,
								wM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
									if wM.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
										wM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
									end
								end)
							)
							for WM, WM in ipairs(wM:GetDescendants()) do
								if m(WM) then
									table.insert(LM.restore, { WM, "Enabled", WM.Enabled })
									WM.Enabled = false
								elseif WM:IsA("Decal") or WM:IsA("Texture") then
									WM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								end
							end
						end
						local function wM(LM)
							for WM, WM in ipairs({ LM, unpack(LM:GetDescendants()) }) do
								local LM = WM:GetAttribute("PulseBase")
								if LM ~= nil then
									WM.Transparency = LM
								end
								local LM = WM:GetAttribute("PulseOn")
								if LM ~= nil then
									WM.Enabled = LM
								end
							end
						end
						local function LM(WM)
							if WM:IsA("MeshPart") then
								return WM.MeshId .. "|" .. WM.TextureID
							end
							local VM = WM:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
							return VM and VM.MeshId .. "|" .. VM.TextureId or ""
						end
						local WM = {
							"SoundId",
							"Volume",
							"PlaybackSpeed",
							"RollOffMaxDistance",
							"RollOffMinDistance",
							"RollOffMode",
							"Looped",
						}
						local function VM(rM, _M)
							local qM = UM(rM)
							if not qM then
								return
							end
							local uM = _M and Y.rm.tools or XM
							local sM
							if _M then
								sM = _M.name
							else
								sM = fM(qM)
							end
							local hM = uM[rM]
							if hM and hM.name == sM and (not hM.vis or hM.vis.Parent and hM.vis:IsDescendantOf(rM)) then
								return
							end
							RM(rM, uM)
							local YM = sM and n[sM]
							local lM = rM:GetAttribute("ItemID") or (not _M and v[qM] or nil)
							if not Y.enabled or not YM or sM == lM then
								return
							end
							local xM = rM:FindFirstChild("Handle") or rM:WaitForChild("Handle", 5)
							if not xM or not rM.Parent then
								return
							end
							hM = { name = sM, conns = {}, restore = {}, handle = xM, plr = _M and _M.plr or nil }
							uM[rM] = hM
							local SM = {}
							for kM, kM in ipairs(YM.sounds or {}) do
								SM[kM.n] = kM
							end
							local kM = {}
							local function yM(QM)
								local EM = SM[QM.Name]
								if not EM or kM[QM] or not QM:IsA("Sound") or hM.vis and QM:IsDescendantOf(hM.vis) then
									return
								end
								kM[QM] = true
								local kM = {}
								for IM, IM in ipairs(WM) do
									if EM.p[IM] ~= nil then
										kM[IM] = g(EM.p[IM])
										table.insert(hM.restore, { QM, IM, QM[IM] })
										pcall(function()
											QM[IM] = kM[IM]
										end)
									end
								end
								if kM.SoundId then
									table.insert(
										hM.conns,
										QM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SoundId"):Connect(function()
											if QM.SoundId ~= kM.SoundId then
												for WM, IM in pairs(kM) do
													pcall(function()
														QM[WM] = IM
													end)
												end
											end
										end)
									)
								end
								for WM, WM in ipairs(EM.fx or {}) do
									local kM, EM = pcall(Instance.new, WM.c)
									if kM and EM then
										for kM, IM in pairs(WM.p) do
											pcall(function()
												EM[kM] = g(IM)
											end)
										end
										EM.Name = "PulseFx"
										EM.Parent = QM
										table.insert(hM.restore, { EM, "Parent", nil })
									end
								end
							end
							if next(SM) then
								for g, g in ipairs(rM:GetDescendants()) do
									if g:IsA("Sound") then
										yM(g)
									end
								end
								table.insert(
									hM.conns,
									rM.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(g)
										if g:IsA("Sound") then
											yM(g)
										end
									end)
								)
							end
							local g = YM.h or YM.d
							local WM = YM.cx and N.build(YM)
								or not YM.cx and p(g, {
									skip = function(SM)
										return SM.c == "Beam" and SM.n == "CustomBeam" or SM.c == "Sound"
									end,
								})
								or nil
							if uM[rM] ~= hM then
								if WM then
									WM:Destroy()
								end
								return
							end
							if WM then
								Q(YM, WM)
								if not _M then
									GM(xM, WM, lM)
								end
								WM.Name = "VH"
								local GM
								if YM.g then
									GM = rM.Grip * d(YM.g):Inverse()
								else
									local lM = e(qM, _M and _M.plr) or CFrame.identity
									local e = YM.a1 and d(YM.a1) or CFrame.identity
									GM = lM * e:Inverse()
								end
								local e = Instance.new("Weld")
								e.Name = "PulseGrip"
								e.Part0 = xM
								e.Part1 = WM
								e.C0 = GM
								e.Parent = WM
								WM.CFrame = xM.CFrame * e.C0
								local e = {}
								local GM = {}
								local lM = { WM }
								for SM, SM in ipairs(WM:GetDescendants()) do
									table.insert(lM, SM)
								end
								for SM, SM in ipairs(lM) do
									if SM:IsA("BasePart") or SM:IsA("Decal") or SM:IsA("Texture") then
										e[SM] = SM.Transparency
										SM:SetAttribute("PulseBase", SM.Transparency)
									elseif m(SM) and not SM:IsA("Beam") then
										GM[SM] = SM.Enabled
										SM:SetAttribute("PulseOn", SM.Enabled)
									end
								end
								WM.Parent = xM
								hM.vis = WM
								if YM.cx and not _M then
									pcall(N.animate, rM, xM, WM, hM, YM)
								end
								local function lM()
									local SM = xM.Transparency >= 0.99
									for kM, yM in pairs(e) do
										if kM.Parent then
											kM.Transparency = SM and 1 or yM
										end
									end
									for e, kM in pairs(GM) do
										if e.Parent then
											e.Enabled = kM and not SM
										end
									end
								end
								lM()
								table.insert(hM.conns, xM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(lM))
								for e, e in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
									if cM(e, xM) then
										KM(e, hM)
									end
								end
								table.insert(
									hM.conns,
									workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(e)
										if e.Name == "Handle" then
											task.defer(function()
												if uM[rM] == hM and cM(e, xM) then
													KM(e, hM)
												end
											end)
										end
									end)
								)
								xM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								table.insert(
									hM.conns,
									xM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
										if xM.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
											xM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
										end
									end)
								)
								local function e(GM)
									table.insert(hM.restore, { GM, "LocalTransparencyModifier", 0 })
									GM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
									table.insert(
										hM.conns,
										GM:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
											if GM.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
												GM.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
											end
										end)
									)
								end
								local function GM(cM, KM)
									for lM, lM in ipairs(cM:GetDescendants()) do
										if not (KM and (lM == KM or lM:IsDescendantOf(KM))) then
											if lM:IsA("Decal") or lM:IsA("Texture") then
												table.insert(hM.restore, { lM, "Transparency", lM.Transparency })
												lM.Transparency = 1
											elseif m(lM) and not lM:IsA("Beam") then
												table.insert(hM.restore, { lM, "Enabled", lM.Enabled })
												lM.Enabled = false
											elseif lM:IsA("BasePart") then
												e(lM)
												if lM.Name == "VH" and lM.Parent == cM then
													table.insert(hM.restore, { lM, "Name", lM.Name })
													lM.Name = "VHOff"
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end
								GM(xM, WM)
								local function cM(KM)
									if not KM:IsA("BasePart") or KM:GetAttribute("PulseDual") then
										return
									end
									KM:SetAttribute("PulseDual", true)
									local lM = WM:Clone()
									local WM = lM:FindFirstChild("PulseGrip")
									if WM then
										WM.Part0 = KM
									end
									wM(lM)
									lM.CFrame = KM.CFrame * (WM and WM.C0 or CFrame.identity)
									e(KM)
									GM(KM, nil)
									lM.Parent = KM
									table.insert(hM.restore, { lM, "Parent", nil })
									table.insert(hM.restore, { KM, "PulseDual", nil, true })
								end
								for e, e in ipairs(rM:GetChildren()) do
									if e.Name == "Dual" then
										cM(e)
									end
								end
								table.insert(
									hM.conns,
									rM.ChildAdded:Connect(function(e)
										if e.Name == "Dual" then
											task.defer(cM, e)
										end
									end)
								)
							end
							if qM == "Gun" then
								local e = xM:FindFirstChild("CustomBeam")
								if e then
									table.insert(hM.restore, { e, "Name", e.Name })
									e.Name = "CustomBeamOff"
								end
								local e = C(g, function(g)
									return g.c == "Beam" and g.n == "CustomBeam"
								end) or C(YM.d, function(C)
									return C.c == "Beam" and C.n == "CustomBeam"
								end)
								if e then
									local C = p(e)
									if C then
										C.Name = "CustomBeam"
										C.Parent = xM
										hM.beam = C
									end
								end
							end
							if not _M and YM.img and YM.img ~= "" then
								hM.oldTex = rM.TextureId
								hM.newTex = YM.img
								rM.TextureId = YM.img
								H(hM.oldTex, YM.img, rM.Name)
								task.delay(0.5, function()
									if XM[rM] == hM then
										H(hM.oldTex, YM.img, rM.Name)
									end
								end)
							end
							local C = not _M and D[sM] or nil
							if C then
								for H, H in ipairs({
									"ItemName",
									"Image",
									"Rarity",
								}) do
									local g = rM:GetAttribute(H)
									if g ~= nil and C[H] ~= nil then
										table.insert(hM.restore, { rM, H, g, true })
										pcall(rM.SetAttribute, rM, H, C[H])
									end
								end
							end
							local C = not _M and rM:FindFirstChild("CustomHold") or nil
							if C and C:IsA("Animation") and C.AnimationId ~= YM.hold then
								local H = C.AnimationId
								local function C()
									local g = E.Character and E.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
									local e = g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
									if not e then

							local GM = os.clock()

							for WM = #C, 1, -1.0 do
								local rM = C[WM]
								if GM - rM.t > 6 then
									if rM.tpl then
										rM.tpl:Destroy()
									end
									table.remove(C, WM)
								elseif rM.sig == cM then
									local GM = e.Position - rM.origin
									local cM
									if rM.dir then
										local _M = GM:Dot(rM.dir)
										cM = _M > -3.0 and (GM - rM.dir * _M).Magnitude or math.huge
									else
										cM = GM.Magnitude * 0.05
									end

										KM, wM = WM, cM
									end
								end
							end

								return false
							end

							local C = GM.tpl
							if not C then
								return false
							end

							C:Destroy()
							g(e, GM)
							return true

										if FM and FM.PulseFake then

												end)

											if i then

											end
										end
									end

									local GM = O.Weapons and O.Weapons.Owned

										return nil
									end
									return FM - (s.__pulseSpawned[j] or 0)

								local function j(GM, ...)
									local FM = O.Weapons and O.Weapons.Owned
									local O = {}
									if type(FM) == "table" and type(s.__pulseSpawned) == "table" then
										for TM, BM in pairs(s.__pulseSpawned) do
											local UM = FM[TM]
											if type(UM) == "number" then
												O[TM] = UM
												local wM = UM - BM
												FM[TM] = wM > 0 and wM or nil
											end
										end
									end
									local TM = table.pack(pcall(GM, ...))
									if type(FM) == "table" then
										for GM, BM in pairs(O) do
											FM[GM] = BM
										end
									end
									if not TM[1] then
										error(TM[2], 0)
									end
									return table.unpack(TM, 2, TM.n)
								end

									local GM = d and d.TradeInventory

									local GM = type(FM) == "table" and FM.Weapons

										return
									end

										for GM, TM in pairs(FM) do

												local BM = l(GM)
												if BM == nil or BM <= 0 then
													if type(TM) == "table" and TM.Frame then
														pcall(function()
															TM.Frame:Destroy()
														end)
													end
													FM[GM] = nil
												elseif type(TM) == "table" then
													TM.Amount = BM
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end

				if typeof(r) ~= "ColorSequence" then
					return ColorSequence.new(_)
				end
				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(r.Keypoints) do
					local r = u.Value
					local s = math.max(r.R, r.G, r.B)
					local h = math.min(r.R, r.G, r.B)
					local r = 0.3 + 0.7 * s
					local s = Color3.new(_.R * r, _.G * r, _.B * r)
					if h > 0.72 then
						s = s:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (h - 0.72) / 0.28 * 0.75)
					end
					q[#q + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(u.Time, s)
				end
				return ColorSequence.new(q)
			end

				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(r.Keypoints) do

				local q, u, s, h = _.size or 1, _.density or 1, _.bright or 1, _.alpha or 1
				pcall(function()
					if r:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
						if q ~= 1 then
							r.Size = V.scaleNS(r.Size, q)

						if s ~= 1 then

			V.dec = function(r)
				if type(r) ~= "table" then
					return r
				end
				local _ = r[1]
				if _ == 1 then
					return Color3.new(r[2], r[3], r[4])
				end
				if _ == 2 then
					return Vector3.new(r[2], r[3], r[4])
				end
				if _ == 3 then
					return Vector2.new(r[2], r[3])
				end
				if _ == 4 then
					return NumberRange.new(r[2], r[3])
				end
				if _ == 5 then
					local q = {}
					for u = 2, #r, 3 do
						q[#q + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(r[u], r[u + 1], r[u + 2])
					end
					return NumberSequence.new(q)
				end
				if _ == 6 then
					local q = {}
					for u = 2, #r, 4 do
						q[#q + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(r[u], Color3.new(r[u + 1], r[u + 2], r[u + 3]))
					end
					return ColorSequence.new(q)
				end
				if _ == 7 then
					return CFrame.new(table.unpack(r, 2, 13))
				end
				if _ == 8 then
					local _ = tostring(r[2]):gsub("^Enum%.", "")
					local q, u = pcall(function()
						return Enum[_][r[3]]
					end)
					return q and u or nil
				end
				return nil
			end

			V.build = function(r, _, q)
				if r.g and q.off[r.g] then
					return
				end
				local u = V.CLS[r.c]
				if not u then
					return
				end
				local s = Instance.new(u)
				s.Name = r.n or u
				if r.p then
					for u, h in pairs(r.p) do
						pcall(function()
							s[u] = V.dec(h)
						end)
					end
				end
				if r.c == "A" and q.hatHost then
					s.Position = s.Position * ((q.hatK or 1) * q.size)
				elseif r.c == "A" then
					local u = s.Position
					local h = q.fit
					if q.mapA then
						s.Position = q.mapA(u)
					else
						if h then
							u = Vector3.new(u.X * h.x, h.f + (u.Y + 3) * h.y, u.Z * h.z)
						end
						s.Position = u * q.size + q.liftV
					end
				elseif r.c == "PT" then
					s.Anchored, s.CanCollide, s.CanQuery, s.CanTouch, s.Massless, s.CastShadow =
						false, false, false, false, true, false
					local u = (q.hatK or 1) * q.size

					h = CFrame.new((h.Position - Vector3.new(0, q.hatCrown or 0, 0)) * u) * h.Rotation

					end
					local u = q.opt.alpha or 1
					if u ~= 1 then
						s.Transparency = 1 - (1 - s.Transparency) * u
					end
				elseif r.c == "SH" then
					local u = (q.hatK or 1) * q.size
					s.Scale = s.Scale * u
					s.Offset = s.Offset * u
				elseif r.c == "HL" then
					local u, h = q.opt.alpha or 1, q.opt.bright or 1
					s.FillTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - s.FillTransparency) * u * h, 0, 1)
					s.OutlineTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - s.OutlineTransparency) * u, 0, 1)
				elseif r.c == "FI" and q.hatHost then
					s.Size = math.clamp(s.Size * (q.hatK or 1) * q.size, 2, 30)
				elseif r.c == "P" then
					s.LockedToPart = true
				elseif r.c == "T" then
					s.Lifetime = math.min(s.Lifetime, 0.3)
				end
				if r.i then
					q.ids[r.i] = s
				end
				if r.a or r.b then
					q.links[#q.links + 1] = { s, r.a, r.b }
				end
				if r.g then
					V.tune(s, q.opt)
				elseif q.hatTune and V.HATFX[r.c] then
					V.tune(s, q.hatTune)
				end
				V.mark(s, q.key)
				if r.k then
					for u, u in ipairs(r.k) do
						V.build(u, s, q)
					end
				end
				s.Parent = _
				return s
			end

				local q, u, s = r:FindFirstChild("Head"), r:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
				if not (q and u and s and q:IsA("BasePart") and u:IsA("BasePart") and s:IsA("BasePart")) then
					return nil
				end
				local h = { [_] = CFrame.new() }
				local _ = {}
				for Y, Y in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
					if Y:IsA("Motor6D") and Y.Part0 and Y.Part1 then
						_[#_ + 1] = { Y.Part0, Y.Part1, Y.C0, Y.C1 }
					elseif Y:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and Y.Attachment0 and Y.Attachment1 then
						local r, l = Y.Attachment0, Y.Attachment1
						if r.Parent and l.Parent and r.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and l.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
							_[#_ + 1] = { r.Parent, l.Parent, r.CFrame, l.CFrame }
						end
					end
				end
				local r = true
				while r do
					r = false
					for Y, Y in ipairs(_) do
						if h[Y[1]] and not h[Y[2]] then
							h[Y[2]] = h[Y[1]] * Y[3] * Y[4]:Inverse()
							r = true
						end
					end
				end
				if not (h[q] and h[u]) then
					return nil
				end
				local r = h[u].Position.Y - u.Size.Y / 2
				local _ = (h[q].Position.Y - r) / 4.5
				if r > -1.0 or _ < 0.4 or _ > 2 then
					return nil
				end
				return {
					x = math.clamp(s.Size.X / 2, 0.45, 1.8),
					y = _,
					z = math.clamp(s.Size.Z, 0.45, 1.8),
					f = r,
					rest = h,
				}

			V.hideList = function(r, _)
				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
					if u:IsA("Accessory") then
						local r = V.accKind(u)
						if r == "hat" and _.hat or r == "hair" and _.hair then
							for r, r in ipairs(u:GetDescendants()) do
								if r:IsA("BasePart") then
									q[#q + 1] = r
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				return q
			end
			V.hairLift = function(r, _, q)
				local u
				for s, s in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do
					if s:IsA("Accessory") and V.accKind(s) == "hair" then
						local r = s:FindFirstChild("Handle")
						if r and r:IsA("MeshPart") and r.Transparency < 0.95 then
							local s = _.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(r.CFrame)
							local h = r.Size
							local r = s.Y
								+ math.abs(s.XVector.Y) * h.X / 2
								+ math.abs(s.YVector.Y) * h.Y / 2
								+ math.abs(s.ZVector.Y) * h.Z / 2
							if math.abs(s.X) < _.Size.X and math.abs(s.Z) < _.Size.Z and (not u or r > u) then
								u = r
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if not u then
					return 0
				end
				return math.clamp((u - q.Y) * 0.7, 0, 0.9)
			end
			V.hatCollect = function(r, _)
				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(_) do
					q[#q + 1] = u
					for _, _ in ipairs(u:GetDescendants()) do
						q[#q + 1] = _
					end
				end
				local _ = r.root.CFrame
				for u, u in ipairs(q) do
					local q
					if u:IsA("BasePart") then
						q = { u, 1, o1 = u.Color, tr = u.Transparency }
					elseif u:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						local s = u.Parent and u.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and u.Parent.Material
						q = {
							u,
				2,
							o1 = u.VertexColor,
							mul = s == Enum.Material.ForceField and 0 or (s == Enum.Material.Neon and 0.9 or 1.3),
						}
					elseif u:IsA("Highlight") then
						q = {
							u,
				3,
							o1 = u.OutlineColor,
							o2 = u.FillColor,
							tr = u.FillTransparency,
							tr2 = u.OutlineTransparency,
						}
					elseif u:IsA("Fire") then
						q = { u, 4, o1 = u.Color, o2 = u.SecondaryColor }
					elseif u:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or u:IsA("Beam") or u:IsA("Trail") then
						q = { u, 5, o1 = u.Color }
					elseif u:IsA("Light") then
						q = { u, 6, o1 = u.Color }
					end
					if q then
						local s = u:IsA("BasePart") and u or u:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
						local u = s and _:PointToObjectSpace(s.Position) or Vector3.zero
						q.ph = math.atan2(u.Z, u.X) / 6.283185307179586 % 1
						r.col[#r.col + 1] = q
					end
				end
			end
			V.hatRestore = function(r)
				for _, _ in ipairs(r.col) do
					local r, q = _[1], _[2]
					pcall(function()
						if q == 1 then
							r.Color, r.Transparency = _.o1, _.tr
						elseif q == 2 then
							r.VertexColor = _.o1
						elseif q == 3 then
							r.OutlineColor, r.FillColor, r.FillTransparency, r.OutlineTransparency =
								_.o1, _.o2, _.tr, _.tr2
						elseif q == 4 then
							r.Color, r.SecondaryColor = _.o1, _.o2
						else
							r.Color = _.o1
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			V.hatPaint = function(r, _, q)
				for u, u in ipairs(r.col) do
					local r, s = u[1], u[2]
					local h = Color3.fromHSV((_ + (q and u.ph or 0)) % 1, 0.78, 1)
					if s == 1 then
						r.Color = h
					elseif s == 2 then
						if u.mul > 0 then
							r.VertexColor = Vector3.new(h.R, h.G, h.B) * u.mul
						end
					elseif s == 3 then
						r.OutlineColor = h
						r.FillColor = h
					elseif s == 4 then
						r.Color = h
						r.SecondaryColor = h:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
					elseif s == 5 then
						r.Color = ColorSequence.new(h)
					else
						r.Color = h
					end
				end
			end
			V.hatPulse = function(r, _)
				for q, q in ipairs(r.col) do
					local r, u = q[1], q[2]
					if u == 1 and q.tr < 1 then
						r.Transparency = q.tr + (1 - q.tr) * 0.6 * _
					elseif u == 3 then
						r.FillTransparency = q.tr + (1 - q.tr) * 0.8 * _
					end
				end
			end
			V.hatStep = function()
				local r = os.clock()
				local _, q = {}, {}
				for u, u in ipairs(V.hats) do
					if u.root.Parent and u.w.Parent then
						_[#_ + 1] = u
						local s = (r - u.t0) * u.spd
						local h, Y = u.motion, u.k
						local l = u.base
						if h == "Spin" then
							l = l * CFrame.Angles(0, s * 1.5, 0)
						elseif h == "Float" then
							l = l * CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(s * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * Y, 0)
						elseif h == "Spin + Float" then
							l = l * CFrame.new(0, (math.sin(s * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08 * Y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, s * 1.5, 0)
						elseif h == "Sway" then
							l = l * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(s * 1.7) * 0.1, 0, math.sin(s * 1.3 + 1.1) * 0.1)
						elseif h == "Wobble" then
							local x = s * 2.6
							l = l * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(math.cos(x), 0, math.sin(x)), 0.13)
						elseif h == "Hover" then
							l = l
								* CFrame.new(0, (0.45 + math.sin(s * 1.8) * 0.1) * Y, 0)
								* CFrame.Angles(0, s * 0.9, 0)
						elseif h == "Bounce" then
							l = l * CFrame.new(0, math.abs(math.sin(s * 3.2)) * 0.2 * Y, 0)
						end
						if h ~= "None" then
							u.w.C0 = l
							u.still = false
						elseif not u.still then
							u.w.C0 = l
							u.still = true
						end
						local h = u.fx
						if h ~= "None" and r - (u.fxAt or 0) >= 0.025 then
							u.fxAt = r
							if h == "Rainbow" or h == "Wave" then
								V.hatPaint(u, s * 0.22 % 1, h == "Wave")
							elseif h == "Pulse" then
								V.hatPulse(u, 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(s * 3.2))
							end
						end
						if u.hide then
							if r - (u.hideAt or 0) > 0.5 then
								u.hideAt = r
								u.hideList = V.hideList(u.ch, u.hide)
							end
							for r, r in ipairs(u.hideList or {}) do
								q[r] = true
								if r.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 then
									r.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				V.hats = _
				for r in pairs(V.hidden) do
					if not q[r] then
						pcall(function()
							r.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
						end)
					end
				end
				V.hidden = q
			end
			V.hatLoop = function()
				if V.hatOn then
					return
				end
				V.hatOn = true
				M(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function()
					if #V.hats == 0 and next(V.hidden) == nil then
						return
					end
					local r, _ = pcall(V.hatStep)
					if not r and not V.hatErr then
						V.hatErr = true
						warn("[Pulse] hat: " .. tostring(_))
					end
				end)
			end
			V.hatSet = function(r, _, q)
				local u = L.Character
				local s = V.skinOf and V.skinOf(u) or nil
				for h, h in ipairs(V.hats) do
					if h.key == r and (h.ch == u or s ~= nil and h.ch == s) then
						if _ == "fx" then
							if h.fx ~= "None" then
								V.hatRestore(h)
							end
							h.fx = q
							if q == "None" then
								pcall(function()
									getgenv().__pulseVFXTint()
								end)
							end
						elseif _ == "motion" then
							h.motion = q
							h.still = false
						elseif _ == "spd" then
							local r = os.clock()
							local u = (r - h.t0) * h.spd
							h.spd = math.clamp(q, 0.1, 3)
							h.t0 = r - u / h.spd
						elseif _ == "hide" then
							h.hide = q
							h.hideAt = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
			V.putHat = function(r, _, q, u)
				local s = r:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if not (s and s:IsA("BasePart")) then
					return
				end
				local h = u.size or 1
				local Y = math.clamp(V.headW(s) / 1.196, 0.5, 2.5) * (V.HATFIT[q] or 1)
				local l = Y * h
				local x = V.crownOf(s)
				local S = 0
				if not (u.mine and u.hideHair == true) then
					local k, y = pcall(V.hairLift, r, s, x)
					S = k and y or 0
				end
				local k = x * CFrame.new(0, (u.lift or 0) + S, 0)
				local x = Instance.new("Part")
				x.Name = "PulseHatRoot"
				x.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
				x.Transparency = 1
				x.Anchored, x.CanCollide, x.CanQuery, x.CanTouch, x.Massless, x.CastShadow =
					false, false, false, false, true, false
				x.CFrame = s.CFrame * k
				local S = Instance.new("Weld")
				S.Name = "PulseHatWeld"
				S.Part0, S.Part1, S.C0 = s, x, k
				S.Parent = x
				V.mark(x, q)
				x.Parent = r
				local s = {
					key = q,
					opt = u,
					off = u.off or {},
					size = h,
					ids = {},
					links = {},
					liftV = Vector3.zero,
					hatHost = x,
					hatK = Y,
					hatCrown = _.crown or 0.6,
					hatTune = { size = l, density = u.density or 1, bright = u.bright or 1, alpha = u.alpha or 1 },
				}
				local h = {}
				for Y, Y in ipairs(_.h) do
					for _, _ in ipairs(Y.k) do
						local Y = V.build(_, r, s)
						if Y then
							h[#h + 1] = Y
						end
					end
				end
				for _, _ in ipairs(s.links) do
					local Y, y, Q = _[1], _[2], _[3]
					pcall(function()
						if y and s.ids[y] then
							Y.Attachment0 = s.ids[y]
						end
						if Q and s.ids[Q] then
							Y.Attachment1 = s.ids[Q]
						end
					end)
				end
				local _, s = V.hatDef(q)
				local Y = {
					ch = r,
					root = x,
					w = S,
					base = k,
					k = l,
					key = q,
					t0 = os.clock(),
					still = true,
					col = {},
					motion = u.motion or _,
					fx = u.cfx or s,
					spd = math.clamp(tonumber(u.aspd) or 1, 0.1, 3),
				}
				if u.mine then
					Y.hide = V.hideOf({ hideHat = u.hideHat, hideHair = u.hideHair })
				end
				V.hatCollect(Y, h)
				V.hats[#V.hats + 1] = Y
				V.hatLoop()
			end
			V.put = function(r, _, q, u)
				local s = (V.data() or {})[q]
				if not s then
					return
				end
				u = u or {}
				if s.hat then
					return V.putHat(r, s, q, u)
				end
				local h = u.size or 1
				local Y = u.lift or 0
				local l = r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
				local x = l and V.fitOf(r, _) or nil
				local S = { key = q, opt = u, off = u.off or {}, size = h, ids = {}, links = {}, liftV = Vector3.zero }
				local u, k
				if s.rig and x then
					local y, Q = r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), r:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local E, I = y and x.rest[y], Q and x.rest[Q]
					if E and I and I.Position.Y > E.Position.Y + 0.2 then
						local Q = s.rig
						local C = (I.Position.Y - E.Position.Y) / (Q.hy - Q.ty)
						local I = math.clamp(y.Size.X / Q.tx, 0.3, 2.5)
						local H = math.clamp(y.Size.Z / Q.tz, 0.3, 2.5)
						local y = E.Position.Y
						k = Vector3.new(I, C, H)
						u = function(E)
							return Vector3.new(E.X * I, y + (E.Y - Q.ty) * C, E.Z * H)
						end
					end
				end
				for y, y in ipairs(s.h) do
					local s
					S.mapA = nil
					local Q = r:FindFirstChild(y.n)
					if Q and Q:IsA("BasePart") and (l and V.R15[y.n] or not l and V.R6[y.n]) then
						s = Q
						S.liftV = Q.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(0, Y, 0))
						S.fit = Q == _ and x or nil
						if u then
							local l = S.liftV
							if Q == _ then
								S.mapA = function(E)
									return u(E) * h + l
								end
							else
								local E = V.dec(y.s) or Q.Size
								local I = Vector3.new(
									Q.Size.X / math.max(E.X, 0.01),
									Q.Size.Y / math.max(E.Y, 0.01),
									Q.Size.Z / math.max(E.Z, 0.01)
								)
								S.mapA = function(Q)
									return Vector3.new(Q.X * I.X, Q.Y * I.Y, Q.Z * I.Z) * h + l
								end
							end
						end
					else
						S.liftV = Vector3.zero
						S.fit = nil
						local l = V.dec(y.cf) or CFrame.new()
						local Q = l
						local E = l.Position
						if u then
							E = u(E)
						elseif x then
							E = Vector3.new(E.X * x.x, x.f + (E.Y + 3) * x.y, E.Z * x.z)
						end
						l = l - l.Position + E * h + Vector3.new(0, Y, 0)
						if u then
							local E = l
							S.mapA = function(I)
								return E:PointToObjectSpace(u(Q:PointToWorldSpace(I)) * h + Vector3.new(0, Y, 0))
							end
						end
						local u = Instance.new("Part")
						u.Name = "PulseAuraHost"
						u.Size = (V.dec(y.s) or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)) * h
						if k then
							u.Size = Vector3.new(u.Size.X * k.X, u.Size.Y * k.Y, u.Size.Z * k.Z)
						end
						u.Transparency = 1
						u.CanCollide, u.CanQuery, u.CanTouch, u.CastShadow, u.Massless =
							false, false, false, false, true
						local h, Y = _, l
						local _ = x and V.LIMB[y.n] and r:FindFirstChild(V.LIMB[y.n])
						if _ and _:IsA("BasePart") and x.rest[_] then
							h, Y = _, x.rest[_]:Inverse() * l
						end
						u.CFrame = h.CFrame * Y
						local _ = Instance.new("Weld")
						_.Part0, _.Part1, _.C0 = h, u, Y
						_.Parent = u
						V.mark(u, q)
						u.Parent = r
						s = u
					end
					for r, r in ipairs(y.k) do
						V.build(r, s, S)
					end
				end
				for r, r in ipairs(S.links) do
					local _, q, u = r[1], r[2], r[3]
					pcall(function()
						if q and S.ids[q] then
							_.Attachment0 = S.ids[q]
						end
						if u and S.ids[u] then
							_.Attachment1 = S.ids[u]
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			V.parts = function(r)
				local _ = (V.data() or {})[r]
				local r, q = {}, {}
				local function u(s)
					if s.g and not r[s.g] then
						r[s.g] = true
						q[#q + 1] = s.g
					end
					if s.k then
						for r, r in ipairs(s.k) do
							u(r)
						end
					end
				end
				if _ then
					for r, r in ipairs(_.h) do
						for _, _ in ipairs(r.k) do
							u(_)
						end
					end
				end
				table.sort(q)
				return q
			end

			local function _(q)
				if q == nil then
					return nil
				end
				if q == L.Character then
					local u = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkinModel")
					local s, h = pcall(function()
						return type(u) == "function" and u() or nil
					end)
					return s and h or nil
				end
				local u = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(q)
				local q = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseRemoteSkin")
				if u and type(q) == "table" and type(q.liveModel) == "function" then
					local s, h = pcall(q.liveModel, u)
					return s and h or nil
				end
				return nil
			end
			V.skinOf = _
			local function q(u)
				local s = {}
				if u then
					s[1] = u
				end
				local h = _(u)
				if h then
					s[#s + 1] = h
				end
				return s
			end
			local function u(s)
				s = s or L.Character
				for h, h in ipairs(q(s)) do
					for s, s in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
						if s:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
							pcall(function()
								s:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			V.opt = function(s)
				local h = w.vfxCol and w.vfxCol[s]
				if type(h) ~= "table" then
					return { mine = true }
				end
				return {
					size = tonumber(h.size) or 1,
					lift = tonumber(h.lift) or 0,
					density = tonumber(h.density) or 1,
					bright = tonumber(h.bright) or 1,
					alpha = tonumber(h.alpha) or 1,
					off = type(h.off) == "table" and h.off or {},
					mine = true,
					motion = type(h.motion) == "string" and h.motion or nil,
					cfx = type(h.cfx) == "string" and h.cfx or nil,
					aspd = tonumber(h.aspd),
					hideHat = h.hideHat,
					hideHair = h.hideHair,
				}
			end
			local function s(h, Y)
				h = h or L.Character
				if not h then
					return
				end
				local l = Y == nil
				Y = Y or R
				u(h)
				local x = _(h) or h
				local _ = x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not _ then
					return
				end
				for h, h in ipairs(r) do
					if Y[h.key] then
						local Y, S = pcall(V.put, x, _, h.key, l and V.opt(h.key) or nil)
						if not Y then
							warn("[Pulse] aura " .. h.key .. ": " .. tostring(S))
						end
					end
				end
				if l and getgenv().__pulseVFXTint then
					pcall(getgenv().__pulseVFXTint)
				end
			end

			local _ = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			local h = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

			local function l()
				local x = L.Character
				if not x then
					return
				end
				local S = getgenv().__pulseFxTintOn
				local k = getgenv().__pulseFxColor
				local y = S and k and k() or nil
				local S = w.vfxCol or {}
				local function k(Q, E, I)
					if Q:IsA("BasePart") and Q.Name ~= "PulseAuraHost" then
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.Color
						end
						Q.Color = E or _[Q]
						return
					elseif Q:IsA("Highlight") then
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.OutlineColor
						end
						if Y[Q] == nil then
							Y[Q] = Q.FillColor
						end
						Q.OutlineColor = E or _[Q]
						Q.FillColor = E or Y[Q]
						return
					elseif Q:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
						local C = Q.Parent and Q.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and Q.Parent.Material
						if C == Enum.Material.ForceField then
							return
						end
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.VertexColor
						end
						Q.VertexColor = E and Vector3.new(E.R, E.G, E.B) * (C == Enum.Material.Neon and 1 or 1.6)
							or _[Q]
						return
					elseif Q:IsA("Fire") then
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.Color
						end
						Q.Color = E or _[Q]
						return
					end
					if Q:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or Q:IsA("Beam") or Q:IsA("Trail") then
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.Color
						end
						if h[Q] == nil then
							h[Q] = Q.LightEmission
						end
						Q.Color = E and V.recolor(_[Q], E) or _[Q]
						Q.LightEmission = E and h[Q] * I or h[Q]
					elseif Q:IsA("PointLight") or Q:IsA("SpotLight") or Q:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
						if _[Q] == nil then
							_[Q] = Q.Color
						end
						if Y[Q] == nil then
							Y[Q] = Q.Brightness
						end
						Q.Color = E or _[Q]
						Q.Brightness = E and Y[Q] * I or Y[Q]
					end
				end
				local Q = {}
				for E, E in ipairs(q(x)) do
					for x, x in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
						Q[#Q + 1] = x
					end
				end
				for x, x in ipairs(Q) do
					if x:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
						pcall(function()
							local Q = x:GetAttribute("PulseVFXKey")
							local E = Q and S[Q] or nil
							if E and not E.custom then
								E = nil
							end
							local S = E and Color3.fromRGB(E.r, E.g, E.b) or y
							local y = E and E.glow and E.glow / 100 or 1
							k(x, S, y)
							for Q, Q in ipairs(x:GetDescendants()) do
								k(Q, S, y)
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end
			getgenv().__pulseVFXTint = l
			getgenv().__pulseVFXTintFor = function(x, S)
				if not (x and type(S) == "table") then
					return
				end
				local function k(y, Q, E)
					if y:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or y:IsA("Beam") or y:IsA("Trail") then
						if _[y] == nil then
							_[y] = y.Color
						end
						if h[y] == nil then
							h[y] = y.LightEmission
						end
						y.Color = Q and V.recolor(_[y], Q) or _[y]
						y.LightEmission = Q and h[y] * E or h[y]
					elseif y:IsA("PointLight") or y:IsA("SpotLight") or y:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
						if _[y] == nil then
							_[y] = y.Color
						end
						if Y[y] == nil then
							Y[y] = y.Brightness
						end
						y.Color = Q or _[y]
						y.Brightness = Q and Y[y] * E or Y[y]
					end
				end
				local _ = {}
				for h, h in ipairs(q(x)) do
					for q, q in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
						_[#_ + 1] = q
					end
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(_) do
					if q:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
						pcall(function()
							local _ = q:GetAttribute("PulseVFXKey")
							local h = _ and S[_] or nil
							local _, Y = nil, 1
							if type(h) == "number" and h > 1 then
								local x = math.floor(h / 16777216)
								local S = h % 16777216
								_ = Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(S / 65536) % 256, math.floor(S / 256) % 256, S % 256)
								if x > 0 then
									Y = x / 100
								end
							end
							k(q, _, Y)
							for h, h in ipairs(q:GetDescendants()) do
								k(h, _, Y)
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end

							q = nil
						end
						local u = q and Color3.fromRGB(q.r, q.g, q.b) or Y

							local Y = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(q and q.glow) or 100), 0, 250)
							_[h.key] = math.floor(u.R * 255) * 65536
								+ math.floor(u.G * 255) * 256
								+ math.floor(u.B * 255)
								+ Y * 16777216
						else
							_[h.key] = true
						end
					end
				end
				return _
			end

					local C = math.floor((E - 1) / x)

					local E = C * (u + l) + (y and C > y and Q + l or 0)

						I.b.Position = C
					end
					I.b.Visible = true
					I.placed = true
				end
				local S = math.ceil(#k / x)
				local x = S > 0 and S * (u + l) - l or 0
				local S = x + (y and Q + l or 0)
				if y then
					local x = (y + 1) * (u + l)

					elseif V then
						h.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, x)
						h.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
						Y(h, B.EASE, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Q) })
					else
						h.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, x)
						h.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Q)
					end
				elseif h.Visible then
					if V then
						Y(h, B.EASE, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) })
						B.hideTok = (B.hideTok or 0) + 1
						local u = B.hideTok
						task.delay(0.35, function()
							if B.hideTok == u and not B.editKey then
								h.Visible = false
							end
						end)
					else
						h.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
						h.Visible = false
					end
				end
				if V then
					Y(q, B.EASE, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, S) })
				else
					q.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, S)
				end
				B.empty.Visible = #k == 0
			end
			M(B.grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
				if B.grid.AbsoluteSize.X ~= B.lastW then
					B.layout(false)
				end
			end)

					end
				end

				end
			end

				end
			end

				B.layout(false)

			_.order = {
				"Natural",
				"Cinematic",
				"Golden Hour",

				"Competitive",
			}
			_.swatch = {
				Original = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80) },
				Natural = { Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 205) },
				Cinematic = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 120), Color3.fromRGB(30, 110, 130) },
				["Golden Hour"] = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 60) },
				Dusk = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 110), Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 120) },
				Night = { Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 150), Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 45) },
				Moonlight = { Color3.fromRGB(160, 185, 240), Color3.fromRGB(28, 38, 76) },
				["Dark Fog"] = { Color3.fromRGB(96, 104, 122), Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 32) },
				["Blood Moon"] = { Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 46), Color3.fromRGB(46, 8, 12) },
				Horror = { Color3.fromRGB(96, 120, 96), Color3.fromRGB(12, 16, 12) },
				Vivid = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 110), Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255) },
				Overcast = { Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 218), Color3.fromRGB(120, 128, 140) },
				Noir = { Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30) },
				Neon = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 210), Color3.fromRGB(0, 210, 255) },
				Competitive = { Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255), Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255) },
			}
			_.remember = function(q, u)
				local s = _.saved[q]
				if s and s[u] ~= nil then
					return s[u]
				end
				local h, Y = pcall(function()
					return q[u]
				end)
				if not h then
					return nil
				end
				s = s or {}
				_.saved[q] = s
				s[u] = { value = Y }
				return s[u]
			end
			_.baseline = function(q, u)
				local s = _.remember(q, u)
				if s == nil then
					return nil
				end
				local h, Y = pcall(function()
					return q[u]
				end)
				if h and s.hasWritten and Y ~= s.written then
					s.value = Y
				end
				return s.value
			end
			_.releaseProp = function(q, u)
				local s = _.saved[q]
				local h = s and s[u]
				if h == nil then
					return
				end
				pcall(function()
					local Y = q[u]
					if h.hasWritten and Y ~= h.written then
						h.value = Y
					end
					q[u] = h.value
				end)
				s[u] = nil
				if next(s) == nil then
					_.saved[q] = nil
				end
			end
			_.sync = function(q, u, s, h)
				if q == nil then
					return
				end
				if not s then
					_.releaseProp(q, u)
					return
				end
				local s = _.remember(q, u)
				if s == nil then
					return
				end
				pcall(function()
					local Y = q[u]
					if s.hasWritten and Y ~= s.written then
						s.value = Y
					end
					s.written, s.hasWritten = h, true
					if Y ~= h then
						q[u] = h
					end
					s.written = q[u]
				end)
			end
			_.drop = function(q)
				local u = _.effects[q]
				_.effects[q] = nil
				if u ~= nil then
					_.owned[u] = nil
					pcall(function()
						u:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
			_.ensure = function(q, u, s)
				local h = _.effects[q]
				if h ~= nil and h.Parent == s then
					return h
				end
				_.drop(q)
				local h, Y = pcall(function()
					local l = Instance.new(u)
					_.owned[l] = true
					_.effects[q] = l
					l.Name = "PulseVisual_" .. q
					l.Parent = s
					return l
				end)
				if not h then
					_.drop(q)
					return nil
				end
				return Y
			end
			_.configure = function(q, u, s, h)
				if not s then
					_.drop(q)
					return
				end
				local s = _.ensure(q, u, workspace.CurrentCamera or R)
				if s == nil then
					return
				end
				for q, u in pairs(h) do
					pcall(function()
						s[q] = u
					end)
				end
				s.Enabled = true
			end
			_.ours = function(q)
				local u = q.Name
				return u:sub(1, 5) == "Pulse" or u:sub(1, 4) == "Nova"
			end
			_.targets = function(q, u)
				local s, h = {}, {}
				if q == nil then
					return s
				end
				for Y, Y in ipairs(q:GetChildren()) do
					if Y:IsA(u) and not _.owned[Y] and not _.ours(Y) then
						s[#s + 1], h[Y] = Y, true
					end
				end
				for Y, l in pairs(_.saved) do
					if not h[Y] and l.Parent and l.Parent.value == q and Y:IsA(u) then
						s[#s + 1] = Y
					end
				end
				return s
			end
			_.prune = function()
				for q, u in pairs(_.saved) do
					if q.Parent == nil and u.Parent == nil then
						for s in pairs(u) do
							_.releaseProp(q, s)
						end
						_.saved[q] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			_.overlay = function()
				if not _.vignetteOn then
					if _.gui then
						pcall(function()
							_.gui:Destroy()
						end)
						_.gui = nil
						_.screen = nil
					end
					return
				end
				if _.gui == nil or _.gui.Parent == nil then
					local q = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
					q.Name = "PulseVisualScreen"
					q.ResetOnSpawn, q.IgnoreGuiInset, q.DisplayOrder = false, true, 5
					pcall(function()
						q.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None
					end)
					pcall(function()
						q.Parent = W
					end)
					if q.Parent == nil then
						pcall(function()
							q.Parent = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
						end)
					end
					_.gui = q
					local u = { edges = {} }
					_.screen = u
					for s = 1, 4 do
						local h = Instance.new("Frame")
						h.Name, h.BorderSizePixel, h.Active = "Vignette" .. s, 0, false
						h.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
						h.Parent = q
						local q = Instance.new("UIGradient")
						q.Rotation = ({ 90, 270, 0, 180 })[s]
						q.Parent = h
						u.edges[s] = { frame = h, gradient = q }
					end
					u.edges[1].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28)
					u.edges[2].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.28)
					u.edges[2].frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.72)
					u.edges[3].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 1)
					u.edges[4].frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.23, 1)
					u.edges[4].frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.77, 0)
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(_.screen.edges) do
					q.frame.Visible = true
					q.gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1 - math.clamp(_.vignette / 100, 0, 0.8)),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					})
				end
			end
			_.apply = function()
				if not _.on or _.applying then
					return
				end
				_.applying = true
				local q, u = pcall(function()
					_.prune()
					local s
					if _.tech ~= "Game" then
						pcall(function()
							s = Enum.Technology[_.tech]
						end)
					end
					_.sync(R, "Technology", s ~= nil, s)
					local s = not _.brightOn and _.brightScale ~= 1
					local h = s and _.baseline(R, "Brightness")
					_.sync(
						R,
						"Brightness",
						_.brightOn or s,
						_.brightOn and _.bright or (tonumber(h) or 3) * _.brightScale
					)
					_.sync(R, "ClockTime", _.timeOn, _.time % 24)
					local s = math.clamp(tonumber(_.ambientLift) or 0, 0, 1)
					local h = tonumber(_.ambientScale) or 1
					local Y = typeof(_.ambientTint) == "Color3" and _.ambientTint or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					local l = not _.ambientOn and (s > 0 or h ~= 1 or Y ~= Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
					local x = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
					local S = l and _.baseline(R, "Ambient")
					local k = l and _.baseline(R, "OutdoorAmbient")
					local function y(Q)
						local E = typeof(Q) == "Color3" and Q or x
						E = Color3.new(
							math.clamp(E.R * h * Y.R, 0, 1),
							math.clamp(E.G * h * Y.G, 0, 1),
							math.clamp(E.B * h * Y.B, 0, 1)
						)
						return E:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), s)
					end
					_.sync(R, "Ambient", _.ambientOn or l, _.ambientOn and _.ambient or y(S))
					_.sync(R, "OutdoorAmbient", _.ambientOn or l, _.ambientOn and _.outdoorAmbient or y(k))
					_.sync(R, "ExposureCompensation", _.exposureOn, _.exposure)
					_.sync(R, "GlobalShadows", _.noShadows, false)
					_.sync(R, "ShadowSoftness", _.shadowSoftOn, _.shadowSoftness)
					_.sync(R, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", _.envOn, _.envDiffuse)
					_.sync(R, "EnvironmentSpecularScale", _.envOn, _.envSpecular)
					_.sync(R, "ColorShift_Top", _.shiftOn, _.shiftTop)
					_.sync(R, "ColorShift_Bottom", _.shiftOn, _.shiftBottom)
					_.sync(R, "FogStart", _.fogOn, math.clamp(_.fogStart, 0, 1999))
					_.sync(R, "FogEnd", _.fogOn, math.clamp(math.max(_.fogEnd, _.fogStart + 1), 1, 2000))
					_.sync(R, "FogColor", _.fogOn, _.fogColour)
					for s, s in ipairs({ R, workspace.CurrentCamera }) do
						for h, h in ipairs(_.targets(s, "PostEffect")) do
							_.sync(h, "Enabled", _.noPost, false)
						end
					end
					local s = Enum.TonemapperPreset.Default
					if _.toneOn then
						pcall(function()
							s = Enum.TonemapperPreset[_.tone] or s
						end)
					end
					for h, h in ipairs({ R, workspace.CurrentCamera }) do
						for Y, Y in ipairs(_.targets(h, "ColorGradingEffect")) do
							_.sync(Y, "TonemapperPreset", true, s)
						end
					end
					local s = _.atmosphereOn and not _.noAtmosphere and not _.fogOn
					local h = _.targets(R, "Atmosphere")
					if s and #h == 0 then
						local Y = _.ensure("Air", "Atmosphere", R)
						if Y then
							h[1] = Y
						end
					else
						_.drop("Air")
					end
					for Y, Y in ipairs(h) do
						if not _.owned[Y] then
							_.sync(Y, "Parent", _.noAtmosphere or _.fogOn, nil)
						end
						local h = not s and not _.owned[Y] and _.airScale ~= 1
						for l, x in pairs({
							Density = _.density,
							Offset = _.offset,
							Haze = _.haze,
							Glare = _.glare,
							Color = _.atmosphereColour,
							Decay = _.decay,
						}) do
							if _.owned[Y] then
								Y[l] = x
							elseif l == "Density" and h then
								_.sync(Y, l, true, (tonumber(_.baseline(Y, l)) or _.density) * _.airScale)
							else
								_.sync(Y, l, s, x)
							end
						end
					end
					local s = V and V()
					local h = not s and _.skies[_.skybox] or nil
					local Y = _.skyOn and not s
					local s = _.targets(R, "Sky")
					if (Y or h) and #s == 0 then
						local l = _.ensure("Sky", "Sky", R)
						if l then
							s[1] = l
						end
					else
						_.drop("Sky")
					end
					for l, l in ipairs(s) do
						for s, x in pairs({
							StarCount = _.stars,
							SunAngularSize = _.sunSize,
							MoonAngularSize = _.moonSize,
							CelestialBodiesShown = _.celestial,
						}) do
							if _.owned[l] then
								l[s] = x
							else
								_.sync(l, s, Y, x)
							end
						end
						for s, s in ipairs(_.skyProps) do
							local Y = h and h[s]
							if _.owned[l] then
								if Y then
									l[s] = Y
								end
							else
								_.sync(l, s, Y ~= nil, Y)
							end
						end
					end
					if not _.lampShadows then
						for s, h in pairs(_.saved) do
							if h.Shadows ~= nil then
								_.releaseProp(s, "Shadows")
							end
						end
						_.lights, _.lightRoots = nil, nil
					end
					local s = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
					local h = _.targets(s, "Clouds")
					if _.cloudsOn and s and #h == 0 then
						local Y = _.ensure("Clouds", "Clouds", s)
						if Y then
							h[1] = Y
						end
					else
						_.drop("Clouds")
					end
					for s, s in ipairs(h) do
						for h, Y in pairs({
							Cover = _.cloudCover,
							Density = _.cloudDensity,
							Color = _.cloudColour,
							Enabled = true,
						}) do
							if _.owned[s] then
								s[h] = Y
							else
								_.sync(s, h, _.cloudsOn, Y)
							end
						end
					end
					local s = math.clamp(_.strength / 100, 0, 1)
					local h = _.quality == "Full"
					_.configure("Color", "ColorCorrectionEffect", _.gradeOn, {
						Brightness = _.gradeBrightness * s,
						Contrast = _.contrast * s,
						Saturation = _.saturation * s,
						TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(_.tint, s),
					})
					_.configure(
						"Bloom",
						"BloomEffect",
						_.bloomOn,
						{ Intensity = _.bloomIntensity * s, Size = _.bloomSize, Threshold = _.bloomThreshold }
					)
					_.configure(
						"Rays",
						"SunRaysEffect",
						_.raysOn and h,
						{ Intensity = _.raysIntensity * s, Spread = _.raysSpread }
					)
					if _.toneOn then
						local Y
						pcall(function()
							Y = Enum.TonemapperPreset[_.tone]
						end)
						if Y then
							_.configure("Tone", "ColorGradingEffect", true, { TonemapperPreset = Y })
						end
					else
						_.drop("Tone")
					end
					_.sync(R, "GeographicLatitude", _.latOn, _.lat)
					_.configure("DOF", "DepthOfFieldEffect", _.dofOn and h, {
						FarIntensity = _.dofFar * s,
						FocusDistance = _.dofFocus,
						InFocusRadius = _.dofRadius,
						NearIntensity = 0,
					})
					pcall(_.setMaterials, _.mats or "Game")
					pcall(_.lampApply)
					_.overlay()
				end)
				_.applying = false
				if not q then
					warn("[Pulse] shaders: " .. tostring(u))
				end
			end
			_.mapRoots = function()
				local q = {}
				local u = game:GetService("Players")
				for s, s in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if
						s.ClassName == "Model"
						and (s:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") or string.find(s.Name, "Lobby", 1, true))
						and not u:GetPlayerFromCharacter(s)
					then
						q[#q + 1] = s
					end
				end
				return q
			end
			_.castShadows = function()
				if not _.lampShadows then
					return
				end
				local q = _.mapRoots()
				local u = _.lightRoots ~= nil and #_.lightRoots == #q
				if u then
					for s, h in ipairs(q) do
						if _.lightRoots[s] ~= h then
							u = false
							break
						end
					end
				end
				local s = os.clock()
				if not u or s > (_.lightScanAt or 0) then
					_.lightScanAt = u and math.huge or s + 5
					_.lightRoots, _.lights = q, {}
					for u, u in ipairs(q) do
						for q, q in ipairs(u:GetDescendants()) do
							local u = q.ClassName
							if u == "PointLight" or u == "SpotLight" or u == "SurfaceLight" then
								_.lights[#_.lights + 1] = q
							end
						end
					end
				end
				for q, q in ipairs(_.lights or {}) do
					if q.Parent and not q.Shadows then
						_.sync(q, "Shadows", true, true)
					end
				end
			end
			_.request = function()
				if _.batch or _.uiSyncing or _.queued then
					return
				end
				_.queued = true
				local q = _.epoch
				task.defer(function()
					if q ~= _.epoch then
						return
					end
					_.queued = false
					if getUpvalue(a)() and _.on then
						_.apply()
					end
				end)
			end
			_.disconnect = function(q)
				for u, u in ipairs(q) do
					pcall(function()
						u:Disconnect()
					end)
				end
				table.clear(q)
			end
			_.watchCamera = function()
				_.disconnect(_.cameraConns)
				local q = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if _.watchedCamera and _.watchedCamera ~= q then
					for u, u in ipairs(_.targets(_.watchedCamera, "PostEffect")) do
						_.releaseProp(u, "Enabled")
					end
				end
				_.watchedCamera = q
				if q then
					_.cameraConns[1] = M(q.ChildAdded, function(q)
						if not _.owned[q] then
							_.request()
						end
					end, true)
				end
				_.request()
			end
			_.watch = function()
				if _.watching then
					return
				end
				_.watching = true
				_.conns[#_.conns + 1] = M(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), _.watchCamera, true)
				_.conns[#_.conns + 1] = M(R.ChildAdded, function(q)
					if not _.applying and not _.owned[q] then
						_.request()
					end
				end, true)
				_.conns[#_.conns + 1] = M(R.Changed, function(q)
					if _.applying or not _.on then
						return
					end
					local u = _.saved[R]
					if u and u[q] then
						local s, h = pcall(function()
							return R[q]
						end)
						local Y = u[q]
						if s and (not Y.hasWritten or h ~= Y.written) then
							Y.value = h
							_.request()
						end
					end
				end, true)
				_.watchCamera()
			end
			_.unwatch = function()
				_.epoch = _.epoch + 1
				_.queued = false
				_.disconnect(_.conns)
				_.disconnect(_.cameraConns)
				_.watching = false
				_.watchedCamera = nil
			end
			_.restore = function()
				_.applying = true
				for q, u in pairs(_.saved) do
					for s in pairs(u) do
						_.releaseProp(q, s)
					end
				end
				table.clear(_.saved)
				local q = {}
				for u in pairs(_.effects) do
					q[#q + 1] = u
				end
				for u, u in ipairs(q) do
					_.drop(u)
				end
				if _.gui then
					pcall(function()
						_.gui:Destroy()
					end)
					_.gui = nil
					_.screen = nil
				end
				_.lights, _.lightRoots = nil, nil
				for q, q in pairs(_.neonLights or {}) do
					pcall(function()
						q:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				_.neonLights = {}
				pcall(function()
					_.setMaterials("Game")
				end)
				_.applying = false
			end
			_.setEnabled = function(q)
				if q == true and not getUpvalue(a)() then
					return
				end
				_.on = q == true
				getgenv().__pulseVisOwns = _.on
				if _.paintChips then
					pcall(_.paintChips)
				end
				if _.on then
					_.watch()
					_.request()
				else
					_.unwatch()
					_.restore()
				end
			end
			_.presetNames = function()
				local q = { "Original" }
				for u, u in ipairs(_.order) do
					q[#q + 1] = u
				end
				return q
			end
			_.syncUI = function()
				local q = _.uiSyncing
				_.uiSyncing = true
				for u, s in pairs(_.controls) do
					if _[u] ~= nil then
						pcall(function()
							if s.SetSilent then
								s.SetSilent(_[u])
							else
								s.Set(_[u])
							end
						end)
					end
				end
				_.uiSyncing = q
			end
			_.resetLook = function()
				_.batch = true
				_.setEnabled(false)
				for q, u in pairs(_.defaults) do
					_[q] = u
				end
				_.preset = "Original"
				w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
				w.visuals.look = _.preset
				_.syncUI()
				if _.paintChips then
					pcall(_.paintChips)
				end
				_.batch = false
			end
			_.applyPreset = function(q)
				if q == "Original" then
					_.resetLook()
					return
				end
				local u
				for s, s in ipairs(_.looks) do
					if s.name == q then
						u = s
						break
					end
				end
				if u == nil then
					return
				end
				_.batch = true
				local s = { on = true, preset = true, quality = true, strength = true, tech = true }
				for h, Y in pairs(_.defaults) do
					if not s[h] then
						_[h] = Y
					end
				end
				for s, h in pairs(u.values) do
					_[s] = h
				end
				_.preset, _.on = q, true
				w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
				w.visuals.look = q
				_.syncUI()
				if _.paintChips then
					pcall(_.paintChips)
				end
				_.batch = false
				_.setEnabled(true)
			end
			J.visSnap = function()
				local q = {}
				for u in pairs(_.defaults) do
					local s = _[u]
					local h = typeof(s)
					if h == "Color3" then
						q[u] = {
							c3 = {
								math.floor(s.R * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
								math.floor(s.G * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
								math.floor(s.B * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000,
							},
						}
					elseif h == "number" or h == "string" or h == "boolean" then
						q[u] = s
					end
				end
				return q
			end
			J.visLook = function(q)
				if type(q) ~= "string" or not (q == "Original" or _.swatch[q]) then
					q = "Original"
				end
				_.preset = q
				w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
				w.visuals.look = q
				if _.paintChips then
					pcall(_.paintChips)
				end
				if _.paintPacks then
					pcall(_.paintPacks)
				end
			end
			J.visApply = function(q)
				if type(q) ~= "table" then
					return
				end
				_.batch = true
				for u, s in pairs(q) do
					local q = _.defaults[u]
					if q ~= nil then
						if type(s) == "table" and type(s.c3) == "table" then
							s = Color3.new(tonumber(s.c3[1]) or 0, tonumber(s.c3[2]) or 0, tonumber(s.c3[3]) or 0)
						end
						if typeof(s) == typeof(q) then
							_[u] = s
						end
					end
				end
				_.batch = false
				w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
				w.visuals.look = _.preset
				pcall(_.syncUI)
				if _.paintChips then
					pcall(_.paintChips)
				end
				if _.paintPacks then
					pcall(_.paintPacks)
				end
				pcall(_.setEnabled, _.on == true)
			end

			_.matSet, _.matMade, _.matPrev = "Game", {}, {}
			_.setMaterials = function(s)
				if s == _.matSet then
					return
				end
				for h, Y in pairs(_.matPrev) do
					pcall(function()
						q:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[h], Y)
					end)
				end
				_.matPrev = {}
				for h, h in ipairs(_.matMade) do
					pcall(function()
						h:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				_.matMade = {}
				local h = u[s]
				if h then
					for u, Y in pairs(h) do
						pcall(function()
							local l = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
							l.Name = "PulseHD_" .. u
							l.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material[u]
							if Y[1] ~= "" then
								l.ColorMap = "rbxassetid://" .. Y[1]
							end
							if Y[2] ~= "" then
								l.NormalMap = "rbxassetid://" .. Y[2]
							end
							if Y[3] ~= "" then
								l.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. Y[3]
							end
							if Y[4] ~= "" then
								l.MetalnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. Y[4]
							end
							l.StudsPerTile = Y[5]
							l.Parent = q
							_.matMade[#_.matMade + 1] = l
							_.matPrev[u] = q:GetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[u])
							q:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[u], l.Name)
						end)
					end
				end
				_.matSet = h and s or "Game"
			end
			_.neonLights = {}
			_.lampScan = function()
				local q = _.mapRoots()
				local u = _.lampRoots ~= nil and #_.lampRoots == #q
				if u then
					for s, h in ipairs(q) do
						if _.lampRoots[s] ~= h then
							u = false
							break
						end
					end
				end
				local s = os.clock()
				if u and s < (_.lampScanAt or 0) then
					return
				end
				_.lampScanAt = s + (u and 30 or 5)
				_.lampRoots, _.lamps, _.neons = q, {}, {}
				for u, u in ipairs(q) do
					for q, q in ipairs(u:GetDescendants()) do
						local u = q.ClassName
						if u == "PointLight" or u == "SpotLight" or u == "SurfaceLight" then
							if not _.owned[q] and q.Name ~= "PulseNeonGlow" then
								_.lamps[#_.lamps + 1] = q
							end
						elseif q:IsA("BasePart") and q.Material == Enum.Material.Neon and q.Transparency < 0.6 then
							_.neons[#_.neons + 1] = q
						end
					end
				end
			end
			_.lampApply = function()
				local q = tonumber(_.lampBoost) or 1
				local u = _.on and math.abs(q - 1) > 0.01
				if u or _.on and _.neonGlow then
					pcall(_.lampScan)
				end
				for s, s in ipairs(_.lamps or {}) do
					if s.Parent then
						local h = u and _.baseline(s, "Brightness")
						_.sync(s, "Brightness", u, (tonumber(h) or 1) * q)
						local h = u and _.baseline(s, "Range")
						_.sync(s, "Range", u, math.min(60, (tonumber(h) or 8) * (1 + (q - 1) * 0.5)))
					end
				end
				for q, u in pairs(_.neonLights) do
					if not q.Parent or not u.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							u:Destroy()
						end)
						_.neonLights[q] = nil
					end
				end
				if _.on and _.neonGlow then
					local q = 0
					for u in pairs(_.neonLights) do
						q += 1
					end
					for u, u in ipairs(_.neons or {}) do
						if q >= 90 then
							break
						end
						if u.Parent and not _.neonLights[u] then
							local s = u.Size
							local h = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
							if h >= 0.8 then
								pcall(function()
									local s = Instance.new("PointLight")
									s.Name = "PulseNeonGlow"
									s.Color = u.Color
									s.Brightness = 1.4
									s.Range = math.clamp(h * 1.6, 6, 18)
									s.Shadows = false
									s.Parent = u
									_.owned[s] = true
									_.neonLights[u] = s
									q += 1
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				else
					for q, u in pairs(_.neonLights) do
						pcall(function()
							u:Destroy()
						end)
						_.neonLights[q] = nil
					end
				end
			end

			for q, q in ipairs(_.packs) do
				_.looks[#_.looks + 1] = { name = q.name, shader = true, values = q.values, pack = true }
				_.extras[q.name] = q.extra
				_.swatch[q.name] = q.sw
			end
			_.PACK_ATLAS =
				""
			_.loadPackPhotos = function()
				if _.packAsset == nil then
					_.packAsset = false
					pcall(function()
						if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
							return
						end
						if
							type(isfolder) == "function"
							and type(makefolder) == "function"
							and not isfolder("PulseHub")
						then
							makefolder("PulseHub")
						end
						if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg")) then
							writefile("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg", F(_.PACK_ATLAS))
						end
						local q = getcustomasset("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg")
						if type(q) == "string" and #q > 0 then
							_.packAsset = q
						end
					end)
				end
				if not _.packAsset then
					return
				end
				for q, u in ipairs(_.packTiles or {}) do
					u.img.Image = _.packAsset
					u.img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((q - 1) % 4 * 256, math.floor((q - 1) / 4) * 128)
					u.img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(256, 128)
					u.img.Visible = true
				end
			end
			_.applyExtras = function(q)
				local u = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseWeather")
				if type(u) ~= "table" or type(u.settingsChanged) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				local s = _.extras[q]
				if not s then
					if _.extrasOn then
						_.extrasOn = false
						u.scene = ""
						u.on = false
						pcall(u.settingsChanged)
						if _.extrasSky and u.setSky then
							pcall(u.setSky, nil)
						end
						_.extrasSky = nil
						if u.syncUI then
							pcall(u.syncUI)
						end
						if u.paintScenes then
							pcall(u.paintScenes)
						end
					end
					return
				end
				pcall(u.stop)
				local q = {
					quality = true,
					shelter = true,
					sound = true,
					soundVolume = true,
					wet = true,
					wetness = true,
					grade = true,
					matchLight = true,
					radius = true,
					scale = true,
					ripples = true,
					gusts = true,
				}
				for h, Y in pairs(u.defaults or {}) do
					if not q[h] and not string.find(h, "olour", 1, true) then
						u[h] = Y
					end
				end
				u.scene = ""
				if s.weather then
					u.on = true
					for q, h in pairs(s.weather) do
						u[q] = h
					end
				else
					u.on = false
				end
				pcall(u.settingsChanged)
				if s.sky and u.setSky then
					pcall(u.setSky, s.sky)
					_.extrasSky = s.sky
				end
				_.extrasOn = true
				if u.syncUI then
					pcall(u.syncUI)
				end
				if u.paintScenes then
					pcall(u.paintScenes)
				end
			end
			_.nextPreset = function()
				local q = _.presetNames()
				local u = 1
				for s, h in ipairs(q) do
					if h == _.preset then
						u = s
						break
					end
				end
				local s = q[u % #q + 1]
				if s == "Original" then
					s = q[2]
				end
				_.applyPreset(s)
				pcall(_.applyExtras, s)
			end
			_.changed = function(q, u)
				if _.uiSyncing then
					return
				end
				_[q] = u
				_.request()
			end
			r = function()
				if _.on then
					_.request()
				end
			end
			f(function()
				pcall(_.unwatch)
				pcall(_.restore)
				getgenv().__pulseVisOwns = false
			end)
			table.insert(getgenv().__pulseResetHooks, function()
				pcall(_.resetLook)
			end)
			task.spawn(function()
				local q = 0
				while isAlive(a) do
					task.wait(1)
					if _.on then
						q = q + 1
						_.request()
						if _.lampShadows and q % 2 == 0 then
							pcall(_.castShadows)
						end
					end
				end
			end)
