			local function B(V)
				if q then
					pcall(function()
						q.Parent = nil
					end)
				end
				local S
				if V.faces then
					S = l(V.faces, V)
				else
					S = Instance.new("Sky")

			local function V(l, S)
				if s then
					return
				end
				if S and h == l then
					return
				end
				s = true
				if S then
					for S, k in pairs(u) do
						if S ~= l and k.ui then
							pcall(function()
								k.ui.Set(false)
							end)
						end
					end
					x()
					local S = pcall(function()
						B(u[l].spec)
					end)
					if S then
						h = l
						w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
						w.visuals.sky = l
					else
						x()
						h = nil
						w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
						w.visuals.sky = ""
						if u[l].ui then
							pcall(function()
								u[l].ui.Set(false)
							end)
						end
					end
				else
					if h == l then
						x()
						h = nil
						w.visuals = w.visuals or {}
						w.visuals.sky = ""
					end
				end
				if r then
					pcall(r)
				end
				s = false
				if Y.fn then
					pcall(Y.fn)
				end
			end

			R.ORDER = {
				"Off",
				"Minecraft",
				"Nether",
				"Classic",
				"Stylized",
				"Toon",
				"Realistic",
				"Luxury",
				"Urban",
				"Medieval",
				"Sci-Fi",
				"Space",
				"Winter",

				"Beach",
				"Candy",
				"SpongeBob",
				"Jungle",
				"Lava",
				"Halloween",
			}
			R.decode = function(B)
				for V, V in ipairs({
					crypt and crypt.base64decode,
					base64decode,
					base64_decode,
					base64 and base64.decode,
				}) do
					if type(V) == "function" then
						local r, q = pcall(V, B)
						if r and type(q) == "string" and #q > 0 then
							return q
						end
					end
				end
				local V = {}
				for r = 1, 64 do
					V[string.byte("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", r)] = r - 1
				end
				local r, q = {}, 0
				for u = 1, #B - 3, 4 do
					local s, h, Y, l = string.byte(B, u, u + 3)
					local B = (V[s] or 0) * 262144 + (V[h] or 0) * 4096 + (V[Y] or 0) * 64 + (V[l] or 0)
					local V, u, s = math.floor(B / 65536) % 256, math.floor(B / 256) % 256, B % 256
					q += 1
					if Y == 61 then
						r[q] = string.char(V)
					elseif l == 61 then
						r[q] = string.char(V, u)
					else
						r[q] = string.char(V, u, s)
					end
				end
				return table.concat(r)
			end
			R.asset = function(B, V)
				local r = B .. "/" .. V
				if R.assets[r] then
					return R.assets[r]
				end
				local q = R.PACKS[B]
				local u = R.TEX[B] and R.TEX[B][V]
				if not (q and u) or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
					return nil
				end
				local u = "PulseHub/texpack/" .. string.lower(B) .. "_" .. V .. "_v1." .. q.ext
				pcall(function()
					if type(isfolder) == "function" then
						if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
							makefolder("PulseHub")
						end
						if not isfolder("PulseHub/texpack") then
							makefolder("PulseHub/texpack")
						end
					end
					if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(u)) then
						local s = getgenv().__pulseData
						if V ~= q.icon and type(isfile) == "function" then
							R.pre = R.pre or {}
							if not R.pre[B] then
								R.pre[B] = true
								local h = {}
								for Y in pairs(R.TEX[B]) do
									if
										Y ~= V
										and Y ~= q.icon
										and not isfile(
											"PulseHub/texpack/" .. string.lower(B) .. "_" .. Y .. "_v1." .. q.ext
										)
									then
										h[#h + 1] = "tex_" .. B .. "_" .. Y
									end
								end
								s.prefetch(h)
							end
						end
						local q = s.take("tex_" .. B .. "_" .. V)
						if q then
							writefile(u, R.decode(q))
						end
					end
					local B = getcustomasset(u)
					if type(B) == "string" and #B > 0 then
						R.assets[r] = B
					end
				end)
				return R.assets[r]
			end
			R.variant = function(B, V, r)
				local q = R.made[B]
				if not (q and q.Parent) then
					q = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
					q.Name = "PulseTP_" .. B.Name
					q.BaseMaterial = B
					q.Parent = R.MS
					R.made[B] = q
				end
				local B = R.asset(R.cfg.pack, V)
				if B and q.ColorMap ~= B then
					q.ColorMap = B
				end
				q:SetAttribute("PulseKey", V)
				q.StudsPerTile = math.clamp((tonumber(R.cfg.scale) or 4) * (r.tile[V] or 1), 0.5, 32)
				return q
			end
			R.eligible = function(B)
				if not B:IsA("BasePart") or B:IsA("Terrain") then
					return false
				end
				if B.Transparency >= 0.95 or B.MaterialVariant ~= "" then
					return false
				end
				local V = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if V and B:IsDescendantOf(V) then
					return false
				end
				if string.sub(B.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
					return false
				end
				if B:IsA("MeshPart") and B.TextureID ~= "" then
					return false
				end
				local V = B.Parent
				while V and V ~= workspace do
					if V:IsA("Model") and V:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false
					end
					if
						V:IsA("Tool")
						or V:IsA("Accessory")
						or V.Name == "CoinContainer"
						or string.sub(V.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse"
					then
						return false
					end
					V = V.Parent
				end
				return true
			end
			R.applyPart = function(B, V)
				if R.parts[B] then
					return
				end
				local r = V.map[B.Material.Name]
				if not r or not R.eligible(B) then
					return
				end
				local q = R.made[B.Material]
				if not (q and q.Parent) then
					q = R.variant(B.Material, r, V)
				end
				local u = { mat = B.Material, color = B.Color }
				R.parts[B] = u
				B.MaterialVariant = q.Name
				if R.cfg.mcColors and V.neutral[r] then
					B.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				end
			end
			R.restorePart = function(B, V)
				pcall(function()
					if B.Parent then
						if string.sub(B.MaterialVariant, 1, 8) == "PulseTP_" then
							B.MaterialVariant = ""
						end
						B.Color = V.color
					end
				end)
			end
			R.clear = function()
				R.gen = (R.gen or 0) + 1
				table.clear(R.queue)
				for B, V in pairs(R.parts) do
					R.restorePart(B, V)
				end
				R.parts = {}
				for B, B in pairs(R.made) do
					pcall(function()
						B:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				R.made = {}
				if R.oldUse ~= nil then
					pcall(function()
						R.MS.Use2022Materials = R.oldUse
					end)
					R.oldUse = nil
				end
			end
			R.apply = function()
				R.last = R.cfg.pack
				R.clear()
				local B = R.PACKS[R.cfg.pack]
				if not B then
					return
				end
				if R.oldUse == nil then
					R.oldUse = R.MS.Use2022Materials
					pcall(function()
						R.MS.Use2022Materials = true
					end)
				end
				local V = R.gen
				task.spawn(function()
					local r = workspace:GetDescendants()
					for q = 1, #r do
						if R.gen ~= V or not getUpvalue(a)() then
							return
						end
						local V = r[q]
						if V:IsA("BasePart") then
							pcall(R.applyPart, V, B)
						end
						if q % 600 == 0 then
							task.wait()
						end
					end
				end)
			end
			R.refreshColors = function()
				local B = R.PACKS[R.cfg.pack]
				if not B then
					return
				end
				for V, r in pairs(R.parts) do
					pcall(function()
						if V.Parent then
							local q = B.map[r.mat.Name]

					return
				end
				for V, V in pairs(R.made) do
					pcall(function()
						local r = V:GetAttribute("PulseKey")
						V.StudsPerTile = math.clamp((tonumber(R.cfg.scale) or 4) * (B.tile[r] or 1), 0.5, 32)
					end)

					end
				end
				if os.clock() - (R.pruneAt or 0) > 5 then
					R.pruneAt = os.clock()
					for B in pairs(R.parts) do
						if not B.Parent then
							R.parts[B] = nil
						end
					end
				end

				Ash = {

					layers = {

							tex = "glow",

							spread = 30,
							drag = 0.55,
							rot = 40,
							light = 1,
							glow = 0,
							sway = 1.4,
							tint = 0,
						},
						{
							tex = "glow",
							base = "ground",
							y = 4,
							h = 8,
							reach = 0.8,
							rate = { 1, 14 },
							life = { 2.2, 4 },
							speed = { 1.6, 3.4 },
							size = { 0.16, 0.3 },
							alpha = 1,
							spread = 35,
							drag = 0.3,
							light = 0,
							glow = 1,
							sway = 2.6,

							noShelter = true,
							fire = true,
							col2 = "emberColour",
							windK = 0.7,

				Pollen = {
					colour = "pollenColour",
					wet = false,
					voices = {
						{ id = V.wind, base = 0.2, lo = 0.2, hi = 0.5, wind = true },
						{ id = V.birds, base = 0.55, lo = 0.55, hi = 0.55, steady = true },
					},
					layers = {
						{
							tex = "glow",
							y = 5,
							h = 11,
							reach = 0.7,
							rate = { 2, 26 },

							speed = { 0.1, 0.4 },

							tint = 0.2,

							y = 6,
							h = 14,

							rate = { 1, 14 },
							life = { 8, 12 },

							size = { 0.6, 1.1 },
							alpha = 0.16,
							spread = 180,
							drag = 0.8,
							light = 0,
							glow = 1,

							flicker = true,
							noShelter = true,

							tint = 0.3,

			}
			R.grades = {
				Snow = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(228, 240, 255), saturation = -0.14, contrast = 0.04, brightness = 0.02 },
				Fireflies = {
					tint = Color3.fromRGB(205, 218, 255),
					saturation = -0.08,
					contrast = 0.05,
					brightness = -0.05,
				},
				Embers = {
					tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 198),
					saturation = 0.05,
					contrast = 0.06,
					brightness = -0.02,
				},
				Ash = { tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 205), saturation = -0.25, contrast = 0.06, brightness = -0.04 },
			}
			R.number = function(r, q, u, s)
				r = tonumber(r)
				if r == nil or r ~= r or r == math.huge or r == -math.huge then
					r = q
				end
				return math.clamp(r, u, s)
			end
			R.validate = function()
				if R.recipes[R.kind] == nil then
					R.kind = "Snow"
				end
				if R.qualities[R.quality] == nil then
					R.quality = "Balanced"
				end
				for r, q in pairs(R.limits) do
					R[r] = R.number(R[r], q[1], q[2], q[3])
				end
				for r, r in ipairs(R.colourFields) do
					if typeof(R[r]) ~= "Color3" then
						R[r] = R.defaults[r]
					end
				end
			end
			R.mapRoots = function()
				local r = os.clock()
				if R.rootsAt and r - R.rootsAt < 5 and R.roots then
					return R.roots
				end
				local q = {}
				for u, u in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if
						u.ClassName == "Model"
						and (u:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") or string.find(u.Name, "Lobby", 1, true))
					then
						q[#q + 1] = u
					end
				end
				R.roots, R.rootsAt = q, r
				return q
			end
			R.invisible = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			R.splashes = {}
			R.filter = function(r)
				local q = { r }
				for r, r in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
					if r.Character then
						q[#q + 1] = r.Character
					end
				end
				for r in pairs(R.invisible) do
					if r.Parent then
						q[#q + 1] = r
					end
				end
				local r = RaycastParams.new()
				r.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				r.FilterDescendantsInstances = q
				r.IgnoreWater = true
				pcall(function()
					r.RespectCanCollide = true
				end)
				R.params = r
			end
			R.cast = function(r, q)
				if not R.params then
					return nil, false
				end
				for u = 1, 6 do
					local u, s = pcall(function()
						return workspace:Raycast(r, q, R.params)
					end)
					if not u then
						return nil, false
					end
					if not s then
						return nil, true
					end
					local r = s.Instance
					if r:IsA("BasePart") and r.Transparency >= 0.95 then
						R.invisible[r] = true
						pcall(function()
							R.params:AddToFilter(r)
						end)
					else
						return s, true
					end
				end
				return nil, true
			end
			R.volume = function(r, q)
				local u = Instance.new("Part")
				u.Name = q
				u.Anchored, u.CanCollide, u.CanTouch, u.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
				u.CastShadow, u.Transparency = false, 1
				u.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
				u.Parent = r
				return u
			end
			R.clear = function()
				for r, r in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					pcall(function()
						r.emitter:Clear()
					end)
				end
				for r, r in ipairs(R.splashes) do
					pcall(function()
						r.ripple:Clear()
						r.spray:Clear()
					end)
				end
			end
			R.stop = function(r)
				if not r then
					R.wetLevel, R.wetPainted = 0, 0
					pcall(R.wetRestore)
				end
				if R.folder then
					pcall(function()
						R.folder:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				if R.flash then
					pcall(function()
						R.flash:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				if R.gradeFx then
					pcall(function()
						R.gradeFx:Destroy()
					end)
				end
				R.folder, R.flash, R.gradeFx, R.camera, R.character, R.lastPosition, R.params =
					nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
				R.builtKind, R.builtQuality, R.builtSound, R.boltPart, R.storm = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
				table.clear(R.nodes)
				R.splashes = {}
				table.clear(R.voices)
				R.splashIndex, R.splashBudget = 0, 0
				R.visibility, R.frameElapsed, R.probeElapsed = 0, 0, 1
				R.cameraCovered, R.suspended, R.dirty = nil, nil, true
				R.audioLevel, R.gradeLevel, R.coverBlend = 0, 0, 0
			end
			R.destroy = function()
				R.stop()
				R.dead = true
			end
			R.envStep = function()
				local r = game:GetService("Lighting")
				local q = r.ClockTime
				local u = math.clamp((q - 5.5) / 1.5, 0, 1) * math.clamp((19.5 - q) / 1.5, 0, 1)
				local q = r.OutdoorAmbient
				local r = (q.R + q.G + q.B) / 3
				local q = math.clamp(1 - r / 0.55, 0, 1)
				R.envDark = math.max(1 - u, q * 0.8)
			end
			R.audioBuild = function()
				table.clear(R.voices)
				R.audioLevel = 0
				if not R.sound then
					return
				end
				for r, r in ipairs(R.recipes[R.kind].voices or {}) do
					local q = Instance.new("Sound")
					q.Name = "Voice"
					q.SoundId = r.id
					q.Looped, q.Volume = true, 0
					q.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
					q.Parent = R.folder
					local u = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
					u.LowGain, u.MidGain, u.HighGain = 0, 0, 0
					u.Parent = q
					pcall(function()
						q:Play()
					end)
					R.voices[#R.voices + 1] = { sound = q, eq = u, spec = r, level = 0 }
				end
			end
			R.build = function(r)
				R.stop(true)
				R.camera, R.character = r, L.Character
				R.builtKind, R.builtQuality, R.builtSound = R.kind, R.quality, R.sound
				R.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
				R.folder.Name = "PulseWeather_" .. tostring(T)
				R.folder.Parent = r
				local q = R.recipes[R.kind]
				for u, s in ipairs(q.layers) do
					local h = s.noShelter and 1 or 3
					local Y = (h + 1) / 2
					for l = 1, h do
						for x = 1, h do
							local S = R.volume(R.folder, "WeatherVolume" .. u .. "_" .. l .. x)
							local u = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
							u.Name = "WeatherParticles"
							u.Enabled, u.Rate = false, 0
							u.LockedToPart, u.VelocityInheritance = false, 0
							u.EmissionDirection = s.lift and Enum.NormalId.Top or Enum.NormalId.Bottom
							pcall(function()
								u.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
								u.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
								u.ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward
							end)
							u.Parent = S
							R.nodes[#R.nodes + 1] = {
								part = S,
								emitter = u,
								blocked = true,
								layer = s,
								grid = h,
								gx = x - Y,
								gz = l - Y,
								slots = h * h,
								seed = math.random() * 6.2832,
							}
						end
					end
				end
				if q.ripples and R.ripples then
					local u = R.volume(R.folder, "WeatherSplashes")
					u.CFrame = CFrame.new()
					for s = 1, R.qualities[R.quality].pool do
						local s = Instance.new("Attachment")
						s.Parent = u
						local u = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
						u.Name = "Ripple"
						u.Enabled, u.Rate, u.LockedToPart = true, 0, false
						u.Parent = s
						local h = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
						h.Name = "Spray"
						h.Enabled, h.Rate, h.LockedToPart = true, 0, false
						h.Parent = s
						R.splashes[#R.splashes + 1] = { attachment = s, ripple = u, spray = h }
					end
				end
				if q.storm then
					R.flash = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
					R.flash.Name = "PulseWeatherFlash_" .. tostring(T)
					R.flash.Brightness, R.flash.Contrast, R.flash.Saturation = 0, 0, 0
					R.flash.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					R.flash.Parent = r
					R.boltPart = R.volume(R.folder, "WeatherBolts")
					R.boltPart.CFrame = CFrame.new()
					R.storm =
						{ nextAt = os.clock() + 6 + math.random() * 10, active = nil, thunder = {}, flashPower = 0 }
				end
				R.gradeFx = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
				R.gradeFx.Name = "PulseWeatherGrade_" .. tostring(T)
				R.gradeFx.Brightness, R.gradeFx.Contrast, R.gradeFx.Saturation = 0, 0, 0
				R.gradeFx.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				R.gradeFx.Parent = r
				R.audioBuild()
				R.filter(r)
				R.dirty = true
			end
			R.flutter = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.14, 0.75),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.29, -0.55),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.43, 0.65),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.57, -0.7),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.71, 0.5),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.86, -0.6),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2),
			})
			R.stretchSquash = function()
				local T = w.ui and tonumber(w.ui.stretch) or 0
				if T <= 0 then
					return 0
				end
				local r = math.max(0.1, 1 - T / 100 * 0.6)
				return math.floor(-math.log(r, 2) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
			end
			R.squashFor = function(T, r)
				if T.flutter then
					return R.flutter
				end
				return NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(r, -3.0, 3))
			end
			R.spinFor = function(T, r, q)
				local u = r.rot and not (q > 0 and not r.flutter)
				T.Rotation = u and NumberRange.new(0, 360) or NumberRange.new(0)
				T.RotSpeed = u and NumberRange.new(-r.rot, r.rot) or NumberRange.new(0)
			end
			R.applySquash = function(T)
				R.squash = T
				for r, r in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					pcall(function()
						r.emitter.Squash = R.squashFor(r.layer, T)
						R.spinFor(r.emitter, r.layer, T)
					end)
				end
			end
			R.fadeSeq = function(T)
				return NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 1 - T),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.78, 1 - T),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
				})
			end
			R.pulseSeq = function(T)
				local r = 1 - T
				return NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, r),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 1 - T * 0.15),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, r + (1 - r) * 0.9),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, r),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 1 - T * 0.25),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
				})
			end
			R.pulseSize = function(T, r)
				local q = (T + r) * 0.5
				return NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, q),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, r * 0.45),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, r),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72, T * 0.5),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.88, q * 0.8),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
				})
			end
			R.layerRate = function(T)
				local r = R.amount / 100
				if T.from and r < T.from then
					return 0
				end
				local q = T.rate
				local T = q[1] + (q[2] - q[1]) * r
				local r = R.qualities[R.quality].rate
				return T * r * ((R.effectiveRadius or R.radius) / 30) ^ 2
			end
			R.configure = function()
				local T = R.recipes[R.kind]
				local r = R.opacity / 100
				local q = R.speed / 100
				local u = R[T.colour]
				R.effectiveRadius = R.radius
				local T = R.envDark
				for s, s in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					local h = s.layer
					local Y = R.effectiveRadius * 2 * h.reach / s.grid
					s.tile = Y
					s.part.Size = Vector3.new(Y, h.h, Y)
					s.rate = R.layerRate(h) / s.slots
					local Y = s.emitter
					Y.Texture = B[h.tex]
					local s = h.col or u
					local l = h.tint or 0.2
					local x = h.col2 and R[h.col2] or u
					if h.fire then
						Y.Color = ColorSequence.new({
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, x:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 210), 0.65)),
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, x),
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, x:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 6), 0.65)),
						})
					elseif h.pulse then
						Y.Color = ColorSequence.new({
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, s:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)),
							ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, s),
						})
					else
						Y.Color = ColorSequence.new(s:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), l), s)
					end
					Y.LightInfluence = h.light or 0.3
					Y.LightEmission = math.clamp((h.glow or 0) * (0.4 + 0.6 * T), 0, 1)
					Y.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(h.life[1] / q, h.life[2] / q)
					Y.Speed = NumberRange.new(h.speed[1] * q, h.speed[2] * q)
					local q, s = h.size[1] * R.scale, h.size[2] * R.scale
					local l, x = (q + s) * 0.5, (s - q) * 0.5
					if h.pulse then
						Y.Size = R.pulseSize(q, s)
					elseif h.fire then
						Y.Size = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, l, x),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, l * 0.75, x * 0.7),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, l * 0.2, 0),
						})
					else
						Y.Size = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, l * 0.9, x),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, l, x),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, l * 0.92, x),
						})
					end
					local q = math.clamp(r * (h.alpha or 1) * (0.9 + 0.2 * T), 0, 1)
					if h.pulse or h.flicker then
						Y.Transparency = R.pulseSeq(q)
					else
						Y.Transparency = R.fadeSeq(q)
					end
					Y.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(h.spread or 5, h.spread or 5)
					Y.Drag = h.drag or 0
					local T = R.stretchSquash()
					R.spinFor(Y, h, T)
					Y.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
					pcall(function()
						Y.Squash = R.squashFor(h, T)
					end)
					pcall(function()
						Y.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None
					end)
					Y.Enabled = true
				end
				local T = u:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
				for q, q in ipairs(R.splashes) do
					local u = q.ripple
					u.Texture = B.ring
					u.Color = ColorSequence.new(T)
					u.LightInfluence, u.LightEmission = 0.5, 0.25
					u.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.6)
					u.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
					u.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01, 0.02)
					u.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
					u.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					u.Drag = 0
					u.Size = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 0.8 * R.scale),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.2 * R.scale),
					})
					u.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, 1 - math.clamp(r * 0.5, 0.15, 0.5)),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					})
					u.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180.0, 180)
					u.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
					u.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
					local r = q.spray
					r.Texture = B.splash
					r.Color = ColorSequence.new(T)
					r.LightInfluence, r.LightEmission = 0.5, 0.4
					r.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.45)
					r.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
					r.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.6)
					r.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20)
					r.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -6.0, 0)
					r.Drag = 0
					r.Size = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.9 * R.scale),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.1 * R.scale),
					})
					r.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 0.35),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.78),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
					})
					r.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-360.0, 360)
					r.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
					r.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
				end
				R.dirty = false
			end
			R.covered = function(T, B)
				local r, q = R.cast(T + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), Vector3.new(0, B or 40, 0))
				return not q or r ~= nil
			end
			R.probe = function(T)
				R.filter(R.camera)
				local B = R.shelter and R.covered(T) or false
				if B and not R.cameraCovered then
					for r, r in ipairs(R.nodes) do
						if not r.layer.noShelter then
							pcall(function()
								r.emitter:Clear()
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				R.cameraCovered = B
				for r, r in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					local q = false
					if not r.layer.noShelter then
						q = B
						if not q and R.shelter then
							q = R.covered(
								Vector3.new(r.part.Position.X, T.Y, r.part.Position.Z),
								math.max(r.layer.h, 8) + 8
							)
						end
					end
					if q and not r.blocked then
						r.emitter:Clear()
					end
					r.blocked = q
				end
			end
			R.splash = function(T, B)
				local r = R.effectiveRadius or 30
				local q
				if math.random() < 0.7 then
					q = math.atan2(B.Z, B.X) + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2.2
				else
					q = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
				end
				local B = 2.5 + math.sqrt(math.random()) * r * 0.85
				local r = Vector3.new(T.X + math.cos(q) * B, T.Y + 28, T.Z + math.sin(q) * B)
				local B = R.cast(r, Vector3.new(0, -70.0, 0))
				if not B or B.Normal.Y < 0.55 or B.Position.Y > T.Y + 14 then
					return
				end
				R.splashIndex = R.splashIndex % #R.splashes + 1
				local T = R.splashes[R.splashIndex]
				T.attachment.WorldPosition = B.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)
				T.ripple:Emit(1)
				if math.random() < 0.55 then
					T.spray:Emit(1)
				end
			end
			R.gustValue = function()
				if not R.gusts then
					return 1
				end
				return 0.8
					+ math.sin(R.phase * 0.7) * 0.2
					+ math.sin(R.phase * 1.9) * 0.08
					+ math.sin(R.phase * 0.23 + 1.3) * 0.1
			end
			R.audioStep = function(T)
				if #R.voices == 0 then
					return
				end
				local B = R.amount > 0 and 1 or 0
				R.audioLevel = (R.audioLevel or 0) + (B - (R.audioLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-T * 2.5))
				local B = R.cameraCovered and 1 or 0
				R.coverBlend = (R.coverBlend or 0) + (B - (R.coverBlend or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-T * 3))
				local B = R.soundVolume / 100
				local r = R.gustValue()
				local q = R.amount / 100
				local u = 1 - math.exp(-T * 3.5)
				for T, T in ipairs(R.voices) do
					local s = T.spec
					local h = s.lo + (s.hi - s.lo) * q
					if s.from then
						h = h * math.clamp((q - s.from) / 0.2, 0, 1)
					end
					local q = s.base * h
					if s.wind then
						q = q * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.clamp(R.wind / 10, 0, 1.4) * r)
					end
					local r = 1
					if s.roof then
						r = R.coverBlend
					elseif s.open then
						r = 1 - R.coverBlend * 0.75
					elseif not s.steady then
						r = 1 - R.coverBlend * 0.55
					end
					local h = B * R.audioLevel * q * r
					T.level = T.level + (h - T.level) * u
					T.sound.Volume = T.level
					local B = R.coverBlend > 0.5 and not s.roof and -14.0 or 0
					T.eq.HighGain = T.eq.HighGain + (B - T.eq.HighGain) * u
				end
			end
			R.gradeStep = function(T)
				local B = R.gradeFx
				if not B then
					return
				end
				local r = R.grade and R.grades[R.recipes[R.kind].grade or ""] or nil
				local q = r and R.amount > 0 and 0.35 + 0.65 * R.amount / 100 or 0
				R.gradeLevel = (R.gradeLevel or 0) + (q - (R.gradeLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-T * 1.5))
				local T = R.gradeLevel
				if not r then
					B.Enabled = false
					return
				end
				B.Enabled = true
				B.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(r.tint, T)
				B.Saturation = (r.saturation or 0) * T
				B.Contrast = (r.contrast or 0) * T
				B.Brightness = (r.brightness or 0) * T
			end
			R.bolt = function(T, B, r)
				local q = {}
				for u, s in ipairs(T) do
					local T = Instance.new("Attachment")
					T.Parent = R.boltPart
					T.WorldPosition = s
					q[u] = T
				end
				local T = {}
				for u = 1, #q - 1 do
					local s = 0.55 + 0.45 * u / #q
					for h, h in ipairs({ { 1, Color3.fromRGB(232, 240, 255) }, { 4.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 178, 255) } }) do
						local Y = Instance.new("Beam")
						Y.Attachment0, Y.Attachment1 = q[u], q[u + 1]
						Y.Color = ColorSequence.new(h[2])
						Y.Width0, Y.Width1 = B * h[1] * s, B * h[1] * (0.55 + 0.45 * (u + 1) / #q)
						Y.LightEmission, Y.LightInfluence = 1, 0
						Y.FaceCamera, Y.Segments = true, 1
						Y.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
						Y.Parent = R.boltPart
						T[#T + 1] = { beam = Y, weight = h[1] == 1 and 1 or r }
					end
				end
				return T
			end
			R.strike = function(T)
				local B = R.storm
				local r = R.stormPower / 100
				local q = math.random()
				local u, s
				if q < 0.12 then
					u, s = "close", 110 + math.random() * 90
				elseif q < 0.55 then
					u, s = "mid", 260 + math.random() * 260
				else
					u, s = "far", 560 + math.random() * 420
				end
				local q = R.camera.CFrame.LookVector
				local h = math.atan2(q.Z, q.X)
				h = math.random() < 0.6 and h + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.6 or math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
				local q = T + Vector3.new(math.cos(h) * s, -6.0, math.sin(h) * s)
				local T = q
					+ Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * s * 0.15, 130 + s * 0.55, (math.random() - 0.5) * s * 0.15)
				local h = (T - q).Magnitude
				local Y = h * 0.045
				local function l(x, S, k, y)
					local Q = { x }
					for E = 1, k - 1 do
						local I = E / k
						Q[#Q + 1] = x:Lerp(S, I)
							+ Vector3.new(
								(math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * y * (1 - I * 0.3),
								(math.random() - 0.5) * y * 0.4,
								(math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * y * (1 - I * 0.3)
							)
					end
					Q[#Q + 1] = S
					return Q
				end
				local x = l(T, q, 16, Y)
				local T = math.clamp(s * 0.0065, 0.7, 4.5)
				local q = R.bolt(x, T, 0.32)
				for S = 1, 2 do
					local S = math.random(4, 11)
					local k = x[S]
					local x = k
						+ Vector3.new(
							(math.random() - 0.5) * h * 0.35,
							-h * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.14),
							(math.random() - 0.5) * h * 0.35
						)
					for h, h in ipairs(R.bolt(l(k, x, 6, Y * 0.6), T * 0.55, 0.28)) do
						q[#q + 1] = h
					end
				end
				local T = u == "close" and 0.26 or u == "mid" and 0.16 or 0.09
				B.active = { t0 = os.clock(), beams = q }
				B.flashPower = T * (0.35 + r) * (R.cameraCovered and 0.45 or 1)
				local T = u == "far" and V.thunderFar or V.thunderClose
				local r = u == "close" and 1 or u == "mid" and 0.8 or 0.6
				B.thunder[#B.thunder + 1] = {
					at = os.clock() + 0.3 + s / 430,
					id = T[math.random(1, #T)],
					volume = r,
					crack = u == "close",
				}
			end
			R.playOnce = function(T, B, r)
				if not R.sound or not R.folder then
					return
				end
				local q = Instance.new("Sound")
				q.SoundId = T
				q.Volume = B * R.soundVolume / 100
				if r then
					local T = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
					T.HighGain, T.MidGain = -16.0, -3.0
					T.Parent = q
				end
				q.Parent = R.folder
				pcall(function()
					q:Play()
				end)
				task.delay(16, function()
					pcall(function()
						q:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
			R.stormStep = function(T, B)
				local r = R.storm
				if not r then
					return
				end
				if R.thunder and R.stormPower > 0 and not r.active and T >= r.nextAt then
					R.strike(B)
					r.nextAt = T + (14 + math.random() * 30) * (1.9 - 1.6 * R.stormPower / 100)
				end
				local B = 0
				local q = r.active
				if q then
					local u = T - q.t0
					if u < 0.05 then
						B = 1
					elseif u < 0.1 then
						B = 0.25
					elseif u < 0.19 then
						B = 0.9
					elseif u < 0.55 then
						B = 0.55 * (1 - (u - 0.19) / 0.36)
					else
						for u, u in ipairs(R.boltPart:GetChildren()) do
							u:Destroy()
						end
						r.active = nil
					end
					if r.active then
						for u, u in ipairs(q.beams) do
							u.beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(B * u.weight * 1.6, 0, 1) * 0.96)
						end
					end
				end
				if R.flash then
					R.flash.Brightness = B * r.flashPower
					R.flash.TintColor = Color3.new(1 - B * 0.08, 1 - B * 0.03, 1)
				end
				for B = #r.thunder, 1, -1.0 do
					local q = r.thunder[B]
					if T >= q.at then
						R.playOnce(q.id, q.volume, R.cameraCovered)
						if q.crack then
							R.playOnce(V.crack[math.random(1, #V.crack)], 0.5, R.cameraCovered)
						end
						table.remove(r.thunder, B)
					end
				end
			end
			R.wetStore = function()
				local T = getgenv().__pulseWetStore
				if type(T) ~= "table" then
					T = {}
					getgenv().__pulseWetStore = T
				end
				return T
			end
			R.wetRestore = function()
				local T = R.wetStore()
				for B, V in pairs(T) do
					if B.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							B.Color = V[1]
							B.Reflectance = V[2]
						end)
					end
					T[B] = nil
				end
				R.wetSkip = {}
			end
			R.wetFloor = function(T)
				if T.Transparency >= 0.5 then
					return false
				end
				local B, V = T.Size, T.CFrame
				local T, r, q = B.Y, V.UpVector, math.max(B.X, B.Z)
				if B.X < T then
					T, r, q = B.X, V.RightVector, math.max(B.Y, B.Z)
				end
				if B.Z < T then
					T, r, q = B.Z, V.LookVector, math.max(B.X, B.Y)
				end
				return math.abs(r.Y) > 0.9 and T <= 6 and T < q * 0.7 and q >= 3
			end
			R.wetPaint = function(T, B, V)
				local r = R.wetness / 100 * V
				T.Color = B[1]:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.3 * r)
				T.Reflectance = math.min(B[2] + 0.26 * r, 0.4)
			end
			R.wetScan = function(T)
				local B = R.mapRoots()
				if #B == 0 then
					return
				end
				local V = R.wetStore()
				R.wetSkip = R.wetSkip or {}
				local r = OverlapParams.new()
				r.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
				r.FilterDescendantsInstances = B
				r.MaxParts = 1800
				local B = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(T, 64, r)
				local r = {}
				local q = 0
				for u, u in ipairs(B) do
					r[u] = true
					if not V[u] and not R.wetSkip[u] then
						if u:IsA("BasePart") and not u:IsA("MeshPart") and R.wetFloor(u) then
							V[u] = { u.Color, u.Reflectance }
							R.wetPaint(u, V[u], R.wetLevel)
						else
							R.wetSkip[u] = true
						end
					end
				end
				for B in pairs(R.wetSkip) do
					q += 1
					if not B.Parent then
						R.wetSkip[B] = nil
					end
				end
				if q > 6000 then
					R.wetSkip = {}
				end
				for B, q in pairs(V) do
					if not B.Parent then
						V[B] = nil
					elseif not r[B] and (B.Position - T).Magnitude > 100 then
						pcall(function()
							B.Color = q[1]
							B.Reflectance = q[2]
						end)
						V[B] = nil
					end
				end
			end
			R.wetStep = function(T, B)
				local V = R.on and R.wet and R.recipes[R.kind].wet and R.wetness > 0
				local r = V and 0.35 + 0.65 * R.amount / 100 or 0
				R.wetLevel = (R.wetLevel or 0) + (r - (R.wetLevel or 0)) * (1 - math.exp(-T / 7))
				R.wetClock = (R.wetClock or 0) + T
				if not V and R.wetLevel < 0.03 then
					if next(R.wetStore()) ~= nil then
						R.wetLevel, R.wetPainted = 0, 0
						pcall(R.wetRestore)
					end
					return
				end
				if R.wetClock < 1.3 then
					return
				end
				R.wetClock = 0
				pcall(R.wetScan, B)
				if math.abs(R.wetLevel - (R.wetPainted or 0)) > 0.04 or R.wetnessPainted ~= R.wetness then
					R.wetPainted, R.wetnessPainted = R.wetLevel, R.wetness
					for T, B in pairs(R.wetStore()) do
						if T.Parent then
							pcall(R.wetPaint, T, B, R.wetLevel)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			R.groundY = function(T)
				local B = os.clock()
				if R.groundAt and B - R.groundAt < 0.5 and R.groundValue then
					return R.groundValue
				end
				R.groundAt = B
				local B = R.cast(T + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -60.0, 0))
				R.groundValue = B and B.Position.Y or T.Y - 3
				return R.groundValue
			end
			R.settingsChanged = function()
				if R.uiSyncing then
					return
				end
				R.validate()
				R.dirty, R.probeElapsed = true, 1
				if R.renderedKind and R.renderedKind ~= R.kind then
					R.clear()
				end
				if not R.on then
					R.stop()
				end
			end
			R.setEnabled = function(T)
				if R.uiSyncing then
					return
				end
				R.on = T == true
				R.settingsChanged()
			end
			R.step = function(T)
				if R.dead then
					return
				end
				if not isAlive(a) then
					R.destroy()
					return
				end
				if not R.on then
					if R.folder then
						R.stop()
					end
					return
				end
				local B = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if B == nil then
					if R.folder then
						R.stop()
					end
					return
				end
				T = R.number(T, 0.016666666666666666, 0, 0.1)
				R.frameElapsed = R.frameElapsed + T
				if R.frameElapsed < 0.03333333333333333 then
					return
				end
				local T = R.frameElapsed
				R.frameElapsed = 0
				R.phase = R.phase + T
				R.validate()
				R.envClock = (R.envClock or 0) + T
				if R.envClock > 1 then
					R.envClock = 0
					local V = R.envDark
					R.envStep()
					if math.abs(V - R.envDark) > 0.08 then
						R.dirty = true
					end
				end
				local V = R.qualities[R.quality]
				if R.failureAt and os.clock() < R.failureAt then
					return
				end
				if
					R.camera ~= B
					or not R.folder
					or R.folder.Parent ~= B
					or R.builtKind ~= R.kind
					or R.builtQuality ~= R.quality
					or R.builtSound ~= R.sound
				then
					local r, q = pcall(R.build, B)
					if not r then
						R.stop()
						R.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
						warn("[PulseHub] weather build failed: " .. tostring(q))
						return
					end
				end
				local r = B.CFrame
				local q = L.Character
				local u = r.Position
				local s = q and q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if s and (s.Position - u).Magnitude < 70 then
					u = s.Position
				end
				local s = Vector3.new(r.LookVector.X, 0, r.LookVector.Z)
				if s.Magnitude > 0.05 then
					u = u + s.Unit * 4
				end
				R.focus = u
				if R.character ~= q or R.lastPosition and (u - R.lastPosition).Magnitude > 48 then
					R.clear()
					R.visibility, R.probeElapsed = 0, 1
					R.filter(B)
				end
				R.character, R.lastPosition = q, u
				if R.dirty then
					local B, q = pcall(R.configure)
					if not B then
						R.stop()
						R.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
						warn("[PulseHub] weather setup failed: " .. tostring(q))
						return
					end
				end
				R.renderedKind = R.kind
				local B = R.stretchSquash()
				if B ~= R.squash then
					R.applySquash(B)
				end
				local B = R.gustValue()
				local q = math.rad(R.windAngle)
				local s = Vector3.new(math.cos(q), 0, math.sin(q))
				local q = Vector3.new(-s.Z, 0, s.X)
				local h = R.groundY(u)
				for Y, Y in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					local l = Y.layer
					local x = l.base == "ground" and h + l.y or u.Y + l.y
					Y.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(u.X + (Y.gx or 0) * (Y.tile or 0), x, u.Z + (Y.gz or 0) * (Y.tile or 0))
				end
				R.probeElapsed = R.probeElapsed + T
				if R.probeElapsed >= V.probeInterval then
					R.probeElapsed = 0
					R.probe(u)
				end
				local h = R.amount == 0
				if h and not R.suspended then
					R.clear()
				end
				R.suspended = h
				local Y = h and 0 or 1
				R.visibility = R.visibility + (Y - R.visibility) * (1 - math.exp(-T * 5))
				if h then
					R.visibility = 0
				end
				local Y = R.wind * 0.3 * B * (R.speed / 100) ^ 2
				for B, B in ipairs(R.nodes) do
					local l = B.layer
					local x = math.sin(R.phase * 0.9 + B.seed) * 0.6
						+ math.sin(R.phase * 2.3 + B.seed * 1.7 + 1.7) * 0.4
					local S = math.cos(R.phase * 1.3 + B.seed * 0.7) * 0.5
					local k = l.noWind and Vector3.zero or s * Y * (l.windK or 1)
					local Y = l.sway or 0
					local y = (l.lift or 0) - (l.fall or 0)
					if l.still then
						B.emitter.Acceleration = s * (l.drift or 0.3) * R.wind * 0.1
					else
						B.emitter.Acceleration = k + q * (Y * x) + s * (Y * S * 0.5) + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
					end
					local q = R.cameraCovered and not l.noShelter
					B.emitter.Rate = (B.blocked or q) and 0 or B.rate * R.visibility
				end
				if #R.splashes > 0 and not h and not R.cameraCovered then
					R.splashBudget = R.splashBudget + T * V.splashes * (R.amount / 100) * R.visibility
					local B = math.min(math.floor(R.splashBudget), 10)
					R.splashBudget = R.splashBudget - B
					local V = r.LookVector
					for r = 1, B do
						R.splash(u, V)
					end
				else
					R.splashBudget = 0
				end
				R.audioStep(T)
				R.gradeStep(T)
				R.stormStep(os.clock(), u)
				R.wetStep(T, u)
			end
			R.reset = function()
				R.scene = ""
				R.stop()
				for T, B in pairs(R.defaults) do
					R[T] = B
				end
				if R.syncUI then
					R.syncUI()
				end
			end
			pcall(R.wetRestore)
			M(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function(T)
				local B, V = pcall(R.step, T)
				if not B then
					R.failureAt = os.clock() + 3
					pcall(R.stop)
					warn("[PulseHub] weather step failed: " .. tostring(V))
				end
			end)
			f(function()
				pcall(R.destroy)
			end)

					tlen = 6397,
					spec = {

						celestial = true,

						moon = 11,
					},
				},
				{
					key = "haze",
					name = "Golden Haze",
					look = "Golden Hour",
					tlen = 8075,
					spec = {
						faces = { 600830446, 600831635, 600832720, 600886090, 600833862, 600835177 },
						celestial = true,
						stars = 3000,
						sun = 21,
						moon = 11,
					},
				},
				{

			local B = getgenv().__pulseSkyAPI
			R.skyList = T
			R.b64 = function(T)
				for V, V in ipairs({
					crypt and crypt.base64decode,
					base64decode,
					base64_decode,
					base64 and base64.decode,
				}) do
					if type(V) == "function" then
						local r, q = pcall(V, T)
						if r and type(q) == "string" and #q > 0 then
							return q
						end
					end
				end
				local V = {}
				local r = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
				for q = 1, 64 do
					V[r:byte(q)] = q - 1
				end
				local r, q, u = {}, 0, 0
				for s = 1, #T do
					local h = V[T:byte(s)]
					if h then
						q = q * 64 + h
						u += 6
						if u >= 8 then
							u -= 8
							r[#r + 1] = string.char(math.floor(q / 2 ^ u) % 256)
							q = q % 2 ^ u
						end
					end
				end
				return table.concat(r)
			end
			R.thumbAsset = function(T)
				if T.asset ~= nil then
					return T.asset or nil
				end
				T.asset = false
				local V = type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset or nil
				if not (V and type(writefile) == "function") then
					return nil
				end
				local r, q = pcall(function()
					local u = "PulseHub"
					for s in string.gmatch("textures/weather", "[^/]+") do
						u = u .. "/" .. s
						pcall(function()
							if not isfolder(u) then
								makefolder(u)
							end
						end)
					end
					local s = u .. "/sky_" .. T.key .. "-" .. tostring(T.tlen) .. ".jpg"
					if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(s)) then
						local u = getgenv().__pulseData.take("wx_" .. T.key)
						if not u then
							T.asset = nil
							return ""
						end
						writefile(s, R.b64(u))
					end
					return V(s)
				end)
				if r and type(q) == "string" and q ~= "" then
					T.asset = q
					return q
				end
				return nil
			end

			R.setSky = function(T)
				if not B then
					return
				end
				if T == nil or T == "" then
					pcall(B.clear)
				else
					pcall(B.activate, T, true)
				end
				R.skyKey = B.active and B.active() or nil
				if R.paintSkies then
					pcall(R.paintSkies)
				end
			end
			R.takeLook = function(T)
				if not R.lookByWeather then
					R.prevLook = { preset = _.preset, on = _.on }
				end
				pcall(_.applyPreset, T)
				R.lookByWeather = true
			end
			R.restoreLook = function()
				if not R.lookByWeather then
					return
				end
				R.lookByWeather = false
				local T = R.prevLook
				R.prevLook = nil
				if T and T.on and T.preset and T.preset ~= "Original" then
					pcall(_.applyPreset, T.preset)
				else
					pcall(_.resetLook)
					pcall(_.setEnabled, false)
				end
			end
			R.pickSky = function(T)
				if B and B.active and B.active() == T then
					R.setSky(nil)
					if R.matchLight then
						R.restoreLook()
					end
					return
				end
				R.setSky(T)
				if R.matchLight then
					for V, V in ipairs(R.skyList) do
						if V.key == T and V.look then
							R.takeLook(V.look)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			R.applyScene = function(T)
				local V
				for r, r in ipairs(R.scenes) do
					if r.name == T then
						V = r
						break
					end
				end
				if not V then
					return
				end
				R.stop()
				local r = {
					quality = true,
					shelter = true,
					sound = true,
					soundVolume = true,
					wet = true,
					wetness = true,
					grade = true,
					matchLight = true,
					radius = true,
					scale = true,
					ripples = true,
					gusts = true,
				}
				for _, q in pairs(R.defaults) do
					if not r[_] and not string.find(_, "olour", 1, true) then
						R[_] = q
					end
				end
				R.scene = T
				if V.weather then
					R.on = true
					for T, r in pairs(V.weather) do
						R[T] = r
					end
				else
					R.on = false
				end
				R.settingsChanged()
				if V.sky then
					R.setSky(V.sky)
				end
				if V.look then
					R.takeLook(V.look)
				end
				do
					local T = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkyFx")
					if type(T) == "table" then
						if V.fx then
							pcall(T.scene, V.fx)
						else
							pcall(T.sceneEnd)
						end
					end
				end
				if R.syncUI then
					R.syncUI()
				end
				if R.paintScenes then
					pcall(R.paintScenes)
				end
			end
			R.clearScene = function()
				do
					local T = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkyFx")
					if type(T) == "table" then
						pcall(T.sceneEnd)
					end
				end
				R.scene = ""
				R.on = false
				R.settingsChanged()
				R.setSky(nil)
				R.restoreLook()
				if R.syncUI then
					R.syncUI()
				end
				if R.paintScenes then
					pcall(R.paintScenes)
				end
			end

					local function Q(E, I, C)
						local H = math.clamp(E:Dot(I), -1.0, 1)
						local n = math.acos(H)
						if n < 0.0001 then
							return E
						end
						local H = math.sin(n)
						return E * (math.sin((1 - C) * n) / H) + I * (math.sin(C * n) / H)
					end
					local function E(I, C)
						local H = Instance.new("Part")
						H.Name = C
						H.Anchored, H.CanCollide, H.CanTouch, H.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
						H.CastShadow, H.Transparency = false, 1
						H.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
						H.Locked = true
						H.Parent = I
						return H
					end
					local function I(C, H)
						local n = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
						n.Enabled = false
						n.Rate = 0
						n.Texture = H.tex
						n.LightEmission = H.light or 1
						n.LightInfluence = 0
						n.Brightness = H.bright or 2
						n.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(H.life[1], H.life[2] or H.life[1])
						n.Speed =
							NumberRange.new(H.speed and H.speed[1] or 0, H.speed and (H.speed[2] or H.speed[1]) or 0)
						n.LockedToPart = H.locked == true
						n.Orientation = H.orient or Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
						n.ZOffset = H.z or 0
						n.Drag = H.drag or 0
						n.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
						n.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
						if H.accel then
							n.Acceleration = H.accel
						end
						if H.spread then
							n.SpreadAngle = H.spread
						end
						n.Parent = C
						return n
					end
					local function C(H)
						local n = Instance.new("Attachment")
						n.Parent = H
						return n
					end
					local function H(n, O, N, z)
						local D = Instance.new("Beam")
						D.Attachment0, D.Attachment1 = O, N
						D.FaceCamera = z.face ~= false
						D.LightEmission, D.LightInfluence = 1, 0
						D.Brightness = z.bright or 2
						D.Segments = z.seg or 1
						D.Width0, D.Width1 = z.w0 or 1, z.w1 or 1
						D.Texture = z.tex or ""
						D.TextureMode = z.mode or Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
						D.ZOffset = z.z or 0
						D.Enabled = z.enabled ~= false
						D.Parent = n
						return D
					end
					local function n(O, N)
						local z = N and q.sq or 0
						local N = NumberSequence.new(z)
						for z, z in ipairs(O) do
							pcall(function()
								z.Squash = N
							end)
						end
					end
					local function O()
						return (q.cfg.general.bright or 100) / 100
					end
					local N = {}
					local function z(D, b, Z)
						b = math.floor(math.clamp(b, 0, 1) * 24 + 0.5) / 24
						local P = D .. b
						local D = N[P]
						if not D then
							D = Z(b)
							N[P] = D
						end
						return D
					end
					q.radius = function()
						local N = r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
						local D
						if N then
							D = 72 / math.max(N.Density, 0.04)
						else
							D = r.FogEnd * 0.5
						end
						return math.clamp(D, 110, 520)
					end
					q.squashNow = function()
						local r = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseWeather")
						if r and type(r.stretchSquash) == "function" then
							local N, D = pcall(r.stretchSquash)
							if N and type(D) == "number" then
								return math.max(D, 0)
							end
						end
						return 0
					end

								{

								},

							r.big.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.12, 0.05 }, { 0.88, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } })

							end

							r.big.Rotation = D and NumberRange.new(0, 0) or NumberRange.new(-20.0, 20)
							r.big.RotSpeed = D and NumberRange.new(0, 0) or NumberRange.new(-12.0, 12)

										end)
										Z.ion[2].Transparency = z("ci2", r, function(Q)
											return Y({ { 0, 1 - 0.3 * Q }, { 1, 1 } })
										end)

								end
							end
						end,
						drop = function(r)
							for Q, Q in ipairs(r.pool or {}) do
								pcall(function()
									Q.head:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							if r.anchor then
								r.anchor:Destroy()
							end
							r.anchor, r.pool = nil, nil
						end,
					}
					q.fx.net = {
						build = function(r, Q, N)
							r.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
							r.folder.Name = "Net"
							r.folder.Parent = Q
							r.anchor = E(r.folder, "NetAnchor")
							r.anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new()
							r.shell = E(r.folder, "NetShell")
							r.fig = {
								I(r.shell, { tex = _.const1, life = { 9, 13 }, locked = true, bright = 1.8 }),
								I(r.shell, { tex = _.const2, life = { 9, 13 }, locked = true, bright = 1.8 }),
							}
							for Q, Q in ipairs(r.fig) do
								Q.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere
								Q.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface
								Q.ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward
								Q.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
								pcall(function()
									Q.ShapePartial = 0.4
								end)
							end
							r.cursor = C(r.anchor)
							r.nodes, r.links, r.sparks, r.active = {}, {}, {}, {}
							r.place = nil
							r.linkClock, r.sparkClock, r.colClock, r.flashClock = 1, 0, 1, 0
						end,
						rebuild = function(r, Q)
							for N, N in ipairs(r.nodes) do
								pcall(function()
									N.p:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							for N, N in ipairs(r.links) do
								pcall(function()
									N.b:Destroy()
									N.f:Destroy()
									N.tip:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							for N, N in ipairs(r.sparks) do
								pcall(function()
									N.p:Destroy()
								end)
							end
							r.nodes, r.links, r.sparks, r.active = {}, {}, {}, {}
							local N = q.cfg.net
							local D = math.clamp(math.floor(N.nodes), 8, 140)
							r.place = N.place
							local b = N.place ~= "Around me"
							local N = y(Q)
							for y = 1, D do
								local Z = { flash = 0, hue = u:NextNumber(), shade = s(0, 0.5) }
								Z.p = E(r.folder, "Node")
								Z.a = C(Z.p)
								Z.big = (y % 6 == 0)
								Z.e = I(
									Z.p,
									{ tex = Z.big and _.spark or _.dot, life = { 12 }, locked = true, bright = 2.8 }
								)
								Z.e.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.15, 0 }, { 0.85, 0 }, { 1, 1 } })
								Z.nextEmit = Q.t + s(0, 6)
								if b then
									Z.az = u:NextNumber() < 0.75 and N + s(-1.25, 1.25) or s(0, 6.283185307179586)
									Z.el = math.rad(s(14, 72))
									Z.vaz = s(-1.0, 1) * 0.022
									Z.vel = s(-1.0, 1) * 0.014
								else
									Z.rel = Vector3.new(s(-44.0, 44), s(-10.0, 14), s(-44.0, 44))
									Z.vel = Vector3.new(s(-1.0, 1), s(-0.4, 0.4), s(-1.0, 1))
								end
								r.nodes[y] = Z
							end
							for y = 1, D * 2 + 6 do
								local Q = { tip = C(r.anchor), on = false, grow = 0, target = 0 }
								Q.b = H(
									r.anchor,
									nil,
									Q.tip,
									{ w0 = 1, w1 = 1, bright = 1.8, tex = _.beam, enabled = false, seg = 6 }
								)
								Q.f = H(
									r.anchor,
									nil,
									Q.tip,
									{
										w0 = 1,
										w1 = 1,
										bright = 3,
										tex = _.rays,
										mode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap,
										enabled = false,
									}
								)
								r.links[y] = Q
							end
							for y = 1, 16 do
								local Q = { on = false }
								Q.p = E(r.folder, "Spark")
								Q.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000.0, 0)
								Q.e = I(Q.p, { tex = _.spark, life = { 30 }, locked = true, bright = 3.2 })
								Q.g = I(Q.p, { tex = _.soft, life = { 30 }, locked = true, bright = 1.6 })
								r.sparks[y] = Q
							end
							r.N = D
						end,
						nodeColor = function(r, r, y)
							local Q = q.cfg.net
							if Q.rainbow then
								return Color3.fromHSV((r.hue + y * 0.05) % 1, 0.6, 1)
							end
							return S(Q.color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), r.shade)
						end,
						apply = function(r, y)
							local Q = q.cfg.net
							if r.place ~= Q.place or r.N ~= math.clamp(math.floor(Q.nodes), 8, 140) then
								r:rebuild(y)
							end
							local C = y.R
							local H = Q.place ~= "Around me"
							local N = O()
							local D = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
							for b, b in ipairs(r.nodes) do
								b.s = H and C * (b.big and 0.06 or 0.036) or (b.big and 1.7 or 1)
								b.e.Size = NumberSequence.new(b.s)
								b.e.Color = ColorSequence.new(S(r:nodeColor(b, y.t), D, 0.45))
								b.e.Brightness = 2.8 * N
								n({ b.e }, true)
								if not b.seeded then
									b.seeded = true
									b.e:Emit(1)
								end
							end
							r.w = (H and C * 0.0075 or 0.16) * q.kb
							r.dash = H and C * 0.2 or 7
							for y, y in ipairs(r.links) do
								y.b.Width0, y.b.Width1 = r.w, r.w
								y.f.Width0, y.f.Width1 = r.w * 1.9, r.w * 1.9
								y.f.TextureLength = r.dash
								y.f.TextureSpeed = 0.35 + 0.6 * Q.speed / 100
								y.b.Brightness, y.f.Brightness = 1.8 * N, 5 * N
								y.tq = nil
								if y.on then
									y.f.Enabled = Q.pulses == true
								end
							end
							for y, y in ipairs(r.sparks) do
								y.e.Size = NumberSequence.new(H and C * 0.032 or 0.85)
								y.g.Size = NumberSequence.new(H and C * 0.05 or 1.3)
								y.e.Brightness, y.g.Brightness = 3.2 * N, 1.6 * N
								n({ y.e, y.g }, true)
							end
							r.shell.Size = Vector3.one * math.min(C * 1.9, 2040)
							for y, y in ipairs(r.fig) do
								y.Size = NumberSequence.new(C * 0.2)
								y.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.25, 0.3 }, { 0.75, 0.3 }, { 1, 1 } })
								y.Color = ColorSequence.new(S(Q.color, D, 0.4))
								y.Brightness = 1.8 * N
								y.Rate = 0.06
								y.Enabled = H and Q.figures == true
								n({ y }, true)
							end
							r.reachDot = math.cos(math.rad(5 + 20 * Q.reach / 100))
							r.reachSt = 10 + 24 * Q.reach / 100
							r.linkClock, r.colClock = 1, 1
						end,
						freeLink = function(r)
							for y, y in ipairs(r.links) do
								if not y.on then
									return y
								end
							end
						end,
						link = function(r, y, Q, C, H)
							local N = r.active[y]
							if N then
								N.target = 1
								N.seen = true
								return N
							end
							N = r:freeLink()
							if not N then
								return nil
							end
							local D = r.nodes[Q]
							N.on, N.grow, N.target, N.seen, N.key, N.landed = true, 0, 1, true, y, false
							N.ia, N.ib, N.cur = Q, C, H
							N.b.Attachment0, N.f.Attachment0 = D.a, D.a
							N.tip.Position = D.wp
							N.b.Enabled = true
							N.f.Enabled = q.cfg.net.pulses == true
							N.tq = nil
							r.active[y] = N
							if not H then
								D.flash = math.max(D.flash, 0.5)
							end
							return N
						end,
						step = function(r, y)
							local Q = q.cfg.net
							local C = Q.place ~= "Around me"
							local H = y.R * 0.92
							local N = Q.speed / 100
							local D = y.dt
							local b = y.me + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
							r.shell.CFrame = CFrame.new(y.pos)
							local Z, P
							if Q.cursor ~= false then
								local i = game:GetService("UserInputService")
								local d = y.cam.ViewportSize
								local g, o = d.X / 2, d.Y / 2
								if i.MouseEnabled then
									local d = i:GetMouseLocation()
									g, o = d.X, d.Y
								end
								local i = y.cam:ViewportPointToRay(g, o)
								if C then
									if i.Direction.Y > -0.05 then
										P = i.Direction.Unit
										Z = y.pos + P * H
									end
								else
									Z = i.Origin + i.Direction.Unit * 26
								end
							end
							if Z then
								r.cursor.Position = Z
							end
							local i, d
							if P then
								i = math.atan2(P.Z, P.X)
								d = math.asin(math.clamp(P.Y, -1.0, 1))
							end
							local g = math.acos(r.reachDot)
							for o, o in ipairs(r.nodes) do
								if C then
									o.az += o.vaz * N * D
									o.el += o.vel * N * D
									if P then
										local p = (i - o.az + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793
										local i = d - o.el
										local d = math.sqrt(p * p * math.cos(o.el) ^ 2 + i * i)
										if d < g * 1.4 and d > g * 0.35 then
											local m = (1 - d / (g * 1.4)) * 0.35 * D
											o.az += p * m
											o.el += i * m
										end
									end
									if o.el < 0.20943951023931956 then
										o.vel = math.abs(o.vel)
									elseif o.el > 1.2915436464758039 then
										o.vel = -math.abs(o.vel)
									end
									o.dir = k(o.az, o.el)
									o.wp = y.pos + o.dir * H
								else
									o.rel += o.vel * (2.5 * N * D)
									if Z then
										local k = Z - b - o.rel
										local H = k.Magnitude
										if H < r.reachSt * 1.4 and H > 5 then
											o.rel += k.Unit * (1 - H / (r.reachSt * 1.4)) * 6 * D
										end
									end
									local k = o.rel
									if math.abs(k.X) > 44 then
										o.vel = Vector3.new(-math.sign(k.X) * math.abs(o.vel.X), o.vel.Y, o.vel.Z)
									end
									if k.Y < -10.0 or k.Y > 14 then
										o.vel =
											Vector3.new(o.vel.X, (k.Y < 0 and 1 or -1.0) * math.abs(o.vel.Y), o.vel.Z)
									end
									if math.abs(k.Z) > 44 then
										o.vel = Vector3.new(o.vel.X, o.vel.Y, -math.sign(k.Z) * math.abs(o.vel.Z))
									end
									o.wp = b + o.rel
								end
								o.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(o.wp)
								if y.t >= o.nextEmit then
									o.nextEmit = y.t + 6
									o.e:Emit(1)
								end
							end
							local k = r.nodes
							local H = #k
							r.linkClock += D
							if r.linkClock >= 0.05 then
								r.linkClock = 0
								for N, N in pairs(r.active) do
									N.seen = false
								end
								local N = {}
								for b = 1, H do
									local i = k[b]
									for d = b + 1, H do
										local o = k[d]
										local p
										if C then
											local m = i.dir:Dot(o.dir)
											if m > r.reachDot then
												p = (m - r.reachDot) / (1 - r.reachDot)
											end
										else
											local m = (i.wp - o.wp).Magnitude
											if m < r.reachSt then
												p = 1 - m / r.reachSt
											end
										end
										if p and (N[b] or 0) < 4 and (N[d] or 0) < 4 then
											N[b], N[d] = (N[b] or 0) + 1, (N[d] or 0) + 1
											local N = r:link(b * 1000 + d, b, d, false)
											if N then
												N.q = p
											end
										end
									end
								end
								if Z then
									local N = {}
									for b = 1, H do
										local H = k[b]
										local i
										if C then
											local C = H.dir:Dot(P)
											local P = math.cos(math.min(g * 1.3, 1.5707963267948966))
											if C > P then
												i = (C - P) / (1 - P)
											end
										else
											local C = (H.wp - Z).Magnitude
											if C < r.reachSt * 1.3 then
												i = 1 - C / (r.reachSt * 1.3)
											end
										end
										if i then
											N[#N + 1] = { i = b, q = i }
										end
									end
									table.sort(N, function(C, H)
										return C.q > H.q
									end)
									for C = 1, math.min(6, #N) do
										local H = r:link(-N[C].i, N[C].i, nil, true)
										if H then
											H.q = N[C].q
										end
									end
								end
								for C, C in pairs(r.active) do
									if not C.seen then
										C.target = 0
									end
								end
							end
							local C = false
							r.colClock += D
							if r.colClock >= 0.1 then
								r.colClock = 0
								C = true
							end
							for H, N in pairs(r.active) do
								local b = N.target > N.grow and 3.2 or 4.5
								N.grow = math.clamp(
									N.grow
										+ (N.target - N.grow) * math.min(1, b * D)
										+ (N.target > N.grow and 0.6 or -0.6) * D,
				0,
									1
								)
								local b = k[N.ia]
								local P = N.cur and (Z or b.wp) or k[N.ib].wp
								if N.grow <= 0.001 and N.target == 0 then
									N.on = false
									N.b.Enabled, N.f.Enabled = false, false
									r.active[H] = nil
									if not N.cur then
										local H = k[N.ib]
										if H then
											H.flash = math.max(H.flash, 0.15)
										end
									end
								else
									N.tip.Position = b.wp:Lerp(P, N.grow)
									if N.grow > 0.98 and not N.landed and not N.cur then
										N.landed = true
										local H = k[N.ib]
										if H then
											H.flash = math.max(H.flash, 0.7)
										end
									elseif N.grow < 0.9 then
										N.landed = false
									end
									local H = math.clamp((N.q or 0) * 1.7, 0, 1) * (0.35 + 0.65 * N.grow)
									if N.cur then
										H = H * 0.8
									end
									local Z = math.floor(H * 14 + 0.5)
									if N.tq ~= Z then
										N.tq = Z
										local H = Q.pulses ~= false and 0.72 or 1
										N.b.Transparency = z("nl" .. H, Z / 14, function(P)
											return Y({
												{ 0, 1 - 0.9 * P * H },
												{ 0.5, 1 - 0.6 * P * H },
												{
				1,
													1 - 0.9 * P * H,
												},
											})
										end)
										N.f.Transparency = z("nf", Z / 14, function(H)
											return Y({
												{ 0, 1 },
												{ 0.12, 1 - 0.95 * H },
												{ 0.88, 1 - 0.95 * H },
												{
				1, 1,
												},
											})
										end)
									end
									if C then
										local H = r:nodeColor(b, y.t)
										local z = N.cur and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or r:nodeColor(k[N.ib], y.t)
										N.b.Color = l({ { 0, H }, { 1, z } })
										N.f.Color = l({
											{ 0, S(H, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65) },
											{ 1, S(z, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65) },
										})
									end
								end
							end
							if Q.pulses ~= false then
								r.sparkClock += D
								if r.sparkClock >= 0.12 then
									r.sparkClock = 0
									local l = {}
									for H, H in pairs(r.active) do
										if H.grow > 0.95 and not H.cur and H.target == 1 then
											l[#l + 1] = H
										end
									end
									if #l > 0 then
										for H, H in ipairs(r.sparks) do
											if not H.on then
												local N = l[u:NextInteger(1, #l)]
												local l = u:NextNumber() < 0.5
												H.on, H.t0, H.dur = true, y.t, s(0.5, 0.95)
												H.from, H.to = l and N.ia or N.ib, l and N.ib or N.ia
												local u = S(r:nodeColor(k[H.to], y.t), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
												H.e.Color, H.g.Color = ColorSequence.new(u), ColorSequence.new(u)
												H.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(k[H.from].wp)
												H.e:Emit(1)
												H.g:Emit(1)
												break
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
							for u, u in ipairs(r.sparks) do
								if u.on then
									local s = (y.t - u.t0) / u.dur
									local l, H = k[u.from], k[u.to]
									if s >= 1 or not l or not H then
										u.on = false
										u.e:Clear()
										u.g:Clear()
										u.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000.0, 0)
										if H then
											H.flash = 1
										end
									else
										local N = s * s * (3 - 2 * s)
										u.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(l.wp:Lerp(H.wp, N))
									end
								end
							end
							r.flashClock += D
							if r.flashClock >= 0.06666666666666667 then
								local u = r.flashClock
								r.flashClock = 0
								local s = O()
								for l, l in ipairs(k) do
									if l.flash > 0.01 or l.fs then
										l.flash = math.max(0, l.flash - u * 1.6)
										local u = l.flash
										l.e.Size = NumberSequence.new(l.s * (1 + 1.3 * u))
										l.e.Brightness = 2.8 * s * (1 + 1.2 * u)
										l.fs = u > 0.01
									end
									if C and Q.rainbow then
										l.e.Color = ColorSequence.new(S(r:nodeColor(l, y.t), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45))
									end
								end
							end
						end,
						drop = function(r)
							if r.folder then
								r.folder:Destroy()
							end
							r.folder, r.anchor, r.shell, r.fig, r.nodes, r.links, r.sparks, r.active, r.place, r.N, r.cursor =
								nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
						end,
					}
					q.fx.runes = {
						build = function(r, u)
							r.p = E(u, "Runes")
							r.p.Size = Vector3.new(80, 22, 80)
							r.e = I(
								r.p,
								{ tex = _.runes, life = { 6, 10 }, bright = 2.6, speed = { 0.5, 1.5 }, drag = 0.3 }
							)
							r.e.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
							r.e.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
							r.e.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
							r.e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
							r.e.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4
							r.e.FlipbookMode = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
							r.e.FlipbookFramerate = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
							r.e.FlipbookStartRandom = true
							r.glow = I(r.p, { tex = _.dot, life = { 3, 6 }, bright = 2, speed = { 0.3, 1 } })
							r.glow.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
							r.glow.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
							r.glow.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
							r.filled = false
						end,
						apply = function(r, u)
							local u = q.cfg.runes
							local s = u.size / 100
							local l = O()
							local S = 1.7 * s
							r.e.Texture = u.set == "Glyphs" and _.glyphs or _.runes
							r.e.Size = h({ { 0, S * 0.6 }, { 0.15, S }, { 0.85, S }, { 1, S * 0.8 } })
							r.e.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.15, 0.05 }, { 0.75, 0.15 }, { 1, 1 } })
							r.e.Color = ColorSequence.new(u.color)
							r.e.Brightness = 2.6 * l
							r.e.Rate = u.amount * 0.32
							r.e.Enabled = u.amount > 0
							local S = q.sq > 0.05
							r.e.Rotation = S and NumberRange.new(0, 0) or NumberRange.new(-10.0, 10)
							r.glow.Size = h({ { 0, 0.5 * s }, { 1, 0 } })
							r.glow.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 0.3 }, { 1, 1 } })
							r.glow.Color = ColorSequence.new(u.color)
							r.glow.Brightness = 2 * l
							r.glow.Rate = u.amount * 0.3
							r.glow.Enabled = u.amount > 0
							n({ r.e, r.glow }, true)
							if not r.filled and u.amount > 0 then
								r.filled = true
								r.e:Emit(math.floor(u.amount * 1.6))
							end
						end,
						step = function(r, u)
							r.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(u.me + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0))
						end,
						drop = function(r)
							if r.p then
								r.p:Destroy()
							end
							r.p = nil
						end,
					}
					q.fx.dust = {
						build = function(r, u)
							r.p = E(u, "Stardust")
							r.p.Size = Vector3.new(90, 30, 90)
							r.a = I(r.p, {
								tex = _.spark,
								life = { 4, 8 },
								bright = 2.6,
								speed = { 0.1, 0.5 },
								spread = Vector2.new(180, 180),
								accel = Vector3.new(0, -0.15, 0),
							})
							r.b = I(r.p, {
								tex = _.dot,
								life = { 3, 7 },
								bright = 2.2,
								speed = { 0.1, 0.4 },
								spread = Vector2.new(180, 180),
								accel = Vector3.new(0, -0.1, 0),
							})
							for _, _ in ipairs({ r.a, r.b }) do
								_.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
								_.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
							end
							r.filled = false
						end,
						apply = function(r, _)
							local _ = q.cfg.dust
							local u = O()
							r.a.Size = h({
								{ 0, 0 },
								{ 0.15, 0.75 },
								{ 0.3, 0.26249999999999996 },
								{ 0.45, 0.75 },
								{ 0.6, 0.30000000000000004 },
								{ 0.78, 0.75 },
								{ 1, 0 },
							})
							r.a.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.12, 0 }, { 0.85, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } })
							r.b.Size = h({ { 0, 0.38 }, { 1, 0.14 } })
							r.b.Transparency = Y({ { 0, 1 }, { 0.15, 0.1 }, { 0.5, 0.5 }, { 0.75, 0.1 }, { 1, 1 } })
							if _.palette == "Rainbow" then
								r.a.Color = x(0)
								r.b.Color = x(0.4)
							else
								local s = q.palettes.dust[_.palette] or q.palettes.dust.Gold
								r.a.Color = ColorSequence.new(s[1])
								r.b.Color = ColorSequence.new(s[2])
							end
							r.a.Brightness, r.b.Brightness = 3.2 * u, 2.6 * u
							r.a.Rate, r.b.Rate = _.amount * 0.9, _.amount * 1.1
							r.a.Enabled, r.b.Enabled = _.amount > 0, _.amount > 0
							local u = q.sq > 0.05
							r.a.Rotation = u and NumberRange.new(0, 0) or NumberRange.new(0, 45)
							r.a.RotSpeed = u and NumberRange.new(0, 0) or NumberRange.new(-30.0, 30)
							n({ r.a, r.b }, true)
							if not r.filled and _.amount > 0 then
								r.filled = true
								r.a:Emit(math.floor(_.amount * 3))
								r.b:Emit(math.floor(_.amount * 3))
							end
						end,
						step = function(r, _)
							r.p.CFrame = CFrame.new(_.me + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0))
						end,
						drop = function(r)
							if r.p then
								r.p:Destroy()
							end
							r.p = nil
						end,
					}
					q.dirtyAll = function()
						for r, r in ipairs(q.order) do
							q.fx[r].dirty = true
						end
					end
					q.set = function(r, _, u)
						local s = q.cfg[r]
						if not s then
							return
						end
						s[_] = u
						if r == "general" then
							q.dirtyAll()
							return
						end
						q.fx[r].dirty = true
						if q.onChange then
							pcall(q.onChange, r, _, u)
						end
					end
					q.ensure = function(r)
						if q.folder and q.folder.Parent == r then
							return
						end
						q.dropAll()
						local _ = Instance.new("Folder")
						_.Name = "PulseSkyFX"
						_.Parent = r
						q.folder = _
					end
					q.dropAll = function()
						for r, r in ipairs(q.order) do
							local _ = q.fx[r]
							if _.live then
								pcall(_.drop, _)
								_.live = false
							end
						end
						if q.folder then
							pcall(function()
								q.folder:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						q.folder = nil
					end
					q.step = function(r)
						if q.dead then
							return
						end
						if not V() then
							q.destroy()
							return
						end
						local V = false
						for _, _ in ipairs(q.order) do
							if q.cfg[_].on then
								V = true
								break
							end
						end
						local _ = workspace.CurrentCamera
						if not V or not _ then
							if q.folder then
								q.dropAll()
							end
							return
						end
						q.ensure(_)
						r = math.clamp(r or 0.016666666666666666, 0, 0.1)
						q.t += r
						q.envClock += r
						if q.envClock > 0.5 then
							q.envClock = 0
							local V = q.radius()
							if math.abs(V - q.R) / q.R > 0.08 then
								q.R = V
								q.dirtyAll()
							end
							local V = q.squashNow()
							if math.abs(V - q.sq) > 0.02 then
								q.sq = V
								q.ky = 2 ^ -V
								q.kb = 1 / q.ky
								q.dirtyAll()
							end
						end
						local V = q.ctx
						V.cam, V.dt, V.t, V.R = _, r, q.t, q.R
						V.pos = _.CFrame.Position
						V.look = _.CFrame.LookVector
						local r = B.Character
						local B = r and r:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						V.me = B and B.Position or V.pos
						for B, B in ipairs(q.order) do
							local r = q.fx[B]
							local _ = q.cfg[B].on
							if _ and not r.live and not (r.failAt and q.t < r.failAt) then
								local u, s = pcall(r.build, r, q.folder, V)
								if u then
									r.live, r.dirty = true, true
								else
									r.failAt = q.t + 5
									pcall(r.drop, r)
									warn("[PulseHub] sky fx " .. B .. ": " .. tostring(s))
								end
							elseif not _ and r.live then
								pcall(r.drop, r)
								r.live = false
							end
							if r.live then
								if r.dirty then
									r.dirty = false
									local _, u = pcall(r.apply, r, V)
									if not _ then
										warn("[PulseHub] sky fx " .. B .. ": " .. tostring(u))
									end
								end
								local _, u = pcall(r.step, r, V)
								if not _ then
									r.failAt = q.t + 5
									pcall(r.drop, r)
									r.live = false
									warn("[PulseHub] sky fx " .. B .. ": " .. tostring(u))
								end
							end
						end
					end
					q.destroy = function()
						q.dead = true
						pcall(q.dropAll)
						if q.conn then
							pcall(function()
								q.conn:Disconnect()
							end)
						end
					end
					q.conn = c(R.RenderStepped, function(R)
						local B, c = pcall(q.step, R)
						if not B then
							warn("[PulseHub] sky fx step: " .. tostring(c))
						end
					end)
					return q
				end
			end)()({ lp = L, pconn = M, pAlive = getUpvalue(a) })

				pcall(T.destroy)
			end)

				if T.photoAsset == nil then
					T.photoAsset = false
					pcall(function()
						if not T.ATLAS or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
							return
						end
						if
							type(isfolder) == "function"
							and type(makefolder) == "function"
							and not isfolder("PulseHub")
						then
							makefolder("PulseHub")
						end
						if not (type(isfile) == "function" and isfile("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg")) then
							writefile("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg", F(T.ATLAS))
						end
						local F = getcustomasset("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg")
						if type(F) == "string" and #F > 0 then
							T.photoAsset = F

					end)

					return
