		do
			local F = (function()
				local T = game:GetService("RunService")
				local R = Enum.Material
				local B = {
					["ForceField"] = { m = R.ForceField },
					["Hologram"] = { m = R.ForceField, clean = true, edge = true },
					["Flat"] = { m = R.SmoothPlastic, clean = true },
					["Neon"] = { m = R.Neon, clean = true },
					["Glow"] = { m = R.Neon, clean = true, edge = true },
					["Glass"] = { m = R.Glass, clean = true, r = 0.25, t = 0.35 },
					["Crystal"] = { m = R.Glass, clean = true, r = 0.5, t = 0.55, edge = true },
					["Chrome"] = { m = R.SmoothPlastic, clean = true, r = 0.6 },
					["Metallic"] = { m = R.Foil, clean = true, r = 0.3 },
					["Ice"] = { m = R.Ice, clean = true, r = 0.2, t = 0.15 },
					["Lava"] = { m = R.CrackedLava, clean = true },
					["Ghost"] = { m = R.SmoothPlastic, clean = true, r = 0.1, t = 0.6, edge = true },
					["Wireframe"] = { m = R.ForceField, clean = true, t = 0.85, wire = true },
					["Silhouette"] = { fill = 0, edge = true },
					["Tint"] = { fill = 0.5 },
					["Outline"] = { edge = true },
				}
				local R = {
					"ForceField",
					"Hologram",
					"Flat",
					"Neon",
					"Glow",
					"Glass",
					"Crystal",
					"Chrome",
					"Metallic",
					"Ice",
					"Lava",
					"Ghost",
					"Wireframe",
					"Silhouette",
					"Tint",
					"Outline",
				}
				local c = {
					"None",
					"Pulse",
					"Breathe",
					"Fade",
					"Flash",
					"Rainbow",
					"Wave",
					"Gradient",
				}
				local V = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				local function r(_, q)
					if type(_) == "table" and tonumber(_.r) and tonumber(_.g) and tonumber(_.b) then
						return Color3.fromRGB(_.r, _.g, _.b)
					end
					return q
				end
				local function _(q)
					return {
						r = math.floor(q.R * 255 + 0.5),
						g = math.floor(q.G * 255 + 0.5),
						b = math.floor(q.B * 255 + 0.5),
					}
				end
				local q = r(w.chamsCol, Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255))
				if type(w.chamsCfg) ~= "table" then
					w.chamsCfg = {}
				end
				local u = {}
				for s, s in ipairs({ "self", "tool" }) do
					local h = type(w.chamsCfg[s]) == "table" and w.chamsCfg[s] or {}
					w.chamsCfg[s] = h
					u[s] = {
						on = false,
						col = r(h.c, q),
						col2 = r(h.c2, V),
						style = B[tostring(h.style)] and h.style or "ForceField",
						anim = table.find(c, tostring(h.anim)) and h.anim or "None",
						speed = math.clamp(tonumber(h.speed) or 100, 10, 300),
						alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(h.alpha) or 0, 0, 90),
						sv = h,
					}
				end
				local function q(s)
					local h = u[s]
					local Y = h.sv
					Y.c, Y.c2 = _(h.col), _(h.col2)
					Y.style, Y.anim, Y.speed, Y.alpha = h.style, h.anim, h.speed, h.alpha
					w.chamsCfg[s] = Y
					if s == "self" then
						w.chamsCol = _(h.col)
					end
				end
				local _, s, h = {}, {}, {}
				local Y, l, x = {}, {}, {}
				local S
				local k = os.clock()
				local y = false
				local function Q()
					local E = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if S and S.Parent == E then
						return S
					end
					if S then
						pcall(function()
							S:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					S = Instance.new("Folder")
					S.Name = "PulseSelfChams"
					S.Parent = E
					return S
				end
				local function E(I, C)
					if typeof(I) == "Color3" and typeof(C) == "Color3" then
						return math.abs(I.R - C.R) < 0.004
							and math.abs(I.G - C.G) < 0.004
							and math.abs(I.B - C.B) < 0.004
					end
					if type(I) == "number" and type(C) == "number" then
						return math.abs(I - C) < 0.002
					end
					return I == C
				end
				local function I(C, H, n, O)
					local N = C[n]
					local z = H.w[n]
					if z == nil or not E(N, z) then
						H.o[n] = N
					end
					if type(O) == "function" then
						O = O(H.o[n])
					end
					if O == nil then
						H.w[n] = nil
						return
					end
					if not E(N, O) then
						C[n] = O
					end
					H.w[n] = O
				end
				local function C(H, n, O)
					if not E(H[n], O) then
						H[n] = O
					end
				end
				local function H(n, O)
					if O.cloth then
						if n.Parent == nil and O.par and O.par.Parent then
							n.Parent = O.par
						end
						return
					end
					if not n.Parent then
						return
					end
					for N, z in pairs(O.o) do
						local D = O.w[N]
						if D ~= nil then
							pcall(function()
								if E(n[N], D) then
									n[N] = z
								end
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				local function E(n, O, N)
					local z, D, b = n.col, n.col2, n.anim
					local Z = O * n.speed / 100
					if b == "Pulse" then
						local n, O, P = z:ToHSV()
						return Color3.fromHSV(n, O, P * (0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(Z * 4)))), 0
					elseif b == "Breathe" then
						return z, 0.7 * (0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(Z * 3))
					elseif b == "Fade" then
						return z:Lerp(D, 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(Z * 2.5)), 0
					elseif b == "Flash" then
						return math.floor(Z * 5) % 2 == 0 and z or D, 0
					elseif b == "Rainbow" or b == "Wave" then
						local n, n, O = z:ToHSV()
						local P = b == "Wave" and Z * 0.35 - N * 0.08 or Z * 0.25
						return Color3.fromHSV(P % 1, math.max(n, 0.55), math.max(O, 0.8)), 0
					elseif b == "Gradient" then
						return D:Lerp(z, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(Z * 2.2 - N * 0.8)), 0
					end
					return z, 0
				end
				local function n(O, N, z, D)
					return 1 - (1 - O) * (1 - (N or 0)) * (1 - z.alpha / 100) * (1 - D)
				end
				local function O()
					local N = workspace.CurrentCamera
					local z = N and N:FindFirstChild("PulseSkin")
					if z and z:IsA("Model") then
						return z
					end
					return nil
				end
				local function N(z)
					local D = {}
					for b, b in ipairs({
						"DisplayRefKnife",
						"DisplayRefGun",
					}) do
						local Z = z:FindFirstChild(b)
						local z = Z and Z:IsA("ObjectValue") and Z.Value or nil
						if z and z.Parent then
							D[#D + 1] = z
						end
					end
					local z = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
					if z then
						for b, b in ipairs(z:GetChildren()) do
							if b.Name:sub(1, 9) == "PulseSkin" then
								D[#D + 1] = b
							end
						end
					end
					return D
				end
				local function z(D)
					if D:IsA("BasePart") then
						return D.Transparency < 0.99 and D.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99
					end
					return true
				end
				local function D(b, Z, P, i)
					local function d(g)
						if g:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
							return
						end
						if g:IsA("BasePart") then
							if g.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
								return
							end
							if P.m and (_[g] or g.Transparency < 0.99) then
								Y[g] = Z
							end
							if P.wire and g.Transparency < 0.99 then
								x[g] = Z
							end
						elseif P.clean then
							if g:IsA("Decal") or g:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
								Y[g] = Z
							elseif i and (g:IsA("Clothing") or g:IsA("ShirtGraphic")) then
								Y[g] = Z
							end
						end
					end
					d(b)
					for Z, Z in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
						d(Z)
					end
				end
				local function b()
					Y, l, x = {}, {}, {}
					local Z = L.Character
					if not Z then
						return
					end
					local P, i = u.self, u.tool
					if P.on then
						local d = B[P.style]
						local P = O()
						for g, g in ipairs(Z:GetChildren()) do
							if not g:IsA("Tool") then
								D(g, "self", d, true)
							end
						end
						if P then
							D(P, "self", d, true)
						end
						if d.fill or d.edge then
							l[P or Z] = "self"
							if not P then
								for P, P in ipairs(Z:GetChildren()) do
									if P:IsA("Tool") then
										l[P] = "block"
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if i.on then
						local P = B[i.style]
						for d, d in ipairs(Z:GetChildren()) do
							if d:IsA("Tool") then
								D(d, "tool", P, false)
								if P.fill or P.edge then
									l[d] = "tool"
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if i.on then
						local P = B[i.style]
						for i, i in ipairs(N(Z)) do
							if z(i) then
								D(i, "tool", P, false)
								if P.fill or P.edge then
									l[i] = "tool"
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local function N()
					for D, Z in pairs(_) do
						local P = Y[D] == Z.kind
						if not P and Z.cloth then
							local i = u[Z.kind]
							P = i.on and B[i.style].clean == true and Z.par ~= nil and Z.par.Parent ~= nil
						end
						if not P then
							_[D] = nil
							pcall(H, D, Z)
						end
					end
					for D, Z in pairs(Y) do
						if not _[D] then
							local Y = { kind = Z, o = {}, w = {} }
							if D:IsA("Clothing") or D:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
								Y.cloth, Y.par = true, D.Parent
								_[D] = Y
								pcall(function()
									D.Parent = nil
								end)
							else
								Y.part = D:IsA("BasePart")
								Y.mp = D:IsA("MeshPart")
								Y.decal = D:IsA("Decal")
								Y.mesh = D:IsA("SpecialMesh")
								_[D] = Y
							end
						end
					end
					for Y, D in pairs(s) do
						if l[Y] ~= D.kind or not Y.Parent then
							s[Y] = nil
							pcall(function()
								D.h:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					for Y, D in pairs(l) do
						if not s[Y] then
							local l = Instance.new("Highlight")
							l.Name = "PulseChamsHL"
							l.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
							l.FillTransparency, l.OutlineTransparency = 1, 1
							l.Adornee = Y
							l.Parent = Q()
							s[Y] = { h = l, kind = D }
						end
					end
					for Y, l in pairs(h) do
						if x[Y] ~= l.kind or not Y.Parent then
							h[Y] = nil
							pcall(function()
								l.b:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
					for Y, l in pairs(x) do
						if not h[Y] then
							local x = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
							x.Name = "PulseChamsWire"
							x.LineThickness = 0.025
							x.SurfaceTransparency = 1
							x.Transparency = 1
							x.Adornee = Y
							x.Parent = Q()
							h[Y] = { b = x, kind = l }
						end
					end
				end
				local function Y(l)
					local x = os.clock() - k
					local k = L.Character
					local Q = k and k:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local D = Q and Q.Position.Y or nil
					local Q = O()
					for O, Z in pairs(_) do
						local P = u[Z.kind]
						local i = B[P.style]
						if Z.part then
							if O.Parent and i.m and (l or P.anim ~= "None") then
								pcall(function()
									local d, g = E(P, x, D and O.Position.Y - D or 0)
									I(O, Z, "Material", i.m)
									I(O, Z, "Color", d)
									I(O, Z, "Reflectance", i.r or 0)
									if l and i.clean and Z.mp then
										I(O, Z, "TextureID", "")
									end
									local d = i.t or 0
									if d > 0 or P.alpha > 0 or g > 0 or Z.w.Transparency ~= nil then
										I(O, Z, "Transparency", function(i)
											if i >= 0.99 then
												return nil
											end
											return n(i, d, P, g)
										end)
									end
								end)
							end
						elseif l and O.Parent then
							if Z.decal then
								pcall(I, O, Z, "Transparency", 1)
							elseif Z.mesh then
								pcall(I, O, Z, "TextureId", "")
							end
						end
					end
					for l, I in pairs(s) do
						local O = u[I.kind]
						if I.kind == "block" then
							pcall(function()
								C(I.h, "FillTransparency", 1)
								C(I.h, "OutlineTransparency", 1)
								if not I.h.Enabled then
									I.h.Enabled = true
								end
							end)
						else
							pcall(function()
								local Z = B[O.style]
								local P, i = E(O, x, 0)
								local d = I.h
								local I = 0
								if l == k or l == Q then
									local k = l:FindFirstChild("Head")
									if k and k:IsA("BasePart") then
										I = k.LocalTransparencyModifier
									end
								end

			local function _()

			local function q()

				c.objs, c.emitters, c.stampFx = {}, {}, {}

			local function s(h, Y, l, x, S, k, y)
				local Q = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				Q.Texture = Y.tex
				Q.Color = k(Y.color)
				Q.LightEmission = Y.le or 1
				Q.LightInfluence = Y.li or 0
				local k, E = Y.size[1] * l * (y or 1), Y.size[2] * l * (y or 1)
				Q.Size = r({ { 0, k }, { 1, E } })
				local k = Y.tr or 0
				local y = 1 - (1 - k) * x
				Q.Transparency = r({ { 0, Y.flat and 1 or y }, { 0.15, y }, { 1, 1 } })
				local x = Y.life
				if type(x) == "table" then
					Q.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(x[1] * S, x[2] * S)
				else
					Q.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(x * S)
				end
				Q.Rate = 0
				local x = Y.speed or { 0.001, 0.001 }
				Q.Speed = NumberRange.new(x[1] * l, x[2] * l)
				Q.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(Y.spread or 0, Y.spread or 0)
				Q.Acceleration = (Y.acc or Vector3.zero) * l
				Q.Drag = Y.drag or 0
				Q.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
				local l = Y.rot or 0
				Q.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-l, l)
				if Y.upright then
					Q.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCameraWorldUp
					Q.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-8.0, 8)
				end
				if Y.par then
					Q.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel
					Q.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0)
				end
				pcall(function()
					Q.Brightness = 3
				end)
				Q.Parent = h
				return Q
			end
			local function h(Y)
				q()
				local l = u[F.mode] or u.Aurora
				local x = math.clamp((tonumber(F.scale) or 100) / 100, 0.3, 3)
				local S = math.clamp((tonumber(F.alpha) or 100) / 100, 0, 1)
				local k = math.clamp((tonumber(F.life) or 3) / 3, 0.4, 3)
				local y = F.custom
						and Color3.fromRGB(
							math.clamp(tonumber(F.r) or 0, 0, 255),
							math.clamp(tonumber(F.g) or 200, 0, 255),
							math.clamp(tonumber(F.b) or 255, 0, 255)
						)
					or nil
				local function Q(E)
					return y and B.recolor(E, y) or E
				end
				local function B(y)
					c.objs[#c.objs + 1] = y
					return y
				end
				for y, y in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
					local E = Y:FindFirstChild(y .. "Foot") or Y:FindFirstChild(y .. " Leg")
					if E then
						local Y = -E.Size.Y / 2 + 0.08
						local y = l.width * x
						local I = B(Instance.new("Attachment"))
						I.Position = Vector3.new(-y / 2, Y, 0)
						I.Parent = E
						local C = B(Instance.new("Attachment"))
						C.Position = Vector3.new(y / 2, Y, 0)
						C.Parent = E
						local H = B(Instance.new("Attachment"))
						H.Position = Vector3.new(-y * (l.glow or 2.6) / 2, Y, 0)
						H.Parent = E
						local n = B(Instance.new("Attachment"))
						n.Position = Vector3.new(y * (l.glow or 2.6) / 2, Y, 0)
						n.Parent = E
						local y = l.ribLife * k
						local O = B(Instance.new("Trail"))
						O.Attachment0, O.Attachment1 = I, C
						O.Color = Q(l.rib)
						O.Transparency = r({ { 0, 1 - 0.95 * S }, { 0.5, 1 - 0.55 * S }, { 1, 1 } })
						O.WidthScale = r({ { 0, 1 }, { 1, 0.2 } })
						O.Lifetime = y
						O.LightEmission, O.LightInfluence = 1, 0
						O.FaceCamera = false
						O.MinLength = 0.05
						pcall(function()
							O.Brightness = 3

					X(_, 10)

		G:Header("Optimizer")
		w.optim = w.optim or {}
		local F = w.optim
		local function T(R, B)
			if F[R] == nil then
				F[R] = B
			end
		end
		T("fpsunlock", false)
		T("darken", 45)
		if F.on == true and F.migrated2 == nil then
			F.gfxLow = F.lowquality ~= false
			F.noShadows = F.shadows ~= false
			F.noFx = F.particles ~= false
			F.noTex = F.textures ~= false
			F.stopAnims = F.anims ~= false
			F.plastic = F.materials == true
			F.antiGlare = true
		end
		F.migrated2 = true
		F.on = false
		for R, R in ipairs({
			"gfxLow",
			"noShadows",
			"noLights",
			"noPost",
			"noFx",
			"noTex",
			"plastic",
			"simplePlayers",
			"stopAnims",
			"bgSaver",
			"antiGlare",
		}) do
			T(R, false)
		end
		local R = game:GetService("Players")
		local B = R.LocalPlayer
		local U = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local c = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
		local w = { orig = {}, glob = {} }
		local L = { ParticleEmitter = true, Beam = true, Trail = true, Fire = true, Smoke = true, Sparkles = true }
		for V, V in ipairs({
			"shadow",
			"lshadow",
			"light",
			"fx",
			"tex",
			"mtex",
			"plastic",
			"acc",
			"wrap",
			"post",
		}) do
			w.orig[V] = {}
		end
		function w.skip(V)
			local r = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if r and V:IsDescendantOf(r) then
				return true
			end
			local r = B.Character
			if r and V:IsDescendantOf(r) then
				return true
			end
			local r = V
			while r and r ~= workspace and r ~= U do
				if string.sub(r.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
					return true
				end
				r = r.Parent
			end
			return false
		end
		function w.save(V, r, _)
			local q = w.orig[V]
			if q[r] == nil then
				q[r] = _
			end
		end
		function w.otherChar(V)
			local r = V:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while r do
				if r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					local V = R:GetPlayerFromCharacter(r)
					return V ~= nil and V ~= B
				end
				r = r.Parent and r.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end
			return false
		end
		function w.touch(V)
			local r = V.ClassName
			local _ = V:IsA("BasePart")
			local q = not _ and V:IsA("Light")
			local u = L[r] == true
			local L = r == "Decal" or r == "Texture" or r == "SpecialMesh"
			local s = r == "WrapLayer"
			if not (_ or q or u or L or s) then
				return
			end
			if w.skip(V) then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if _ then
					if F.noShadows and V.CastShadow then
						w.save("shadow", V, true)
						V.CastShadow = false
					end
					if
						F.plastic
						and (V.Material ~= Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or V.Reflectance ~= 0)
						and V.Material ~= Enum.Material.ForceField
						and V.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon
					then
						w.save("plastic", V, { V.Material, V.Reflectance })
						V.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						V.Reflectance = 0
					end
					if F.noTex and r == "MeshPart" and V.TextureID ~= "" then
						w.save("mtex", V, V.TextureID)
						V.TextureID = ""
					end
					if F.simplePlayers and V:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") and w.otherChar(V) then
						w.save("acc", V, V.LocalTransparencyModifier)
						V.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
					end
				elseif q then
					if F.noLights and V.Enabled then
						w.save("light", V, true)
						V.Enabled = false
					end
					if F.noShadows and V.Shadows then
						w.save("lshadow", V, true)
						V.Shadows = false
					end
				elseif u then
					if F.noFx and V.Enabled then
						w.save("fx", V, true)
						V.Enabled = false
					end
				elseif L then
					if F.noTex then
						if r == "SpecialMesh" then
							if V.TextureId ~= "" then
								w.save("tex", V, V.TextureId)
								V.TextureId = ""
							end
						elseif V.Transparency < 1 then
							w.save("tex", V, V.Transparency)
							V.Transparency = 1
						end
					end
				elseif s then
					if F.simplePlayers and V.Enabled and w.otherChar(V) then
						w.save("wrap", V, true)
						V.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		function w.restore(L)
			local V = w.orig[L]
			w.orig[L] = {}
			for r, _ in pairs(V) do
				pcall(function()
					if not r.Parent then
						return
					end
					if L == "shadow" then
						r.CastShadow = _
					elseif L == "lshadow" then
						r.Shadows = _
					elseif L == "light" or L == "fx" or L == "wrap" then
						r.Enabled = _
					elseif L == "tex" then
						if r.ClassName == "SpecialMesh" then
							r.TextureId = _
						else
							r.Transparency = _
						end
					elseif L == "mtex" then
						r.TextureID = _
					elseif L == "plastic" then
						r.Material, r.Reflectance = _[1], _[2]
					elseif L == "acc" then
						r.LocalTransparencyModifier = _
					end
				end)
			end
		end
		function w.sweep()
			if not (F.noShadows or F.noLights or F.noFx or F.noTex or F.plastic or F.simplePlayers) then
				return
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local L = workspace:GetDescendants()
				for V, r in ipairs(L) do
					w.touch(r)
					if V % 600 == 0 then
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		function w.globals()
			pcall(function()
				if F.gfxLow then
					if w.glob.gfx == nil then
						w.glob.gfx = c.SavedQualityLevel
					end
					if c.SavedQualityLevel ~= Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1 then
						c.SavedQualityLevel = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1
					end
				elseif w.glob.gfx ~= nil then
					c.SavedQualityLevel = w.glob.gfx
					w.glob.gfx = nil
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if F.noShadows then
					if w.glob.shadows == nil then
						w.glob.shadows = U.GlobalShadows
					end
					U.GlobalShadows = false
				elseif w.glob.shadows ~= nil then
					U.GlobalShadows = w.glob.shadows
					w.glob.shadows = nil
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if F.noPost then
					for L, L in ipairs(U:GetChildren()) do
						if string.sub(L.Name, 1, 5) ~= "Pulse" then
							if L:IsA("PostEffect") and L.Enabled then
								w.save("post", L, true)
								L.Enabled = false
							elseif L:IsA("Atmosphere") and L.Density > 0 then
								w.save("post", L, L.Density)
								L.Density = 0
							end
						end
					end
				else
					local L = w.orig.post
					w.orig.post = {}
					for V, r in pairs(L) do
						pcall(function()
							if not V.Parent then
								return
							end
							if V:IsA("Atmosphere") then
								V.Density = r
							else
								V.Enabled = r
							end
						end)
					end
				end
			end)
			w.glare()
		end
		function w.glare()
			if getgenv().__pulseVisOwns == true then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				if F.antiGlare then
					if not w.glob.light then
						w.glob.light = { U.Brightness, U.Ambient, U.OutdoorAmbient }
					end
					local L = w.glob.light
					local V = math.clamp((tonumber(F.darken) or 0) / 100, 0, 1)
					local r = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
					U.Brightness = L[1] * (1 - V * 0.8)
					U.Ambient = L[2]:Lerp(r, V)
					U.OutdoorAmbient = L[3]:Lerp(r, V)
				elseif w.glob.light then
					local L = w.glob.light
					w.glob.light = nil
					U.Brightness, U.Ambient, U.OutdoorAmbient = L[1], L[2], L[3]
				end
			end)
		end
		function w.restoreAll()
			for L in pairs(w.orig) do
				w.restore(L)
			end
			pcall(function()
				if w.glob.gfx ~= nil then
					c.SavedQualityLevel = w.glob.gfx
					w.glob.gfx = nil
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if w.glob.shadows ~= nil then
					U.GlobalShadows = w.glob.shadows
					w.glob.shadows = nil
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if w.glob.light then
					local L = w.glob.light
					w.glob.light = nil
					U.Brightness, U.Ambient, U.OutdoorAmbient = L[1], L[2], L[3]
				end
			end)
			pcall(function()
				if w.bgOff then
					w.bgOff = false
					game:GetService("RunService"):Set3dRenderingEnabled(true)
					if w.bgCap and type(setfpscap) == "function" then
						setfpscap(w.bgCap)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		f(function()
			pcall(w.restoreAll)
		end)
		M(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(L)
			if F.noShadows or F.noLights or F.noFx or F.noTex or F.plastic or F.simplePlayers then
				task.defer(w.touch, L)
			end
		end)
		M(U.ChildAdded, function()
			if F.noPost then
				task.defer(w.globals)
			end
		end)
		M(c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SavedQualityLevel"), function()

									* math.sin(U / 0.24 * 3.141592653589793)

				K("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, c)
			A(w, "Color", "Glass")
			for L = 1, 3 do
				for W, W in ipairs({ true, false }) do
					local V = K("Frame", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = W and UDim2.fromScale(0.5, L / 4) or UDim2.fromScale(L / 4, 0.5),
						Size = W and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1) or UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						BackgroundTransparency = L == 2 and 0.88 or 0.95,
					}, c)
					A(V, "BackgroundColor3", "Text")
				end
			end
			a.pv = K("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ZIndex = 2,
			}, c)
			a.pvSc = K("UIScale", {}, a.pv)
			local L = T.icon({
				Parent = c,
				Icon = "mouse-pointer-2",
				Size = 24,
				Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Color = "Faint",
				Z = 2,
			})
			local W = T.label({
				Parent = U,
				Text = "",
				Font = T.Font.Bold(),
				Size = 15,
				Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 12),
				Box = UDim2.new(1, -98.0, 0, 20),
				Truncate = true,
				Color = "Text",
			})
			local V = T.label({
				Parent = U,
				Text = "",
				Font = T.Font.Medium(),
				Size = 12,
				Pos = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 34),
				Box = UDim2.new(1, -98.0, 0, 16),
				Truncate = true,
				Color = "Muted",
			})
			local r = K("TextButton", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(98, 58),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
			}, U)
			X(r, 8)
			A(r, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
			local U =
				K("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, r)
			A(U, "Color", "Glass")
			K("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }, r)
			K("UIListLayout", {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}, r)
			local U = T.icon({ Parent = r, Icon = "power", Size = 12, Color = "Muted", Z = 2 })
			U.LayoutOrder = 1
			local U = T.label({
				Parent = r,
				Text = t.tr("Turn off"),
				Font = T.Font.Semi(),
				Size = 12,
				Box = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				Auto = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Color = "Text",
				Z = 2,
			})
			U.LayoutOrder = 2
			pcall(function()
				t.bind(U, "Turn off")
			end)
			M(r.MouseEnter, function()
				B(r, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2", "Quick")
			end)
			T.U.leave(r, function()
				B(r, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated", "Quick")
			end)
			M(c.MouseButton1Click, function()
				a.pvClickAt = os.clock()
			end)
			a.title = function(U)
				if U == "Off" then
					return t.tr("Off")
				end
				if a.NAMES[U] then
					return t.tr(a.NAMES[U])
				end
				return t.tr("Image") .. " #" .. tostring(U:sub(2))
			end
			a.paintPv = function()
				local U = F.cursor or "Off"
				local c = U ~= "Off"
				L.ImageTransparency = c and 1 or 0
				W.Text = a.title(U)
				local U = {
					t.tr("Size") .. " " .. tostring(math.floor((tonumber(F.cursorSize) or 100) + 0.5)) .. "%",
				}
				if F.cursorSpin then
					U[#U + 1] = t.tr("Spin")
				end
				if F.cursorPulse then
					U[#U + 1] = t.tr("Pulse")
				end
				if F.cursorRainbow then
					U[#U + 1] = t.tr("Rainbow")
				end
				if F.cursorClick then
					U[#U + 1] = t.tr("Bounce")
				end
				V.Text = table.concat(U, " · ")
				r.Visible = c
				B(w, "Color", c and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
				R(w, "Quick", { Transparency = c and 0.45 or 0.86 })
			end
			local U =
				K("Frame", { Name = "CursorSeg", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, G:Container())
			X(U, 10)
			A(U, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
			local c =
				K("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.88, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, U)
			A(c, "Color", "Glass")
			local c = K(
				"Frame",
				{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4.0, 1, -6.0), BorderSizePixel = 0 },
				U
			)
			X(c, 8)
			A(c, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
			local w =
				K("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.6, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, c)
			A(w, "Color", "Accent")
			local w = { "Shapes", "Crosshairs" }
			local L = {}
			for W, V in ipairs(w) do
				local _ = K("TextButton", {
					Position = UDim2.new((W - 1) * 0.5, 0, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = "",
					ZIndex = 2,
				}, U)
				local U = T.label({
					Parent = _,
					Text = t.tr(V),
					Font = T.Font.Semi(),
					Size = 13,
					Box = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					AlignX = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
					Color = "Muted",
					Z = 3,
				})
				pcall(function()
					t.bind(U, V)
				end)
				L[V] = { b = _, l = U, i = W }
			end
			local t = {}
			for U, U in ipairs(w) do
				local w = K("Frame", {
					Name = "Cursor" .. U,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Visible = false,
				}, G:Container())
				t[U] = {
					f = w,
					gl = K("UIGridLayout", {
						CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46),
						CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					}, w),
					built = false,
				}
			end
			a.cw = 46
			local function U()
				if f and f.Scaling then
					if f._scalingDefer then
						f:_scalingDefer(U)
					end
					return
				end
				local w = f and f.Scale and f.Scale.Scale or 1
				local f = t[a.cat or "Shapes"].f
				local W = f.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(w, 0.1)
				if W < 60 then
					return
				end
				local f = math.max(4, math.floor((W + 8) / 54))
				local w = math.floor((W - 8 * (f - 1)) / f)
				a.cw = w
				for f, f in pairs(t) do
					f.gl.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(w, w)
				end
				for f, f in pairs(a.cells) do
					if f.ms then
						f.ms.Scale = math.clamp(w / 64 * 0.9, 0.3, 1.2)
					end
				end
			end
			for f, f in pairs(t) do
				M(f.f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), U)
			end
			a.paintCell = function(f)
				local w = a.cells[f]
				if not w then
					return
				end
				local W = f == (F.cursor or "Off")
				B(w.b, "BackgroundColor3", W and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
				R(w.b, "Quick", { BackgroundTransparency = W and 0.82 or 0 })
				B(w.st, "Color", (W or w.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
				R(w.st, "Quick", { Transparency = W and 0.15 or (w.hover and 0.5 or 0.86), Thickness = W and 1.5 or 1 })
				w.chk.Visible = W
			end
			a.select = function(f)
				pcall(function()
					T.Sound.play("tick")
				end)
				local w = F.cursor or "Off"
				F.cursor = f
				a.build()
				a.paintCell(w)
				a.paintCell(f)
			end
			M(r.MouseButton1Click, function()
				a.select("Off")
			end)
			a.makeCell = function(f, w, W)
				local V = K("TextButton", {
					Name = "C" .. tostring(W),
					LayoutOrder = w,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					ClipsDescendants = true,
				}, f)
				X(V, 10)
				A(V, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
				local f = K(
					"UIStroke",
					{ Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border },
					V
				)
				A(f, "Color", "Glass")
				local w = { b = V, st = f, hover = false }
				if W == "Off" then
					T.icon({
						Parent = V,
						Icon = "ban",
						Size = 18,
						Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
						Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Color = "Muted",
						Z = 2,
					})
				elseif a.NAMES[W] then
					local f = K("Frame", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						ZIndex = 2,
					}, V)
					w.ms = K("UIScale", { Scale = math.clamp(a.cw / 64 * 0.9, 0.3, 1.2) }, f)
					a.paint(a.draw(f, W), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true)
				else
					K("ImageLabel", {
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.68),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
						Image = a.IMGS[tonumber(W:sub(2))] or "",
						ZIndex = 2,
					}, V)
				end
				local f = K("Frame", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -3.0, 0, 3),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 4,
				}, V)
				X(f, 7)
				A(f, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
				T.icon({
					Parent = f,
					Icon = "check",
					Size = 10,
					Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Color = "OnAccent",
					Z = 5,
				})
				w.chk = f
				a.cells[W] = w
				M(V.MouseButton1Click, function()
					a.select(W)
				end)
				M(V.MouseEnter, function()
					w.hover = true
					a.paintCell(W)
				end)
				T.U.leave(V, function()
					w.hover = false
					a.paintCell(W)
				end)
				a.paintCell(W)
			end
			local function A(f)
				local X = t[f]
				if X.built then
					return
				end
				X.built = true
				if f == "Shapes" then
					a.makeCell(X.f, 0, "Off")
					for f, K in ipairs(a.SHAPES) do
						a.makeCell(X.f, f, K[1])
					end
				else
					for f = 1, #a.IMGS do
						a.makeCell(X.f, f, "I" .. tostring(f))
					end
				end
			end
			a.setCat = function(f, X)
				a.cat = f
				A(f)
				for A, K in pairs(t) do
					K.f.Visible = A == f
				end
				local A = L[f].i
				local t = UDim2.new((A - 1) * 0.5, A == 1 and 3 or 1, 0, 3)
				if X then
					c.Position = t
				else
					R(c, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = t })
				end
				for A, t in pairs(L) do
					B(t.l, "TextColor3", A == f and "Text" or "Muted", X and TweenInfo.new(0) or "Quick")
				end
				task.defer(U)
			end
			for A, f in pairs(L) do
				M(f.b.MouseButton1Click, function()
					if a.cat ~= A then
						pcall(function()
							T.Sound.play("tick")
						end)
						a.setCat(A)
					end
				end)
			end
			local A = F.cursor or "Off"
			a.setCat(type(A) == "string" and A:match("^I%d+$") and "Crosshairs" or "Shapes", true)
			G:Slider({
				Text = "Cursor Size",
				Min = 40,
				Max = 300,
				Default = F.cursorSize,
				Decimals = 0,
				Suffix = "%",
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorSize = A
					if a.paintPv then
						a.paintPv()
					end
				end,
			})
			G:Slider({
				Text = "Cursor Transparency",
				Min = 0,
				Max = 90,
				Default = F.cursorFade,
				Decimals = 0,
				Suffix = "%",
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorFade = A
					a.repaint()
				end,
			})
			G:Colorpicker({
				Text = "Cursor Color",
				Default = Color3.fromRGB(
					tonumber(F.cursorR) or 255,
					tonumber(F.cursorG) or 255,
					tonumber(F.cursorB) or 255
				),
				Callback = function(A)
					if typeof(A) ~= "Color3" then
						return
					end
					F.cursorR, F.cursorG, F.cursorB =
						math.floor(A.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(A.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(A.B * 255 + 0.5)
					a.repaint()
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Cursor Outline",
				Default = F.cursorOutline ~= false,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorOutline = A == true
					a.repaint()
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Recolor Images",
				Default = F.cursorTint == true,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorTint = A == true
					a.repaint()
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Rainbow Cursor",
				Default = F.cursorRainbow == true,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorRainbow = A == true
					a.repaint()
					if a.paintPv then
						a.paintPv()
					end
				end,
				Settings = function()
					G:Slider({
						Text = "Rainbow Speed",
						Min = 1,
						Max = 10,
						Default = F.cursorRainbowSpd,
						Decimals = 0,
						Callback = function(A)
							F.cursorRainbowSpd = A
						end,
					})
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Cursor Pulse",
				Default = F.cursorPulse == true,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorPulse = A == true
					if a.paintPv then
						a.paintPv()
					end
				end,
				Settings = function()
					G:Slider({
						Text = "Pulse Speed",
						Min = 1,
						Max = 10,
						Default = F.cursorPulseSpd,
						Decimals = 0,
						Callback = function(A)
							F.cursorPulseSpd = A
						end,
					})
					G:Slider({
						Text = "Pulse Size",
						Min = 5,
						Max = 80,
						Default = F.cursorPulseAmt,
						Decimals = 0,
						Suffix = "%",
						Callback = function(A)
							F.cursorPulseAmt = A
						end,
					})
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Cursor Spin",
				Default = F.cursorSpin == true,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorSpin = A == true
					if a.paintPv then
						a.paintPv()
					end
				end,
				Settings = function()
					G:Slider({
						Text = "Spin Speed",
						Min = 10,
						Max = 1080,
						Default = F.cursorSpinSpd,
						Decimals = 0,
						Suffix = "°",
						Callback = function(A)
							F.cursorSpinSpd = A
						end,
					})
					G:Toggle({
						Text = "Reverse Spin",
						Default = F.cursorSpinRev == true,
						Callback = function(A)
							F.cursorSpinRev = A == true
						end,
					})
				end,
			})
			G:Toggle({
				Text = "Click Bounce",
				Default = F.cursorClick == true,
				Callback = function(A)
					F.cursorClick = A == true
					if a.paintPv then
						a.paintPv()
					end
				end,
				Settings = function()
					G:Slider({
						Text = "Bounce Size",
						Min = 5,
						Max = 80,
						Default = F.cursorClickAmt,
						Decimals = 0,
						Suffix = "%",
						Callback = function(G)
							F.cursorClickAmt = G
						end,
					})
				end,
			})
			task.defer(function()
				pcall(a.build)
			end)
			table.insert(J.applyHooks, function()
				local G = F.cursor or "Off"
				if
					not (
						a.NAMES[G]
						or G == "Off"
						or type(G) == "string" and a.IMGS[tonumber(G:match("^I(%d+)$") or "")]
					)
				then
					F.cursor = "Off"
					G = "Off"
				end
				pcall(a.build)
				pcall(a.setCat, type(G) == "string" and G:match("^I%d+$") and "Crosshairs" or "Shapes", true)
				for G in pairs(a.cells) do
					pcall(a.paintCell, G)
				end
				if a.paintPv then
					pcall(a.paintPv)
				end
			end)
		end
		if F.fpsunlock and type(setfpscap) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				setfpscap(9999)
			end)
		end
	end
end

local VMRuntime = {
	pr = function(G, G, a, A, F)
		local T = F[31][A]
		F = #T
		T[F + 1] = G
		T[F + 2] = a
		T[F + 3] = 1
	end,
	Cr = function(G, G, a, A)
		A[38][a + 3] = G
	end,
	NC = coroutine,
	Vr = function(G, G, a)
		a[1] = G
	end,
	kr = function(G, G, a, A)
		G = 66
		a = #A
		return a, G
	end,
	vC = function(G, a, A, F)
		A[11] = 4503599627370496
		if F[0xf55] then
			a = G:_C(F, a)
		else
			a = -3111201366 + (((G.r6(4001001516, F[5198])) - 3179364466 > 2421486621 and 21201 or 3111201408) - F[31687])

		return a
	end,

			[22] = bit32.bxor,
			[23] = bit32.bnot,

			[21] = bit32.band,

		}
	end,
	gr = function(G, a, A, F)
		a[44] = G.cC

			local T = G:lr(T, a)
			a[26] = a[26] + 2

		end

			local f = a[19](a[36], a[26])

		end

			local T = a[18](a[36], a[26])

	Fr = function(G, a, A, F, T, f)

	yE = function(G, a, A, F, T, f, J, X, t)

											else

					end

					else

					end
				end
			end
		end

			if f == 102 then
				continue
			else
				if f ~= 199 then
				else
					G:GE(F, a, J, A)
					break
				end
			end
		end
		return T
	end,

	r = function(G)

		J = G:iC(a, J, T)

		J = G:gr(a, J, T)
		J = G:Nr(a, T, J)
		G:mr(a)
		local f, X, R
		X, R, f, A, J, F = G:CE(J, a, R, f, X, T)
		if A == -1 then
			return
		else
