						local N, D = pcall(function()
							return E:LoadAnimation(Y)
						end)
						if not N or not D then
							return false
						end
						D.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
						r = D
						if B.current then
							pcall(function()
								B.current:Stop(0.15)
							end)
						end
						B.current = nil
						B.pose = "Emote"
						pcall(function()
							D:Play(0.1)
						end)
						D.Stopped:Once(function()
							if r == D then
								r = nil
								if y == B.token then
									k(S())
								end
							end
						end)
						return true
					end
					B.playEmote = z
					if animate then
						local Y = animate:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
						if Y and Y:IsA("BindableFunction") then
							pcall(function()
								Y.OnInvoke = function(Y)
									return z(Y)
								end
							end)
						end
					end
					table.insert(B.conns, a(Q.Running, k))
					table.insert(B.conns, a(Q.Jumping, I))
					table.insert(B.conns, a(Q.FreeFalling, H))
					table.insert(B.conns, a(Q.Climbing, n))
					table.insert(B.conns, a(Q.Swimming, O))
					table.insert(
						B.conns,
						a(Q.Seated, function(Y)
							if not Y then
								k(0)
							end
						end)
					)
					table.insert(
						B.conns,
						a(Q.StateChanged, function(Y, Y)
							if y ~= B.token then
								return
							end
							if
								Y == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
								or Y == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
								or Y == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
							then
								if B.pose == "Jumping" or B.pose == "FreeFall" then
									B.pose = "Landed"
									k(S())
								end
							end
						end)
					)
					c(C.idle, 0.2, 1)
					task.spawn(function()
						while y == B.token do
							if animate and not animate.Disabled then
								animate.Disabled = true
							end
							local c = B.current
							if c and c.Looped and not c.IsPlaying then
								pcall(function()
									c:Play(0.1)
								end)
							end
							task.wait(0.4)
						end
					end)
					task.spawn(function()
						while y == B.token do
							if not r and B.pose ~= "Jumping" and B.pose ~= "FreeFall" then
								pcall(function()
									k(S())
								end)
							end
							task.wait(0.1)
						end
					end)
					return true
				end
				local function c()
					if K.autoLoad ~= false then
						return
					end
					K.autoLoad = true
					local r = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseCtrlSetters")
					local Y = r and r["Free anims/bundles/Auto-load on respawn"]
					if Y then
						pcall(Y, true)
					end
				end
				local function r(Y, S)
					local k = M.Character
					if not k or not k:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false, "No character"
					end
					local y, Q = l(Y, S, function(S)
						x(k, S)
					end)
					if not y then
						return false, "Failed to load bundle animations (ID: " .. tostring(Y) .. ")"
					end
					if not x(k, y) then
						return false, "Couldn't apply (no Animator)"
					end
					K.lastBundle = tostring(Y)
					K.lastMode = "bundle"
					c()
					w()
					return true, "Applied (visible to all): " .. (Q and Q.Name or "ID " .. Y)
				end
				local Y = {
					Head = "Head",
					DynamicHead = "Head",
					Torso = "Torso",
					LeftArm = "LeftArm",
					RightArm = "RightArm",
					LeftLeg = "LeftLeg",
					RightLeg = "RightLeg",
				}
				local S = {
					HairAccessory = true,
					FaceAccessory = true,
					NeckAccessory = true,
					ShouldersAccessory = true,
					FrontAccessory = true,
					BackAccessory = true,
					WaistAccessory = true,
				}
				local function k(y)
					local Q
					if
						not pcall(function()
							Q = U:GetItemDetails(y, Enum.AvatarItemType.Bundle)
						end) or type(Q) ~= "table"
					then
						return nil, "Bundle not found (rate limit?)"
					end
					local U = Q.BundledItems or Q.Items
					if type(U) ~= "table" or #U == 0 then
						return nil, "Bundle is empty"
					end
					local E = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
					local I, C = {}, 0
					for H, H in ipairs(U) do
						local U = tostring(H.AssetType)
						if Y[U] then
							pcall(function()
								E[Y[U]] = H.Id
							end)
							C = C + 1
						elseif S[U] then
							I[U] = I[U] or {}
							table.insert(I[U], tostring(H.Id))
						end
					end
					for U, Y in pairs(I) do
						pcall(function()
							E[U] = table.concat(Y, ",")
						end)
					end
					if C == 0 and next(I) == nil then
						return nil, "This bundle has no body parts"
					end
					return E, Q.Name or "ID " .. tostring(y)
				end
				local U = {
					model = nil,
					char = nil,
					links = nil,
					token = 0,
					hidden = {},
					grips = {},
					attachAt = 0,
					bound = false,
					status = "off",
					corpses = {},
					raggies = {},
					isaCache = {},
				}
				function U.isA(Y, S)
					local y = U.isaCache[S]
					if not y then
						y = {}
						U.isaCache[S] = y
					end
					local Q = Y.ClassName
					local E = y[Q]
					if E == nil then
						E = Y:IsA(S)
						y[Q] = E
					end
					return E
				end
				do
					local Y = game:GetService("Players")
					local S = game:GetService("RunService")
					local y = game:GetService("AssetService")
					local Q = Y.LocalPlayer
					function U.joints(E)
						local I = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
							if C:IsA("Motor6D") and C.Part0 and C.Part1 then
								I[C.Part1.Name] = { j = C, p0 = C.Part0, p1 = C.Part1, motor = true }
							elseif
								C:IsA("AnimationConstraint")
								and C.Attachment0
								and C.Attachment1
								and C.Attachment0.Parent
								and C.Attachment1.Parent
							then
								I[C.Attachment1.Parent.Name] = {
									j = C,
									p0 = C.Attachment0.Parent,
									p1 = C.Attachment1.Parent,
									a0 = C.Attachment0,
									a1 = C.Attachment1,
								}
							end
						end
						return I
					end
					function U.frames(E)
						if E.motor then
							return E.j.C0, E.j.C1
						end
						return E.a0.CFrame, E.a1.CFrame
					end
					function U.ground(E, I)
						local C = E:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local H = E:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
						if not C or not H then
							return nil
						end
						local E, n = {}, H
						while n and n ~= C do
							local C = I[n.Name]
							if not C then
								return nil
							end
							table.insert(E, 1, C)
							n = C.p0
						end
						local I = CFrame.new()
						for C, C in ipairs(E) do
							local E, n = U.frames(C)
							I = I * E * n:Inverse()
						end
						return H.Size.Y / 2 - I.Position.Y
					end
					function U.ghost(E)
						E.CanCollide, E.CanTouch, E.CanQuery, E.Massless = false, false, false, true
						E.CastShadow = true
						E:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
							if E.CanCollide then
								E.CanCollide = false
							end
						end)
					end
					function U.solid()
						local E = U.model
						if not E then
							return
						end
						for I, I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
							if I:IsA("BasePart") and (I.CanCollide or I.CanTouch or I.CanQuery) then
								I.CanCollide, I.CanTouch, I.CanQuery = false, false, false
							end
						end
					end
					function U.prep(E)
						for I, I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
							if I:IsA("BaseScript") then
								I:Destroy()
							elseif I:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(I)
							elseif I:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
								I.IsKinematic = true
							elseif I:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
								I.Enabled = false
							end
						end
						local I = E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if I then
							pcall(function()
								I.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
								I.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
								I.EvaluateStateMachine = false
								I.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
							end)
						end
						local I = E:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if I then
							I.Anchored = true
							I.Transparency = 1
						end
						E.Name = "PulseSkin"
						E.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(I)
							if I:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(I)
							end
						end)
						U.cj = U.joints(E)
						U.cg = U.ground(E, U.cj)
						U.modelParts = {}
						for I, I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
							if I:IsA("BasePart") and I.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
								U.modelParts[#U.modelParts + 1] = I
							end
						end
					end
					function U.attach(E)
						U.char, U.links = E, nil
						local I = U.joints(E)
						local C = U.ground(E, I)
						if C == nil or U.cg == nil or C <= 0 then
							return
						end
						local H, n = {}, {}
						for O, N in pairs(I) do
							local I = U.cj[O]
							if I then
								local O, z = U.frames(N)
								local D, b = U.frames(I)
								H[#H + 1] = {
									g = N,
									c = I,
									root = N.p0.Name == "HumanoidRootPart",
									restG = O * z:Inverse(),
									restC = D * b:Inverse(),
									c0inv = D:Inverse(),
									c1 = b,
									pivot0 = CFrame.new(D.Position),
									pivot1 = CFrame.new(b.Position):Inverse(),
								}
								n[I.p1.Name] = #H
							end
						end
						if #H == 0 then
							return
						end
						U.k = U.cg / C
						U.lift = U.cg - C
						U.chain = {}
						for I in pairs(n) do
							local C, O, N = {}, I, 0
							while O and n[O] and N < 32 do
								N += 1
								local N = n[O]
								table.insert(C, 1, N)
								local n = H[N].c.p0
								O = n.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and n.Name or nil
								if O == nil then
									U.chain[I] = C
								end
							end
						end
						U.feet = {}
						for I, I in ipairs({ "LeftFoot", "RightFoot" }) do
							local C, n = E:FindFirstChild(I), U.model:FindFirstChild(I)
							if U.chain[I] and C and n and C:IsA("BasePart") and n:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.feet[#U.feet + 1] = { list = U.chain[I], gh = C.Size.Y / 2, ch = n.Size.Y / 2 }
							end
						end
						local E = U.model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
						local I = E and E:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
						U.modelGrip = I and I:IsA("Attachment") and I.CFrame or CFrame.new(0, -E.Size.Y / 2, 0)
						U.links = H
						U.notify(nil)
					end
					function U.notify(E)
						local I = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseSkinChanged")
						if type(I) == "function" then
							task.defer(function()
								pcall(I, E)
							end)
						end
					end
					getgenv().__pulseSkinModel = function()
						local E = U.model
						if E and U.links and E.Parent then
							return E
						end
						return nil
					end
					function U.drive(E)
						local I = U.links
						local C = PulseFC(E, "HumanoidRootPart")
						local E = PulseFC(U.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
						if not (I and C and E) then
							return false
						end
						local H = U.k
						for n = 1, #I do
							local O = I[n]
							local n = O.g
							local N, z
							if n.motor then
								N, z = n.j.C0, n.j.C1
							else
								N, z = n.a0.CFrame, n.a1.CFrame
							end
							local D = N * n.j.Transform * z:Inverse()
							local n
							if O.root then
								n = CFrame.new(O.restC.Position + (D.Position - O.restG.Position) * H) * D.Rotation
							else
								n = O.pivot0 * D.Rotation * O.pivot1
							end
							O.relG, O.relC = D, n
							O.c.j.Transform = O.c0inv * n * O.c1
						end
						local H = U.lift
						if #U.feet > 0 then
							local n, O = math.huge, math.huge
							for N, N in ipairs(U.feet) do
								local z, D = CFrame.identity, CFrame.identity
								for b, b in ipairs(N.list) do
									z = z * I[b].relG
									D = D * I[b].relC
								end
								n = math.min(n, z.Y - N.gh)
								O = math.min(O, D.Y - N.ch)
							end
							if n < math.huge and O < math.huge then
								H = n - O
							end
						end
						local I = C.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, H, 0)
						E.CFrame = I
						U.rootCF, U.hrpCF = I, C.CFrame
						return true
					end
					function U.pose(E, I, C, H)
						if not (E and H) then
							return false
						end
						local n
						for O = 1, #E do
							local N = E[O]
							local E
							if N.root then
								E = N.restC
								n = N
							else
								local O, z = I(N.g.p0), I(N.g.p1)
								if O and z and O.Parent and z.Parent then
									E = N.pivot0 * (O.CFrame:Inverse() * z.CFrame).Rotation * N.pivot1
								else
									E = N.restC
								end
							end
							local O = C and C[N.c.p1.Name] or N.c
							if O then
								O.j.Transform = N.c0inv * E * N.c1
							end
							if not C then
								N.relC = E
							end
						end
						local E = n and I(n.g.p1)
						if not (E and E.Parent) then
							return false
						end
						H.CFrame = E.CFrame * n.restC:Inverse()
						return true
					end
					function U.fadeOf(E)
						local I = 0
						for C, C in ipairs(E) do
							if
								C.Parent
								and U.isA(C, "BasePart")
								and C.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
								and C.Transparency > I
							then
								I = C.Transparency
							end
						end
						return I
					end
					function U.sig(E)
						local I = E:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
						local C = E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
						local H = E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
						return table.concat({
							I and I:IsA("MeshPart") and I.MeshId or "",
							C and C.ShirtTemplate or "",
							H and H.PantsTemplate or "",
						}, "|")
					end
					function U.corpseFree(E)
						if E.watch then
							pcall(function()
								E.watch:Disconnect()
							end)
							E.watch = nil
						end
						if E.model then
							pcall(function()
								E.model:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						for I, I in ipairs(E.hidden or {}) do
							if I.Parent then
								pcall(function()
									I.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end)
							end
						end
					end
					function U.clearCorpses()
						for E, I in pairs(U.corpses) do
							U.corpseFree(I)
							U.corpses[E] = nil
						end
					end
					function U.adopt(E)
						if U.corpses[E] or not U.model or not U.links then
							return
						end
						local I = U.model:Clone()
						I.Name = "PulseSkinCorpse"
						local C = {
							model = I,
							map = {},
							hidden = {},
							seen = {},
							fade = -1.0,
							links = U.links,
							t0 = os.clock(),
						}
						for H, H in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								C.map[H.Name] = H
							end
						end
						C.joints = U.joints(I)
						C.parts = {}
						for H, H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(H)
								if H.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
									C.parts[#C.parts + 1] = H
								end
							end
						end
						C.root = I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						I.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
						for H, H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								H.CanCollide, H.CanTouch, H.CanQuery = false, false, false
							end
						end
						U.corpses[E] = C
					end
					function U.corpseStep()
						for E, I in pairs(U.corpses) do
							if not E.Parent or not I.model.Parent then
								U.corpseFree(I)
								U.corpses[E] = nil
							else
								local C = os.clock()
								if I.dirty ~= false or C - (I.scanAt or 0) > 1 then
									I.dirty, I.scanAt = false, C
									if not I.watch then
										I.watch = E.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
											I.dirty = true
										end)
									end
									for C, C in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
										if U.isA(C, "BasePart") or U.isA(C, "Decal") then
											if C.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
												C.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
											end
											if not I.seen[C] then
												I.seen[C] = true
												I.hidden[#I.hidden + 1] = C
											end
										end
									end
								end
								local E = I.map.LowerTorso
								if not I.done then
									U.pose(I.links, function(C)
										return I.map[C.Name]
									end, I.joints, I.root)
									if E and E.Anchored and os.clock() - I.t0 > 5 then
										I.done = true
									end
								end
								local E = U.fadeOf(I.hidden)
								if E ~= I.fade then
									I.fade = E
									for C, C in ipairs(I.parts) do
										if C.Parent then
											C.LocalTransparencyModifier = E
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function U.watchRaggy(E)
						if E.Name == "Raggy" and E:IsA("Model") then
							local I, C = os.clock(), {}
							for H, H in ipairs(U.raggies) do
								if I - H.t < 6 then
									C[#C + 1] = H
								end
							end
							C[#C + 1] = { m = E, t = I }
							U.raggies = C
						end
					end
					function U.matchDeath()
						local E = U.death
						if not E or E.done then
							return
						end
						if os.clock() - E.t > 4 then
							E.done = true
							return
						end
						local I = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(U.raggies) do
							if os.clock() - C.t < 6 and C.m.Parent then
								I[#I + 1] = C
								local H = C.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or C.m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local n, O = pcall(U.sig, C.m)
								if
									H
									and (H.Position - E.pos).Magnitude < 12
									and (E.sig == "||" or n and O == E.sig)
								then
									E.done = true
									E.corpse = C.m
									U.adopt(C.m)
								end
							end
						end
						U.raggies = I
					end
					function U.world(E, I)
						local C = U.chain and U.chain[I]
						if not C then
							return nil
						end
						local I = E == "model" and U.rootCF or U.hrpCF
						for H, H in ipairs(C) do
							I = I * (E == "model" and U.links[H].relC or U.links[H].relG)
						end
						return I
					end
					function U.gripFollow(E)
						local I = PulseFC(E, "RightHand")
						local E = I and PulseFC(I, "RightGrip")
						for I, C in pairs(U.grips) do
							if I ~= E then
								if I.Parent and C.applied and I.C0:FuzzyEq(C.applied, 0.001) then
									pcall(function()
										I.C0 = C.c0
									end)
								end
								U.grips[I] = nil
							end
						end
						if not (E and E:IsA("JointInstance")) then
							return
						end
						local I = U.grips[E]
						if not I or not (I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied, 0.001)) then
							I = { c0 = E.C0 }
							U.grips[E] = I
						end
						local C = U.world("real", "RightHand")
						local H = U.world("model", "RightHand")
						if not (C and H) then
							return
						end
						local n = C:Inverse() * H * U.modelGrip
						I.applied = n
						E.C0 = n
					end
					function U.restoreGrips()
						for E, I in pairs(U.grips) do
							if E.Parent and I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied, 0.001) then
								pcall(function()
									E.C0 = I.c0
								end)
							end
						end
						U.grips = {}
						U.restoreMounts()
					end
					U.mountReg = {}
					function U.mountOrig(E)
						local I = U.mountReg[E]
						if I and E.Parent and I.applied and E[I.prop]:FuzzyEq(I.applied, 0.0001) then
							return I.orig
						end
						return nil
					end
					getgenv().__pulseMountOrig = U.mountOrig
					function U.restoreMountsOf(E)
						for I in pairs(E.mounts or {}) do
							local C = U.mountReg[I]
							if C and I.Parent and C.applied and I[C.prop]:FuzzyEq(C.applied, 0.0001) then
								pcall(function()
									I[C.prop] = C.orig
								end)
							end
							U.mountReg[I] = nil
						end
						E.mounts, E.mountList, E.mountCh = {}, nil, nil
					end
					function U.restoreMounts()
						U.restoreMountsOf(U)
					end
					function U.mountScanOf(E, I)
						local C, H = {}, {}
						local n = {
							LowerTorso = PulseFC(I, "LowerTorso"),
							UpperTorso = PulseFC(I, "UpperTorso"),
						}
						local function O(N)
							if N == nil then
								return nil
							end
							for z, D in pairs(n) do
								if D == N then
									return z
								end
							end
							return nil
						end
						local n = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
						if n then
							for N, N in ipairs(n:GetChildren()) do
								local n = N:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
								local z = n and n.Attachment0
								local n = z and O(z.Parent)
								if n and not H[z] then
									H[z] = true
									C[#C + 1] = { inst = z, prop = "CFrame", part = n }
								end
								local n = N:FindFirstChild("PulseMount")
								local N = n and U.isA(n, "JointInstance") and O(n.Part0)
								if N and not H[n] then
									H[n] = true
									C[#C + 1] = {
										inst = n,
										prop = "C0",
										part = N,
										anchor = n:GetAttribute("PulseAnchor"),
									}
								end
							end
						end
						E.mountList, E.mountCh, E.mountAt = C, I, os.clock()
					end
					local function E(I, C, H)
						local n = math.abs(I)
						local O = math.min(n, C)
						local N = (C > 0.001 and O * H / C or 0) + math.max(n - C, 0)
						return I < 0 and -N or N
					end
					function U.mountFollowOf(I, C, H, n)
						if I.mountCh ~= C or os.clock() - (I.mountAt or 0) > 0.5 then
							U.mountScanOf(I, C)
						end
						local O = I.mountList
						if not (O and #O > 0 and H) then
							return
						end
						I.mounts = I.mounts or {}
						local N = {}
						local function z(D)
							local b = N[D]
							if b ~= nil then
								return b
							end
							b = false
							local Z, P = PulseFC(C, D), PulseFC(H, D)
							local C, H = n("real", D), n("model", D)
							if Z and P and C and H then
								b = { M = C:Inverse() * H, hr = Z.Size / 2, hs = P.Size / 2, part = Z }
							end
							N[D] = b
							return b
						end
						for C, C in ipairs(O) do
							local H = C.inst
							local n = H.Parent and z(C.part)
							if n then
								local O = H[C.prop]
								local N = U.mountReg[H]
								if not (N and N.applied and O:FuzzyEq(N.applied, 0.0001)) then
									N = { orig = O, prop = C.prop }
									U.mountReg[H] = N
								end
								I.mounts[H] = true
								local I = N.orig.Position
								if C.anchor then
									local z = n.part:FindFirstChild(C.anchor)
									if z and U.isA(z, "Attachment") then
										local D = U.mountOrig(z)
										I = (D or z.CFrame).Position
									end
								end
								local z, D = n.hr, n.hs
								local b = Vector3.new(E(I.X, z.X, D.X), E(I.Y, z.Y, D.Y), E(I.Z, z.Z, D.Z))
								local E = n.M * CFrame.new(b - I) * N.orig
								N.applied = E
								if not O:FuzzyEq(E, 0.0001) then
									H[C.prop] = E
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function U.mountFollow(E)
						U.mountFollowOf(U, E, U.model, U.world)
					end
					function U.collectBody(E)
						local I = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
							if not U.isA(C, "Tool") and not C:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
								if U.isA(C, "BasePart") or U.isA(C, "Decal") then
									I[#I + 1] = C
								end
								for H, H in ipairs(C:GetDescendants()) do
									if
										(U.isA(H, "BasePart") or U.isA(H, "Decal"))
										and not H:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
									then
										I[#I + 1] = H
									end
								end
							end
						end
						U.body, U.bodyAt, U.bodyDirty = I, os.clock(), false
						if U.bodyChar ~= E then
							if U.bodyConn then
								pcall(function()
									U.bodyConn:Disconnect()
								end)
							end
							U.bodyChar = E
							U.bodyConn = E.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
								U.bodyDirty = true
							end)
						end
					end
					function U.hideBody(E)
						local I = os.clock() - (U.bodyAt or 0)
						if U.char ~= E or U.bodyChar ~= E or not U.body or U.bodyDirty and I > 0.2 or I > 3 then
							U.collectBody(E)
						end
						for E, E in ipairs(U.body) do
							if E.Parent and E.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
								E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								U.hidden[E] = true
							end
						end
					end
					function U.showBody()
						for E in pairs(U.hidden) do
							if E.Parent then
								pcall(function()
									E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end)
							end
						end
						U.hidden = {}
						U.body = nil
					end
					function U.firstPerson(E)
						local I = workspace.CurrentCamera
						local C = PulseFC(E, "Head")
						local E = I and C and (I.CFrame.Position - C.Position).Magnitude < 1.4
						local I = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseInvis")
						local C = type(I) == "table" and I.active == true
						local I = E and 1 or (C and 0.5 or 0)
						if I ~= U.near then
							U.near = I
							for E, E in ipairs(U.modelParts or {}) do
								if E.Parent then
									E.LocalTransparencyModifier = I
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function U.step()
						local E = U.model
						if not E then
							return
						end
						local I = Q.Character
						local Q = I and PulseFCC(I, "Humanoid")
						local C = workspace.CurrentCamera
						pcall(U.matchDeath)
						pcall(U.corpseStep)
						local H = I ~= nil
							and Q ~= nil
							and I.Parent ~= nil
							and Q.Health <= 0
							and U.char == I
							and U.links ~= nil
						if H then
							if not U.death or U.death.ch ~= I then
								local H = I:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local n, O = pcall(U.sig, I)
								U.death = {
									ch = I,
									t = os.clock(),
									pos = H and H.Position or Vector3.zero,
									sig = n and O or "||",
								}
								pcall(U.matchDeath)
							end
							U.restoreGrips()
							local H = U.death.corpse ~= nil and U.corpses[U.death.corpse] ~= nil
							if
								H
								or not U.pose(U.links, function(H)
									return H
								end, nil, E:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
							then
								if E.Parent then
									E.Parent = nil
								end
							elseif E.Parent ~= C then
								E.Parent = C
								U.solid()
							end
							U.hideBody(I)
							local H = U.fadeOf(U.body or {})
							if H ~= U.deadFade then
								U.deadFade = H
								for n, n in ipairs(U.modelParts or {}) do
									if n.Parent then
										n.LocalTransparencyModifier = H
									end
								end
							end
							U.near = nil
							return
						end
						if not (I and Q and Q.Health > 0 and PulseFC(I, "HumanoidRootPart")) then
							if E.Parent then
								E.Parent = nil
							end
							U.showBody()
							U.restoreGrips()
							U.char, U.links = nil, nil
							return
						end
						if U.deadFade then
							U.deadFade = nil
							U.near = nil
						end
						if U.char ~= I or U.links == nil and os.clock() - U.attachAt > 0.5 then
							U.attachAt = os.clock()
							U.showBody()
							U.restoreGrips()
							pcall(U.attach, I)
						end
						if not U.links then
							return
						end
						if E.Parent ~= C then
							E.Parent = C
							U.solid()
						end
						if not U.drive(I) then
							return
						end
						U.hideBody(I)
						pcall(U.gripFollow, I)
						pcall(U.mountFollow, I)
						U.firstPerson(I)
					end
					function U.bind(Q)
						if Q and not U.bound then
							U.bound = true
							S:BindToRenderStep("PulseSkinStep", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
								local E = pcall(U.step)
								if not E then
									U.links = nil
								end
							end)
							U.addConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(U.watchRaggy)
						elseif not Q and U.bound then
							U.bound = false
							pcall(function()
								S:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseSkinStep")
							end)
							if U.addConn then
								U.addConn:Disconnect()
								U.addConn = nil
							end
						end
					end
					function U.stop()
						U.token += 1
						U.bind(false)
						U.showBody()
						U.restoreGrips()
						U.clearCorpses()
						U.death, U.raggies = nil, {}
						local S = U.model
						U.model, U.char, U.links, U.cj, U.cg, U.near = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
						U.baseDesc, U.kbOn, U.pub = nil, nil, nil
						if S then
							pcall(function()
								S:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						if S and U.notify then
							U.notify(nil)
						end
					end
					function U.wear(S)
						if U.dead then
							return false, "cancelled"
						end
						U.token += 1
						local Q = U.token
						local E, I = pcall(function()
							return Y:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(S, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
						end)
						if Q ~= U.token or U.dead then
							if E and typeof(I) == "Instance" then
								I:Destroy()
							end
							return false, "cancelled"
						end
						if not E or typeof(I) ~= "Instance" then
							return false, "Couldn't build: " .. tostring(I)
						end
						local S, Q = pcall(U.prep, I)
						if not S or U.cg == nil then
							I:Destroy()
							return false, "Couldn't rig: " .. tostring(Q)
						end
						local S = U.model
						U.showBody()
						U.restoreGrips()
						U.model, U.char, U.links, U.near = I, nil, nil, nil
						if S then
							pcall(function()
								S:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						U.bind(true)
						return true
					end
					U.KB_LEG = 139607718
					function U.cosWant()
						local S = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseCosMine")
						if type(S) ~= "function" then
							return false, false
						end
						local Q, E, I = pcall(S)
						if not Q then
							return false, false
						end
						return E == true, I == true
					end
					function U.headless(S, Q)
						local E = S and S:FindFirstChild("Head")
						if not E then
							return
						end
						local S = { E }
						for I, I in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
							if I:IsA("Decal") then
								S[#S + 1] = I
							end
						end
						for E, E in ipairs(S) do
							pcall(function()
								local S = E:GetAttribute("PulseHL")
								if Q then
									if S == nil then
										E:SetAttribute("PulseHL", E.Transparency)
									end
									E.Transparency = 1
								elseif S ~= nil then
									E.Transparency = S
									E:SetAttribute("PulseHL", nil)
								end
							end)
						end
					end
					function U.dress(S)
						U.baseDesc = S
						local Q, E = U.cosWant()
						local I = S
						if Q then
							local C, H = pcall(function()
								return S:Clone()
							end)
							if C and H then
								pcall(function()
									H.RightLeg = U.KB_LEG
								end)
								I = H
							else
								Q = false
							end
						end
						local S, C = U.wear(I)
						if S then
							U.kbOn = Q
							U.headless(U.model, E)
						end
						return S, C
					end
					local S = {
						"BodyTypeScale",
						"DepthScale",
						"HeadScale",
						"HeightScale",
						"ProportionScale",
						"WidthScale",
						"Face",
						"Head",
						"LeftArm",
						"LeftLeg",
						"RightArm",
						"RightLeg",
						"Torso",
						"GraphicTShirt",
						"Pants",
						"Shirt",
					}
					local Q = {
						"HeadColor",
						"LeftArmColor",
						"LeftLegColor",
						"RightArmColor",
						"RightLegColor",
						"TorsoColor",
					}
					function U.serial(E)
						local I, C = pcall(function()
							local H = { p = {}, c = {}, acc = {} }
							for n, n in ipairs(S) do
								H.p[n] = E[n]
							end
							for n, n in ipairs(Q) do
								local O = E[n]
								H.c[n] = {
									math.floor(O.R * 255 + 0.5),
									math.floor(O.G * 255 + 0.5),
									math.floor(O.B * 255 + 0.5),
								}
							end
							for n, n in ipairs(E:GetAccessories(true)) do
								H.acc[#H.acc + 1] = {
									t = n.AccessoryType.Name,
									id = n.AssetId,
									l = n.IsLayered == true,
									o = n.Order,
									pf = n.Puffiness,
								}
							end
							return H
						end)
						return I and C or nil
					end
					function U.deserial(E)
						if type(E) ~= "table" then
							return nil
						end
						local I, C = pcall(function()
							local H = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
							for n, n in ipairs(S) do
								local S = type(E.p) == "table" and E.p[n]
								if type(S) == "number" then
									pcall(function()
										H[n] = S
									end)
								end
							end
							for S, S in ipairs(Q) do
								local Q = type(E.c) == "table" and E.c[S]
								if type(Q) == "table" then
									pcall(function()
										H[S] = Color3.fromRGB(
											tonumber(Q[1]) or 0,
											tonumber(Q[2]) or 0,
											tonumber(Q[3]) or 0
										)
									end)
								end
							end
							local S = {}
							for Q, Q in ipairs(type(E.acc) == "table" and E.acc or {}) do
								local E, n = pcall(function()
									return Enum.AccessoryType[tostring(Q.t)]
								end)
								if E and n and tonumber(Q.id) then
									local E = { AccessoryType = n, AssetId = tonumber(Q.id), IsLayered = Q.l == true }
									if tonumber(Q.o) then
										E.Order = tonumber(Q.o)
									end
									if tonumber(Q.pf) then
										E.Puffiness = tonumber(Q.pf)
									end
									S[#S + 1] = E
								end
							end
							H:SetAccessories(S, true)
							return H
						end)
						return I and C or nil
					end
					function U.refreshCos()
						if not (U.model and U.baseDesc) then
							return
						end
						local S, Q = U.cosWant()
						if S ~= (U.kbOn == true) then
							U.dress(U.baseDesc)
						else
							U.headless(U.model, Q)
						end
					end
					getgenv().__pulseSkinCos = function()
						task.spawn(function()
							pcall(U.refreshCos)
						end)
					end
					function U.fromBundle(S)
						local Q = y:GetBundleDetailsAsync(S)
						for S, S in ipairs(Q.Items or {}) do
							if S.Type == "UserOutfit" then
								return Y:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(S.Id), Q.Name
							end
						end
						error("bundle has no outfit")
					end
					function U.fromUser(S)
						local y = tonumber(S)
						if not y then
							y = Y:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(S)
						end
						local Q = tostring(S)
						pcall(function()
							Q = Y:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(y)
						end)
						return Y:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(y), Q, y
					end
				end
				function U.applyBundle(Y)
					local S = tonumber(Y)
					if not S then
						return false, "Bad bundle id"
					end
					if not M.Character then
						return false, "No character"
					end
					local Y, y, Q = pcall(U.fromBundle, S)
					if not Y or not y then
						y, Q = k(S)
					end
					if not y then
						return false, tostring(Q)
					end
					local Y, E = U.dress(y)
					if not Y then
						return false, tostring(E)
					end
					U.pub = { b = S }
					K.skin = { kind = "bundle", id = tostring(S), name = Q, desc = U.serial(y) }
					w()
					return true, tostring(Q)
				end
				function U.applyUser(Y)
					Y = (tostring(Y or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
					if Y == "" then
						return false, "Enter a username"
					end
					if not M.Character then
						return false, "No character"
					end
					local S, y, Q, E = pcall(U.fromUser, Y)
					if not S or not y then
						return false, "Player not found"
					end
					local S, I = U.dress(y)
					if not S then
						return false, tostring(I)
					end
					U.pub = tonumber(E) and { u = tonumber(E) } or nil
					K.skin = { kind = "user", id = Y, name = Q, uid = tonumber(E), desc = U.serial(y) }
					w()
					return true, tostring(Q)
				end
				function U.applySaved(Y)
					if type(Y) ~= "table" then
						return false
					end
					local S = U.deserial(Y.desc)
					if S then
						local y = U.dress(S)
						if y then
							if Y.kind == "bundle" then
								U.pub = tonumber(Y.id) and { b = tonumber(Y.id) } or nil
							else
								local S = tonumber(Y.uid) or tonumber(Y.id)
								U.pub = S and { u = S } or nil
							end
							K.skin = Y
							w()
							return true
						end
					end
					if Y.kind == "user" then
						return U.applyUser(Y.id)
					end
					if Y.id then
						return U.applyBundle(Y.id)
					end
					return false
				end
				function U.reset()
					U.stop()
					K.skin = nil
					w()
					return true, "Skin removed"
				end
				local Y = { list = {}, raggies = {}, descs = {}, bound = false }
				getgenv().__pulseRemoteSkin = Y
				do
					local S = game:GetService("Players")
					local y = game:GetService("RunService")
					function Y.prep(Q)
						for E, E in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
							if E:IsA("BaseScript") then
								E:Destroy()
							elseif E:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(E)
							elseif E:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
								E.IsKinematic = true
							elseif E:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
								E.Enabled = false
							end
						end
						local E = Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if E then
							pcall(function()
								E.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
								E.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
								E.EvaluateStateMachine = false
								E.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
							end)
						end
						local E = Q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if E then
							E.Anchored = true
							E.Transparency = 1
						end
						Q.Name = "PulseRemoteSkin"
						Q.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(E)
							if E:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(E)
							end
						end)
						local E = U.joints(Q)
						local I = U.ground(Q, E)
						local C = {}
						for H, H in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") and H.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
								C[#C + 1] = H
							end
						end
						return E, I, C
					end
					function Y.solid(Q)
						if not Q.model then
							return
						end
						for E, E in ipairs(Q.model:GetDescendants()) do
							if E:IsA("BasePart") and (E.CanCollide or E.CanTouch or E.CanQuery) then
								E.CanCollide, E.CanTouch, E.CanQuery = false, false, false
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.attach(Q, E)
						Q.char, Q.links = E, nil
						local I = U.joints(E)
						local C = U.ground(E, I)
						if C == nil or Q.cg == nil or C <= 0 then
							return
						end
						local H, n = {}, {}
						for O, N in pairs(I) do
							local I = Q.cj[O]
							if I then
								local O, z = U.frames(N)
								local D, b = U.frames(I)
								H[#H + 1] = {
									g = N,
									c = I,
									root = N.p0.Name == "HumanoidRootPart",
									restG = O * z:Inverse(),
									restC = D * b:Inverse(),
									c0inv = D:Inverse(),
									c1 = b,
									pivot0 = CFrame.new(D.Position),
									pivot1 = CFrame.new(b.Position):Inverse(),
								}
								n[I.p1.Name] = #H
							end
						end
						if #H == 0 then
							return
						end
						Q.k = Q.cg / C
						Q.lift = Q.cg - C
						Q.chain = {}
						for I in pairs(n) do
							local C, O, N = {}, I, 0
							while O and n[O] and N < 32 do
								N += 1
								local N = n[O]
								table.insert(C, 1, N)
								local n = H[N].c.p0
								O = n.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and n.Name or nil
								if O == nil then
									Q.chain[I] = C
								end
							end
						end
						Q.feet = {}
						for I, I in ipairs({ "LeftFoot", "RightFoot" }) do
							local C, n = E:FindFirstChild(I), Q.model:FindFirstChild(I)
							if Q.chain[I] and C and n and C:IsA("BasePart") and n:IsA("BasePart") then
								Q.feet[#Q.feet + 1] = { list = Q.chain[I], gh = C.Size.Y / 2, ch = n.Size.Y / 2 }
							end
						end
						local E = Q.model:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
						local I = E and E:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
						Q.modelGrip = I and I:IsA("Attachment") and I.CFrame
							or (E and CFrame.new(0, -E.Size.Y / 2, 0) or CFrame.identity)
						Q.links = H
						if Q.plr then
							U.notify(Q.plr)
						end
					end
					function Y.drive(Q, E)
						local I = Q.links
						local C = PulseFC(E, "HumanoidRootPart")
						local E = PulseFC(Q.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
						if not (I and C and E) then
							return false
						end
						local H = Q.k
						local n = os.clock()
						local O = n - (Q.framesAt or 0) > 1
						if O then
							Q.framesAt = n
						end
						for n = 1, #I do
							local N = I[n]
							local n = N.g
							if O or not N.g0 then
								local O, z
								if n.motor then
									O, z = n.j.C0, n.j.C1
								else
									O, z = n.a0.CFrame, n.a1.CFrame
								end
								N.g0, N.g1inv = O, z:Inverse()
							end
							local O = N.g0 * n.j.Transform * N.g1inv
							local n
							if N.root then
								n = CFrame.new(N.restC.Position + (O.Position - N.restG.Position) * H) * O.Rotation
							else
								n = N.pivot0 * O.Rotation * N.pivot1
							end
							N.relG, N.relC = O, n
							N.c.j.Transform = N.c0inv * n * N.c1
						end
						local H = Q.lift
						if #Q.feet > 0 then
							local n, O = math.huge, math.huge
							for N, N in ipairs(Q.feet) do
								local z, D = CFrame.identity, CFrame.identity
								for b, b in ipairs(N.list) do
									z = z * I[b].relG
									D = D * I[b].relC
								end
								n = math.min(n, z.Y - N.gh)
								O = math.min(O, D.Y - N.ch)
							end
							if n < math.huge and O < math.huge then
								H = n - O
							end
						end
						local I = C.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, H, 0)
						E.CFrame = I
						Q.rootCF, Q.hrpCF = I, C.CFrame
						return true
					end
					function Y.world(Q, E, I)
						local C = Q.chain and Q.chain[I]
						if not C then
							return nil
						end
						local I = E == "model" and Q.rootCF or Q.hrpCF
						if not I then
							return nil
						end
						for H, H in ipairs(C) do
							I = I * (E == "model" and Q.links[H].relC or Q.links[H].relG)
						end
						return I
					end
					function Y.gripFollow(Q, E)
						local I = PulseFC(E, "RightHand")
						local E = I and PulseFC(I, "RightGrip")
						for I, C in pairs(Q.grips) do
							if I ~= E then
								if I.Parent and C.applied and I.C0:FuzzyEq(C.applied, 0.001) then
									pcall(function()
										I.C0 = C.c0
									end)
								end
								Q.grips[I] = nil
							end
						end
						if not (E and E:IsA("JointInstance")) then
							return
						end
						local I = Q.grips[E]
						if not I or not (I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied, 0.001)) then
							I = { c0 = E.C0 }
							Q.grips[E] = I
						end
						local C = Y.world(Q, "real", "RightHand")
						local H = Y.world(Q, "model", "RightHand")
						if not (C and H) then
							return
						end
						local n = C:Inverse() * H * Q.modelGrip
						I.applied = n
						E.C0 = n
					end
					function Y.restoreGrips(Q)
						for E, I in pairs(Q.grips) do
							if E.Parent and I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied, 0.001) then
								pcall(function()
									E.C0 = I.c0
								end)
							end
						end
						Q.grips = {}
						U.restoreMountsOf(Q)
					end
					function Y.collectBody(Q, E)
						local I = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
							if not U.isA(C, "Tool") and not C:GetAttribute("PulseVFX") then
								if U.isA(C, "BasePart") or U.isA(C, "Decal") then
									I[#I + 1] = C
								end
								for H, H in ipairs(C:GetDescendants()) do
									if
										(U.isA(H, "BasePart") or U.isA(H, "Decal"))
										and not H:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
									then
										I[#I + 1] = H
									end
								end
							end
						end
						Q.body, Q.bodyAt, Q.bodyDirty = I, os.clock(), false
						if Q.bodyChar ~= E then
							if Q.bodyConn then
								pcall(function()
									Q.bodyConn:Disconnect()
								end)
							end
							Q.bodyChar = E
							Q.bodyConn = E.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
								Q.bodyDirty = true
							end)
						end
					end
					function Y.hideBody(Q, E)
						local I = os.clock()
						local C = I - (Q.bodyAt or 0)
						if Q.char ~= E or Q.bodyChar ~= E or not Q.body or Q.bodyDirty and C > 0.2 or C > 3 then
							Y.collectBody(Q, E)
						elseif I - (Q.hideAt or 0) < 0.25 then
							return
						end
						Q.hideAt = I
						for E, E in ipairs(Q.body) do
							if E.Parent and E.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
								E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
								Q.hidden[E] = true
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.showBody(Q)
						for E in pairs(Q.hidden) do
							if E.Parent then
								pcall(function()
									E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end)
							end
						end
						Q.hidden = {}
						Q.body = nil
					end
					function Y.corpseFree(Q)
						if Q.watch then
							pcall(function()
								Q.watch:Disconnect()
							end)
							Q.watch = nil
						end
						if Q.model then
							pcall(function()
								Q.model:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						for E, E in ipairs(Q.hidden or {}) do
							if E.Parent then
								pcall(function()
									E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end)
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.adopt(Q, E)
						if Q.corpses[E] or not Q.model or not Q.links then
							return
						end
						local I = Q.model:Clone()
						I.Name = "PulseRemoteSkinCorpse"
						local C = {
							model = I,
							map = {},
							hidden = {},
							seen = {},
							fade = -1.0,
							links = Q.links,
							t0 = os.clock(),
						}
						for H, H in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								C.map[H.Name] = H
							end
						end
						C.joints = U.joints(I)
						C.parts = {}
						for H, H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								U.ghost(H)
								if H.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
									C.parts[#C.parts + 1] = H
								end
							end
						end
						C.root = I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						I.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
						for H, H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants()) do
							if H:IsA("BasePart") then
								H.CanCollide, H.CanTouch, H.CanQuery = false, false, false
							end
						end
						Q.corpses[E] = C
					end
					function Y.corpseStep(Q)
						for E, I in pairs(Q.corpses) do
							if not E.Parent or not I.model.Parent then
								Y.corpseFree(I)
								Q.corpses[E] = nil
							else
								local Q = os.clock()
								if I.dirty ~= false or Q - (I.scanAt or 0) > 1 then
									I.dirty, I.scanAt = false, Q
									if not I.watch then
										I.watch = E.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
											I.dirty = true
										end)
									end
									for Q, Q in ipairs(E:GetDescendants()) do
										if U.isA(Q, "BasePart") or U.isA(Q, "Decal") then
											if Q.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
												Q.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
											end
											if not I.seen[Q] then
												I.seen[Q] = true
												I.hidden[#I.hidden + 1] = Q
											end
										end
									end
								end
								local Q = I.map.LowerTorso
								if not I.done then
									U.pose(I.links, function(E)
										return I.map[E.Name]
									end, I.joints, I.root)
									if Q and Q.Anchored and os.clock() - I.t0 > 5 then
										I.done = true
									end
								end
								local Q = U.fadeOf(I.hidden)
								if Q ~= I.fade then
									I.fade = Q
									for E, E in ipairs(I.parts) do
										if E.Parent then
											E.LocalTransparencyModifier = Q
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.matchDeath(Q)
						local E = Q.death
						if not E or E.done then
							return
						end
						if os.clock() - E.t > 4 then
							E.done = true
							return
						end
						for I, I in ipairs(Y.raggies) do
							if os.clock() - I.t < 6 and I.m.Parent and not I.taken then
								local C = I.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or I.m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local H, n = pcall(U.sig, I.m)
								if
									C
									and (C.Position - E.pos).Magnitude < 12
									and (E.sig == "||" or H and n == E.sig)
								then
									E.done = true
									E.corpse = I.m
									I.taken = true
									Y.adopt(Q, I.m)
									return
								end
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.watchRaggy(Q)
						if Q.Name == "Raggy" and Q:IsA("Model") then
							local E, I = os.clock(), {}
							for C, C in ipairs(Y.raggies) do
								if E - C.t < 6 then
									I[#I + 1] = C
								end
							end
							I[#I + 1] = { m = Q, t = E }
							Y.raggies = I
						end
					end
					function Y.stepOne(Q)
						local E = Q.plr
						pcall(Y.corpseStep, Q)
						local I = Q.model
						if not I then
							return
						end
						local C = E.Character
						local E = C and PulseFCC(C, "Humanoid")
						local H = workspace.CurrentCamera
						pcall(Y.matchDeath, Q)
						local n = C ~= nil
							and E ~= nil
							and C.Parent ~= nil
							and E.Health <= 0
							and Q.char == C
							and Q.links ~= nil
						if n then
							if not Q.death or Q.death.ch ~= C then
								local n = C:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or C:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local O, N = pcall(U.sig, C)
								Q.death = {
									ch = C,
									t = os.clock(),
									pos = n and n.Position or Vector3.zero,
									sig = O and N or "||",
								}
								pcall(Y.matchDeath, Q)
							end
							Y.restoreGrips(Q)
							local n = Q.death.corpse ~= nil and Q.corpses[Q.death.corpse] ~= nil
							if
								n
								or not U.pose(Q.links, function(n)
									return n
								end, nil, I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
							then
								if I.Parent then
									I.Parent = nil
								end
							elseif I.Parent ~= H then
								I.Parent = H
								Y.solid(Q)
							end
							Y.hideBody(Q, C)
							local n = U.fadeOf(Q.body or {})
							if n ~= Q.deadFade then
								Q.deadFade = n
								for O, O in ipairs(Q.parts or {}) do
									if O.Parent then
										O.LocalTransparencyModifier = n
									end
								end
							end
							return
						end
						if not (C and E and E.Health > 0 and PulseFC(C, "HumanoidRootPart")) then
							if I.Parent then
								I.Parent = nil
							end
							Y.showBody(Q)
							Y.restoreGrips(Q)
							Q.char, Q.links = nil, nil
							return
						end
						if Q.deadFade then
							Q.deadFade = nil
							for E, E in ipairs(Q.parts or {}) do
								if E.Parent then
									E.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
								end
							end
						end
						if Q.char ~= C or Q.links == nil and os.clock() - (Q.attachAt or 0) > 0.5 then
							Q.attachAt = os.clock()
							Q.driven = nil
							Y.showBody(Q)
							Y.restoreGrips(Q)
							pcall(Y.attach, Q, C)
						end
						if not Q.links then
							return
						end
						if I.Parent ~= H then
							I.Parent = H
							Q.driven = nil
							Y.solid(Q)
						end
						local E = Y.view
						if Q.driven and E.cam then
							local H = PulseFC(C, "HumanoidRootPart").Position
							local n = (H - E.eye).Magnitude
							if n > 12 then
								local O = E.cam:WorldToViewportPoint(H)
								if O.Z < -6.0 or O.X < -E.mx or O.X > E.w + E.mx or O.Y < -E.my or O.Y > E.h + E.my then
									return
								end
								if n > 100 then
									Q.tick = (Q.tick or 0) + 1
									if Q.tick % (n > 250 and 3 or 2) ~= 0 then
										return
									end
								end
							end
						end
						if not Y.drive(Q, C) then
							return
						end
						Q.driven = true
						Y.hideBody(Q, C)
						pcall(Y.gripFollow, Q, C)
						Q.worldFn = Q.worldFn or function(E, H)
							return Y.world(Q, E, H)
						end
						pcall(U.mountFollowOf, Q, C, I, Q.worldFn)
					end
					Y.view = {}
					function Y.step()
						local Q, E = Y.view, workspace.CurrentCamera
						Q.cam = E
						if E then
							local I = E.ViewportSize
							Q.eye, Q.w, Q.h, Q.mx, Q.my = E.CFrame.Position, I.X, I.Y, I.X * 0.35, I.Y * 0.35
						end
						for Q, Q in pairs(Y.list) do
							local E = pcall(Y.stepOne, Q)
							if not E then
								Q.links = nil
							end
						end
					end
					function Y.bind()
						local Q = next(Y.list) ~= nil
						if Q and not Y.bound then
							Y.bound = true
							y:BindToRenderStep("PulseRSkinStep", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, function()
								pcall(Y.step)
							end)
							Y.addConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(Y.watchRaggy)
						elseif not Q and Y.bound then
							Y.bound = false
							pcall(function()
								y:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseRSkinStep")
							end)
							if Y.addConn then
								Y.addConn:Disconnect()
								Y.addConn = nil
							end
							Y.raggies = {}
						end
					end
					function Y.drop(y)
						y.token = (y.token or 0) + 1
						Y.showBody(y)
						Y.restoreGrips(y)
						for Q, E in pairs(y.corpses) do
							Y.corpseFree(E)
							y.corpses[Q] = nil
						end
						if y.bodyConn then
							pcall(function()
								y.bodyConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							y.bodyConn = nil
						end
						if y.model then
							pcall(function()
								y.model:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						y.model, y.char, y.links = nil, nil, nil
					end
					function Y.clear(y)
						local Q = Y.list[y]
						if not Q then
							return
						end
						Y.list[y] = nil
						Y.drop(Q)
						Y.bind()
						U.notify(y)
					end
					function Y.descOf(y)
						local Q
						if y.u then
							Q = "u" .. tostring(y.u)
						elseif y.b then
							Q = "b" .. tostring(y.b)
						else
							return nil
						end
						local E = Y.descs[Q]
						if E then
							return E
						end
						local E
						if y.u then
							local I, C = pcall(function()
								return S:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(y.u)
							end)
							if I then
								E = C
							end
						else
							local I, C = pcall(U.fromBundle, y.b)
							if I and C then
								E = C
							else
								E = k(y.b)
							end
						end
						if E then
							Y.descs[Q] = E
						end
						return E
					end
					function Y.build(k, y, Q, E)
						y.token = (y.token or 0) + 1
						local I = y.token
						local C = Y.descOf(Q)
						if I ~= y.token or Y.list[k] ~= y then
							return
						end
						if not C then
							y.failAt = os.clock()
							return
						end
						local Q = C
						if E then
							local E, H = pcall(function()
								return C:Clone()
							end)
							if E and H then
								pcall(function()
									H.RightLeg = U.KB_LEG
								end)
								Q = H
							end
						end
						local E, C = pcall(function()
							return S:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(Q, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
						end)
						if I ~= y.token or Y.list[k] ~= y then
							if E and typeof(C) == "Instance" then
								C:Destroy()
							end
							return
						end
						if not E or typeof(C) ~= "Instance" then
							y.failAt = os.clock()
							return
						end
						local k, Q, E, I = pcall(Y.prep, C)
						if not k or E == nil then
							C:Destroy()
							y.failAt = os.clock()
							return
						end
						Y.showBody(y)
						Y.restoreGrips(y)
						if y.model then
							pcall(function()
								y.model:Destroy()
							end)
						end
						y.model, y.cj, y.cg, y.parts, y.char, y.links = C, Q, E, I, nil, nil
						U.headless(C, y.hl == true)
						y.hlOn = y.hl == true
					end
					function Y.set(k, y, Q, E)
						if typeof(k) ~= "Instance" or k == M then
							return
						end
						local I = type(y) == "table" and tonumber(y.u) or nil
						local C = type(y) == "table" and tonumber(y.b) or nil
						if I and (I < 1 or I >= 10000000000000) then
							I = nil
						end
						if C and (C < 1 or C >= 10000000000000) then
							C = nil
						end
						if not I and not C then
							Y.clear(k)
							return
						end
						local y = I and { u = math.floor(I) } or { b = math.floor(C) }
						local C = (I and "u" .. y.u or "b" .. y.b) .. (Q and "|k" or "")
						local I = Y.list[k]
						if I and I.key == C then
							I.hl = E == true
							if I.model and I.hlOn ~= I.hl then
								U.headless(I.model, I.hl)
								I.hlOn = I.hl
							end
							if I.model or I.busy or os.clock() - (I.failAt or 0) < 30 then
								return
							end
						end
						if not I then
							I = { plr = k, hidden = {}, grips = {}, corpses = {} }
							Y.list[k] = I
						else
							Y.drop(I)
						end
						I.key, I.hl, I.failAt = C, E == true, nil
						Y.bind()
						I.gen = (I.gen or 0) + 1
						local E = I.gen
						I.busy = true
						task.spawn(function()
							pcall(Y.build, k, I, y, Q)
							if I.gen == E then
								I.busy = false
							end
						end)
					end
					function Y.modelOf(k)
						local y = Y.list[k]
						return y and y.model or nil
					end
					function Y.liveModel(k)
						local y = Y.list[k]
						local Q = y and y.model
						if Q and y.links and Q.Parent and y.char == k.Character then
							return Q
						end
						return nil
					end
					function Y.clearAll()
						for k in pairs(Y.list) do
							Y.clear(k)
						end
					end
					a(S.PlayerRemoving, function(S)
						Y.clear(S)
					end)
					T(function()
						pcall(Y.clearAll)
					end)
				end
				getgenv().__pulseSkinMine = function()
					if U.model and type(U.pub) == "table" then
						return U.pub
					end
					return nil
				end
				local T = {
					{ key = "IdleAnimation", label = "Idle" },
					{ key = "WalkAnimation", label = "Walk" },
					{ key = "RunAnimation", label = "Run" },
					{ key = "JumpAnimation", label = "Jump" },
					{ key = "FallAnimation", label = "Fall" },
					{ key = "ClimbAnimation", label = "Climb" },
					{ key = "SwimAnimation", label = "Swim" },
				}
				local S = {
					idle = "IdleAnimation",
					walk = "WalkAnimation",
					run = "RunAnimation",
					jump = "JumpAnimation",
					fall = "FallAnimation",
					climb = "ClimbAnimation",
					swim = "SwimAnimation",
					swimidle = "SwimAnimation",
				}
				local function k(y)
					local Q = {}
					local E = y and y:FindFirstChild("Animate")
					if not E then
						return Q
					end
					for y, y in ipairs(E:GetChildren()) do
						local E = S[string.lower(y.Name)]
						if E then
							for S, S in ipairs(y:GetChildren()) do
								if S:IsA("Animation") then
									local y = tostring(S.AnimationId):match("%d+")
									if y and y ~= "0" then
										Q[E] = Q[E] or {}
										Q[E][S.Name] = S.AnimationId
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					return Q
				end
				local function S(y)
					local Q = {}
					if type(y) == "table" then
						for E, I in pairs(y) do
							if type(I) == "table" then
								Q[E] = { id = I.id, name = I.name }
							end
						end
					end
					return Q
				end
				local function y(Q)
					local E = M.Character
					if not E or not E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
						return false, "No character"
					end
					local I = false
					for C, C in ipairs(T) do
						if K.mix[C.key] then
							I = true
							break
						end
					end
					if not I then
						return false, "Assign at least one slot first (tap SET)"
					end
					local I = k(E)
					local k = {}
					for C, C in ipairs(T) do
						local H = K.mix[C.key]
						local n = H and tonumber(H.id)
						if n then
							if k[n] == nil then
								if Q then
									pcall(Q, "Loading " .. (H.name or "ID " .. n) .. "")
								end
								k[n] = l(n) or false
							end
							local l = k[n]
							if l and l[C.key] then
								I[C.key] = l[C.key]
							end
						end
					end
					if not x(E, I) then
						return false, "Couldn't apply mix (no Animator)"
					end
					K.lastMode = "mix"
					c()
					w()
					return true, "Applied mix (visible to all)"
				end
				local function c()
					q()
					local l = M.Character
					local x = l and l:FindFirstChild("Animate")
					if x then
						pcall(function()
							x.Disabled = true
							task.wait(0.1)
							x.Disabled = false
						end)
					end
					K.lastBundle = nil
					w()
					return true, "Default animations restored"
				end
				local l = { track = nil, conns = {} }
				local function x()
					for k, k in ipairs(l.conns) do
						pcall(function()
							k:Disconnect()
						end)
					end
					l.conns = {}
					if l.track then
						pcall(function()
							l.track:Stop(0.2)
						end)
						l.track = nil
					end
				end
				local function k(Q)
					local E = tostring(Q):match("%d+")
					if not E then
						return nil
					end
					local Q = "e" .. E
					if u[Q] then
						return u[Q]
					end
					local I = h(E)
					if I then
						u[Q] = I
						s()
						return I
					end
					local h, I = pcall(function()
						return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. E)
					end)
					if h and I then
						for h, h in ipairs(I) do
							local I = { h }
							for C, C in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
								I[#I + 1] = C
							end
							for h, h in ipairs(I) do
								if h:IsA("Animation") then
									local I = h.AnimationId:match("%d+")
									if I then
										u[Q] = I
										s()
										return I
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					return E
				end
				local function u(s, h)
					local Q = M.Character
					local E = Q and Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local Q = E and E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
					if not Q then
						return false, "No character"
					end
					local I = k(s)
					if not I then
						return false, "Couldn't load emote"
					end
					x()
					local s = Instance.new("Animation")
					s.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. I
					local k, C = pcall(function()
						return Q:LoadAnimation(s)
					end)
					if not k or not C then
						return false, "Couldn't load emote"
					end
					C.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
					C.Looped = true
					l.track = C
					pcall(function()
						C:Play(0.15)
					end)
					C:AdjustSpeed(K.emoteSpeed or 1)
					l.conns = {
						a(E.Running, function(s)
							if not K.emoteHold and s and s > 0.5 then
								x()
							end
						end),
						a(E.Jumping, function(s)
							if not K.emoteHold and s then
								x()
							end
						end),
					}
					return true, "Playing emote: " .. (h or "ID " .. I)
				end
				local function s()
					if l.track then
						pcall(function()
							l.track:AdjustSpeed(K.emoteSpeed or 1)
						end)
					end
				end
				local h = a(M.CharacterAdded, function(l)
					l:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
					task.wait(1)
					if K.autoLoad == false then
						return
					end
					if K.lastMode == "mix" then
						y()

					elseif K.lastBundle then

						end)
					end
				end)

					end

					K.lastBundle = T.lastBundle
					K.speed = tonumber(T.speed) or 1
					K.emoteSpeed = tonumber(T.emoteSpeed) or 1
					K.mix = type(T.mix) == "table" and T.mix or {}
					K.mixSaves = type(T.mixSaves) == "table" and T.mixSaves or {}
					K.skinMix = type(T.skinMix) == "table" and T.skinMix or {}
					K.skin = type(T.skin) == "table" and T.skin or nil
					K.lastMode = T.lastMode or "bundle"
					K.toggleKey = type(T.toggleKey) == "string" and T.toggleKey or "RightShift"
					K.autoLoad = T.autoLoad ~= false
					K.emoteHold = T.emoteHold == true
					K.animPreview = T.animPreview ~= false
					W = L(K.toggleKey)

					B.speedMul = K.speed

					pcall(x)

							pcall(U.applySaved, B)
						end
						if t.applyGen ~= T then
							return
						end

							pcall(y)
						elseif L then
							pcall(function()
								r(tonumber(L))
							end)
						else
							pcall(q)

							local V = W and W:FindFirstChild("Animate")
							if V then
								pcall(function()
									V.Disabled = true
									task.wait(0.1)
									V.Disabled = false
								end)
							end
						end
						if t.applyGen ~= T then
							return
						end
						K.lastBundle, K.lastMode, K.skin = L, c, B
						w()
						if t.uiRefresh then
							pcall(t.uiRefresh)
						end
						if t.paintPresets then
							pcall(t.paintPresets)
						end
						if t.favRefresh then
							pcall(t.favRefresh)
						end
					end)
