	end,
	J = function(G)
		local a = G[3]
		local A = G[2]
		local F = G[6]
		local T = G[8]
		local f = G[5]
		local J = G[4]
		local X = G[0]
		local t = G[1]
		local R = G[7]
		return function()
			local G = game:GetService("RunService")
			local B = game:GetService("Workspace")
			local U
			pcall(function()
				U = require(t.Modules.CurrentRoundClient)
			end)
			local function t()
				local U = A.Character
				local M = U and PulseFC(U, "Gun")
				if M then
					return M
				end
				local U = PulseFC(A, "Backpack")
				return U and PulseFC(U, "Gun")
			end
			local function U()
				local M = A.Character
				return M and M:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
			local function M()
				return isAlive(J)
			end
			local function c()
				local K = getgenv().__pulseDuel
				if K and K.on then
					return K.pick()
				end
				local K = M()
				for w, w in ipairs(PulsePlayers()) do
					local L = K[w.Name]
					if L and L.Role == "Murderer" and L.Dead ~= true and L.Killed ~= true then
						local K = w.Character
						local L = K and K:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						if K and L and L.Health > 0 then
							return w, K
						end
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function K(K)
				return K and (K:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or K:FindFirstChild("Head"))
			end
			local K = game:GetService("Stats")
			local function w()
				local L, W = pcall(function()
					return K.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
				end)
				if L and W and W == W then
					return math.clamp(W / 1000, 0, 1)
				end
				return 0.1
			end
			do
				local L = game:GetService("RunService")
				local W = {
					rtt = 0.1,
					jit = 0.01,
					interp = 0.08,
					wire = 0,
					up = 0.05,
					n = 0,
					lastL = 0,
					hbias = 0,
					hn = 0,
					tHist = {},
					mHist = {},
					rawHist = {},
					char = nil,
					pend = nil,
				}
				local function V(r, _, q)
					return r + (_ - r) * q
				end
				local function r()
					return math.max(W.rtt, W.wire)
				end
				local function _()
					local q
					local u, s = pcall(function()
						return A:GetNetworkPing()
					end)
					if u and type(s) == "number" and s == s and s >= 0 and s < 2 then
						q = s
					end
					local u, s = pcall(function()
						return K.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
					end)
					if u and type(s) == "number" and s == s and s >= 0 and s < 2000 then
						q = q and math.max(q, s / 1000) or s / 1000
					end
					return q
				end
				local K = {}
				function K.leadT()
					return math.clamp(
						r() + W.interp + math.clamp(W.hbias, -0.08, 0.2) + (tonumber(X.sheriff.predEx) or 0),
				0.02,
						0.6
					)
				end
				function K.jitter()
					return W.jit
				end
				function K.uplink()
					return W.up
				end
				function K.stats()
					return {
						rtt = W.rtt,
						wire = W.wire,
						jit = W.jit,
						interp = W.interp,
						up = W.up,
						n = W.n,
						hbias = W.hbias,
						hn = W.hn,
						lead = K.leadT(),
					}
				end
				function K.note(q, u, s, h)
					local Y = u - q
					if Y.Magnitude < 0.5 then
						W.pend = nil
						return
					end
					W.pend = {
						t = os.clock(),
						o = q,
						u = Y.Unit,
						char = s,
						v = h or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
						rh = W.rawHist,
						base = r() + W.interp,
					}
				end
				function K.onFired(q, u, s)
					local h = W.pend
					if not h then
						return
					end
					if typeof(q) == "Vector3" then
						h.startP = q
					end
					if typeof(u) == "Vector3" and typeof(s) == "Instance" and h.char and s:IsDescendantOf(h.char) then
						h.endP = u
						local q = 0.5
						pcall(function()
							local u, Y = s.CFrame, s.Size
							q = 0.5
								* (
									math.abs(u.RightVector:Dot(h.u)) * Y.X
									+ math.abs(u.UpVector:Dot(h.u)) * Y.Y
									+ math.abs(u.LookVector:Dot(h.u)) * Y.Z
								)
						end)
						h.hw = math.clamp(q, 0.2, 1.2)
					end
					local q = os.clock() - h.t
					if q > 0.005 and q < 1.2 then
						if W.wire > 0 then
							W.jit = V(W.jit, math.abs(q - W.wire), 0.2)
						end
						W.wire = W.wire > 0 and V(W.wire, q, 0.25) or q
					end
				end
				local function q(u, s, h, Y)
					local l, x
					for S = s, 1, -1.0 do
						if not l and u[s].t - u[S].t >= h then
							l = u[S]
						end
						if l and l.t - u[S].t >= Y then
							x = u[S]
							break
						end
					end
					if not (x and l) then
						return nil
					end
					local u = l.t - x.t
					if u < 0.03 then
						return nil
					end
					local s = (l.p - x.p) / u
					return Vector3.new(s.X, 0, s.Z), (l.t + x.t) * 0.5
				end
				function K.turnRate()
					local u = W.tHist
					local s = #u
					if s < 5 then
						return 0
					end
					local h, Y = q(u, s, 0, 0.12)
					local l, x = q(u, s, 0.12, 0.12)
					if not (h and l and Y and x) then
						return 0
					end
					if h.Magnitude < 4 or l.Magnitude < 4 then
						return 0
					end
					local q, u = l.Unit, h.Unit
					local s = Vector3.new(-q.Z, 0, q.X)
					local h = math.atan2(s:Dot(u), q:Dot(u))
					local q = Y - x
					if q < 0.03 then
						return 0
					end
					local u = h / q
					if u ~= u then
						return 0
					end
					return math.clamp(u, -6.0, 6)
				end
				function K.arcLead(q, u)
					local s = q.Magnitude
					if s < 0.001 or u <= 0 then
						return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), q
					end
					local h = q.Unit
					local Y = K.turnRate()
					if math.abs(Y) < 0.35 then
						return q * u, q
					end
					local q = Vector3.new(-h.Z, 0, h.X)
					local l, x = s / Y, math.clamp(Y * u, -1.0, 1)
					local u = h * (l * math.sin(x)) + q * (l * (1 - math.cos(x)))
					local Y = (h * math.cos(x) + q * math.sin(x)) * s
					return u, Y
				end
				local q = { HumanoidRootPart = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, Torso = true, Head = true }
				function K.bestPart(u, s)
					if not u or typeof(s) ~= "Vector3" or s.Magnitude < 0.001 then
						return nil, 0
					end
					local h = s.Unit
					local s = math.abs(h.Y) > 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
					local Y = h:Cross(s)
					if Y.Magnitude < 0.001 then
						return nil, 0
					end
					Y = Y.Unit
					local s = h:Cross(Y).Unit
					local h, l
					for x, x in ipairs(u:GetChildren()) do
						if x:IsA("BasePart") and q[x.Name] and x.Transparency < 1 then
							local q, u = x.CFrame, x.Size
							local S, k, y = u.X * 0.5, u.Y * 0.5, u.Z * 0.5
							local u, Q, E = q.RightVector, q.UpVector, q.LookVector
							local q = S * math.abs(u:Dot(Y)) + k * math.abs(Q:Dot(Y)) + y * math.abs(E:Dot(Y))
							local Y = S * math.abs(u:Dot(s)) + k * math.abs(Q:Dot(s)) + y * math.abs(E:Dot(s))
							local u = math.min(q, Y)
							if not l or u > l then
								h, l = x, u
							end
						end
					end
					return h, l or 0
				end
				function K.bestAxis(q, u)
					local s = q and (q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or q:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
					if not s then
						return nil, nil, 0
					end
					local h = s.CFrame
					local s = {
						Vector3.new(h.LookVector.X, 0, h.LookVector.Z),
						Vector3.new(h.RightVector.X, 0, h.RightVector.Z),
					}
					if u and u.Magnitude > 0.1 then
						s[#s + 1] = Vector3.new(u.X, 0, u.Z)
					end
					local u, h, Y
					for l, l in ipairs(s) do
						if l.Magnitude > 0.1 then
							local s = l.Unit
							local l, x = K.bestPart(q, s)
							if l and (not Y or x > Y) then
								u, h, Y = s, l, x
							end
						end
					end
					return u, h, Y or 0
				end
				local function q(u, s, h)
					local Y, l, x = {}, {}, {}
					for S = s, h do
						local s = u[S].p
						Y[#Y + 1] = s.X
						l[#l + 1] = s.Y
						x[#x + 1] = s.Z
					end
					if #Y == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					table.sort(Y)
					table.sort(l)
					table.sort(x)
					local u = math.floor(#Y / 2) + 1
					return Vector3.new(Y[u], l[u], x[u])
				end
				function K.jumpCycle()
					local u = W.rawHist
					local s = #u
					if s < 8 then
						return false, 0
					end
					local h = u[s].t
					local Y = 1
					for l = s, 1, -1.0 do
						if h - u[l].t > 0.6 then
							Y = l + 1
							break
						end
					end
					if s - Y + 1 < 8 then
						return false, 0
					end
					local h, l = math.huge, -math.huge
					local x, S = 0, 0
					for k = Y + 1, s do
						local s = u[k].p.Y
						if s < h then
							h = s
						end
						if s > l then
							l = s
						end
						local Y = s - u[k - 1].p.Y
						if math.abs(Y) > 0.05 then
							local u = Y > 0 and 1 or -1.0
							if S ~= 0 and u ~= S then
								x = x + 1
							end
							S = u
						end
					end
					local u = l - h
					return u > 4 and x >= 2, u
				end
				function K.resolve()
					local u = W.rawHist
					local s = #u
					if s < 6 then
						return nil, "none"
					end
					local h = u[s].t
					local Y = 1
					for l = s, 1, -1.0 do
						if h - u[l].t > 0.35 then
							Y = l + 1
							break
						end
					end
					if s - Y + 1 < 5 then
						return nil, "none"
					end
					local h = q(u, Y, s)
					if not h then
						return nil, "none"
					end
					local l, x, S, k = 0, 0, 0, 0
					for y = Y, s do
						local Q = (u[y].p - h).Magnitude
						x = x + Q
						S = S + 1
						if Q > k then
							k = Q
						end
						if Q > 50 then
							l = l + 1
						end
					end
					local y = S > 0 and x / S or 0
					if l > 0 and k > 100 then
						local l = {}
						for x = Y, s do
							if (u[x].p - h).Magnitude <= 25 then
								l[#l + 1] = u[x]
							end
						end
						if #l >= 3 then
							return q(l, 1, #l), "blink"
						end
						return nil, "none"
					end
					local q = (u[s].p - u[Y].p).Magnitude
					if y > 3 and q < y * 1.5 then
						return h, "jitter"
					end
					return nil, "clean"
				end
				getgenv().__pulseAimV3 = K
				task.spawn(function()
					local K = 0
					while isAlive(a) do
						L.Heartbeat:Wait()
						local q = X.sheriff
						if
							not (q and q.aimVer == "V3" and (q.silentAim or q.autoShoot or q.aimType == "Flick Shot"))
						then
							if W.char or #W.tHist > 0 then
								W.tHist, W.mHist, W.char, W.pend = {}, {}, nil, nil
							end
						else
							local q = os.clock()
							if q >= K then
								K = q + 0.25
								local K = _()
								if K then
									W.jit = V(W.jit, math.abs(K - W.rtt), 0.15)
									W.rtt = V(W.rtt, K, 0.25)
								end
							end
							pcall(function()
								local K, K = c()
								if W.char ~= K then
									W.char, W.tHist, W.rawHist = K, {}, {}
								end
								local _ = K and K:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								if _ then
									local K = W.tHist
									local u = 12
									if #K >= 2 then
										local s = math.max(K[#K].t - K[#K - 1].t, 0.016666666666666666)
										local h = (K[#K].p - K[#K - 1].p).Magnitude / s
										u = math.max(12, h * math.max(q - K[#K].t, 0.016666666666666666) * 3 + 8)
									end
									if #K > 0 and (_.Position - K[#K].p).Magnitude > u then
										K = {}
										W.tHist = K
									end
									K[#K + 1] = { t = q, p = _.Position }
									while #K > 2 and q - K[1].t > 1.1 do
										table.remove(K, 1)
									end
									local K = W.rawHist
									K[#K + 1] = { t = q, p = _.Position }
									while #K > 2 and q - K[1].t > 0.6 do
										table.remove(K, 1)
									end
								end
								local K = U()
								if K then
									local _ = W.mHist
									_[#_ + 1] = { t = q, p = K.Position }
									while #_ > 2 and q - _[1].t > 1.1 do
										table.remove(_, 1)
									end
								end
							end)
						end
					end
				end)
				task.spawn(function()
					while isAlive(a) do
						L.Heartbeat:Wait()
						local K = W.pend
						if K and os.clock() - K.t > 0.7 then
							W.pend = nil
							pcall(function()
								if typeof(K.startP) == "Vector3" then
									local L, _, q = nil, nil, false
									for u, u in ipairs(W.mHist) do
										local s = u.t - K.t
										if s >= -0.02 and s <= 0.5 then
											local h = (u.p - K.startP).Magnitude
											if not _ or h < _ then
												_, L = h, s
											end
										end
										if math.abs(u.t - K.t) < 0.4 and (u.p - K.startP).Magnitude > 4 then
											q = true
										end
									end
									if L and _ and _ < 2 and q then
										W.up = V(W.up, math.clamp(L, 0, 0.5), 0.2)
									end
								end
								if typeof(K.endP) == "Vector3" and K.rh then
									local L = K.rh
									local _, q, u = nil, nil, 0
									for s, h in ipairs(L) do
										local Y = h.t - K.t
										if Y >= 0.01 and Y <= 0.65 then
											u = u + 1
											local Y = (h.p - K.endP).Magnitude
											if not q or Y < q then
												q, _ = Y, s
											end
										end
									end
									if _ and q and q < 6 and u >= 5 then
										local q = L[_]
										local u
										for s = _, 1, -1.0 do
											if q.t - L[s].t >= 0.1 then
												u = s
												break
											end
										end
										local _ = u and (q.p - L[u].p) / (q.t - L[u].t) or nil
										local L = _ and _.Magnitude or 0
										if L >= 8 then
											local u = _.Unit
											local _ = u:Dot(K.endP - q.p)
											local s = (K.endP - q.p - u * _).Magnitude
											local h = math.clamp((K.hw or 0.5) * K.u:Dot(u) / L, -0.08, 0.08)
											local u = q.t - K.t + _ / L + h
											if s < 2.5 and _ / L > -0.06 and _ / L < 0.2 and u > 0.03 and u < 0.6 then
												local L = math.clamp(u - (K.base or r() + W.interp), -0.15, 0.2)
												if W.hn <= 2 or math.abs(L - W.hbias) < 0.12 then
													W.hbias = V(W.hbias, L, W.hn < 3 and 0.4 or 0.15)
													W.hn = W.hn + 1
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end
								local L = K.v.Magnitude
								if L < 8 then
									return
								end
								local _ = L * (1 - math.abs(K.u:Dot(K.v.Unit)))
								if _ < 6 then
									return
								end
								local L = W.tHist
								if #L < 6 then
									return
								end
								local _, q, u, s
								for h, h in ipairs(L) do
									local L = h.t - K.t
									if L >= 0.01 and L <= 0.6 then
										local Y = h.p - K.o
										local h = (Y - K.u * Y:Dot(K.u)).Magnitude
										if not q or h < q then
											q, _ = h, L
										end
										u = u or L
										s = L
									end
								end
								if not (_ and q and u and s) then
									return
								end
								if q > 8 then
									return
								end
								if _ <= u + 0.02 or _ >= s - 0.02 then
									return
								end
								local K = _ - r()
								if K < 0 or K > 0.25 then
									return
								end
								if W.n > 3 and math.abs(K - W.interp) > 0.15 then
									return
								end
								W.interp = math.clamp(V(W.interp, K, 0.12), 0.02, 0.2)
								W.n, W.lastL = W.n + 1, _
							end)
						end
					end
				end)
			end
			local K = { part = nil, vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), hist = {} }
			task.spawn(function()
				local L = game:GetService("RunService")
				while isAlive(a) do

					if L and (L.silentAim or L.autoShoot or L.aimType == "Flick Shot") then
						pcall(function()

								K.part = nil
								K.vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

							end

							local _ = #V > 0 and math.max(L - V[#V].t, 0.016666666666666666) or 0.016666666666666666
							local q = math.max(12, r * _ * 3 + 8)
							if #V > 0 and (W.Position - V[#V].p).Magnitude > q then
								K.hist = { { t = L, p = W.Position } }
								K.vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
								return
							end
							V[#V + 1] = { t = L, p = W.Position }
							while #V > 2 and L - V[1].t > 0.28 do
								table.remove(V, 1)
							end
							local r = L - V[1].t
							if r >= 0.08 then
								local L = (W.Position - V[1].p) / r
								if L.Magnitude > 400 then
									L = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
								end
								K.vel = L
							end
						end)
					elseif K.part then
						K.part, K.vel, K.hist = nil, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), {}
					end
				end
			end)
			local L, W, V = nil, 0, false
			local function r()
				local r = B.CurrentCamera
				if not r or not L or not L.Parent or os.clock() > W then
					if V then
						pcall(function()
							G:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseAimCam")
						end)
						V = false
					end
					return
				end

				end)

			local function L(W)
				return W
					and (
						W:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
						or W:FindFirstChild("Torso")
						or W:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						or W:FindFirstChild("Head")
					)
			end
			local function W(W)
				local V = U()
				if X.sheriff.wallbang then
					local r = V and (V.Position - W).Magnitude > 0.1 and (V.Position - W).Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
					return W + r * 3
				end
				local r = V and V:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
				return r and r.WorldCFrame.Position or V and V.Position or W + Vector3.new(0, 0, 3)
			end
			local function W(V)
				local r = V and V:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not r then
					return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				local V
				if K.part == r then
					V = K.vel
					K.acc = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					if X.sheriff.aimVer == "V3" then
						local _ = K.vel
						local q = K.hist
						local u = #q
						if u >= 2 then
							local s = q[u]
							local h = u
							while h > 1 and s.t - q[h].t < 0.1 do
								h = h - 1
							end
							local u = s.t - q[h].t
							if u >= 0.06 then
								local Y = (s.p - q[h].p) / u
								if Y.Magnitude == Y.Magnitude and Y.Magnitude < 400 then
									_ = Y
								end
							end
						end
						local q = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
						if q.Magnitude ~= q.Magnitude then
							q = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
						end
						local u = Vector3.new(_.X, 0, _.Z)
						local _ = u.Magnitude * 1.5 + 8
						if q.Magnitude > _ and q.Magnitude > 0.001 then
							V = q.Unit * _
						else
							V = q
						end
					end
				else
					V = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					K.acc = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				local r = Vector3.new(V.X, 0, V.Z)
				if r.Magnitude ~= r.Magnitude then
					return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				if r.Magnitude > 400 then
					r = r.Unit * 400
				end
				return r
			end
			local function V(r, _)
				local q = 11
				pcall(function()
					local u = RaycastParams.new()
					u.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					u.FilterDescendantsInstances = { r, A.Character }
					local r = B:Raycast(_ + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 11, 0), u)
					if r then
						q = math.max(2.5, r.Position.Y - _.Y - 0.8)
					end
				end)
				return q
			end
			local r = { Effect = true, Rocket = true, Bullet = true, Handle = true, Coin = true }
			local _ = { vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), t = 0 }
			local function _(q)
				local u = {}
				pcall(function()
					for s, s in ipairs(R:GetPlayers()) do
						if s ~= A then
							local h = s.Character
							if h and h ~= q then
								local q = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								local s = h:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or h:FindFirstChild("Head")
								if q and q.Health > 0 and s then
									u[#u + 1] = s.Position
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				return u
			end
			local function q(u, s, h, Y)
				if #u == 0 then
					return true
				end
				local l = h - s
				if l.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
					return true
				end
				local h = l.Unit
				local l = 2500
				pcall(function()
					local x = { Y, A.Character }
					pcall(function()
						for Y, Y in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
							x[#x + 1] = Y
						end
					end)
					local Y = getgenv().__pulseXrayOrig
					local S = RaycastParams.new()
					S.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					S.IgnoreWater = true
					for k = 1, 10 do
						S.FilterDescendantsInstances = x
						local k = B:Raycast(s, h * l, S)
						if not k then
							return
						end
						local S = Y and Y[k.Instance]
						if S == nil then
							S = k.Instance.Transparency
						end
						if k.Instance and (S == 1 or r[k.Instance.Name]) then
							x[#x + 1] = k.Instance
						else
							l = (k.Position - s).Magnitude + 1
							return
						end
					end
				end)
				local Y = h * l
				local h = Y:Dot(Y)
				for l, l in ipairs(u) do
					local u = 0
					if h > 0.000001 then
						u = math.clamp((l - s):Dot(Y) / h, 0, 1)
					end
					if (l - (s + Y * u)).Magnitude < 5 then
						return false
					end
				end
				return true
			end
			local function u(s)
				local h = X.sheriff.fov
				if not (h and h.on) then
					return true
				end
				if (tonumber(h.size) or 220) >= 1500 then
					return s ~= nil
				end
				local Y = s and (s:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or s:FindFirstChild("Head"))
				if not Y then
					return false
				end
				local s = B.CurrentCamera
				if not s then
					return true
				end
				local l, x = pcall(function()
					local S, k = s:WorldToViewportPoint(Y.Position)
					if not k or S.Z <= 0 then
						return false
					end
					local Y = s.ViewportSize
					local s, k = S.X - Y.X * 0.5, S.Y - Y.Y * 0.5
					local Y = tonumber(h.size) or 220
					return s * s + k * k <= Y * Y
				end)
				return l and x or false
			end

			local function h(Y, l, x)
				local S = { A.Character }
				if x then
					for k, k in ipairs(x) do
						S[#S + 1] = k
					end
				end

						S[#S + 1] = x
					end
				end)
				local x = RaycastParams.new()
				x.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				x.IgnoreWater = true
				for k = 1, 10 do
					x.FilterDescendantsInstances = S
					local k = B:Raycast(Y, l, x)
					if not k then
						return nil
					end
					if k.Instance and (s(k.Instance) == 1 or r[k.Instance.Name]) then
						S[#S + 1] = k.Instance
					else
						return k
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function r(s, Y, l, x, S)
				local k = Y - s
				if k.Magnitude < 0.5 then
					return false
				end
				local y = false
				pcall(function()
					local Q = h(s, k.Unit * (k.Magnitude + 45))
					y = Q ~= nil and Q.Instance:IsDescendantOf(l)
					if not y and S then
						local E = Q ~= nil and (Q.Position - s).Magnitude < k.Magnitude - 0.5
						if not E then
							local k = S.Position - s
							if k.Magnitude >= 0.5 then
								local S = h(s, k.Unit * (k.Magnitude + 45))
								y = S ~= nil and S.Instance:IsDescendantOf(l)
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				if not y then
					return false
				end
				return q(x, s, Y, l)
			end
			local s =
				{ confirmT = 0, lastHit = nil, lastEnd = nil, lastStart = nil, pending = nil, tries = 0, armed = false }

			local Y = { char = nil, t = 0, u = nil }
			local S = { t = 0, w = 0 }
			local function k(y, Q)
				if not y or not y.Parent then
					return nil
				end
				local E = y:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not E or E.Health <= 0 then
					return nil
				end
				local I = U()
				if not I then
					return nil
				end
				local C = I:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
				local H = C and C.WorldCFrame.Position or I.Position
				do
					local C = getgenv().__pulseFakePos
					if type(C) == "table" and C.active and typeof(C.off) == "Vector3" then
						H = H - C.off
					end
				end
				if X.sheriff.aimVer == "V3" then
					pcall(function()
						local C = getgenv().__pulseAimV3
						local n = C and C.uplink and C.uplink() or 0
						local C = I.AssemblyLinearVelocity
						if n > 0 and typeof(C) == "Vector3" and C.Magnitude > 8 then
							H = H + Vector3.new(C.X, 0, C.Z) * math.clamp(n, 0, 0.3)
						end
					end)
				end
				local I = y:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or L(y)
				local C, n = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), "off"
				if X.sheriff.resolver and X.sheriff.aimVer == "V3" and I then
					local O = getgenv().__pulseAimV3
					if O and O.resolve then
						local N, z, D = pcall(O.resolve)
						if N then
							n = D or "none"
							if typeof(z) == "Vector3" then
								C = z - I.Position

				V.duel = function()
					local Q = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or nil
					local I = Q and rawget(Q, "__pulseDuel")
					if I and I.on and I.pick then
						return I
					end
					return nil
				end
				V.murderer = function(Q)
					local I = V.duel()
					if I then
						return I.pick()
					end
					for I, I in ipairs(h()) do
						local C = Q[I.Name]
						if I ~= E and C and C.Role == "Murderer" and C.Dead ~= true and C.Killed ~= true then
							local Q = I.Character
							local C = Q and q(Q, "Humanoid")
							if Q and C and C.Health > 0 and _(Q, "HumanoidRootPart") then
								return I, Q
							end
						end
					end
				end
				V.passthrough = PULSE_NV(function()
					local Q = {}
					pcall(function()
						for I, I in ipairs(y:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
							Q[#Q + 1] = I
						end
					end)
					return Q
				end)
				V.serverRay = PULSE_NV(function(y, Q, I, C)
					local H = C and V.passthrough() or {}
					if E.Character then
						H[#H + 1] = E.Character
					end
					for C, C in ipairs(I or {}) do
						H[#H + 1] = C
					end
					local I = RaycastParams.new()
					I.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					I.IgnoreWater = true
					for C = 1, 12 do
						I.FilterDescendantsInstances = H
						local C = workspace:Raycast(y, Q, I)
						if not C then
							return nil
						end
						if not V.skipTransparent or C.Instance.Transparency < 1 then
							return C
						end
						H[#H + 1] = C.Instance
					end
				end)
				V.insideSolid = PULSE_NV(function(y, Q)
					local I = V.probePart
					if not I then
						I = Instance.new("Part")
						I.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
						I.Anchored = true
						I.CanCollide = false
						I.CanQuery = false
						I.CanTouch = false
						V.probePart = I
					end
					I.CFrame = CFrame.new(y)
					local y = OverlapParams.new()
					y.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					local C = {}
					for H, H in ipairs(r:GetPlayers()) do
						if H.Character then
							C[#C + 1] = H.Character
						end
					end
					y.FilterDescendantsInstances = C
					y.RespectCanCollide = true
					if Q then
						pcall(function()
							y.CollisionGroup = Q
						end)
					end
					local Q, C = pcall(workspace.GetPartsInPart, workspace, I, y)
					if not Q then
						return nil
					end
					for y, y in ipairs(C) do
						if y.CanQuery and y.CanCollide then
							local Q = y:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
							if not (Q and Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
								return y
							end
						end
					end
					return nil
				end)
				V.moveParams = PULSE_NV(function()
					local y = RaycastParams.new()
					y.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					y.IgnoreWater = true
					y.RespectCanCollide = true
					local Q = {}
					for I, I in ipairs(r:GetPlayers()) do
						if I.Character then
							Q[#Q + 1] = I.Character
						end
					end
					y.FilterDescendantsInstances = Q
					return y
				end)
				V.sample = function(y)
					local Q = _(y, "HumanoidRootPart")
					local I = q(y, "Humanoid")
					if not (Q and I) then
						return nil
					end
					local y = I.UseJumpPower and I.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * (V.G or workspace.Gravity) * I.JumpHeight)
					return {
						t = os.clock(),
						p = Q.Position,
						cf = Q.CFrame,
						md = I.MoveDirection,
						ws = I.WalkSpeed,
						v = Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity,
						st = I:GetState(),
						air = I.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air,
						jump = I.Jump,
						hh = I.HipHeight,
						jp = y,
					}
				end
				V.median = function(y)
					local Q = #y
					if Q == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local I = table.clone(y)
					table.sort(I)
					if Q % 2 == 1 then
						return I[(Q + 1) / 2]
					end
					return (I[Q / 2] + I[Q / 2 + 1]) * 0.5
				end
				V.watchLag = PULSE_NV(function(y, Q, I, C, H)
					local n = V.lagDB[y.UserId]
					if not n then
						n = { js = {} }
						V.lagDB[y.UserId] = n
					end
					if n.c ~= Q then
						n.c, n.py, n.ev = Q, nil, nil
					end
					local y = C:GetState()
					local Q = I.Position.Y
					if n.py then
						local I = n.ev
						if I then
							if Q <= I.ymin + 0.05 then
								if Q < I.ymin then
									I.ymin = Q
								end
								I.tmin = H
							end
							if Q > I.ymin + 0.3 and Q - n.py > 0.25 then
								local C = I.tmin - I.t0 + 0.008
								if C > 0.04 and C < 0.5 then
									local O, N = n.js, V.lagPool
									O[#O + 1] = C
									if #O > 7 then
										table.remove(O, 1)
									end
									N[#N + 1] = C
									if #N > 40 then
										table.remove(N, 1)
									end
									V.lagVer = (V.lagVer or 0) + 1
									V.lagCount = (V.lagCount or 0) + 1
									if V.lagCount % 8 == 0 and #N >= 8 then
										V.lagPrior = V.median(N)
										V.saveState()
									end
								end
								n.ev = nil
							elseif H - I.t0 > 0.6 then
								n.ev = nil
							end
						elseif y == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and n.pst ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
							n.ev = { t0 = H, ymin = Q, tmin = H }
						end
					end
					n.py, n.pst = Q, y
				end)
				V.lagOf = function(y)
					local Q
					if y then
						local I = V.lagCP
						if I and V.lagCC == y and I.Character == y and I.Parent then
							Q = I
						else
							Q = r:GetPlayerFromCharacter(y)
							V.lagCC, V.lagCP = y, Q
						end
					end
					local y = Q and V.lagDB[Q.UserId]
					local Q = V.lagVer or 0
					local I
					if y and #y.js > 0 then
						if y.medVer ~= Q or y.medN ~= #y.js then
							y.medVer, y.medN, y.med = Q, #y.js, V.median(y.js)
						end
						I = y.med
					elseif y then
						I = false
					end
					local C
					if #V.lagPool >= 4 then
						if V.poolMedVer ~= Q or V.poolMedN ~= #V.lagPool or V.poolMedT ~= V.lagPool then
							V.poolMedVer, V.poolMedN, V.poolMedT, V.poolMed =
								Q, #V.lagPool, V.lagPool, V.median(V.lagPool)
						end
						C = V.poolMed
					end
					C = C or V.lagPrior
					local Q
					if I and C then
						local H = #y.js
						Q = (I * H + C * 3) / (H + 3)
					else
						Q = C or I and #y.js >= 2 and I or nil
					end
					if not Q then
						return 0
					end
					return math.clamp(Q - V.lagRef, -0.07, 0.25)
				end
				V.shiftJ = function()
					return V.useLagJ and V.shift or 0
				end
				V.shiftL = function()
					return V.useLagL and V.shift or 0
				end
				V.track = PULSE_NV(function()
					do
						local y = getgenv and getgenv()
						local Q = y and rawget(y, "__pulseWorldBase")
						V.G = type(Q) == "table" and tonumber(Q.Gravity) or workspace.Gravity
					end
					local y = V.roles()
					local Q, Q = V.murderer(y)
					if V.forced and V.forced.Parent then
						Q = V.forced
					end
					local I = V.queued
					if I and I.c and I.c.Parent then
						Q = I.c
					end
					if Q ~= V.target then
						V.target, V.hist = Q, {}
					end
					local I = os.clock()
					for C, C in ipairs(h()) do
						if C ~= E then
							local H = C.Character
							local n = H and _(H, "HumanoidRootPart")
							local O = H and q(H, "Humanoid")
							if n and O then
								V.watchLag(C, H, n, O, I)
							end
						end
					end
					V.shift = Q and V.lagOf(Q) or 0
					if Q then
						local I = V.sample(Q)
						if I and V.dsFarP(I.p) then
							local C = V.ds
							if not C or C.c ~= Q then
								C = { c = Q }
								V.ds = C
							end
							if not C.farAt or C.backAt then
								table.clear(V.hist)
								V.hcut = os.clock()
								C.since = I.t
							end
							C.farAt, C.backAt = I.t, nil
							I = nil
						elseif I and V.ds and V.ds.c == Q and V.ds.farAt and not V.ds.backAt then
							V.ds.backAt = I.t
							table.clear(V.hist)
							V.say(string.format("DESYNC back %s after %.2fs", Q.Name, I.t - (V.ds.since or V.ds.farAt)))
						end
						if I then
							local C = V.hist
							local H = C[#C]
							if not H or I.t - H.t >= 0.004166666666666667 then
								if H and (I.p - H.p).Magnitude > 8 then
									V.jumps = (V.jumps or 0) + 1
								end
								if H and (I.p - H.p).Magnitude > 60 and V.spikeOn ~= true then
									table.clear(C)
									V.hcut = os.clock()
								end
								C[#C + 1] = I
								if
									V.spoofOn ~= false
									and typeof(I.v) == "Vector3"
									and H
									and I.v.Magnitude >= (V.spoofMin or 400)
								then
									local n, O = pcall(V.kinVel, C, I.t, 0.1)
									O = n and typeof(O) == "Vector3" and O
										or (I.p - H.p) / math.max(I.t - H.t, 0.004166666666666667)
									if O.Magnitude < I.v.Magnitude * (V.spoofK or 0.25) then
										I.vr = I.v
										I.v = O
									end
								end
								while #C > 2 and I.t - C[1].t > 3 do
									table.remove(C, 1)
								end
							end
						end
					end
					V.othersC, V.othersData, V.othersDirty = Q, y, true
				end)
				V.getOthers = function()
					if not V.othersDirty then
						return V.others or {}
					end
					V.othersDirty = false
					local y, Q = V.othersC, V.othersData or {}
					local I = {}
					local C = V.duel()
					for H, H in ipairs(h()) do
						if H ~= E and H.Character ~= y and not (C and C.foes[H.Name]) then
							local h = Q[H.Name]
							local y = H.Character
							local Q = y and _(y, "HumanoidRootPart")
							local _ = y and q(y, "Humanoid")
							if Q and _ and _.Health > 0 and not (h and (h.Dead or h.Killed)) then
								I[#I + 1] = { c = y, p = Q.Position, md = _.MoveDirection, ws = _.WalkSpeed }
							end
						end
					end
					V.others = I
					return I
				end
				V.dsFarP = function(_)
					return _.X ~= _.X or _.Y ~= _.Y or _.Z ~= _.Z or _.Magnitude > (V.dsFar or 1000000)
				end
				V.dsHot = function(_)
					local q = V.ds
					if not q or not q.backAt or _ and q.c ~= _ then
						return false
					end
					return os.clock() - q.backAt < (V.dsWinT or 0.9)
				end
				V.spShots = false
				V.sp = { c = nil, on = false, since = 0, endAt = nil }
				V.spTick = function(_)
					local q = V.target
					local h = V.sp
					if h.c ~= q then
						h.c, h.on, h.since, h.endAt = q, false, 0, nil
					end
					if not q then
						return
					end
					local y, Q = pcall(V.spoofVel, q)
					local I = y and typeof(Q) == "Vector3"
					if I and not h.on then
						h.on, h.since = true, _
						V.say(string.format("SPOOF on %s |v|=%.0f, waiting for a window", q.Name, Q.Magnitude))
					elseif not I and h.on then
						h.on, h.endAt = false, _
						V.say(string.format("SPOOF off %s after %.2fs", q.Name, _ - h.since))
					end
				end
				V.spActive = function(_)
					local q = V.sp
					return q.on and q.c == _
				end
				V.spHot = function(_)
					local q = V.sp
					return not q.on and q.c == _ and q.endAt ~= nil and os.clock() - q.endAt < (V.spWinT or 0.9)
				end
				V.at = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = #_
					if h == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					if q >= _[h].t then
						return _[h], h
					end
					if q <= _[1].t then
						return _[1], 1
					end
					local y, Q = 1, h
					while y < Q do
						local h = math.floor((y + Q + 1) / 2)
						if _[h].t <= q then
							y = h
						else
							Q = h - 1
						end
					end
					return _[y], y
				end)
				V.posAt = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h, y = V.at(_, q)
					if not h then
						return nil
					end
					local Q = _[y + 1]
					if not Q or q <= h.t then
						return h.p
					end
					return h.p:Lerp(Q.p, math.clamp((q - h.t) / math.max(0.0001, Q.t - h.t), 0, 1))
				end)
				V.kinVel = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					h = h or 0.1
					if #_ < 2 or q - h < _[1].t then
						return nil
					end
					local y, Q = V.posAt(_, q), V.posAt(_, q - h)
					if not (Q and y) then
						return nil
					end
					local I = (y - Q) / h
					local Q = V.posAt(_, q - h * 0.5)
					local C = Q and (y - Q) / (h * 0.5) or I
					if (I - C).Magnitude < 0.35 * math.max(I.Magnitude, C.Magnitude) + 3 then
						return C.Magnitude < 400 and C or Vector3.zero
					end
					local h = V.posAt(_, q - 0.025)
					local _ = h and (y - h) / 0.025 or Vector3.zero
					if _.Magnitude > 300 then
						return Vector3.zero
					end
					return _
				end)
				V.speedFactor = PULSE_NV(function(_)
					local q = #_
					if q < 10 then
						return 1
					end
					local h = _[q].t
					local y = {}
					local Q = q
					while Q > 1 and h - _[Q].t < 1.5 do
						local q = _[Q]
						local I = q.t - 0.2 >= _[1].t and V.posAt(_, q.t - 0.2) or nil
						local C = V.at(_, q.t - V.D)
						local H = V.at(_, q.t - V.D - 0.2)
						if
							I
							and C
							and H
							and C.md.Magnitude > 0.9
							and H.md.Magnitude > 0.9
							and C.md:Dot(H.md) > 0.95
							and not q.air
						then
							local H = (q.p - I) / 0.2
							local q = Vector3.new(H.X, 0, H.Z).Magnitude
							local I = C.ws * C.md.Magnitude
							if I > 4 and q > 2 then
								y[#y + 1] = q / I
							end
						end
						Q -= 3
					end
					local q = #y >= 5 and math.clamp(V.median(y), 0.4, 8) or 1
					if V.kFit == true then
						local y, Q = V.velMdFit(_, h)
						if y and Q and y < (V.velFitDeg or 25) and Q > math.max(V.kFitMin or 1.6, q * 1.4) then
							q = math.clamp(Q, 0.4, 8)
						end
					end
					return q
				end)
				V.kNow = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y = V.kLocW or 0
					if y <= 0 then
						return h
					end
					local Q = V.kLocWin or 0.25
					local I, C = V.posAt(_, q), V.posAt(_, q - Q)
					if not (I and C) then
						return h
					end
					local H, n = 0, 0
					for O = 0, 4 do
						local N = V.at(_, q - Q + (O + 0.5) * Q / 5 - V.D)
						if not N or N.air then
							return h
						end
						H += N.md.X * N.ws * Q / 5
						n += N.md.Z * N.ws * Q / 5
					end
					local _ = math.sqrt(H * H + n * n)
					if _ < (V.kLocMin or 1.5) then
						return h
					end
					local q = I - C
					local Q = math.sqrt(q.X * q.X + q.Z * q.Z) / _
					if Q >= h * (V.kLocThr or 0.6) then
						return h
					end
					return h + (math.max(Q, 0.15) - h) * y
				end)
				V.jumpTau = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = #_
					local y = h
					local h = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
					local Q = V.jFlagLead or 0
					local I
					while y > 1 and q - _[y].t < 0.4 + V.shiftJ() do
						local C, H = _[y], _[y - 1]
						if I and I - C.t > (V.jFlagWin or 0.15) then
							break
						end
						if C.t <= q then
							if C.jump and not H.jump and not I then
								if Q <= 0 then
									return C.t + V.J + V.shiftJ() - q
								end
								I = C.t
							end
							if C.st == h and H.st ~= h and not H.air then
								return C.t + V.J + V.shiftJ() - q
							end
							if
								C.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
								and C.jump
								and not H.air
								and H.st ~= h
								and H.st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
							then
								return C.t + V.J + V.shiftJ() - q
							end
							if
								V.ffJump == true
								and C.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
								and not C.air
								and not H.air
								and (
									H.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
									or H.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
									or H.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
								)
							then
								return C.t + V.J + V.shiftJ() - q
							end
						end
						y -= 1
					end
					if I then
						return I + V.J + V.shiftJ() - Q - q
					end
					return nil
				end)
				V.mdAvg = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y, Q, I = 0, 0, 0
					for C = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local H = _[C]
						if H.t <= q then
							if q - H.t > h then
								break
							end
							y += H.md.X
							Q += H.md.Z
							I += 1
						end
					end
					if I == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return Vector3.new(y / I, 0, Q / I)
				end)
				V.clampTraj = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					if V.kinClamp ~= true or not _ or #_ < 3 or not q then
						return _
					end
					local h
					local y = 1
					while y < #_ do
						local Q = math.min(y + 2, #_)
						local I, C = _[y].p, _[Q].p
						local H = C - I
						local C = H.Magnitude
						if C > 0.001 then
							local n = workspace:Raycast(I, H, q)
							if n then
								h = n.Position - H / C * (V.kinStandoff or 0.6)
								for q = y + 1, #_ do
									_[q].p = h
								end
								break
							end
						end
						y = Q
					end
					return _
				end)
				V.fastRecent = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y = 0
					for Q = #_, 2, -1.0 do
						local I = _[Q]
						if q - I.t > h then
							break
						end
						if I.t <= q + 0.000001 then
							local q
							if typeof(I.v) == "Vector3" then
								q = Vector3.new(I.v.X, 0, I.v.Z).Magnitude
							elseif I.t - 0.1 >= _[1].t then
								local h = V.posAt(_, I.t - 0.1)
								if h then
									q = Vector3.new(I.p.X - h.X, 0, I.p.Z - h.Z).Magnitude / 0.1
								end
							end
							if q and q < 400 and q > y then
								y = q
							end
						end
					end
					return y
				end)
				V.velMdFit = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = V.vfCache
					if h and h.h == _ and h.t == q and h.n == #_ then
						return h.deg, h.mag
					end
					local h = V.velLagFit or 0.16
					local y = V.velFitWin or 0.6
					local Q, I = {}, {}
					local C = #_
					while C >= 2 do
						local H = _[C]
						if q - H.t > y then
							break
						end
						if H.t <= q + 0.000001 and typeof(H.v) == "Vector3" then
							local y, n = H.v.X, H.v.Z
							local O = math.sqrt(y * y + n * n)
							if O > (V.velFitMinV or 30) and O < 400 then
								local N = V.at(_, H.t - h)
								local h = N and N.md
								if h and h.X * h.X + h.Z * h.Z > 0.25 then
									local H = (math.atan2(n, y) - math.atan2(h.Z, h.X) + 3.141592653589793)
											% 6.283185307179586
										- 3.141592653589793
									Q[#Q + 1] = math.abs(H)

					"fly",
					"mdv",
					"arc",
					"stop",
					"half",
					"mdS",
				}
				V.btKindsV = {
					"md",
					"cv",
					"mdE",
					"mdL",
					"fly",
					"mdv",
					"arc",
					"stop",
					"half",
					"mdS",
					"vel",
					"velf",
				}
				V.btYield = function()
					if coroutine.isyieldable() and os.clock() - (V.btT or 0) > (V.btBudget or 0.0006) then
						coroutine.yield()
					end
				end
				V.backtest = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					_ = V.despikeView(_)
					local h = #_
					if h < 20 then
						return
					end
					local y = _[h].t
					local Q = math.clamp((V.mode(_) == "nr" and V.Lnr or V.L) + V.shiftL(), 0.08, 0.45)
					local I = y - Q
					if I - 0.2 < _[1].t then
						return
					end
					local C = V.posAt(_, y)
					local H = {}
					local n = V.posAt(_, I)
					local O = V.kinVel(_, I, 0.08) or Vector3.zero
					local N = false
					for z = h, 1, -1.0 do
						if _[z].t < I - 0.1 then
							break
						end
						if _[z].air then
							N = true
							break
						end
					end
					local h
					local z = V.mode(_) == "nr"
					local D = V.kNow(_, I, V.k or 1)
					for b, b in ipairs(V.velOn ~= false and V.btKindsV or V.btKinds) do
						local Z = (b == "md" or b == "mdv" or b == "mdS") and V.D
							or b == "mdE" and V.D - 0.05
							or b == "mdL" and V.D + 0.05
							or 0
						local P
						if b == "stop" then
							P = n
						elseif b == "half" then
							P = n + O * (Q * 0.5)
						else
							local n = (b == "cv" or b == "fly" or b == "mdv" or b == "arc" or b == "vel" or b == "velf")
									and b
								or b == "mdS" and "mds"
								or "md"
							local O = V.simulate(_, I, Z, n, Q, D, q, true)
							P = V.trajAt(O, Q)
						end
						if b == "md" then
							h = P.Y
						end
						local q = Vector3.new(P.X - C.X, 0, P.Z - C.Z).Magnitude
						H[b] = q
						V.err[b] = (V.err[b] or 0.8) + (math.min(q, 6) - (V.err[b] or 0.8)) * 0.08
						if V.airV2 then
							local n = P.Y
							if h and not z and (b == "mdv" or b == "arc" or b == "stop" or b == "half") then
								n = h
							end
							local h = q
							if N then
								local O = (n - C.Y) * 0.45
								h = math.sqrt(q * q + O * O)
							end
							local q = "W" .. b
							local n = V.err[q] or V.err[b]
							V.err[q] = n + (math.min(h, 6) - n) * 0.08
						end
						if V.btSlice then
							V.btYield()
						end
					end
					if V.repOn ~= false then
						local q = V.repInfo
						if q and q.tEnd <= I + 0.001 and y - q.tEnd < 0.5 and q.fit < (V.repFitMax or 1.2) then
							local h = V.repTraj(_, I, q.T, Q)
							if h then
								local q = V.trajAt(h, Q)
								local h = Vector3.new(q.X - C.X, 0, q.Z - C.Z).Magnitude
								local n = N and (q.Y - C.Y) * 0.45 or 0
								local q = V.err.rep or 3
								V.err.rep = q + (math.min(h, 6) - q) * 0.08
								local O = V.err.Wrep or q
								V.err.Wrep = O + (math.min(math.sqrt(h * h + n * n), 6) - O) * 0.08
							end
						else
							local q = V.err.rep or 3
							V.err.rep = q + (4 - q) * 0.08
							V.err.Wrep = V.err.rep
						end
						if V.btSlice then
							V.btYield()
						end
						local q, h, n = V.repFind(_, y)
						V.repInfo = q and { T = q, fit = h, amp = n, tEnd = y } or nil
					end
					local q = (C - V.posAt(_, I)).Magnitude > Q * 4
					if q then
						if H.mdE + 0.05 < H.md and H.mdE <= H.mdL then
							V.D = math.clamp(V.D - 0.002, 0.06, 0.32)
						elseif H.mdL + 0.05 < H.md and H.mdL < H.mdE then
							V.D = math.clamp(V.D + 0.002, 0.06, 0.32)
						end
					end
					if V.dPrior ~= false and V.modern ~= false then
						V.D = math.clamp(V.D + ((V.dCenter or 0.158) - V.D) * 0.01, 0.1, 0.24)
					end
				end)
				V.estD = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					if #_ < 30 or q - _[1].t < 1.5 then
						return nil
					end
					local h = math.max(_[1].t + 0.45, q - 2)
					local y, Q = {}, {}
					local I = 0
					local C = h
					while C <= q - 0.05 do
						local q, h = V.posAt(_, C - 0.05), V.posAt(_, C + 0.05)
						if q and h then
							local H = (h - q) / 0.1
							H = Vector3.new(H.X, 0, H.Z)
							y[#y + 1], Q[#Q + 1] = H, C
							if H.Magnitude > 3 then
								I += 1
							end
						end
						C += 0.05
					end
					if I < 6 then
						return nil
					end
					local q = V.k or 1
					local h, I, C
					local H = V.D
					for n = 0, 17 do
						local O = 0.05 + n * 0.02
						local n = 0
						for N, z in ipairs(Q) do
							local Q = V.at(_, z - O)
							if Q then
								local _ = Vector3.new(Q.md.X, 0, Q.md.Z) * (Q.ws * q)
								local q = y[N] - _
								n += math.min(q.Magnitude, 20) ^ 2
							end
						end
						if not I or n < I then
							h, I = O, n
						end
						if math.abs(O - H) < 0.011 then
							C = n
						end
					end
					return h, I, C
				end)
				V.clusters = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = {}
					for y = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local Q = _[y]
						if q - Q.t > 0.6 then
							break
						end
						h[#h + 1] = Q.p
					end
					if #h < 8 then
						return nil
					end
					local _, q, y = 0, 0, nil
					for Q = 2, #h do
						local I = h[Q] - h[Q - 1]
						if I.Magnitude > 8 then
							_ += 1
							if y and I:Dot(y) < -0.3 * I.Magnitude * y.Magnitude then
								q += 1
							end
							y = I
						end
					end
					if _ < 3 then
						return nil
					end
					if V.clusterRev and q < V.clusterRev then
						return nil
					end
					local _, q = h[1], h[1]
					for y, y in ipairs(h) do
						if (y - _).Magnitude > (q - _).Magnitude then
							q = y
						end
					end
					for y = 1, 6 do
						local y, Q, I, C = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, 0, 0
						for H, H in ipairs(h) do
							if (H - _).Magnitude <= (H - q).Magnitude then
								y += H
								I += 1
							else
								Q += H
								C += 1
							end
						end
						if I > 0 then
							_ = y / I
						end
						if C > 0 then
							q = Q / C
						end
						V.clusterW = { I / #h, C / #h }
					end
					return { { p = _, w = V.clusterW[1] }, { p = q, w = V.clusterW[2] } }
				end)
				V.oscillation = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = {}
					for y = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local Q = _[y]
						if Q.t <= q then
							if q - Q.t > 0.45 then
								break
							end
							h[#h + 1] = Q.p
						end
					end
					if #h < 8 then
						return nil
					end
					local _ = V.oscXZ ~= false
					local q, y, Q = 0, h[1], h[1]
					for I = 2, #h do
						local C = h[I] - h[I - 1]
						if _ then
							C = Vector3.new(C.X, 0, C.Z)
						end
						q += C.Magnitude
						y = Vector3.new(math.min(y.X, h[I].X), math.min(y.Y, h[I].Y), math.min(y.Z, h[I].Z))
						Q = Vector3.new(math.max(Q.X, h[I].X), math.max(Q.Y, h[I].Y), math.max(Q.Z, h[I].Z))
					end
					local I, C = h[1] - h[#h], Q - y
					if _ then
						I, C = Vector3.new(I.X, 0, I.Z), Vector3.new(C.X, 0, C.Z)
					end
					local y = I.Magnitude
					local Q = C.Magnitude
					if q > y * 3 + 6 and Q > 2.5 and Q < 12 then
						if V.oscMinRev then
							local q = V.oscSeg or 3
							local y, Q = 0, nil
							for I = 1, #h - q, q do
								local C = h[I] - h[I + q]
								if _ then
									C = Vector3.new(C.X, 0, C.Z)
								end
								if C.Magnitude > 0.3 then
									if Q and C:Dot(Q) < -0.3 * C.Magnitude * Q.Magnitude then
										y += 1
									end
									Q = C
								end
							end
							if y < V.oscMinRev then
								return nil
							end
						end
						local _ = {}
						local q = math.max(1, math.floor(#h / 8))
						for y = 1, #h, q do
							_[#_ + 1] = h[y]
						end
						return _
					end
					return nil
				end)
				V.jitterAxis = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y = V.jitWin or 0.25
					local Q = {}
					for I = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local C = _[I]
						if C.t <= q then
							if q - C.t > y then
								break
							end
							Q[#Q + 1] = C
						end
					end
					local y = #Q
					if y < (V.jitMinN or 8) then
						return nil
					end
					local I, C = 0, 0
					for H, H in ipairs(Q) do
						I += H.p.X
						C += H.p.Z
					end
					I, C = I / y, C / y
					local H, n, O = 0, 0, 0
					for N, N in ipairs(Q) do
						local z, D = N.p.X - I, N.p.Z - C
						H += z * z
						n += z * D
						O += D * D
					end
					H, n, O = H / y, n / y, O / y
					local N, z = H + O, H * O - n * n
					local D = math.sqrt(math.max(0, N * N / 4 - z))
					local z, b = N / 2 + D, math.max(N / 2 - D, 0)
					if z < (V.jitMinVar or 9) or z < b * (V.jitRatio or 9) then
						return nil
					end
					local N = math.abs(n) > 0.000001 and Vector3.new(z - O, 0, n)
						or (H >= O and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
					N = N.Unit
					local H, n = 0, 0
					local O = y
					for z = y - 1, 1, -1.0 do
						local D, Z = Q[O], Q[z]
						local P = Z.t - D.t
						if P >= 0.02 then
							local i = ((Z.p.X - D.p.X) * N.X + (Z.p.Z - D.p.Z) * N.Z) / P
							if math.abs(i) > (V.jitMinV or 50) then
								local D = i > 0 and 1 or -1.0
								if n ~= 0 and D ~= n then
									H += 1
								end
								n = D
							end
							O = z
						end
					end
					if H < (V.jitMinRev or 2) then
						return nil
					end
					local n = {}
					for O, O in ipairs(Q) do
						n[#n + 1] = (O.p.X - I) * N.X + (O.p.Z - C) * N.Z
					end
					table.sort(n)
					local O, z = n[math.max(1, math.floor(y * 0.05))], n[math.min(y, math.ceil(y * 0.95))]
					local y = (z - O) / 2
					if y < (V.jitMinHalf or 3) or y > (V.jitMaxHalf or 45) then
						return nil
					end
					local n = (O + z) / 2
					local O = Q[1]
					local Q = Vector3.new(-N.Z, 0, N.X)
					local z = (O.p.X - I) * Q.X + (O.p.Z - C) * Q.Z
					local D = O.p.Y
					for Z = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local P = _[Z]
						if q - P.t > (V.jitFloorWin or 1) then
							break
						end
						if P.p.Y < D then
							D = P.p.Y
						end
					end
					local _ = typeof(O.v) == "Vector3" and O.v.Y or 0
					local q = h or 0.16
					local h = O.p.Y
					if V.jitBall ~= false then
						h = math.max(O.p.Y + _ * q - 0.5 * (V.G or workspace.Gravity) * q * q, D)
					end
					local _ = Vector3.new(I + N.X * n + Q.X * z, h, C + N.Z * n + Q.Z * z)
					return { c = _, u = N, nv = Q, half = y, rev = H, sdPerp = math.sqrt(b) }
				end)
				V.repFind = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					if #_ < 30 then
						return nil
					end
					local h = V.repWin or 1
					local y = V.repTMin or 0.25
					local Q = math.min(V.repTMax or 1.6, q - _[1].t - h)
					if Q < y + 0.05 then
						return nil
					end
					local I, C = {}, Vector3.zero
					for H = 0, 15 do
						local n = V.posAt(_, q - H * h / 16)
						I[H] = n
						C += n
					end
					C /= 16
					local H = 0
					for n = 0, 15 do
						local O = I[n] - C
						H += O.X * O.X + O.Z * O.Z
					end
					H = math.sqrt(H / 16)
					if H < (V.repAmp or 1.5) then
						return nil
					end
					local function C(n)
						local O = 0
						for N = 0, 15 do
							local z = I[N] - V.posAt(_, q - N * h / 16 - n)
							O += z.X * z.X + z.Z * z.Z + z.Y * z.Y * 0.2
						end
						return math.sqrt(O / 16)
					end
					local n = {}
					do
						local O = y
						while O <= Q do
							n[#n + 1] = O
							O += 0.03333333333333333
						end
					end
					local O = #n
					local N = table.create(O, 0)
					do
						local z = #_
						local D = table.create(z)
						for b = 1, z do
							D[b] = _[b].t
						end
						local b, Z = D[1], D[z]
						for P = 0, 15 do
							local i = I[P]
							local I = nil
							for d = 1, O do
								local g = q - P * h / 16 - n[d]
								local q
								if g >= Z then
									q = z
								elseif g <= b then
									q = 1
								else
									if I == nil then
										local h, b = 1, z
										while h < b do
											local Z = math.floor((h + b + 1) / 2)
											if D[Z] <= g then
												h = Z
											else
												b = Z - 1
											end
										end
										I = h
									else
										if I > z then
											I = z
										end
										while I > 1 and D[I] > g do
											I -= 1
										end
										while I < z and D[I + 1] <= g do
											I += 1
										end
									end
									q = I
								end
								local h = _[q]
								local I = _[q + 1]
								local _
								if not I or g <= h.t then
									_ = h.p
								else
									_ = h.p:Lerp(I.p, math.clamp((g - h.t) / math.max(0.0001, I.t - h.t), 0, 1))
								end
								local q = i - _
								N[d] += q.X * q.X + q.Z * q.Z + q.Y * q.Y * 0.2
							end
						end
					end
					local _, q
					for h = 1, O do
						local I = math.sqrt(N[h] / 16)
						if not q or I < q then
							_, q = n[h], I
						end
					end
					for h, h in ipairs({ -0.016666666666666666, 0.016666666666666666 }) do
						local I = _ + h
						if I >= y and I <= Q then
							local h = C(I)
							if h < q then
								_, q = I, h
							end
						end
					end
					return _, q, H
				end)
				V.repTraj = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y)
					local Q = V.posAt(_, q)
					local I = V.posAt(_, q - h)
					if not (Q and I) or q - h < _[1].t then
						return nil
					end
					local C = Q - I
					local Q = {}
					local I = math.max(2, math.ceil(y * 60))
					for H = 0, I do
						local n = y * H / I
						local y = q + n - h
						while y > q do
							y -= h
						end
						Q[#Q + 1] = { tau = n, p = V.posAt(_, y) + C }
					end
					return Q
				end)
				V.orbitFit = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					if V.orbit ~= true or #_ < 8 or q - _[1].t < 0.65 then
						return nil
					end
					local y, Q, I = {}, {}, {}
					local C, H = 0, nil
					for n = 0, 36 do
						local O = -0.6 + n * 0.016666666666666666
						local n = V.posAt(_, q + O)
						if not n then
							return nil
						end
						y[#y + 1], Q[#Q + 1], I[#I + 1] = O, n.X, n.Z
						if H then
							C += math.sqrt((n.X - H.X) ^ 2 + (n.Z - H.Z) ^ 2)
						end
						H = n
					end
					if C / 0.6 < 22 then
						return nil
					end
					local C = #y
					local H, n, O, N, z, D = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
					for b = 1, C do
						local Z = y[b]
						H += Z
						n += Z * Z
						O += Q[b]
						N += I[b]
						z += Z * Q[b]
						D += Z * I[b]
					end
					local b = C * n - H * H
					if math.abs(b) < 1e-9 then
						return nil
					end
					local n, Z = (C * z - H * O) / b, (C * D - H * N) / b
					local z, D = (O - n * H) / C, (N - Z * H) / C
					local H = 0
					for O = 1, C do
						local N, b = z + n * y[O] - Q[O], D + Z * y[O] - I[O]
						H += N * N + b * b
					end
					local function n(O)
						local N = {}
						for z = 1, 6 do
							N[z] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
						end
						for z = 1, C do
							local D = y[z]
							local b, Z = math.cos(O * D), math.sin(O * D)
							local P = { 1, D, 0, 0, b, -Z }
							local i = { 0, 0, 1, D, Z, b }
							for D = 1, 6 do
								local b = N[D]
								for Z = 1, 6 do
									b[Z] += P[D] * P[Z] + i[D] * i[Z]
								end
								b[7] += P[D] * Q[z] + i[D] * I[z]
							end
						end
						for z = 1, 6 do
							local D = z
							for b = z + 1, 6 do
								if math.abs(N[b][z]) > math.abs(N[D][z]) then
									D = b
								end
							end
							if math.abs(N[D][z]) < 1e-9 then
								return nil
							end
							N[z], N[D] = N[D], N[z]
							for D = 1, 6 do
								if D ~= z then
									local b = N[D][z] / N[z][z]
									if b ~= 0 then
										for Z = z, 7 do
											N[D][Z] -= b * N[z][Z]
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
						local z = {}
						for D = 1, 6 do
							z[D] = N[D][7] / N[D][D]
						end
						local N = 0
						for D = 1, C do
							local b = y[D]
							local y, Z = math.cos(O * b), math.sin(O * b)
							local O = z[1] + z[2] * b + z[5] * y - z[6] * Z - Q[D]
							local Q = z[3] + z[4] * b + z[5] * Z + z[6] * y - I[D]
							N += O * O + Q * Q
						end
						return z, N
					end
					local y, Q, I
					for O, O in ipairs({ 4.5, 6, 7.5, 9, 11, 13, 16, -4.5, -6.0, -7.5, -9.0, -11.0, -13.0, -16.0 }) do
						local N, z = n(O)
						if N and (not I or z < I) then
							y, Q, I = N, O, z
						end
					end
					if not y then
						return nil
					end
					local n = math.sqrt(y[5] ^ 2 + y[6] ^ 2)
					local O = math.sqrt(I / C)
					if n < 1.2 or n > 15 or O > 0.6 or I > H * 0.3 then
						return nil
					end
					local I = (V.posAt(_, q) or _[#_].p).Y
					local _ = {}
					for q = 0, math.ceil(h * 60) do
						local h = q / 60
						local q, C = math.cos(Q * h), math.sin(Q * h)
						_[#_ + 1] = {
							tau = h,
							p = Vector3.new(
								y[1] + y[2] * h + y[5] * q - y[6] * C,
								I,
								y[3] + y[4] * h + y[5] * C + y[6] * q
							),
						}
					end
					return _, n, Q, O
				end)
				V.bodyModel = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h = _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not h then
						return nil
					end
					local y = {}
					local Q, I = {}, {}
					local C, H =
						Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
					local n = {}
					for O, O in ipairs(_:GetChildren()) do
						if O:IsA("BasePart") then
							n[#n + 1] = O
						elseif O:IsA("Accessory") or O:IsA("Tool") then
							local _ = O:FindFirstChild("Handle")
							if _ and _:IsA("BasePart") and _.Size.Magnitude < 7 then
								n[#n + 1] = _
							end
						end
					end
					local _ = 0
					for O, O in ipairs(n) do
						if O.CanQuery and not y[O] then
							local y = h.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(O.CFrame)
							local n = O == h
								or O.Name == "UpperTorso"
								or O.Name == "LowerTorso"
								or O.Name == "Torso"
								or O.Name == "Head"
							local N = O.Size * ((n or q) and 0.5 or 0.43)
							if y.Position.Magnitude > 7 then
								I[#I + 1] = { cf = O.CFrame, half = N }
							else
								Q[#Q + 1] = { rel = y, half = N, core = n }
								for q, q in ipairs({ -1.0, 1 }) do
									for n, n in ipairs({ -1.0, 1 }) do
										for O, O in ipairs({ -1.0, 1 }) do
											local z = y * Vector3.new(N.X * q, N.Y * n, N.Z * O)
											C = Vector3.new(math.min(C.X, z.X), math.min(C.Y, z.Y), math.min(C.Z, z.Z))
											H = Vector3.new(math.max(H.X, z.X), math.max(H.Y, z.Y), math.max(H.Z, z.Z))
											if z.Magnitude > _ then
												_ = z.Magnitude
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if #Q == 0 and #I == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					table.sort(Q, function(q, y)
						return q.core and not y.core
					end)
					local q = 0
					for y, y in ipairs(Q) do
						if y.core then
							q += 1
						end
					end
					local y = { parts = Q, detached = I, rot = h.CFrame - h.CFrame.Position, rad = _ + 0.05, nCore = q }
					if #Q > 0 then
						y.bcf, y.bhalf = CFrame.new((C + H) * 0.5), (H - C) * 0.5
					end
					return y
				end)
				V.rayBox = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y, Q)
					local I = _:PointToObjectSpace(h)
					local h = _:VectorToObjectSpace(y)
					local _, y = -math.huge, Q
					local Q, C, H, n, O, N = I.X, I.Y, I.Z, h.X, h.Y, h.Z
					local h, I, z = q.X, q.Y, q.Z
					if math.abs(n) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(Q) > h then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local q, D = (-h - Q) / n, (h - Q) / n
						if q > D then
							q, D = D, q
						end
						if q > _ then
							_ = q
						end
						if D < y then
							y = D
						end
						if _ > y then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if math.abs(O) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(C) > I then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local q, h = (-I - C) / O, (I - C) / O
						if q > h then
							q, h = h, q
						end
						if q > _ then
							_ = q
						end
						if h < y then
							y = h
						end
						if _ > y then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if math.abs(N) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(H) > z then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local q, h = (-z - H) / N, (z - H) / N
						if q > h then
							q, h = h, q
						end
						if q > _ then
							_ = q
						end
						if h < y then
							y = h
						end
						if _ > y then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if _ <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return _
				end)
				V.slab = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y, Q, I, C, H, n, O)
					local N, z = -math.huge, O
					if math.abs(y) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(_) > C then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local O, D = (-C - _) / y, (C - _) / y
						if O > D then
							O, D = D, O
						end
						if O > N then
							N = O
						end
						if D < z then
							z = D
						end
						if N > z then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if math.abs(Q) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(q) > H then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local _, y = (-H - q) / Q, (H - q) / Q
						if _ > y then
							_, y = y, _
						end
						if _ > N then
							N = _
						end
						if y < z then
							z = y
						end
						if N > z then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if math.abs(I) < 1e-9 then
						if math.abs(h) > n then
							return nil
						end
					else
						local _, q = (-n - h) / I, (n - h) / I
						if _ > q then
							_, q = q, _
						end
						if _ > N then
							N = _
						end
						if q < z then
							z = q
						end
						if N > z then
							return nil
						end
					end
					if N <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					return N
				end)
				V.hitsBody = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y, Q)
					local I = _.parts
					if #I == 0 then
						return nil
					end
					local C = _.rad
					local H, n, O = h.X - q.X, h.Y - q.Y, h.Z - q.Z
					if C then
						local q = -(H * y.X + n * y.Y + O * y.Z)
						if q < -C or q > Q + C then
							return nil
						end
						if H * H + n * n + O * O - q * q > C * C then
							return nil
						end
					end
					local q = _.rot
					if _.cd ~= y then
						_.cd = y
						local h = q:VectorToObjectSpace(y)
						_.cld = h
						for y, y in ipairs(I) do
							y.ld = y.rel:VectorToObjectSpace(h)
						end
					end
					local h = q:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(H, n, O))
					local q = _.cld
					if _.bcf then
						local y, C = _.bcf.Position, _.bhalf
						if
							not V.slab(
								h.X - y.X,
								h.Y - y.Y,
								h.Z - y.Z,
								q.X,
								q.Y,
								q.Z,
								C.X + 0.01,
								C.Y + 0.01,
								C.Z + 0.01,
								Q
							)
						then
							local q, H, n = h.X - y.X, h.Y - y.Y, h.Z - y.Z
							if not (math.abs(q) <= C.X and math.abs(H) <= C.Y and math.abs(n) <= C.Z) then
								return nil
							end
						end
					end
					local q, y
					local C = _.nCore or 0
					for _, H in ipairs(I) do
						if _ == C + 1 and y then
							return y, y
						end
						local _ = H.rel:PointToObjectSpace(h)
						local h, I = H.ld, H.half
						local C = V.slab(_.X, _.Y, _.Z, h.X, h.Y, h.Z, I.X, I.Y, I.Z, Q)
						if C then
							if not q or C < q then
								q = C
							end
							if H.core and (not y or C < y) then
								y = C
							end
						end
					end
					return q, y
				end)
				V.hitsDetached = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y)
					local Q
					for I, I in ipairs(_.detached) do
						local _ = V.rayBox(I.cf, I.half, q, h, y)
						if _ and (not Q or _ < Q) then
							Q = _
						end
					end
					return Q
				end)
				V.mode = function(_)
					local q = _ and _[#_]
					if not q then
						return "std"
					end
					local _ = q.st
					if
						_ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
						or _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
						or _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
						or _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
					then
						return "nr"
					end
					return "std"
				end
				V.airMix = {
					{ 0.8, 0.15 },
					{ -0.8, 0.15 },
					{ 2.4, 0.1 },
					{ -2.4, 0.1 },
					{ 4.5, 0.05 },
					{ -4.5, 0.05 },
					{
				7, 0.025,
					},
					{
				-7.0, 0.025,
					},
				}
				V.takeoffMix = { { -1.0, 0.08 }, { 1.5, 0.17 }, { 3, 0.22 }, { 4.5, 0.15 }, { 6.5, 0.13 } }
				V.pingShift = function()
					if not V.pingCal then
						return 0
					end
					local _, q = pcall(function()
						return E:GetNetworkPing()
					end)
					if not _ or type(q) ~= "number" then
						return 0
					end
					return math.clamp(q - V.pingCal, -0.06, 0.25)
				end
				V.taus = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y, Q = {}, 0
					local I, C = V.L, V.Lsd
					if _ == "nr" then
						I, C = V.Lnr, V.Lnrsd
					end
					I = I + V.pingShift() + V.shiftL()
					if h then
						C = C * h
					elseif q then
						C = C * (V.tauSdKAir or 2.5)
					else
						C = C * (V.tauSdK or 4)
					end
					local _, q = V.tauN or 3, V.tauStep or 0.75
					for h = -_, _ do
						local H = I + h * C * q
						if V.tauClamp == true and H <= -0.15 then
							H = -0.149 + (h + _) * 0.001
						end
						if H > -0.15 then
							local _ = math.exp(-0.5 * (h * q) ^ 2)
							y[#y + 1] = { tau = H, w = _ }
							if h == 0 then
								y.mid = #y
							end
							Q += _
						end
					end
					for _, _ in ipairs(y) do
						_.w = _.w / Q
					end
					return y
				end)
				V.hypotheses = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y)
					V.jShiftTmp = nil
					V.jForceTmp = nil
					local Q = V.D
					local I = false
					if V.trustScale ~= false and V.useTrust ~= false then
						local C = V.mdTrust(_, q)
						I = C < (V.trustScaleT or 0.6)
					end
					if V.estDOn == true then
						local C, H, n = V.estD(_, q)
						if C and n and H < n * (V.estDGain or 0.8) then
							Q = C
						end
						V.lastDD = Q
					end
					if V.dFix then
						Q = V.dFix
					end
					if V.pdUse == true and V.pdOverride then
						Q = V.pdOverride
					end
					local C = V.err
					if V.airV2 then
						local H = V.err
						C = setmetatable({}, {
							__index = function(n, n)
								return H["W" .. n] or H[n]
							end,
						})
					end
					local H = {}
					local n = V.kNow(_, q, V.k or 1)
					local function O(N, z, D, b, Z)
						local P = V.modern == false and 0.8 or (V.hpScale or 1.6)
						if V.modern ~= false and _[#_].air then
							P = V.hpScaleAir or 0.8
						end
						if I then
							P = V.hpScaleLie or 0.8
						end
						H[#H + 1] = {
							kind = N,
							w = b * math.exp(-(D * D) / P),
							traj = V.simulate(_, q, z, N == "cv" and "cv" or N == "mdS" and "mds" or "md", h, n, y, Z),
						}
					end
					O("md", Q, C.md, V.hpMd or 1.2, true)
					O("mdE", Q - 0.05, C.mdE, V.hpEL or 0.8, true)
					O("mdL", Q + 0.05, C.mdL, V.hpEL or 0.8, true)
					if (V.hpMdS or 0) > 0 then
						O("mdS", Q, C.mdS or 0.8, V.hpMdS, true)
					end
					O("cv", 0, C.cv, V.hpCv or 0.7, false)
					if V.dWide ~= false and V.modern ~= false and not I then
						O("mdL", Q + 0.12, C.mdL, V.dWideW1 or 0.3, true)
						O("mdL", Q + 0.25, C.mdL, V.dWideW2 or 0.15, true)
					end
					if V.dEarly ~= false and V.modern ~= false and Q > 0.11 and not I then
						O("mdE", Q - 0.1, C.mdE, V.dEarlyW or 0.15, true)
					end
					if V.rehopW then
						local I = 0
						local n = Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
						for N = #_, 2, -1.0 do
							local z = _[N]
							if q - z.t > (V.rehopT or 2.5) then
								break
							end
							if z.st == n and _[N - 1].st ~= n then
								I += 1
							end
						end
						V.lastJumps = I
						if I >= (V.rehopN or 2) then
							V.rehopTmp = true
							local I = pcall(O, "mdH", Q, C.md, V.rehopW, true)
							V.rehopTmp = nil
						end
					end
					do
						local I = 0
						for n = #_, 1, -1.0 do
							if not _[n].air then
								break
							end
							I = q - _[n].t
						end
						local n = I > 1.2 and 1.4 or 0.35
						H[#H + 1] = {
							kind = "fly",
							w = n * math.exp(-((C.fly or 1.4) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8)),
							traj = V.simulate(_, q, 0, "fly", h, 1, y, false),
						}
						local I = V.kinVel(_, q, 0.08) or Vector3.zero
						local n = Vector3.new(I.X, 0, I.Z).Magnitude > 22
						H[#H + 1] = {
							kind = "mdv",
							w = (n and 1 or 0.3) * math.exp(-((C.mdv or 1.4) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8)),
							traj = V.simulate(_, q, Q, "mdv", h, 1, y, false),
						}
						H[#H + 1] = {
							kind = "arc",
							w = (n and 1 or 0.3) * math.exp(-((C.arc or 1.4) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8)),
							traj = V.simulate(_, q, 0, "arc", h, 1, y, false),
						}
						if V.velOn ~= false then
							local N = V.at(_, q) or _[#_]
							local z = typeof(N.v) == "Vector3" and N.v or I
							local N = Vector3.new(z.X, 0, z.Z).Magnitude
							if V.fastWin then
								N = math.max(N, V.fastRecent(_, q, V.fastWin))
							end
							if N > (V.velMin or 30) then
								H[#H + 1] = {
									kind = "vel",
									w = (V.hpVel or 1.2) * math.exp(-((C.vel or 1.4) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8)),
									traj = V.simulate(_, q, 0, "vel", h, 1, y, false),
								}
								if V.velF ~= false then
									H[#H + 1] = {
										kind = "velf",
										w = (V.hpVelF or 1.2) * math.exp(-((C.velf or 1.4) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8)),
										traj = V.simulate(_, q, 0, "velf", h, 1, y, false),
										better = (C.velf or 9) < (C.vel or 9),
									}
								end
							end
						end
						if n then
							local y = V.posAt(_, q) or _[#_].p
							local n = 0.8 * math.exp(-((C.stop or 2) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8))
							H[#H + 1] = { kind = "stop", w = n, traj = { { tau = 0, p = y }, { tau = h, p = y } } }
							n = 0.8 * math.exp(-((C.half or 1.5) ^ 2) / (V.hpScale2 or 0.8))
							local N = {}
							for z = 0, math.ceil(h * 60) do
								local D = z / 60
								N[#N + 1] = { tau = D, p = y + I * (D * 0.5) }
							end
							H[#H + 1] = { kind = "half", w = n, traj = N }
						elseif V.stopAll == true and Vector3.new(I.X, 0, I.Z).Magnitude > 6 and not _[#_].air then
							local y = V.posAt(_, q) or _[#_].p
							local n = 1.2 * math.exp(-(C.md * C.md) / 0.8) * (V.stopW or 0.1)
							H[#H + 1] = { kind = "stop", w = n, traj = { { tau = 0, p = y }, { tau = h, p = y } } }
							local N = {}
							for z = 0, math.ceil(h * 60) do
								local D = z / 60
								N[#N + 1] = { tau = D, p = y + I * (D * 0.5) }
							end
							H[#H + 1] = { kind = "half", w = n, traj = N }
						end
					end
					if
						V.ffgJump == true
						and _[#_].st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
						and not _[#_].air
						and not V.jumpTau(_, q)
					then
						local y = #_
						while y > 1 and _[y - 1].st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and not _[y - 1].air do
							y -= 1
						end
						local I = q - _[y].t
						if I < (V.ffgMax or 0.3) then
							local y = V.ffgW or 1
							for I, I in ipairs({ { 0, 0.5 }, { 0.05, 0.45 }, { 0.1, 0.35 }, { 0.2, 0.2 } }) do
								V.jForceTmp = I[1]
								O("mdJa", Q, C.md, I[2] * y, true)
							end
							V.jForceTmp = nil
						end
					end
					if
						V.jumpAny == true
						and not V.jumpTau(_, q)
						and not _[#_].air
						and _[#_].st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
					then
						local y = V.jumpAnyW or 0.1
						V.jForceTmp = 0.02
						O("mdJa", Q, C.md, y, true)
						V.jForceTmp = 0.1
						O("mdJa", Q, C.md, y * 0.7, true)
						V.jForceTmp = nil
					end
					if V.jumpTau(_, q) then
						O("mdNJ", Q, C.md, V.njW or 0.4, false)
						if V.jVar ~= false and not _[#_].air then
							if V.jVarW ~= false then
								local y = V.jvMul or 1
								V.jShiftTmp = -0.18
								O("mdJe", Q, C.md, 0.35 * y * (V.jvEarly or 1), true)
								V.jShiftTmp = -0.09
								O("mdJe", Q, C.md, 0.55 * y * (V.jvEarly or 1), true)
								V.jShiftTmp = 0.09
								O("mdJl", Q, C.md, 0.45 * y, true)
								V.jShiftTmp = 0.18
								O("mdJl", Q, C.md, 0.25 * y, true)
							else
								V.jShiftTmp = -0.1
								O("mdJe", Q, C.md, 0.6, true)
								V.jShiftTmp = 0.1
								O("mdJl", Q, C.md, 0.45, true)
							end
							V.jShiftTmp = nil
						end
					end
					if V.airV2 and V.mode(_) ~= "nr" then
						local y = H[1].traj
						for Q, Q in ipairs(H) do
							if Q.kind == "mdv" or Q.kind == "arc" or Q.kind == "stop" or Q.kind == "half" then
								local I = {}
								for n = 0, math.ceil(h * 60) do
									local O = n / 60
									local n = V.trajAt(Q.traj, O)
									I[#I + 1] = { tau = O, p = Vector3.new(n.X, V.trajAt(y, O).Y, n.Z) }
								end
								Q.traj = I
							end
						end
					end
					local y = V.clusters(_, q)
					if y then
						for Q, I in ipairs(y) do
							H[#H + 1] = {
								kind = "cl" .. Q,
								w = 1.5 * I.w,
								traj = { { tau = 0, p = I.p }, {
									tau = h,
									p = I.p,
								} },
							}
						end
					end
					local y = V.oscillation(_, q)
					if y then
						V.oscMode = os.clock()
						for Q, I in ipairs(y) do
							H[#H + 1] =
								{ kind = "osc" .. Q, w = 1.6 / #y, traj = { { tau = 0, p = I }, { tau = h, p = I } } }
						end
					end
					do
						local y = V.repInfo
						if V.repOn ~= false and y and math.abs(q - y.tEnd) < 0.35 and y.fit < (V.repFitMax or 1.2) then
							local Q = V.repTraj(_, q, y.T, h)
							if Q then
								local _ = C.rep or 3
								H[#H + 1] = {
									kind = "rep",

						return nil

						y -= 1
					end

								H += O

									C += H
								end
								H = 0
							end
						end

								if O > 1.3 and O < 25 then
									Q += 1
								end
							end
							H, n = n, q
							I += 0.016666666666666666
						end
					end
					local q = _[h].t - _[y].t
					if q <= 0.2 then
						return nil
					end

					local _ = C / q
					if Q >= 5 or I > 4 and _ > 0.35 then

				V.mdTrust = PULSE_NV(function(_, q)
					local h, y = 0, 0

								h += -0.3

								y += 1

								h += -0.3
								y += 1
							elseif _.Magnitude < 1 and C.Magnitude <= 0.5 then
								h += 1
								y += 1
							end

					end
					if y < 6 then
						return 1
					end

				end)
				V.resolverHyps = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y, Q)
					local I = #_

					local function H(n)

							end

							N, z = H(Z)
						else
							Z = O
						end

					end

				V.caFit = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y, Q, I, C, H, n = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
					local O, N, z = { 0, 0, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0 }
					local D = 0
					for b = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local Z = _[b]
						if Z.t <= q then
							local _ = Z.t - q
							if _ < -h then
								break

							O[2] += _.X * q
							O[3] += _.X * h

							N[3] += _.Y * h
							z[1] += _.Z
							z[2] += _.Z * q

						end

						return nil
					end

					if math.abs(y) < 1e-12 then
						return nil
					end

						local C = I[1] * (D * Z - b * b) - q * (I[2] * Z - b * I[3]) + h * (I[2] * b - D * I[3])
						local H = _ * (I[2] * Z - b * I[3]) - I[1] * (q * Z - b * h) + h * (q * I[3] - I[2] * h)
						local n = _ * (D * I[3] - I[2] * b) - q * (q * I[3] - I[2] * h) + I[1] * (q * b - D * h)
						return C / y, H / y, n / y
					end

					local y, I, C = Q(N)
					local H, n, O = Q(z)
					local Q = Vector3.new(h, C, O)
					local h = V.caAmax or 900
					if Q.Magnitude > h then
						Q = Q.Unit * h
					end
					return Vector3.new(_, y, H), Vector3.new(q, I, n), Q

							if C.Magnitude < (V.losMax or 900) then
								o(O, y + C.Unit * 3, "los")
							end
							o(y - C.Unit * 6, y + C.Unit * 3, "losNear")
						end
					end
					local function y(C, b)
						local Z = C.e - C.o
						local o = Z.Magnitude
						local j = Z / o
						C.d, C.len = j, o
						local Z = {}
						local e = 0
						if n < 1 then
							for GM, aM in ipairs(D) do
								local AM, TM = V.hitsBody(q, aM.p, C.o, j, o + 400)
								if AM then
									Z[GM] = { AM, TM }
									e += TM and aM.w or aM.w * 0.3
								end
							end
							e *= (1 - n)
						end
						local GM
						if n > 0 then
							GM = V.hitsDetached(q, C.o, j, o + 400)
							if GM then
								e += n
							end
						end
						if b and e <= b then
							C.score = e
							C.pruned = true
							return e
						end
						local q = V.serverRay(C.o, j * (o + 0.1), { _ })
						local b = q and (q.Position - C.o).Magnitude or math.huge
