							local TM = 0
							if n < 1 then
								for fM, JM in ipairs(D) do
									local XM = Z[fM]
									if XM then
										if XM[2] and XM[2] < aM and XM[2] > AM then
											TM += JM.w
										elseif XM[1] < aM and XM[1] > AM then
											TM += JM.w * 0.3
										end
									end
								end
								TM *= (1 - n)
							end
							if GM and GM < aM and GM > AM then
								TM += n
							end
							return TM
						end

						if q and V.wallStart == true and not C.o2 then

							local q = (Z - C.o).Magnitude
							local GM = o + 0.1 - q
							if GM > 0.5 then
								local o = V.serverRay(Z, j * GM, { _ })
								local j = o and (o.Position - C.o).Magnitude or math.huge
								if j > b + 0.3 then
									local b = e(j, q)
									if b > n + 0.001 then
										n = b
										C.o2 = Z
									end
								end
							end
						end

						return n
					end

					local C = not p and Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude > (V.gmSpeed or 6)

							local j = h[o]
							if Q - j.t > (V.bounceT or 1.5) then

							end

								b = j.p.Y
							end
							if j.p.Y > Z then
								Z = j.p.Y
							end
						end
						n = Z - b > (V.bounceY or 4)

					V.lastBouncy = n
					local function b(Z)
						local o
						if q then
							o = q.score + 0.001
							if p and not (Z.kind:find("^column") or Z.kind:find("^colH") or Z.kind:find("^tilt")) then
								o = o
									/ (
										(P.air or P.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing) and (V.airPen or 0.8)
										or (V.takePen or 0.65)
									)
							end
						end

						if Z.pruned then
							return
						end
						local y = d and V.jitNoPen and Z.kind:find("^jit") ~= nil
						if Z.o2 then
							Z.o = Z.o2
							Z.len = (Z.e - Z.o).Magnitude
							Z.kind = Z.kind .. "+w"
						end
						if n and not y and not (Z.kind:find("^column") or Z.kind:find("^colH")) then
							j = j * V.bounceK
							Z.score = j
						end
						if V.tiltK and Z.kind:find("^tilt") then
							j = j * V.tiltK
							Z.score = j
						end
						if
							p
							and V.airNonColK
							and not y
							and not (Z.kind:find("^column") or Z.kind:find("^colH") or Z.kind:find("^tilt"))
						then
							j = j * V.airNonColK
							Z.score = j
						end
						if C and V.railPref ~= false and (Z.kind:find("^column") or Z.kind:find("^colH")) then
							j = j * (V.railK or 0.72)
							Z.score = j
						end
						if FM and not y and not (Z.kind:find("^rail:velf") or Z.kind:find("^chord:velf")) then
							j = j * (V.velfOtherK or 0.75)
							Z.score = j
						end
						if
							p
							and not y
							and not (Z.kind:find("^column") or Z.kind:find("^colH") or Z.kind:find("^tilt"))
						then
							j = j
								* (
									(P.air or P.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing) and (V.airPen or 0.8)
									or (V.takePen or 0.65)
								)
							Z.score = j
						end
						if j <= 0.02 then
							return
						end
						local y = V.serverRay(Z.o, Z.d * 600, { _ }, true)
						Z.reach = y and (y.Position - Z.o).Magnitude or 600
						if V.innocentRisk(Z.o, Z.d, Z.reach, _) then
							Z.risky = true
							V.riskyN = (V.riskyN or 0) + 1
							return
						end
						if not q or j > q.score + 0.001 then
							q = Z
						end
					end
					for y, y in ipairs(g) do
						if y.kind == "los" or y.kind == "losNear" then
							b(y)
						end
					end
					if d and V.jitOnly then
						local y = {}
						for C, C in ipairs(g) do
							if C.kind:find("^jit") or C.kind == "los" or C.kind == "losNear" then
								y[#y + 1] = C
							end
						end
						g = y
					end
					if d and V.jitFirst ~= false then
						for y, y in ipairs(g) do
							if y.kind:find("^jit") then
								b(y)
								y.done = true
							end
						end
					end
					if V.colFirst then
						local y = {
							column = 1,
							colH = 2,
							tilt = 2,
							hold = 2,
							holdR = 2,
							resl = 3,
							pca3 = 3,
							chord = 4,
							rail = 5,
							pca = 6,
						}
						for C, n in ipairs(g) do
							n.ord = (y[n.kind:match("^[^:+]+")] or 7) * 1000 + C
						end
						table.sort(g, function(y, C)
							return y.ord < C.ord
						end)
					end
					V.riskyN = 0
					local y = os.clock() + (V.candBudget or 0.012)
					local C = 0
					for n, n in ipairs(g) do
						if n.kind ~= "los" and n.kind ~= "losNear" and not n.done then
							b(n)
							C += 1
							if q and q.score > 0.995 then
								break
							end
							if os.clock() > y and q then
								break
							end
						end
					end
					V.lastEval = C .. "/" .. #g
					if q and q.score < 0.995 then
						local C = q.d
						local n = math.abs(C.Y) > 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
						local Z = C:Cross(n).Unit
						local n = C:Cross(Z).Unit
						local C = q
						local d = C.kind:find("^column") or C.kind:find("^colH")
						local o = d and V.colRefine ~= true or V.rRefine ~= true
						local j = d and V.colRefineK or 1
						for d, d in ipairs({ Z * 0.3, -Z * 0.3, n * 0.3, -n * 0.3, Z * 0.6, -Z * 0.6 }) do
							if o or os.clock() > y + 0.003 then
								break
							end
							b({ o = C.o + d * j, e = C.e + d * j, kind = C.kind .. "+r" })
						end
						if V.refineRot == true and q and q.score < 0.995 then
							local C = q
							local n = C.d or (C.e - C.o).Unit
							local Z = C.o + n * (i - C.o):Dot(n)
							local d, o = (Z - C.o).Magnitude, (C.e - Z).Magnitude
							local j = n:Cross(math.abs(n.Y) > 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
							local e = n:Cross(j).Unit
							for GM, GM in ipairs({ j, e }) do
								for j, j in ipairs({ 6, -6.0, 12, -12.0 }) do
									if os.clock() > y + 0.006 then
										break
									end
									local y = math.rad(j)
									local j = (
										n * math.cos(y)
										+ GM:Cross(n) * math.sin(y)
										+ GM * GM:Dot(n) * (1 - math.cos(y))
									).Unit
									b({ o = Z - j * d, e = Z + j * o, kind = C.kind .. "+a" })
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if (not q or q.score < (V.pbBelow or 0.3)) and V.pbFallback ~= false then
						for y, y in ipairs({
							Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
							Vector3.new(0, -1.0, 0),
							Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
							Vector3.new(-1.0, 0, 0),
							Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
							Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.0),
							Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0),
							Vector3.new(-0.7, 0.7, 0),
							Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0.7),
							Vector3.new(0, 0.7, -0.7),
						}) do
							local C = y.Unit
							b({ o = i - C * (V.pbBack or 2.2), e = i + C * (V.pbFwd or 3), kind = "pb" })
						end
					end
					if q then
						for y, y in ipairs(g) do
							if
								y.kind == "los"
								and y.score
								and not y.risky
								and y.reach
								and y.score >= 0.985
								and y.score >= q.score - 0.005
							then
								q = y
								break
							end
						end
						if q.kind ~= "los" then
							for y, y in ipairs(g) do
								if
									y.kind == "losNear"
									and y.score
									and not y.risky
									and y.reach
									and y.score >= 0.985
									and y.score >= q.score - 0.005
								then
									q = y
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end
					if V.inWall ~= false and Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude < 4 then
						local y = _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local _ = y and V.insideSolid(y.Position, y.CollisionGroup)
						if _ then
							if V.lastInWall ~= _ then
								V.lastInWall = _
								V.say("target inside " .. _:GetFullName())
							end
							local y = O or i + Vector3.new(0, 0, 5)
							local C = Vector3.new(i.X - y.X, 0, i.Z - y.Z)
							C = C.Magnitude > 0.1 and C.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
							local y = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
							local n = {
								{ o = i + y - C * 2.2, e = i + y + C * 3, kind = "inW" },
								{ o = i + Vector3.new(0.02, 3.3, 0.02), e = i - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), kind = "inWc" },
							}
							if V.inWallInside ~= false then
								local O, Z = _.CFrame, _.Size * 0.5
								local function _(d)
									local o = O:PointToObjectSpace(d)
									return math.abs(o.X) < Z.X - 0.05
										and math.abs(o.Y) < Z.Y - 0.05
										and math.abs(o.Z) < Z.Z - 0.05
								end
								local O = Vector3.new(-C.Z, 0, C.X)
								for Z, Z in ipairs({ C, O, -O, -C }) do
									for C, C in ipairs({ 0.5, 1, 1.6, 2.4 }) do
										local O = i + y - Z * C
										if _(O) then
											n[#n + 1] = { o = O, e = i + y + Z * 3, kind = "inWi" }
											break
										end
									end
								end
								for y, y in ipairs({ 1.2, 2.2, 3.2 }) do
									local C = i + Vector3.new(0.02, y, 0.02)
									if _(C) then
										n[#n + 1] = { o = C, e = i - Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), kind = "inWci" }
										break
									end
								end
							end
							for _, _ in ipairs(n) do
								local y = q
								q = nil
								b(_)
								local _ = q
								q = y
								if _ and (not q or _.score >= q.score - 0.02) then
									q = _
								end
							end
						end
					end
					V.planDur = (V.planDur or 0.01) + (math.clamp(os.clock() - H, 0, 0.1) - (V.planDur or 0.01)) * 0.3
					if q then
						q.hyps, q.samples, q.tNow, q.mode, q.anom = N, #D, Q, I, z ~= nil
						q.spike = z ~= nil and (z.jumps or 0) >= 5

						local y = 0
						if V.fastFlat ~= false and Q - h[1].t >= 0.3 then
							local C, H = 0, V.posAt(h, Q - 0.3)
							for n = 1, 18 do
								local O = V.posAt(h, Q - 0.3 + n / 60)
								if O and H then
									C += Vector3.new(O.X - H.X, 0, O.Z - H.Z).Magnitude
								end
								H = O
							end
							y = C / 0.3
						end

						q.fresh = #h < 2 or h[#h].t - h[1].t < (V.freshSpan or 2.5)

							local y = h[_].p
							local I = _
							while I > 1 and (h[I - 1].p - y).Magnitude < 0.001 do
								I -= 1
							end

							if y >= 0.04 and y < 1.5 and Vector3.new(h[_].md.X, 0, h[_].md.Z).Magnitude > 0.5 then
								q.frozenT = y
							end
						end
						q.air = (p or P.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or V.jumpTau(h, Q) ~= nil) and not m
						q.takeoff = q.air and not (P.air or P.st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
					end
					return q, g
				end)
				V.gun = function()
					local _ = E.Character
					local q = _ and _:FindFirstChild("Gun")
					if q then
						return q
					end
					local _ = E:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
					return V.backpackOk and _ and _:FindFirstChild("Gun") or nil
				end
				V.muzzleState = PULSE_NV(function()
					local _ = E.Character
					local q = _ and _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local h = _ and _:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local y = q and q:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
					if not (q and h and y) then
						return false
					end
					local Q = RaycastParams.new()
					Q.FilterDescendantsInstances = { _ }
					local _ = workspace:Raycast(h.Position + V.selfShift(), y.WorldPosition - h.Position, Q)
					return _ ~= nil, q, h, y, Q
				end)
				V.mzMargin = function()
					return math.clamp((V.mzBase or 0.21) + E:GetNetworkPing() * (V.mzPingK or 0.5), 0.1, 0.35)
				end
				V.guardInfo = function()
					local _ = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseMuzzle")
					if type(_) ~= "table" or not _.alive or not _.at or os.clock() - _.at > 0.15 then
						return nil
					end
					return _
				end
				V.clearMuzzle = PULSE_NV(function()
					if V.mzGate == false then
						return true
					end
					local _ = V.guardInfo()
					if not _ then
						return true
					end
					local q = os.clock()
					local h = V.mzMargin()
					if not _.blocked and q - (_.clearSince or 0) >= h then
						return true
					end
					if _.request then
						_.request(V.mzHoldFor or 0.3)
					end
					if V.mzSaidAt == nil or q - V.mzSaidAt > 1 then
						V.mzSaidAt = q
						V.say(
							string.format(
								"muzzle %s, stepping out (clear %.0fms, need %.0fms)",
								_.blocked and "blocked" or "fresh",
								_.blocked and 0 or (q - (_.clearSince or q)) * 1000,
								h * 1000
							)
						)
					end
					if _.blocked then
						return false, q + 0.02
					end
					return false, _.clearSince + h
				end)
				V.ready = function()
					return os.clock() - V.lastAccepted >= V.cooldown
				end
				V.spoofMin, V.spoofK, V.spoofT = 400, 0.25, 0.1
				V.spoofVel = PULSE_NV(function(_)
					if V.spoofOn == false or V.target ~= _ then
						return nil
					end
					local _ = V.hist
					local q = #_
					if q < 4 then
						return nil
					end
					local h = _[q].t
					local y, Q, I = 0, 0, nil
					for C = q, 1, -1.0 do
						local q = _[C]
						if h - q.t > 0.35 then
							break
						end
						y += 1
						if q.vr then
							Q += 1
							I = I or q.vr
						end
					end
					if y < 4 or Q < y * 0.6 or not I then
						return nil
					end
					return I
				end)
				V.spoofPlan = function(_, q)
					local h = V.spoofVel(q)
					if not h or h.Magnitude < 1 then
						return nil
					end
					local y = h.Unit
					local Q
					local I
					for C, C in ipairs(_.hyps or {}) do
						if not I or C.w > I.w then
							I = C
						end
					end
					if I and I.traj then
						local C, H = pcall(V.trajAt, I.traj, V.L + V.shiftL())
						if C and typeof(H) == "Vector3" then
							Q = H
						end
					end
					if not Q then
						local I = q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local C = (_.e - _.o).Unit
						if I then
							Q = _.o + C * (I.Position - _.o):Dot(C)
						end
					end
					if not Q or Q.X ~= Q.X then
						return nil
					end
					local I = V.vsLock or V.vsNext or 1
					local C = math.clamp(h.Magnitude * (V.spoofT or 0.1), 80, 9000)
					local H = Q + y * (C * I)
					local n = y * -I
					if V.innocentRisk(H, n, C + 250, q) then
						V.say("SPOOF skip: innocent on line")
						return nil
					end
					local q = table.clone(_)
					q.o, q.e = H, Q + n * 2
					q.kind = tostring(_.kind) .. (I > 0 and "+vs" or "-vs")
					q.anom = true
					V.say(
						string.format(
							"SPOOF v=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) sign=%d D=%.0f p=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)",
							h.X,
							h.Y,
							h.Z,
							I,
							C,
							Q.X,
							Q.Y,
							Q.Z
						)
					)
					return q, I
				end
				V.send = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y)
					local Q = V.gun()
					local I = Q and Q:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
					if not I then
						return false
					end
					if _.o.X ~= _.o.X or _.e.X ~= _.e.X or (_.e - _.o).Magnitude < 0.3 then
						return false
					end

					if
						type(X) == "table"
						and X.sheriff
						and X.sheriff.wallbang
						and V.spoofOn ~= false
						and V.spShots == true
					then
						local C, H, n = pcall(V.spoofPlan, _, q)
						if C and H then
							_, Q = H, n
						end
					end
					pcall(function()
						getgenv().__pulseShotHold = os.clock() + (V.holdFor or 0.35)
					end)
					pcall(function()
						local C = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseAntiAim")
						if C and C.desyncAt and os.clock() - C.desyncAt < 0.2 then
							getgenv().__pulseShotHold =
								math.max(tonumber(getgenv().__pulseShotHold) or 0, os.clock() + 0.45)
						end
					end)
					local C = q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local H = V.pending
					V.pending = {
						t = os.clock(),
						o = _.o,
						e = _.e,
						kind = _.kind,
						score = _.score,
						c = q,
						reason = h,
						tp = C and C.Position,
						manual = h ~= "auto",
						tries = H and H.c == q and H.retry and H.tries + 1 or 0,
						mode = _.mode or "std",
						shift = V.shiftL(),
						lag = V.shift,
						anom = _.anom,
					}
					if Q then
						V.pending.vsSign = Q
					end
					local Q = false
					pcall(function()
						Q = V.muzzleState()
					end)
					local H = V.guardInfo()
					local n
					pcall(function()
						local O = E.Character
						local N = O and O:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local z = O and O:FindFirstChild("Head")
						local O = N and N:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
						local D = workspace.CurrentCamera
						local b = V.selfShift()
						n = {
							hp = N and N.Position + b,
							hl = N and N.CFrame.LookVector,
							hd = z and z.Position + b,
							mz = O and O.WorldPosition + b,
							cp = D and D.CFrame.Position,
							cl = D and D.CFrame.LookVector,
						}
					end)
					local O = getgenv().__pulseAim
					if O then
						O.bypass = true
					end
					local N = pcall(function()
						I:FireServer(CFrame.new(_.o, _.e), CFrame.new(_.e))
					end)
					if O then
						O.bypass = false
					end
					if H and H.request and (H.guarding or H.blocked) then
						H.request(V.mzAfter or 0.2)
					end
					if N then
						V.stats.fired += 1
						local I = V.pending
						if I then
							I.mz = H and (H.blocked and "noPose" or (H.guarding and "guard" or "clear"))
								or (Q and "blocked" or "clear")
							if H and not H.blocked then
								I.mzAge = os.clock() - (H.clearSince or 0)
							end
							I.me = n
							I.pre = V.target == q and table.clone(V.hist) or {}
							I.post = {}
							I.pingS = V.pingShift()
							pcall(function()
								I.body = V.bodyModel(q, true)
							end)
							local Q
							Q = Y.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
								if os.clock() - I.t > 0.66 or not q.Parent then
									Q:Disconnect()
									return
								end
								local Q = V.sample(q)
								if Q then
									I.post[#I.post + 1] = Q
								end
							end)
						end
					end
					pcall(function()
						local Q
						for I, I in ipairs(_.hyps or {}) do
							if not Q or I.w > Q.w then
								Q = I
							end
						end
						local I = V.pending
						if Q and I then
							I.top = Q.kind
							I.pred = { V.trajAt(Q.traj, 0), V.trajAt(Q.traj, 0.05), V.trajAt(Q.traj, 0.1) }
							local Q = V.hist[#V.hist]
							I.info = Q
									and string.format(
										"st=%s md=(%.2f,%.2f) ws=%.0f air=%s",
										tostring(Q.st.Name),
										Q.md.X,
										Q.md.Z,
										Q.ws,
										tostring(Q.air)
									)
								or "?"
						end
					end)
					local Q = -1.0
					pcall(function()
						local I = V.hist
						if V.target == q and #I > 2 then
							local q = I[#I].t
							local H, n = 0, nil
							for O = 0, 30 do
								local z = V.posAt(I, q - 3 + O * 0.1)
								if z and n then
									H += Vector3.new(z.X - n.X, 0, z.Z - n.Z).Magnitude
								end
								n = z
							end
							Q = H
						end
					end)

						V.pending.mvPath = Q
					end
					local q = E.Character and E.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					pcall(function()
						local H = {}
						for n, n in ipairs(_.hyps or {}) do
							H[#H + 1] = n
						end
						table.sort(H, function(n, O)
							return n.w > O.w
						end)

							" tr=%.2f fdt=%.0fms hy=%s",

					end)

						string.format(
							"FIRE mv=%.0f %s score=%.3f L=%.3f+%.3f D=%.3f err md=%.2f cv=%.2f dist=%.0f %s wait=%.0fms mz=%s st=%s",
							Q,
							_.kind,
							_.score,

										and V.pending.mzAge
										and string.format("/%.0fms", V.pending.mzAge * 1000)

				V.fireFor = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					if not _ or not _.Parent then
						return false
					end
					do
						local y = _:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local Q = E.Character and E.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

							local I = y.Position
							if V.dsFarP(I) then
								if q then
									V.dsArm = { c = _, untilT = os.clock() + (V.dsArmT or 1.2), needLos = h }
									V.say("CLICK " .. _.Name .. " desync, armed")
								end
								return q == true
							end
							if V.spActive(_) and os.clock() >= (V.spPassUntil or 0) then
								if q then
									V.spArm = { c = _, untilT = os.clock() + (V.spArmT or 2), needLos = h }
									V.say("CLICK " .. _.Name .. " spoofing, armed")
									return true
								end
								if os.clock() - V.sp.since < (V.spAutoWait or 2.5) then
									return false
								end
							end

								(I - Q.Position - V.selfShift()).Magnitude > (V.maxDist or 3000)
								or I.Y < workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 20

									return false
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if y or V.queued then
						return q == true
					end

						V.forced, V.forcedAt = _, y
						if q then
							V.queued = { c = _, needLos = h, clickAt = y, waitFrom = y, manual = true }
							V.say("target switch queued")
							return true
						end
						return false
					end
					if not V.ready() then
						if q then
							local Q = V.cooldown - (y - V.lastAccepted)

								V.queued = { c = _, needLos = h, clickAt = y, waitFrom = y, manual = true }
							else
								V.say(string.format("click in cooldown (%.2fs left), ignored", Q))
							end
							return true
						end
						return false
					end
					local Q, I = V.clearMuzzle()
					if not Q and I then
						if q then
							V.queued = { c = _, needLos = h, clickAt = y, waitFrom = y, manual = true }
						end
						return q
					end
					local Q = V.plan(_, h)
					if not Q then
						if q then
							V.queued = { c = _, needLos = h, clickAt = y, waitFrom = y, manual = true }
						end
						return q == true
					end
					local I = V.minAuto
					if not q then
						if not V.autoFrom or y - (V.autoLast or 0) > 0.5 then
							V.autoFrom = y
						end
						V.autoLast = y
						I = V.autoNeedFor(Q, y - V.autoFrom)
					end
					if Q.score >= (q and V.needFor(Q, 0) or I) then
						V.autoFrom = nil
						return V.send(Q, _, q and "manual" or "auto", y)
					end
					if not q then
						return false
					end
					V.queued =
						{ c = _, needLos = h, clickAt = y, waitFrom = y, manual = true, plans = 1, bestScore = Q.score }
					return true
				end)
				V.plan = function(_, q)
					local h = V.hist
					local y = V.despikeView(h)
					if y == h then
						return V.planRaw(_, q)
					end
					if V.jitNoDespike ~= false and V.jitOn ~= false and #h > 0 and V.jitterAxis(h, h[#h].t, V.L) then
						return V.planRaw(_, q)
					end
					V.hist = y
					V.histRaw = h
					local y, Q = pcall(V.planRaw, _, q)
					V.hist = h
					V.histRaw = nil
					if not y then
						error(Q, 0)
					end
					return Q
				end
				V.window = 0.95
				V.airPatT2 = 0.9
				V.maxThink = 0.1
				V.quick100 = true
				V.q100Need = 0
				V.q100Floor = 0
				V.hpMdS = 0.6
				V.mdsW = 0.2
				V.jFlagLead = 0.05
				V.landExtra = 0.06

				V.applyTiming = function()
					local _ = type(X) == "table" and X.sheriff and X.sheriff.shotTiming
					if _ == "Instant" then
						V.quick100, V.maxThink = true, 0.1
					else
						V.quick100, V.maxThink = false, 0.8
					end
				end
				pcall(V.applyTiming)
				V.need = function(_)
					local q = math.clamp(_ / 0.6, 0, 1)
					return 0.55 - 0.3 * q ^ 1.5
				end
				V.autoNeedFor = function(_, q)
					if V.dsHot(V.target) then
						return math.max(V.dsNeedMin or 0.3, (V.dsNeed or 0.6) - 2 * (os.clock() - V.ds.backAt))
					end
					if V.spHot(V.target) then
						return math.max(V.dsNeedMin or 0.3, (V.dsNeed or 0.6) - 2 * (os.clock() - V.sp.endAt))
					end
					if V.autoPatient == false then
						return V.needFor(_, q)
					end
					local h = V.quick100
					V.quick100 = false
					local y, Q = pcall(V.needFor, _, q)
					V.quick100 = h
					Q = y and Q or 0.5
					if _ and (_.fast or _.anom) then
						Q = math.max(Q, V.autoFastNeed or 0.45)
					end
					if V.autoCalmV and q < (V.autoCalmMax or 2.5) then
						local _ = V.hist
						if _ and #_ > 1 and V.pathSpeed(_, _[#_].t, V.autoCalmWin or 0.2) > V.autoCalmV then
							Q = math.max(Q, V.autoCalmNeed or 2)
						end
					end
					return Q
				end
				V.pathSpeed = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h)
					local y, Q, I = 0, nil, nil
					for C = #_, 1, -1.0 do
						local H = _[C]
						if q - H.t > h then
							break
						end
						if Q then
							y += Vector3.new(Q.X - H.p.X, 0, Q.Z - H.p.Z).Magnitude
						end
						Q, I = H.p, H.t
					end
					if not I or q - I < 0.05 then
						return 0
					end
					return y / (q - I)
				end)
				V.needFor = function(_, q)
					if V.quick100 == true then
						if _ and (_.fast or _.anom) and q < (V.cheatWait or 0) then
							return V.cheatNeed or 0.6
						end
						local h, y = V.q100Need or 0.6, V.q100Floor or 0.15
						return h - (h - y) * math.clamp(q / (V.q100Ramp or 0.07), 0, 1)
					end
					local h = V.need(q)
					if _ and _.spike and V.spikeImm == true then
						return math.min(h, 0.15)
					end
					if _ and (_.anom or _.fast) and V.anomImm == true then
						return math.min(h, 0.15)
					end
					if _ and _.takeoff and V.takeHold and q < V.takeHold and not (_.fast or _.fresh) then
						return 2
					end
					if _ and _.air and V.airPat ~= false and V.modern ~= false and not (_.fast or _.fresh) then
						if q < (_.takeoff and V.takeT or V.airPatT or 0.8) then
							return V.airPatNeed or 0.95
						end
						local y = V.airPatT2 == nil and 1.1 or V.airPatT2
						if y and q < y then
							return V.airPatNeed2 or 0.6
						end
						return 0
					end
					if _ and _.frozenT and V.frzWait == true then
						if q < (V.frzWaitT or 0.6) then
							return V.frzNeed or 0.95
						end
						return 0
					end
					if _ and V.quick ~= false and not (_.fast or _.fresh) then
						local y = V.modern == false and 0.6 or (V.quickNeed or 0.7)
						if _.lowTrust and V.trustScale ~= false then
							y = V.quickNeedLie or 0.6
						end
						if q < (V.quickWin or 0.3) then
							return y
						end
						local Q = V.quickWin2 == nil and 0.8 or V.quickWin2
						if Q and q < Q then
							local I = math.min(y, V.quickNeed2 or 0.7)
							local y = V.quickRampTo == nil and 0.55 or V.quickRampTo
							if y then
								local C = V.quickWin or 0.3
								I = I + (math.min(y, I) - I) * math.clamp((q - C) / math.max(Q - C, 0.001), 0, 1)
							end
							return I
						end
						return 0
					end
					if _ and _.air and V.airWait ~= false then
						if q < 0.75 then
							return 0.9
						end
						if q < 0.9 then
							return 0.6
						end
						return 0.25
					end
					if V.groundWait ~= false then
						if q < 0.35 then
							return 0.9
						end
						if q < 0.7 then
							return 0.75
						end
						if q < 0.9 then
							return 0.5
						end
						return 0.25
					end
					return h
				end
				V.flushQueue = PULSE_NV(function()
					local _ = V.queued
					if not _ then
						return
					end
					local q = os.clock()
					_.clickAt = _.clickAt or q
					_.waitFrom = _.waitFrom or _.clickAt

					if _.hardUntil then

						local y = V.guardInfo()
						V.say(
							string.format(
								"SKIP no plan in %.0fms risky=%s eval=%s anom=%s mz=%s plans=%d best=%.2f nr=%d tm=%d mzw=%d",
								(q - _.clickAt) * 1000,
								tostring(V.riskyN),
								tostring(V.lastEval),
								tostring(V.lastAnom ~= nil),
								y and (y.blocked and "blocked" or (y.guarding and "guard" or "clear")) or "-",
								_.plans or 0,
								_.bestScore or -1.0,
								_.nr or 0,
								_.tm or 0,
								_.mzw or 0
							)
						)
						V.queued = nil
						return
					end
					if not V.ready() then
						_.nr = (_.nr or 0) + 1
						return
					end

						_.tm = (_.tm or 0) + 1
						return

							V.dsArm = { c = _.c, untilT = q + (V.dsArmT or 1.2), needLos = _.needLos }

								_.hardUntil = H

								Q = q + y > h
							end
						end

							_.mzw = (_.mzw or 0) + 1
							return
						end
						_.mzForced = true
					end

						return
					end

					_.plans = (_.plans or 0) + 1

						return
					end

						_.bestScore = I.score
					end

						V.send(I, _.c, _.mzForced and "queue-mz" or "queue", _.clickAt)
					end
				end)
				V.onFired = PULSE_NV(function(_, q, h, y)
					local Q = V.pending
					local I = false
					pcall(function()
						I = typeof(_) == "Instance" and E.Character ~= nil and _:IsDescendantOf(E.Character)
					end)
					if not I then
						return
					end

					V.lastAccepted = os.clock() - V.echo * 0.5
					V.trueAccepted = V.lastAccepted
					if not Q then
						return
					end

					if C < 8 then
						V.say(string.format("accept gap=%.2f", C))
					end

						if typeof(q) == "Vector3" and typeof(h) == "Vector3" and Q.o and Q.e then
							local _ = Q.e - Q.o
							if _.Magnitude > 0.01 then
								local H = _.Unit
								local n = h - Q.o
								local O = (n - H * n:Dot(H)).Magnitude

								if O > 1.5 or H > 0.5 then
									Q.offLine = true
									V.say(
										string.format(
											"ECHO off-line: start moved %.1f, end %.1f st off the sent line, mz=%s",
											H,
											O,
											tostring(Q.mz)
										)
									)

										local function O(N)
											if typeof(N) ~= "Vector3" or N.Magnitude < 0.001 then
												return -1.0
											end
											return math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(n:Dot(N.Unit), -1.0, 1)))
										end
										V.say(
											string.format(
												"ECHO geometry: len=%.0f vs sent=%.0f | angle to hrpLook=%.0f camLook=%.0f (muzzle->e)=%.0f (o->muzzle)=%.0f (o->hrp)=%.0f | end-muzzle=%.0f",
												H.Magnitude,
												_.Magnitude,
												O(q.hl),
												O(q.cl),
												O(q.mz and Q.e - q.mz),
												O(q.mz and q.mz - Q.o),
												O(q.hp and q.hp - Q.o),
												q.mz and (h - q.mz).Magnitude or -1.0
											)
										)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end)
					if C > 2.4 and C < V.cooldown + 0.25 then
						V.cdLo = math.max((V.cdLo or 0) - 0.001, 0)
						V.cooldown = math.clamp(math.max(math.min(V.cooldown, C) - 0.04, V.cdLo), V.cdFloor, 5.5)
					end
					local _ = typeof(y) == "Instance" and Q.c and y:IsDescendantOf(Q.c)
					if _ then
						V.stats.hit += 1
						task.delay(1.5, function()
							pcall(function()
								local _ = Q.c
								local q = _ and r:GetPlayerFromCharacter(_)
								local r = _ and _:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
								local C = q and V.roles()[q.Name]
								local H = not _.Parent
									or r and r.Health <= 0
									or C and (C.Dead or C.Killed)

								V.say("KILL " .. (H and "yes" or "no") .. " " .. y.Name)

						local H = y.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
							or y.Name == "UpperTorso"
							or y.Name == "LowerTorso"
							or y.Name == "Torso"

						local O = H and C.Magnitude > 8 or n > 40
						local C, n
						if
							O
							and q.Magnitude > 1
							and math.abs(q.Unit:Dot(_)) > 0.6
							and typeof(h) == "Vector3"
							and #r > 0
						then
							local O = r[#r]
							for N = -0.15, 0.45, 0.005 do
								local z = Q.t + N
								local D
								if z <= O.t then
									D = V.posAt(r, z)
								else
									D = O.p + q * (z - O.t)
								end
								if D then
									local r = h + _ * 0.5 - D
									local q = (r - _ * r:Dot(_)).Magnitude
									local O = math.abs(r:Dot(_)) + q * 0.25
									if not n or O < n then
										n, C = O, N
									end
								end
							end
						end
						local r = H and 2 or 3
						local _ = C and n and n < r and C or nil
						task.delay(0.7, function()
							if Q.anom then
								return
							end
							if (Q.mvPath or 0) >= (V.tauMissMaxV or 60) and V.tauFastHits ~= true then
								return
							end
							local r, q, H = pcall(V.tauEvidence, Q, true, h, _)
							if r and V.tauShots then
								V.saveState()
								V.say(
									string.format(
										"  tau window %s..%s -> L=%.3f sd=%.3f (shots %d)",
										q and string.format("%.2f", q) or "-",
										H and string.format("%.2f", H) or "-",
										V.L,
										V.Lsd,
										V.tauShots
									)
								)
							end
						end)
						if _ and Q.mode == "nr" then
							V.nrCalib = (V.nrCalib or 0) + 1
							local r = C - V.Lnr - V.pingShift() - (Q.shift or 0)
							V.Lnr = math.clamp(V.Lnr + r * (V.nrCalib < 4 and 0.4 or 0.15), 0, 0.5)
							V.Lnrsd = math.clamp(V.Lnrsd + (math.abs(r) - V.Lnrsd) * 0.2, 0.03, 0.12)
						elseif _ and not Q.anom then
							V.calib = (V.calib or 0) + 1
						end
						if Q.vsSign then
							V.vsLock, V.vsNext, V.vsMiss = Q.vsSign, nil, 0
							V.say(string.format("  spoof resolver: sign %d confirmed", Q.vsSign))
						end
						V.saveState()
						V.record(Q, "hit", h, y.Name)
						V.say(
							string.format(
								"HIT %s part=%s lat=%.0fms mode=%s tau=%s L=%.3f Lnr=%.3f lag=%.3f ping=%.3f",
								Q.kind,
								y.Name,
								I * 1000,
								tostring(Q.mode),
								C and string.format("%.3f", C) or "?",
								V.L,
								V.Lnr,
								(Q.lag or 0) + V.lagRef,
								E:GetNetworkPing()
							)
						)
					else
						V.stats.miss += 1
						if Q.vsSign then
							if V.vsLock then
								V.vsMiss = (V.vsMiss or 0) + 1
								if V.vsMiss >= 3 then
									V.vsLock, V.vsMiss = nil, 0
									V.vsNext = -Q.vsSign
									V.saveState()
								end
							else
								V.vsNext = -Q.vsSign
							end
						end
						V.record(Q, "miss", h, typeof(y) == "Instance" and y:GetFullName() or "nil")
						V.say(
							string.format(
								"MISS %s score=%.3f hit=%s lat=%.0fms",
								Q.kind,
								Q.score or -1.0,
								typeof(y) == "Instance" and y:GetFullName() or "nil",
								I * 1000
							)
						)
						task.delay(0.7, function()
							local r, _, q = false, nil, nil
							if not Q.anom and (Q.mvPath or 0) < (V.tauMissMaxV or 60) then
								r, _, q = pcall(V.tauEvidence, Q, false, h, nil)
							end
							if r and V.tauShots then
								V.saveState()
								V.say(
									string.format(
										"  tau window %s..%s -> L=%.3f sd=%.3f (shots %d)",
										_ and string.format("%.2f", _) or "-",
										q and string.format("%.2f", q) or "-",
										V.L,
										V.Lsd,
										V.tauShots
									)
								)
							end
							local r = V.shotTraj(Q)
							local _ = (Q.e - Q.o).Unit
							local q, h
							for y = 0, 0.6, 0.01 do
								local I = V.posAt(r, Q.t + y)
								if I then
									local C = I + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0) - Q.o
									local I = (C - _ * C:Dot(_)).Magnitude
									if not h or I < h then
										h, q = I, y
									end
								end
							end
							V.say(
								string.format(
									"  miss: closest lateral=%.2f at tau=%.2f top=%s %s",
									h or -1.0,
									q or -1.0,
									tostring(Q.top),
									tostring(Q.info)
								)
							)
							if Q.pred then
								local _ = {}
								for q, h in ipairs({ 0, 0.05, 0.1 }) do
									local y = V.posAt(r, Q.t + h)
									local r = Q.pred[q]
									if y and r then
										_[#_ + 1] = string.format(
											"t%.2f dXZ=%.2f dY=%.2f",
											h,
											Vector3.new(y.X - r.X, 0, y.Z - r.Z).Magnitude,
											y.Y - r.Y
										)
									end
								end
								V.say("  miss pred-vs-actual " .. table.concat(_, " | "))
							end
						end)
					end
				end)
				V.shotTraj = function(r)
					local _ = {}
					for q, q in ipairs(r.pre or {}) do
						_[#_ + 1] = q
					end
					local q = _[#_] and _[#_].t or -math.huge
					for h, h in ipairs(r.post or {}) do
						if h.t > q then
							_[#_ + 1] = h
							q = h.t
						end
					end
					return _
				end
				V.tauGridMin, V.tauGridStep, V.tauGridN = -0.05, 0.01, 51
				V.tauInit = function()
					if type(V.tauLog) == "table" and #V.tauLog == V.tauGridN then
						return
					end
					V.tauLog = {}
					local r, _ = V.L, math.max(V.Lsd * 1.5, 0.05)
					for q = 1, V.tauGridN do
						local h = V.tauGridMin + (q - 1) * V.tauGridStep
						V.tauLog[q] = -0.5 * ((h - r) / _) ^ 2
					end
				end
				V.tauApply = function()
					local r = 0.12 + (V.pingCal or 0.05)
					local _ = {}
					local q = -math.huge
					for h, y in ipairs(V.tauLog) do
						local Q = V.tauGridMin + (h - 1) * V.tauGridStep
						_[h] = y - 0.5 * ((Q - r) / 0.05) ^ 2
						if _[h] > q then
							q = _[h]
						end
					end
					local r, h = {}, 0
					for y, Q in ipairs(_) do
						r[y] = math.exp(Q - q)
						h += r[y]
					end
					local _, q = 0, nil
					local y = 0
					for Q = 1, V.tauGridN do
						local I = V.tauGridMin + (Q - 1) * V.tauGridStep
						y += I * r[Q] / h
						_ += r[Q] / h
						if not q and _ >= 0.5 then
							q = I
						end
					end
					local _ = 0
					for Q = 1, V.tauGridN do
						local I = V.tauGridMin + (Q - 1) * V.tauGridStep
						_ += (I - y) ^ 2 * r[Q] / h
					end
					V.L = math.clamp(q or y, -0.05, 0.45)
					V.Lsd = math.clamp(math.sqrt(_), 0.035, 0.09)
				end
				V.tauEvidence = PULSE_NV(function(r, _, q, h)
					if r.mode == "nr" or not r.body or r.offLine then
						return nil
					end
					local h = V.shotTraj(r)
					if #h < 6 then
						return nil
					end
					V.tauInit()
					local y = r.e - r.o
					local Q = y.Unit
					local I = y.Magnitude + 400
					local y = math.huge
					if not _ and typeof(q) == "Vector3" then
						y = (q - r.o).Magnitude + 0.5
					end
					local q, C = h[1].t, h[#h].t
					local H = (r.pingS or 0) + (r.shift or 0)
					local n, O
					for N = 1, V.tauGridN do
						local z = V.tauGridMin + (N - 1) * V.tauGridStep
						local D = r.t + z + H
						local H
						if D < q or D > C then
							H = _ and 0.6 or 1
						else
							local q = V.posAt(h, D)
							local h, C = V.hitsBody(r.body, q, r.o, Q, I)
							local r = h ~= nil and h < y
							if _ then
								H = r and 1 or 0.1
							else
								H = C and C < y and (V.missCoreLike or 0.3) or (r and (V.missLike or 0.7) or 1)
							end
							if r then
								if not n then
									n = z
								end
								O = z
							end
						end
						V.tauLog[N] = V.tauLog[N] * 0.97 + math.log(H)
					end
					V.tauApply()
					V.tauShots = (V.tauShots or 0) + 1
					return n, O
				end)
				V.meJson = function(r)
					if not r then
						return "null"
					end
					local function _(q)
						return typeof(q) == "Vector3" and string.format("[%.3f,%.3f,%.3f]", q.X, q.Y, q.Z) or "null"
					end
					return string.format(
						'{"hp":%s,"hl":%s,"hd":%s,"mz":%s,"cp":%s,"cl":%s}',
						_(r.hp),
						_(r.hl),
						_(r.hd),
						_(r.mz),
						_(r.cp),
						_(r.cl)
					)
				end
				V.record = function(r, _, q, h)
					task.delay(0.7, function()
						pcall(function()
							local y = V.shotTraj(r)
							local Q = {}
							for I, I in ipairs(y) do
								if I.t >= r.t - 0.6 and I.t <= r.t + 0.65 then
									local y = typeof(I.v) == "Vector3" and I.v or Vector3.zero
									Q[#Q + 1] = string.format(
										"[%.4f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.2f,%.2f,%.1f,%d,%s,%s,%.1f,%.1f,%.1f]",
										I.t - r.t,
										I.p.X,
										I.p.Y,
										I.p.Z,
										I.md.X,
										I.md.Z,
										I.ws,
										I.st.Value,
										I.air and "1" or "0",
										I.jump and "1" or "0",
										y.X,
										y.Y,
										y.Z
									)
								end
							end
							local y = string.format(
								'{"t":%.3f,"kind":"%s","score":%.3f,"res":"%s","part":"%s","o":[%.3f,%.3f,%.3f],"e":[%.3f,%.3f,%.3f],"end":%s,"L":%.3f,"D":%.3f,"k":%.2f,"emd":%.2f,"ecv":%.2f,"reason":"%s","ping":%.3f,"mz":"%s","mv":%.1f,"me":%s,"rows":[%s]}',
								r.t,
								tostring(r.kind),
								r.score or -1.0,
								_,
								tostring(h),
								r.o.X,
								r.o.Y,
								r.o.Z,
								r.e.X,
								r.e.Y,
								r.e.Z,
								typeof(q) == "Vector3" and string.format("[%.3f,%.3f,%.3f]", q.X, q.Y, q.Z) or "null",
								V.L,
								V.D,
								V.k,
								V.err.md,
								V.err.cv,
								tostring(r.reason),
								E:GetNetworkPing(),
								tostring(r.mz),
								r.mvPath or -1.0,
								V.meJson(r.me),
								table.concat(Q, ",")
							)
							if isfile("PulseHub/aimx_shots.jsonl") then
								appendfile("PulseHub/aimx_shots.jsonl", y .. "\n")
							else
								writefile("PulseHub/aimx_shots.jsonl", y .. "\n")
							end
						end)
					end)
				end
				V.stop = function()
					V.alive = false
					for r, r in ipairs(V.conns) do
						pcall(function()
							r:Disconnect()
						end)
					end
				end
				V.start = function(r)
					V.loadState()
					pcall(function()
						if isfolder and makefolder and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
							makefolder("PulseHub")
						end
					end)
					V.logFile = "PulseHub/aimx_log.txt"
					local _ = S:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 10)
					_ = _ and _:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 10)
					_ = _ and _:WaitForChild("GunFired", 10)
					if _ then
						V.conns[#V.conns + 1] = r(_.OnClientEvent, function(...)
							if V.alive then
								pcall(V.onFired, ...)
							end
						end)
					end
					local _, q = 0, 0
					local h = 0
					V.conns[#V.conns + 1] = r(Y.Heartbeat, function()
						if not V.alive then
							return
						end
						if not (V.forced or V.queued) then
							local r = false
							pcall(function()
								local Y = E.Character
								local S = E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
								r = Y ~= nil and Y:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
									or S ~= nil and S:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
							end)
							if not r then
								local r = os.clock()
								if r - h < 0.1 then
									return
								end
								h = r
							end
						end
						pcall(V.track)
						local r = os.clock()
						pcall(V.spTick, r)
						local h = V.spArm
						if h then
							if not (h.c and h.c.Parent) then
								V.spArm = nil
							elseif
								V.target == h.c
								and not V.queued
								and #V.hist >= 8
								and (not V.spActive(h.c) or r > h.untilT)
							then
								V.spArm = nil
								V.say(
									V.spActive(h.c) and "SPOOF no window, plain shot"
										or "SPOOF window, armed click fires"
								)
								V.spPassUntil = r + 0.6
								pcall(V.fireFor, h.c, true, h.needLos)
							end
						end
						local h = V.dsArm
						if h then
							if r > h.untilT or not (h.c and h.c.Parent) then
								V.dsArm = nil
							elseif V.target == h.c and V.dsHot(h.c) and #V.hist >= 8 and not V.queued then
								V.dsArm = nil
								V.say("DESYNC window, armed click fires")
								pcall(V.fireFor, h.c, true, h.needLos)
							end
						end
						if V.hbLast then
							V.frameDt = (V.frameDt or 0.017)
								+ (math.clamp(r - V.hbLast, 0.004, 0.2) - (V.frameDt or 0.017)) * 0.1
						end
						V.hbLast = r
						if V.btCo then
							V.btT = os.clock()
							local h = coroutine.resume(V.btCo)
							if not h or coroutine.status(V.btCo) == "dead" then
								V.btCo = nil
								V.btSlice = false
							end
						elseif V.target and r - _ > 0.1 then
							_ = r
							local _, h = table.clone(V.hist), V.moveParams()
							V.btCo = coroutine.create(function()
								V.btSlice = true
								pcall(V.backtest, _, h)
								V.btSlice = false
							end)
							V.btT = os.clock()
							local _ = coroutine.resume(V.btCo)
							if not _ or coroutine.status(V.btCo) == "dead" then
								V.btCo = nil
								V.btSlice = false
							end
						end
						if V.target and r - q > 0.5 then
							q = r
							local _, q = pcall(V.speedFactor, V.hist)
							if _ then
								V.k = q
							end
						end
						if V.queued then
							pcall(V.flushQueue)
						end
						if V.autoRotateRestore and r > (V.autoRotateUntil or 0) then
							pcall(function()
								V.autoRotateRestore.AutoRotate = true
							end)
							V.autoRotateRestore = nil
						end
						local _ = V.pending
						if
							_
							and not _.dead
							and r - _.t > math.max(0.28, V.echo * 2.5, E:GetNetworkPing() * 2.2 + 0.15)
						then
							_.dead = true
							local q = _.t - (V.trueAccepted or 0)
							local h = E.Character ~= nil and E.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
							if h and q < V.cooldown + 0.6 and not _.anom then
								if q > 2.4 then
									V.cdLo = math.max(V.cdLo or 0, q + 0.03)
								end
								V.cooldown = math.clamp(math.max(V.cooldown + 0.1, V.cdLo or 0), V.cdFloor, 5.5)
								V.lastAccepted = math.max(V.lastAccepted, r - V.cooldown + 0.12)
							end
							V.say(
								string.format(
									"DROP %s cooldown=%.2f since=%.2f held=%s",
									tostring(_.kind),
									V.cooldown,
									q,
									tostring(h)
								)
							)
							if _.manual and _.tries < 3 and _.c and _.c.Parent then
								_.retry = true
								V.queued = {
									c = _.c,
									needLos = false,
									clickAt = r,
									waitFrom = r,
									manual = true,
									hardUntil = r + 0.25,
								}
							end
						end
						if V.forced and (not V.forced.Parent or r - (V.forcedAt or r) > 5) then
							V.forced = nil
						end
					end)
					V.say(string.format("start L=%.3f sd=%.3f D=%.3f", V.L, V.Lsd, V.D))
				end
				V.start(F)
			end
			local function V(r, _, q)
				if X.sheriff.aimVer == "V4" then
					local h = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseAimX")
					if h and h.alive then
						return h.fireFor(r, q == true, not X.sheriff.wallbang)
					end
				end
				local h = t()
				local Y = h and h:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
				if not Y then
					return false
				end
				local h = k(r, q)
				if not (h and h.ok) then
					return false
				end
				local S = r and r:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not (r.Parent and S and S.Health > 0 and t()) then
					return false
				end
				local S, y = h.origin, h.aim
				getgenv().__pulseAim = getgenv().__pulseAim or {}
				getgenv().__pulseAim.bypass = true
				local Q = (y - S).Magnitude < 0.1 and CFrame.new(S) or CFrame.new(S, y)
				local E = pcall(function()
					Y:FireServer(Q, CFrame.new(y))
				end)
				getgenv().__pulseAim.bypass = false
				if E and X.sheriff.aimVer == "V3" then
					local Y = getgenv().__pulseAimV3
					if Y then
						pcall(Y.note, S, y, r, W(r))
					end
				end
				if E and s.armed then
					if not _ then
						s.tries = 0
					end
					local W = U()
					local _ = math.max(0.35, w() * 1.2 + 0.15)
					if X.sheriff.aimVer == "V3" then
						local Y = getgenv().__pulseAimV3
						if Y and Y.stats then
							local y, Q = pcall(Y.stats)
							if y and type(Q) == "table" and type(Q.wire) == "number" and Q.wire > 0.005 then
								_ = math.clamp(Q.wire * 2 + (tonumber(Q.jit) or 0) * 4 + 0.05, 0.18, 0.5)
							end
						end
					end
					local Y = r and r:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					s.pending = {
						char = r,
						t = os.clock(),
						manual = q == true,
						mode = h.mode,
						spd = h.spd,
						ld = h.ld,
						tmo = _,
						originSent = S,
						hrpAt = W and W.Position,
						tgtAt = Y and Y.Position,
						aimAt = h.aim,
					}
				end
				return E == true
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				local W = game:GetService("RunService")
				while isAlive(a) do
					W.Heartbeat:Wait()
					local W = s.pending
					if W then
						local r = W.tmo or math.max(0.35, w() * 1.2 + 0.15)
						if s.confirmT >= W.t then
							if l() then
								pcall(function()
									local w = s.lastHit ~= nil and s.lastHit:IsDescendantOf(W.char)
									local _ = -1.0
									local q = W.char and W.char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
									if q and typeof(s.lastEnd) == "Vector3" then
										_ = (s.lastEnd - q.Position).Magnitude
									end
									local h = os.clock() - W.t
									local Y = -1.0
									if typeof(W.tgtAt) == "Vector3" and typeof(s.lastEnd) == "Vector3" then
										Y = (s.lastEnd - W.tgtAt).Magnitude
									end
									local l = -1.0
									if typeof(s.lastEnd) == "Vector3" and K.part == q then
										local q = K.hist
										local K = os.clock() - h * 0.5
										local S
										for y = #q, 1, -1.0 do
											S = q[y]
											if q[y].t <= K then
												break
											end
										end
										if S then
											l = (s.lastEnd - S.p).Magnitude
										end
									end
									local K = ""
									if typeof(s.lastStart) == "Vector3" then
										local q = typeof(W.originSent) == "Vector3"
												and (s.lastStart - W.originSent).Magnitude
											or 999
										local S = typeof(W.hrpAt) == "Vector3" and (s.lastStart - W.hrpAt).Magnitude
											or 999
										K = string.format(" src=%s(org%.0f/hrp%.0f)", q < S and "ORIGIN" or "HRP", q, S)
									end
									if typeof(W.aimAt) == "Vector3" and typeof(s.lastEnd) == "Vector3" then
										K = K .. string.format(" aimEcho=%.2f", (s.lastEnd - W.aimAt).Magnitude)
									end
									x(

					return false
				end
				local X = G.hrp()
				if not X then
					return false
				end
				T = os.clock()
				while os.clock() - T < 1.2 and F.Parent and not G.gun() and G.alive() do
					pcall(function()
						X.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						X.CFrame = CFrame.new(F.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
					end)
					G.touch(F)
					G.Run.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				local F = G.gun() ~= nil
				G.say(F and "GUN near" or "GUN miss")
				G.toLobby()
				return F
			end
			function G.fling(F)
				local T = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseFlingDown")
				if type(T) ~= "function" then
					return false
				end
				local X, t, R = pcall(T, F, 0.8, { home = G.lobbyCF() })
				G.say("FLING " .. tostring(F.Name) .. " " .. tostring(X and R or t))
				return X and t == true
			end
			function G.hold(F)
				F = F == true
				if F then
					G.acted = true
				end
				if G.holding ~= F then
					G.holding = F
					getgenv().__pulseRoleFarmHold = F or nil
				end
			end
			function G.count(F)
				for T, X in pairs(F) do
					if T ~= A.Name and type(X) == "table" then
						local A = X.Dead == true or X.Killed == true
						if not A then
							G.seen[T] = true
						elseif G.seen[T] then
							G.seen[T] = nil
							if G.state == "Killing" or G.state == "Shooting" and G.target == T then
								G.kills += 1
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			function G.expInnocent(A)
				if G.gun() then
					G.toLobby()
					G.state = "Shooting"
					G.shoot(A)
					return
				end
				local F, T = G.who(A, "sheriff")
				if not T then
					F, T = G.who(A, "hero")
				end
				local A = os.clock()
				if T and A >= G.flingWait and (G.flung[T] or 0) < 4 then
					G.flung[T] = (G.flung[T] or 0) + 1
					G.state = "Flinging"
					local A = G.fling(T)
					G.flingWait = os.clock() + (A and 2.5 or 0.5)
					G.toLobby()
					return
				end
				if G.drop() then
					G.state = "Picking Gun"
					G.grab()
					return
				end
				G.toLobby()
				G.state = "Surviving"
			end
			function G.step()
				local A = G.on
				if not (A.inno or A.sheriff or A.murder or A.exp) then
					G.state, G.role = "Off", nil
					G.hold(false)
					return
				end
				G.hook()
				local F, T = G.mine()
				G.role = F
				if not F or not G.alive() then
					G.state = "Waiting"
					G.hold(false)
					if not F then
						table.clear(G.seen)
					end
					return
				end
				G.count(T)
				local X = F:lower()
				if X:find("murder") then
					if A.murder or A.exp then
						G.hold(true)
						G.state = "Killing"
						G.stabAll(T)
						return
					end
				elseif X == "sheriff" then
					if A.sheriff or A.exp then
						G.hold(true)
						G.toLobby()
						G.state = "Shooting"
						G.shoot(T)
						return
					end
				elseif X == "hero" then
					if A.exp then
						G.hold(true)
						G.toLobby()
						G.state = "Shooting"
						G.shoot(T)
						return
					elseif A.inno then
						G.hold(true)
						G.toLobby()
						G.state = "Surviving"
						return
					end
				else
					if A.exp then
						G.hold(true)
						G.expInnocent(T)
						return
					elseif A.inno then
						G.hold(true)
						G.toLobby()
						G.state = "Surviving"
						return
					end
				end
				G.hold(false)
				G.state = "Waiting"
			end

					return false
				end
				if M.Transparency >= 1 then
					return false
				end
				local c = M:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
				while c do
					if a:GetPlayerFromCharacter(c) then
						return false
					end
					c = c.Parent and c.Parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model") or nil
				end
				return true
			end
			local function a(M, c)

			end
			local function M()
				local c = X.xray.strength

					end
				end
			end

				for K, w in pairs(t) do

				local J = 0
				while B <= #R and J < 180 do
					local K = R[B]
					B = B + 1
					J = J + 1
					if K and K.Parent and t[K] == nil and U(K) then
						local J = K.Transparency
						t[K] = J
						K.Transparency = a(J, G)
					end
				end

					B = 1
				end
			end)

					return
				end
				for N, N in ipairs(n) do
					C(N, O)
					if type(N) == "table" and N._pulseKids then
						local C = true
						if N._pulseState then
							local n, z = pcall(N._pulseState)
							C = n and z == true
						end
						H(N._pulseKids, O and C)
					end
				end
			end
			local function C(n)
				if not n then
					return nil
				end
				local O = l
				local N, z = Y, h
				l = { depth = O and not O.detached and (O.depth or 1) + 1 or 1 }
				local D, b = pcall(n)
				if not D then
					warn("[PulseHub] " .. tostring(b))
				end
				local n = l
				l = O
				Y, h = N, z
				n.detached = nil
				return n
			end
			local function n(O, N)
				if not N then
					return nil
				end
				local z = l
				local D, b = Y, h
				l = { depth = 0, drawer = true }
				Y = O
				Y._pulseCount = 0
				local O, Z = pcall(N)
				if not O then
					warn("[PulseHub] " .. tostring(Z))
				end
				local O = l
				l = z
				Y, h = D, b
				return O
			end
			local function O(N, z)
				local D = 10 ^ math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(z) or 0))
				return math.floor(N * D + 0.5) / D
			end
			local function N(z, D)
				if not z or not z.Container then
					return nil
				end
				return z:Container({ Gap = D or 8, Pad = 2 })
			end
			local function z(D, b)
				if type(D) ~= "table" then
					return
				end
				if D.Title then
					k(D.Title, b)
				end
			end
			function w:SubTabs(D)
				x = {}
				for b, b in ipairs(D or {}) do
					if type(b) == "table" and b.key then
						table.insert(x, b)
					end
				end
				w._subSelectFn = function(D)
					local b, Z = F.novaResolve(M, D, "*")
					local D = K.NovaTabs[b]
					if D then
						pcall(function()
							W:SelectTab(D)
						end)
						if Z then
							pcall(function()
								D:SelectSub(Z)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			function w:LastSection()
				return Y
			end
			function w:Sub(W)
				w._curSub = W
				w._navSub = W
				Y = nil
				h = 1
				u = s[W] == true
			end
			function w:Columns()
				u = true
				s[w._navSub or "-"] = true
				h = 1
				return { Left = nil, Right = nil }
			end
			function w:Group(W)
				W = W or {}
				local u = W.Side or "Left"
				local s = tostring(W.Title or W.Text or "Section")
				local D = tostring(w._navSub or "root") .. "/" .. u .. "/" .. s
				w._groups = w._groups or {}
				local b = w._groups[D]
				if b then
					Y = b.section
					h = u == "Right" and 2 or 1
					w._curSub = s
					return b.handle
				end
				Q(s, u, W.Pin == true)
				w._curSub = s
				local W = Y
				local u = {
					card = W and W.Card or nil,
					header = W and W.Head or nil,
					title = W and W.TitleLabel or nil,
					elements = W and W.Content or nil,
					SetCollapsed = function(s)
						if W then
							W:SetVisible(not s)
						end
					end,
				}
				w._groups[D] = { section = W, handle = u }
				return u
			end
			local function W(u, s)
				local h = #x > 0 and (w._navSub or x[1].key) or w._navSub
				local x, D = F.novaResolve(M, h, s)
				local M = K.NovaTabs[x] or J
				if D and not (M.SubButtons and M.SubButtons[D]) then
					D = nil
				end
				if not D and M.SubDefs then
					D = M.SubDefs[1].key
				end
				return u._pulseTarget == x .. "/" .. tostring(D)
			end
			local function J(M)
				pcall(function()
					local K = M.Tab.Sections
					for u = #K, 1, -1.0 do
						if K[u] == M then
							table.remove(K, u)
						end
					end
					M.Page.Load[M.Side] = math.max(0, M.Page.Load[M.Side] - 1);
					(M.Wrap or M.Card):Destroy()
				end)
			end
			local function M(K, u)
				if type(K) ~= "table" or not K.TitleLabel then
					return false
				end
				if not W(K, u) then
					J(K)
					if Y == K then
						Y = nil
					end
					return false
				end
				pcall(function()
					local J = F.NovaSectionIcons[u]
					if J and K.HeadIcon then
						V.Icons.apply(K.HeadIcon, J)
					end
				end)
				K._pulseText = u
				pcall(function()
					for F = #B.reg, 1, -1.0 do
						if B.reg[F].inst == K.TitleLabel then
							table.remove(B.reg, F)
						end
					end
				end)
				k(K.TitleLabel, u)
				return true
			end
			function w:Header(F, J)
				if
					Y
					and not l
					and (Y._pulseCount or 0) == 0
					and (J == nil or y(J) == nil or y(J) == "Right" == (Y.Side == 2))
				then
					if M(Y, F) then
						return Y.Card
					end
				end
				local K = Q(F, J)
				return K and K.Card or nil
			end
			function w:Note(F)
				F = F or {}

			function w:Toggle(F)
				local J = not F.NoSave and c(F.Text) or nil
				if J then
					T[J] = F.Default == true
				end
				local K = J and q(J, "boolean")
				if K ~= nil then
					F.Default = K
				end
				local K = F.Default == true
				local W = _()
				local u = nil
				local s
				pcall(function()
					s = W:Toggle({
						Text = S(F.Text),
						Desc = F.Desc and S(F.Desc) or nil,
						Default = K,
						Tooltip = F.Tooltip and S(F.Tooltip) or nil,
						Indent = E(),
						Locked = F.Locked,
						Drawer = F.Settings ~= nil,
						Callback = function(W)
							K = W == true
							L(J, K)
							if F.Callback then
								F.Callback(K)
							end
						end,
					})
				end)
				z(s, F.Text)
				if s and s.DescLabel and F.Desc then
					k(s.DescLabel, F.Desc)
				end
				I(s)
				local W = {
					Row = s and s.Row or nil,
					Get = function()
						return K
					end,
					Set = function(h)
						K = h == true
						L(J, K)
						if s then
							pcall(s.SetSilent, s, K)
						end
						if F.Callback then
							F.Callback(K)
						end
					end,
					SetSilent = function(h)
						K = h == true
						L(J, K)
						if s then
							pcall(s.SetSilent, s, K)
						end
					end,
				}
				if J then
					A[J] = function(J)
						W.Set(J == true)
					end
				end
				if F.Settings then
					if s and s.Drawer then
						u = n(s.Drawer, F.Settings)
					else
						u = C(F.Settings)
						H(u, K)
					end
				end
				pcall(function()
					if F.Callback then
						F.Callback(K)
					end
				end)
				return W
			end
			function w:Slider(F)
				local J, K = F.Min or 0, F.Max or 1
				local W = F.Decimals or 0
				local u = not F.NoSave and c(F.Text) or nil
				if u then
					T[u] = tonumber(F.Default)
				end
				local s = u and q(u, "number")
				if s ~= nil then
					F.Default = math.clamp(s, J, K)
				end
				local s = O(math.clamp(tonumber(F.Default) or J, J, K), W)
				local h = _()
				local x
				pcall(function()
					x = h:Slider({
						Text = S(F.Text),
						Min = J,
						Max = K,
						Default = s,
						Decimals = W,
						Suffix = F.Suffix or "",
						Tooltip = F.Tooltip and S(F.Tooltip) or nil,
						Indent = E(),
						Display = F.Display,
						Callback = function(W)
							s = W
							L(u, W)
							if F.Callback then
								F.Callback(W)
							end
						end,
					})
				end)
				z(x, F.Text)
				I(x)
				local W = {
					Row = x and x.Row or nil,
					Get = function()
						return s
					end,
					Set = function(h)
						h = math.clamp(tonumber(h) or J, J, K)
						s = h
						L(u, h)
						if x then
							pcall(x.SetSilent, x, h)
						end
						if F.Callback then
							F.Callback(h)
						end
					end,
					Refresh = function()
						if x then
							pcall(x.SetSilent, x, s)
						end
					end,
				}
				if u then
					A[u] = function(J)
						if tonumber(J) then
							W.Set(J)
						end
					end
				end
				if F.Settings then
					C(F.Settings)
				end
				if F.Callback then
					F.Callback(s)
				end
				return W
			end
			function w:Dropdown(F)
				local J = not F.NoSave and c(F.Text) or nil
				if J then
					T[J] = F.Default
				end
				local K, W = {}, {}
				for u, u in ipairs(F.Options or {}) do
					local s = tostring(u.label or u.code)
					table.insert(K, { code = u.code, label = S(s) })
					W[u.code] = s
				end
				local u = J and q(J, "string")
				if u ~= nil and W[u] then
					F.Default = u
				end
				local u = F.Default
				local s = _()
				local h
				pcall(function()
					h = s:Dropdown({
						Text = S(F.Text),
						Options = K,
						Default = u,
						Tooltip = F.Tooltip and S(F.Tooltip) or nil,
						Indent = E(),
						Callback = function(K)
							if K == nil then
								return
							end
							u = K
							L(J, K)
							if F.Callback then
								F.Callback(K)
							end
						end,
					})
				end)
				z(h, F.Text)
				I(h)
				pcall(function()
					local K = function()
						local s = {}
						for x, x in ipairs(F.Options or {}) do
							table.insert(s, { code = x.code, label = B.tr(tostring(x.label or x.code)) })
						end
						h:SetOptions(s)
					end
					table.insert(getgenv().__pulseNovaLangHooks, K)
				end)
				local K = {
					Row = h and h.Row or nil,
					Get = function()
						return u
					end,
					Set = function(s)
						if W[s] == nil then
							return
						end
						u = s
						L(J, s)
						if h then
							pcall(h.Set, h, s, true)
						end
						if F.Callback then
							pcall(F.Callback, s)
						end
					end,
					SetOptions = function(s)
						F.Options = s
						W = {}
						local x = {}
						for k, k in ipairs(s or {}) do
							local s = tostring(k.label or k.code)
							W[k.code] = s
							table.insert(x, { code = k.code, label = S(s) })
						end
						if h then
							pcall(h.SetOptions, h, x)
						end
					end,
				}
				if J then
					A[J] = function(J)
						K.Set(J)
					end
				end
				if F.Settings then
					C(F.Settings)
				end
				pcall(function()
					if F.Callback then
						F.Callback(u)
					end
				end)
				return K
			end
			function w:Colorpicker(F)
				local J = not F.NoSave and c(F.Text) or nil
				local K = typeof(F.Default) == "Color3" and F.Default or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				if J then
					T[J] = select(
				2,
						pcall(function()
							return K:ToHex()
						end)
					)
				end
				local W = J and q(J, "string")
				if type(W) == "string" then
					local u, s = pcall(Color3.fromHex, W)
					if u and typeof(s) == "Color3" then
						K = s
					end
				end
				local function W(u)
					if not J then
						return
					end
					pcall(function()
						U[J] = u:ToHex()
					end)
				end
				local u = _()
				local s
				pcall(function()
					s = u:Colorpicker({
						Text = S(F.Text),
						Default = K,
						Alpha = F.Alpha == true,
						DefaultAlpha = F.DefaultAlpha,
						Indent = E(),
						Callback = function(u, h)
							if typeof(u) ~= "Color3" then
								return
							end
							K = u
							W(u)
							if F.Callback then
								F.Callback(u, h)
							end
						end,
					})
				end)
				z(s, F.Text)
				I(s)
				local u = {
					Row = s and s.Row or nil,
					Get = function()
						return K
					end,
					Set = function(h)
						if typeof(h) ~= "Color3" then
							return
						end
						K = h
						W(h)
						if s then
							pcall(s.SetSilent, s, h)
						end
						if F.Callback then
							F.Callback(h)
						end
					end,
					SetAlpha = function(W)
						if s then
							pcall(s.SetSilent, s, K, W)
						end
					end,
				}
				if J then
					A[J] = function(J)
						if type(J) ~= "string" then
							return
						end
						local W, s = pcall(Color3.fromHex, J)
						if W then
							u.Set(s)
						end
					end
				end
				if F.Settings then
					C(F.Settings)
				end
				pcall(function()
					if F.Callback then
						F.Callback(K, F.DefaultAlpha)
					end
				end)
				return u
			end

			function w:ToggleKey(F)
				local J = not F.NoSave and c(F.Text) or nil
				if J then
					T[J] = F.Default == true

					local q = getgenv().__pulseBindFromName(u)
					if q then
						c = q
					end
				end
				local q = _()

				pcall(function()
					s = q:Toggle({
						Text = S(F.Text),

						Indent = E(),

							if F.OnBind then
								task.defer(function()

								end)
							end
						end,
						Callback = function(q)
							K = q == true
							L(J, K)
							if F.Callback then
								F.Callback(K)
							end
						end,
					})
				end)
				z(s, F.Text)

						u = C(F.Settings)

					end
				end
				local q = {
					Row = s and s.Row or nil,
					Get = function()
						return K
					end,
					Set = function(u)
						K = u == true
						L(J, K)
						if s then
							pcall(s.SetSilent, s, K)
						end
						if F.Callback then
							F.Callback(K)
						end
					end,
				}
				if J then
					A[J] = function(J)
						q.Set(J == true)
					end
				end
				T[W] = typeof(F.Bind) == "EnumItem" and F.Bind.Name or ""

					if s and s.Bind and s.Bind.Set then
						pcall(s.Bind.Set, T)

						U[W] = T and T.Name or ""
						if F.OnBind then
							task.defer(function()
								pcall(F.OnBind, T)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
				pcall(function()
					if F.Callback then
						F.Callback(K)
					end
				end)
				if F.OnBind then
					task.defer(function()
						pcall(F.OnBind, c)
					end)
				end
				return q
			end
			function w:Section(A)
				A = A or {}
				local F
				if Y and not l and (Y._pulseCount or 0) == 0 and M(Y, A.Text or "Section") then
					F = Y
				else
					F = Q(A.Text)
				end
				local T = A.Toggle == true
				local J
				if F and (A.Toggle ~= nil or A.OnToggle ~= nil) then
					pcall(function()
						J = F:Toggle({
							Text = S(A.Text),
							Default = T,
							Callback = function(U)
								T = U == true
								if A.OnToggle then
									pcall(A.OnToggle, T)
								end
							end,
						})
					end)
					z(J, A.Text)
					I(J)
				end
				return {
					Native = F,
					Capture = function(A, A)
						if A then
							pcall(A)
						end
					end,
					SetOpen = function(A)
						if F then
							F:SetVisible(A ~= false)
						end
					end,
					IsOpen = function()
						return F and not F.Hidden or false
					end,
					SetToggle = function(A)
						T = A == true
						if J then
							pcall(J.SetSilent, J, T)
						end
					end,
				}
			end

				A = A or {}
				local F = _()
